tei:div.tei:p: ra 6 77777 /rgya 7 rgya0770 0 ba ṇaca gli ciX ba bab jaX ba —7 jib 'ji

rgyud 'bum/ sgomi (78)0395 rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba/ 3dang po/ de kho na nyid snang ba dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rim par phye ba/ 3gnyis pa/ sgyu ma chen pos rnam par 'phrul pa'i sngags kyi cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 10gsum pa/ klu thams cad dgug pa'i rim par phye ba/ 16bzhi pa/ las thams cad kyi tshogs rab tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rim par phye ba/ 26lnga pa/ klu thams cad dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rim par phye ba/ 35drug pa/ klu'i sngags thams cad kyi rab tu sbyor ba'i rim par phye ba/ 39bdun pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi brda'i rim par phye ba/ 44brgyad pa/ lag pa'i phyag rgya'i sbyor ba dang / sos btab pa'i mtshan ma

la sogs pa'i rim par phye ba/ 46dgu pa/ 'khrul 'khor thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 48bcu pa/ dbugs brtsi ba'i rim par phye ba/ 61bcu gcig pa/ sgyu ma kun tu rnam par 'phrul pa'i rim par phye ba/ 77bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 81bcu gsum pa/ dpa' bo'i gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa dang / las kyi tshogs rnams 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 84bcu bzhi pa/ dpa' bo gnyis su med pa'i gnas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 86bco lnga pa/ sku gsum dang sngags dang rgyud kyi 'byung ba dang / 'chi ba blu ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 89bcu drug pa/ dpa' bo thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i 'khor lo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 93bcu bdun pa/ bcud kyis len gyi cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 106bco brgyad pa/ 'du pa'i gnas nges pa dang / sgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 114bcu dgu pa/ 'byung bo dang gdon thams cad kyi sgrub thabs 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 122nyi shu pa/ rtsa ba dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dbugs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 133nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ gong du 'pho ba'i bsam gtan dang / seng ge rnam par rol pa'i phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 138nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi ngag gi phyag rgya'i brda yis rol pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 1422

nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ gza' dang nyi ma'i nges par 'chi ba tshar gcad pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rim par phye ba/ 144nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ gza' rnams kyi rgyu ba dang sde tshan gyi ltas kyi cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 146nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ thams cad rgyu ba'i rim par phye ba/ 1gnyi shu rtsa drug pa/ dus 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 151nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ skar ma rnams kyi stobs la dbang ba'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 153nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ tshes grangs dang skar ma'i nges pa rim par phye ba/ 155nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ ye shes 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 157sum cu pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 158sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i mtshan nyid dang tshad kyi cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 160sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ bla ma'i bsnyen bkur dang / dam tshig dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 165sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ sngags kyi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 169sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i brda'i rim par phye ba/ 172sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ ho ru ma'i rnam par rol pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 173sum cu rtsa drug pa/ brda yis rol pa dang dam tshig dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 174sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ mtshon cha thams cad kyi brda'i ye shes kyi go cha'i rim par phye ba/ 174sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ pho nya gdul ba'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 1763

sum cu rtsa dgu pa/ stobs skyed pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 177bzhi bcu pa/ 'bras bu bcos ma'i phyag rgya'i ye shes kyi rim par phye ba/ 185bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ ā li kā li'i sngags kyi sgrub thabs 'byung ba'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 191bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ gsang ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa de kho na nyid 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba/ 210bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ las thams cad kyi bsam gtan 'byung ba dang sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 221bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ ro langs sgrub pa dang / nang gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 224bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ bzlas pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 227bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa/ sa gzung ba dang / sta gon la gnas pa dang /thig bri ba'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 228bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa/ bcud kyis len gyi rdzas kyi dbang du byas pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 236bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ las thams cad kyi gsang chen sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 244bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa/ bcud kyis len gyi sbyor ba dang / sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba/ 254lnga bcu pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbugs dbyung ba dang / rang bzhin nyid nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 285rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ga ya dha ra dang /bod kyi zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te/ dpe gnyis la gtugs nas gtan la phab/

bsdur mchan/(297) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(371)0396 rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i rgyud phyi ma/ 372le'u dang po/ 372le'u gnyis pa/ 380le'u gsum pa/ 386le'u bzhi pa/ 388le'u lnga pa/ 389le'u drug pa/ 389le'u bdun pa/ 390le'u brgyad pa/ 390le'u dgu pa/ 391le'u bcu pa/ 391le'u bcu gcig pa/ 392le'u bcu gnyis pa/ 392le'u bcu gsum pa/ 396le'u bcu bzhi pa/ 396rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mchog gi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyis grom pa ru lag rgyang phu'i lha ri mo'i mgul gyi dben gnas su bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(401) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(403)0397 dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po zhes bya ba/ 4045

dang po/ ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 404gnyis pa/ rdo rje phag mo skyed pa dang gtso mo dang 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang / dkyil 'khor sgom pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 412gsum pa/ mkha' 'gro ma skyed pa'i mtshan nyid dang / bde ba la kun du spyod pa'i las kyi de kho na nyid kyi rnam par gzhag pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 432bzhi pa/ lā ma bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid dang sngags dgod pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ba drug la sogs pa'i rang bzhin dang mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa'i rnam par gzhag pa'i le'u/ 437lnga pa/ dum skyes ma'i mtshan nyid dang skyed pa dang / 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa'i rnam par gzhag pa'i ming mdor bstan pa dang / sngags dgod pa la sogs pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 443drug pa/ gzugs can ma'i mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin/ rtsa'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhin dang gnas kyi rnam par gzhag pa dang rgyud kyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 447bdun pa/ khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i srog skyed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 451brgyad pa/ lug gdong ma'i nges pa'i tshul dang yang dag pa'i cho ga las skyed pa dang srog la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 455dgu pa/ khyi gdong ma'i mtshan nyid dang bde ba la sogs pa'i gnas skabs kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 459bcu pa/ phag gdong ma dang skyed pa dang dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa la sogs pa'i le'u/ 462bcu gcig pa/ gshin rje brtan ma'i rnam par gzhag pa dang skyed pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 4676

bcu gnyis pa/ gshin rje pho nya mo skyed pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang 'chi ba bslu ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'i man ngag mdor bsdus pa'i le'u/ 469bcu gsum pa/ gshin rje mche ba ma'i rab tu sbyor ba la 'jug pa 'chi ba bslu ba la sogs pa'i le'u/ 473bcu bzhi pa/ gshin rje 'joms ma 'jug pa skyed pa dang dus su 'chi ba bslu ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid dang sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs kyi rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 476bco lnga pa/ bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par gzhag pa dang man ngag sna tshogs bstan pa'i le'u/ 480gnyis pa/ snying po'i 'khor lo/ 480gsum pa/ yon tan gyi 'khor lo/ 487dang po/ nam mkha'i 'khor lo/ 489gnyis pa/ rlung gi 'khor lo/ 490gsum pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa 491dang po/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phar ma'i me'i 'khor lo/ dzinaganyis pa/ chu'i 'khor lo/ 494gsum pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ 495dang po/ thugs kyi 'khor lo/ 496gnyis pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo/ 497gsum pa/ sku yi 'khor lo/ 498bcu drug pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags btu ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 505bcu bdun pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang phag mo'i go cha skyed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 530bco brgyad pa/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i go cha srung ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 531bcu dgu pa/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug la sogs pa'i srung ba go cha'i sngags 7

gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 533nyi shu pa/ ho ru ka la sogs pa'i srung ba'i go cha'i cho ga'i le'u/ 534nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rdo rje nyi ma la sogs pa'i go cha'i srung ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 536nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rta mchog la sogs pa'i go cha'i srung ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 537nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ gtor ma dang 'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 539nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor dang sbyin sreg dang slob dpon mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 542nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa dang de bzhin du rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 548nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ rab tu gtum mo bdag po'i dkyil 'khor du rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo rnams kyi phyag rgya'i brda yis gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i spyod yul gyi le'u/ 552nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ gtum mig ma'i mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya dang bdag po'i rang bzhin gyi cho ga'i le'u/ 558nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ 'od ldan ma'i mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya'i cho ga'i le'u/ 560nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ sna chen ma'i mtshan nyid kyi brda'i cho ga'i nges pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 562sum cu pa/ phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi ming zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 565sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ mi'u thung ma'i yi ge'i brda'i mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi ye shes zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 567sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ lang ma'i dbang phyug ma'i phyas rgya'i brda'i mtshan nyid dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin dang ming gi cho ga'i 8

yeshes kyi le'u/ 570sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ shing grib ma'i rang gi mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya'i brda'i cho ga'i nges pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 573sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ sa srung ma'i sku'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 576sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ 'jigs byed chen mo'i nang gi phyag rgya'i cho ga 'chad pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 579sum cu rtsa drug pa/ rlung shugs ma'i kha dog gi phyag rgya'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 580sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ chang 'thung ma'i rab tu sbyor ba'i brda'i rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 582sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med pa'i ljang lha mo'i dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg dang 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 585sum cu rtsa dgu pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags dang / shin tu bzang mo gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i bdag nyid can rta'i sngags mdor bstan pa rigs kyi klu'i las kyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 591bzhi bcu pa/ rta rna ma dang dpa' bo gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas go cha dang rtsa ba'i sngags kyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi bsad pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 594bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ bya gdong ma dang dpa' bo gnyis su med pa'i smyo bar byed pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i snying po'i sngags dang bcas pa'i las zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 598bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'i rengs par bya ba'i las dpa' bo dang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi rang

bzhin zhes bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 601bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ dum skyes ma'i rab tu sbyor ba sgom pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskrad pa'i las rnal 'byor ma drug gi go cha'i sngags kyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 604bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ chang 'tshong ma'i rab tu sbyor bas dbye ba'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 607bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ 'khor lo'i go cha ma'i lkugs par bya ba'i rab tu sbyor ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid dang 'khor lo sgom pa dang dpa' bo dang gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor srin po'i rnam pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 609bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa/ shin tu dpa' mo'i zhi ba'i las kyi rab tu sbyor ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa dang gnod mdzes kyi sngags kyi las kyi tshogs zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 613bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa/ stobs chen ma'i sbyor bas srung ba chen po phur bu'i sngags kyi las byang chub sems dpa'i 'khrul 'khor sgom pa'i man ngag gi cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 616bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ 'khor los sgyur ma'i rab tu sbyor ba la sogs pa las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa'i lam dang rdza rnga'i sngags mdor bstan pa'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 618bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa/ brtson 'grus chen mo'i rab tu sbyor ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid gsang ba'i bcud len la sogs pa dang rgyas pa'i las dpal yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ho ru ma'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 622lnga bcu pa/ de kho na nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid rgyud thams cad kyi don 10

ston pa po gsang chen thams cad pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 630rab tu byed pa dang po/ thod pa'i dum bu can gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid kyi sgrub pa'i thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi ming can bstan pa/ 630rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ bong bu'i rnal 'byor la keng rus chen po sgom pa po'i man ngag de kho na nyid dang ldan pa bstan pa/ 639rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ keng rus kyi cho ga bstan pa/ 642rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i cho ga bstan pa/ 650rab tu byed pa lnga pa/ lha dgra yi cho ga bstan pa/ 658rab tu byed pa drug pa/ 'od dpag med kyi cho ga bstan pa/ 661rab tu byed pa bdun pa/ rdo rje 'od kyi cho ga bstan pa/ 664rab tu byed pa brgyad pa/ rdo rje sku'i cho ga bstan pa/ 670rab tu byed pa dgu pa/ rdo rje myu gu can gyi cho ga bstan pa/ 674rab tu byed pa bcu pa/ rdo rje ral pa can gyi cho ga bstan pa/ 677rab tu byed pa bcu gcig pa/ dpa' bo chen po'i cho ga bstan pa/ 678rab tu byed pa bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje snye mdzad kyi cho ga bstan pa/ 680rab tu byed pa bcu gsum pa/ shin tu bzang po'i cho ga bstan pa/ 682rab tu byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ rdo rje bzang po'i cho ga bstan pa/ 683rab tu byed pa bco lnga pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i cho ga bstan pa/ 685rab tu byed pa bcu drug pa/ mig mi bzang gi cho ga bstan pa/ 687rab tu byed pa bcu bdun pa/ stobs po'i che'i cho ga bstan pa/ 689rab tu byed pa bco brgyad pa/ rin chen rdo rje'i cho ga bstan pa/ 690rab tu byed pa bcu dgu pa/ rta mgrin gyi cho ga bstan pa/ 692rab tu byed pa nyi shu pa/ nam mkha'i snying po'i cho ga bstan pa/ 694rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dpal he ru ma'i cho ga bstan pa/ 695rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ pad+ma gar dbang gi cho ga bstan pa/ 697rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi cho ga bstan pa/ 699rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ gnas thams cad kyi bdag nyid can bstan pa/ 70011

rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ 702lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ bstod pa dang mchod pa bzhi la sogs pa gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig bstan pa'i le'u/ 704dpal rdo rje phag mo'i zhabs kyi chu skyes kyi rdul la reg pa shākya'i sras po rgyal ba'i sde'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong dharma yon tan gyis mnyan cing bsgyur/phyis gang zag chos kyi spyan can dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje'i bka'i tshul dang yang bstun te zhu gtugs legs par byas/bsdur mchan/(709) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(773)0398 dpal bde mchog 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ 774dang po/ zhus pa'i le'u/ 774gnyis pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 776gsum pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 779bzhi pa/ 'byung ba bzhi dang rnam pa lnga dang / yul drug lha'i rnam par dag pa rim par phye ba/ 781lnga pa/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i man ngag gi rim par phye ba/ 784drug pa/ lam lnga nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 791bdun pa/ rtsa'i 'khor lo'i thabs rim par phye ba/ 792brgyad pa/ dam tshig gi brda'i cho ga rim par phye ba/ 794dgu pa/ brda dang gnas la sogs pa'i brdas sa rnams nges par bstan 12

pa'i rim par phye ba/ 798bcu pa/ las rab 'byam 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 801bcu gcig pa/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i nges pa bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 807bcu gnyis pa/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i bgrang phreng nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 809bcu gsum pa/ dpal he ru ga'i bskyed pa'i rim par phye ba/ 811bcu bzhi pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 815bco lnga pa/ snod kyi mtshan nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 817bcu drug pa/ bdud rtsi lnga sgrub pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 819bcu bdun pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 821bco brgyad pa/ dbang bskur ba'i rim par phye ba/ 825bcu dgu pa/ 'chi ba'i ltas lta ba dang 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor rim par phye ba/ 829nyi shu pa/ dus bzhi po nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 832nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ spyod pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 833nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ lha rnams rab tu gnas pa'i rim par phye ba/ 836nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ sbyin sreg nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 838nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ las rab 'byam gyi sman gyi rab tu sbyor ba nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 844nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bcud kyis len gyi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 850nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ myos byed nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 852nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ sngags btu ba'i cho ga rim par phye ba/ 857nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 86313

nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 866sum cu pa/ ri mo la sogs pa'i sku'i mtshan nyid nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 868so gcig pa/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / 'khor lo bzhi yi rim pa dang /byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 871so gnyis pa/ gtor ma'i mchod pa bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 875rim par phye ba so gsum pa/ 879rgya gar gyi mkhan po gzhan la phan pa mtha' yas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rgyus brje smon lam grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan sladro sdu/ yo/ ngas su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na'i rgya dpe la gtugs nas lots+tsha ba gzhon nu dpal gyis kyang zhus/bsdur mchan/(884) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(911)

spa/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba/91)༄ho /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ḍā ka ②nā ma ma hā tan+t+ra rā dzā / bod skad du/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes ④pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag (petu bzhugs/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /lhag pa yi ni lha gcig 56nyenyid / /'byung gnas sgra tshul nges 'byung rnams/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul yin / /'jig ༅rten gsum du rnyed dka' nib/ /thog ma dbus mthar yang dag gnas/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgya/ /'di ni gnyis med 1)ye shes mchog /rnyed 7dang bde ba kun mos pas/ /ngan par spyod pa'ang 'grub par 78—3

'gyur / /nam mkha' kun tu rgyu grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /sna tshogs kun tu phyag rgya ni/ /sna tshogs kun gyi ①sdom pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes byar grub/ /de nyid med sems rnal 'byor pa/ /lha la dmigs par byed pa dag② /kun tu gzugs brnyan yid kyis ni/ /lugs ①sogs rnal 'byor skye ba min④/ /byang chub sems can 95)rnal 'byor gang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rang nyid gtso/ /byang gyechub sems 'di rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag rang bzhin gyis/ /sna tshogs g.yogs te rnam bzhugs pas/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis stimachod par bya/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo thams cad nyid ⑧yin te/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo thams cad nyid dang ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du/ /tshe 'di nyid du 'grub 'gyur zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /dpal ldan bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa'i/ /'gro kun sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi/ /'gro ba dmigs su med pa ste/ /mthong ba dang ni reg ⑨pa'i dngos/ /thams cad sgyu ma ji bzhin no/ /gang gis blun po 'ching 'gyur ba/ /'dir des mkhas rnams rnam par grol/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sa gsum ma lus bza' bar bya/ /gzhan du gal te sbyor ba ni/ /ma tshang mar me lta bur 78—4

'da' / /gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba rdo je nyi ma yin/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang ste/ /'du byed rdo rje rgyal po yin/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /'di dag dngos kun rang bzhin ni①/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes byar grags/ /yang dag chen po gcig pu'i ②lha/ /bde ba thams cad rab ster ba/ /sgyu ma chen po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /chags bral chags pa zhes byar bshad / /sa khams lhung byed ma yin te/ /de bzhin chu khams gsod chama'o/ /me khams 'gugs byed ma yin te/ /de bzhin rlung ni gar dbang ngo / /nam mkha'i khams ni sgyu ma che/ /rang nyid 'gro ma zhes byar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni 'bar ba'i mchog /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /de ni rdo rje gtso mor ④gnas/ /mig gnyis gti mug rdo rjer bshad/ /nyan pa zhe snang phyirdo rjer ⑥brjod/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje ste/ /kha ni 'dod chags rdo rjer gsungs/ /lus ni phrag dog rdo rje ste/ /skye mched thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo (perje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /gzugs 'di thams cad stong pa nyid/ /stong pa'i tshul gyi ⑧mig gis ni/ /dogs pa med par bsgom ⑨pa'i mchog /rnam par mi rtog pa yis blta/ /nam mkha'i tshul gyi sems kyis ni/ /der ni thams cad nam mkha'i dngos/ /dogs pa med pa'i bsgom ⑩par ldan/ /rnam par mi rtog skye 'gyur zhes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thogs pa med cing gdon mi za ba bde ba chen po'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni⑩/ /78—5

mkhas (11mchog 'dug par gyur pa'i bar/ /de (bsrid sems can mtshungs med don / /mya ngan mi 'da' bar ri ni mdzad/ /de ltar sems can dam pa rnams/ /sred 4)pa'i zhags pas 'jigs med par/ /mi skyo bar ni brtson 'grus kyis/ /rtag tu sems can don rnams mdzad/ /nam mkha'i gnas kyi mthar ⑤thug par / /smon lam rnam par spyod 565byed cing / /sems can don brtson sems kyis ni/ /dpa' bo srid pa sbyong 57ribar mdzad/ /rtag tu 'dod pas myos pa yi/ /lha yi bu 'di rnams dang ni/ /gzhan yang skye bo chags 985can phyir/ /'dod chags thams cad dag par mdzad/ /bde chen shin tu grub bya'i phyir/ /rtog pa rgyas par sbyin pa dang / /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /rtog pa thams cad dang por bshad/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /rtog (9)pa dang po bde ba che / /der ni rdo rje sems chen gyi/ /lhag pa yi ni lha gcig bzhugs/ /'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas kyi/ /sems can kun don 'byung bya'i ⑩phyir / /glu dang /)rol mo sogs pa'i gar/ /srid pa kun gyi gtso bor gyur/ /sems can thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /dga' ba yang dag bsdus pa nga hunye de nas sems can skye 'gyur ba'i/ /'dod pa'i chags pa rnam spangs te/ /des 'dul bar ni mkhyen nas su/ /yi ge las byung rnams mi spangs shing / /nam mkha' 4lta bur bdag med par/ /dag pa nyid du de nas son/ /de nas sems can sangs rgyas kyi/ /bla med don ni nus med pa'i/ /stong pa nyid la rtag bzhugs pas/ /'gro kun stong pas bcom 1snyenas ni/ /thams cad dmyal bar ltung mthong ste/ /slar yang bdag dang gzhan don la/ /mos pas gus pa nyid du gyur/ /de nas 'jig rten khams kun na/ /bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas 78—6

kun bsdus te/ /myur ba nyid du bdag la bskul/ /oṃ ma hā su kha ①badz+ra satwa dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ 'dis ④ni bskul ba tsam gyis kyang / /dag pa'i bde ba kun ster ba/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byabyed cing / /'gro kun bde ba skyed ⑤par gyurasti/ /nga ni 'dod pa'i gzugs kyi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyis tso)byin brlabs ⑧pa/ /nga nyid chos kyi sku yi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyor 'phrog cing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba che/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi sku chen po/ /tshisangs rgyas kun gyi gsung snyan pa / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs chen yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchod pa che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal po che/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi gtso/ /rin chen 'dzin pa kun gyi dbang / /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pas na/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes byar 'grub/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /de nas dkyil 'khor thams cad bri/ /de yi dbus su tshul bzhin du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gzhag hu )par bya/ /zla ba'i mdog can 'dzum hunyedang bcas/ /'od zer dmar po 'khrugs pa las/ /sangs rgyas phreng bas mdzes pa ste/ /rgyan kun gyis 32ni rnam par bklubasalhonya/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi spyan gsum dang / /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan 8cing / /lha mo bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyis nye bar brgyan/ /rtsa zhal zhi zhing g.yas dkar minabo/ /de bzhin gzhan yang g.yon pa dmar/ /rgyab zhal ser po gser bsregs ⑩'dra/ /thod pa la bzhugs gar dang ldan/ /sum cu /rtegasum pa 'jigs par mdzad/ /rdo rje dang ni ral gri dang / /dril bu thod 78—7

pa bsnams pa nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi hu)'khor los gang / /skyob pa sna tshogs bri bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i②/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde mchog zhes / /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang / /de bzhin nye du mo rnams ④ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sgrub pas/ /'dod pa'i sbyor bas chags par bya/ /ba glang (9sha dang rta sha sogs/ /dogs pa med par bza' bar bya/ /'jig rten la rtag g.yon la spyod/ /brtan ⑥pa dang ni g.yo ba yig/ /'gro kun g.yon las byung bas nas)/ /g.yon gyis bza' zhing g.yon mchod bya/ /pho nya ma gtogs gzhan rnams la/ /'dod la nyarmongs pas bgrod mi bya/ /pho nya mo rtag zhen thar par/ /'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med/ /sgrub pos mchog tu 'bad byas te/ /brtul zhugs min spangs brtul zhugs rdzogs/ /dam tshig rigs la spyod pa dang / /tsa ru'i bza' ba lhan cig bya/ /rigs lnga la ni kun 0spyod paraphonyal/ /rigs gcig nyid du brtag par bya/ /sbrang rtsi khrag dang ga pur bcas / /tsan+dan tsodamar po sbyar byas la/ /rdo rje chu dang bsres pa ni/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa'i/ /de dag bdud rtsi lngar ni 'gyur/ /mthe bo srin lag sbyar ba yis/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bza'/ /zhi ba'i btung ⑫ba bzhin myangs na/ /dngos grub rtag par 'thob ④par 'gyur/ /'di dag dam tshig dam pa ste/ /mdzes ma'i gdong can khyod la bshad/ /las rnams kun la thabs bcas shing / /dogs pa med par gang spyod dang / /rnam par mi rtog sgom pa ni/ /brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /las rnams kun la kun tu ni/ /rnam par mi rtog sgom byed cing / /dogs pa med par kun du 78—8

spyod / /de ni dka' thub rnams kyi mchog /the tshom med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /skra zla la sogs ②rjes dngos kyi/ /yul rnams ma lus sten byed pa'i/ /dka' thub shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /gang yang las rnams thams cad la/ /shes rab dang ni sbyar byas te/ /de yang stong pa'i gnas su sbyar/ /de 'dir bdag chen dka' thub yin/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis ni/ /shes rab dang ni mtshungs gzugs la/ /dogs med spyod pa'i kun spyod pa/ /de ni bdag chen dka' thub yin/ /shes rab thabs ni ma gtogs par/ /gang tshe sems ②gzhan mi g.yo na/ /de tshe byang chub chen po ni/ /nges par ster ba nyid du bshad / /rnam par mi rtog rjes 'jug la/ /rnal 'byor pa ni mngon par brtson / /de ni thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yin/ /gang tshe 'dus byas tshul rnams ni/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis bu①/ /me long lta bur rab shes pa/ /de ni shes rab bsten ④pa yin/ /glog dang chu bur ltar smin pa/ /gang tshe 'dus byas tshul rnams ni/ /gang gis ji ltar mthong 'gyur ba/ /de ni shes rab bsten ⑤pa yin/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang ske/ /rmi lam sgyu ma dri za'i grong / /mig 'phrul mtshungs par gang gis mthong ske/ /de ni gtso bo yin par brjod/ /de ni gang du'ang mngon zhen dang / /gang du'ang gnas pa yod ma yin/ /de ltar yang dag 'byung mod kyi/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i dngos dag ni/ /longs spyod khyad 'phags skye 'gyur ba/ /bde ba yongs su 'gyur bzhin pas/ /'bras bu khyad 'phags 'thob du'agyur bar/ /ci yi phyir na 'dod mi ①bya/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po yod min te/ /'on kyang snang ba tsam mtshan nyid/ /bsgom ⑧pa khyad par can gang zhig /goms pa'i stobs 78—9

ni rdzogs pa na/ /yid 'ong bde ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /bla med gsal ba'i blo yi mthu / /'bras bu don gnyer rgyu bsgrubs na/ /der ni lha mo su zhig 'gog /de bas 'bad pa 1)thams cad kyis/ /kun tu 'gro ba mchod par bya/ /dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad (2)pas/ /lus ni bskams ①shing sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs (pen/ /g.yengs pas dngos grub gzhan du 'gyur/ /lus dang sems ni brtan gyur na/ /bde ba thams cad brtan par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni g.yo gyur pas/ /shin tu 'gog par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /des na lus dang ngag sems rnams/ /brtan par byas na tso)byang chub 'thobayi/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang / /dmyal bar nges par bsreg (7)'gyur zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis ⑧gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rishedadapal rdo ri narje mkha' 'gro las de kho na nyid snang ba dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rim par phye ba dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la btsun mo rnams kyis slar yang mchod cing phyag byas nas 'di skad ces nyu1gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das snying po gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa 'dral nyunyeba'i lha la sogs pa'i gdug pa can rnams dang / skye bo gdug pa can gzhan dag kyang gdul ba dang /'joms pa dang / zhum par byed pa dang / ltung ba dang / zhi bar byas te/byang chub kyi 51 snying po'i bar du gnod pa byed par mi 'gyur ba'i snying po sdang ba thams cad rab tu 'joms pa lha yis 7bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 78—10

'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang 0)/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i bdag pos/ glur blangs te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /dang por rnam par ⑤snang mdzad nas / /der ni sde tshan ④rnams kyi mthar(1)/ /ta dang po yi dha bha'i mtha'agye/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas spyir brgyan pa'i/ /sa yi mtha' ni rang gis blta/ / la sa'i (bedabus kyi stan bzhugs pa'i/ /sa yi mtha' ni sbyar bar bya/ /mtha' chaganyis kyis ni rnam par sbyang ('o/ /a stan gnas pa sa yi mtha' / /slar yang sa mtha' mda' lnga bstana'i/ /zla ba'i dum bu nyamathig les brgyan / / la sa'i hurtedabus gnas sa bon ni/ /mda' bcu 912yis ni yongs su sbyangs / /sha dang sa yi dbus gnas la/ /zhal gsum gyis ni brgyan pa dang / /rlung gi phyogs gnas sa bon la/ /ru ta 8yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /hūṃ rtsu ha ni bzung nas su/ /dbyangs kyi dgu pas yang dag dgang / /phaṭa ces bya ba dgod par bya/ /lhag ma ha yi rkang pa dgang / /lnga pa'i dbus gnas de nyid de / /de la ha dzo 32zhes bya'o/ /ra stan la gnas sa yi mtha'/ /i zhes bya ba'i mda' dang sbyarapo/ /slar yang pa zhes bya ba'i mtha'/ /mda' ṅge sar nyi pas yongs su sbyangs/ /sa mtha' der ni ra yig zhon/ /e 3)zhes bya ba rna 19ba'i rgyanadu )/ /i dbyangs zla dum tsumathig les brgyan/ /yi ge ra zhon sa yi mtha' / /slar yang sa mthar sgra tsho 2lngar ldan/ /zla dum thig les cod pan brgyan / /slar yang de nyid mgon po bzla/ /rin chen mtha' ma phaṭa kyis brgyan / /rnam par snang mdzad sna tshogs kyis/ /tshig rnams kun la dgang bya zhes / /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs / /dpa' bo drug dang mnyam sbyor ba'i lha/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i 78—11

sdom / /sna tshogs pad+ma'i nyi dkyil la/ /der ni rtsu las byung ba yispyi las kyi rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /rgyu gi de nyid rnam bsgom ②pa'o/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba las/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi zhutshogs spro ba'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa'i/ /sku mdog dmar mo drag chen mo/ /mdung dugi dbyibs can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /spyan dmar kham ⑤spa gyen du brjes/ /lang tsho (6 phun sum tshogs par ldan/ /stag gi pags ⑦pa'i na bza' can/ /ljags 'dril bas ni cher 'jigs te/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par mdzad / /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rab grags zhes / /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs / /sngon bsags las ni mthar byed pa/ /me dang bcas te lan gnyis bzla / /ku ru ku ru sems dpa' bral/ /ral pa gya gyu ban dha gsal/ /de ni slar yang bzlas par (snerabya/ /'jig rten gzugs rang 'bral ba yi0/ /tā skyes ya zhes bya ste brdzunanyuge/ /dam pa de ni lan gnyis bzla/ /k+ṣa 0zhes bya ba cha.o sgrar ldan/ /glo na bha (8ya yang dag gnas/ /de yang slar ni bzlas par tsobya/ /sa yi mtha' ni nyi stan gnas/ /mda' bcu zla dum thig les dgang ⑩/ /de yang slar ni brjod par bya/ /'od byed sbyangs pa'i sa yi mtha'atso/ /gshegs su gsol ba glo na gnas/ /nyis 517'gyur du ni bya ba yin/ /zla dzu )zhin thig gsal phe ri ཿzhes bya/ /de yang slar ni bzlas par ⑤bya/ /phaṭa ces bya ba bsgyings te bsgrags / /rnam par rtog pa kun gyi shing / /da ha da ha bumakha' 'gro'i sdom/ /lnga sde'i thog ma nyid nadang ldan/ /sde gtso 3de ni slar bzlas tsobya/ / bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ④zhes bya dang / /ba sa tsho sheru dhi tsunar an+t+ra/ /mā lā ba lo tsu )bi ne dang / / groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa ⑥78—12

sap+ta ste/ /pā ① ta la ga ②ta bhu rdza ga② /sa bya'i tardza ⑤ya nyis 'gyur bya/ /ā rjodang ka yi ⑦yi ge dang / /gsum pa yi ni gsum par sbyar/ /bzhi pa dang ni rlung la gnas/ /lan gnyis su ni bzlas par dubya/ /sa yi mtha' ni nyi mar gnas / /yi ge bzhi pas dgang bar ⑨bya/ /slar yang de ni lan gnyis bzla/ /lnga sde ⑩mtha' yi stan yibazhugs pa/ /ka ṣa 8a dang thig ler ldan/ /sa bon de ni gnyis bzlas 8bya/ /sa mtha' mda' gnyis dang ldan pa/ /slar yang sa mtha' mda' gsum sbyar/ /de bzhin sa mtha' mda' lnga'i ④stan/ /de kun zla ba'i dum bu dang / /thig le yis ni cod pan brgyan/ /de dag yang yang bsgyur 8bar bya/ /ka sa tsa dang dha rnams ni/ /i sgra yi ni mchog gis gzung ⑩//li yi mtha' ni re rer sbyar/ /de dag kyang ni yang yang bsgyur/ /u sgra la zhon sa yi mtha'/ /slar yang zla dum 8thig les sbyangs/ /phaṭa ces bya ba'i rin chen bsgrubatso/ /cha dang cha min sna tshogs pa'i/ /me tog yimang pos yang dag zin / /de dag lha mo sgyu ma che/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'o/ /'di ni gsungs pa tsam gyis kyang / /'jig rten khams kun g.yos gyur cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun skrag nas/ /slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /byang chub tu ni mngon sangs rgyas/ /ri bo thams cad 'dar zhing gas/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gdon dang rims dang dbyig dug dang / /gnod sbyin srin po log 'dren dz+nya )sogs/ /sdang ba thams cad btul zhing bcom//zhi 'gyur bkug ste dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbus su bcug ste dam tshig gis/ /bcings nas kyang ni dbang du mdzad/ /dmyal ba pa yi sdig pa kun/ /dral te nges bcom bsnyil 0lo zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje 78—13

dang ske/ thams cad chags 0)pa dang / dgug pa dang / gzhug ( pa dang /bskyod pa dang / gar dang / glu dang / rgod du gzhug (kyepa dang / mang du smrar gzhug ri nopa dang / ltas ngan bstan pa dang / thob pa (dedabang du bya ba'i las thams cad la sbyar ba dang / bkol ba dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / log 'dren dang / 'dul byed dang /⑥'byung po dang / ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa thams cad gdul ba dang ske/ mchog sbyin dang / sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang /nam mkha' rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i las bya ba dang / tshangs pa dang /khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po las rgyal ba dang / chags pa thams cad gzhom pa dang / rims dang / dug dang / dbyig dug dang /mkha' 'gro ma las dgrol ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba dgas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i skyo ba bsal (7༄ba'o/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed par/ /'di de ⑧lha mo bshad pa yin/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di nyid ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhes/ /sgyu ma kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab grags pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan (gerdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i skyalas humathams cad kyi cho ga las 8sgyu ma chen pos rnam par 'phrul pa'i sngags kyi cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /mdor bsdus pa ste rgyas par 8min/ /sgyu 78—16

ma kun gyis mnyam sbyor las①/ /las rnams thams cad rnam 'phrul ba/ /sgyu ma kun gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /dbang phyug thams cad rab sgrub ②cing / /'byung po gdon gyi rig pa che/ /gang gis sdud cing spro byed pa'o/ /hi ma wan+ta ①su ut+ta⑥re ṇadhi/ bha batri wo na bumaḥtso ma hā sa mosri/ so wi ad+dha masti/ si haṃ be ⑩hi ma se hi ⑩/ma se 8nyi/ ba ti pu 50/ i ④so ni do/ ma nyi nī do kum+bha kuṇ+ḍa/san ni do sā ga ra/ sa sa r+ya pa ḍa be si na sarnyi rda baṃ dhā mi'i/ ku ku tsor sam bi ḍa 0la sa/ tuṇ+ḍa 8ban dhā yimi dza wa ṭu )su ru 0u da ni 3/ dza ba ra di/ bya bha ba a dhi a ta to baṇ+ḍi0/ a nu ba de na/ sā dhu d+ma ma tsa du nyeri ya a sarba sirnya tson swā hā zhes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ sngags 0'di lan bdun mngon par bzlas te khang thog tu bzhag na/ khyim gyi mi rnams dran pa med par 'gyur ro/ /ba sa ha to li mi dzha a/ ba sa ba dza na mo hi/ e sa bidz+dza tsa hi/ na marnyi/ in+d+ra na/ ha a bā yi/ dza be+e na din ni dha/ ta ma pi ha/ ma hā swa ba a ne na/ bā dho sa/ rī dza ku la khaṇ+ḍa ḍa ṇi ḍa/ dze bā i ba dha/ ta dhi ṇa ta ṇa/ na maḥsi dha na/ na maḥpu pa tsadz+dza bā da na/ ba glang gi gdong zhes bya ba'o/ /ma sa ra ba ṇi/ tabya thā re/ ma hā daṇ+ḍi da ha he du na he he 0swā hā/ sngags 'di bye ma la lan bdun mngon par bsngags te zhing la gtor na/ ri dgas tsol sogs pa'i srog chags thams cad kyis za bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyi bka' 8shetsam gyis sprin bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /rat+na dz+nya ster ti/ oṃ a l+li bi li ba ra tsu lbi0/ tso ra bsgyus / kun+da0/ sa bā mu (steha/ ban dhā bumi swā hā/ sngags 'di shing sor bzhi pa la lan bdun sngags ④te/ rna gong g.yas par btsugs sgo tshon/ tso 8ster 78—17

ba thams cad bcing bar (17'gyur ro/ / in+da sa a ti ṇi dza ha al/ ka li lo hi dhi sa/piṅga (4rali ma/ me ka 5swābha ni(6)/ a haṃ si la u sa ri zhi)mi sa ba ra bha khyi(8)la/ a haṃ bā da 9 u sa ra mi/ a ba ra/ bha ṇa mi/ a han+dhe ha mi bhi to ba dza dza pa/ mi lo lo ka li/ lo hi di/ piṅga li hūṃ phaṭa'i/ khyu mchog gi rwa themagong du chags pa'i sa sa la ma lhung ba blangs te sngags 'di lan bdun du bzlas pa / byas na/ bas mtha' dang 'brog dgon pa'i lam dang rgyal po'i pho brang du yang 'tshe ba thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ba glang gi gdong gi cho ga la yang 'di nyid do/ /ka 1snyer bī bera'i lcug ma la sngags bzla ba'i 32cho ga 'dis rlung dang char pa dang ser ba bzlog nya9par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ rdza bi li a bi dze dza / su ti tha da si i su bha de o/ sa ṇa o/ a tsa la hi/ suṇ+ḍa pa ta ne/hi si la ba da/ ba ra sa 1 ba dza he kyi swā hā/ zhib ma'i nang du chu blugs la sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas te rlung phyogs su nam mkha' la gtor na/ rlung dang char dang ser ba la sogs pa bzlog 19 par 'gyur ro/ /na ya oṃ dhe bha ga wa te/ ki bhi ku re ṇa sha tra ya/ tha ma ke ha tha ka ra lbā ke ni ta saṃ ru bi ti bi bha tu ya/ ru tsha re ṭa ra ma ṭa ku ke to li ṭa ku ke to li ṭa lu ya/ lu rda tiṣ+ṭha le ka si ra le lo ti gra le sgyi ṣi ṣa la ṇi si mu le kha/ a ya the sarba ha de sra na bhu dza ku bha na su the ra ṣa ya/ na pa ra ya ti 6 dha yan so pa bya ti ta ka su se la ka kha se ḍa ghi gha se dha gha ri sa ni/ ma byā ha gha gha dzi se na r+ghaṃ ba sa ra/ gha dha se ra sa a ha/ a oṃ ha pi ru ga i bra lān dha k+ṣa ka a ra sku/ rtsu hūṃ r+ghaṃ/ pa pha pu ṭa gas / zla tshes thig ler na ldan pa'i khros/ /rkang pa zhugebargyad pa nisemadzes par bya/ /swā hā zhes byas brgyan pa ste/ /mtha' dang mthar ni phaṭa mchog bya/ /'di sani gsungs pa 78—18

tsam gyis kyang / /klu rnams skrag cing brgyal 0)bar gyur②/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i sbyor ba ni 'di yin te/ sngags pa bdag nyid rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje r+ghaṃ mdzad zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa 'dam skyes sngon po lta bu'i (2)mdog can sangs rgyas lnga'i me tog gi phreng bas dbu brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yan lag gi cha shas thams cad nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma spro zhing /zhal bzhi nas hūṃ bzhi sgrogs par mdzad par bsgom par 94bya'o/ /de nas kham phor (5)gnyis bzung ste/ kham phor 76)gnyis po de ba blas rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor rang gi mtshan mas mtshan cing 'bar ba la/ klu brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor re'u (7mig dgu par bris te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su klu lhag ma can/ mgo la gdengs ka bdun gyis brgyan pa/ cung zad bskum (8)pa'i phyed krung can du bri/de'i brla g.yon pa la gnas par klu mo gdengs ka gsum (7dang ldan pa g.yon gyis 'khyud par bri/ de ltar phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su mtha' yas la sogs pa bris la/ gdengs ka rnams la rdu dang spel ba'i phuḥ1 stabakod de/thams cad kyi lag pa g.yas na ral gri thogs pa'o/ /dpral ba rnams su yang rtsu phuḥm la/ rkang mthil 12rnams la dzaḥnya3bri/ rkang pa rnams kyang klu migazhan gyis bcings pa ste/ de dag gi gdengs ka la yang hūṃ phuḥ8rgyu bri'o/ /de nas oṃ sgri tsha.a ni la ta ra be ga di thi bi brnye ṣe ya nyi ru sarba nā ga ku la bya na ya phuḥyi tsho sa ma ye pra be sha ya ā be sha ya phuḥnyin sarba pon sā dha ya phuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥso )zhes bya ba 'dis / dkyil 'khor bskor la yang sngags 'di dang phyag rgyas so so'i lus la bkug ste gzhug par bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ mthe bong kha sbyar te bcings la phyi rol tu bzhag ste/ sor mo lhag ma rnams gdengs ka ltar bya 78wa 19

ba thams cad bcing bar 1tsho'agyur ro/ / in+da sa a ti ṇi dza ha a / ka li lo hi dhi ge/piṅga (4)li ma/ me ka 45swābha ni(6)/ a haṃ si la u sa ri dzodami sa ba ra bha ṇi48)ske/ a haṃ bā da 9ni.u sa ra mi/ a ba ra/ bha ṇa mi/ a ha ha mi bhi to ba dza dza pa/ mi lo lo ka li/ lo hi di/ piṅga li hūṃ phaṭa'i/ khyu mchog gi rwa nyurnyegong du chags pa'i sa sa la ma lhung ba blangs te sngags 'di lan bdun du bzlas pa / byas na/ bas mtha' dang 'brog dgon pa'i lam dang rgyal po'i pho brang du yang 'tshe ba thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ba glang gi gdong gi cho ga la yang 'di nyid do/ /ka 1snyer bī skora'i lcug ma la sngags bzla ba'i 32cho ga 'dis rlung dang char pa dang ser ba bzlog 39par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ rdza bi li a bi dze dza / su ti tha da si i su bha de o/ sa ṇa o/ a tsa la hi/ suṇ+ḍa pa ta ne/hi si la ba da/ ba ra sa 1 ba dza he the swā hā/ zhib ma'i nang du chu blugs la sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas te rlung phyogs su nam mkha' la gtor na/ rlung dang char dang ser ba la sogs pa bzlog 517par 'gyur ro/ /na ya oṃ dhe bha ga wa te/ ki bhi ku re ṇa sha tra ya/ tha ma ke ha tha ka ra lbā ke ni ta si ru bi ti bi bha tu ya/ ru tsha re ṭa ra ma ṭa ku ke to li ṭa ku ke to li ṭa lu ya/ lu rda tiṣ+ṭha le ka si ra le lo ti gra le gi ṣi ṣa la ṇi si mu le kha/ a ya the sarba ha de sra na bhu dza ku bha na su the ra ṣa ya/ na pa ra ya ti ṣā dha yan so pa bya ti ta ka su se la ka kha se ḍa ghi gha se dha gha ri sa ni/ ma byā ha gha gha dzi se na r+ghaṃ ba sa ra/ gha dha se ra sa a ha/ a oṃ ha pi ru ga i bra lān dha k+ṣa ka a ra ri/ rtsu hūṃ r+ghaṃ/ pa pha pu ṭa gci 1/ zla tshes thig ler na ldan pa'i os/ /rkang pa so brgyad pa rdo stemadzes par bya/ /swā hā zhes byas brgyan pa ste/ /mtha' dang mthar ni phaṭa mchog bya/ /'di sani gsungs pa 78—18

tsam gyis kyang / /klu rnams skrag cing brgyal ①bar gyur②/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i sbyor ba ni 'di yin te/ sngags pa bdag nyid rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje hūṃ mdzad zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa 'dam skyes sngon po lta bu'i (gyimadog can sangs rgyas lnga'i me tog gi phreng bas dbu brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yan lag gi cha shas thams cad nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma spro zhing /zhal bzhi nas hūṃ bzhi sgrogs par mdzad par bsgom par 9 bya'o/ /de nas kham phor (5)gnyis bzung ste/ kham phor 96)gnyis po de ba blas rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor rang gi mtshan mas mtshan cing 'bar ba la/ klu brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor re'u (7mig dgu par bris te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su klu lhag ma can/ mgo la gdengs ka bdun gyis brgyan pa/ cung zad bskum (8)pa'i phyed krung can du bri/de'i brla g.yon pa la gnas par klu mo gdengs ka gsum (7dang ldan pa g.yon gyis 'khyud par bri/ de ltar phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su mtha' yas la sogs pa bris la/ gdengs ka rnams la rtsu dang spel ba'i phuḥnya )bkod de/thams cad kyi lag pa g.yas na ral gri thogs pa'o/ /dpral ba rnams su yang rtsu phuḥm la/ rkang mthil 12rnams la dzaḥ43bri/ rkang pa rnams kyang klu chagazhan gyis bcings pa ste/ de dag gi gdengs ka la yang hūṃ phuḥ8rgyu bri'o/ /de nas oṃ sgri 8a ni la ta ra be ga di thi bi brnye ṣe ya hi ru sarba nā ga ku la bya na ya phuḥlha tsho sa ma ye pra be sha ya ā be sha ya phuḥ she sarba ho/na sā dha ya phuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥs )zhes bya ba 'dis / dkyil 'khor bskor la yang sngags 'di dang phyag rgyas so so'i lus la bkug ste gzhug par bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ mthe bong kha sbyar te bcings la phyi rol tu bzhag ste/ sor mo lhag ma rnams gdengs ka ltar bya 78—19

ba'o0)la/ /dzaḥrgyu rba hoḥ(kyezhes bya ba sngags kyi mthar bzla zhing dgug pa dang /gzhug (kyepa la sogs pa byas la/ de ④nas kham phor ⑤de mar nag tsha bas bkang ste/ sdong bu la me spar ⑥la/ kham mephor gzhan gyis bkab la/ kham phor de 98)ri rab tu bsgoms nas/ de'i steng du hūm̐ gis khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ cho ga bzhin du gzhag (9)par bya'o/ /de nas kham phor gyi steng du bsgoms pa'i rdo rje r+ghaṃ mdzad la sogs pa'i khro bo'i 7dkyil 'khor ba'i lus kyi gzar bu las byung ba'i chu rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'thor bar bsams hunyel/ bdag nyid rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sbyor ba dang ldan pas zhal bzhi nas hūṃ bzhi sgrogs shing / rdo rje r+ghaṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya nyusnyebacings pa'i mdzub tsomo'i rtse mor hūṃ gnyis bsgoms te/ de las byung ba'i me lce'i phreng bas sprin rnams bzlog par bsams te④/ dpal rdo rje r+ghaṃ mdzad kyi sngags kyang rung ba bzla'o/ /sbyor ba 'dis ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol khru brgyad kyi bar du char bzlog par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba yis//phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de yi dbus gyur pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dkar po mdzes pa la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /ye shes sa bon bsgom par bya/ /rlung dang me yi dbus gnas par/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor bsgom 32par bya/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab bsgoms te/ /zla ba rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom bya ba/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /glang chen stan la g.yas brkyang bzhugs / /spyan gsum skra ni grol bas brgyan/ /gzugs bzang gzhon ⑩pa phun sum tshogs / /thod pa'i phreng bas nyunyernam par bklubs8/ /kha dog dmar 78wa 20

po gsal ba'i mdangs/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /'bar ba'i ral gri thod pa dang / /mda' dang gzhu ni 'gengs pa ste/ /khrag la dgyes pa ①hrīḥrgyalas byung / /'od zer dmar po'i phreng 'khrugs shing / /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par mdzad/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa'i(mi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi (ge'akhor lo bsgom⑤/ /bla re dam pa bres (6)pa dang / /rlung bskyod ba dan 9)bsgrengs nas ni/ /sna tshogs gos ni rnam dpyangs par/ /dur khrod so phag la sogs pa'i/ /tshon rtsi rnam pa lnga yis ni/ /khru bzhi pa yi tshad tsam du/ /dkyil 'khor dge ba'i las tsam sogs/ /de nas rdzing bu bya ba ni/ /tshon rtsi sngon pos gcal ⑧bkram ste/ /dba' (ḍarlabs chu gnyer la sogs bri/ /tshon chen gyis ni gang ba'i gzugs/ /nya dang nya mid la sogs pa'i/ /srog chags rnam pa sna tshogs bri/ /phyi rol bya rog sogs pas ⑩brgyan/ /de nas cho ga 'di yis ni/ /rig pa che dang klu (lhabargyad dgod/ /sgo bzhir mgo gnyis bsnol ba la/ /mjug 12mas grwa bzhir dkris nas su/ /shar du klu rgyal mtha' yas ni/ /'dam skyes sngon po lta bu'i mdog /gdengs ka bdun ni bsgyings pa la/ /klu mo dang ni bcas par dgod1snye/ /phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /byang na ④nor rgyas ser po ste / /nub tu 'jog po dmar po yin/ /lho ru stobs rgyu ljang skya ste/ /dbang ldan du ni dung skyong yin/ /rlung mtshams pad+ma bden bral du/ /pad+ma chen po dgod par bya/ /me mtshams su ni rigs ldan te/ /cho ga snga mas bri bar bya/ /klu ni brgyad po thams cad kyang / /rin chen cod pan blta sdug 7ldan/ /rgyan kun gyis ni rnam par bklubasashi/ /gdengs ku'i nor bu'i 'od kyis ni/ /mun pa thams cad sel byed pa/ /thal mo sbyar zhing skrag nas su/ /gdeng hunyeka las 78—21

ni chu rgyun 'bebs/ /sprin gyi dbang phyug rgyal po rnams/ /phyogs brgyad hu)nas ni dgug par bya/ /sgra grag (midang ni rmugs pa dang / /drag po 'gugs byed de bzhin no/ /rgyal ba bzang po dpal dga' mo/ /char 'bebs dang ni sdug ma dang ske/ /myur ba dang ni dbyangs can ma/ /gtum dang 'bebs dang gang dang g.yo / /'di dag rdo nisprin rgyal brgyad po zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun (pedang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /bud med gnyis kyi thod pa ming dang ldan pa la/ go ro tsa na dang ske/ khrag gis me'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bris te/ me'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams rnams su yi ge k+ṣe 5ridang hrīḥtshonerabakod (7skal/ dbus su bsgrub bya'i bu mo'i shu ciming bris te/ ri mo gsum gyis bskor nas/ mo dza'i sa bon nam/ re phas dkyil 'khor sum (9༄rim du bskor te/ thod pa'i steng 'og gi bye brag shes par byas la seng ldeng gi me la dus gsum du bsros na/ phyi de nyin par 'ong ba'am skams ri7par 'gyur ro/ /gnas dben pa'i sa phyogs su bla gab med par rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gzugs mar nag tsha bas byugs te(1lha/ shing stegs mdzes pa la bzhag la12/ khrus chab gsol nas bskams te/ sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas par char dbab par dmigs nas kha shar stod du bltas la/ sngags bzlas na brgya nyugebyin gyis char 'bebs so/ /min na dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sngags dang spel ñtsate bzlas na/ rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab bo/ /yang na kham phor la sbrul mgo gnyis pa'i sha dang / khrag gis snga ma ltar bris te me lces ma reg par nam mkha' la bzhag la/ char dbab pa la sngags bzlas na 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /char gcad 12par 'dod na rdo rje can la phul ba'i me tog gi nyu9bdug nyurtepa khang nyi 78—22

steng du gnas te/ gcer bur byung la sprin la bdugs shing sngags bzlas na zlogs ①par 'gyur ro/ /kham phor so ma btang ba la/ dug (mil sogs pas rlung la sogs pa'i 78)dkyil 'khor gsum bris te/ de'i sa bon las gyur par bsams ④la/ chu'i steng du yang pad+ma 'dab sa)brgyad bris nas/ lte ba la rgyu gnyis kyis gzir ba'i ā+oṃ (6)bri/ 'dab (kham brgyad la yang (8)klu brgyad kyi snying po gzir ba bris la stobs po che'i sngags dang / hūm̐ dgus cho ga bzhin du mtsho skyes bskor te sngags bzla zhing 5)ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin 0mchod pa byas la/ kham phor kha sbyar te klu'i 4lhaganas su bcug na/ klu thams cad char gyi rgyun 'bebs sol/ /gal te des sdang ba'i klu rnams char mi 'bebs nyusnyen der sbyor ba 'di ltar bya ste/ gtum po'i sa bon la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ klu'i mtshor sbyin sreg byas na char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te des kyang char 'bab par ma gyur na/ de'i tshe yungs kur ྅snyedang / tsha ba'i tsomar 1snyenag dang / sbrang rtsi dang ske/ ka 39ra bī 1 tshora'i me tog rnams lhan cig phye mar byas te ril bu 3)byas la/de nyid la lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas hurtete/ klu'i mtshor bcug na 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te klu rnams sdang bas char mi 'bebs na mgo 'gas ( )par 'gyur ro/ /gal te yang mi 'bab na dur khrod kyi thal ba tsho skyebazung ste / rtsa bas ni skyur por na sbangs nas sngags bzlas tsho gete mtshor bcug na/ klu rnams myos shing char gyi rgyun 'bebs so/ / ji ste 35des kyang ma babs 3ston pad+ma dang ske/ ut+pal sngon po dang / ba ( tshobla dang / zangs kyi phye ma dang / yungs kur —snyedang / dbang po'i lag pa dang / pa la sha rnams las ril bu 3)rgya shug gi 0 'bru gu tsam byas la/ ril bu 8)re re zhing lan bdun bdun risnyemangon par 78wa 23

bsngags te/ ji srid char 'bab kyi bar du ril bu ①rnams mtshor skyur ②na/nyin mo dang mtshan mo bye brag med par nichar 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa 0chen pos sngags kyi rgyal po 'di gsungs te/oṃ na mo (ge'i la e ba ra stidha rā ya/ badz+ra pā ṇa ⑦ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na nipa ta ye/a ne ka 6)gi gā nā dri pā lu ko pa mā bud+dha ko ṭi0/ sha ta sa ha 7sra pa ri dzod tā ⑫yal/ bi kṛ rta rda:hurte/ ka rā tshul rū pā 8ya/ ag ni rā byasi/ na yā na yā/dz+wa nyu tsholi ta/ bi ṣa sa swā phonyeya/ sdi ma na dā ya/ ba su ki nā ga rā dzā gi bhū ṣi ⑩ta ka ra tsa ra ṇa ya/ kriṇ+ḍa 0 bhu dzi gā du nyeya/ ya rnyo pa bī tā tsoya/ dz+wa li ta bhu dza ma ṇi mu ku ṭā ( )ya/ pu ri ta ṭa pa bā da nā ya(ste/ saṃ kru tsi tā bhu la tā ya da sha na ṣaṇ+ḍa re ṣa ṇa ya/ kri tān+ta rū pā ya bibyu khyi hā ya ma ho ra ga bak+ṣa ṇa ya/kā ra sbo ṭa tā tsos na ka rā ya/ su bar+ṇa ka na ka rā phyadza me kha lā ya/ hūṃ kā ra nā da tā du tshos na ka rā ya/ a shrī gti yo dza na sa ha sra gi gli ra sā ⑥ga ra dzā nu maṇ+ḍa zhu lā ya/ tsa krā dit+ya skan dha ba ha dunanā ya/ rda'i 0ka rā 0lā ya/ hā si ta abasta hā sa nā da nā dā sa ya/ ma hā saṃ khyo bha eka rā ya/ kā chal rū 0sna ya/ tre+e lo kya bhak+ṣa ṇa ka ra ṇa geya/ nā gā rnam mṛ kyu kā ( )lnga ya0/ i me gi gā na dri bā lu ka sa ma bud+dha bha ga ba'i bhā ṣi 6shete/ man+t+ra mā bsto yi tī mi 8sto bho pa: ga a rnyi pa ri sputa ye/ i cadan nī s+t+waṃ ba ra dha ra sha rī raṃ badz+ra ༅pā ṇi skṛ rgyad yā ya sa mā ti kra ma tha/ mā ku lo'i da rna/ bha bi ṣ+yo ti/ tabya byathā/ bud+dha bud+dha/ bi bud+dha bi budha(7/ ma hā ba lo ka pā li nī/ dza ha ra dza ha ra/ nā gā dzā0 / pra ha ra pra ha ra/ sarba nā gā māṃ/ sbyin sbyin/ nā gā ṭ+wāṃ skṛ da yā ni snyin+da bhin+da/ nā ga ma ra mā ༅ṇi smibi shir+yan+tu zhurtenā ga skṛ da yā ④ni/ sbo ṭa g.ya/ sgo ṭa 0ya/ nā 78—24

ga nā ya nā ni①/ bi shir+yas②/ nā ga sha rī rā ṇi bu/ tabya ④shā/ rtsu rtsu phaṭa/nā ga bi dā ra ṇa ya phaṭa/ nā ga sbyin nā ya phaṭa/ nī la ba ⑤sa nā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa ⑥ra kra mā meya duphaṭa/ ⑨ kṛ tān ta 0ru sh+yapā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa 8ya phaṭa/ tā 0sa nā ya phaṭa/ kuṣ+ṭhazlo'i da na ka rā ya phaṭa/ bre ta pi shā tsa pi nā sha ka blarā ya phaṭa/ 8yak+ṣa a pa sma ⑩ra bi nā sha ka rā ⑩ya phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ da ra da ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sarba bi bi nā sha ka rā ya 'phaṭa/ nī s+t+waṃ ba ra dha ro badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā hukyepa ya ti swā hā/ gnod sbyin dang srin po la sogs pas zin pa la ni chu la bzlas te gtor na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /char bzlog pa la ni thal ba la bzlas nas sprin la bltas te gtor bar bya'o/ /chu la bzlas te gtor na ni char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /rims la ni skud pa sngon po la bzlas te lag pa la btags na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba dang nyi ma gzas zin pa'i dus su go ro tsa na la lan stong mngon par bzlas te dpral bar thig le 9 kye byas na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /don la dmigs te gtsang zhing gtsang ba'i gos gyon la nyin mtshan du kun du ru bsregs te lan brgyad brgya 67bzlas na rmi lam du dge sdig thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /sa la lan bdun bzlas te chom po la bltas nas bus na chom po bas mi mthong zhing bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /me tog gam bu'abras bu la lan bdun bzlas te gang la byin 0pa de dbang du 'gyur ro zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las klu thams cad dgug ④pa'i rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //78—25

de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo rnams kyis slar yang mchod pas mchod cing phyag gsum byas te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /las thams cad kyi tshogs bcom ldan 'das lha 1)yis bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rig pa'i rgyal po 'di mgur du bzhes te bka' stsal pa/ ghi li ghi li bar+ṣa ya bsgo ya ba dza da i ni ba ri sha ba ri sbyo sha pa ya(mi/ hūṃ hūṃ (3)/ ho ho ho/ bha sa jam/ ṭha ja45// ha sa/ ha sa/ ha ha/ o ༷6)ni zla phyed thig les brgyan/ /de ni chu 'dzin (7)brgyad la gnas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi mirig 7sngags te/ /sgyu ma chen po'i rang bzhin no/ /'di ni gsungs ma thag tu yang / /klu rnams thams cad brgyal 7'gyur zhes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan 511rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /na maḥ thra shā na bā nyugesi ni(snye/ ma hā kā ④la/a nu tsa rā cho1snyeya/ tabya thā/nyu0 i tsa le tsa le pra tsa lenyu sna/ la lā tsol lā ya/ de ba lo ga sna'iswā hā/ sngags 'di bsnyen pa khri byas te/ mtshan phyed na ling ga'i drung du ji srid 'ongs kyi bar du bzlas pa byas zhu )te gong bu 2stedagug pa'i cho ga'o/ /oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍi dru ri 2ma ke shi bibyu dzi he snye/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/de ba dat+ta mā ra shu ya swā hā/ rang gi rkang mthil (snyegayon par sen 39ris ri rab bris la/ de'i nang rol gyi grwa tshobazhir yi ge hrīḥdu snyebazhi bri —ste/ dbus su sngags kyi tshig bris la ri/ rdog pas mnan te bzlas na khugs shing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu'i byin pa g.yon pa'i rus pa'i thur ma la steng gi char tshogs kyi dbang phyug phyag bzhi pa zhal 'og tu gzigs pa/ lag pa g.yas pa dang / g.yon par tho ⑥ba dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pa 3 bsnams pa 78—26

byas la/ dug dang / khrag ①dang / ske tshe dang / lan tshwa (midang / lce myang tshar bcas ①pa'i mar nag gi nang du phur bu de btsos te stobs po che'i sngags bzlas la/ gang gi khyim sgor sbas pa de la gcong nad chen po 'byung bar 'gyur gel / bton ⑤na thar bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhā tshonam hā ba la (7)ha na da ha pā 2tsa / bi dh+wan ⑨ya/ ud sā dā ya mā rā ya lho )rtsu phaṭa/ grog mkhar gyi sa dang /ba'i rnam lngar bcas pas klu bā su ki'i (lhagazugs brnyan mtho gang tsam pa byas te ka tsor bī tsora'i lhug mas bkab la gu gul gyi ④bdug pa rgyun mi 'chad 9/gepar bdug cing dkar tsogasum gyi gtor ma byin la/ ka na)ra bī 3dera'i lcug mas rgyun mi 'chad par chu gtor zhing bzlas na/ zhag bdun gyis 7char gyi rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /ji ste bab par ma gyur na/ nyi ma bdun pa la dum bu dum bur byas te/ bum pa'i nang du blugs la/ rtsu bzhi pa'i sngags zlos 2 )shing chu bo chen por bskur na nges par 'bab 27par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bug ga a ri ga gā ḍa steg hā/sngags 'dis ④nang par sngar gdong ma bkrus par rde'u tsho —snyel lan bdun bzlas te gang yang rung ba'i bu gar bcug la/ che ge mo'i kha chings shig ces brjod na kha 'chings gyupar 'gyur ro/ / mu kha tiṣ+ṭha na tsho 7ti mu ka /gats+tsha 2)ti/ muḥkāḥkuyon ti/ dan+ta lo/ ga lo mū kā ṭ+wāṃ/ mu tra pu ri ṣe ṇa/ de wa dat+ta su mu kha ban dhā kyemi swā hā/ glang gi rtsi ba sa la ma lhung sa )ba byi ba'i khung 0bu sgo gnam du bltas ④pa'i nang du bcug la/ bzlas shing kha chings shig ces brjod na rgyal po'i pho brang la sogs pa dang / shags su'agyed pa la gi )bzlas pa tsam gyis kha bcings par 'gyur ro/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ thog mar sbyar ge/ sarba dhasmyu ṇ+ḍaṃ bude mthar / /rab tu sbyar te slar yang ni/ / ār+ya nut+pan+da ༷ snatāta ces bya/ /sngon du 78wa 27

gsungs pa'i sbyor ba yang / /blo gros chen mo mdun hu)gnas te/ /sngags 'di bdun ni brjod byas ②na/ /mkhar gnas rnams kyis nges par ni/ /chu ni rab tu mang po 'bebs/ /sde tshan gyi mtha' ①ma ra'i stan la gnas pa la/dbyangs yig bzhi pa dang ④thog les brgyan te/ tsan+dan dmar pos nyal ba'i sngas kyi sa (gegazhi la byugs te/ der rang gi khrag gis snying po la ming bris la nyal ba'i dus su me tog dmar pos gtor zhing bdug pas bdugs na/ rang gi bud med chags pas mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /snying gar ④nyi ma la rtsu bsgoms te/bdag nyid khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba la sogs par bsgoms la④/ rdo rje so can gyi khrag gis shing dzā ti'i (nyelhug ma'i myu tso)gus ras sam gro yig la rlung gi sa bon gyi dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming dang bskul tshig tu bcas pa0/ rtsu ṭa'i ⑩zhes bya ba'i sa bon gnyis kyi dbus su bris la lcags kyu la sogs pas dgug 'o pa la sogs pa'i las byas te so phag gi dbus su bcug ④la/ skud pa dmar pos dkris nas rlung mtshams su g.yon brkyang gi hunyerkang pas mnan te bzlas na rgya mtsho la thug gi sa gzhi thams cad du 'khyam par 'gyur ro/ /bton ⑩nas 'o mas bkrus na grol bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /bdag nyid mi dmar po las bud med kyi gzugs su bskyed de/ oṃ dmar po spyi bor yang bsams ⑩la/bu mo'i kha nas bdag gi khar sngags kyi phreng ba cho ga bzhin du zhugs par bsams ⑫na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bud med kyi gci 0ba'i shul gyi sa dang / rang gi gci rga )ba'i shul gyi sa las mo mtshan gyi gzugs byas zhute/ de'i steng du rang gi mtshan ma bzhag la/ sngags lan bdun bzlas nas der gci tsoba'i las byas la nyi ma bdun du dus gsum du sngags brgya rtsa brgyad tsunyebazlas na/ brgya byin gyi chung 78—28

ma yang 'ong bar 'gyur na gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ skyes pa'i thod par go ro tsa na dang sen rtsis bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan bris te/ snying gar ①ming dang spel ba'i sngags bris la/ dri'i ②chus byugs nas thod pa gnyis ①kha sbyar cing ④ro'i skud pas kun tu dkris te/ spra tshil gyis byugs la ro bsregs pa'i sol ba'i me la / ji srid spra tshil zhu bar ma gyur gyi bar du rig pa'i rgyal po 'di zlos shing gdungs na/ las kyi cho ga de lta bus lha'i 'jig rten yang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /dug can gyi thod par gnod sbyin smyon ⑤pa'i lce bcug la/ rta'i mig pa'i ser gar dubacug ste/ gang gi khyim sgor sbas pa gnyi ma bdun gyis bskrad par 'gyur ro / /yang na las kyi dus su kha zas kyi phud kyi chang bu la sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas ②te/ khro ba dang bcas pas bsgrub byar gzhug tho)ste/ nyi ma bdun gyis bskrad par 'gyur ro/ /rtsi ba sa la ma lhung ⑩ba la 0bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan sor bcu drug pa'am/ phyed dang bcu gsum pa byas la/ ras ma'i dum bu la de'i 3)ming bris te stor bcug la/ bag zan gyis de'i kha bkang ste(nye/ro'i ④spas dkris la gtun shing la sngags lan bdun bzlas te/ khro ba tsodang bcas pas de'i gdong btsogs phonyen bcings par 'gyur ro/ / da pa' bo hu 3g.yul du bsad 8pa'i ras la bu mo'i gzugs brnyan ri mor bris te/ ba glang gi rdul dang / shing bu pa ta la'i rtsa ba'i bdug pas bdugs na bu mo de 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /ras sam/ gro chaga'am/ spang leb bam/ rtsig ngos la/khro bo gshin rje'i du gshed kyi gzugs kha dog thams cad dang 0ldan pa g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/ lag pa g.yas na tho ba g.yon na sbrul zhags 'dzin cing /khro gnyer dang / smin ma bcum pa/ mche ba gtsigs ⑥shing spyan dmar ba/78—29

spa gyen du 'greng zhing sbrul gyi 1)rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa bris la/ sbrul zhags 5kyi stor (kyidur khrod kyi sol bas dgra'i tshogs kyi ming sngags dang spel ba bris te bzhag na/ ji srid gnas kyi bar du dgra rnams bcings par (ji)'gyur te/ tha na yid kyis kyang cung zad tsam yang gnod par sems par mi 'gyur te/ gal te gnod par sems na 'byung po dang / rims dang ske/ gdon dang / sha za dang / mkha' 'gro mas nye bar 'tshe bar 'gyur la / lha rnams kyis kyang gtor (snyebar 'gyur te/ pha rol gyi dpung gi tshig spel na dpung bcings par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang shing lo la sogs pa la sngags phreng gnyis su bris te/ phreng gnyis pa'i mthar bsgrub bya'i ming (yiyi ge dang spel te bris nas bcings la/ kham phor du bzhag ste/ der bshang ba btang laphya/ba glang gi lci skam gyi thal bas bkang ste/ kham phor kha sbyar la dbugs nang du rngub cing sa 'og tu sbas nas/ sas na 'thug pa kho nar bkab na/ dgra bcings par 'gyur ba las gzhan du ma yin no/ /rat+na stibadz+ra zhes byas nas/ /de nas oṃ dang badz+ra brjod/ /hrī 7dang phaṭa ni mthar sbyar ba/ /sngags 'di dpung ni 'ching byed yin/ sa nag po la lha (11mo tsa muṇ+ḍa'i gdong 8byas la/ go ro tsa nas bsgrub bya du yod pa'i ming dang spel ba'i sngags bris te de'i khar bcug la / de'i khar mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod cing / khyim gyi phyogs gcig tu bzhag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du mchod par byas na kha bcings shing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /kham phor la ldong ros kyis 12bud med kyi gzugs brnyan bris la ④de'i bha gar mdzub skomo btsugs 7te/ zla ba gzas zin nas ji srid grol gyi bar du sngags bzla ba'am/ yang na bud med dngos kyi bha gar yang rung ste/ de 78—30

ltar bsgrub ①pa'i mdzub mo (9des mdzub yug (0tsam gyis bu mo thams cad 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /nim pa'i lo ma la dug dang / rang gi khrag dang / dha ④du ra'i khu bas yi ge phu ཿbri(mi/ de'i dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming bris la bag zan nam zan gyi ril bu'i (5)nang du bcug ste dgongs (7)mo bya rog tshang du 'gro kha ma la (nyezar bcug na nges par bskrad par 'gyur ro/ /rtsig (7)ngos sam spang leb la yi ge tha 7bri/ de'i nang du dbyangs kyi yi ges 37'khor bar bri de'i nang du pha bri(ste / de'i nang du ha bri/ ha'i nang du ka /der bsgrub bya'i ming bris la de (nyakha bcad de bzhag na dbang du 'gyur zhing bcing bas bcings par 'gyur ro/ /lte ba'i pad+ma'i dbus su ming gi yi ge'am/ a bsgoms te/ pad+ma'i bsdu ba byas la / snying gi zhags pas 7bcings na bsrung 7bar 'gyur te/ a nyanyani sems can thams cad kyi/ /rang gi phyag rgya rtags lco tshos bon/ /srog bsrung (snyel sogs don gyi phyir/ /stobs kyis yang dag bcing bar bya/ /yang na rdo rje lte ba kha sbyor gyi nang du gangs nyi kyi 'od lta bu'i yi ge a bsams zhu )la/ de'i mtha' gnyis su snying gi zhags pas bcings na yang srung ༷ 7ba'i dam par 'gyur ro/ /snying ga'i ༷ stepad+ma la gnas par yi ge ba kha mthur ni du bltas pa bsams tsho — )la/ lte ba'i pad+mar yi ge a nas kyi 'bru tshod tsam bsams te/ ba las ba'i 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'babs 25pas a la ༷ stekhras chab gsol ba rtag tu bsams ni tshon / pad+ma kha gesbyor gyi bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba 'dis ni lus brtan 27par 'gyur ba dang / srog bsrung stab la snying gar yodabang bskur zhing rgyas pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /shing ta la'i 'dab sa ma la bsgrub bya'i ming gi yi ge ga dang spel ba/ thog ma dang tha mar oṃ kha sbyar ba'i ri mo bris la ri mo de dur khrod 78—31

kyi sol bas bkang la zhi)bum pa la sogs pa'i nang du bcug ste/ spra tshil la sogs pas kha bcad la dbugs nang du rngub cing mi gtsang ba'i phung po'i nang du bcug na rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /shing ar ku'i (snyertsa ba la tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi gzugs lag pa bzhi dang ldan pa byas te/ sa bon dang / dgug pa dang / dam tshig sbyin pa la sogs pa byas nas/ lan ②tshwa dang / ma ri tsi dang / bca' sga (pedang / sngon po dang / ske tshe dang / spun pa dang ⑤/ chu rnams kyis legs par byugs te nyi ma phyed na khyim gyi chu'i nang du ske man chad kha lhor bstan te bcug la mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod de/sngags pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /khyod kyis bdag la sogs pa'i las 'di zhes bya ba byas na(6)/ de nas ci nus pa'i rjes su mthun 9)pa'i mchod (gepa khyod la sbyin no zhes brjod la nyi ma bdun gyi bar du bya'o/ /de nas bya ba byas pa dang ske/ de nas bton la 'o mas bkru zhing ci nus pa'i mchod pa byin la bzod pa gsol bar bya'o/ /bum pa dri'i chus rtsi)bkang ste rin po che dang / sman dang /'bru dang ldan par byas shing stobs po che'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi 7par byas pa'i steng du skyes bu'i gtso bo bzhag ste/ bum pa des khrus byas la sngags de gro 17ga la go ro tsa nas bris nas gtsug pud rtsonyal btags te g.yul du zhugs na pha rol gyi g.yul 3nyelas rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi ras sam/ a ba dhū tī'i tsoras la dug dang / khrag dang / nim pa'i lo ma'i khu ba rnams kyis sngags kyi yi ge re re zhing / bsgrub bya'i ming dang spel ba lugs las bzlog 7ste bris la bcings nas nya phor gyi nang du bcug ste/ sha za'i ⑩shing gi rtsa ba'i rlung mtshams su sbas na ni bskrad par 'gyur la me mtshams su bzhag na 78wa 32

ni phan tshun sdang bar 'gyur la①/ bden bral gyi mtshams su gsang ste sbas na ni gsod par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis rnal 'byor pas g.yul du zhugs na dpung ②bcings par 'gyur ro/ /slar bzlog pa la ni bton la 'o mas ①bkru zhing ske/ skyes bu'i ming dang spel ba'i sngags lugs su 'byung bar bzlas so/ /ldong ros kyis rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil la bsgrub bya'i ming 0bris la me mar gyi rtse mo la bsros ⑤na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /maṇ+ḍal byugs te/ zan gyi chang bu la ming ༅sngags bzlas nas dgongs (7mo tshang du 'gro kha ma'i bya rog la byin na niyang bskrad ⑨par 'gyur ro/ /bsgegs cinas bsad pa'i ro'i thag gu blangs yil/ dum bu gsum du byas te/ ro bsregs hunyapa'i shing phyed tshig pa blangs la srub 0shing byas nas/ dur khrod du shing gi khri 'khrog 0cing sgra dang bcas pa la 'dug ste/ thag 8gu des srub ⑩shing la btags nas/ ro'i bum par 0bcug ste/ des bsrubs shing 4)sngags bzlas na gang gi ming nas bzung ste bzlas pa de 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang tha mal pa'i rdo'am/ brdar rdo la klu'i rgyal po gdengs ka gsum dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas la rdza ma nag po'i nang du bzhag ste/ sbrang rtsi dang 'bras yos kyi bo ga ling dang / dri dang / me tog dang ske/ bdug pa dang / mar me dang / 'o thug la sogs pas mchod la snod de nyid kyi nang du bzhag ste/ ras sar yipas bkab la bcings nas rgya btab ste / de'i steng du lag pa bzhag la stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas shin tu gsang ste grong khyer gyi dbus su sbas na ji srid ma bton tsukye gyi bar du grong khyer de gnas par 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer ba 'bros pa rnams dgug par 'dod na de nyid du mchod cing dus gsum du sngags bzlas na 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer ba 'bros 78—33

par rtsom pa la ni bu ram la bzlas te bza' 0)bar byin na mi 'bros so/ /grong brtan napar bya ba'i sbyor ba gzhan yang rdza mkhan gyi lag pa phyis pa'i 'jim pa la snod byas la stong rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas te/ dbugs mi 'byin par chu'i nang du bzhag na brtan du dpar 'gyur ro/ /ji ④ste dgra gsad (denapar 'dod na spra tshil 95skulam / bag zan (7las gzugs brnyan (debyas la/ chos gos kyi dzinagazugs brnyan gyi gdong nas brtsams te rkang pa'i mthar thug par dkris la legs par sbas te/de'i steng du lag pa bzhag la ming dang spel ba'i sngags stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba bzlas nas lha mchod pa'i khyim gyi phyogs gcig tu bzhag ste/ snying gar pho byeseng ldeng nyu1gi phur bu /2btab la phur bu'i steng du dus gsum du chu tshan blugs shing yongs su bzlas na brlag par 'gyur ro/ /nyi shu'i phyed kyi rdzas dang kha cher sbyar la rnal 'byor pas thig le byas na skye bo skal 51 ba bzang por 'gyur ro/ /rdzas de dag ma la ya skyes dang bcas pas yan lag thams cad byugs te/ gang la reg pa de shi yang mi gtong ngo / /rdzas de dag nyid dmar po dang pa la sha dang ske/ sbrang rtsi dang / nad kyi dbang po tshadang / 'tshod byed dang / lhan cig tu bsres te byas na rtag tu sa stengs pa 8rnams byams shing thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur te/ rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i blon po rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa 7thams cad du bsrung nyu bar 'gyur ba la the tsom 32med do/ /rtsa sngags 'bum du bzlas nas su/ /de 'og las rnams brtsam par bya/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang / dmyal bar nges par bsreg 17'gyur zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje tsho )sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal 78—34

po chen po dpal ①rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ las thams cad kyi tshogs rab tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas mkha' dbyings dbus gyur par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam bya ba / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nam mkha' la/ /dpag med rigs kyis yongs gang ba'o/ /mkha' dbyings nyi ma de dbus su/ /rang gi sa bon mtshan ma ni/ /nyi ma stong bas lhag pa yi/ /'od zer rnon po 'bar zhing 9ge'akhrug /me stag 'phro bas bdud sde bsreg9kye /gong bur de bsdus ④sbyor ba yis/ /zhu ba las ni skur bzhengs pa/ /sku mdog sngon po drag chen po/ /'od zer bskal pa'i me dang mtshungs/ /'bar ba'i lus dang sgra (5)chen gyisayi/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par mdzad/ /lhag ger bzhad chen tshems kyi (pe'od/ /lha mo'i dkyil 'khor rgyun chags kyi/ /'khor lo bla re mthar gnas shing / /slar (8sayang 'od ldan phyag bzhi bzhi/ /thong ka sgyu ma chen mos mdzes/ /rgyal ba rnam grol dri ⑨med rgyun/ /kha ba mchog gi zer 7tshogs 'khrugam /nyis 'gyur du ni byung bas gsal/ /rin chen la zhugs 8zhabs gnyis bskyod/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs tsol sogs pa'i/ /mthar thug bskyod pas skerab mdzes pa/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyun 'jug cing / /'byung 'jug dbugs ni yongs gang ba'i/ /sgra ⑫yi tshogs kyis 'joms 7byed pa/ /sa gsum pa hu tshoni rab tu g.yo/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phangs pas khyab/ /mun pa'i tshogs kyis gtibs pa bzhin/ /thams cad du ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /gnam 'osnyel gnas pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po'i bdag po tshangs sogs kyang / /rkang pa'i grib ma'i mtha' tsam 78—35

yang 3)/ /nye bar bzod par nus ma yin/ /bgegs kyi tshogs gzhan sgyu ②can dang ske/ /srin po la sogs lha dugazhan gyis/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor phyi rol gyi/ /dpag tshad 'bum gyi char meyang ni/ /nye bar gzung bar ⑤nus ma yin/ /yod med de ni lha yi phyogs/ /cung zad 'od kyi lus can yang ⑥/ /rdul lam du ba lta bur g.yo/ /pad+ma rā ga lta bu yi/ /g.yon zhal 'od zer tshogs kyis ni/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg 9)snyam sems/ / ban dhu ⑧ka yi me tog gi/ /phung po srungs 'dra'i 'od kyis ni/ /rigs gsum las byung kun nas ni/ /lhags ⑨pa thams cad ngo mtshar gyur/ /'od gzugs des ni bsreg rdzo )snyam sems/ /nyi ma stong bas lhag 'od kyis/ /bskul zhing byang chub thob par mdzad/ /phaṭa sgra chen pos sad phonyemadzad cing / /rab tu bsgyings pas ⑩lha kun bsregatso /g.yas zhal dkar po'i 'od zer ni/ /gangs kyi snying ④po spungs pa dang / /shel dang be+e ḍūr 8rdo dang ni/ /ngang pa kun da zla 'dra ba'i/ /dri med 'od kyis gsal mdzad pa/ /rnyog pa med pa'i gdengs ku'i bar/ /rang gi chu rgyun 'bab pa bzhin / /rgyal ba'i rigs kun gsal bar mdzad/ /nub ni ser po gser btsos tso'adra/ /ku sum dza yi 8me tog dang / /me 'bar sol ba spungs 'dra zhing ske/ /nyi ma 'char ku'i 'od 'dra ba'i/ /spyan zur bgrad pas 'jigs par mdzad / /shin tu drag pa'i 8gzugs chen las/ /sa gzhi rnams ni ma lus par / /skar mda'i 'od ltar lding zhing 'khrug /blta bar dka' ⑩zhing gzung ⑩bar dka' / /me lce 'khyil pa lta bur 'bar/ /dpag tshad stong phrag du ma ru/ /yangs pa'i rdo rje mda' yi ni/ /dra ba chen pos 'khor lo bcings/ /khā gdong la sogs so so yi/ /ba spu re re'i khung nas kyang / /ri rab du ma'i rdul 78—36

mtshungs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin rnams / /spro bas nam mkha' gsal mdzad pa/ /phyag brgyad spyan gsum gyen skra 'bar / /mkha' 'gro nyi shu bzhi phyed bskor/ /de ltar sngags pas rnam bsam bya/ /g.yas ①dang po na rdo rje sngon po 'bar zhing rno ba gdengs pa la rigs ldan gyis dkris pa bsnams pa'o/ /gnyis pa na pad+mas ②bcings pa'i mda'i ①mchog go/ /gsum pa na pad+ma chen pos yu ba dkris pa'i ral gri'o/ /bzhi pa na dung skyong gi zhags pas ④dkris pa'i lcags kyu'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po na mtha' yas kyi ba dan btags pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ tshig bsgreng ba'okhya/ /gnyis pa na nor rgyas kyi bu yis rgyud byas pa'i gzhu'i mchog go/ /gsum pa na 'jog po'i zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub (7)bo/ /bzhi pa na tshangs pa'i mgo khrag 'dzag pa stobs kyi rgyus dubacings pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang mche ba gtsigs shing lce 'dril ⑨ba/ lta ⑩ba'i dug can gdengs ma'i nor bu'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i ngos thams cad gsal tunyeba'o/ /khu gdong ma la sogs pa thams cad kyang sbrul gyi rgyan gyis bklubs ⑩shing spyan gsum pa/ skra gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag na zangs gri dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 8dang / thod pa bsnams pa thod pa'i phreng bas bklubs ④shing gcer bu zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ khro gnyer gyi rim pa can/ zur mig tu gzigs pas sa gzhi bskyod cing ⑫/ klu'i tshogs skrag pas kha bub 7tu 'gyel bar bsams na (/rtenam mkha' la gnas te char gyi rgyun gtong bas sa gzhi skad cig gis gang bar byed do zhes/ mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni 'bar ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can 78—37

gyis gsungs/ /yang na rta bla mo zhib tu btags la ras kyis g.yogs te li khri dang bsres la/ sbrang rtsis sbrus te/ mgo bdun pa'i klu'i gzugs sor bcu gnyis pa byas la/ de'i khang pa sor bcu drug yangs par byas nas/ khang pa de gru bzhi la gdong bzhi byas te/ gru gcig pa ni rta'i gdong pa/ gnyis pa la seng ge'i gdong pa/ gsum pa la spre'u'i lho)gdong pa/ bzhi pa la nya'i gdong pa du dbyas te/ de'i nang du klu'i rgyal po ras kha dog sna tshogs pas g.yogs te bzhag tsho skal/ de nas sngags brgya ༅rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas pas btab stephyi/yid kyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i me tog dang / bdug ⑥pa dang / gtor ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa bsams te ④byin la/ yungs kur (8)la lan bdun bsngags (9)te klu'i steng du gtor te/ de nas 'dod pa thams cad pa'i gtor ma byin na/ des klu'i tshergyal po rnams mdza' bor gyur nas/ klu thams cad kyis than pa byung ba'i dus su nyi ma bdun du 37char phab rtsonapas 'dzam bu'i hunyegling thams cad gang bar byed do/ /char mi 'bab pa'i dus su de ltar byas na gdon mi za bar char 'bab bo/ /ci 7ste klu gdug pa can yin na yang rlung grang mo dang /rdo char dang / glog 1snyedang / ser ba 'bebs 0te de bzlog par 'dod na rig pa 'dzin pas thal ba dang yungs kur nyu3zho gnyis tsam la 'oshelan nyi shu'i bar du bzlas te/ ji srid 'dod pa'i sa phyogs su mtshams bcings la/ yang de nyid la lan bdun bzlas te/ klu'i mgor bsnun zhing yid kyis ji snyed 'dod par phyogs bcing ba byas te/ phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og tu gtor na hu)mtshams chen po bcings par 'gyur ro/ /ji ste dgra thams cad dang 'gran zla dang sdang ba'i grogs po dang / sdang ba'i phyogs byed pa rnams dang / pha rol gyi 'khor 78—38

lo 'jigs shing gdul bar 'dod pa dang / btags hu)pa dang / bcing ba dang ske/ gsad (7pa dang / rengs pa dang / gzhom par 'dod na rta bla mo de nyid dur khrod kyi thal ba dang bsgos te/ skyes pa'am/ bud med kyi gzugs byas la/ khro bo chen po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ dur khrod kyis brkos rdzu dpa'i nang du ming nas smos te bzhag la/ yungs kur (4)la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te de'i steng du gtor la seng ldeng gi phur bu la lan brgya rtsa zhu)brgyad bzlas te btab nas sbas na ji srid phur bu ma bton rinagyi bar du sdug bsngal chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ rig pa 'dzin pa ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis dgrol bar mi nus so/ /ci (7)ste gsad 58)par 'dod na mi rus kyi phur bu la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas bsnun la ('okhrag dang bcas pa'i yungs kur 7la bzlas te gtor na zhag bdun sdod par mi 'gyur /lhazhes/ mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ klu thams cad dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing 3)ba'i cho ga rgyas pa ste/ rim par phye ba lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo rnams kyis slar yang mchod cing phyag byas te / 'di skad ces gsol to/ sgra chen pos rnam par 'phrul pa'i klu'i sngags mi 'tshal na/ bka' drin chen pos bshad du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ sngags kyi rgyal po chen po'i mtshan nyid skal ba chen mo'i 32lha mo nyon cig /gshin rje mche ba can ma nyid/ /rus lisngal gyi ni stan la bzhugs/ /dbu ma yi ni tha ma nyid/ /78—39

slar yang bzhi pa la gnas pa/ /gshin rje'i phyogs kyi mthar gnas pa/ /bzang po yis ni steng ①du brgyan/ /slar yang gshin rje'i mche ba can/ /rus ②sbal gyis ni rab tu brgyan/ /oṃ bha zhes bya ba'i ③tshig dang ldan/ /dang po ru ni rus 0sbal gyi/ /stan bzhugs mgon po ri mo dang / /rtses brgyan lan gnyis bsgyur bar bya/ /mgon po phan phan tshig gis brgyan/ /ka ki ⑤mu khi/mu ka ke si/ na ga ཿyi/ yin dhu bha ga gi/ ke ④ti sa / pi ⑧nyi ba di hi/a pa ri'o stisi'o/ /ka ha ka hi 0 dz+dza'i/ kusma da the/ dza'i 0yin da bha mi 'bid thu ma he sa ro (nyepa tsaskye bi sarba la ba (steha ṇi (smebi ho bi ṇa sa na ta ha na 4)se'i/ka ki ha a a sarnyi a 'o)zhes/ mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /'bugs 8byed pa ni sa dbang phyug /zla ba'i dum bus brgyan pa ste/ /slar yang dbu ma'i dbu ma gzung yi/ /byang phyogs kyi ni dbu ma yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma nyi mar ldan/ /bden bral la ni sme bas brgyan/ /'bar bas 'bugs du )pas rnam par bklubs0/ /byang phyogs kyi ni dang po dang ske/ /khyu mchog steng na gnas pa yi/ /gshin rje phyogs kyi mthar gnas dang pyo nye/ /rlung ni yugs sa ( nyemo yis brgyan/ /bden bral tsol ni gnas pa yi / /gshin rje yi ni mche ba can/ /gti mug rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gshin rje 'joms ma zhugati mug bklubs/ /klu yi ⑩phyag rgya 'di yis ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun dga' mgur 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po bcu drug 'di/ /yi ge re rer kun gnas zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /78—40
