yin / /shes rab thabs kyi mnyam sbyor gyis/ /kha sbyor zhes byar brjod pa yin/ /lag gnyis kun tu 'khyud pa yin/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings lho)brjod/ /slar yang rnam par grol ba'i lam/ /'bab pa'i tshogs ku ni mchog tu dga'/ /sbyor ba kha sbyar nyid dang ni/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud du bzhed/ /rdo rje pad+ma dbye ba dang / / sgro chun ③sprang rtsi byed par bshad/ /skor ④ba gang phyir bskyod pa ste/ /bde de'i thabs kyis kun rig pa'o/ /dga' dang bde ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /zhags pa pad+mor bcug (nyepa yin/ /chags pa lcags kyu kho na ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgug /mi 'khrug rdo rjes dkrug 6)par bya/ /de ni gsal shing ⑦zhes byar brjod/ /de nas chags sogs nyon mongs kyi/ /bag chags dum bu nyid du bya/ /shin tu rgya cher dmigs pa yis(de/ /kun rdzob de bzhin brdung ba dang / /dngos kun rdo rjes mid sa9༄par bya/ /rdo rje zhes bya de bzhin gshegs/ /ji ltar bstan kyang de dbus su/ /rtag stong 'byin dang sdud pa po0/ /de ni de nyid ces bya ste/ /rang 'byung rtsomagacig gis khyab pa'o/ /gang ming tsosangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sgyu ma zhes byar grags pa ste/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid gang gnas pa'o/ /'di ni kun mkhyen zhes bya ste/ /kun tu 'gro ba mi shigs rtso pa'o/ /pad+ma yi ni sna rtse ru/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu kun bsgom 8bya/ /phyi rol yi ge spangs nas su/ /yid kyi bzlas dang ldan par bya/ /nges pa'i go 'phang rtag tu gnas/ /bstan 8pa chos dbyings rang bzhin no/ /rtag tu phra ba rdul tsodang bral/ /ye shes sku ste dri ma med / /gsal ba chos kyi rang bzhin shes/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'ba' zhig lho rmoyul / /phan tshun mdud pa'i 32gsang sngags ni/ /bye brag tu ni phye nas su/ /78—91

sa bon phreng ba de 1)nas bsgom(mi/ /hūm̐ gi skud pas brgyu ①bar bya/ /bsgrub bya 'gog par gyur na ni/ /gom pa gnyis kyang ④mi 'gro'o/ /'di yi shes rab lhan (lde)skyes te/ /de yi gzugs su gyur pas gnas/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod nas su/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di nas 'bar/ /sgyu ma chen po ⑥zhes byar bshad / /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub pa'o/ /skra rtse brgyar gyur pa yi cha/ /skad cig glog (7gi 'od zer can/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dus su ni/ /ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas(8na/ /phyogs bcu rnams su spros nas ni/ /lha dang lha min kun bsdigs te/ /snying ga'i (9)chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /bsregs te longs spyod 'khor lor song / /sna bug g.yas nas byung nas ni/ /slar yang zhugs te smin mtshams kyi/ /mdzod spu'i khung nas byung nas su/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i ⑩sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /sna sgo g.yon du zhugs nas ni/ /spyi bo'i nyi 'khor lo bsregs nas su/ /sngon gyi lam nas slar byung ste/ /slar yang spyi gtsug tu ni zhugs/ /bsregs par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas rnams51ge/ /dga' ba bskyed hurtenas lte chab yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni song gyur nas/ /sngon bzhin du ni gnas par gyur/ /dus min 'chi ba las rgyal nyid / /yan lag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang sbyar/ /thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni/ /zhal du mchod yon nges sbyar zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las sku gsum dang sngags dang rgyud kyi 'byung ba dang / 'chi ba blu tsob zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba ste bcwa tsolnga pa'o// //78—92

de nas dngos grub kun gyi gnas/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa ste/ /yid 'ong bcud ni kun gyi rten①/ /sems can kun la bde ster ba/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan②/ /bla re dam pa bres ③pas 'bar④/ /'dab rjostong ldan pa'i pad+ma che/ /sbyor ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa la/ /der ni lha mos zhus gyur pa/ /'khor lo kun gyi nges pa dang / /dbyangs rnams kyi ni bye brag dang ske/ /yi ge'i yidabye ba mi 'tshal te/ /'khor lo'i grangs ni ji lta bu/ /de rnams las ni ci zhig lags/ /sna tshogs glu yi sngags dang ni/ /'khrul ⑦'khor dag ni mdor bsdus dang / /'khor lo'i dbang phyug dus dang ni/ /de bzhin dpa' bo rnams kyi stanadu/ /'di dag la ni the tsom ⑨mchis/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ / bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩bka' stsal pa/ /rgyud rnams kun tu sbas pa gang / /de dag thams cad zhu 'dod pa/ /legs so legs so lha mo che/ /blo gros chen mo ⑩legs so legs/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad kyang ske/ /the tsom ⑩skye na gzhan ci smos/ /sgyu ma kun tu rnam 'phrul ba/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che/ /gang zhig bris pa tsam gyis ni/ /sgrub pos dngos grub 'thob 8'gyur ba/ /mdor bsdus nas ni brjod bya ste/ /de ni bdag gis bshad kyis ④nyon/ /gnag hunyedang dmar bar rtag gyur nas/ /khyad par du ni gtor ma sbyin/ /tsa ru'i bza' ba lhan cig bya/ /sgrub pa po yis g.yon nas bskor / /'di yis sgrub po kun la ni/ /ma mo dga' 'gyur the com 7med/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni/ /sa rnams la ni rnam rol pa/ /brtson chen 'khor lo 0sgyur ma dang / /stobs chen ma dang rab dpa' mo/ /'khor lo'i go 78—93

cha glang sna ma/ /khaṇ+ḍa ro ha 'khor lo'i shugs/ /bya gdong ma dang rta rna mo/ /shin tu bzang mo sngo bsangs 3mo/ /chang 'thung ma dang rlung shugs ma/ /de bzhin 'jigs byed chen mo dang / /sa srung (snyem dang ljon grib ma/ / lang ku'i ②bdag mo mi'u ( thung mo/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma sna chen mo/ /'od ldan ma dang gtum mig ma/ /rab gtum ma ste sgrub byed yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni (5)nyi shu bzhi / /'di dag sngon nyid grub tsi pa yin/ /rang ming brjod pa'i sngags la ni/ /mthar ni hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa dang sbyar/ /oṃ ni thams cad gsal (7dbyed do/ /grub gsol 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rnal 'byor dam mchog 'di (snyemathong na/ /gzhan dag snying po med rtswar ri9mtshungs/ /dpa' bo nyid gyur grub pa ni/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yi ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa mthong bas 7yin/ /de nas de shes rtag sgom 1nyapa/ /dngos grub de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /nyon cig lha mo shes rab can/ /rig pa'i rgyal po sgrub hu pa'i thabs/ /'khor lo chen po rmad gyur pa/ /gdengs ku'i dbang phyug ces bya ste/ /thos pa tsam gyis sreg 1 byed na/ /ming dang ldan par bris pa yis/ /gdengs ka thams cad smos ci dgos/ /dbang ldan nas ni brtsams nas su/ /klu rnams sa bon las byung ba/ /rin chen dang ldan gdengs gsum mtho/ /gzhan yang phyogs ni kun tu bsam/ /de nas mgur ni ribo'adi bzhes te/ /shar du k+ṣa me bar du bri/ /nub tu nyi ste byang du haṃ/ /gshin rjer rtsu zhes bya ba bris/ /ki li ki li yi dgas su/ /srin por tsi li ji snyed pa/ /rlung ni si li si li bri/ /me yi phyogs su dhi tsheli nyid/ /dang por rab gtum 51 snam nas ni/ /brtson chen ma yi mthar thug pa/ /sngags 'di dag ni byin gyis brlab/ /'khor lo 'di ni skal 78—94

chen ldan/ /dgra rnams kyi ni gnad gcod ①pa/ /rtsu phaṭa ces bya spel ba yi / /bsgrub ②bya de yi dbus su bri/ /lan cig ②bzlas pa'i gu gul gyis/ /bdug ④pa nyid du sbyar byas la(snye/ /klu rnams thams cad 'bebs par 'gyur/ /lag pa g.yon pa la 'khor lo 'di dngos su'am yid kyis bris la (6)sngags lan cig ⑦bzlas pas (nyebyabs na 'chi bas dus su zin pa slong bar ⑨byed do/ / ka ra bī ⑩ra'i 'dab ⑩ma'i khu bas ka ra bī lcagera'i smyug gus bris te/ lan cig tunyebazlas pas reg na mngal gang du 'dod pa der 'pho bar 'gyur ro/ /dug dang lan tshwa dang skye 8tshes bris te/ khros na gsod 8par 'gyur ro/ /ro bsregs pa'i mgal ⑩pa da ⑩du ra'i khu bas me pho bsad de 3)'byung po'i nyi ma la de nyid kyis 'khor lo bris la lan cig zhu )bzlas pa des gang la bsnun pa ltung bar 'gyur rol/ /sang ko ta'i sgyug gus sngags cho ga snga ma bzhin bris 0la/ thal ba la mngon par bsngags sate/ gang la bsnun pa de sha zas gzung ( nyebar 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi sol bas shing leb bam rtsig bungos la 'byung po'i du sematshan mo gang gi snying gar ( ༅ming bris pa de gdon chen pos gzung ( tshobar 'gyur ro/ /bsgrub bya'i gzugs byas la/ de'i snying kur 'khrul 32'khor bcug ste/ zhag bdun gyi bar du dri'i 47chu'i nang du bzhag nas/ a ti mug ta'i lcug ma la lan bdun bsngags te de la bsnun zhi stan/ zhag bdun gyi mthar rlung gi shugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo de nyid bye brag du dur khrod kyi ras la pho nya'i kha dog gis sumabye brag tu gyur pa bris la las kyi pho nya dang lhan cig tu bsgrub par bya'o/ / ka ra bī ra'i 0lhug ma khru phyed dang gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa la gang la mngon par phyogs te sngags bris nas ro bsregs 0pa'i me 'bar ba la dor (9te/ ji srid ma 78—95

tshig pa dang myur du blangs la rig pa'i rgyal po lan bdun bzlas nas gang zhig dran te klad 6)la bskor na/ de de'i mod la rlung gi shugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur rol/ /skyes pa'i ro'i kham phor (snyel ba bla chadang yung ba'i khu bas gang gi ④ming bris pa de de'i mod (5)la bcings par ⑥'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi ras sam zla mtshan gyi ras la shing a sho ku'i ④sgyug gus klu rnams spangs pa'i 'khor lo 'di bris la/ de'i dbus su sngags pas cho ga bzhin ⑧yi ge e dang spel ba bris na/mkha' 'gro ma'i khyad par thams cad dang / lus srul dhipo thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /thod pa la skyes pa'i khrag gis gang gi ming bris la sngags pa khro ba dang bcas pas sngags bzlas na/ de'i khrag 'gugs ⑩par byed la yid zhi ba dang ldan pas zhi bas sngags bzlas na slar gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo de nyid zla bas brgyan cing gsal shibar go ro tsa nas gro ga la skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par bris te/ bud med gang gis rtag tu bcangs 8na rig pa'i rgyal po nyid de'i lhums su zhugs hu par 'gyur ro/ /bud med dang zhi ba'i 'dus pas kun tu 8spyod pa'i mi'i rimamachog de'i lag mthil tson yod pa'i dpal gang gis kyang dbrog par mi nus la/ rnam pa de lta bu'i cho ga dang ldan pas ni dngos grub thams cad kyi 'bras bu ster bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la ⑩ni brtul zhugs dang spyod pa dang smyung nyu༄ba dang / cho ga med par yang cho ga zhib mo'i sbyor ba'i tshul 'di nyid kyis las thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin byed do / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus bsam pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste / /'od zer tshogs ni gsal ba'i mdangs/ /'khor lo'i phreng ba rnam par bklubs7ske/ /de dbus 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang / /pad+ma'i phreng bas shin tu 78—96

mdzes / /slar yang 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /①rdo rje phreng ba rnam par 'phro(ge/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor lta bu yin/ /nam mkha' thams cad g.yog byed pal/ /rang gi lus las spro bar byali/ /dkar dang dmar dang sngon po ste/ /kha dog mchog gi bye brag bya/ /bya ba'i cho ga 'di yis ni/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug de bzhin bri/ /dbus su bsgrub par bya ba'i ming ske/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng ba ni/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs bri/ /'di ni srung tshib chen po ste/ /thams cad srung dub bla na med/ /rims 4)dang nad dang dug dang ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis 'tshe ba dang / /gdon dang bdud dang log 'dren dang / /gang yang lus srul la sogs pa/ /grib ma yang ni mi 'gom dun/ / de yi 0lus lta smos ci dgos/ /zla gzugs lta bu'i yi ge lta0/ /phyogs bcur rnam par 'byer bar lho)byed/ /dkar po yis ⑩ni zhi 'gyur te/ /nag pos 8skad cig dag gis gsodayi/ /dmar po yis ni dbang byed de/ /de nyid kyis ni nges par 'gugs/ /ser pos nges par 'ching 'gyur te/ /dmag gi dpung ni 'ching bar 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ /las thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i srung ⑫ba'i 'khor lo'o/ / bka' yi ⑩'khor lo'i khyad par ni/ /de nas pho 7yang dag bshad par bya/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /sems can kun gyi don byed pa'o / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yi8/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ⑩lta bur 5 kye bsam/ / de dbus pad+ma bri bya ba/ /shurnyebacu drug 'dab (nyams rnam par brgyan bu/ /de dbus pad chen 'dab tsobargyad tripa/ /rdo rje rtse lnga pa yi mchog /'od zer dkar pos shin tu mdzes/ /sgrub 78—97

pos (1 'khor lo'i phyi rol bri/ /pad+ma'i lte bar swā hā bri/ /dngos grub thams cad rab (gester ba'o/ /ma mo'i khyim ni nyams dga' bar/ /tsan+dan dmar pos byugs tsho rinas ni/ /'bol zhing 0shin tu 'jam pa yi/ /stan la (snyeskye gnas phyag rgya bcing 76ci/ /sngags pas bsgrub bya mngon phyogs te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas par bya/ /yan lag rus pas brgyan bsam zhing / /gcer bur gyur pas rang gis bri/ /yi dgas gos sam ro yi ni/ /bum pa skam po dag la yang yi dgas sen 7rtsi khrag dang ni/ /de bzhin tsan+dan dmar pos bri/ /'khor lo de yi steng gnas te/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin thun gsum du/ /blo ldan mthe'u chung bskyod nas ni/ /bram ze gsod pa'ang nyin bdun 'grub/ /tsan+dan dmar po'i rdul las ni/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i gzugs byas la/ /tsha ba gsum gyis lus byugs nas/ /spra tshil gyis kyang byug par bya/ /zangs ma'i khab kyis skye gnas dbug /seng ldeng mdag shesam (9)du med la/ /blo dang ldan pas nyin bdun bsro/ /sgrub pa po yis brgya bzlas na/ /rgyal po blon bcas mdun na 'don/ /btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas par 7ni/ /myur du 'gugs par byed pa yin/ /gro ga yi ni 'dab 11ma la/ /ro yi sen rtsi 5nyenaro tsa nasanyunye/ /mi yi bdag po 'khor bcas pa/ /ming dang spel te bri bar bya/ /mngon par phyogs te bzlas bzhin du / /seng ldeng dang ni dur khrod mer8/ /ji srid spra tshil ma zhu bar/ /me yi steng du gdung bar bya/ /bsgrub bya mngon par gdungs tsam gyis/ /lha dang lha min 'ong 'gyur na/ /sa steng skye bo smos ci dgos/ /yi dgas sen rtsi me skyes pa yis / /khrag dang gi (1 tshowang bcas pa yis/ /bsgrub bya'i ming spel gro gar bri/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i rkang rjes sa/ /tsan+dan dmar po nyid dang ni/ /dur khrod 78—98

zas lhag thal ba rnams/ /sgrub ①pa po yis gcig bsdus nas/ /seng ldeng me ni du med la/ /rdul de lag pa gnyis kyis ②ni/ /mnyes nas sbyin sreg 57byas pa yis④/ /thal ba de ni bzung nas su/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i gzugs byas te⑤ / /snying gar 'khrul 'khor (chubacug nas ni/ /zlos bzhin du ni mer (7gdungs na/ /brgyal ⑤zhing sems dang bral 'gyur la/ /rmongs shing rab tu myos nas ni/ /rlung gi shugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur/ /cho ga'i bya ba 'di yis ni / /yi ge nyi ④shu rtsa gnyis bzhed/ /lha mo sngags chen 'di dag ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 7snying 'joms yin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs kun gyinyu1/ /yid 'ong zhi ba bskyed 8pa mo/ / bka' yi rtsonya'akhor lo bshad par bya/ /mkha' dbyings dbus gyur bsam pa ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje rtse gsum kha bzhi pa/ /des ni de nas bri bar bya/ /de dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad rngupal/ /shin tu mdzes pa bris nas su/ /be+e hunyero tsa na'i rig pa che/ /sems can kun skyed 0sdud pa mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /nad thams cad med par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sung ⑩ba'i 'khor lo'i sbyor ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan kun mkhyen pas/ ye shes mngon par shes pa yi 'khor lo zhes bya bka' stsal pa/ ge sar lte bar ldan pa yi / /pad+ma 'dab tsom drug par bri/ /zla ba bzang pos nye bar brgyan/ /rdo rje'i 7phreng bas rnam par bklubs( )/ /de yi phyi rol 'khor lo ste/ /ston ku'i zla ltar dri med pa tī/ /yi ge'i 'amachog ni rnam pa bdun/ /lha mo chen mo phan pa gcig /bdud thams cad kyi las 'joms par byed pa 'khor lo'i rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /tsan+dan dkar po ro tsa nas/ /gro ga zhu la ni bris nas su/ /'khor 78wa 99

lo lag pa g.yon par bcang / /'khor lo 'di ni lha mo che/ /las kyi 'od kyis brgyan pa yin/ /de nas bsgrub bya nyi chadabus su/ /bsams te ②stong du bzlas nas ni/ /yi ge shel gyi rnam pa ltar/ /bsams te nad kyis gdungs la bstan ske/ /mthong ba tsam gyi mod ④la ni/ /nad rnams kun las rnam ⑧grol bar darka/ /'gyur ba nyid du the tshom (7med/ /lag pa g.yon par 'khor lo 'di/ /zla ba'i dbus su rnam bkod na/ /ston ka yi ni zla 'drar 'gyur/ /'khor lo 'di ni lha mo che/ /las kyi 'od kyis rab brgyan na/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis / /bya ba thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /dur khrod ras sam thod pa 'am/ /arka (8)yi ni 'dab ri9skum la/ /sngar bstan pa yi sol ba dang / /skyes pa'i khrag gi snag tsha yis/ /sgrub pos mi 7rus sgyug gus bri/ /nyi ma'i dbus gyur khro sems kyis/ /gzugs brnyan byas la bsgrub bya yi7/ /dbus su de ni bcug nas su/ /ske tshe yis ni byugs nas ni/ /yang dang yang du bsro bar bya/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bskul hu ba yis/ /bya ba thams cad byed par 'argyur/ / 'di yi /nyend rnams thams cad ni/ /'phel dang de bzhin sbyor byed pa'o/ /rims la yi dgas snying gar sabri/ /'ga' re 8yi dgas klad 8pa ste/ /brjed 0byed rlung dang sprin la bri/ /gzer bar bya ba mdung la ste'oshe/ /dug dang mdze nad lto 'phye la/ /gza' la gza' yi (7mtshan mar bri/ /mdor bsdus nas ni 'khor lor dgod/ /shel dang zla ba'i 'od 'dra ba'i/ /yi ge bdud rtsi rgyun pya 'bab pas / / ston ku'i 2)zla zer lta bur ni/ /bsam gtan bsams dupa tsam gyis ni / /'chi ba'ang nges par slong bar 'gyur/ /sbrul chen brgya yis 0zin nas ni / /'chi ba'ang myur du slong bar byed/ /dug gis brgyal 2bar gyur pa dag /78wa 100

bstan pa tsam gyis slong bar 'gyur/ /rims dang gdon dang brjed ①byed dang ske/ /lag pa mthong bas rlag ②par byed/ /grib ma yang ni mi 'gom dun/ / de yi ④lus lta smos ci dgos/ /zangs ma yi ni 'dab ⑤ma 'am/ /lag pa g.yon par 'khor lo 'di/ /ba yibla dang ni yung bas bri/ /de nas chu yi (penang bzhag la/ /ji ltar 'byung bzhin 'bad de mchod/ /mtshams kyi dus su mnyam bzhag ⑧pas/ /de bzhin du ni sngags bzlas bya/ / chu yi tso)nang nas bton tsonas su/ /'o mas bkrus tsol rgya mtshor gzhugatso /g.yul du khu tshur bcangs nas ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam brgyan te/ /yid la rtag tu zlos byed na/ /ji srid khu tshur ma bgrol 8bar/ /myur du thams cad rengs 'gyur te/ /dgra bo gal te lag na ni/ /mtshon cha phyar ④te thogs pa yang / /ji srid khu tshur ma bgrol tsobar/ /mtshon cha gtong bar mi nus so/ /yi ge bdun dang rnal 'byor ma / /drug gi yi ge 'di dag ni/ /'khor lo drug la gnas par ni/ /lag pa'i dbus su bkod tsonas su/ /cho ga rim ⑩pas bcang bar bya/ /kha nas gsang sngags rgyal po zlos/ / de yi tsogazugs gyur bzung nas ni/ /de ni 'gugs tso'agyur the tshom bu med/ /tsan+dan dmar po'i rdul dang ni/ /lan tshwa ske 'o/tshe de bzhin te/ /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes rdul dang ni/ /gcig tu byas nas btag ⑫par bya/ /lan brgyar bzlas te rab bsgoms na bu/ /sa bdag ciskye bo'i nor dang ni/ /bcas te dbang du 'gyur ba tso'am/ /de ni 'gugs 0'gyur the tshom ( tshomed / /sbyor ba 'di ni grub 0pa ste/ /gzhan dag tu ni nga mi smra/ /rdul de nyid ni bzung nas su/ /lcags phye 0dang ni bsre dz+nya )bar bya/ /dur khrod ras la gtums dunas su/ /lan bdun du ci geni bzlas par bya/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor 78—101

sor brgyad tsam/ /brkos (1)te dgra yi (kyeming nas ni/ /bzung nas sa yis ①dgab par bya/ /gang gi ming bzung de bcings 'gyur/ /phye ma de nyid bzung nas su/ /'o ma yis ni 'bad de bkrul/ /slar yang grol ⑤'gyur the tshom ⑥med / /phye ma de nyid 7)bzung nas su/ /smyo byed lnga dang ldan par bya/ /ro yi gos la na kyibasgrub bya yi79na/ /ming bris nas ni gtum 7par bya/ /lan brgya bzlas te dur khrod du/ /sbas na /skyeskyes bu 'phral du ni/ /smyo 'gyur 'di la the tshom ⑫med / /phyung nas ba yi (1lha'o ma yis/ /'bad de slar yang bkrus yin ni/ /'grol 1lha'agyur 'dir 17ni the tshom nyu 3med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegasal/ /rdo rje dpa' bo'i 'khor lo gsungs/ /zla ba'i dbus 'gyur hunyerdo rje ni / /rtse gsum de bzhin kha drug pa/ /slar yang zla bar pad+ma ni/ /'dab ⑪drug legs par gnas pa bri/ /de yi dbus gyur sa bon ni/ /'dod don thams cad sgrub byed pa'o/ /sngags pas lte bar bri bar bya/ /bsgrub bya'i ming dang ri )spel bar bya/ /rdo rje sems sogs lha 0rnams ni/ /thams cad sna tshogs bla na med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi go cha che/ /mdzes ma'i gdong can khyod la bshad / /dbus su snga ma'i gsang sngags bri/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ( semar de bzhin gzhan / / ring po da drug ni yongs spangs pa/ /rdo rje yi ni lte bar bri/ /gur kum )sen rtsi rang khrag dang / /ro tsa na yis gro ga la/ /cho ga bzhin du bris nas ni/ /dus gsum du ni bzlas dgebyas la/ /mchod chen byas nas gzung bar ༷ stebya / /lan bdun du ni mngon bzlas zhunate/ /gos kyi mtha' ri —snyemar bcing bar bya//lam du 'gro na rkun po dang / /stag sogs 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /thams 78wa 102

cad du ni bsrung ①'gyur ba/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom (gyimed/ /lte ba der ni thig le yis/ /bskor ba'i thig le dag kyang bya/ /a ri tsa ta ①ka bcud dang ske/ / yung ba ④dag gis khyad par du/ /a sho ka yi ④sgyug gu yis⑥/ /dpa' bo yi ⑦ni ras mar bri/ /bsgrub bya'i ⑧ming dang spel ba yisasti/ /sngags 'di 0stong du de nas bzla7/ /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes sa dang ni/ /glang po che yi hu3rkang rjes rdul/ /dur khrod thal bar bcas pa las/ /sgrub pos gzugs brnyan byas nas su/ /bcing bas bcings te de yi ni/ /snying ga 32ru ni gzhug 7par bya / /me tog ser pos mchod nas ni/ /gsang ba'i gnas su sbas gyur na/ /dgra rnams thams cad 'ching 'gyur zhing / /rlag 8par byed pa mi bzad par/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 0snying po'i sngags/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /nam mkha'i dbyings gyur sa bon ni/ /kun tu 'od zer rab 'phro ba/ /ston ku'i zla ltar dri med pa'i/ /'khor lo rtsibs ni bcu gnyis bya/ /rtsibs de rnams la sa bon gyi0/ /yi ge mchog tu phan pa dgod/ /de yi lte bar dgod bya ba / /rig pa chen mo'i (sheyi ge che/ /bsrung 7ba rdo rje'i chog rig pasadu )/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun go cha du /bya/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bskul ba yi/ /dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming bri bya/ /rnam pa'i mchog kun ldan pa ru/ /spro ba'i bdag nyid can gyis spro/ /gur kum ( 2dang ni ro tsa nas/ /gro ga 'am ni ras dkar la/ /snying stobs can gyis bri bar bya/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yinas/ /thams cad du ni bsrung ④ba dang / /sgrub nunyepa po yis sngar bstan bzhin/ /gdug pa rnams ni tshar gcod byed/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'i/ /las mchog de 78—103

nas bshad par bya/ /gang zhig bsgrubs gyo)pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po dbang byed pa'o/ /skye gnyis rdo rje'i rigs dang ni/ /gzugs bzang bu mo gzhan yang rung / / ka ra bī rira'i me tog dmar/ /rgyal gyi sbyor bas bsgrub par bya/ /go ro tsa nas bsgrubs nas su/ /me tog der ni chur gnas la/ /sgrub ( po shin tu mnyam bzhag byupas/ /lan brgya (peru ni bzlas par bya/ /chu bo chen por zhugs nas su/ /lte ba man chad chur bcug ste/ /lag pa thal sbyar dbus bzung nas/ /rig pa stong du bzlas par bya/ /snyim pa chu yis bkang ba dang glu/ /bcas pas sgrub pos btung bar bya/ /de nas de ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /sgrub pos ngag leni grub pa yis/ /rgyal po chung mar bcas pa dag9) /yid kyis 'gugs 85'gyur gdon mi za/ / ka ra bī khyira'i me tog ni/ /dmar po yang dag bzung nas ni/ /rig pa lan bdun bzlas byas la/ /skye gnas dbus su gzhug 1 )bya ste/ /me tog de ni kha sbyar nas/ /gsang ba'i gnas su gzhag 7par bya / /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor pas/ /brgya phrag gcig tu bzlas par bya/ /sgrub po rtse gcig yid kyis ni/ /me tog de ni blangs nas su/ /me tog gis ni gang bsnun pa/ / de yi 1 med 51snyel dbang du 'gyur/ /brgyal ④zhing sems dang bral 'ob dang 17/ /yan lag tshigs kun gzhan dbang stebya/ /mngon 'gyur hu3sems ni ldog pa ru/ /skad cig gis ni dbang byed 'gyur/ /'di ni mngon sum grub pa yi/ /don yod dbang du byed pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/6/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gugs tsu )pa'i cho ga 'khor lo'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'o/ /gang zhig bris pa tsam gyis su/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang 0brlag 'gyur ri rtezhing / /dngos grub myur du ster 'gyur ba/ /de nas yang dag 78wa 104

bshad par bya①/ /zla ba'i dbus gyur (kyerdo rje ste/ /de bzhin gzhan yang pad+ma'ol/ /kun nas rnam par 'phro ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gas bon dgod/ /dbus su rdo rje phag mo ni/ /shin tu drag cing ④gsal ba'i gzugs/ /yi ge'i dgod pas dgod par bya/ /rim pa de ltar brjod pa la/ /zhi la zhi ba'i yid kyis su/ /ro tsa na yis gro gar bri/ /ma mo'i gnas dang dur khrod du/ /gos chen de bzhin khro dang bcas/ /chags pa la ni dmar po'i gos/ /rgyas 6)la gos ser de bzhin te/ /de dang der ni bsgom (6)byas nas/ /ci rigs par ni sprul par bya/ /bu mo gzhon nu'i ro yi ⑦ni/ /gos ni 'bad de blangs nas su/ /tshes brgyad dang ni bcu bzhi la/ /de (shenyid las byung sol ba yis/ /sna tshogs rdo rje kha bzhi lal/ /sngags dang spel bar bris nas ni/ /lan bdun du ni bzlas nas su/ /gang gi khyim du sbas gyur pa/ /de ni gshin rje'i grong khyer du/ /nyi ma bdun gyis 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de yi rkang pa'i rkang 0sbubs dang / /bum pa la sogs dag kyang rung / /rus pa'i phur bu'i sbu gur ni/ /'khrul 1lha'akhor 'di ni bcug bya ste/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /'chi 'gyur 'dir ni gdon mi za/ /las rnams kun la sgrub pa pos/ /cho ga dang ni ldan par bya/ /rang gis bzung tsoba'i sngags kyis ni/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyas mi 'onya'agrub/ /las 'di mchog tu shes bya ste/ /sngags gzhan rgyas pas ci zhig bya/ /de dag thams cad spangs nas su/ /'di nyid sko'abad 8de gzung tsobar bya/ /gang dang gang gi bsam gtan gyis/ /sgrub pos bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /sbyor ba de dang de dag gis/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'thob ⑩par 'gyur/ /ji ltar nor bu dag pa ni/ /rdzas gang la brten nyunyede gzugs 'dzin/ /de bzhin rdo rje 78—105

mkha' 'gro yang / /yang dag bsam gtan mchog 'dzin 'gyur/ /bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /de dang de yi ①dngos 'gyur te(ge/ /sna tshogs rgozugs can nor bu bzhin/ /de nyid bsdus dang 'dus pa ste/ /gzhan yang sngon dang tha ma yi(ge/ /de nyid sbyor ba'i cho ga can / /bya ba'i rgyud rnams thams cad du/ /ji srid me yis 'jig gi bar/ /de der 'gro ba nyon mongs (ga'agyur/ /thams cad du ni sbas ⑤pa ste/ /brtson 'grus pha rol 'joms pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid che/ /myur du dngos grub skye 'gyur ba/ /'phral ༅du yang dag yid ches byed/ /sgrub pos phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /nyon ⑦mi mongs ⑧par 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig mi ldan mi dag la/ /klog gam gal te byin gyur na/ /ngan 99)pa'i bdag nyid bcom ⑩nas ni/ /ngan 'gro rnams su ltung bar 'gyur/ /g.yon gyi rgyud ni dmigs nas su/ /skye bo g.yon gyi spyod pa bya / /thams cad g.yon pas byas na (lhani/ /myur du dngos grub 'grub 'gyur zhes / /sgyu ma kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po hu dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dpa' bo thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i 'khor lo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /snying po thams cad bsdus pa ste/ /sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /sgrub po'i bdud rtsi sbyor ba'i mchog /ga pur 78wa 106

dang ni gur kum ①dang / / garnya garnya ②pa tra ste/ /shing tsha dang ni sug smel bcas / /ku sum dang ni de bzhin chu/ /pi si ta dang kun du ru/ /de bzhin ri yi zhag chadang ni/ /ri skyes dang ni spu gu'i zhag / dri yi byamar khu so dang ni / /de bzhin lag skyes kyi ni rdul/ /gangs kyi chu dang snying po dang / /rgya mtsho las skyes de dag ni/ /lus can rnams (snyel phan byed pa/ /gang gang la ni gangs chu bzhin/ /de ltar bcwa ⑥brgyad rdzas rnams ni/ /bcud kyis len mchog phan byed yin/ /de nas brtag pa'i las dang ni/ /yon tan yan stilag cho ga bshad/ /tsam pa ka dang ba ku la/ /nā (gug ge sar ku mu tan)/ /ut+pal she shā ⑩li ka dang / /sbrang rtsi 'dzag dang pri yang ku/ /ku su ma ni nyid dag go/ /shrī lhonyeb la dang po so 'cha'/ /ka pi ta dang la ku tsha/ /ku tsob dang ni brta ki/ /a ru ra dang ba ru ra/ /ba la ta na)ka skyu ru ra/ /e la rtsi tsodang pu 8na ka /e raṇ+ḍa 0dang ma ri tsi'o 1/ /de bzhin du ni pi pi ling / /bca' 8ba dang ni shu dag dang ske/ /yung ba dang ni ru rta dang / / bca' sga yidang ni sgog skya dang / /rlan can gyi ni do pya ba dang / /nā ( ri7ga pha du gyel dkar po dang / /de bzhin rgan po gzhon nur byed/ /glang chen dgra dang ri mdzes dang / /'dzag dang byis pa stag po dang / /ral pa dmar po smyo byed dang / /mtshan mo'i shing dang myur 'gro dang / / ka daspa du )dang gser shing ste/ /de bzhin du ni shi ri sha /ka ran dza chadang shri kru chadang / /nim pa dang ni pi la si/ /de bzhin ga du ma dza ri / /pa la sha dang tsan+dan gnyis/ /de bzhin a gar nag po dang / / gur kum 0gur shing bye ka ra 1/ /sbrang rtsi mo k+ṣa puṣa ༷ steka ra/ /me tog 'bras bu rtsa ba dang ske/ /shun pa shing gyudang ro nyid do/ /khu byug zangs kyi gtsug phud ru )can/ /78wa 107

bya rog dang ni gar ra dang / /rma gyo)bya thi (7bya phug ron dang / /drang srong bu stobs 'phel bar byed/ /ra dang ri bong (kyeri dgas dang / /sa li ga dang phag dang ni/ /khyad par du ni byi ba rnams/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms par byed / /me tog 'bras bu shun pa'i chang / /de bzhin du ni 'bru yi ④cang / /gzhan yang chang gi bye brag dag /mdor bsdus nas ni btung ba'i mchog /'di dag skyes pa bud med kyi/ /stobs rnams skyed (snyepa'i sman yin te/ / nad rnams thams cad 'joms par byed/ /6)bza' dang btung medang bzhib (nyepa dang / /ldag (7pa dang ni mur ba dang / /sna sman mgo bor bsku ba dang / /bkru ba dang ni dril phyi tshadang / /bza' dang btung sogs de dag ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sbyor ba mchog /de ltar drug cu rtsa bzhi yi(sto/ /rdzas dang bcwa tsobargyad dag tu sbyar / /sbom po phra mo'i sbyor ba rnams/ /skyes pa dang ni bud med kyang / /chung skongu la sogs dbye ba ste/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun sogs/ /re re zhing yang gsum gsum thu'adod/ /nag po dkar po sngo bsangs te/ /'dzag dang de bzhin 'pho ba la'o/ /dgra dang mdza' bshes rtsabar ma ste/ /khams kyi sde tshan tsobasdus pa yin/ /dpa' bo gcig dang skye gnyis rtsa/ /'bras bu chen po bska tīb gsum/ /lhang tsher dang ni dngul chu bzhi/ /bdud rtsi yi ni snying po lnga/ /dus drug de bzhin drug cu ste/ /bdun po yal ga 'dab 9/shesogs bcas/ /skam sa dang ni rlan 37can yul/ /mar dang mar nag bkru tsu )sman ni/ /rno dang dngul chu'i zas su sbyinari lha/ /rang skyur dang ni yung ba dag /cha mnyam dngul chu'i 'bras bu ste/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer bsros nas ni/ /sbrang rtsi yi ni thigs pa blugs 2ske/ /thal sman lan tshwas bu gar bsgrub ste/ /ro ni bska steb rnams dang 78wa 108

yang ①/ /lhang tsher dkar po'i skyo ma sbyin/ /dngul chu drug char bya ba mchog /skyed byed ②don ni rga ba 'joms/ /cha ni tshad ldan 'ching byed de/ /'bras bus bya ba byed par 'gyur/ /sngon du gser shog blugs (2)pa yis/ /rang skyon 'joms pa'i cho ga yin/ /de nas chu dang lan tshwa dang / /thal ba'am rdul ni blug ④par bya/ /dron mo blugs na skra dkar skye/ /glang chen mgo yi (5)bcud blangs la/ /seng ge'i tshad du bco bar bya/ /de nas slar ni phyung nas su/ / mar ku'i ⑥shing gi khu ba blugs(mu/ /tshos pa'i 'od kyis snying mig 'joms/ /tsan+d+ra ⑧dang ni ra sa na/ /sgog 9)skya dang ni ker sa dang / /a tra pa ti'i rus pa dang —/ /de bzhin du ni me tog gzung bo/ /bya rmi shistodang ni kun 8du ru/ /sa ri ba dang sen mo dang / /nor bu zla 'od na huḥge sar/ /thigs pa'i rgyun dang ka dmatso / /tsam 8pa ka 8ri so ba dang / /shi shu bil ba ut+pa la/ /rang skyur dang ni bcas pa ru/ /'dzag dang dngul chu kha tshos bya/ /phyung 3)na sbrul gyi gzugs ltar 'gyur/ /khrag dang smyo byed mtshan shing blugs38/ /skra dkar gyi ni nyes pa 'joms / /rgas dang mdze nad sel bar byed/ /rnon po thal sman bcas pa yis/7)la/ /bkrus shing bskus na 2 stagazhang 'brum 'joms/ /lto skyes ma rnyings ri rirmirdzas kyi las/ /bcud dang bcud len mar zhag sngagasardo 2/ /shi ri sha yi du rtswas ④kyang gzag /mgor gnas la skyes ldan par bya/ /mdog dmar dngul chu rmongs pa gso/ /gsos hunyete 'khrus ri 9na 'bras bu'i lam/ /tshad las 'das na dug tu 'gyur/ /de nas pags tsho mepa shun pa dang / /me tog dang ni 'bras bu sogs / /kha dang bska sbyo 3dang mngar ba dang / /tshwa dang skyur po la sogs pas/ /khyad par du ni btso bya ba/ /kha med rdzar ni btso bar bya/ /kha dang bcas par 78wa 109

chen po/ /ma ru'i yul du rim pa mo/ /'jigs gdong dpa' bo'i skye gnas 'byung ①/ /lcags kyu zhags thogs lha mo de/ /zhing der shin tu myos pas gnas / /yul der gnas pa'i lha mo de/ /dbye chen la ni brten te (kyeganas/ /gtsigs pa zhes bya'i zhing skyong ni/ /rmongs par byed pa bzhin (kyeyangs pa'o/ /nā ④ga rar ni thong gshol ma/ /sme brtsegs yan lag skye gnas byung / /ro langs can ni 'od chen ma⑤/ /dpa' bo kun la dngos grub stsol/ /gnas der gnas pa'i bzang mo de/ /spa ⑥yi shing gi ldum rar gnas/ /spu (7yi byin pa zhes bya ba'i/ /k+ṣe tra pā (shel gtsigs pa che/ / puṇ+ḍa bar ta'i (geyul du ni/ /tsa muṇ+ḍi 0zhes bya ba ste/ /stobs po che yi (17skye gnas byung / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis lag pa brgyan/ /lha mo spyod dang grol bar 8byed/ /sdig pa ma lus zad byed pa/ /bum pa zhes bya'i tunyezhing skyong ni/ /zhing de na ni yang dag gnas/ / dzā larnyar tsoni bzhin dngas tsom/ /chags pa'i rigs kyi skye gnas 'byung tso/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ⑩thogs nas ni/ /bde ba'i mchog ni kun la ster/ /grong khyer mchog der gnas lha mo/ /khang pa rtseg hunyamar brten te husteganas/ /ral pa gsum zhes bya ba yis )/ /zhing skyong shin tu gtsigs pa 2lhache/ /bre ta rdo ges rir glog gi gdong / /gtsigs pa'i skye gnas yang dag byung / /lha mo dbyig pa shat+ta du ༄thogs/ /bsam tsu )pa thams cad rdzogs byed ma/ /zhing der gnas pa'i lha mo de/ /drag pa'i du snyegazugs can 'jigs par byed/ /dril bu'i sgra zhes bya ba yi/ /k+ṣe tra pā la smad ( wīpa min/ /lug pa'i gdong can 'jigs su rung / /so ba der ni me lce'i gdong ske/ /zangs gri yis zhurteni lag pa brgyan/ /sha chen gyi ni stan sgo la gnas/ /bde ba'i dbang phyug rab ster ba/ /zhing der gnas pa'i lha mo che nye/ /shal ma 78—117
