te ①gnas/ /sems can thams cad 'jigs par byed/ /brtul zhugs chen po zhes bya ba'i/ /k+ṣe tra pā ②la zhing der gnas/ /rgyal po'i ①khab tu dza na sa/ /khrag chen gyi ni skye gnas byung / /rdo rje lcags kyur ④yang dag ldan/ /pha rol g.yul las rgyal bar mdzad/ /zhing der gnas pa'i lha mo de/ /dzi la'i ⑤sgra 'byin 'jigs par byed/ /rna chen zhes bya'i zhing skyong ni/ /rtag tu de dang nye bar gnas/ /bod yul du ni lhan skyes te/ /rang byung gi ni skye gnas byung / /chu srin rgyal mtshan lag na thogs/ /zhi zhing gsal ba'i gzugs can te/ /yul der gnas pa'i lha mo de/ /brag gi khyim la brten te yiganas/ /longs spyod zhes bya'i dpa' bo che/ /k+ṣe tra pā ⑦la thub dka' ba'o/ /mā dul bar ni tso)dbang bskur ma/ /tho ba yi ni phyag rgya thogs/ /sgrub pa po la rtag tu brtse/ /grags dang dpal dang bkra shis ster/ /zhing der gnas pa'i lha mo de0/ /mngar ba'i shing la brten te gnas/ /skyes bu'i dbang phyug zhes bya ba'i/ /zhing skyong sna tshogs dbang phyug yod/ /zhing 'di rnams kyi bu mo dang / /dpa' bo rnams ni dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu mtshan mo 'phyan 0pa dang / /rtag tu mtshan mo 'du bar byed/ /mkha' la spyod pa rnyed dka' ba'i/ /dngos grub yangs pa ster 'gyur te/ / sgrub pa po yi 7las rnams ni/ /thams cad 'grub 'gyur the tshom hu med/ /de nas dngos grub kun ster ba'i/ /mchod pa'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /me tog bdug pa de bzhin du/ /mar me dri yi khyad par dang / /gtor ma'i snod kyis nye bar mchod/ /sha rlon dang ni nya la sogs/ /bza' ba'i rdzas ni thams cad dang / /de bzhin bdud rtsi lnga yi mchog /g.yon gyi char ni snod yin te/ /g.yas su khro bo bstan par bya/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni 78—119

dur khrod dang / /ri bo ①dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang bzhi mdo ②zhing dang ni / /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /sems can snod dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni chu la gnas/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du bsten (kyepa dang / /nag po gtsigs pa 'jigs byed dang / /rga las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byad ④ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang u ma dang / /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo (snyebazang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ⑥ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdang chadang 'phyang ba mo/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jib byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen mo9)/ /thod phreng phreng dang (94kha ṭ+wāṃ r+sha )ma/ /sbrul chen skoral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma / /de nyid chen mo'i mkha' 'gro lnga/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo(12/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang mo bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon ( cig /oṃ kuk+ka rgya na ba ba ban dha na kha kha khā da na sabra duglen yiha na ha na bhā ta ya bhā ta ya a mu ka su kār+ya ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dzaḥtsheswā hā/ bdud rtsi yis ni kha bkang ste/ /lha rnams thams cad tshim par bya/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma yis ni/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub par bsgomanyune/ /oṃ bak+ṣa bak+ṣa r+sha 7sarba yo ge shwa ri hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥhosheswā hā/ la sogs sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma'i las ni sbyar bya ste/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /gsad sti/dang snang dang bcing ba la/ /78—120

sgrub pos gtor ma'i de nyid kyis/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub bya zhing / /ye shes lcags kyu'i bye brag gis/ /rang 'dod lha ni tshim par bya/ /zhing dang gnas ①dang de bzhin grong / /grong khyer ri yi rtse mo ru/ /'byung po thams cad tshogs gyur par/ /'dus na sgrub po la mchog ster/ /gnas la sogs par rtag ②gnas shing / /sgrub pa po ni gus ldan la/ /lha mo rnams kyis mchog ster bar②ske/ /sgrub pa po la the tshom ④med/ /gang gis sgrub ⑤pa po 'grub pa'i/ /ro yi bsgrub ⑥pa bshad par bya/ /rgan po ma yin rma med cing / /mdze dang shu ba la sogs spangs/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ⑦pa yis/ /'byung po'i nyi ma la bsgrub bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi khyad par dang / /lha yi chu yis bkru bar bya(kye/ /mar khu chen pos byug pa dang / /bdug pa chen pos de bdug bya/ /maṇ+ḍal (9)gru bzhi byas nas ni/ /de dbus 'bad pas gru gsum bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la gson/ /zhes bya la sogs sngon bzhin brjod/ /ha hā nyi tī tso hūṃ hūṃ 0he he/ zhes bya'i dgod 42pa rnam pa na:brgyad/ /sgrub pa po yis ④chog nyugebazhin bya/ /me la gnas pa'i sa bon ni/ /rlung gi sa bon gyis phye ba/ /spyi gtsug tu ni sbyar byas la/ /sa yi steng du mchod par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dbus tsoganas par/ /'bad pa yis ni myur du blta/ /sgrub pos bdag nyid bsam bya ba/ /skye gnas dbus su rim bzhin blta7/ /'bar phreng 8gi ni rgya mtsho ste/ /pho nya 'od dang bcas blta ⑩zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'du ba'i tsu )gnas nges pa dang / sgrub 0pa'i cho 78—121

ga'i rim par phye ba ste bcwa ①brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dge ba dang / /lha rnams thams cad bsgrub tshan pa dang / /de bzhin pho nya'i khyad par dang / /'byung po gdon gyi rig pa che/ /gang gzhan lus srul ①la sogs pa/ /de bzhin sngags kyi phreng ba rnams/ /da ④ni khyod la bshad kyis ⑤nyon/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo khyud dang ni ldan pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bri bar bya / /dngos grub kun gyi yon tan gnas/ /'dod yon lnga yis rab brgyan pa/ /mchod pa lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /ro la g.yogs pa'i ras sam ni/ /mtshon gyis brgyab tsho65pa'i ras 7dadag dang / /bu btsas pa yi ⑧ras dang ni/ /ba lang ⑨ko ba la sogs la/ /dam tshig can gyi 'dri ⑩mkhan gyis/ /sgrub po mchog gis 'dri 97ru gzhug /tshes brgyad dang ni bcu bzhi la/ /'byung po'i tsodakyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /de nas 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas/ /mngon sum du ni mdun gnas 'gyur/ /tshangs pa mo dang zhi ba mo/ /gzhon nu mo dang phag mo dang ske/ /dbang mo dang ni tsa muṇ+ḍing// /tshogs kyi dbang mo sreg byed ma/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i'onyurte/ /dbang po gshin rje chu lha dang / /lus ngan dang ni yi dgas gtso'oge/ /sreg byed bden bral ⑩rlung gi lha/ /rim pa gsum pa'i'os sna/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /mig dmar dang ni gza' lag 'oshedang / /phur bu dang ni pa ba sangs/ /spen pa dang ni rā 0hu la/ /rim pa bzhi pa'i'ong )/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug de bzhin du/ / ru dra 0skom byed sgo bzhir ro/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /'byung po chen po'i khams rnams dang / /mkha' 'gro ma 78—122

dang mar me ma/ /'jib ①byed 'phrog byed bcas ②pa'i gtso/ /'byung po las kyang 'byung ba'i nigazugs/ /sgrub pos ④cho ga bzhin du bsgrubs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dbus su kun nas zlum por ni/ /ri mo mdzes pas stibaskor bar bya/ /pad ma 'dab brgyad bris nas ni/ /ge sar gsang ba'i spyod yul gyi/ /dbus su khro bo chen po bri / /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gtsigs/ /khro dang bcas shing bzhad pa'i zhal/ /sku mdog sngon po drag chen po/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par bklubs7/ /yi dgas la zhon nyi mar bzhugs/ /sum cu gsum pa 'jigs par mdzad/ /gar dang ldan zhing stag ⑧lhags mnabs / /spyan gsum shin tu gsal ba'i gzugs/ /rdo rje 'bar ba ba dan gsum / /khrag gang ba yi ⑨gshol pyadang bcas/ /mda' dang gzhu ni de bzhin te / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gis 'phyar/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma bri ste/ / lho yi hunyephyogs su 'phrog byed ma/ /'jib 'byed lha mo nub tu bri/ /byang du lha mo 'bar ma'o/ /lha mo phag nyu༄mo zhes bya ba/ /phyag bzhi yi ge hrīḥ0las byung / /sku mdog sngon mo drag rtse chen mo/ /phag gi gdong 8can 'jigs par byed/ /mda' dang de bzhin gzhu dang ni/ /rgyal mtshan thod pa thogs pa'o/ /zhi ba mo ni dze ⑩las byung / /mdog dmar gzi brjid chen mo ste0/ /thod pa dang ni lcags kyu dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍam hu)ru de bzhin no/ /gzhon nu ma ni haṃ so )las byung / /kha dog ser mo phyag bzhi pa/ /mdung rtse gsum dang ba dan gsum/ /mda' dang gzhu ni de bzhin no/ /tsa muṇ+ḍi zhunyeni ho las byung / /mdog sngo lag pa bzhi pa ste/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ dang ni thod pa dang / /gshol du nyedang de bzhin ḍa ma ru/ /bo 78—123

las byung ba'i tshangs pa mo/ /mdog dkar lag pa bzhi pa ste/ /pad ma dang ni thod pa dang / /de bzhin gzhan na stimada' gzhu'o/ /tshogs kyi dbang mo gi las byung / /sngo bsangs mdog ste lag bzhi ma/ /mdung rtse gsum dang thod pa dang ske/ /bgrang phreng g.yon gyi (kyelag tu thogs/ /khyab 'jug ma ni bam ①las byung ske/ /mdog sngo lag pa bzhi pa ste/ /chang dang chu yi thod pa dang / /zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ de bzhin gzhan/ /dbang mo i ④las byung ba ste/ /mdog ser lag pa bzhi dang ldan/ /rdo rje shasti ⑧thod pa dang / / sdigs mdzub (nyadang ni zhags pa nyid / /thams cad gyen skra 'bar ba dang / /sna tshogs kyis ni brgyan pa ste/ /ro yi stan bzhugs spyan gsum dang / /stag (7)gi pags pas 6)rked dkris pa'ol/ /shar sgor tshangs pa bri bya ste/ /mdog dkar lag pa bzhi dang ldan/ /thod pa dang ni bgrang phreng dang / /ril ba spyi blugs pad+ma thogs/ /byang du de bzhin khyab 'jug ste/ /mdog 6)sngon lag pa bzhi dang ldan/ /mdung ⑩dang de bzhin 'khor lo dang / /thod pa dang ni dbyug pa mchog /lho ru ru dra 7bri bya ste / /du ba'i mdog can lag pa bzhi/ /rtse gsum mdung dang thod pa dang / /zhags pa dang ni bgrang phreng thogs/ /nub tu skem hu)byed bri bya ste/ /mdog ser lag pa bzhi dang ldan/ /shat+ta 8dang ni dbyug pa dang / /dpa' bo'i 8thod pa bgrang phreng 8thogs/ /dbang ldan khyu mchog stan la zhon/ /kha dog dkar po lag bzhi pa/ /thod pa dang ni rtse gsum thogasatso/ /gzhan gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o / /dbang po glang chen zhon pa ste/ /mdog ser lag pa bzhi dang ldan/ /rdo rje dang ni thod pa thogs/ /gzhan gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /me ni lug gi stan 1mel zhon/ /kha dog dmar po lag bzhi pa/ /me thab nyid dang thod pa 78—124

dang ske/ /gzhan gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /gshin rje ma he'i ①stan la zhon/ /kha dog sngon po lag bzhi pa/ /dbyug pa dang ni thod pa thogs/ /gzhan gnyis skrag ste thal sbyar ba'o/ /bden bral mi ro'i stan bzhugs pa/ /kha dog ljang khu (snyelag bzhi pa/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa thogs/ /gzhan gnyis skrag ste thal sbyar ba'o / /chu lha chu srin stan la bzhugs/ /kha dog dkar po lag bzhi pa/ /zhags pa dang ni thod pa thogs/ /gzhan gnyis skrag ste thal sbyar ba'o/ /rlung ni sha ba'i stan la bzhugs/ /du ba'i mdog can lag bzhi pa/ /ba dan dang ni thod pa ③thogs/ /gzhan gnyis de bzhin thal sbyar ba'o/ /lus ngan gter gyi stan la gnas/ /kha dog ser po lag bzhi pa/ /rin chen dang ni tho ba thogs/ /gzhan ④gnyis de bzhin thal sbyar ba'o/ /gza' dang skar ma thams cad kyang / /rang rang dam tshig las byung zhing / /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing stobs chen pog/ /rang rang stan yil gnas par bsam/ /ma mo rnams kyang kun gyi ma/ /'byung po'i 0rig pa gzhan de bzhin/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub pa yi/ /pho nya'i sgrub ⑤thabs de nas bshad/ /so sor stobs kyis tshar gcad ⑨pa/ /nyon cig lha mo skal chen ma7/ /longs spyod la dga'i sgrub pa pos/ /pho nya'i las ni btsam ⑩par bya/ /zla ba 8rdo rje'i cho ga yisahunye/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms tsobyas te/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bskul ba yis/ /thams cad bran bzhin byed par 'gyur / /dur khrod dang ni shing gcig tu/ /der ni dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya / /shar dang byang dang nub dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni lho 8phyogs su/ /drug drug tu ni byas nas su/ /de nas mchod pa brtsam par bya/ /gnas la tsosogs pa nyi shu bzhi/ /rim pa bzhin du yongs su bskor/ /dri dang me tog de bzhin 78—125

dul / /mar me dang ni dri yi chu/ /de ②yi chu yis bkang ba yi/ /bum pa'ang gos kyis mdzes par bya/ /nyin mtshan phrugs gcig gnas gyur cing / /de nas mtshan gcig gnas par bya/ /gnas sogs yang dag ③phyag byas nas/ /de nas bzod pa gsol bar bya/ /dpa' bo yi ni ston mo yis/ /dang por slob dpon mnyes par bya/ /de ltar byas pa'i sngags pa yis/ /phyi nas las ni brtsam ④par bya/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang / /dmyal bar nges par bsreg ⑤'gyur te/ /bgegs kyis nye bar gtses yinas ni/ /nges par dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i 'dri ⑦mkhan gyis/ /'byung po'i nyi ma ⑧la rnyed ⑨pa'i/ /bu btsas la sogs ras la ni/ /tshon rtsi khrag dang bsres ⑩ nas su/ /steng du skyes pa'i nang bzhag yinas/ /sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya / /yi dgas sen rtsi mar chen dang / /sha chen gyis ni bdug par bya/ /de la dri yis bsgos nas su/ /de bzhin yi dgas me tog mchod/ /lha mo chen mo ⑫mchod pa 'dis/ /me 'bar ma ni mchog tu mnyes/ /shing gcig gi ni drung du ni/ /cho ga bzhin du 'bum bzlas bya/ /rgyal la sogs pa'i dus su ni/ /slob dpon gyis 'orteni 'dri stiru gzhug8 /sor ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /gzugs bzang bzhon pa tshephun sum tshogs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa lca 7ste / /gos ni ser po 8bgos par bri/ /lag gnyis gyen du thal mo sbyar/ /me 'bar ba ni kun tu 'od/ /sgrub po'i mdun du bkram nas ni/ /'bad de cho ga bzhin mchod bya/ /me tog dmar dang dri la 7sogs/ /sha skam gyis ni bdug par bya/ /sha dang nya sha btsong ( )la sogs/ /nye bar spyod pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /rdzas lnga dag gi dngos po yis/ /mchod nas 'bum du bzlas na ni/ /dang po la 78—126

ni sgra 'byung ste/ /gnyis pa la ni nya dri bro/ /gsum par shing ni g.yo 'gyur te/ /bzhi pa la ni mdun du gnas/ /dam tshig phyag rgya ①bstan nas ni/ /sngags ni de la brjod par bya/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /spyi bor bzhag ste brjod bya ba/ /oṃ de 〈be shwa ri hūṃ/ phuḥphuḥphuḥl/ dam tshig gi dusngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis bkang ⑤ba yi/ /dam tshig chu ni sbyin par bya/ /'bad de dam tshig byin nas ni/ /lag pa g.yon pas gzung dubar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis med pa/ /byin gyis rlobs la nga sgrubs shig⑦ /de nas shin tu mdzes ma yis/ /bza' zhobyedang btung sogs ston mo dang / /gser zho gnyis ni ster 'gyur te/ /zad pa nyid du longs spyod bya/ /'dod la dga' ba'i 'bar byed ma/ /gal te grub par ma gyur na/ /drag mo yi ni sa bon gyis/ /gzir 0te 'bum du bzlas par bya/ /sa bon gyis ni gzir 0tsam gyis/ /mar ⑪me ma yi spyi bo 'gems/ /rtag tu sems can don brtson pas/ /'bar ma chung mar bsgrub par bya/ /nyon cig lha mo shes rab che/ /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro sgrub 7pa'i thabs/ /thang ka khru nyunyaganyis byas nas su/ /lhag ④par gnas te mchod gtor nas/ /de nas ri mo 'dri 8ru gzhug /dkar zhing dmar la shin du mdzes/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i yin bza' gsol / /lag na sdigs mdzub hu )lcags kyu thogs/ /skra grol bas ni rnam par mdzes / /me 'bar 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /ha har rgod 8cing mig yon ma/ /sa la khrag gis byugs nas su/ /gnas der bris tu)sku dgram par bya/ /me tog dmar po la shu )sogs dang / /dri dang bdug pa'i khyad par gyis/ /nye bar mchod pa'i gtor ma dgodapu she/ /sha dang nya dang btsong dul sogs/ /bdud rtsi 78—127

lnga yis dgang bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma ni 7sgom ②zhing zlos/ /'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas su/ /khar bcug nas ni bgad /kyepar bya/ /oṃ ḍā ki nī ④rgyu phuḥphuḥ(5)/ bsgrub ⑥pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dang po sa ni g.yo 'gyur te⑦/ /gnyis pa la ni mdun du dgod/ /gsum pa mdun du snang 'gyur te/ /bzhi pa la ni bka' nod do/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi khyad par gyi(8)/ /dam tshig 'bad de byin nas ni/ /g.yog mo ru ni bsgrubs pa yis/ /ci 'dod bka' ni bsgo bar 49)bya/ /dgra rnams bsad ⑩ cing smad 37pa dang / /yan lag gzir rtsonyab gang 'dod pa'i/ /las la sogs pa ljortethams cad ni/ /g.yog mo'i las kyis bsgrub bipar 'gyura'i/ /gal te 'bum gyis gdon za na/ /rdo rje ma yi sa bon gyis/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /mkhas pas gzir tsobar byas te bzla/ /ra hu dag gi ni pags zhu pa la 'bad de thang ka brkyang bar bya/ /'jib byed ma ni 'dri ()ru gzhugazhu bye /kha dog dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /lus la rgyan ⑥gyis brgyan pa dang / /mdzes pa'i gos ni gyon par bri/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub duzhags pa dang / /g.yas su dgra sta dgod par bya/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo yid 'ong bar/ /mkhas pa yis ḍo — ni bsgrub bya ste/ /lci ba yis ni byugs byas 'istel/ /me tog sna tshogs dgram par bya/ /me tog bdug pa mar me sogs/ /'byung po kun gyi gtor ma sbyin/ /khrag dang nya dang sha dang btsong 3/ /bza' dunyab dag ni sna tshogs dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis bkang la sbyin/ /'bad rdo — 〉de bsam gtan gnas pas bzla(nya/ /oṃ 0ā zhu kur+sha (1 ya phuḥsaphaṭa/ lag gnyis mnyam par byas nas su/ /zhags pa'i tshul gyis gar bskyod bya/ /snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 78—128

'bum bzlas pas/ /'jib byed ma ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /dang po khyi ni ngu ba'i sgra / /gnyis pa la ni gsal bar dgod0)/ /gsum pa la ni mtshon thogs nas/ /bsdigs ②pa'i phyir ni 'ong bar byed/ /bzhi ①par mdun du gnas nas ni/ /bdag gis ci bgyi bka' stsol za④/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi khyad par gyirgya/ /dam tshig dag ni byin nas su/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /dbul po bdag yigis khyod bsgrubs so/ /de nas nyi ma re re zhing / /gser srang phyed phyed ster bar 'gyur/ /gal te 'bum gyis ma grub na/ /ro langs snying pos gzir ⑦te bzla / /sa bon 'di yis gzir ⑤tsam gyis/ /'jib byed ma yi ⑨mgo 'gems sol/ /chu 'gram gyi ni sa phyogs su/ /kum po dzi ni bsgrub par bya/ /ba glang tsol sogs ko ba ni/ / brgyang ste hunye'aphrog byed ma 'drir hurtegazhug /lus ni sbrul gyis brgyan pa ste/ /kha dog sngon po 'bar ba'i 'od/ /skra grol bas ni rnam par brgyan / /gos dmar bgos shing phyag gnyis mdzes/ /ral gri dang ni zhags pa thogs / /ha har dgod 0cing rnam par gtsigs/ /khrag gis maṇ+ḍal tsobyugs nas ni/ /dri dang me tog bdug pas bdug /sha dang nya dang btsong tsol sogs / /nye bar mchod pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /sngon bzhin lha yi gtor ma sbyin/ /rnal 'byor pa ni sgom zhing zlos0/ /'bum gcig gis ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /dang po chu ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa la ni char chen 'bebarko/nye/ /gsum par thog ni 'bab 'gyur te/ /bzhi pa la ni mdun yidu gnas/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi khyad par gyis/ /dam tshig de nas 'bad de sbyin/ /oṃ kri du ) rku sum̐ (nya phuḥphaṭa 3/ lag gnyis khu tshur bcings nas su/ /de yi sngags ni brjod par bya/ /snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /mdun na 78—129

thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /ci zhig bgyi zhes brjod par 'gyur/ /ti se'i gangs kyi rtse ru ni/ /brtse phyir khyod kyis nga khrid la/ /slar yang 'dir ni 'ong ba dang / /rgyal po'i ①bu mo'am gzhan yang rung / /nga 'dod pa ni khrid de shog /gser dang dngul dang zangs la sogs/ /bza' dang bgo dang btung ba dang / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin khyer te 'ong (mi/ / lha yi ①bu mo'am mi mo'ang ⑤rung / /ti se'i gangs kyi rtse ru ni/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin khrid par byed/ /bstan pa'i las kyis ma grub na/ /las gzhan gyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ru/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgoms nas su/ /de ni rkang pa g.yon pa yis(snyem/ /mnan te lnga brgyar bzlas na ni/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur / /gal te des kyang ma grub na/ /dpa' bo'i dbus su bkug nas ni/ /dum bu dum bur gtub par bya/ /kṛ ⑥zhes bya dang gsod pa dang / /hūm̐ gi 9)sa bon bsgoms pa yis/ /thams cad du ni bza' bar bsam/ /des (8)ni bsgrub bya'i rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad kyi ni dbang phyug ma'ang / /gal te ma grub 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bstan pa'i las kyis ma grub na/ /ba la ta ka nag po'i shing ske/ /me sbar ba yi dbus su ni/ /khrag dang bcas pa'i yungs kur ni/ /nyi ma phyed na hūm̐ zhes pa/ /brjod cing sbyin sreg ⑨byas nas ⑩ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams tha'achi 'gyur bas/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas shang kur sgrub snyi/pa'i thabs/ /nyon cig lha mo skal chen ma/ /dur khrod dang ni shing gcig dang / /chu 'gram lam gyi bzhi mdor bsgrub(3/ /dam tshig can gyi 'dri 8mkhan gyis/ /tshon gyi 8dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /sor ni bcu bzhi'i tshad dag tu / /dpa' bo yi ni ras la bri/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor dge ba ste/ /dkyil 78—130

'khor zlum po'i tshul du bya①/ /sku mdog sngon po glang la zhon/ /lus la thal ba'i rdul gyis byugs/ /pho mtshan gyen 'greng zhi ba'i gzugs/ /ral pa'i cod (gyepan mdung dang ldan/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par bklubs(gyi/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa nyid/ /de bzhin gzhan na ④gshor dang ldan / / bshang gcir ②ldan pas mchod bya ste/ /'byung po kun gyi gtor ma sbyin / /sngags 'di yis ni bkug nas su/ /'bum du bzlas pas yibasgrub par bya / /oṃ ka pā la mā la a lo kṛ ta shir se rtso)rgyu rtsu/ ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya ru drwa ya duswā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥru dra (pe r+ghaṃ swā hā/ 'bum du bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gal te grub par ma gyur na/ /de nas de ni bsreg par bya/ /grub nas bya ba thams cad ni/ /byed par 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /nor lha yi ni sgrub ⑩pa'i thabs ri bo yidang ni rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /'bab chu 'dus pa'i mdo dag tu/ /sngar bstan pa yi cho ga yis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /sor ni bcu gnyis tshad dag tu/ /khyad par du ni bsgrub par bya/ /kha dog nag po shin tu mdzes/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /'khor lo dang ni dbyig pa bsnams/ /thod pa pad+ma de bzhin no/ /rin chen gyi ni cod pan dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubasa'orte/ /bshang gci dang ni khu ba khrag /mchod pa nyid du sbyin bya zhing ske/ /mi yi sha yis bdug nyunyebyas na/ /dngos grub nye bar byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra nā rā ya ṇa ④rgyu rtsu āḥ8swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma ma tsakra sā dha ya sabra ⑩a su ra da ma na hūm̐ r+ghaṃ yinaswā hā/ stong phrag brgyar (snyeni bzlas pa yis / /lha ma yin ni kun gyi sgorahunye/ /'jug pa'i nus dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /78—131

sgyu ma thams cad ston byed de①/ /dgra rnams thams cad 'dul nus shing / /rgyal srid dag kyang thob par 'gyur/ /cho ga'i rim pa 'di nyid kyis/ /de nas tshangs pa'ang bsgrub bya ste/ / chu yi ②'gram ni dben pa dang / /khyad par pad mo'i tshal ②du bsgrubadu/ /kha dog ser po phyag bzhi pa/ /gdong bzhi yis ni mdzes par byasabu/ /zhi ba ral pa'i cod pan 'chang / /mchod phyir thogs kyis rnam par brgyan⑥/ /pad+ma dang ni bgrang phreng dang / /dbyug pa dang ni thod pa bsnams / /sgrub pa po yi gtso bo yis/ /bris dusku dag ni dmigs nas su/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs dri zhim ni/ /gur kum ⑤tsan+dan la 0sogs pa/ /dri chus yang 0yang bsgo bya zhing / /rtag tu sgom yidang ldan pa yis/ /mchod pa'i cho ga'i 8rim de dag /bha ga'i dbus su sbyin par bya/ /oṃ bra d+ma ā 0gats+tsha rtsu āḥ8swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ bhu bsta twa bi duji re ṇa/ bhargo de ba sa adhi ma hi/ dhi yo yo na pra tso da ya tatso/ 'bum du bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur te / /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /dgug dang dbang du bya ba dang / /nor skyed ⑩pa dang mngon spyod sogs/ /las rnams thams cad nus 'gyur te/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg (3kun gyis 'grub/ /khyod la yang dag bshad pa yin/ /nyon cig lha mo skal chen mo/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po sgrub ⑩pa'i thabs ma mo'i khyim ni nyams dga' bar/ /sgom pa dge ba byas nas ni/ /blo ldan mchod pa sngon dz+nya )'gro bas/ /'bad 0de bris sku dmigs par bya/ /kha dog dmar po cher 'bar ba/ / skyil krung phyed pa'i 0gar gyis bzhugs/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs dag dang ldan/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar zhing 'khrug /mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs par bri/ /dgra sta dang ni gtun shing 78—132

dang ske/ /mda' dang gzhu ni de bzhin te/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang lcags kyu dang / /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /de bzhin rdo rje ral gri ste/ /gzhan yang sha chen thod pa bsnamasal/ /mu sun di dang ba dan gsum/ /shalti ②dang ni bcu gnyis so/ /oṃ a mo gha sid+dha sarba ar+sha me pra sā dha ya rtsu hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥdus hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥg ④rgyu swā hā/ bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /stong phrag brgyas ni 'grub 'gyur ⑤te/ /de nas las ni brtsam par bya/ /lan cig ⑥bzlas nas thig le dag /sngags /sa byas na skal bzang 'gyur/ /rgyal po sgor yang mchod 'thob ④ste/ /dgra rnams thams cad zad byed 'gyur/ /bgegs rnams ma lus bskrad pa dang / /'dod pa kun gyi (8)'bras ster bar/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom ⑨med/ /cho ⑩ga'i sbyor ba 7de nyid kyis/ /ma mo rnams kyi sgrub 8thabs mchog /sbyor ba'i rim pa de nyid kyis/ /gza' rnams kyang ni bsgrub par 8'dod/ /oṃ sabra ti thi nāk+ṣa 8tra gra ha maṅga le bh+yaḥ8snga hā/ gza' thams cad kyi sngags so/ /oṃ zhes bya ba dang po ste/ /swā hā'i mtha' can byin brlab ⑩ces/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'byung po dang gdon thams cad kyi sgrub 0thabs 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba ste bcu dgu pa'o // //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha hunyemo rnams kyis mchod cing phyag byas te/'di skad ces gsol toyi/ /ye shes de nyid khyad par dang / /lus kyi mtshan ma 78—133

ji ltar lags/ /rtsa rnams gang la brten ①gyur dang / /de rnams dbye ba mi 'tshal te/ /bcom ldan 'das la nyan par 'tshal/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che/ /sgyu ma kun tu rnam 'phrul ba/ /rtsa chen po ni sum cu gnyis/ /de dag gzhan las shin tu gtso/ /bcu dang gnyis ni de bzhin du/ /dbyangs rnams 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /yar ngo mar ngo'i bye brag gis/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir brjod pa yin/ /dus ni myur dang ②ring ba dag /yan lag mtshan ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab pas gnas/ /dbugs ni rnam par rgod ③gyur na/ /lus can drug dang gnyis kyis ri4)'chi/ /snga dro ro hi ta'i dus su/ /de yi mtshan ma mtshon par bya/ /sna dang mig gi gnas dang ni/ /'gram pa dang ni rna ba'i rtsal lce dang so yi mtshams dang ni/ /de bzhin mgrin pa'i phyi rol dang / /snying ga'i rjodra ba lte ba dang / /brla dang byin pa de bzhin gzhan/ /chu so dang ni mtshan dag dang / /mgo dang spyi gtsug gi ni phyogs/ /dbugs ni chad gcing chad gyur pa'i/ /lus kyi mtshan ma myur ba ru/ /'chi ba'i dus ni ston par byed/ /nyi ma'i grangs kyi tshad kyis ni/ /'khor los dus kyi bdag nyid brtsi/ /sgo gcig nas ni nyin drug tu/ /gang tshe ⑧dbugs ni rgyu gyur pa/ /yon tan gsum gyi lo dag ni/ /zhag ni sum brgya po)drug cu ru/ /bgos pa yi ni tshad dag tsheni / /mdor bsdus nas ni bstan par bya/ /lo gnyis dang ni zla ba dag /dus kyi grangs su bstan pa dang / /nyin zhag dag ni bcwa 3stobargyad du/ /de yi tshad ni yang dag brjod/ /nyi ma dag ni bdun dang mtha'/ /gal te rlung ni rgyu hu3gyur na/ /lo gnyis dang ni de bzhin du/ /zla ba drug tu 'tsho 'gyur zhing / /78—134

nyi ma brgyad du rlung rgyu na/ /①de bzhin lo gnyis zla ba ni/ /rig byed kyi ni grangs dang ni/ /nyi ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ru/ /'tsho 'gyur dus kyi grangs yin no/ /gal te nyin dgu ②rgyu gyur na/ /lo gnyis zla ba bzhi dang ni/ /nyin zhag nyi ma'i grangs su ni/ /lus can rnams kyi sbyor ba yin/ /gal te nyin bcur rgyu gyur na / /lo gnyis las ni mi 'cho'i(/ /gal te nyin zhag bcu gcig tu/ /sgo gcig nas ni rgyu ba dag /lo gcig zla ba dgu dang ni/ /nyin zhag bcwa ②brgyad dag las ni/ /mi 'tsho mdzes ma khyod la bshad/ /nyin zhag bcu gnyis rgyu na ni/ /lo gcig dang ni zla ba ni/ /dbyangs kyi grangs dang nyin zhag ni/ /dus kyi grangs las mi 'tsho'o/ /gal te nyi stim bcu gsum du/ /g.yas kyi lam nas rgyu ba ni/ /lo gcig dang ni zla ba dag /rig byed kyi ni grangs dang ni/ /nyi ma dgu las mi 'tsho zhes/ /mdzes ma'i gdong can khyod la bshad/ /gal te bdun phrag gnyis su ni/ /g.yas kyi lam nas rlung rgyu de/ /lo gcig zla ba gnyis dang ni/ /nyi ma bcu yi phyed dag las/ /'tsho bar mi 'gyur de yi (geni/ /tshe tshad nges ⑥par bstan tso)pa yin/ /gang zhig nyi ma lnga gsum du/ /g.yas kyi sgo nas rlung rgyu na0/ /lo gcig na ni gdon mi za/ /gang zhig brgya ⑨zag gnyis su ni/ /g.yas nas rlung ni rgyu ba dang tshe/ /de yi tshe tshad nges pa dag /zla ba bcu dang nyi ma ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi dag las ni/ /mi 'tsho bar ni ngas bshad do/ /gal te nyin zhag bcu bdun du/ /g.yas kyi lam nas rlung rgyu na/ /de nas de yi tshe tshad ni/ /zla ba dgu dang nyin zhag ni/ /bcwa skobargyad dag las mi 'tsho bar/ /gdon mi za bar bshad pa yin/ /nyin zhag bcwa rtsonyebargyad rgyu na ni / /zla ba dag zhu ni brgyad dang ni/ /nyin zhag nyi ma'i grangs su ni/ /de yi 78—135

dus 0)ni bshad pa yin/ /gal te nyin zhag bcu dgu ru/ /dri yi bzhon ②pa rgyu ba dag /ji srid 'tsho ba ①bshad par bya/ /zla ba dag ni bdun dang ni/ /nyin zhag dus kyi grangs las ni/ /'tsho bar mi 'gyur gdon mi za/ /gal te nyin zhag nyi shur ni/ /rgyu ba zla ba drug na ni/ /de yi srog ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gal te nyin zhag nyi shu gcig /nyi ma'i lam nas rlung rgyu ba/ /zla ba lnga dang nyi ma ni/ /nyi ma'i grangs las mi 'tsho'o/ /nyin zhag nyi shu gnyis rgyu na/ /zla ba rig byed grangs dang ni/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ /mi 'tsho bar ni yang dag brjod/ /gal te nyin zhag nyi shu gsum/ /sgo gcig nas ni rlung rgyu na/ /zla ba bzhi dang nyi ma ni/ /dus kyi grangs las mi 'tsho ④brjod/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir rgyu ba dang / /zla ba gsum dang nyi ma ni/ /bcu gcig dag las mi 'tsho'oX/ /nyin zhag nyi shu lnga rgyu na/ /zla ba gsum las mi 'tsho'oyi/ /de las gong ma sngar bstan pa'i/ /grangs las mdor bsdus shes par bya/ /bcu dang gnyis kyi rtsis las ni/ /bar bar gyi ni bstan pa yin/ /cha dang cha yis rim bzhin du/ /bar bar nyi ma gsal bar byasasti/ /blo dman rnams kyis rtogs bya'i phyir/ /dus de dag ni bshad pa yin/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams la ni dus/ /shin tu phra ba ngas bshad pa/ /khams rnams snyoms pa'i lus las nini/ /de dag blta zhing yid ches bya/ /sgo ni steng du ltas 'bab pa/ / sna yi stibar sha chad gyur na/ /nyin zhag bdun gyis the tshom 7med/ /cha shas dgu ni yang dag gnas/ /de bzhin sgo ni steng bltas 37las/ /mig gi chu ni chad gyur na/ /nyi ma lnga na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /cha shas bcu ni shes bya ba/ /steng du ltas 8te 'gro ba las/ /rna ba g.yon dang 'gram pa yi/ /ngos kyi mtshan ma dag las ni/ /nyin zhag gcig 78—136

las mi 'tsho'o/ /cha shas bcu gcig gnas pa yi/ /gsal bar steng ①du 'gro ba las/ /rna ba g.yas par brten (kyepa yis/ /nyin zhag bcwa ②brgyad dag na 'chad/ /cha shas bcu gnyis de bzhin gnas/ / lce yi ④skud pa nag mthong na//lus can dus kyi nyin zhag 'chi/ /cha shas bcu gsum brten ⑤pa yi/ /de bzhin steng du 'bar ba yi/ /steng 'og so ni 'thams gyur na/ /'byung ba dag ni ma lus 'dren6)/ /srog ni dus grangs nyi mas 'gro/ /dbyangs yig bcu bzhi brten ⑦pa ni/ /mgrin pa'i blo dun ciganas pa'i rtsa/ /steng du bltas pa zhes grags kyisayonye/ /nyin zhag lnga las mi 'tsho'o/ /cha shas bco 7lnga gnas pa yi/ /steng du bltas pa'i mchog de la/ /brang gi dra ba zhom gyur na/ /zla phyed na ni gdon mi za/ /cha shas bcu drug rdzogs pa'i bdag /lte ba'i dbus gyur steng bltas pa/ /sen mo'i khrag ni med gyur na/ /nyin zhag bcu na yang dag nyal/ /slar yang cha shas bcu bdun ni/ /gnas pa'i brla yi mtshan ma las/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bzhi na/ /'chi 'gyur 'dir ni gdon mi za/ /cha shas bcwa hunyebargyad gnas pa yi(nya/ /byin pa la ni gnas pa'i rtsa/ /de bzhin steng du bltas pa yis/ /nyin zhag nyi ma'i grangs kyis 'chi/snye/ /bcu dgu yi ni cha shas gnas//chu so de bzhin steng bltas pas/ /de dang mnyam pa'i nyin zhag gis/ /'chi 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom 8med/ /cha shas nyi shu gnas pa yi/ /pho mtshan la ni gnas pa'i rtsa/ /steng du bltas pa'i amachog dbang phyug /mtshan mas nyin zhag dus kyi ni/ /grangs kyis 'chi 'gyur the tshom 7med/ /re'u mig bcu gnyis rtsis ⑩pa la/ /bar bar nyi ma bstan pa dag / lo yi phonyerim gyis de sbyangs te/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis rim pa dang / /sum cu rtsa drug bcwa 7brgyad kyis/ /zla ba la 78—137

sogs go rims 0)bzhin/ / rim gyis ②rim gyis dbri bar bya/ /lhag mar ②gang zhig gyur pa ni/ /bsdus te 'tsho ba'i dus su ni/ /lha mo chen mo shes bya zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun ④dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po (5)dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las rtsa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dbugs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu pa'o// //sgo dgu po yi sbyo6༄mtshan nyid dang / /rtsa ni gang bar gnas pa yi/ /yon tan skyon sogs ji ltar blta/ /de rnams ⑦bye brag mi 'tshal te/ /ye shes dbang la nyan par 'tshal/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /gong du 'pho ba'i sbyor mtshan nyid/ /bshad kyis (nyelha mo mnyan par gyis/ /sngon du bdag nyid sbyang 794byas la/ /phyi nas las ni brtsam par bya/ /gzugs med gnas pa mdog sngo ba'i/ /pad nya )chen zla ba lta bu 'dzag /slar yang gzugs su gnas pa ste / /rnam pa kun gyis brgyan pa'o/ /cha shas bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /kha ni thur du bltas te 'phyang / /go 'phang gnas pa'i gnas nas ni/ /kun da zla 'dra rtag tu dag /rnam shes ye shes bdud rtsi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'bab pa'i mchog /rten du gyur pa'i pad+ma gang / /zla ba'i 'od kyis rnam par brgyan/ /de ni cha dang cha yi 31)gzugs/ /gong bu rdzogeganas pa zhes byar brjod/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gnas kyi mtha' ni dag par bya/ /dag nas srid pa 'pho bya yi(snye/ /gzhan du na ni don med 'gyur/ /dgang yib yis ni lus bkang na / /dug dang rims kyi 'itsha ba 'phrog /bum pa can gyis sgo bcings na/ /78—138

sgo yi ①ji ②gu dag par 'gyur/ /'thor bas sna tshogs rdul du bya/ /rab tu zhi bas zhi bar 'gyur/ /rnam shes dbrog ①pa'i cho ga dang / /gzhan du 'gro ba'ang bshad par bya/ /de nas phyi rol sbyor ba ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni sbyang bar bya / /gnas gnyis dag ni bsams nas su/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya / /rlung gi dbus su me yis ni/ /yang dang yang du dbye bar bya/ /ā byali kā lir ldan pa yi/ /sa bon der ni sbyar bar bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis khyad par dul/ /'byung dang 'jug pas bzlas ⑤par bya/ /'byung ba ye shes sa bon gyis/ /bsnun dang ldan par bsam par bya/ /'jug pa snying gi rnam shes la/ /me tog lta bur bsnun ⑥par bya/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'byung bzlas te⑦/ /bdag nyid las ni phyi rol bya/ /'jug pa (kye'abyung bar mtshon ⑨bya ste/ /de kho na nyid mnyam par bsgomam/ /mnyam bzhag yidangos po bsgoms nyusnyen ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom 0med/ /de nas phyi rol lus la ni/ /sgrub 8pa po yis rnam par sprul/ /nyi ma'i lam nas ngang 8phyung ste/ /lha mo cha shas ldan par bya/ /bsgrub bya'i snying gar tsozhugs nas ni/ /rlung dang me yis 'bar ba dgatunye /de yi rnam shes bzung nas ni/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug(3 /bsgrub bya'i rnam shes bsdus nas su/ /'og gi tu)'khor lo so )sbyar bar bya/ /ji srid zad par byas bar du/ /de srid lkugs te gnas par 'gyur/ /'chi ba'i dus dul bab gyur na/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma ston pa dang / /rims 4)la sogs pas ma phog par / /gong du 'pho ba mchog yin no nya/ /de nas gzhan lus la 'jug pa/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /seng ge rnam rol phyag rgya yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bcings nas su/ /rtag tu srog dang rtsol ba ( zebya/ /khyod kyi tso78—139

gnas su sbyar nas ni/ /rang gi lus ni yongs btang ste/ /rim gyis nyusbyor bas phye nas su/ /cho ga 'di ltar byas pa yis/ /sngags pa gzhan gyi lus la 'jug /sbyor ba'i rim pa de nyid kyis/ /rang gi lus la sbyar bar 'dod/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i bye brag gis/ /mnyam par bzhag ②ste gang byed pa/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug thams cad dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang sbyor bas mchod/ /gang gi ring dhi nas thos gyur pa/ /de ni yang dag bshad kyis ④nyon/ /de bzhin mkhas pas gzhan sems kyi/ /bsam pa rjes su shes par bya/ /sgom ⑤dang bzlas pa'i khyad par gyiyi/ /sbyor ba'i dam pa skye bar 'gyur/ /gang gi ⑦lam nas bsams na ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom dumed/ /'khor lo gang zhig sngar bstan par/ /zhugs te nyan pa gnyis su ni/ /'jig rten gsum dang 'dres (9)nas ni/ /me stag bzhin du rnam par 'khor/ /rlung gis bskyod ⑩pa'i me yis ni/ /shes rab ldan pas zhugs bsams na/ /zla drug tsam gyis nges par ni/ /ring na gnas pa thos par 'gyur/ /bsgom ⑩pa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /ye shes mig gis mthong 'gyur ba'o)/ /shin tu ring na gnas pa yang ske/ /sgrub lhonyepos skad cig gsal bar mthong / /bstan dang ma bstan gang ci'ang rung / /de kun nga ④yis yang dag bshad/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che/ /dge ba'i sgo nas 'gro ba dang / /gang gi byalam nas 'gro ba yis/ /thar pa'i dngos grub rab ster ba/ /mchog dang tha ma'i bye brag rnams/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /lte ba las ni 'dod khams lha/ /thig le ⑩gzugs can mtho ris te/ /steng nas 'gro bar na)steng gi ni/ /myur du 'gro bar (nyebyed par 'gyur/ /sna nas gnod sbyin gnas su ste/ /rna ba dag ni grub pa'i lha/ /78—140

gal te mig las ye shes 'gro/ /mi rnams kyi ni bdag por 'gyur/ /srid pa'i sgo las yi dgas te/ /de bzhin chu las dud 'gro'o/ /chu min gyis ni dmyal bar ltung / /thar pa'i lam las gzhan du 'gro/ /sngon du bum pa brtsams pa yis / /sgo rnams thams cad bcing bar bya/ /rgyal ba lnga yi mchod rten gyi/ /sgo yi bu gar bsgom par bya/ /de la 'og gi sgo ru ni/ /chu yi sa bon dkar po bsam / /chu dang chu min sgo la ni/ /me yi sa bon 'bar ba ste/ /de la shin tu mnyam gzhag ①pas/ /dbugs ni bum pa can du bsgomadu/ /lus ③ni rlung gi mdog tu ste/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rlung gi mtha' ni rtsa ba can / /rlung gi sa bon rtsa bar te④/ /thig le sgra dang ldan pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i sa bon drang bar bya/ /'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /sgra dang sgra yis 'phul bar byed/ /dus la bab na 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur / /lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni/ /dmyal bar nges par sreg ⑤par 'gyur / /de bas 'chi ba'i stimatshan ma ni/ /mkhas pas 'bad de shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sngar bstan ⑦pa'i/ /sngo 2chen bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /sgrub 0po rnams kyis smin pa la/ /steng gi rtsa ba bza' bar bya/ /chu dang skya rengs 0ldan pa dag /g.yon pa'i bdud rtsir sbyar byas la/ /zos na zhi dang rgyas pa ste/ /dug dang rims kyi 0tsha ba 'phrog /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rnyings tsodang smin pa hunye'ajoms par byed/ /lha mo slar yang bzlog ④pa yis/ /nam mkhar 7'gro ba brjod par bya/ /rlung dang me yi 2bye brag gis/ /rkang pa'i 'khor lo 0sbyar byas te/ /yid kyis rab tu zhir sbyar nas/ /nam mkha' la ni 'gro 'gyur zhing / /mkha' 'gro kun gyis bskor nas su/ / lha yi 8lus 78—141

kyis ①kun tu rtsel/ /ji srid zla nyi g.yod kyi bar/ /de srid nam mkhar ④gnas par 'gyur/ /slar yang lugs las zlog ⑤pa yisayi/ /kha dog dkar po'i pad+ma bsam / /bsgrub bya'i dbus su sbyar ba ⑦ni/ /rtag tu ngag gi dngos grub byed/ /rang gi lus dbus bsgom bya ba/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'khrug pa ltar/ /rang gi kha nas byung nas su/ /bsgrub bya'i kha ru thim par bya/ /nyi ma bdun gyis dngos grub tu/ /'gyur te gzhan du yang nim yin/ /rlung gi lam nas bsgrub bya yi/ /lus la thim par gyur pa dang / / de yi ⑨sems ni bzung nas su/ /bdag la gzhug ste me la ni/ /bsams te rlung dang me spar 0bas/ / de yi ⑩lus ni 'khrug par 'gyur/ /tshigs dgu las ni steng gzhan gyis/ /mod tshul 'pho bar shes bya ste/ /nyin re bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /rku 'phrog 'dod la spyod pa yang / /lam 'di yis ni dag 'gyur te/ /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur zhing / /srid pa'i skyon las ring du 'grol/ /ji ltar 'dam las skyes pa yi0/ /pad+ma dri med yid 'ong ba/ /de bzhin lus kyi 'dam las ni/ /ye shes sku ni 'dod bzhin 'gro/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gong du 'pho ba'i bsam gtan dang /seng ge rnam par rol pa'i phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'byung 8ba'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa tshigacig pa'o// //ngag gi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ni/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /78—142

g.yas kyi cha ru rnal 'byor pa/ /g.yon du rnal 'byor ma nyid de/ /sor mo khar ni 'jug byed pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi ①mtshan ma'o/ /sto ku/ thal mo spyi bor 'jog byed pa/ /'bar byed ma yi ②mtshan ma'o/ /gu ku/ mthe bo ③'tshir bar byed pa ni/ /'jib ⑤byed ma yi ⑤mtshan ma'o/ /mu ghu/ lag pa rna bar rdebs ⑥pa ni/ /blo ldan 'phrog byed rtags yin no/ /lu snadu/ sna rtser skyor mo debs ⑧pa ni/ /thugs bde mi bde 'dri ba yin/ doḥkhya/ sha ba'i mgo ltar ston byed pa/ /rnal 'byor 0byed pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /gan dho ⑩de/ gang zhig smin ma'i dbus reg pa/ / nga yi 8snying sdug grogs po'o/ /a li ni da ha/ so yis lce ni 'tshir 7byed pa/ /'dus nang gtor ma bza' zhes pa'o8/ /bhar+sha ⑫yol/ lag pa rtsa la 'ju byed pa/ /khyod kyi khyim du ngas phyin pa'o/ / di ra ⑩ti/lag pa snying gar nyed 0byed na/ /da 8ni nga'i yiyid 'ong ba'o/ /ru tsa pa ta ba ta / sna rtser hu )khu tshur 'chang ba ni/ /med do zhes ni 0ston pa'o/ / shu n+ya tācha/lag pa brkyang ste stor rdebs yin/ /phun sum ldan par yod zhes pa'o/ /kri ④ka sa ha/ lte ba ru ni nyed ( nyebyed na/ /kha zas za bar 'dod pa'o/ /tsan+d+ra ⑩li ka /mdzub ⑦mo mdun du ston byed na/ /zhe gnag ( nyegatum la drag pa'o/ /nī tshul dan ta ba ta/ smin ma la ni reg byed na/ /'dir 'dod pa ni da lta ston/ /a rna ga u du )ta/ lce ni 'dril bar byed pa dag /da lta 0'chi zhes bya ba'o/ /dur ga ti/ kun tu lta bar byed pa ni/ /tshes grangs shes par 'dod pa'o/ /ta ra ga na/ tshes gcig nas ni brtsams nas su/ /mthe bos ri mo bri bar bya/ /nyi tshod yi ge la sogs pa/ /sngar bstan chabazhin du mdun du reg /gi ri/ steng du lta bar byed pa ni/ / nyin phyed du dga' bas rol pa'o/ /sa ma tsha ya/ 'dzum 78—143

dang bcas par lta byed cing / /lag pas lag pa bzung ①nas su/ /rgya mtsho lta bur ston byed pa/ /nor zas byin zhes bya ba'o/ /dzir na pa ta/ lag gnyis khu tshur 'chang byed na/ /da ltar 'grogs ②la 'dong zhes pa'o/ /sa la ba ②ta/mthe bong ④yis ni srin lag la/ /reg pa 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba'o/ /so ma/mthe bong ༅khro bo bza' la sogs/ srurusti/ mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs//bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las rnal 'byor pa dang ⑦rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dag gi phyag rgya'i brda yis 6)rol pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //lha mos slar yang gar mdzad de/ /glu 'di yis ni mnyes par byas/ /e bo si ta a ①ru ni na ⑩bha/ dza ni te ma dha ma ga ma ā tunyeg ma dha ma pā si ni sā sā sā/ni ga ma sā sā sā/ ri ga mo bhu pa ti/ sa ri ri sa ri rī sā sā sā/ ma dha ma/a dha ma sā sā sā/ shu ta ni sa sā sā sā/ sa ni sa ri ta gha ma gha ma/ a dha ma dha ma sā sā sā/ ba ba ma ya ba ba dha na (nyemo zhes bya'o/ /shar du me'o/ /gshin rjer ni bre'o/ /nub tu ni mi'o/ /byang du ni ku'o/ /me mtshams su ni dha si'o②ske/ /bden bral du ni ma ku'o/ /rlung mtshams su ni tu ku'o/ /dbang ldan du ni bi mo'o/ /a ni sgur ④po'o/ /i ni zla ba la skyes 8pa'o/ /u ni lha'i bla ma'i'o / /e ⑩ni pa ba sangs kyi'o/ /o ni nyi ma'i bu'i'o/ /i ni gza'i bdag po ri bong 7can no/ /a ni nyi ma'o/ /gza' rnams kyi 0ni cho ga las/ /zla ba nyi ma'i brjod par bya/ /zla ba /rka ṭa tunyel dbang / /nyi ma gdong lnga pa la 78—144

ste / /gza' rnams lhag ma ji snyed pa/ /rā ①yi gnyis gnyis la ni spyod/ /sgang gshong 'khor lo khyod kyis bshad/ /skar ma dus dang nyi ma yi③/ /bye brag dag ni mi 'tshal te/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bka' stsal pa/lug dang ro hi ta sogs ①pa/ /gang gi 'chi ba bshad kyis nyon④/ /mdor rjobasdus nas ni brjod par bya/ /zla ba dang ni tshes grangs dang / /skar ma yi ni dus dang ldan0/ /gdon dang nad ni de bzhin te/ /sgang gshong rā ④si tshad ma ni/ /gang zhig las ni skyes pa'i brjod/ / bha dra ⑧yi ni nyi ma la/ /dgun zla ra ba'i zla ba yi/ /gza' ni mig dmar dag dang ni/ /rgyu skar smin drug ldan gyur pa/ /de ni de yi ⑨'chi dus yin/ /sus kyang bskyab par mi nus so/ /khyu mchog gi ni nyi ma la/ /lus kyi mtshan ma la sogs dang / /smyo ⑩zhing 'gul ba'i nad kyis ni/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba ⑩bshad par bya/ /de bzhin dgun zla 'bring po yi/ /gza' lag dang ni snar mar ldan/ /nyi ma bzhi pa de la ni/ / dgongs mo 8'chi 'gyur the tshom 8med/ /dgun zla tha chungs yilha mo 38/ /skar ma mgo dang ldan pa dang / /gza' ni gza' lag bcas pa la/ /'khrig pa'i mi ni gang yin pa/ /nyi ma drug la 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la/ /skar ma mgo dang ldan pa dang / /gza' ni pa ba sangs 'dzom zhing ⑩/ /nyi ma snga dro'i zhu 1dus la ni/ /kun 8ṭa ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i gnyis lnga la/ /skar ma mchu dang ldan pa dang / /gza' ni spen par ldan pa la/ /seng ge'i mi ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dpyid zla tha chungs ⑩bcu gnyis la/ /skar ma nag par ldan pa dang / /gza' ni nyi ma dag la ni/ —/skran dang gzer ba'i nad kyis ni/ /bu mo'i mi ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbyar zla 78—145

ra ba'i bcu bzhi la/ /skar ma lha mtshams ldan pa dang / /gza' ni mig dmar dag la ni/ /srang gi mi ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i bcu gcig la / /nag pa dang ni mig dmar la/ /sdig pa'i mi ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbyar zla tha chungs ①tshes dgu la/ /skar ma gro zhun ②ldan pa dang / / gzhu yi ( gemi ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de dag nges par ldan gyur na/ /'chi ④'gyur bden par nga yis bshad/ /ston zla ra ba'i bdun pa la/ /skar ma rgyal dang ldan pa dang ske/ /gza' ni zla bar bcas pa la/ /chu srin mi ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /ston zla 'bring po'i bcu gsum la/ /skar ma tha skar ldan pa dang / /gza' ni zla bar bcas pa la/ /bum pa'i mi ni zad par 'gro/ /ston zla tha chungs (lde)sgyu ma che / /nyi ma dag ni brgyad pa la/ /skar ma nam grur ldan pa dang / /gza' ni spen ⑥par bcas pa la/ / nya yi ⑦mi ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sngon du skye (8)dus shes bya ste/ /phyi nas dus ni brtsi (pebar bya/ /gzhan du dus ni smra ba dag /thams cad don med nyid du 'gyur/ /skye dus shin tu mnyam bzhag tsho ste/ /zhi dang drag po dpyad par bya/ /tshe dang 'chi dus la sogs pa/ /de nas de ltar lung bstan zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gza' dang nyi ma'i nges par 'chi ba tshar gcad ⑩pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //ltas kyi mtshan nyid dge ba ni/ /rab tu bshad kyis 8lha mo nyon/ /ā li kā rtso 78—146

li mnyam byas la①/ /sde tshan du ni bsdeb par bya/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed dang po sogs/ /bltas te ming ni gzung ②bar bya/ /cha shas ldan la snying stobs can/ /de yi rigs ni shes par bya/ /mtha' yas la sogs klu rnams dang ske/ /nyi ma la sogs de bzhin gza'/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs ma mo rnams/ /de yi rigs su rab tu grags/ /lha rnams thams cad nyid dang ni/ /sngags rnams thams cad de las skyes/ /skye bo thams cad skyed byed ma/ /des na ma zhes bya bar brjod/ /a yig dang ni de bzhin ā(0/ /ka tsa ṭa dang ④yang dag ldan/ /ta pa dang ni ya sha ste/ /sde dgu yi ni yi ge'o/ /i (5)dang slar yang lha mo khri/ /de bzhin gzhan yang kha tsha ṭha/ /tha pha dang ni ra ṣa yinyid/ /sde tshan gnyis pa ⑦yin par brjod/ /u dang lha mo de bzhin u(kye/ /ga dza ḍa dang yang dag ldan/ /da ba dang ni la sa ste(9nye/ /de dag sde tshan gsum pa yin/ /yi ge e dang de bzhin e/ /de bzhin slar yang gha dzha nye/ /dha bha wa ha slar de bzhin//'di dag sde tshan bzhi pa yin/ /o yig dang ni au yig dang / /e zhes bya dang tsheg drag bcasam/ /slar yang nga nya ṇa na ma/ /'di dgu sde tshan lnga pa yin/ /kun tu bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi dang / /lhag ma yolhalnga dang bcas par bya/ /de dag skye bo thams cad kyi/ /skye dang 'jig par yang dag gnas/ /yi ge bcu gnyis sgyu 'phrul che'i/ /'tsho dang dus kyi rang bzhin brjod/ /de dag rā tunyesi zhes bya ba/ /skar ma kun dang yang dag ldan/ /zla ba nyi ma'i bye brag gis/ /de bzhin 'og dang steng du ltas/ /brtan pa nyid dang g.yo ba nyid/ /gnyis po gnyis su brjod pa yin/ /rkyang pa dang ni sbyar ba ste/ /ring dang thung dang pham dang rgyal / /de las steng gi rgyal ba ste/ /'og ni 'chi bar shes par bya/ /nyi ma'i 78—147

rgyu bar 'gro ba yi/ /gza' ①dang rā si ②skar ma rnams/ /nyi ma la ni gnas de ①'char / /rā ④si gza' dang gsum par 'dod/ /dbugs rgyu ba dang yang dag ldan / /thams cad rā ⑤sir shes par bya/ /kun ṭa dudang glang po'i dgrame/ /de bzhin gzhon nu ma dang srang ni/ /cha shas drug dang yang dag ldan/ /gza' yis bskul nas 'char bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa dang ni chu skyes dang / /khyu mchog dang ni bum par bcas/ /cha shas lnga yi tshad dang ldan/ /gza' yis bskul nas 'char bar 'gyur/ /nya dang lug dang de bzhin du/ /gzhu dang zung du sprod pa dag /cha shas bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /snga ma bzhin du 'char bar 'gyur / /slar yang ltas dang bcas pa yi0/ /gza' rnams 'char bar ⑩bshad par bya/ /'bras bu'i ming ⑩dang ldan par bya/ /ltas 8chen 'byung ba mnyan ⑫par gyis/ /nag mo dang / gtsigs ma dang / 'jigs su rung ma dang / rga las 'das ma dang / log 'dren ma dang / gtum mo dang / drag mo'i gzugs can ma dang / dka' zlog lha mo dang / rgyal ma dang / rnam par rgyal ma dang / mi thub ma dang / gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang / nag mo bzang mo dang / nag mo chen mo dang / nag mo sbom mo dang / dbang mo dang / zla ba mo dang / drag mo dang / snang ma dang / 'phyang ba tsom dang / sum cu'i dbang mo dang / 'phrog byed ma dang / 'bar ma dang / 'jib byed ma dang /lha mo 'di rnams ming dang ni/ /ltas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /ming ni mtshungs pas 'bras bu ster8/ /nyis 'gyur du ni byas nas su/ /dbang po'i cha dang yang dag ldan/ /ltas ⑩ni lhag ma bzung nas su/ /ltas ni shes pa nyid du bya/ /nag mo dang ni 'jigs rung dang / /drag mo'i gzugs dang dka' zlog nyid/ /78—148

nag sbom ma dang rgyal ma dang / /drag mo sum cu'i dbang mo dang / /'phrog byed ma dang 'jib byed ma/ /bcu po 'di dag rtsub por 0)grags/ /bag ma len ②dang bkra shis dang / /grong dang tshong 'dus zhugazugs pa dang / /lam du dpag rjodang thab dumo dang / /chen po'i sar ni dbyung ba sogs/ /ltas ⑥de las ni 'bras med pas/ /dge ba'i las rnams mi bya ste/ /rigs de rnams la sgyu ma che/ /bzang po'i las ni spang bar bya/ /dge bas kyang ni gsod 'gyur na / /drag po'i tshulas kyis smos ci dgos/ /lus la gnas pa'i dbugs dang ni / /phyi rol gza' dang rā ⑧mi ste/ /phyi dang nang du bcas pa yi/ /rgyu ba shes na 'grub par 'gyur/ /gza' gang yin pa dbyangs zhes bya/ /dbyangs gang yin pa de nyid kyang / /rā 6)si nyid du shes par bya/ /dbyangs dang rā yisi de bzhin du/ /skar ma'ang dbyangs kyi gzugs su blta/ /phan tshun sbyor ba ma gtogs par/ /'bras bu 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /g.yo ba 'char la g.yo ba'i las/ /brtan pa la ni mi g.yor 'gyur⑩/ /'dren ma yis ni 'dren ma ste//phyi dang nang du bcas pas gsal/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gza' ⑩rnams kyi rgyu ba dang sde tshan gyi ltas kyi cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //da ni gza' 8dang skar ma ru/ /bcas pa'i rgyu ba bshad kyis ④nyon/ /nyi ma rgyu ba'i nyin mo ni/ /thun phyed 8lnga dang bdun pa la/ /bya ba ci yang mi 78—149

'grub bo/ /zla ba yi ni bzhi dang drug /mig dmar gyi ni gsum dang lnga/ /gza' lag tsa)gnyis dang bzhi pa la/ /gdon mi za bar 'joms par 'gyur/ /bla mas dang po gsum pa la/ /'chi ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /ngan spong gi ni gnyis pa dang / /bdun pa la ni shes par bya/ /dal ba yi ni dang po dang / /drug pa la ni 'chi bar byed/ /rigs 'char ba ni de dag gi②/ /dus ni yongs su chad par bstan/ /de dag thun mong mtshan nyid de/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ①gzhan bshad nyon(pe/ /lnga nas nyi shu lnga yi (pebar 'di dag (yeni brjod bya ste/ /de las bcu gsum gsum gyi bar du re re spel bar bya/ /dgun zla tha chungs gnyi ma la mtshungs gsum mig zla ba drug /gsum zung zla (8)ste zla lhag tshes phyogs mda' yon tan/ /thig le de dag gi ni 'tsho ba yang dag bshad pa yin/ /lnga las bcu yi bar dang de bzhin bcu nas ni/ /bcwa 6)lnga'i bar te ⑩de nas nyi shu'i bar dang ni/ /de nas nyi shu lnga yi nyustobar du sbyang bar bya/ /de nas sgrub ⑫pos shes bya ba/ /gnas skabs 'gyur ba bshad par bya/ /zla ba gang la gnas pa yi/ /dang po tu skar ma bgrang 8bar bya/ /nyi ma yi ni chu tshod dag /ji snyed 'das pa de snyed ni/ /zla ba'i gnas skabs rgyu ba'i phyir/ /de ni drug cur bsgyur bar bya/ /slar yang nyi tshod zla ba bsnan/ /drug cu ru ni bsgyur byas la/ /mda' dang sreg byed ro yi ni/ /dbang por bcas pas de bzhin bcadam/ /bcu gnyis dag gi nang nas ni/ /lhag ma'i cha shas gzung tshebar bya/ /lhag ma'i cha shas de yis zhu ni/ /skyid sdug gnas skabs 'o myong bar 'gyur/ /nyin dang mtshan gyi sbyor ba yis/ /lhag ma'i chu tshod du ni 37brjod/ /dang po'i zla bar rab 3 staganas pa/ /de yi bya ba nyams par 'gyur/ /gnyis pa bkra shis 78—150

shis pa ste/ /gsum pa 'chi ste gsod par hu)'gyur/ /bzhi pa dgod de zhutshim par 'gyur/ /lnga pa nor te rnyed par 'gyur/ /drug pa rims te lus 'jig 'gyur / /bdun pa la ni dga' ba ste/ /tshim pa nyid ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /brgyad pa 'jig rten brlag par 'gyur/ /zla ba dgu par gnas pa yis/ /lus ni dgra dang bcas par 'gyur/ /bcu pa dga' mgur brtse 'gyur zhing / /sna tshogs pas ni rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bcu gcig sna tshogs 'jigs pas gdung / /bcu gnyis pa ni longs spyod de/ /bde ba chen pos rgyal ④bar 'gyur/ /lug la sogs pa ⑤bstan pa yis/ /zla ba rim pa ⑥bzhin du rgyu/ /mkha' 'gro kun ⑨dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las thams cad rgyu ba'i rim par phye ba ste (2)nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mos nyu)mchod cing phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to7/ /sgang nyanagashong 'khor lo khyod bshad pa/ /de rnams dbye ba ci 'dra dang / /dus kyi grangs ni ji bzhin gsungs/ /rgyu ba yi 8ni khyad par dag /'di la bdag ni the tshom (skye skyes/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /sgyu ma kun gyis rnam skorol pa/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu lim che/ /dus kyi bgrang ba lus med cing / /thams cad du ni thams cad gnas/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa ste / /lus la gnas kyang lus mi skye/ /dus nyid dus ni med pa dang / /'jig rten nyid ni 'jig rten min/ /bden pa dang ni brdzun (7pa min/ /lha khyod 78—151

kyis ni sngar bshad pa'i/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dus mtshan nyid/ /gang zhig ①khyod kyis bshad pa ste0/ /don dam shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /lus las 'das shing dri med pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ji ltar rtogs/ /skye bo kun la sman slad dul/ /dbugs kyi nges pa bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ③bka' stsal pa/ /nad med rlung dang bral ba dang ④/ /khams ni snyoms par gnas pa dang ske/ /ran par za zhing tshul bzhin rgyu/ /de yi mig 'dzums ⑤gzung dubar bya / /mig 'dzums ⑦mig ni btsums 0pa ste/ /mig 'dzums ⑨drug la 0cha shas ni / /gcig ces bya bar brjod pa yin/ /yud tsam drug ni skad cig ste/ /skad cig drug ni thang cig yin/ /thang cig drug ni chung zad 0yin/ /dus kyi go rims 8bya ba 'dis/ /sum cu tham ⑩par bsgyur ba la/ /yi ge rtsi ba'i dus zhes brjod/ /yi ge rtsi ba bcu la ni/ /srog gcig ces bya'i dus su bshad / /de ni bcu gsum bsgyur ④ba las/ /de yang gnyis su bsgyur ba ni/ /sung gcig zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /srang ni drug cu tham pa la/ /chu tshod gcig tu bzhed pa yin/ /de brgyad thun gcig zhes bya'o/ /de bzhi tshul ni nyin gcig go/ /nyin mtshan dus ni mnyam pa la/ /mtshan mo'ang de dang mnyam par bshad/ /chu srin nas ni sbal pa'i bar/ /nyi ma 'phel bar brjod pa ste/ /lha mo srang ni gsum gsum gyis/ /nyin re zhing ⑩ni spel bar bya/ /chu srin las ni 'das nas su/ /mtshan mo srang ni gsum gsum 'bridhi/ /tshad ma de dag bstan pa'i phyir/ /zangs ma srang ni bcu gnyis la/ /snod ni dpangs ⑫su sor brgyad dang / /rgyar ni sor mo bcu gnyis pa/ /legs pa nyid du brdung bar bya/ /gser ni 'ol se sum cu las/ /sor drug pa yi 7tshad tsam du/ /78—152

thur ma legs par brdungs nas ni/ /thur ma de yis bu ga ni/ /zangs ma'i snod la ①mkhas pas dbugame /chu ni rnyog ma med pa las/ /srang ni drug cu'i tshad du bya/ /srang 'dis chu tshod tshad yin te/ /skye bo rnams la phan phyir bshad/ /chu tshod de ni yud tsam steni/ /thun phyed dang ni thun gcig dang / /nyin dang mtshan mo'i tshad kyis ni/ /rim bzhin zla phyed zla bar spel/ /zla ba gnyis ni dus yin te/ /de gsum nyi ma 'gro ldog brjod/ /nyi ma 'gro ldog ④gnyis la ni//lo gcig nyid du brjod pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las dus 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas skar ma'i rigs gang yin/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par ⑤bya/ /tha skar dang ni mgo dang rgyal/ /de bzhin du ni nab ⑥so dang / /me bzhi lha mtshams de bzhin du/ /nam gru sa ri gro zhun bcas/ / lha yi ④tshogs zhes brjod pa yin/ /snar ma gre ⑧dang chu stod dang / /khrums stod dang ni bra nye dang ske/ /lag dang mgo dang chu smad dang / /khrums smad mi yi tshogs yin no/ /smin drug dang ni mchu ⑨dang ni/ /mon gru dang ni mon gre dang / /skag dang nag pa snron dang ni/ /sa ga dang ni snabs (3 rnams ni/ /srin po yi ni rigs yin par / /bzhin mdzes ma ni khyod la bshad/ /smin drug ⑩rgyal ni ra yin te/ /mgo dang snar ma klu yin no/ /lag dang snrubs ⑩ni khyi yin te/ /lha mtshams nab 0so phag gi rigs/ /mchu dang gre ni byi ba'o/ /skag ni byi lar bshad pa 78—153

ste / /nag pa sa ga stag yin no/ /dbo ①dang khrums stod gnyis po ni/ /khyu mchog zhes ni bshad pa ste/ /stobs 'dod pas ni shes par bya/ /me bzhi dang ni sa ri gnyis/ /ma her shes bya stobs kyi mchog /tha skar dang ni khrums smad gnyis/ / rta yi ②rigs zhes bya bar grags/ /chu stod dang ni gro zhun gnyis / /spre'u'i tsho0rigs su brjod pa yin/ /bra nye dang ni nam gru gnyis/ /glang po'i rigs kyis byin brlabs ④pa'o/ /mon gru dang ni mon gre dag /mi yi rigs su yang dag gsungs/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa ru/ /lha mo ngas ni bden par bshad/ /chu smad dang ni byi bzhin dang ⑤/ /ne'u le'i rigs su grags pa yin/ /mang po nyid kyis ci zhig bya/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad kyis nyon/ /rang gi skye ba'i skar ma ni/ /bya ba 6)kun la dpyad mi dgos/ /skar ma mi (7)yi srog yin te/ /gzhan du ngas ni ma bshad do/ /skar ma'i cha ni bzlog pa dag(8) /bzung na (9)nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lug dang srang dang kun ṭa/ /chu srin dag ni g.yo bar brjod/ /sdig pa bum pa seng ge dang / /khyu mchog dag ni brtan pa ste/ /nya dang gnyis 7sbyor gzhu dang ni/ /bu mo rnams ni 'dren ma'o/ /lha yi bla ma nyi ma dang / /mig dmar skyes pa'i gzugs yin te/ /pa ba sangs dang sgra gcan dang / /zla ba mo yi lhoskregazugs yin no/ /gza' lag dang ni spen pa gnyis/ /ma ning nyid du bstan pa ste/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lor gnas pa'i gza'/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las skar ma rnams kyi stobs la dbang ba'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa 78—154

bdun pa'o// //tshes dang skar ma gza' 'char ba/ /rab tu bshad kyis ༅lha mo nyon/ /ro hi ta yi 0tshes ②la ni/ /smin drug dang ni mig dmar la/ /'gron byapo lam du 'jug par bzang / /tshes de rnyed pa 'thob (ge'agyur ba'o/ /ma ka ra yi nyi ma la / /mchu dang mig dmar ldan pa la/ /gzer (6)dang 'joms sogs 'byung bas na/ /tshes de yongs su spang bar bya/ / swasna yi ni gnyi ma la/ /lag dang spen par ldan pa'i tshe/ /nag po nyid du shes bya bas/ /tshes de'ang yongs su spang bar bya/ /ro ②gyi ta yi nyi ma la/ /mchu dang gza' lag ldan pa la/ /bkra shis dang ni bzang por byed/ /raṇ+ḍa nyayi ni nyi ma la/ /lag dang gza' lag bcas pa dag /kun tu 'joms 7par bshad pas na/ /mchog gi sbyor bas de yang spang / /sa yi dbang phyug tshes la ni/ /bra nye dang ni gza' lag ldan/ /de yang nag po'i dus zhes bya/ / bha dra 37yi ni tshes dag la/ /gre dang lha yi bla mar ldan/ /tshes de rnyed pa byed pas na/ /sbyor pa po yis bsten par bya/ /mi ki ra yi tshes la ni/ /mon gru lha yi bla ma dgazhude /gal te na ni 'dzom 7gyur na/ /'bru dang nor rnams zad byed par/ /gdon mi za bar bshad pa yin/ /tshes ni bcu gsum dag la ni/ /skag dang lha yi bla ma dag /gal te 'dzom ④na nag po pas/ /nyes pa kun gyis 'jigs par 'gyur/ / bṛ ṣa bha 8yi tshes la ni/ /stobs ldan gyi spuni blon po dang / /gal te khrums stod 'dzom pho na ni/ /tshes de rgyas pa ster 'gyur zhing / /dge ba'i grogs rnams thams cad byed/ /bṛd+dhi tsoka yi nyi ma nihunye / /chu stod dang ni pa ba sangs/ /gal te 'dzom sa )na nad kyis ni/ /78—155

gdungs shing 'joms par the tshom ①med/ /'byung po yi ni nyi ma la/ /bra nye dang ni pa ba sangs/ /'dzom ②na gshin rje'i mche ba ste/ /tshes de yongs su spang bar bya/ /kusma ③yi ni nyi ma la/ /smin drug dang ni spen pa ru/ /gal te 'dzom ④par gyur na ni/ /rnyed dang grags pa la sogs dang / /bsod nams kun gyi 'bras bu 'thob/ /byā duku li yi nyi ma ni/ /skag dang spen pa ji duzhig ltar / /'dzom ⑦na gdung bar byed pas na/ /nyi ma de la'ang ⑧'gro ba spang / /zla ba nya yi nyi ma la/ /mchu dang spen par ldan gyur na/ /'chi ba'i dhidus la bab pas na/ /tshes de shin tu spang bar bya/ / me yi ⑩mtshams su mi gir bri/ /gshin rje ru ni raṇ+ḍa 7ste/ /srin po ru 8ni kyusmra 'bri/ /chu yi phyogs su khyu mchog ste / /'jigs 8byed du ni byā 8ku li/ /gter gyi phyogs su swa ⑩pa na/ /mig gsum phyogs su bzang po bri/ /shar gyi phyogs su'ang khyu mchog go/ /zla ba nyi ma'i bye brag gis/ /de rnams su ni rgyu bar bshad/ / bha dra ⑩nas ni raṇ+ḍar te//byā 8ku li dang bṛ ṣa bhayi/ /'di dag nyi ma ⑥ rgyu bar ni/ /rigs mchog ma ni khyod la bshad/ /khyu mchog dang ni mi ki ra/ /swa pa na dang kusma 0ni/ /zla ba'i rgyu bar bshad pa ste/ /rim pa de ltar brjod pa yin/ /nya la me mtshams gnas pa ste/ /stong la rlung gi phyogs su gnas/ /de ltar de dag dbus su ni/ /gnas pa de dag gdung bar 'gyur/ /zla ba nyi ma las byung ba'i/ /ri mo mnyam du lta bas na / /des na shes rab can gyis spang / /zhi dang sdig par lta bas na/ /lta ba'i chad 3pa 'byung ba ste/ /myur du gsod par byed pa yin/ /sgra gcan gyi duni rgyu ba yi/ /dus ni mdo ru bsdus pa yin ④/ /yar ngo mar ngo'i bye brag gis/ /blo ldan 'bad de shes par bya/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 78—156

'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs①/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las tshes grangs dang skar ma'i nges pa rim par phye ba ste du0nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che/ /sgyu ma kun gyis rnam rol pa(kye/ /lus can kun gyi durnam shes te/ /lus las 'das shing dri ma med/ /lhun po dang ni ti se dang ske/ /de bzhin du ni 'bigs byed sogs/ /shar gyi lus 'phags ba lang ⑤spyod/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan dang ni/ / 'dzam bu'i gling yidang bcas pa dang / /lan tshwa can dang 'o ma yi/ /rgya mtsho la sogs chu tshogs dang / /'og dang steng du gang gyur pa/ /khams gsum ma lus zad par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po dang / /skye mched khams rnams zad par bya/ /'byung po la sogs phyogs bcu yig/ /'jig rten khams kun zad bsams te/ /dngos dang dngos med 'dres par ni/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid rnams/ /mnyam nyid stong pa nyid du bltabu/ /thams cad nam mkhar ⑨jim nas ni/ /ba glang 0mig par grong khyer bsgomaphonye/ /rnal 'byor can gyi 8cho ga bzhin/ /sems ni me mar lta bur bsgom8/ /de dbus yid kyis bltas nas ni/ /der ni mtshan ma brtag par bya/ /me mar lta bus zhi bar 'gyur8/ /dmar pos brgyan na rgyas pa ste/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar snang na8/ /chags pa ⑩la sogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtha' ⑩mar du ba'am gnag 8mthong na/ /mngon spyod du ni grags pa yin/ /rlung yogi mdog ltar rab 'khrugs na/ /de ma thag tu bskrad par 'gyur/ /'od zer dkar po long 78—157

long pos/ /blo ldan sngags kyi dngos grub ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub shes bya / /bkra shis kyis hu)ni lam ston yin/ /cho ga 'dis ni gzhan gsal dang / /gzhan gyi gzugs sogs dbu ma rnams/ /de 'og rnal 'byor bskyed par bya/ /ye shes la sogs sems kyis ni/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes byas na/ /sems ni myur du thar bar 'gyur/ /ye shes kyis ②ni shes bya brtag /shes byas 'gro ba brtag par bya/ /pha dang ma ni bsad byas shing / /bram ze gtsang ma gnyis bzung nas/ /rgyal po yul 'khor bcas bcom na(kye/ /mi ④de dag par 'gyur zhes bya/ /ye shes rang ba zhin kun dang sbyor/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs / /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las ye shes 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //ye shes khyad par gang gis ni/ /ye shes thun mong (nyebyin brlabs ⑥pa/ /bye brag can ni ji lta bu/ /lha las rol mo mnyan ⑦par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /lci bar gyur pa sum cu pos/ /dge dang sdig pa'i 'bras 'byung ba/ /nga rgyal gyis ni byin brlabs ④pa/ /sems kyis byas pa'i las tshogs kyis/ /bsgom ⑨par gyur pa'i ⑩rang rig pa'i/ /sems ni 'gro ba de ru 'gro/ /srid pa'i zhags pas rtag 'jigs pas/ /de yi 'gro ba mi mthong ngo ske/ /'du shes rnam pa lnga dang ni/ /lta ba lnga yis pha rol 'gro/ /lha yi ye shes gsal bar blta/ /lha hunyemin ye shes khro ba'o8/ /yi dgas ye shes zhan phonyepa ste/ /dmyal ba'i ye shes 'jigs pas non/ /byol song ye shes blun pa ste/ /brtan 78—158

pa rnams ni sems med pa'o/ /rgyu yi ①ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /glen pas bsgribs dang lkugs pa dang / /byis pa'i shes pa'i shes pa can/ /sems can yongs su ma smin dang / /bla ma'i lam ni sun 'byin pa/ /de dag kun gyis mi shes te/ /gsang chen sangs rgyas spyod yul lo/ /ye shes de nyid bye brag dag /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ye shes de nyid bye brag dag /nyon cig yang dag sgyu ma che/ /las rnams kyi ni bye brag gis / /ye shes bye brag sprul pa yin/ /dman dang rab dman dman pa can/ /gnod sbyin lha min grub pa po/ /klu dang byol song gsang ba pame/ /lto 'phye dang ni mi 'am ci/ /mi dang yi dgas mkha' 'gro ma/ /dmyal ba la sogs gang gyur dang ske/ /gsal ba'i gzugs su mngon brjod dang / /phra mo sgo nga las byung ba/ /chu dang me chadang rlung dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni sa yi ④khams/ /brtan ⑤pa la sogs thams cad dang / /rtsa khyadang 'dab (3)ma phra ba dang / /sa dang rdo dang brag la ⑧sogs/ /thams cad ye shes byin brlabs ⑨pas/ /thams cad snang ste gzhan du na0/ /ye shes med par skye mi 'gyur/ /skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bskul bas/ /de nas rnal 'byor bstan bcos la/ /'bad de dad pa bskyed par bya/ /gar gyi gnas dang mtshungs pa yi/ /phyi rol bstan bcos sun phonya'abyin pa/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos rjes 'brangs na/ /spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras bu 'thob/ /snying po las kyang snying po mchog /rnal 'byor bstan bcos mtshon par bya/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rtsadapal rdo rje 78—159

mkha' 'gro las rdo rje sems dpa'i ①rnam par 'phrul pa ②'byung ba'i rim par phye ba ste sum cu pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid de/ /rdo rje sems sogs lha rnams su/ /rdo rje'i blos ni shes par bya/ /zhi dang rgyas dang mngon spyod kyi/ /rdo rje dag ni thams cad kyang / /gser la sogs pa ①legs par brdung / /rdo rje kun gyis shin tu brgyan/ /cha gsum du ni bzung linas su//cha brgyad ska rags legs par brgyanadu/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams brgyad dang ni/ /dbus ma nyid dang sangs rgyas dgu/ /rtse mo dgu ni lha nyid de/ /lha dgu yis ni byin gyis brlabs/ /chu srin las ni byung ba yiyi/ /rtse mo pad+ma zla bar gnas/ /rtse dgu zhes ni bya ba ste/ /rdo rje ye shes 'gro ba sgrol(7)/ /cha gsum gyi ⑧ni tshad dag la/ /dbu ma cung zad ring yang rung / /'di ni thun mong tshad yin no/ /rtse mo kun gyi dbus ⑨ma skum/ /phyogs sogs rtse mo 'dus ⑩pas gnas/ /dbus ni zur brgyad dag tu bya/ /dbus kyi cha yi tshad ldan pa/ /gnas pa lte ba zhes bya'o⑩/ /rin chen ma ra ka 8ta ltar/ /de yang cung zad zur brgyad bya/ /steng dang 'og dang dbus dag ni/ /so sor cha ni gsum gsum 'dod/ /steng gi pad+ma zla ba ni/ /drug cha kun nas skum por bya/ /de dag la ni seng ge'i sna/ /nas phyed tsam du mtho bar bya/ /mche 8ba yi ni mthar ④gnas pa/ /de ni drug cha zhes byar grags/ /cha ni nyi shu rtsa bdun la/ /so so ru ni dgu dgur 'dod/ /cha gsum bla ma'i mtha' ma ni/ /steng gi cha gnyis spangs nas ni/ /dbus kyi mtha' yang de bzhin no/ /'dab byam la ni gang 78—160

gnas ①pa'i/ /chu srin cha gcig nyid yin te/ /de yi phyed du ska rags 'dod / /rdo rje kun la blo ldan pas/ /chu chadang zheng ③ni mnyam por bya/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i mtshan nyid de/ /gser la sogs pa las brdungs ④pa/ /cha la sogs pa sngon du ni/ /ji ltar bstan bzhin ldan par bya/ /pad+ma zla ba la gnas pa'i/ /chu srin gyi ni mche ba'i gzugs / /'og gi chu srin las byung ba/ /chu zheng ji ltar bstan pa bzhin/ /rtse mo ye shes rang bzhin 'byung / /kun gyi dbus su rnam snang ste/ /shar phyogs su ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /lho ru rin chen bstan pa ste/ /'od dpag med pa nub tu dgod/ /byang du don yod grub pa ste/ /rtse bzhi la sogs lha yin no/ /pad+ma byang chub yan lag brgyad/ /sa la ji bzhin dgod par bya/ /phyag na pad+ma byams pa dang / /mkha' snying kun tu bzang po dang / /gnod sbyin bdag dang 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sa snying sgrib sel de bzhin te/ /lha ni brgyad po 'di dag nyid / /'dab dum brgyad la ji bzhin brtag /dbus su ye shes sems dpa' ni / /bcu gsum gnas su thim par bya/ /gzhan yang 'dab yibargyad lha mo brgyad / /ji bzhin gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags stikyu zhags pa dang / /rdo rje lcags sgrog ⑧dril bu nyid/ /lha mo dag ni bzhi po 'di/ /phyogs kyi pad+mar yang dag gnas/ /mtshams ni bzhi po dag tu yang / /slar yang de bzhin lha mo bzhi/ /skul byed rin chen sgron ma dang / /de bzhin rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ⑨ma kun la dgod/ /rtse mo dag ni rnam lnga la/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni lnga nyid de⑩/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma / /byang du drag mo zhes bya ba/ /ro langs ma ni nub tu gnas/ /lho ru de 78—161

bzhin tsaṇ+ḍa 'i①/ /dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ste/ /dam tshig rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /gdug la rdo rje rtse gsum ste/ /rtse mo dag ni gdengs par (pebya/ /de bzhin rtse mo gcig pa ni/ /klu rnams skrag par byed pa'o/ /khro bo'i rdo rje gdengs po (guste/ /lhag ma rnams ni 'dul byed pa'o④/ /zhi la zhi ba'i lha nyid de / /rigs kyi rim pa'i cho gas dbye/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /bya ba thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje'i ⑤mtshan nyid do/ /cha lnga'i tshad dang ldan pa ni/ /spyi gtsug rdo rje zhes byar grags/ /rna cha cha drug tshad du bya/ /mgul do cha ni bzhi pa ste/ /snying gar (6)cha lnga pa ni gzung 9)/ /gsang ba dang ni lag par yang / /cha drug pa 58༄ni gzung 6)bya ste/ /ji ltar mdzes par brtag par bya/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan nas ⑩ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 3lhaye shes 'phel/ /cho ga'i bya ba 'di nyid kyis/ /rnal 'byor rig pas nya2rtag tu bsgom/ /de nas dril bu'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /chu zheng la sogs bshad par bya/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje'i ska rags phreng gnyis bya/ /shel sgong dri ma med pa 512ltar/ /dra ba dra ba phyed 7pas brgyan / /cha gsum mtshan nyid ldan pa la/ /rdo rje la sogs mtshan mas brgyan/ /dbus kyi tshekhog pa zab pa dang / /thams cad dga' byed bcud kyi tsoganas/ /de nas pad+ma rin hu tshochen dang / /ut+pal ku mu da lho yis brgyan/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams cha brgyad du/ /lha mo la sogs brgyad du grags/ /de yi steng du lha mo ni/ /sa bon brgyad las bsam par bya/ /shar phyogs su ni sgrol ma ste/ /de bzhin byang du gos dkar mo'o/ /nub tu bdag mo'i yiming can te/ /lho ru sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya/ /mdog mdzes sbrang rtsi yid 'ong ma/ /de bzhin rin 78—162

chen 'khyil ma'o/ /nam mkha'i phyogs kyi dbus su ni/ /gzugs rdzogs bskor bas yang dag gnas/ /pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i dbyibs/ /gzugs med srid pa'i phyogs su ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsi bum pa 'dra/ /shes rab bdud rtsi'i gnas yin te/ /de yi dbus kyi stan la ni/ /steng du pad+ma rdo rje ni/ /rtse mo dgu pa yo)bsam par bya/ /dbus kyi dbyug (mipa ye shes te/ /thams cad spro zhing sdud pa mo / /oṃ ltar mchog ni stsol bar 'grubaXkyi/ /bya ba thams cad rab sgrub gi)ma'o/ /ye shes rdo rje'i dril bu ni/ /rtse mo dgu pa de bzhin no/ /sor mo bcu gnyis tshad du ni/ /rdo rje'i phreng kun ba ska 96)rags byas/ /pad+ma mchog gi 'dab (7)ma dang ske/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas (debargyan/ /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid thams cad ldan / /lha mo yi ni mtshan mas mdzes/ /shar gyi phyogs su pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dkar pos mdzes par bya/ /gshin rjer pad+ma sngo (shebyedamar te/ /nub kyi phyogs su pad+ma dmar/ /byang du ut+pa la ni bri0/ /bdud rtsi gnas kyi dbus na ni/ /lha mo yi ni zhal gcig bri/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma'o/ /gzugs mdzes bskor bas yang dag gnas/ /steng gi pad hunyedang rdo rje ni/ /snga ma bzhin du bsam par bya/ /dbus kyi ye shes dbyig pa ni/ /zur brgyad pas ni mdzes par bya/ /dril bu 'di ni lha mo che/ /tshe dang nad med phun sum tshogs/ /de nas dpa' bo'i dril bu ste/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba'i ska nyisarags ldan/ /de bzhin du ni shes rab dang ske/ /bdud rtsi yi ni bum par ldan/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs / /dra ba dra phyed dpyang hu)bar bya/ /sor dgu ru ni yangs pa ste/ /kha ni rngusor lnga'i tshad du bya/ /de las cung zad lhag bya min/ /rtse lnga pa 'am rtse 8dgu pa / /skal tsob bzang po thams cad dang / /dbang phyug dang ni sngags rnams 78wa 163

kyi① / /'bras bu thams cad rab ster zhing / /mkha' 'gro'i stobs dang rdzu 'phrul ster/ /de bzhin phun tshogs thams cad dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub mchog ni gsal bar ster/ /da ②ni de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /dril bu'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /khar ③ba las byung sgra snyan byed/ /khong stong dang ni bum par ldan/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri la sogs mtshan ma can/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /chu srin las ni byung ba yi0/ /ye shes lnga yi rnam dag pas/ /rtse mo lnga dang bcas pa ste/ /ska rags gnyis gnyis dbus su ni/ /'khor lo'i phreng ba gnyis dang ldan/ /de bzhin ska rags gnyis dbus su/ /pad+ma la ni pad phreng gnyis/ /rin chen la ni rin po che/ /de bzhin ska rags ldan par bya/ /don yod grub pa zhes bya la⑤ / /ska rags gnyis dbus ral gris brgyan/ /kun la shes rab gdong ldan pas / /dpa' bo kun gyis rgyal bar 'gyur/ /kun la'ang 'khar ⑥ba'am yang na ni/ /lcags gsum las byung dril bu ste/ /cha gsum dang ni ldan par bya/ /rdo rje'i rigs la ba glang gdong / /ska rags rdo rje'i chaphreng bas 6)bskor/ /bum pa'i steng du gnas pa yi/ /kha khyer cung zad gru bzhir byal/ /ba glang gdong ni myur ba ru/ /nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel bar byed/ /nad med stobs ni 0rtag ster zhing / /sdug bsngal thams cad 'phrog par byed/ /sngar bstan rjes su 'brangs tunyenas ni/ /rdo rjes 8mtshan nyid mtshon par bya0/ /rin chen dbang sogs thod pa dang / /rang rang mtshan ma shes par bya/ /sor brgyad dam ni bcu drug gam/ /nyi shu las ni lhag mi bya/ /ji ltar nus shing rjes mthun ④par//bsgrub 7pa'i dbang pos de dag bya/ /kha yang cho ga'i rim pa yis/ sor mo lnga 78—164

te / pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs la lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar te/'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /bdag nyid chen mo rnams dang ni/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki nī pu dzo pa'i nā ya āḥ ṭ+wāṃ nir+sā ta yā mi rtsu/ sarba ā tsār+ya pū dzo pa'i nā ya āt+na ā+oṃ nir+sā ta yā mi r+ghaṃ/ sarba satwa pa ri tā ṇa ad+dha āḥ ṭ+wāṃ nir+sā ta yā ①mi hūṃ/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs la/ /slar yang 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ khro dang bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / /tshig rtsub zhe gcod ②spang bar bgyi/ /sdig pa'i grogs dang srog gcod dang / /rku 'phrog dag ni spang bar bgyi/ /longs spyod rgya chen mespang bgyi zhing / /des dang bcas pas chog shes bgyi/ /gar gyi ④gnas dang mtshungs ⑤pa yi/ /phyi rol bstan bcos spang bar bgyi/ /zhes so/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya bdu/ /sdom pa'i cho ga bla na med/ /dang po 0bla ma dam tshig ni/ /thob pa rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung / /bstan dang de bzhin nges par bstan/ /sku gsung methugs kyi rang bzhin te/ /bstan pa dag ni longs spyod yin/ /nges par bstan ⑨pas mya ngan 'das/ /bshang gci la sogs bza' ba dang / /rigs dang rigs min de bzhin gzhan/ /sngags rnams kyi ni man ngag gis/ /ming sogs cho ga bzhin dbang bskur/ /slob mas dngos po bsgoms nas su/ /mya ngan 'das pa bstan par bya/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad ⑩bya zhing / /brdzun du yang ni smra bar bya/ /ma byin par ni blang bar bya/ /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par bya/ /mchod rten las ni mi bya 78—168

nāmā ra dha rā ya/ ma hā dhū mān dha kā ra/ wa pu ṣā ya ①lhu hūṃ phaṭal/ oṃ hūṃ gā hā ②phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kai rtu rgyu phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sasba ra swā hā/④oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī duye swā hā/ oṃ trī duḥha ha rtsu ⑦ phaṭa/ oṃ ha na ma hi/ swā hā 6du/ bo ṣaṭa 7he0/ rtsu hūṃ hoyi/ phaṭa haṃ 8swā hā/ oṃ bhā tī hūṃ/ ho ho hārwa/se ma rba/ haṃ yo/ hrī oṃ/ hro ṭhā/ rtsu ④rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ sasba 8bud+dha badz+ra baṇ+ḍi tso'i 0ye/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī 8ye swā hā/ oṃ sum+bha yini sum+bha 0 hūṃ phye phaṭa/oṃ groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa du hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gros pa ya gro: dupa ya rtsu hūṃ byaphaṭa/ oṃ ā ⑤na ya ho bha ga blos/ bibyā rā dzā 0 hūṃ rgyu 'phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ⑥bar+ṣa bas ⑥pa ya hūm̐ bhu 0swā hā/ oṃ ghi li snyi lis/ bar+ṣa bca 9pa ya rtsu rgyu r+ghaṃ ho ho ho/ ṭha ṭha ṭha swā hā/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ④rgyu hūṃ duphaṭa/ oṃ ka ka k+ṣi tsoka ka ru dri 0ka ka ⑫in+d+ra tsu)ba ha rtso )ri ṇi4te/ tsuges mu ka su dzī bi rta shī r+ghaṃ ā gats+tsha ka ki ya thā su khaṃ ( nyephaṭa / oṃ sarba 4༄ti thi nak+ṣa tra 8gra ha mi zhug le bh+yaḥ0swā hā/ oṃ 9 a mu ni ka su i nu ni ba si mu ni ha tha lī gha le hi pha ḍi i a mu ka su mu kha ha tha brnya ni 0swā hā/oṃ rat+na sro )badz+ra badz+ra 0thi 4)phaṭa/ oṃ gra zhug hā/ oṃ a ṭi ba ṭi na ṭi ⑥ku na ṭi ṭha ke ṭha 5snyer ke ta ru bi ta ru be na ta ke 0li li lu lu hi le mi le ti le ṣi le si le a the ba the na the ku na the a na pa sh+yi ṭi ha (nyen pa 0ti ka su ka su gha su gha su ma hā gha su ma hā gha su be〉 hā/ oṃ piṅga lāk+ṣa 0ya rtsu hūṃ rtsu phaṭa ④su hā/ sngags 'di yis ni sgrub pa po(snye/ /las rnams thams cad byed ④'gyur te/ /sngags kyi cho ga ji bzhin du/ /nyon cig lha mo bshad par bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti badz+ra bā rā ④nyi ār+ya (sgye.a pa rā sko)dzi te tre+e lo kya mā rdzo te ma ༅hā bi bye ⑩ shwa ri sab bhū 0ta bha yā ba ③he / ma hā badz+re chubadzā bus des/ a dzi te a pa rā tidzi te ba ṭ+wāṃ 0ka ri ne tra sgra 78wa 170

ma ṇi/ bi ṣa sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi gro dha ni ka rā li ni/ sarnga tshis ni mā ra ṇi su pra te da ni ba rā dza ye/ bi dza ye rdza bha ni ste (0bha ni mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā rā nyi ⑧ma hā yo gi ni kā dume 0shwa ri kha ge/ tabya thā/ pro haṃ ge pro rta ge/ ha na ha na thā ṇ+ḍaṃ ki ki ni khi dukhri ni/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra ha ste gsho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya (nyekha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la mā la dhā ri ṇi ⑨ma hā pi shi ta 0rmā 7sā sha ni ma 0nu ṣa an+t+ra pra bris sadzi dha na ra shi ro mā lā gre thi ta dhā ra ṇi0/ sum+bha ni sum+bha ha na ha na mā tsā/ sab pā pa satā ṭ+wāṃ sab pa shu rmā ma hā māṃ sa myu da ni gro dha mūrti rda'i ka rā ⑩li ni ma hā hunyenu dre/ shrī ho ru ka de ba r+sā 0gra ma nyi ṣi 0sa ha sra shi ros/ sa ha sra bā yiha ( kye be/ sha ta sa ha sru 0na des/ dz+wa 0li ta te dza se(ste/ dz+wa lā mu khi 'aping ga la lo tsa neng nya/ badz+ra sha rī 0re/ badz+ra ā phyis ne/ mi li mi li/ ti mi li ti mi li ho he ha ha/ lhu buhūṃ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ a du )rwa te ma 0hā yo gi nī pa ⑫ji ta zhusirnye dre dhe dre dhe(ste/ gre gro/ ho ho ha ha/ gli 0me 0ha sa ha sa/ bī 9re ha ha ho ho r+ghaṃ /du/ tre+e lo kya bi nā sus ni/ sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi ta thā ga ta pa ri bā ri 0 te hūṃ 0rgyu phaṭa/ sau (3ha rū (snyen khaḥ se ga dza rū rgyagyebe gaḥsgo) tre lo kya u da re zhus mu dra me (nyekha le (7gra sa gra sa rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī rā dwo te (3 hūṃ rtsu rgya hā hā dum hā pa shu mo aha ni yo gi snyishwa ri tso/ ḍā ki nī sarba lo kā ā+oṃ ban+da 0ni sa byaḥpra t+ya ya kā ri ṇi 0rgyu tso phaṭa/ bhū ta tā so)sa ni ma hā bī re 0pa ra ma sidhe bīr+ya 0yo tsoge 0shwa ri phaṭa ④rgyu tso phaṭa/ rtsu hūm̐ hūṃ thuphaṭa 9swā hā/ a ā/ i khri/u lca/ ṛ rī/ bla zhuste'acha/ e i0/ o au/ i aḥdhi ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣaḥ0 'di ni bcom ldan lha de nyid/ /lha rnams kun gyi mchog 78—171

gi gnas/ /sngags rnams thams cad skyed byed pa/ /rgyud rnams kyang ni de bzhin no/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las sngags kyi cho ga rim par phye ba ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rgyud du sbas pa nges par bya/ /de nas thams cad chos 'byung bar/ /sna tshogs lte bar mi shigs ①dge/ /bris nas cho ga bzhin du sngags/ /chos kun gcig tu ②bsdu bar bya/ /ā li kā ③li mnyam byas nas/ /sde tshan dul ni thim ⑤par bya/ /der gnas pa las dpa' bo ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed btu/ /ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /sprul pa 'thob gyur ⑥gdon mi za/ /'og dang steng 'grub rtag tu ster/ /bdag gi pho nya mo kun 'gro/ /pho nya mo de grub kun ster/ /mthong dang de bzhin reg pa dang / / tsusba na medang rtag par 'khyudadu/ /sbyor ba'i gnas 0kyi khyad par nyid/ /ji snyed rnal 'byor tshogs rnams ni/ /thams cad dngos grub byed par bshad/ /bden pa thams cad sbyin bya ste/ /gzhan du nam yang ma yin no/ /ma dang sring 0mo bu mo dang / /chung ma pho nya mor gnas la/ /gang zhig rtag tu sngags sbyin pa/ /rang gi cho ⑩/ga de bzhin bya/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /de bzhin sangs rgyas gtsug nor bu/ /pad+ma dpal gyi nags rtsa ba/ /brda 0yis sangs rgyas phyag rgya yin/ /dbang po gang dang gang lam nas / /rang bzhin de dang de 'gro ba/ /mchog tu mnyam bzhag 8sbyor ba yis/ /78—172
