sangs rgyas kun tu rang nyid 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i brda'i ①rim par phye ba ste sum cu ②rtsa bzhi pa'o // //de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'i/ /ye shes 'byung ba bshad par bya/ /bong bu'i cha byad rnal 'byor bdag /yid shugs kyis ni zlog ①par byed/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang mdzes ma dang / /dum skyes gzugs can rnal 'byor ma/ /rnal 'byor ma ni 'di dag nyid/ / brda yi ④tshul gyis bstan pa ste/ /bsam gtan phyag rgya 'dod gzugs can/ /bong bu'i cha byad khrag 'dzag zhal/ /sbrul gyis dkris pa'i mdung rtse ni/ /gsum pa mkha' 'gro'i lag na thogs/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa ni/ /steng du bstod ⑤de thogs pa dang / /mi ro'i stan ༅bzhugs cher 'bar ba/ /skra la④ni kham pa dugyen brdzes shing / /spyan gsum gyis ni mdzes par byas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubasanyu/ /phyag na zangs gri bsnams shing rtse0/ /sna tshogs me tog 'bras ldan pa'i/ /rin chen mthon po'i gnas su sgom7/ /tshe thung ba dang shi ba yang ⑫/ /'tsho 8ba dang ni tshe ring bar/ /bong bu'i tshul gyi rnal 'byor gyisal/ /lag mthil tsoganas pa bzhin du mthong / /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 78—173

dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las he ru ku'i rnam par rol pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sgrub po'i cho ga ji bzhin te/ /nyin re'am yang na zla re 'am/ /yang na de bzhin lo re ni/ /ji bzhin byin gyis brlabs na ni/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'jug par 'gyur/ /sgrub pa po yi ①lag g.yon gyis / /pad+ma'i lasnod ni bzung dunas su/ /lag pa g.yas pa ba dan ni/ /gsum par byas te bsgom par bya/ /khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dang / /de bzhin srog dang rtsa las byung / /mngon par 'dus byas legs bris pa/ / slob dpon ⑤kun la sbyin ⑤par bya/ / lha yi ⑥rgyan dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan mas rnam par bklubasaX/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom skyes pas/ /skal ⑧ba bzang po'i gar chen bya/ /pad+ma mchog la reg byed pa/ /lo gcig bar du'ang ma byas na/ /sgrub pos dam tshig spang sti'agyur te/ /des ni dam tshig spangs yinas su/ /slar yang mi bya'i sdom pa blang / /gzhan du sngags dang phyag rgya ni/ /rim pa 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las brda 'o)yis rol pa dang dam tshig dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste sum cu rtsa drug pa'o// //mtshon cha kun gyi tsomatshan nyid ni/ /rab tu bshad kyis hunyelha mo nyon/ /78—174

'khrul 'khor gyis 'phen mi 'phen dang / /de bzhin lag pas 'phen pa dang / /'phangs nas slar ni gzung ①ba dang / /lag pas 'gyed dang rnam pa lnga/ /dbyibs dang bde blag sbyor ba dang / /stong rgyud sbyor dang 'dren dang myur/ /'gengs dang 'phen dang gsal ②ba'o/ /grims pa nyid dang sran 'dzugs dang //mnyen zhing yan lag brtan ②pa dang / /rgya cher ④'gengs shing rnam par dag /lus kyi phyag rgya bde blag can/ /'di yis lus la brgyan nas ni/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig ⑤dug dang / /mkha' 'gros gtses dang gdon rnams kyis/ / nams kyang tshugs ⑥par mi 'gyur ro/ /rang gi snying khar ⑦'dren tshul du/ /bde blag can gyis gzhu bzung (nyenas/ /g.yas su rab tu skor ⑨byed cing / /mda' ⑩'phangs na ni grub par 'gyur/ /shar phyogs legs par bsrangs yinas ni / /nub phyogs cung zad bkug tsonas su/ /gzhu rgyud dal bus drangs na ni/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur/ /thams cad 'gugs 8pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rna drung ④bar du skum por ni/ /ci rigs par ni legs par bzung / /yi ge oṃ gyis khar drangs te/ /ji srid yi ge a brjod pa/ /de srid bar du gzung 8bar bya / /'dzin pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /ci rigs par ni drangs nas ni4nya/ /cho ga bzhin du bzung nas su/ /der ni cung zad dbye bar bya/ /'gengs pa thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /'gengs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /chang pas 'ben ni bsgribs nas su/ /mig ni cung zad gdangs te hunyebalta/ /lta ba chang pa la gtad de/ /myur du 'phangs na tso'agrub pa'i mchog /mda' gzhus rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /gru bzhi pa dang rnon po dang / /de bzhin kun nas skum po ste/ /g.yas phyogs nas ni bskor nas su/ /steng dang de bzhin 'og tu ni/ /rim rtso6gyis gnon 78—175

cing drag tu gnon/ /'jigs pa bcu yi ①rgya mchog gis/ /khams gsum rgyal srid chen po la/ /bde bar rgyal zhing longs spyod 'gyur/ /dpal khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya'i sbyor ba bla na med pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las mtshon cha thams cad kyi brda'i ye shes kyi go cha'i ( mirim par phye ba ste sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //pho nya gdul ba'i sgrub ②pa'i thabs/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /tha mal sngags kyi lus can dang / /zhing skyes ma ni gang yang rung / /sgrub pos de dag thams cad la/ /phan pa'i mchog gis bde ba bsgrubasti/ /'di dag gzhan pas ⑧longs spyod kyi/ /bsnyen bkur gyis ni bsten mi bya/ /skal bzang ⑥phyug cing sra ba ste/ /rang gi bkra shis rigs spyod dang / /ri mo can ni sems g.yo zhing / /'o ma 'dzin sbom pad+ma can/ /lte ba dung 'dra dung can ma/ /de dag rim pa bzhin du brjod/ /'byung po'i shing gi rtsa ba 'bad pas khar bcug na / ji srid (7bu mo'i bde ba rnyed pa de srid kyi bar du sngags pas 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gan du sha dang la k+ṣa na'i ②sman btags te til mar du btsos la rkang pa la bskus na yang 'dod pa la spyod pa rnams kyis bsngags 7so/ /a shad tha'i hu )shing kun da dang pa tha dang / pu shel tse tunyernams cha bsnyams tetunye/shing ar ku'i 8'o ma dang sbyar bul des pho mtshan dril phyis byas na/ gdon mi za bar 'phel 8bar 'gyur te/ de'i 'og tu myur du chu dron gyis bkrus tson ji 78—176

srid ①'dod pa bzhin 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma dkar po'i ge sar sprang rtsi dang lhan cig btags te lte bar bskus na/ bud med sra ba rnams kyang khu ba 'dzag par 'gyur ro/ /til dkar po dang / nā ga ⑤ge sar dang / dpa' bo tshig 'greng gi rtsa ba rnams btags te / sbrang rtsi dang ma he'i dumar dang lhan cig tu sbyar te lte bar bskus ⑤na/ pho mtshan mkhrang yizhing bud med chags pa che ba rnams yid 'phrog par 'gyur zhing / bong bu ltar ni 'dod spyod pas/ /bde don gnyer la bde ster b.rasti/ /'dul ba don yod rgyud las nini/ /ngas ni 'dzin pa bshad pa yin/ /ling gas bud med bsgrub bya zhing / /bha gas skyes pa bsgrub par bya/ /ling ga don gnyer ⑨mtshan ma zhes bshad de/ /bha ga la ni spel bar bya/ /phyag rgya phyag rgyar sbyor ba yin/ /rnam par rol pas ling ga zhes / /bya ba ru ni bstan pa ste/ /rnam par 'byed pas bha ga yin/ /ma ⑩bstan gsal bar bstan pa ste/ /nye phonyebar bstan pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /a yig ba yi 8yi ge las/ /bha ga ming ga bskyed nas ni/ /bung ba la sogs rim ⑫ji bzhin/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun bsgrub par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma chadang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las pho nya gdul 8ba'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mos mchod cing phyag byas te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems can bsod nams med pa dang / /sngags rnams bsten ⑩78—177

par mi nus pa/ /de rnams dngos grub ji ltar 'thobasti/ /stobs med rnams ni (5stobs bskyed cing / /sngags dang bral yang bsrung ①'gyur ba/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad du gsol/ /sgyu ma kun tu rnam 'phrul ba/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che / /sems can rnams ni chags bya'i phyir/ /lha yi sman ni bshad par bya/ /de ni ji ltar gzung (pebya ba/ /de ni de bzhin bshad par bya/ /bdag nyid lha yi ⑤dngos byas nas/ /phyi nas sa bon bsgrub par bya/ /sems can rnams ni chags pa dang / /de bzhin bya ba sna tshogs byed/ /sa bon la sogs gzugs pa yi / /las rnams sna tshogs 'byung ba'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/ ji lta bu'i sa bon la sogs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ e raṇ+ḍa da ⑥dang gser shing la sogs pa'i shing gi sa bon te/ de la sogs pa yongs su smin pa rnams cho ga bzhin bsgrub par bya'o/ /mar ngo'i 'byung po'i nyi (7)ma la zla mtshan tshon (8)dang dbang po bsgo/ /dur khrod thal bar ldan pa dang / /gtor ma dang ni bsrung 6tabar bcas/ /de bzhin lha yi 7lhug ma gzugs/ /pa tha dang ni rgyal ba dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub pa nyid dang / /tsakra ang ga rmongs byed rnams/ /mtshon cha thams cad zlog 7par byed/ /tsakra tsosang ga 8lag pas 'phen8/ /pa tas 'khrul 8'khor 'phen pa ste/ /'phangs nas bzung ba tsorgyal bas pho tshoso/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ⑩lag pas 'gyed/ /rmongs byed kyis mi 'phen pa'o/ /'di dag brda yi mtshul gyis bshadabu / /de dag thams cad grims par ni/ /g.yon phyogs su ni bsgril 0nas su/ /mgrin pa'am spyi bor gzung ⑤byas na/ /mtshon cha lnga ni bzlog 0par byed/ / gdol pa'i 0bu mo mdog sngon gyi/ /pad+ma las ni skyes pa dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis bsgos nas su/ /78—178

nyi tshan dag la bskam ①par bya/ /khyi nag po yi ②thod pa ni/ /dur khrod sa yis bkang ③ba ru/ /mar ngo'i tshes brgyad bcu bzhi la/ /pha mes ④kyi ni nags su gzugs / /de ni 'bad de blangs nas su/ /dur khrod dang ni bla ma dang / /he ⑤ru ka dpal mchod byas la/ /grub pa'i sa bon gzung (6)byas te/ /thod pa ru ni bzhag pa la/ /cho ga bzhin du mngon bsngags (lete/ /mgul par bcings (8)na sbed par 'gyur/ /mnyam par bzhag ste bcing ba dgrol/ /bya rog nag po'i thod pa dang / /mdung ngam mtshon gyis bsad pa yi/ /skyes bu yi ni thod pa ru/ /sbrul nag po yi ⑨zhag gis ni/ /gser shing la sogs sa bon la/ /yang dang yang du bsgos byas la/ /grog mkhar gyi ni sa dag bodang / /dur khrod sa yis bsregs ⑩bkang ste/ /bzhi mdo lam gyi dbus sam ni/ /chu bo yi ni 'gram dag tu/ /sgrub po shin tu mnyam bzhag 8pas/ /thod par dgongs 0mo'i dus su bzhagatso /gtor ma sbyin zhing bcu ba dang / /bsrung 7ba dag ni nyin re bya/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga tsosogs ldan pa yi/ /dpal ldan he ru ka gzugs bya/ /lag g.yon thod pa bzung tshunas ni/ /brtul zhugs spyod par ldan pa yis/ /cho ga bzhin du bskyed byas na/ /sha za la sogs co mi 'dri/ /sa bon smin pa bzung nas ni/ /mkhas pas sngon bzhin mchod byas nas/ /grub pa'i rdzas kyi phud dag ni/ /khyad par du ni bla mar dbul/ /sgrub pos der 1 ni khar bcug na/ /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs su snang / /lha dang sbyin bdag gnod sbyin nya sogs/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin gzugs bsgyur te/ /lha yi bu mo rnams dang ni/ /ji srid 'dod kyi bar du rol/ /dgongs nalhamo gtor ma sngon 'gro bas/ /ji bzhin lhag par gnas bya zhing / /shing bskyed cho ga rgyas pa las/ /'byung bzhin bsrung lke nyab la 78wa 179

sogs bya/ /gzhan du me tog 'bras bu sogs/ /drag po'i gdon gyis gtses pas natu)/ /'grub pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas skra ⑧grol gcer bur ni/ /gyur pa'i bu mo'i lag dugayon du/ /gal te smin pa'i 'bras bu de/ /sgrub pa pos ni gzhag ⑤par bya/ /gang dang gang gi lakhrag gis ni/ /yang dang yang du 'bras bu bsgo/ /de yi khrag gis bsgos pa yi/ /sha la sogs pa mtshon bya zhing / /de yi thal bas bskyed par bya/ /de yi thod par gzugs pa dang / /de yi sha khrag zhag gis ni/ /yang dang yang du bcu bar bya/ /de yi sha sogs bdug pa dang ske/ /byug pa'ang yang dang yang du bya/ /sngon du gtor ma bsrung ⑥sogs bya/ /sa bon de ni smin pa dang (pe/ /cho ga bzhin du blangs nas ni/ /kha yi nang du bzhag gyur na/ / cho gas 2ji ltar bsam ⑨pa bzhin/ /de dang de yi ⑩gzugs 'gyur te/ /de bzhin 'di yi /tshonyemathu yis ni/ /mi snang bar ni thams cad 'gyur/ /sa bon ma nyams stobs kyis su/ /'ug pa la sogs rnams kyis kyang ske/ /cha tsam yang ni mthong mi nus/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mtshon cha thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir/ /nyi ma gzas 8ni zin dus su/ / paṇ+ḍa ra ka 8zhes bya 8dang / /dpa' bo gcig pa stobs po che/ /snga dro nyi ma shar dus su / /byang phyogs rtsa ba brkos tsonas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag ⑩pas gzung ⑩bar bya/ /sngar bstan cho ga'i rim pa yis/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu rmongs par byed/ /bgrod dka'i lam ni nyam nga ru/ /stag dang seng ge sogs 'jigs dang / /rgyal po rkun po'i 'jigs sogs pa/ /thams cad bsrung hunyeb bla na med/ /yang na de yi yige sar ni/ /zho dang lhan cig bza' du bar bya/ /ji srid mgrin par lud kyi bar/ /de srid bar du bza' bar bya/ /ji srid de ni ma zhu'i bar/ /78—180

rdo rje 'dzin 'dra'i lus su 'gyur/ /de 0)lus mtshon cha phog pa yang / /chu yi thigs pa ltar mi snod②/ /mtshon cha thams cad zlog ①pa yi/ /de nas sbyor ba gzhan bshad bya/ /sngon bzhin gtor ma sogs ldan par/ /ang ko ta ku'i ④tsa blangs la/ /de las ri lu ⑤byas nas su/ /lcags gsum gyis (6)ni dkri bar bya/ /lha ⑦mo der ni khar bcug na/ /mtshon cha thams cad ldog 'gyur zhing / /rims dang glo dang gedabugs mi bde/ /nad rnams gzhan yang tshar gcod la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dug dang ni/ /lus srul la sogs gzhan dag kyang / /seng ge tso)yis ni glang chen bzhin/ /dri tsam gyis ni 'bros par 'gyur/ /de nas sbyor ba gzhan bshad pa/ /be ⑩ti zhes bya lha yi 1)sman/ /rgyal dang nyi ma dag gam ni/ /yang na ⑩zla ba gzas zin tshe/ /phyag rgyar bcas pa'i sgrub pa pos/ / lha yi hunyernal 'byor dmigs na ni/ /gtor ma mchog sogs byas nas su/ /'bad de sngags ni bzlas ④byas la/ /skra grol gcer bur gyur pa yis/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag 8sto gzung ⑩/ /cho ga'i bya ba 'di yis ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom 0med/ / cha bdun du ni bgos nas su/ /'onyamakhas pas spyi bor gzung bar tsobya/ / du rim pa 'di yis sgyu ma che/ /mtshon cha thams cad zlog bya'agyur te / /ji snyed sa stengs duganas pa yis / /mtshon cha gzhan yang zlog byed pa/ /nyi ma yis ni mun pa bzhin/ /bltas pa tsam gyis zlog par byed/ /de nas cho ga gzhan bshad pa/ /nag po chen po sman chen po/ /blo ldan gza' ni nyi ma dang ske/ /skar ma rgyal 4stedang tsoldan pa la/ /mchod dang gtor ma'i cho ga yis/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag 0pas gzung zhurte/ /khyu mchog rwa ༷ nyeyi sa dang ni/ /phyi nas gcig tu 0bsre bar bya/ /lo gcig bar du nus dang ldan/ /de nas 78—181

gsar pa gzhan gzung bya/ /ji srid lus la gnas kyi bar/ /mtshon chas chod cing phugs mi 'gyur/ /sgrub po de yi lus la ni/ /dug ①kyang 'pho bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sngon (mibastan cho ga'i bya ba yis/ /bh+ra dum dan ta'i stisman gzung ⑤bya / /pad+ma yi ni 'dam dang ni/ /lhan cig tu ni bsre bar bya/ /sngar bstan cho ga'i rim pa yis/ /i shwa ri ni gzung 6)bar bya/ /mtshan ma gcig gi sa dag dang ske/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ste bsre/ /yon tan dag ni snga ma bzhin/ /nyon cig lha mo shes rab che/ /ku ma rī (7)zhes bya ba'i (8)sman/ /gzhon nu ma yi rkang rjes rdul/ /de yi gci ba'i sa dang bcas/ /ma he rwa yi sa dang ldan/ /'dam 'di sum cu gsum pas mchod/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /birgyu ⑨bi zhes bya ba'i sman/ /sngar bstan cho ga'i bya ba yisam/ /nags kyi phreng ba gzung ri(stobar bya/ /bzlog ste 'khor ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /'jim pa 'bad de blangs nas su/ /de dang lhan cig ldan par bya/ /lus la gnas na bsrung ⑫bar 'gyur/ /rtse gcig yid kyis mnyam hunyepar gyis/ /phag mo zhes bya'i sman dang ni/ /phag gi lus las byung ba'i 'dam/ /ma he'i rwa 7yi nang du gzhagatso lo gcig bar du nus tshedang ldan/ /des kyang snga ma (chubazhin du 'gyur/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo ri rtse dang / /glang chen mche bar chags pa'i sa/ /dbang po shing nyunyegi rtsa bar bcas/ /sum cu gsum dbang 'dam zhes bya/ /de nas hu3 tsa muṇ+ḍa nu )bshad bya/ /kha dog gcig pa bla na med/ /tsaṇ+ḍa ༷ nyeli yi rtsa bzung sel/ /sngar bstan bzhin du bsgrub par bya/ /shing gcig dang ni mtshan gcig pa'i( nye/ /sa dang sbyar te 'dam du gi bya/ /de ni lus la gnas par du/ /sum cu gsum pas kyang mi shigs/ /de nas cho ga gzhan bshad bya/ /snying po thams cad 78—182

bsdus pa ste/ /mngal nas dang po byung ba ni/ / ma yi 6)nu zho ma 'thungs pa/ /rdo rje phag mor bcas pa yil/ /te ru ka ni mchod byas la/ /de ltar byas nas lha mo che/ /gtor ma byin la yang (miyang bsrung sbyong)/ /de yi ltag (5)pa gshags (6)nas su/ /lce ni rtsa bar bcas ⑦te blangs/ /briṅgi (8)rā dza gser shing dang / /ka ga ga dza gzhan mi thub/ /lha yi sman dang bcas pa las/ / ril bu (9)ru ni byas nas su/ /khar bcug nas ni bzung gyur na/ /mtshon cha thams cad zlog par 'gyur⑩/ /ji snyed tunyes steng hurteganas pa yi/ /mtshon cha rnams kyang zlog 3nyebyed na/ /kha cig la lta smos ci dgos/ /rims dang dug dang nad rnams dang ske/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gdon gyis 'tshe/ /de dag thams cad zlog 7'gyur te / /gzhan dag tu ni nga mi smra/ /de nas sbyor ba gzhan bshad bya/ / de yi 1snyesha dang zhag dang khrag /gcin dang khu bar bcas pa yis/ /yung ba nag po la byugs te/ /rgyal dang 'byung po'i nyi ma la/ /bgegs ni zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /'byung po kun gyi gtor byin te/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub tshepa'i phyir/ /sngags pa cho gar ldan pa yis/ /byis pa'i ro yi nyu tshosto bar ni/ /mar ngo 'byung po'i nyi ma la/ /dur khrod kyi ni sa gzhi 18ru/ /cho ga bzhin du btsugs la bskyed / /ce 37spyang la sogs bsrung bar bya/ / 'dab ma brul 2 )zhing smin 2nyapa dang ske/ /sngar gyi cho ga bzhin blangs te/ /de ni lus la gnas kyi bar/ /skad cig gis ni dpa' bor 'gyur/ /sngar bstan byis pa'i lce bla dang ni/ /yung ba nag por bcas pa las/ / ri lur na byas te khar bcug la/ /g.yul du zhugs na dgra bcings 'gyur/ /de nas dpung rnams thams cad ni/ /rmongs byed skud pa bshad par bya/ /skar ma rgyal la nan tan du/ /nags kyi ras bal 78wa 183

blangs nas ni/ /zla mtshan gyis ni byugs byas la/ /sum sgril yang ni sum sgril du / /gzhon nu ma yis 'bad de bkal6)/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /bzlas shing mdud pa de tsam bya/ /mdud pa dag ni thams cad kyang ②/ /ma mo brgyad du brtag ②par bya/ /de ltar sngags brgyad byas pa yis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa ④byas nas su/ /so so re re dag la yang / /brgya rtsa brgyad brgyad bzlas byas la/ /lag pa g.yon par btags na ni/ /mda' dang ral gri la sogs pa'is)/ /mtshon cha thams cad bcings par 'gyur/ /sgyu ma chen po'i ⑥rig pa 'di/ /rab tu 'bad de gsang bar bya/ /de nas cho ga gzhan bshad pa / /nags kyi shal ma li yi ⑦ni/ /bal ni skar ma rgyal la blangasani/ /bu mo yi ni gci ba yis/ /btags te de dang bsre bar bya/ /bu mo yis dhini bkal bar bya / /gza' 0dang skar ma dge ba dang / /zla ba stobs can dag la ni/ /mdud pa'i sbyor ba byas nas su/ /so so zhing ni re re la/ /sngar gyi rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag phonyaste bsgrubatso/ /'di yis bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /sum cu hunyegasum pas kyang mi 'ching / /las ④kyi cho ga mthong ba yis / /mtshon cha thams cad 'ching 'gyur te/ /'di ni ba glang 8lhas su bsgrubatso / /su rag ta dang seng ldeng dang / /nim pa dang ni ar ku'ang hu rung //skar ma rgyal dang nyi ma la/ /shing bu de gnyis bzung nas ni/ /myos par byed pa'i rig lho pa che/ /rig pa kun gyi gtso mo ste/ /lan brgya ru ni bzlas nas su/ /shing bu phan tshun drud gyur na/ /dgra bo nang na yi'athab par 'gyur/ /rdo rje yi ni chu dang ni/ /mdzub sum̐ )mo'i khrag dang bcas pa la/ /myos par byed ma'i (nyerig pa bzla/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa sngon 'gro bas/ /dpral bar thig le byas na zhu ni/ /78—184

chom po dang ni rkun po dang / /'tshe bar byed pa gzhan yang rung / /skye bo thams cad rmongs par byed/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/stobs skyed ①pa'i cho ga'i ②rim par phye ba ste sum cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //gang gis sgrub ①pa po 'grub pa'i/ /de nas sbyor ba gzhan bshad bya/ /ras ster gyi ④ni sa bon dag /snye ⑤ma'i rtser gnas blang bar bya/ /sngon bzhin yi dgas zla phyed kyiyi/ /'byung po'i 4)nyi ma gza' bzang (8)la/ / gau ri ⑨la sogs mkha' 'gro mar/ /bcas pa'i he ru ka mgon mchogabo /bud med kyi ni me tog gis7/ /yang yang du ni bsgo 3stebar bya/ / bsgegs pa 'am rtsonyani mtshon gyis bsad/ /spyang ki 8la sogs ma bros pa'i / /bud med thod pa mdzes pa ru / /cho ga de yis ⑩bskyed par bya/ /de yang rnga mo dag gi 7ni/ /'khrul 'khor la ni bskyon nas su/ /de yi rtse mo blang bar bya/ /sngags pas mchod pa byas nas ni/ /bu mor bsgom zhing 8de bskul nyu7ba'i/ /chu ni 'bad dang bcas te gtor/ /bud med ro bsregs sa dang ni/ /thal bar bcas pas de bkang la / /ras ster gyi so )ni sa bon nyid/ /thod pa der ni bskyed par bya/ /bgegs dgra dang ni gshin gshed kyi/ /sngags ni mngon par bzlas pa yis /mchod dang gtor ma phul nas ni/ /ci rigs su ni bsrung bar bya/ /zhi ba'i tshigs bcad sngags kyis ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa'i chusatsho nya/ /der ni bcu ste bskyed par bya/ /gzhan du yi dgas 'tshe ba ḍo ge'abyung / /'bu la sogs 78—185

pa bsrung nyab dang / /shing bskyed rig byed bzhin du bya/ /de ni 'bad de smin pa yi/ /ras bal dag ni bzung nas su/ /gzhon nu ma yi khrag ②gis ni/ /bsgos ②la sngar gyi bu mo yiX/ /skra dang bcas pa bu mos bkal/ /skud pa de yis bcings gyur na/ /de ma thag tu skyes bu ni/ /'dod chags gdungs pa'i bud med 'gyur/ /bkrol (snyen slar yang rnal mar yi'agyur/ /bsgegs pa'i ro yi (7khrug dang ni/ /zhag gi yungs kur (sheyang yang bsgo/ /gsang ba yi ni zhing sa ru/ /tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal la ni/ /lam dang rigs mchog thod pa ni/ /ro ba sregs sas ponyebakang ro dang bcas/ /nyi ma shis pa dag la gzugs/ /de ni shin tu smin pa blang ⑩/ /ci rigs 'khrul ⑩'khor btsir ba'i mar/ /bskrad pa 8la sogs bya ba kun/ /blo ldan ji ltar 'dod bzhin byed/ /sa mtha' lnga pa ⑫yang yidag ldan/ /rlung gi sa bon las byung ba/ / de yi tsomod la bskrad 'gyur te / /bsgrub bya de ni slar mi ldog /bsgegs nas bsad pa'i skyes bu'i ro/ /cho ga'i rim bzhin mchod byas la/ /sngar tsheni ji ltar bstan pa bzhin/ /mar des yan lag kun tu byug /he ru ka yi spyod pa yis/ /sngags ni zlos shing kun tu gnas/ /sbyor chen de nyurteni bgegs bskrad bya/ /sngags pa chen pos de dus su / /bgegs ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ / ro yi nyunyelus las byung mthong ste/ /de nas der ni de dus su/ /grub pa'i rdzas kyi bar chad byed/ /g.yog dang bcas pa'i sgrub nyu)pa pos/ /de tshe phyag rgya bcing bya ste/ /skyes 3 )gnas phyag rgya dpral ba yi/ /steng du bcings la bstan bya zhing / /drag po yi ni gzugs kyis su/ /dpa' bo'i dam tshig ci rigs bstan/ /sha dang khrag tu bcas pa yi/ /gtor ma yi dgas rnams la sbyin/ /de yi lus las 'dzag zhu1pa'i mar/ /blangs te ku 78—186

ba la sogs ②blugs/ /de yis lus la byugs tsam gyis/ /nam mkhar rdo rgyu ba 'grub ①par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang ral gri mig sman dang / /rtsi la sogs pa rab tu 'grub/ /khrag dang mi yi zhag gis ni/ /yungs kur gel ni bsgos nas su / /mi ro yi ni khar bcug la/ / srung ba (5)la sogs 'bad de bya/ /de nas snga stim bzhin bskyed pa'i/ /yungs kur (3)gang la bsnun (0pa yi/ /bsgrub bya de ni rims nad kyis/ /'dzin te ⑨de ma thag tu 'chi/ /so bya yi ni khrag dang ni/ /zhag gis snum ster bsgo byas la/ /de yi thod pa 7ro bsregs pas/ /bkang 37ba ru ni bskyed par bya/ /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs pa/ /sngar bstan bzhin du ci rigs bya/ /smin pa'i 'bras bu khar bcug na/ /skyes bu bya yi nyugegazugs su 'gyur/ /de ltar sa bon gzhan dag kyang / /dog pa la gnas 'bras bu gzung ske/ /de dang 0'dra ba'i gzugs 'gyur te/ /kha las bton bon sngon bzhin 'gyur/ /bya rnams kyi ni tshe dang mtshungs/ /glang po'i gzugs sogs de bzhin bya/ /bi da 1snye ri yi tsos bon ni/ /mar ngo skar ma rgyal dang ni/ /gza' sne tshoni nyi ma dag la gzung hunye/ /ma du lung ga'i 37yar ngo la/ /mi ro'i zhag gis byugs nas su/ /zla ba gzas ni zin pa'i tshe/ /de yi yan lag mchog tu gzugs / /zin pa de yi py-i stagazugs su 'gyur/ /de yi rus pa rkang dang ni/ /sha la sogs pa bskyed zhu)par bya/ /de yi pags sapa rus pa yi/ /phyag rgyas yan lag brgyan byas la/ /blo dang ldan pas sngar bstan bzhin/ /mchod pa sdo debyas te thal ba gtor4ste/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i chu yis ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni rtag tu bcug /bgegs mthar byed dang gshin gshed kyi/ /sngags ni sngags tsho gepas rtag tu bzla/ /sha za la ni gtor ma sbyin/ /gzhan du na ni bton 30te khyer/ /78—187

sa bon de ni smin par gzung ①/ /lhug ma gsum gyis dkris ②nas su/ /khar bcug na ni sbed 'gyur te/ /nyi ma zla ba sogs pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum 'dir mthong mi 'gyur/ /ma du lung ga gcig pu ni/ /khar bcug nim du lung gar 'gyur/ /bton ④na slar yang snang 'gyur te/ /'bras bskyed ⑤thun mong cho ga'o/ /de nas sngags kyi cho ga bshad/ /spyan ma'i sngags kyis gzugs ⑥par bya / /mā ma tī ⑦yi sngags kyis bcu/ /sgrol ma'i sngags kyis bskyed par bya/ /de bzhin gos dkar mas duni bsrung ⑨/ /'di dag sa la sogs pa ste/ /thams cad 'dzin cing gso ba yin/ /des na 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /spyan la sogs pas bsrung bar bya/ /de nas dgongs 0mo'i dus su ni/ /ku ⑩ba khan de'i sa bon dag /mi yi zhag sogs kyis byugs la/ /bzhi mdo'i sas bkang thod par bskyed/ /de yi dpral 8bar thig le bya/ /bza' 'dang bca' sogs rnam pa lnga/ /mthong ba tsam gyis kha bar 'gyur/ /de nas thig le phyis na ni/ /de yi mod la rnal mar 'gyur/ /'ol ma se yi tsos bon ni/ /bram ze yi ni thod pa ru/ /skar ma rgyal la sngags pas bskyed/ /de nas phyung 8ste slar yang ni/ /tha mal skyes tsobu'i thod par bskyed/ /sa bon de ni grub gyur ⑩na/ /kha ru bcug pas de gzugs 'gyur/ /skyes pa bud med ma ning sogs/ /bya yi 8cho ga bzhin du 'gyur/ /kha las bton yin slar yang ni/ /tha mal gzugs 'gyur the tshom dumed/ /sbyor ba 'di ni grub pa ste/ /gzhan dag tu ni nga mi smra/ /sngags pas bung ba'i rgyal po'i sman/ /gsal shing bsad pa'i thod par bskyed/ /zhag dang khrag gis gtor bar bya/ /de yi rtsa ba blangs nas su/ /srin lag gi ni khrag dang ni/ /zhag tu bcas pa bsre bar bya/ /spyi bor bzhag na rgyal bar 78—188

'gyur / /lha la sogs pa dbang du byed/ /ba glang ①rna ba'i lcug ma ni/ /rnyed nas de yi sa bon ni/ / smin pa ②bzung ste khar ①bcug nas/ /g.yul du zhugs na rgyal bar 'gyur/ /briṅga durā dza bzung ⑤nas su/ /shan ⑥pa'i bu mo sngon mo yi/ /khrag gis ⑦sla ba mar ngo la/ /yang yang byugs te sbyar bar bya/ /ba glang nirna ba'i lcug ⑨dang ni/ /skyes pa'i thod par bskyed dang bcas/ /'bras bu chen po ster bar 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang / /'bras bu tshul bzhin bskyed pa yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad rlag hu )byed par/ /sangs rgyas nges pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ /bsgrub par mi bya ba dang ni/ /'grub par mi 'gyur ci yang med/ /man ngag dag ni ma gtogs par/ /dngos grub snang bar ⑩mi 'gyur ro/ /ko ka na ta'i 'bras bu ni/ /sna chen gyi ni thod par bskyed/ /dur khrod ⑩skyes pa'i briṅga 0ni/ /thod par bskyed pa'i rtsa dang bcas/ /yar ngo mar ngo'i bcu bzhi la/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang lhan cig btags0la/ / ril bu snyimadzes pa byas nas ni/ /grib ma la ni bskam par bya/ /de yis 0thig le byas nas ni/ /'gro kun bran bzhin dbang du 'gyur/ —/am bra'i ⑩shing gi rus pa ni/ /mar khu chen pos byugs nya pa dang / /de bzhin ba yi rnam lngas byug /lag par khu ba byugs yinas su/ /'bras de gang la byin pa ni/ /de dbang 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /bal dz+nya dī po se'u'i 0'bras bu ni/ /khrag ⑤gis byugs te bud med kyi/ /thod par btsugs pa smin pa yi/ /'bras bu de ni mi dbang la/ /rgyal la byin tson rtag dbang 'gyur/ /ku chab khan de'i sa bon ni / /nim pa la sogs 'bras bus byug /ro bsregs tsos dang ldan pa yis/ /chags can 0kham phor sa bon bskyed(nye/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ⑥ste 78—189

bsrung 0)/ /mar ngo yi ni nyi ma la/ /nyin phyed ②nyi ma tsha dus bsgrubazhu/ /de ni blugs pa tsam gyis su/ /chang sogs brlag 'gyur the tshom ④med/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /yungs kur ⑤min pa brgya dang ni/ /rtsa ⑥brgyad blangs nas zhag gis ni/ /bsgos ⑦te legs par thum lapor byadhi/ /bud med ro yi lto bar gzhug⑩ /nyin bdun bzhag ste phyung nas su/ /de yi mchin ⑩par bcas pa'i sas8/ /de yi thod pa bkang bar bskyed/ /gtor ma dang ni srung ⑫ba dang / /bdug pa dang ni chus bcu sogs/ /shin tu 'bad dang bcas pa yis / /las rnams thams cad sngon bzhin bya/ /ji srid smin gyi bar du bskyed/ /de nas sngar bzhin 'bad pas blangasatso/ /bud med kyi ni khrag gis byugaske /'dab ⑩ma dang ni sa bon sogs/ /de yi yan lag ci yang rung / /bud med gang dang gang bsnun pa/ /de ni phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur/ /'ol se'i sa bon 'bad de gzung ⑩/ /dmar ser thod par bskyed par bya/ / de yi 8lcag ma bzung nas su/ /blo dang ldan pas sgo ⑦/nga bya/ / de yi rdu )nang du chang blugs na / /snod der gnas pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /ji srid ma zad bar du ni/ /de na gnas pa'ang zad mi 'gyur/ /chu 'gram sa dang rdza mkhan sa/ /de bzhin thod par 0chags pa'i sa/ /grog mkhar gyi ni sa dag dang / /mtshan ma gcig pa'i sa rnams ni/ /bskyed pa kun la shin tu bsngags ⑫/ /gci ba'i shul gyi sa bzung la/ /sngags kyis mngon par byin gyis brlab/ /bong bu'i gcin dang bcas pa las/ /mkhas pas mi yi gzugs brnyan bya/ /gser shing sngar bzhin sbyang so)byas la/ /sngags pas de yi khar bskyed bya/ /de yi yan lag lnga bzung ste// ril bu shustedag ni mdzes ( gepar bya/ /las rnams thams cad byed 'gyur te/ /78—190

khyad par du ni dbang du byed/ /yungs kur ①la sogs 'bras bu ni/ /glang po che yi sha dang ni②/ /khrag dang rus pa'i zhag la sogs/ /de yi thal ba sogs pas byug /de yi thod par bskyed pa dag /de ni ()kha ru bcug tsam gyis/ /glang po che yi gzugs su 'gyur/ /'di ni thun mong cho ga ste/ /de bzhin rta dang ma ho sogs/ /de bzhin stag dang ri bong sogs/ /cho ga de bzhin bskyed pa yis/ /khrag bcas bsgoms nas ④stag sogs 'gyur/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga'i dus su ni/ /grub pa'i gza' la sogs dang sbyar/ /rtag tu sgom ⑤dang bzlas yil dga'/ /dam tshig spyod pa bsrung (7ba dag /de yis rtag tu po)'grub 'gyur te/ /gzhan du na ni 'bras bu med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las 'bras bu bcos ma'i phyag rgya'i po)ye shes kyi rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //de nas ā li kā li gnyis/ /de nyid las ni kun skyed ⑩cing / /spro zhing sdud par byed pa po7/ /tha snyad kyi ni cho ga ste/ /sngags kyi mtshan nyid thun mong ba/ /cho ga 'di dag ji bzhin nyon/ /a zhes bya ba mdog dmar ba/ /mgo dang thig le spangs pa ni/ /bsgrub bya'i snying ga 32mgo bo dang / /gsang ba dang ni lte bar bsam/ /ā nyurtezhes bya ba 8thig ler ldan/ /mtshal 'idang 'ol ma se dang ni/ /ku su ma ni ⑩lta bu'i nyunyamadog /bsgrub bya'i mgor ni bsam byas la / /myos shing sems dang bral ba dang / /lkugs shing rnam par nyams par bsama'oste / /de yi lus ni rang nyid kyi/ /sa bon gyis dkrugs rmongs bsgoms 78—191

na / /ring por mi thogs dbang 'gyur ①te/ /rtag tu thams cad ster bar 'gyur / /i zhes bya ba skas lta bu/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa'i ②thung ngu ni/ /bsgrub bya'i snying ga du lte ba dang / /de bzhin du ni mgrin par bsgomali/ /khri zhes bya ba'i dbyangs yig bzhi/ /li khri yi ni mdog lta bu/ /bsgrub bya yi ni dpral bar dgod/ /gang gi (gelus la gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa'i mchog ni bkod pa yis/ /myos shing cha lugs nyams pa dang / /sems dang bral bar byas nas su/ /ji srid 'tsho yi ⑥bar du ni/ /lkugs (7pa bzhin du dbang du 'gyur / /de nas dbyangs yig lnga pa ni(nye/ /dbang po'i mtshon cha lta bu'i 'od/ /u ⑨zhes bya ba'i bsgrub bya yi/ /mgrin par zhags pa lta bur bsamacha/ /glog dang mtshungs par 'bar ba yi(nye/ /dbyangs yig mchog ni drug pa ste/ /lca ⑫zhes bya ba bsgrub bya yi/ /snying gi dbus su bsgom (3par bya/ /lkugs shing myos par gyur pa yidang / /lus ni g.yo zhing sems dang bral/ /gang du sgrub pa por gnas par/ /'khrugs pa 8bzhin du ma'ong bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid dang ni ⑪nor dang bcas/ /dbang du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /ṛ tsho/nyezhes bya ba du ba'i mdog /dpral ba hu)lus dang bral ba ste/ /dbyangs yig gi ni dam pa de/ /snying ga nu )dang ni gsang bar bsgomadu rnye/ /de nas rī ni hu mun pa'i mdog /bsgrub bya'i lus kyi mgo bo dang / /de bzhin rkang pa mgrin pa ru/ /ring po de ni bsgom sapar bya/ /bdun pa dang ni brgyad pa 'dis/ /myur du skyod ④par byed pa ste/ /sems ni rmugs shing nyams gyur (minas/ /sa gzhi shustem lus rgyu 'gyur te/ /mthong ba yi ni tshe 'di la/ /slar yang zlog 0par mi 'gyur ro/ /bla (3zhes bya ba srid pa sdom/ /bya rog gi ni gshog zhu )pa 'dra/ /sgrub pos bsgrub ⑥ 78wa 192

bya'i mig dang ni/ /mgrin pa dang ni gsang bar bsgomasti/ /dbyangs yig ring po lī ②zhes pas/ /bsgrub par bya ba dkris par bsam/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la bsgoms tsam gyis/ /snang bar byed pa'i mchog yin te/ /sems can kun gyis smad pa dang / /skye bo kun gyis brnyas pa dang / /mar khu phyung ba'i 'ba' cha bzhin / /skye bo kun gyis spong bar 'gyur/ /cog la ma yi (kyematshal dang ni/ /lham bu chu gsher ④lta bu'i mdog /e zhu)zhes bya ba dbyangs kyi rgyal/ /gsang dang lte ba snying gar yidagod/ /e ⑦zhes bya ba gzi brjid che/ /li khri dang ni nyi ma'i mdog /bsgrub bya'i mig dang de bzhin du/ /kha dang mgrin par bsgom par bya/ /sgrub pa'i mchog gis yid (8)la ni/ /las 'di byas pa tsam gyis su/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /mthe bo'i khyon tsam du ni mthong / /gdong dang gdong ni mngon phyogs te/ /de yi yi ge'i ⑨cha shas kyis0/ /dbugs kyi ri mo lhug mas dgug /cha shas lhug ma'i dam tshig dbang / /a zhes bya ba'i dbyangs yig ni/ /thig le dang ni zla phyed bcas/ /zla ba gnyis ni tsheg drag bcas / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yi ge mchog gi phyag rgya ste/ /sangs rgyas ri 7mor yang dag gnas/ /'di ltar ā li kā ⑩li zhes/ /bcud len thams cad ces byar brjod/ /gtso bo la ni thim byas nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sogs dang sbyar/ /de yi 'og tu phyi minas ni/ /yi ge thams cad gzhug 8par bya/ /ji srid snang ba yod 7kyi bar/ /'dis ni bsrung ba 0byed par brjod/ /thig le zhes bya sems yin te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa yin / /zla ba gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /mi 'gyur mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /de las dbyangs yig rnams kyi ni/ /sgrub po bdag nyid chen po yi/ /las ni lha 78—193

dang lha min dang / /mir bcas myur du dbang du byed/ /oṃ zhes bya ba nyi ma ltar / /'od zer 'bar ba stong dang ldan/ /bsgrub bya yi ni mgo bo dang / /dpral ba khyad par snying gar bsgomatshi/ /oṃ (kyezhes bya ba rtag 'bar ba/ /nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid can/ /bsgrub bya yi ni lus kun la/ /khyab pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /bskal (2)pa yi ni me dpung ltar/ /dbyangs kyis khyab nas bsgom 49pa dang / /dbyangs kyi me yis bsgrub bya yang / /rab tu 'bar bar bsgoms (pebyas nas/ /dgra bo lo brgyar 'tsho ba yang / /de ma thag tu ltung bar 'gyur / /a ni thams cad sdud pa ste/ /'tshe ba zlog ⑥par byed pa'ang yin/ /ā (7)ni gshegs su gsol ba ste/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin lha yang byed/ /bud med kun gyi mngal du ni/ /bsam dun khu ba 'dzag par 'gyur/ /khyad par du ni gzhan dag la'ang yod/ /dkar po dmar po'i ting 'dzin bya/ /a la sogs dang yi ge rnams/ /lus la bkod na dpyad 57mi dgos/ /de ltar dbyangs kyi las rnams ni/ /khyod la bdag gis gang bstan la/ /dbyangs yig dge ba bcu drug ni/ /lus la go char bkod (/nyade bya/ /ā /rtezhes bya ba rkang gnyis dgod / /a 3)ni byin pa gnyis la bsam/ /khri ④ni brla 8la dgod bya ste/ /i tshezhes bya ba gsang bar gnas/ /u ni lte ba'i rtsa ba ste/ /u zhes bya ba lte ba'i dbus / / ṛ ni 3 lte ba'i steng 'o )du dgod/ /rī /tshostezhes bya ba snying gar 3 )yin/ /lo rdo hozhes bya ba mgrin par dgod/ /de bzhin lī du nyeni rkan sogela'o/ /e zhes bya ba kha la ste/ /de bzhin e snye ni sna la'o/ /o ni rna ba dag la ste/ /au zhes bya ba 2gedapral bar ro/ /i ni mgo la dgod byas te(9/ /aḥzhes bya ba rgyab ( nyetu dgod / /dbang dang dgug la dmar por rdo rtete/ /gsang rdo ri)la thams cad sngon 78wa 194

por ro/ /du ba lta bur bsams na 0)ni/ /bskrad pa nyid 'gyur the tshom (gyimed/ /dbyangs yig kun gyis byin brlabs na)'di/ /bdag gi de nyid gsal ba yin/ /sgrub po bdag nyid dam pa yis/ /de ltar go cha bgos nas ni/ /sgrub pos dbyangs dang yi ge yi/ /phyi nas las rnams shin tu sbyar/ /de nas rig pa'i de nyid 'byung / /las ④rnams rtag (getu byas pa ste/ /ka nas ma yi mthar thug pa'i / /las ni blo gros chen pos nyon/ /lha dang lha min mi dang bcas/ /gang gis sa gsum thams cad ni/ /sgrub po shin tu rgyas pa yi/ /dbang du de dag thams cad 'gyur/ /yid la 'dod pa'i 'bras ster ba/ /de ni nga yis bshad par bya/ /dbyangs yig bcu drug po rnams kyi/ /mdzes ma khyod la sngar 6bshad nas / /da ni ka sogs yi ge yi/ /las rnams 'dod bzhin byed pa bshad/ /lha mo yi ge dang po ni/ /nyi ma'i gzi brjid dang mtshungs shing / /li khri spungs pa lta bu yi/ /thig ler ldan pa'i yi ge che/ /sgrub 7༄pos bsgrub na bya'i snying ga tsho'osadang ske/ /lte ba dang ni mgo bor bsgom(7/ /de yis bsgrub bya'i nyaḥlus kyi rtso ni/ /nang du phug ste khyab par bsam/ /de yis lus ni 'khrugs nyurinas su/ /rmongs shing sems dang bral ba dang / /brgyal bzhin du ni dbang du 'gyur/ /ji srid lus la gnas kyi bar/ /de srid dbang du 'gyur ba ste/ /ji 1 srid 'tsho yi bar du ni/ /bdag nyid nor dang bcas 'gyur la/ /kha zhes bya ba'ang bobartson chen mal/ /lham bu chu gsher lta bu dang / /nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog /thig ler bcas pa gzi brjid che/ /gsal zhing 'od dang bcas pa ste/ /bsgrub bya yi ni snying ga yidang / /mgo dang rkang pa kun tu dgod/ /de yis bsgrub bya phug nas ni / /rmongs shing sems dang bral bar bsam/ /sgrub pa po yi mchog gis ni/ /78wa 195

de yi lus ni dkrugs pa dang / /myos shing brgyal bar bsgom par bya/ /de yis shin tu rgyal ①'gyur zhing / /yi ge'i dbang pos che ②bas na/ /sgrub po ③bdag nyid chen po yi/ /ji srid 'tsho ④yi bar du ni/ /nor dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur / /ga zhes bya ba'i sa bon che/ /rang gi lha yi sdom ⑤pa ste/ /tsheg drag bcas pa gzi brjid yiche/ /gtso bo char sprin lta bu'i mdog /bsgrub bya'i ⑦mgo dang mgrin pa dang / /khyad par du ni snying gar ⑧bsam/ /de yis bsgrub par bya ba'i lus/ /yi ges kun tu phug bsam stin/ /lus ni rtag tu dkrugs pas na/ /'dar zhing de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /bdag nyid dang ni nor dang bcasal/ /sdang ba'i dgra rnams ma lus pa/ /khyim la sogs pa kun tu ni/ /ji srid nyi zla yod kyi bar/ /ma lus par ni 'joms par byed/ /gha zhes bya ba sgyu ma che/ /bskal pa'i me dang gzi brjid mtshungs/ /steng du thig les brgyan pa ste / /ku su ma yi khu ba 'dra/ /bsgrub bya yi ni lte ba dang / /gsang ba snying ga ⑩kha dang ni/ /mgo ⑩bo ru ni bsams 8tsam gyis/ /bsgrub bya dga' bas myos nas su/ /sems dang bral zhing nyams nas ni/ /ji srid 'tsho 'o)yi bar du ni/ /bdag nyid nor dang bcas pa ru/ /shin tu de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /nga zhes bya ba gzi brjid che/ /sde tshan gyi ni mtha' mar gnas/ /de ni 'dod pa'i mda' yin te/ /'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed/ /de ni bsgrub bya'i gsang bar bsam/ /khu ba dag ni 'dzag par byed/ /gsang ba ru ni zhugs pa yis / /thams cad du ni 'bigs par 'gyur/ /yan lag gi ni tshigs kun tu/ /de yis 8phug pas myos nas ni/ /nor dang bdag nyid bcas pa ni/ /myur ba nyid du dbang du 'gyur/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ni/ /de la chags dang bral 78—196

mi 'gyur/ /yi ge lnga po kun gyis kyang / /bdag nyid go cha bskon par bya/ /ka zhes bya ba snying gar ①dgod/ /kha zhes bya ba mgo la ste/ /ga zhes bya ba spyi gtsug tu/ /gha zhes bya ba go char bya/ /nga zhes bya ba sgrub pa lapo'i/ /lag pa g.yon la dgod par bya/ /de nas bsgrub bya dbang dang ni/ /dgug dang gsad ②la sogs par sbyar/ /cho ga de ltar byas na ni/ /dpyad mi dgos par dngos grub 'gyur/ /tsa ④zhes bya ba du ba'i mdog /rlung gi gnas kyi yi ge ste/ /sgrub pos de yi snying ga chadang / /mgo dang rkang par bsam 6)par bya/ /bsgrub bya rlung la gnas nas ni/ /kun tu 'pho ⑦bar bsam pa dang / /sems dang bral bar gyur nas su/ /nam mkha' la ni gnas bzhin du/ /rlung gis gzhan dang gzhan dag tu/ /khyer ba ru ni bsgom 78)par bya/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /bsgrub bya shin tu brtan pa yang ⑨/ /bskrad 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom 0med/ /bsgrub bya'i lus ni 'phangs pas na/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar 0du ni / /slar yang 'ong 8bar mi 'gyur ro/ /tsha zhes bya ba'i yi ge che/ /gsal zhing 0mig sman nag po'i mdog /cha gnyis pa dang yang dag ldan/ /bsgrub bya yi ni mgo bor bsam/ /de yi mgo la du ba yi/ /tshogs dang mtshungs pa'i rlung gis khyab/ /cung zad tsam gyis bsgrub bya yi/ /lus ni de yis bskor dū gyibar bsam / /slar yang tsha ni tsheg 8drag bcas/ /lte ba ru ni bsams tshenas su/ /lan gsum du ni brjod byas na/ /yi ge 'di ni bskrad pa'i mchog /bsgrub bya rmongs shing sems dang bral/ /dgra bo mdangs ni nyams nas su/ /sa stengs ⑩ma lus pa ru 'khyamatha/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ni/ /slar yang ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /dza zhes bya ba'i 7yi ge rgyal/ /du ba'i mdog can gzi brjid che/ /78—197

'od zer ldan zhing shin tu 'bar/ /rdul phran dag ni stong du 'phro/ /bsgrub bya yi ni mgo bo dang / /gsang bar yi ge zhugs par bsgomacha/ /yan lag tshigs kun phug pa dang / /sems dang bral ba bzhin du gnas/ /yi ges (geyongs su bkang bas na/ /de nas brgyal (5)bar gyur nas ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du rmongs pa dang / /mi sad par ni bsgom ④par bya/ /sa stengs ⑧shing dang nags tshal ⑥bcas / /thams cad du ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bskrad pa'i cho ga 'di dag ni/ /dge ma khyod la nga yis bshad/ /ji srid 'tsho yi (7)bar du ni/ /slar yang 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dzha (8)zhes bya ba stobs po che/ /bsgrub bya yi ni snying ga 6nyeru/ /nyi ma lta bur 'bar ba dang / /'od zer gsal ba rnam par 'phro/ /thig le zla ba phyed pas brgyan/ /bsgrub bya'i mgo dang snying ga 57dang / /lte ba'i steng du yi ge bsam/ /sgrub pa'i dbang pos bsgrub bya'i lus/ /'bar bas bcud dang phral bar bsam/ /de yis bsgrub bya brgyal hunye'agyur zhing / / bskrad pa 'am tsoni 'chi ba rmoge'am/ /yang na smyon pa nyid du 'gyur/ /yi ge yis ni ltung bas na/ /slar yang kyi 'ong bar mi 'gyur te/ /sa gzhi nags tshal bcas pa ru/ /smyo zhing 'gro 'gyur the tshom 1gemed/ /dzha 17zhes bya ba 'di yis ni/ /myur du bskrad 'gyur the tshom med/ /nya zhes bya ba'i yi ge mchog /sna tshogs pa yi mdog dang ldan/ /pa la sha yi me tog gi/ /'od zer stong phrag 'bar ba ste/ /chu rgyun stong ni 'bab pa yis/ /de yi 3 1lus la dbo bar bya/ /de yis nor dang bcas pa ru/ /brgyal zhing sems dang bral ba dang / /rmongs shing myur lho du dbang du 'gyur/ /ṭa ho/zhes bya ba'i yi ge mchog /dbang po'i mtshon cha lta bu'i mdogaso ) /'od zer 'bar ba stong phrag gis/ /yi ge 'bar dang ldan par bsam/ /bsgrub (nyabya 78wa 198

yi ni dpral ba dang / /mgrin pa dang ni snying gar 51)bsam/ /bsgrub kun)bya'i steng du nam mkha' la/ /bdud rtsi sgo yi thig le ni/ /spyi bo'i steng du rtag tu bsam/ /cung zad glog ni g.yo 'dra ba'i/ /kha ba dag ni 'bab par bsam/ /sgrub (kyepa po yis bsgrub bya ni/ /yan lag tshigs kun g.yo ba dang / /brgyal zhing rmongs la myos bsams na/ /ji srid nyi zla yod bar duri na/ /nor dang bdag nyid bcas pa ru/ /de yis thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /de ltar ṭa yi rgyal po yi/ /las ni khyod la nga yis bshad/ /(lde de nas yi ge tshoneraganyis pa yi/ /las kyi mchog ni bshad par bya/ /ṭha tso)zhes bya ba'i yi ge ni/ /dbang chen dang ni 'dra bar 'dod / /spyi bor bdud rtsi theg 8)les brgyan/ /de bzhin glog dang 'brug gis brgyan / /yi ge'i mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /bdud rtsi chu rgyun 'bab pa yis/ /bsgrub bya'i 9)lus la kun tu gtor/ /bsgrub bya'i mgo dang mgrin pa dang / /snying ga 7ru ni gnas par bsam/ /bsgrub bya'i mgo ni phug pa dang / /lus la kun tu khyab pa yis/ /bsgrub bya myos shing 'dar ba ru/ /sngags pas yi gis rtag 7tu bsgomanyurte/ /de nas ji srid 'tsho bar du/ /brgyal 12zhing rmongs pas dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas ḍa zhes bya ba ni/ /yi ge'i rgyal po gsum rnyipa ste/ / de yi chalas kyi mchog rnams ni/ /rtse gcig yid kyis gus pas nyon/ /ḍa zhes bya ba thig ler bcas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i 10dbyibs can yin/ /ut+pa la ltar ljang ser te/ /'od zer gsal ba kun tu 'phrortsi / /bsgrub bya'i spyi bor bsam 32pa yis / /bsgrub bya'i tshigs ni 'bugs shing 'byed/ /bsgrub 3)bya mig yor bsgom 3byas na spe/ /lus ni kun tu g.yo bzhin du/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ni//rmongs dang bcas pas shu ri dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas las kyi mchog gzhan ni/ /78wa 199

shin tu gnyer bar byed pa ste/ /rto zhes bya ba yi ge'i ①rgyal/ /shin tu rmad ②byung ①byed pa po/ /dbang po'i mtshon cha lta bu'i mdog /nyi ma lta bur 'bar ba ste/ /bsgrub bya'i snying dang lte ba dang / /mgrin par yi ge bsams ④nas su//byang chub sems ni rab (snye'adzag pas/ /de yi lus la dbo bar bya/ /de yis bzi (5)zhing brgyal nas su/ /gnyid log par ni bsgom ④byas na/ /'di yis ring por mi thogs par/ /rmongs shing sgrub po'i ⑧dbang du 'gyur/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /nam yang chags dang bral ①mi 'gyur/ /de nas nye mtha' 7yi ge'i 7las/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'bad de ⑩nyon/ /ṇa zhes bya ba du ba'i mdog /cung zad 'bar zhing gsal ba ste/ /dri ma med pa'i du ba las//'od zer gsal ba rnam par 'phro/ /bsgrub bya yi ni lus kun la/ /de yis rnam par khyab byed cing / /'od zer glog stong 'khyug 'dra ba/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i steng du bsgoma'oste/ /'od zer brgya yis bkang bas na/ /myos nas su ni brgyal bar 'gyur/ /de yis ji srid 'tsho bar du/ /de ni de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /ta zhes bya ba'i ④yi ge tshemachog /'od zer glog ltar gsal ba ste/ /mdog ni rma bya'i mgrin pa 'dra/ /yi ge 'di ni bsgrub bya yi/ /snying dang mgrin ⑩pa gsang ba dang / /lte bar bkod de 'bugs par bsam/ /yi ge de yis rmongs pas na / /bsgrub bya sems dang bral ba dang / /rmongs shing brgyal bar gyur nas su//ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ni/ /myos shing dbang 'gyur gzhan du min/ / de yi ⑩drung na gnas pa yi/ /tha zhes bya ba yi ge mchog /mu men na)gyi ni mdog 'dra dang ske/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 4)ma'i 'od/ /bsgrub bya'i snying ga ⑥ dpral ba dang ske/ /de bzhin du ni rkang par dgod/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la dbang po 0yi/ /78—200

mtshon cha bzhin du thim par bsam/ /yi ge'i rgyal pos mnan ①pas na(mi/ /bsgrub bya sems dang bral 'gyur zhing / /sa 'dzin gyi ni dbang po bzhin/ /'gro ba dag kyang bcings par 'gyur/ /reg bya mi shes dri mi shes/ /sgra mi thos (kyeshing gzugs mi mthong / /lce yis ro rnams mi myong zhing / /dug gis brgyal ba bzhin du gnas/ /gang dang gang gi steng du ni/ /nyi 'od lta bu'i yi ge bsam/ /yi ge'i rgyal po tha yis ni/ /skyes bu bcings 'gyur the tshom ④med/ /de nas gzhan yang da yi 0ni/ /stong pa'i (6)las kyi cho ga nyon/ /da 4)zhes bya ba mdog sngon ni/ /char sprin nag po'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /'od zer 'bar ba rnam 'phro dub/ /bsgrub bya yi ni mgor bsam (pel/ /me stag 'phro ba bsgoms pa ni/ /phyogs kun tu ni bsam ⑩par bya/ /yi ge'i dbang phyug de yis ni/ /bsgrub bya'i mgo bo phug par bsam/ /'bar ba'i sprin ni stong phrag gis/ /de ni kun tu bskor bar bsam/ /de ni bkod pa tsam gyis su/ /sdong gog lhonyadang ni mtshungs par 'gyur/ / phug ste 8shin tu bcings hu pas na/ /'gro ba'ang mi g.yo bar ni 'gyur/ /ji srid sgrub po 'dod bar du/ /sems dang bral zhing brtan par gnas/ /slar yang sgrub (7pos bsams 8tsam gyis/ /rmongs pa las ni grol bar 'gyur/ /de nas yi ge dha yi ni8/ /las ni rmad du gyur pa nyon/ /dha zhes bya ba gzhu yi dbyibs/ /kha dog ser po gser gyi mdog /gser lta bu yi 'od zer 'phra0/ /bsgrub bya yi ni mgrin pa ru/ /zhags 'osnyepa lta bur 'bar bar bsam/ /sgrub yipa'i dbang pos bsgrub bya de'i )/ /khrid de 'ong bar bsgom ( nyabyas na/ /sgrub pa po ni gar gnas par/ /rmongs dang sogebacas te 'ong bar 'gyur/ /ji srid 'tsho yi so)bar du ni/ /phyugs de sems dang bral 'gyur zhing / /78—201

nyi ma brgyad pa'i cha la ni/ /rang gi gnas nas yo)'ong bar 'gyur/ /de nas yi ge na yi ni/ /las kyi cho ga'i sgrub pa nyon/ /mdog ni du ba'i phung po 'dra/ /rlung gi medakyil 'khor 'khrugs sadang ldan/ /bsgrub bya'i snying ga ④mgrin pa dang ske/ /lte ba dang ni rkang par sbyar/ /de yis dgra rnams rang yul nas⑤/ /bskrad 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom (yemed/ /de ni rmongs pas rang yul du/ /nam yang phyis ni 'ong mi 'gyur/ /de nas sde tshan lalnga pa ni/ /yi ge rnams kyi dbang phyug mchog /las ni shin tu grub (kyepa ste/ /gzhan dang gzhan ni bshad par bya / /pa zhes bya ba rlung gi gnas/ /char sprin gyi ni sprin gyis bskor⑨/ /'bar zhing du bas 'khrigs par ldan/ /bsgrub bya yi ni mgo bo dang / /mgrin pa snying ga hu byerked pa dang / /rkang pa dag tu bsams 67nas ni/ /pa zhes bya ba'i ⑫yi ge des/ /bsgrub bya'i lus ni dkri 0debar bya/ /bsgrub par bya ba nga rgyal dang ske/ /khro bas brtan gnas gtso bo yang / /yi ge gtso bo bkod pa yis/ /skad cig gis ni bskrad 'gyur te/ /gal te tshe rabs gzhan dag skola'ang / /slar 8zhing ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas yi ge pha yi ni/ /las mchog nga yis bshad kyis (8nyon/ /yi ge pad+ma'i mdog 'dra zhing / /'bar ba bsgrub bya'i spyi bo dang / /mgrin pa snying ga nya 7lto ba dang / /gsang ba'i gnas su bkod nas ni / /ku su ma yi khu 'dra ba/ /'dzag pa ru ni rnam bsams tetshe/ /bsgrub bya'i lus ni phyi phorkyenang du/ /de yis gang bar bsgom ldu )byas na/ /bsgrub bya rmongs shing brgyal 'gyur la/ /sems med lus ni 'dar gyur nas/ /rmongs pas sgrub pa po yi ni/ /dbang du 'gyur te dpyad mi dgos/ /ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal po ni/ /gru bzhi pa la stobs po che/ /dung dang zla 'dra dkar po'i py-i homadog /zla ba'i 78wa 202

'od can bsgrub bya ni/ /dbus su sgrub pos thim par bsam/ /de lus dug gis mi tshugs shing / /nad la sogs pas gzir mi 'gyur/ /rims (1)dang bkres dang skom ②mi 'byung / /'di ni rtag tu bsgoms gyur na/ /tshe ring nad med rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /zla ba dmar dang bcas pa ru/ /lhan cig (btu ni bzlas gyur na/ /rtag tu bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'drar 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po bha zhes pa'i/ /las kyi mchog ni mnyan par gyisal/ /dbang po'i mtshon cha lta bu ste/ /nyi ma 'char kha (pelta bu'i mdog /bsgrub bya yi ni mgo bo ru/ /rgyal ba'i mchog ni rtag bsams tshonasal/ /de yi lus ni ma lus par/ /yi ge'i rgyal pos dbug par bya/ /rmongs shing sems dang bral 'gyur te/ /rdo rje yin yang brgyal gyur nas/ /mche (6)bas zin ltar skad cig la/ /ltung zhing 'chi ba nyid gyur pas/ /de yi srog ni rmongs par 'gyur/ /dgra ni lo brgyar 'tsho ba ②yang / /skad cig gis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de nas gzi brjid chen po yi/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa 98)lnga pa(9ci/ /ma zhes bya ba dam pa tshemachog /de yi ⑩las ni ji bzhin nyon/ /tsam pa ka ltar ser ba'i (semadog /bskal 0pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /'od ni glog stong be'akhyug pa bzhin/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i steng bsams nyagel/ / de yi sko'od kyis bsgrub bya yi/ /steng dang 'og ni ma lus par/ /lus ni kun tu g.yogs bsams rke tshon/ /gnod sbyin lha dang klu yi bu/ /sha za dang ni srin po dang / /khams gsum yi ge'i bdag po dang / /lha dang lha min mi dang bcas/ /sgrub po bdag nyid chen po yi / /skad cig gis ni dbang 'gyur bar/ /mdor bsdus ngas ni khyod la bshad / /ya zhes bya ba 'o yi ge mchog /mun pa dang ni du ba'i mdog /rlung gi 78wa 203

dkyil 'khor dbus gnas shing / /rlung gi gzugs can yi ge che/ /rlung bdun gyi ni gtso bo dang / /gnas zhes bya bar brjod pa ste/ /zla phyed ①kyi ni dbyibs can la/ /ba dan brgya yis rnam par bklubs②/ /rnam pa bzhi yi rten gyur pa/ /phyi rol gos ltar dkris pa ste/ /ra zhes bya ba ②yi ge mchog /'bar ba bye ba stong dang ldan/ /de yi steng du bsam par bya/ /du ba yi ni phreng bas brgyan④/ /bsgrub bya'i mgo bor bsgoms nas ni/ /dgra bo lo brgya ⑤'tsho ba yang / /sbrul gyi mche ⑥bas zin pa ltar/ /skad cig tsam gyis srog dang ni/ /bral zhing 'chi ba'i sgor gzhol 'gyur/ /lha sogs ④thams cad gang rung gi/ /steng du yi ge 'di sbyar na/ /myur du ltung 'gyur dpyad mi dgos/ /gdon dang rims rnams thams cad ni/ /de la 'bab par 'gyur ba dang / /sbrul chen brgya yi mche (0ba 'bab/ /de yis myur du 'chi 'gyur na/ /gnod pa gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /ya zhes pa dang ra zhes pa/ /rlung dang me yi gzugs can du/ /nam mkha'i phyogs su bsams khanas ni/ /nam mkha'i ngos ni g.yogs bsams ⑩na / /nyi zla gza' skar sogs pa'ang tsorung / /chu bo dang ni rgya mtsho yi/ /dbus su yi ge gnyis po dag /bsams tsonas nyi ma brgyad pa la/ /rgya mtsho la sogs thams cad skam/ /zhing sa 'bru yi phung po dang / /khyim la sogs pa'i gnas bsams natso/ /phyi rol me lce 'bar ba yis/ /thams cad yi ge thal bar byed/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas ④te/ /rlung gis kun tu bskor bar 8ni/ /yi ge mchog ni gnyis bsams ⑩na/ /las ni kun tu nye bar gnas / /de nas gzhan yang yi ge gnyis/ /stobs chen ldan pa bshad par bya/ /dbang chen dang ni de bzhin chu/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa po/ /la zhes 78—204

bya ba sa yin te/ /sa zhes bya ba 'dzin pa'i mchog /dbang po rdo rjes tshimatshan pa dang / /'od zer glog ltar 'bar ba ste/ /kha dog lnga dang ldan pa ru/ /yi ge'i dbang po sa la bsgomadu/ /de steng chu yi yi ge ni/ /bzhi pa legs par gnas pa ste/ /dung dang zla 'dra dkar po'i mdog /kha ba'i rgyun ni 'bab pa ste / / la yi ①steng du bkod nas su/ /shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsi 'dzag /dbang chen gyis ni bskor ba yi/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /spyi bor thig le dang ni ldan/ /char pa'i rgyun ni stong phrag 'bebs/ /steng du sprin gyi phung po ni/ /glog ④dang 'brug la sogs pas brgyan/ /bdud rtsi char gyi rgyun 'bebs pa/ /nam mkha' thams cad khyab pa ru/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi dbus 'gyur ba/ /gang ⑤gi mgo yi steng bsgoms na(ye/ /sgrub po bdag nyid chen po yi/ /las ni ji ltar 'dod bzhin byed/ /gdengs ka gsum gyis mdzes pa yi/ /lhag ma can ni zhi gzugs bsam/ /de yi mig gnyis dbang po yi / /mtshon chas brgyan pa'i dbus su ni/ /bdud rtsi 'bebs pa'i i yig dgod / /grong khyer gyi ni mtha' ma dang (7)/ /bsgrub bya yi ni steng du dbab/ /dug dang gdon dang rims la sogs/ /skad cig gis ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /da ⑧ni skra dkar gzhom pa yi/ /cho ga 'o/bshad kyis mnyan hu )par gyis/ /dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur yi ge ni/ /de ltar rtag tu bsams nyunyegyur na/ /tshe thung ba yang ring 'gyur na/ /skra dkar la sogs smos ci dgos/ /bud med dbang phyug rnams la ni/ /'bad pas yang yang chagayon bskor zhing / /rang gi spyi bo'i steng du ni/ / lo gcig 'ogebar du bsgom 7byas nas/ /rga ba dang ni 'chi ba 'joms / /nad kyis gdung /tsho nyabar mi 'gyur te/ /gal te klu chen brgyad kyi ni/ /78—205

mche ba'i dug gis zin gyur kyang / /dug ni dug med byas nas su/ /dug gis brgyal ba slong bar mdzad51)/ /'gron (0po lam gyis dub pa dang / /gdon la sogs pas gzir ①ba rnams/ /kun las thar bar 'gyur ba yin/ /bdag gi spyi bor bsams ④tsam gyis/ /skad cig gis ni bkres (geskom 'joms/ /nad rnams kun gyis gdungs pa la/ /yi ge bkod pas grol bar 'gyur/ /de ltar las rnams sna tshogs ni/ /lha mo khyod la bshad pa yin/ /gtso mo bzhi yi rnam pa bzhi/ /las kyi cho ga rgyas pa ste/ /rlung dang me dang bdud rtsi bcud/ /de bzhin drod kyi sde pa ste/ /gshin rje brtan ma (7phyag gnyis pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs ska/ /lus ni me (8)las byung ba ru/ /bskal pa'i me lce lta bur bsam/ /'og dang steng du wa yis brgyan/ /de yi phyogs kun thams cad du/ /'bar ba 9༄gang gi snying gar tshebasam/ /'od zer 'bar ba rnam par 'phro / /wa dang ldan pa'i yi ge che/ /nam mkha' khyab pas bcings /nya'agyur te/ /brtan ma yi ni 'khrul 'khor gyi lhan/ /yi ge'i rgyal pos bcings pas na/ /sa 'dzin lta bur brtan par 'gyur/ /rkang med dang ni rkang gnyis dang / /rkang bzhi la sogs sems can gyi lha/ /lte ba ru ni bsgom 8byas na/ /de ma thag tu 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de yang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'bar ba 'phro ba yi / /wa ni steng du bsgom mapar bya/ /slar yang me yis 'bar bsam tson/ /gang gi lag pa g.yon pa la/ /yi ge de ni dgod par bsam/ /ji srid lag tu bsam 7gyi bar/ /sa steng gi ni skye bo rnams/ /rang gi gnas ni de nyid nas//'bebs shing 'gugs par byed pa'i mchog /'di ni gshin rje brtan ma la/ /mos pa'i las rnams bshad pa yin/ /dbang po thams cad 'bebs pa yi/ /78—206

gshin rje'i 0)pho nya'i las bshad bya/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab (kye'adra ba/ /mgo dang thig le spangs pa ni/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab ②lta bu/ /gang gi lce dang rkan bsams ④na/ /skal ba bzang po 'joms par 'gyur/ /snying dang kha dang sna dang ni/ /mig dang rna bar de bzhin du/ /yi ge dbu ma bkod na ni/ /dbang po thams cad 'phrog 'gyur te/ /gzugs mi mthong zhing sgra mi thos/ /dri mi tshor zhing stobs mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin lce yis ro mi myong / /dug gis brgyal ba bzhin du gnas/ /las rnams de dag thams cad la/ /yid kyis bzlog na grol bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje mche ba du ba'i mdog /sreg pa'i bskal pa lta bu ste/ /thams cad khyab ④par 'khyams 'gyur ba/ /sna tshogs 'od can bsgom par bya/ /drod kyi sde pa'i yi ge sa/ /du ba dang ni rlung gi mdog /snying dang lag pa rkang par dgod/ /khams gsum yang ni bskrad 'gyur na/ /sa steng 0skye bo smos ci dgos(pe/ /thig ler bcas shing ha dang ni/ /bcas pa gang gi (0lce steng du/ /bsams stin phur bu lta bur 'gyur/ /yi ge dge ba de nyid ni//rtag tu lce steng bsams bon ni/ /lan cig bzlas pas zin 'gyur te/ /de ni snyan dngags rtsonyamakhan por 'gyur/ /de ltar sa dang sa rtsonamatha' yi/ /yi ge'i cho ga bshad pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum po 'joms byed ma/ /'od zer dmar po gzi brjid che/ /nyi ma bye ba lta bu'i 'od/ /cung zad sngo ba 'jigs chen mo/ /ma te dang ni rta dag nihurte/ /'khrul ༅'khor sbyor ba kun la bsam/ /de yis yi ge'i rgyal po ni/ /gzi brjid chen po'i 8yi ge ha/ /de yi las ni sna tshogs mchog /'dod pa'i las ni bshad par bya/ /de ltar bdag lus rtag tu ni/ /yi ge lngar ⑩ni bsam hunyebyas na/ /'gro ba rnams kyi bya ba ni/ /tshig gis thams 78—207

cad byed par 'gyur/ /sa steng 7lha dang lha min dang / /mi dang bcas pa 'bebs byed cing / /sgrub pa po ni dus min par/ /'chi ba dag ni 'joms par byed/ /sgrub po yid la 'dod bzhin du/ /nad rnams thams cad gnon par byed/ /ngag tsam gyis ni dpung tshogs dang / /chu dang rgya mtsho 'ching ②ba dang ske/ /gru dang khyogs dang 'khrul (kye'akhor dang / /rta dang glang po la sogs 'ching ske/ /shing chen sa la sgyel ba dang / /sems can rnams ni dbang du byed/ /las kyi cho ga mthong (deb yis/ /bya ba rnams ni 'dod bzhin byed/ /ha zhes bya ba'i yi ge mchog /mgo dang bral zhing thig les brgyan/ / de yi (snyelas rnams ma lus pa(be/ /phan pa bshad kyis (pemanyan par gyis/ /khyab bya khyab byed stong pa ste / /kun tu 'gro ba mi shigs pa/ /shin tu stong dang stong pa steme/ /de ni sems med gnyid log pa/ /sad pa dang ni bral ba ste/ /de ni ci ⑨yang snang mi 'gyur / /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin min/ /mi 'am ci dang dri za min/ /klu rnams dang ni srin po dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rab min/ /chu bo'i shing dang nags tshal dang / /de bzhin sa sogs ma yin te/ /'jigs rung dmyal ba la sogs min/ /me dang du ba tshesogs min zhing / /nyi ma zla ba gza' skar min7//mi dang sha za tsol sogs mamin/ /mngal skyes dang ni drod las skyes/ /sgo nga dang ni rlan skyes min/ /thang la gnas dang chu gnas min/ /pad+ma las ni skyes pa dang / /dbang po khyab 'jug bde byed min/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun sogs / /'byung ba'i 'tshogs la 8sogs min te/ /ha zhes bya ba 0yi ge mchog /rtag tu bsams hunyen dmigs mi 'gyur/ /lo gcig bar du bsgoms 'gyur na/ /rga dang nad kun 'joms 'gyur te/ /de la dug kyang mi 'pho yon/ /nad kyi 78—208

'jigs pa ga la zhig /dug ni khur bu brgya zos kyang / /de ni 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu stong nyid bsgoms na ni/ /de ni thar 'gyur the tshom ①med//mgo dang bral ba'i ②yi ge k+ṣa/ /de nyid mchog tu thim dunas su/ /bsgoms na skad cig mngon shes skye/ /thig ler ldan pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkan dang sna sgo'i lam du ni/ /ri mo dag ni zhugs pa bsam/ /ri mo mar me'i rtse lta bu/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi yi ④gzi can bsam/ /rtag tu rkan ni phug ste gnas/ /rtag tu sbyor bar gnas pa yis/ /nyi ⑤ma bdun na 4)mthong 'gyur te/ /'di dang mtshungs pa yod ma yin/ /bram ze gsod pa'ang nyin bdun gyis(7/ /rtse mo rgyas par mthong 'gyur te/ /de ltar mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan gyi grong sogs 'dod bzhin 'gro/ /k+ṣa yi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi/ /las ni bsam gyis mi khyab gnas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das dngos grub/ /brtul zhugs ma ni khyod la bshad/ /re re yi ni las rnams kyang / /bstan pa ru ni nus ma yin/ /skye bo rang don byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yin/ /yi ge sde tshan so so yi/ /yi ge dag ni so so zhing / /re re'ang sbyor ba bzhi bzhi ste / /gcig kyang bzhi ru sbyor ba bzhin/ /ā li kā sa)li'i phyag rgya che/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster (7ba/ /shes rab thabs ni ma gtogs par/ /go 'phang mchog ni 'thob ⑩mi 'gyur/ /sgyu ma che dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las / ā li kā hu)li'i sngags kyi sgrub thabs 'byung ba'i cho ga'i 8rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //78—209

de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo rnams kyis mchod cing phyag 'tshal te/slar gsol pa/ khyod kyis (1 sngar bshad gsang ba dang / /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /yi ge bcu drug rig pa che/ /bde mchog bla mar bshad pa dang / /khams rnams dang ni de bzhin rtsa/ /'byung gnas sgra tshul nges 'byung dang / /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba/ /thog ma dbus mthar na dbye ba dag /ji ltar nang du yang dag gnas/ /de rnams dbye ba de bzhin gsungs / /bka' stsal pa/ sgyu ma kun gyi /rnam rol pa'i/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che/ /sangs rgyas kun la'ang gsang ba ste/ /gzhan rnams la lta smos ci dgos / /sgyu ma chen po bcu drug ni/ /ma mo nyid du rab tu bshad/ /de yis nang gi dkyil 'khor du/ /gyur pa nyid du the tshom ri med/ /rnal 'byor pa yi bdud rtsi sbyor/ /bcu drug char yang mi pod do/ /slar yang bdud rtsi rdzas rnams ni/ /da ni bshad kyis ldemanyan par gyis/ /ra ni dmar chen po yi khams / /ha zhes bya ba ri las skyes/ /se ni gan da pa tra ste/ /pa ni pags snyupar bstan pa yin/ /ra zhes bya ba dri ru gsungs/ /me zhes bya ba me tog ste/ /de bzhin ra 7ni chu yin no/ /me zhes bya ba pi si ta/ /sa ni kun du ru nyid yin / /ra 8ni sa ri zhes bya ste/ /ātra 94zhes bya na la dza47/ /ni zhes bya ba dri yi mar/ /sa ni so dang lag skyes yin/ /dā /lhani rgya mtsho las byung ba/ /sbri ni kha ba'i snying po yin/ /ta zhes bya ba ga bur te/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi / /rtag tu ye shes dam pa mchog /rtsa rnams thams cad yang dag 'dus/ /de dag lha mo khyod la bstan/ /gsang sogs rnal 'byor pa yi rdzas/ /bshang 78—210

dang gci 1)sogs lnga la bya/ /khams rnams bsdus (2)pa'i sde tshan ni/ /de ltar bcud len bstan pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro kun dngos chags pa yi/ /sems dpa' rdo rje las byung ba/ /pad+ma 'byed pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /pad+ma gar dbang zhes bya ste/ /steng du gsal bar 'phro bas na/ /rdo rje nyi ma zhes bya la/ /'di ni gsal zhing 'bar bas na/ /rnam snang mdzad chen thub pa'ang yin/ /rlung ni sna tshogs las byung ba/ /khyad par spyod pas rta mchog yin/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /phan tshun gnyis med rang bzhin no/ /gnas der nyi ma nub pa yi/ /sprul pa'i sku yi gzugs kyi bdag /lha dang mi yi bde ba ni/ /bsdus byas rnyog pa med pa ste/ /'khor ba'i lam ni gcod pa po/ /spros pa thams cad nyer zhi ba'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka /mkha' 'gro ma kun sgra ru bshad/ /yang na mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi sgras 9 /ni rab tu 4rigatum mo la sogs pa la bya la ⑤dngos po ni rang bzhin te/ de rnams kyi rdul phra rab las bsgrubs pa'o / /de nyid sems can gyi don la nus pa dang ldan pa'i phyir sems dpa'i sgrar brjod de/ mi shes pa'i ri bo 'joms pas na ye shes nyid ni rdo rje'o/ /sems dpa' rnam pa gnyis gsungs te/ snod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten no/ /bcud ni rgyu ba zhes bshad la/ /de bzhin snod ni brtan tsho6 pa'o/ /re re zhing yang gnyis gnyis te/ /skal ba bzang dang skal ngan no/ /sa dang chu dang me rlung gi/ /gzugs ni rnam pa bzhi ru gnas/ /'di ni zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das de nyid de 97skurang byung bas na rang byung bcom ldan 'das so/ /rang byung ba rdzun zhes bya ba ni 'byung ba chen po rjes su dpag pa'i rang bzhin gyi phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan 78—211

pas so/ /yang na nyon mongs pa la sogs ①pa'i bdud bcom pas na bcom ldan 'das te/ rang byung ②bcom ldan 'das de nyid lhag pa'i lha ni gcig nyid de lha nyid yin zhing lhag pa nyid kyi phyir lhag pa'i lha ste/ lhag pa'i lha yi ①sgrar gang sngar bstan pa'i khams rnams kyi nang na gtso bo dang dam par gyur pa ste/phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams yang dag par skyed par byed pa'i khu ba dang khrag go/ /mchog tu bde ba de las skyes shing byung bas na 'byung ④gnas te/nges 'byung ni sems skyed pa'i (snyebazhed gzhung gsungs pa'oyi/ /sgra ni dbyangs te / shes rab kyi dbyangs kyi rjes su 'jug pa'o/ /tshul ni sgrar btags 9)pa ste/de las byung ba'o/ /bsten du0cing bsnyen par byas pas lan dam tshig ste/ yul can gyis yang dag par bzhag 1 ripa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams dang /don dam par dbyer med pas nye bar brtags nas yul can dbang po la yang yul zhes bya'o/ /spyod pa ni dbang po bcu gnyis po de rnams kyi nye bar rgyu ba ste/de rnams kyi hu rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems thob pa ni spyod yul lo/ /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba zhes bya ba ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i dngos po gsum las rnyed par mi 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid de thog ma dbus mthar yang dag gnas pa'o/ /de la thog ma ni gsang ba ste/ 'di skad ces bya ba sngar 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i rig pa'o/ /mtha' zhes bya ba ni dges 8pa ste thos pa zhes bya ba bsten par bya'o/ /dbus zhes bya ba ni mchog ste/ bdag gi zhes bya ba shin tu dam par gyur pa'o/ /yang dag gnas ni thams cad bdag nyid de/ dus gcig na zhes bya ba'om/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgyu ma chen mo ④de nyid ngan par spyod pa ste/ lo brgyad pa dang rdo rje pad+mo 0sbyor bas byung ba'i 78—212

khrag dang bcas pa'o/ /lha dang mi yi 6)bde ba ni/ /bsdus byas rdo rje rdul gyi (geni / /bcu drug char yang mi phod pa ste/ de la bcu drug cha ni bud med kyi skud pa las byung ba'i khams rnams skud pa bcu drug dang lhan cig tu bsgril (7ba ste chags pa chen po zhes bya ba gang yin pa'o/ /de ltar skud pa bcu drug dang bsgril (canaba'i cha shas bcu drug go(sgyu/ /bsdus byas zhes bya ba bdud rtsi lnga'i snying po'i (6rigong bur byas pa ste/ bdud rtsi lnga yi 0)sbyor bar gyur pa'o/ /dang zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i don te sde tshan rnams kyis bsdus shing 98chibastan pa'i khams gang dang gang yin pa'i rlan de dang de sa bon dang bsgril (()te brtag 7par bya'o/ /lha'i bde ba zhes bya ba ni de bdud rtsi ltar yongs su smin pas rang gi sku rdo rjer gyur pa'i skad cig go/ /mi'i rtsomayin pas na mi yi nyugaste nges par gsal ba'i bde ba'o / /de yang dngos grub thams cad kyi rang bzhin rtag tu bde ba'i lho gsal bas mtshan pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sems kyi rdo rje mngon du bya zhing bde ba bsten pa las bobade ba nyid du skye bar 'gyur te/ ther zug tu bde ba ster bas so/ /de yang dper na mngar pos 7bsgos pa'i sa bon ni / /mngar po nyid ni bsten 7pa dang / /gang phyir mngar pos bskyed byas na / /de yi ro ni mngar por 'gyur/ /de bzhin du chos kyi bdud rtsi las byung ba'i bde ba bsten na bde ba 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de dang mnyam pa dngos po gsum po gang na ⑩yang yod pa ma yin te cha shas kun dang mtshungs pa rmo lta zhog /de'i rdul phra rab kyi cha dang mtshungs pa yang yod pa ma yin no/ /rdul phra rab ni rdo rje phra mo'i rang bzhin te/ byang chub kyi sems bde ba'i bdag nyid spros pa'o//mthu dang ngo bo nyid dag dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni grub pa ste/ / de yi hurterang 78wa 213

bzhin gtam dag ni/ /bzhin lho)mdzes ma ni khyod la bshad/ /gang zhig phyi rol sbyor la rin)dga'/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do(kye/ /sbyor ba'i mchog ni 'di mthong na / /gzhan (gedag 'bus zos rtswa dang 'dra/ /da (kyeni chu skyes chen po'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa bshad par bya ste/ mi gsal brda yi tshul gyis ni/ /gnas ni gsang ba (6)zhes byar bshad/ /mi gsal ba yi dngos por ni/ /brda yi skad kyis bshad pa yin/ /'di ni rtog pa la brten ⑦ /nas / /gnas ni gsang ba bshad par bya/ /dgon chen zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sgra ji bzhin no/ /gzhan yang dgon chen zhes bya ba (8)ni shes rab ste/sngags kyi yon tan gyi shing gi tshogs dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ / de nyid 9cirang bzhin gyis lha'i bdag nyid pas na sa phyogs so/ /rigs mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin gyi phyir mang po'i tshig go/ /bdag dang sems can la sogs par rtog 7pa dang bral bas nyu7rnam par dben pa ste/ lta ba ngan pa rnams kyis gzhig par mi nus pa'i phyir ri bo'o/ /'jug par dka' ba'i skiphyir ri 'or te1ge/ zab cing rgya che ba'i shes rab kyi chu bo'i gnas su gyur pas rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram rnams so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad chadang sbyin pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa grub nyu pas gdod nas grub pa ste/nyan thos la sogs pa'i byang chub 'dod chags kyi mes bsregs pas dur khrod do / /de ltar na me long lta bu la sogs pa lnga rnam par dag pas gnas rnam pa lngar bsgrags so/ /chung ngu ni dang por lo bcu gcig ma'i pad+ma dang rol 8pas bcud kyis len bsgrub par bya'o/ /gnyis par lo bcu gnyis ma dang rol pas ni dam tshig don du gnyer bar bya'o/ /gsum par lo bcu drug ma dang lhan cig 78—214

tu dga' bas ni (7sngags rnams goms par bya'o/ /bzhi par lo nyi shu ma dang nam mkhar 'phur ba bsgrub (2par bya'o/ /lnga par lo nyi shu rtsa lnga ma dang dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes ( bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de ltar na dbugs 'byung ci mchog dang bar ma dang / zhes bya ba gnas lnga po rdzu de dag dang rim pa bzhin du sbyar (yero/ /de la rigs ldan rnams ni rdo rje rigs kyi bu mo la sogs pa rnams dri yi chus mchod par bya ste/ bcas pa zhes bya ba ni rigs kyi bu mo de'i me tog bzung (pel mkhas pas rang gi khu ba dang bcas pas mchod do/ /rtag tu zhes bya ba ni thams cad du rgyun mi 'chad par te/ dus kyi khyad par zhes bya ba snga dro'i dus su'o/ /gzhan yang lhan cig skyes grub ces bya ba thun mong gi dngos grub dang ldan zhing sgrub pa po la brtse ba stesan/ thig le des sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dgon pa chen po zhes bya ba ni bud med kyi phyag rgya ste/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i nags tshal dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid thabs kyis yongs su sbyangs na (9byang chub kyi lam ste/ yongs su sbyangs pa ni mthar 7thug par son pa'o/ /de'i dhar mo da /nyaya ni sa phyogs te/ de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i rdo rje rigs la sogs pa'i bu mo bas na rnam par dben pa'o/ /de nyid bde ba chen pos mi g.yo bas na ri bo'o/ /sems can dman pas 'jug par 12dka' bas na ri 'or kyi te phug dang ldan pas na tshang tshing ngo / /thabs dang shes rab snyoms par 'jug pa'i rgya mcho1re 1 tshoganas pas rgya mcho1re 'gram ste/ sems can thams cad kyi lorgyud la mnyam par gnas pas na dur khrod do/ /gdod nas grub pa ni rtag tu grub pa ste/ 'char ba dang nub pa spangs shing nam mkha' 78—215

ltar yongs su grub pas 1)rtag tu bde ba chen po'i tshul gyis dmigs pas de'i rang bzhin du byas pa'o/ /ni zhes bya ba ni 'dus pa ste de dang ldan pa'i phyir ro//sna tshogs pad+ma ras kyis g.yogs zhes bya ba (snyel sna tshogs ni rnam pa du ma ste/pad+ma ni gzugs dkyi tshig bla dgas so/ /ras ni gsal bar ma byas pa ste④/g.yogs pa ni shin tu mi dzosemangon par byas pa'o/ /stan ni rig pa nyid yigadan du byas pa ste dag pa ni 'jam pa'o/ /lha mo rnams kyi (7pad+ma rang gi mtshan ma'i gos kyi rgyan gyis brgyan (8)pa'o/ /gzhag ( pa ni mchod par bya ba ste/ yang dang yang du 'dod pas mnyes par bya ba'otshe/ /sdom pa ni bde ba'i mchog go/ /pad+ma'i khrag dang zhes bya ba ni de bzhin du khrag ni bcud kyis len pa ste/ khrag ni pad+ma yin la 11bshang ba la sogs pa ni bcud kyis len tolho / /des 'di skad du bstan 512par 'gyur te/ khrag chen ga bur bcas pa dang / /tsan+dan dmar por sbyar ba dag /tshogs kyi nang du zhugs pa na/ /ra sa ya na bla na med/ /ces bya ba la khrag chen ni dus su 'bab pa'i zla mtshan du gyur pa'o/ /tsan+dan dmar po ni sha ste de dang bcas pa'o/ /tshogs kyi nang du zhugs pa ni dbang po thams cad las byung ba ste/ de dag thams cad kyi bcud ni ra sa ya na'o/ /bza' bar bya zhes 7bya ba la/ cho ga gang gis bza' bar bya zhe na/ sbom po'am mtha' ltag geces bya ba la sbom po ni rdo rje'o/ /mtha' ltag ni bha ga ste/ a nā ⑩ma zhes bya ba ming gis bsnyad pa'i phyir ro/ /khar zhes bya ba ni de nyid kyi khas rang gi lha yi mkhar ro/ /de yang dang por 3)bla mar 4cadabul byas te/ /de nas sangs rgyas rnams la dbul/ /phyag rgya la ni byin nas su/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin du myang / /mchod pa 2 chibazhi zhes bya ba la/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed shurnye78—216

pa'i rim pa sgom pa pos ni/ dus bzhir mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo dang /rnam par thar pa'i 0)sgo bzhi'i bdag nyid can ji srid stong pa nyid kyi nga rgyal nas bzung ste/ gzugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar du nges par byas pas mchod par bya'ol/ /dpa' bo dang ni snyoms 'jug pa zhes bya ba ni/ gzhan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gnas pa'i sgom pa po'i ②ste/ dus kyi nges pa med cing thog ma dang tha ①ma med pa'i nga rgyal gyis rtag tu gnas pa rnams kyis ci zhig bya zhe na/ yid ni nang du chud pa'i ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skyed ma mo'i shes rab dang byaji lta ba bzhin du mnyam par sbyor ba (ge)dang ldan pas mchog tu dga' ba rnam par spro ste/ gnas pas tshim par bya zhes bya ba'i bar du'o / /de ltar mchod pas tha ma (nyamachog dang bar ma ste/ tha ma ni chags pa chen po'i tshul lo/ /de yang rdo rje can gyis thams cad bsdus nas btsun mo'i bha ga bde ba can du spros la/ der ni (7)dkyil 'khor bri bar bya zhes bya ba dang sbyar ba ste/ gzhan gyi de kho na nyid ji lta ba 98)bzhin du bstan pa'o/ /bar ma ni bdag gi de kho (7na nyid de⑩/ rdo rje lho 'dzin pas 'khor lo thams cad rang gi dbus su bsdus la/ rdo rje kun gyi rang bzhin du byas pa cho ga des bsgoms 1nyapa ni mchog go/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma zhes bya ba la bud med kun ni gzugs la sogs pa'o/ /sgyu ma ni yon tan te rang bzhin gyis sku la sogs pas gnas pa'o//sgyu ma ste yon tan gyi rgyus 8ma lus pa/ sgyu ma'i don du gsungs so/ /ma lus pa ni cha shas te 8cha dang bcas pa'o/ /cha ni dngos por bstan pa ste/ /cha med yon tan zhes bya yin/ /yon tan yon tan can sbyar ba/ /yul dang dbang po rab tu dge/ /ā li kā ⑩li yon tan gsungs/ /mnyam pa dam tshig spyod yul 78—217

yin / /de nyid ni mtshan ma yin pas na phyag rgya ste/ 'di ni zhes bya ba ni 'dzin pa po'i blos mngon du byas pa'o/ /yon tan des rtag tu yon tan dang ldan par gyur pa'i ring po la sogs pa gnyis su med pa'i tshul nyid mchog ste/bla na med cing dam par gyur pa'o0)/ /de yang lugs ma la sogs pa gzhan dag las phul du byung bar rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni 'gyur ba med pa'i mtshan nyid dang ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa ste/ ji ltar 'o ma la zho la sogs pa bzhin no/ /de bas na bcos ma las bye brag tu gyur pa'o//gzhan yang ngan par spyod pa'ang 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnyed dang bde dang ②dga' kun gyis/ /zhes bya ba la rnyed pa ni byang chub kyi sems rnyed pa ste/ de nyid dga' ba kun gyis khyad par du 'phel bas yin gyi/ slongs mos (gu'atsho ba la sogs pa dang / dka' thub kyi sbyor ba la sogs pa rnams ④ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin pas nam yang 'grub par mi 'gyur te spang bar bya'o/ /des zhes bya ba ni grub pa'i rdzas kyis te/ khyad par ji lta bu zhig ce (pen/ rang bzhin dang ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa ste/ rang bzhin gyi ri nasngags kyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las rang gi lha'i gzugs su yongs su brje (7skab ste/ sngags bzlas pa dang / rang gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las rang bzhin yongs su brje skuraba'o/ /sna tshogs zhes bya ba ni khams kyi rang bzhin te/ mkha' 'gro ma rnam pa 3)bcwa ⑩brgyad du phye ba yin gyi/ bhu 17ba la sogs pa'i khams ni ma yin no/ /nam mkha' kun tu rgyu grub pa/ /zhes bya ba la nam mkha'i sgras ni sems la bya ste/ ji ltar nam mkha'i khams la sogs pa thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa bzhin du thams cad kyi go skabs ster ba'i phyir ro/ /yang na nyan /(2thos la sogs pa'i gnas bsregs pas 78—218

na ①nam mkha' ste/ nam mkha' der bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis rgyu zhing spyod pas na/ de ni nam mkha' kun tu rgyu grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags zhes so/ /sna tshogs kun tu phyag rgya ste zhes bya ba la/ kun tu ni sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i larigs thams cad do/ /sna tshogs ni rdo rje 'dzin chen po ste/ de'i phyag rgya ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya thams cad do/ /des na sna tshogs 4)phyag rgya ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin gyis zla ba dang dmar po 'grub ④pa'i rdzas de dag nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du rtag tu goms par bya bas (5)stobs su ༅gyur pa'o/ /sna tshogs sdom pa ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bde ba grub pa ste/mkha' 'gro kun zhes bya ba khrag ⑦dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i cho gas 8stesngags pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya bar grags pa ste/ rang nyid skyes par gyur pa'o/ /de nyid med sems ni de kho na nyid kyi sems med pa ste/ phyin ci log gi sems kyis sbyor ba'o/ /lha la 7)dmigs pa ni 'dod pa'i lhar sgom nyu )pa'o/ /shin tu de nyid sems zhes bya ba ni de kho na nyid kyi sems kyis brgyan pa ste/ phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de yang khrag la sogs pa'i khams sangs rgyas rnams kyi rang bzhin gyi /1de kho na nyid de dngos grub thams cad kyi gnas so/ /lugs ma la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ni de spangs nas bcos ma sgom par byed pa ste/ gang gi phyir gzugs brnyan ma yin pas so/ /des ni 'di skad bstan par 'gyur te/ji ltar smin pa'i 'bras bu bor nas/ shing gi rtsa ba len par byed pa bzhin du/rnal tsom bor te bcos ma la chags pa yang nyunyeblo gros dman zhing shin tu blun par ston to/ /des na de kho na nyid kyi sems kyis phun sum tshogs pas bdag nyid sbyor zhing rdzogs pa'i rim pas sangs rgyas kyi sku la chadamigs pa ni mchog tu 78—219

mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ye shes de nyid ni mchog tu mi ①'gyur ba ste/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i ②phyir ro/ /des na gzhan ②yang gzugs brnyan dang lugs ma la ④sogs pa spangs te/ khams sna tshogs kyi shes pa nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus par brtag par bya'o/ / lha yi ⑤rnal 'byor dus su ni/ /ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas zhes bya ba la ⑥ba spu ni lte ba'i dkyil 'khor te bu ga ⑦ni nam mkha'o/ /rtse mo'i bar zhes bya ba ni yi ge bcu drug yongs su gyur pa'i khams rnams te/ spro ba dam tshig dkyil 'khor te/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgomani/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/ /rang gi pad+ma'i lte dbus su/ /zla bar gnas pa'i hūṃ yin te/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag ni/ /phyogs bcu dag tu spro bar byed/ /thig le bcu drug thig skud kyi/ /sngags pas thig gis ⑨btab pa yi7/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug par/ /a sogs k+ṣa yi 0mthar thug pa/ /tha ma las ni sngags btu bya/ /phyi nas thig ler cha dang bral/ /bshang dang gci ba'i rang bzhin pas/ /'di ru k+ṣa ni spang bar bya/ /yi ge ha ni yongs gyur pas/ /yi ge thams cad yal ga me'adra/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos stong pa yi/ /yi ge nyid ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes bya ba ni sngags kyi man ngag go/ /ka sogs yang dag gnas pa yi/ /yi ge lha yi gzugs yin te/ /a sogs dbyangs rnams thams cad kyi/ / sngags kyis sgeg cing ⑫brgyan pa yi8/ /lhag pa'i lha ni yi ge (8/ /lte ba'i dbus su bsam par bya/ /lte ba pad+ma zhes bya ste/ /bsam pa bsgom par bya ba yin/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos stong pa ni/ /rnam shes rgyu gi gzugs 0nyid do/ /yi ge nyid ni mkha' 78—220

'gro ma/ /sgra yi gzugs kyis ①gnas pa'o/ /gang phyir gzhan yang 'di dag ni / /ji ltar sangs rgyas kun de bzhin/ /'di ni rtag tu 'don pa dang ② / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs chal gnas/ /mgo dang thig le durnam spangs pa/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha/ /rang gi dbus gnas rdo rje can/ /yi ge rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /de kho ⑤na nyid snang ba dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba la ye shes ni ⑤spyod yul yongs su shes pa'o/ /yongs su shes pa zhes bya ba ni kun nas shes pa'i ye shes te/ de nyid kyis ni bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad do/ /bdag nyid ces bya ba ni kun rdzob ste/ kun rdzob ⑦yongs su shes pa ni sangs rgyas nyid do/ /de nyid kyis sangs rgyas dang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'grub bo/ /thabs gang gis zhe dun de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gsang ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa de kho na nyid 'byung ba'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //sbyin sreg ⑨las kyi cho ga ni/ /ji bzhin bshad kyis ⑩lha mo nyon/ /rgyal srid phyir ni sngags pa yis/ /stong phrag bcur ni bzla bar bya/ /pho nya'i steng du gnas nas ni/ /sbyin sreg hunyestong phrag lnga ni bya/ /sha chen 'o ma la bsgres pa/ /rim pa 'di yis bsregs na ni/ /dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgya yi 8bar/ /tshun chad pho brang rnyed par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan rgyal srid che grub pa/ /sus kyang gzhig par mi nus so/ /mi dang ba lang ce 0spyang shas/ /de bzhin ngo 78—221

mtshar mchog 'gyur 7)te/ /chang dang 'o mar sbags nas ni/ /sbyin sreg ②'bum phrag gcig byas na/ /gling bdun la ni dbang ba yi/ /rgyal srid longs spyod dpal chen 'gyur/ /de nas mtshams med lnga byed pa/ /gang gis (migazhom par 'dod pa des/ /dug dang khrag dang mar nag bcas/ /mi yi rus pa bsregs byas te/ /tsher ma can gyi shing dang ni/ /de bzhin phub ma mi spar bcas / /shan pa yi (thuni me sbar la/ /gcer bu spa (deni lhug pa yis/ /lho phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /khro dang bcas pas 6)nyin phyed na/ /sems mi g.yeng bas bsreg 57)pa 'am/ /yang na gos sngon gyon nas su/ /mtshan phyed na ni bsreg par bya/ /sngags kyi mthar ni ming dang sbyar/ /dgra bo stobs dang ldan pa yang / /dpung dang bcas par brlag 'gyur na/ /phal pa la lta ci zhig smos / /de nas dgra bo stobs kyis ni/ /dregs pa bskrad pa'i cho ga bshad/ /khā yi gshog ris/pa zhag dang ni/ /nim pa'i khu bar bsres ⑨pa dag /sha za'i shing la me sbar te/ /rlung du bltas te bsreg bobyas na/ /mtshan mo bdun ni tshun chad kyis/ /bskrad 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom hunyemed/ /de nas dbye ba bshad par bya / /smyo byed me ni 'bar ba la/ /nim pa yi ni lo ma dang / /sbrul gyi pags /depar bsre 3gebyas la/ /bya rog dang ni 'ug pa yi/ /tshang gi shing dang bcas pa dag /brgya rtsa brgyad du bsregs na ni/ /mdza' bshes 'osteganyen 'dun mebacas pa dang tso/ /skye bo thams cad sdang bar 'gyur/ /de nas dgug pa pho bshad bya ste / /bsgrub bya shing gi stan 1shel ni/ /rol par bcas shing g.yo 3)dang bcas/ /rlung gis gdong ni steng du bltaso )/ /li khri lta bu'i mdog tu bsam/ /zhags pa ⑨lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /sngags kyi mthar ni dza bzlas te/ /bsgrub bya'i snying 78wa 222
