gi pad+ma dbug /bud med yin na skye gnas dbug① /khams gsum 'grub par gdon mi za/ /de nas cho ga gzhan bshad pa/ /dgug pa la sogs ji bzhin 'byung ske/ /dum bu gcig pa'i thod pa ni/ /gzugs mdzes ma chag ②ma gas la/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i gzugs bris te/ /'dab lam rlon pa brgya la ni/ /khrag dang go ro tsa nar bcas/ / dha du ④ra yi sgyug (shegu yis/ /sngags ni ming dang bcas par yizi/ /thod pa'i nang du bzhag (7nas su/ /bsgrub bya dmar po ras kyis g.yogasal/ /sngags kyi nga rgyal bsgyings 79/nas su/ /'dab ⑩ma re re bzung nas ni/ /go bzlog 7snying po'i gsang sngags ni/ /zlos shing 'dab skem thams cad bsregatso /yid la bsams ④bzhin 'gugs snyipar 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang tsan+dan ni/ /dmar las bsgrub bya'i gzugs byas la/ /rang khrag go ro tsa nar bcas/ /ming bris bsgrub bya'i tsosnying gar gzhug⑩ /tsha ba gsum gyis byugs hunyenas su/ /snying ga 0lte ba gsang ba'i gnas/ /zangs ma'i khab kyis dbug du )byas nang ste/ /mtshan phyed na ni 'dod bzhin 'gugasazhunye/ /gser btsag gis ni skye gnas kyi/ /gzugs bris de yi du ༄steng du ni/ /lag pa g.yon pa gzhag ④byas la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas (snyen ni/ /gang gi du nyeming nas bzung so gyur pa/ /de ni de mod 'ong bar 'gyur/ /rlung gis gtsubs ( nyepa'i shing lo la/ / khu yi 0sgro yi smyug so )gu yis/ /ming dang bcas pa'i 'khrul ⑥'khor ni/ /mchi ma las ni bris nas su/ /gyen du ldang (rteba'i tshub mar bskur / /cho ga des ni bskrad par 'gyur/ /spre'u'i shusterus pa'i phur bu ni/ /sor drug pa yi shustetshad du bya/ /sngags ni lan bdun bzlas nas su/ /gang gi khyim sgor sbas na ni/ /de yi rigs ni chad par 'gyur/ /ba glang dugerta dang glang 78wa 223

chen dang / /bong 17bu rnga mo ma he yi/ /gnas su sbas na brlag par 'gyur/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /bsgrub bya rnga mo'i steng du bskyon ni/ /gcer bu mar khus byugs 8)pa dang / /skra grol kha ni lho ru bltas/ /skyabs med ngu zhing brgyal bar bsam/ /mgrin pa zhags pas bcings nas su/ /rgyab nas khro bos rdeg byed cing / /khams gsum gnon pa'i bsam pa yis me yi mtshams su gdong bltas te/ /sngags kyi mthar ni dza bzlas na/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /rta dang ma hor zhon pa yi4/ /dgra bo nang ni 95phan tshun du/ /mtshon 6cha thogs nas khros nas ni/ /phan tshun dpung dang bcas pa ru/ /'thab 7mo byed pa bsgom par bya/ /sngags pa g.yul du kha bltas te/ /de yi ming dang spel ba yi/ /yi ge ra ni bri bar bya/ /gdong ni 8steng du blta bar 9ribasam/ /sgrub po ro yi 1 )steng du ni/ /rdo rje skyil krung 11mi g.yor gnas/ /de yis bsgrub bya mnan nas su/ /lus dang ngag ni gzir bar bya/ /sngags ni ming dang spel ba ru/ /snga ma bzhin du bzla bar 12bya/ /bcing ba'i cho ga'o/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 1snyedapal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las las thams cad kyi bsam gtan 'byung ba dang sbyin sreg gi 1 chicho ga'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu (5rtsa gsum pa'o// //da 17ni sbyin sreg 51 cho ga gzhan/ /rab tu bshad kyis sna )lha mo nyon/ /bsgogs 19pa 'am ni gzhan yang rung / /rma med shin tu mdzes pa ni/ /'byung 78—224

po'i nyin zhag la rnyed pa/ /sgrub pos sngar bshad bzhin bsgrubs na/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /zla mtshan phyis pa'i ras ma ni/ /byi la'i 51rtug par bcas pa dgacin) /zhib tu brdungs pas ribadug pa bya/ /bdug pa 'di yis sgrub pa po/ /shin tu byin gyis rlob par 'gyur/ /khyi mo nag mo'i 'o ma dang / /ma sha 'bras bu bcas pa las/ /'o thug byas te ro yi 4khar/ /'jigs pa med par sbyin sreg 5bya/ /de nas ro de langs nas ni/ /ci bgyi zhes ni smra 'gyur te/ / ril bu 6mig sman dngos grub dang / /rkang byug ral gri de bzhin te/ /gter dang dgra bo tshar gcod medang / /gnod sbyin mo dang bcud kyis len/ /gang bslangs nagacig ni byin nas su/ /'gro bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /dpa' bo rnams dang rtse 'gyur ba/ /gzhan dag tu ni nga mi smra / /de nas ro langs chen po yi/ /sgrub 9thabs gzhan ni bshad par bya/ /sngar bstan mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /ro ni mdzes pa bzung nas ni/ /rnal 'byor chen por legs gnas pa/ /mtshan phyed na ni bsgoms nas su/ /de yi sha ni dmar chen bcas/ /sbyin sreg 1 brgya rtsa brgyad byas na/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis bskor gyur cing / /ro langs srin po 1lhadu mas bskor/ /ha har bzhad 15pas 'jigs byed pa/ /der ni drung du 'ong bar 'gyur / /ce (1 sbyang brgya phrag mang po ni/ /bskor nas 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs skabyed / /de mthong 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /sngags kyis bsgyings pa'i lus su bya/ /rdo rje brtul zhugs 15bdag nyid sems/ /kye ho dpa' bo chen po legs/ /lha mos 7de skad brjod nas ni/ /sgrub po yid la gang 'dod pa'i/ /dngos grub brgya yang ster bar 'gyur1 / /rnal 'byor ma yis yongs bskor te/ /dpa' bo 78—225

rang gi gnas su 'gro/ /de ni de yi 91)mod la yang / /lha yi lus su gyur nas ni / /khams gsum kun tu rgyu bar 'gyur/ /dpa' bo 'dod pa'i gzugs can te / /skal 2chibazang de bzhin gshegs pa 'dra/ /rtag tu nam mkhar 'phur ba dang ske/ /rga dang 'chi ba rnam par spong / /sa gzhi ྅kun tu rgyu 'gyur zhing / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin dngos grub 'jug /de nas nyon mongs zhi bya dang / /ting nge 'dzin ni rgyas bya'i phyir/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor bar gnas/ /nang gi 4sbyin sreg ldebartsam par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /bdag nyid rtag tu bsam par bya/ /'od zer phreng ba 'khrugs shing drag /'od kyi dkyil 'khor phreng ba can/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ni/ /stong gsum stong gi rdul mtshungs pa/ /kha dog dkar la sogs bkug ste/ /lus mchog de la gzhug 6par bya/ /'di ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 7yin/ /rgyas la byang chub sems dpa' dgug /rengs mo pa'i gzugs su lhag par mos/ /shin tu nyon mongs zad bya'i phyir/ /khyad par khro bo'i gzugs su bya/ /sna tshogs rjes su chags bya'i phyir/ /bud med kyi ni gzugs su bsam/ /'di ni nang gi sbyin sreg 9 tu/ /sgrub 1 ripo kun la bstan pa yin/ /phung po la 11sogs bud shing ni/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa yi1 / /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas 'bar ba/ /ye shes me la bsreg par bya/ /tshangs pa'i me ni rked 1 par gnas/ /la la na 1 ni dgang gzar te/ /ra sa na 15ni blugs 17gzar kha/ /dbyug 1 pa rdo rje rin chen 'og /rang gi rdo rje mtha' yi bar/ /thod pa sreg 1 rdzas snod yin te/ /rdzas rnams thams cad bsreg par bya/ /'di ni bla med sbyin sreg 39gi/ / cho ga'i rim pa nyid yin te/ /lha mo khyod la bshad pa yin/ /de ltar byas na ting 'dzin ni/ /78—226

nyams par mi 'gyur brtan 'gyur bar/ /rgyud rnams kun las thun mong du/ /cho ga 'dis ni rab tu grags/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po (1)dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las ro langs sgrub tshon)pa dang / nang gi sbyin sreg po cigi cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu brtsa bzhi pa'o// //bgrang phreng cho ga ji bzhin du/ /rab tu bshad kyis 5lha mo nyon/ /yang dag cho ga gang gis ni/ /'di ni 'grub 6'gyur the tshom 7)med/ /shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang / /khams kun la nasogs gzhan yang rung / /dung dang lung tang mu men (9)ni/ /tshe dang nad med 'phel bar byed/ /gser dang de bzhin dngul dang ni/ /khyad par pad+ma'i sa bon dang / /rin chen phreng ba mdzes pa ni / /mkhas pa yis ni bgrangs nas su/ /rgyal srid phyir ni sngags bzlas na/ /dpal chen myur du 'thob nyasapar 'gyur/ /gur gum la sogs dri dang ni/ /khyad par du yang byi ru dang / /tsan+dan dmar po dngul la 11sogs/ /sgrub pa po yis ril bu nya bya/ /zhen cing rjes su chags pa mchog /sgrub 1 pa po la 'bras bu ster / /ru rag lung tang sa bon dang / /mi yi rus pa de bzhin te/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /khyad par du ni mngon spyod la'o/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la/ /pu traṃ dzī 1 tshob las kun byed/ /sngags mnyes pa la 35lnga bcu ste/ /rjes su chags par de yi 15phyed/ /zhi ba la ni brgya yin te/ /rgyas la brgyad ni lhag par bya/ /mngon spyod la ni drug cu ste/ /las kyi bye brag gis 78wa 227

ni sbyar/ /las kyi bye brag ji bzhin du/ /bgrang ba'i phreng ba rnams ni bya/ /gser gyi skud pas brgyu bar bya/ /las rnams kun byed dge ba yin/ /yang na ras bal skud pa ni/ /bu mo gzhon nu gzugs mdzes shing / /yan lag shin tu rdzogs pa dang / /blo gros ldan zhing ngag 'jam smra/ /de yis bkal hu)ba'i skud pas brgyu/ /sngags kyi dngos grub grol bar 'gyur/ / ril bu (snyernams ni dgra bcom ste/ /steng ma mchod rten du ni brtag /mchod rten chos kyi dbang po pas / /chos kyi dbyings ni dbus su bya/ /bskrad la bya rog spu dang ni/ /bong bu rnga mo'i spu las bya/ /rta dang ma ho'i spu yis ni/ /phan tshun sdang ba'i skud par bya/ /dur khrod skra du yi skud pa dang / /khyi yi spu dang bsres te bkal/ /drag po'i las la khyad par du/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bstan pa yin/ /zhi ba la ni mdzub (4)mor bzhagar /rgyas la gung mor dgal (6)bar bya/ /dbang du bya ba srin lag gsungs/ /mtha' ma la ni mngon spyod bya/ /mthe bo lcags kyur byas nas ni/ /lha rnams thams cad 'gugs zhonapar bsam/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag ⑧sngags bzlas na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom ⑨med/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las bzlas pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas pad+mar rdo rje bcug 7pa bskyod cing gar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la lha mos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gtsug lag khang dang khang bzangs 7dang / /78—228

mchod rten dkyil 'khor grong khyer dang / /khyim dang ldum ra la ①sogs pa/ /lto 'phye'i lto bar brko ②ba chadang / /slob ma sa gzhi gzung ④ba dang / /bum pa sta gon gnas pa nyid/ /bsrung (5)ba'i cho ga sngon 'gro ba'i/ /lha dang slob ma sta yigon gnas(pe/ /ye shes skud pa tshon rtsi rnams/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad du gsol/ /slob ma yi ni cho ga dag /ji bzhin bshad kyis 67lha mo nyon/ /sngar bshad mtshan nyunyid ldan pa dang / /ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus/ /sems can don brtson sems kyis ni/ /dngos po kun gyis gsol ba gdab/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /slob ma yis ni bla ma la/ /yang dang yang du gsol bar bya/ /gsol nas bla mas ⑩smra bya ste/ /yo ⑩byad thams cad 'byor ram (nyaci/ /cung zad cig 8ni 'byor gyur la/ /kha cig dag ni ma 'byor ces/ /smra na slob dpon bdag chen gyis/ /de yi sems ni brtag par bya/ /brtan pa la ni brtan par te/ /g.yo ba las ④ni g.yo ba ru/ /'dren tsom la ni 'dren ⑩mar shes/ /slob ma yi ni rkang mthil du/ /gzhu 'dra'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam / /lte bar ye shes me 'bar ba/ /de yi 'od zer snying gar pho 7'bar /'bar bas kun nas 'khrigs par bsgomanyusnye/ /rba las byung ba'i mi sdug gzugs//sdig ni sna yi sgo nas dbyung / /de nas khro bo'i gzugs bsgoms la/ /de ni kun nas za bar bsgomanyunye/ /oṃ zhu )badz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha pyo nye' hi da nya' hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha bha smo steku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bsgrub bya lha gzugs bskyed nas su/ /srung bub dag ni dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga ji bzhin du/ /brtag pa 2nyaru ni su yis nus/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor lhab yis/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni brtags na 'grub/ /grong dang dur khrod tshong dus dang / /tshal dang lha khang grong khyer 78—229

gyi / /shar dang byang gi sa gzhi shis/ /lho dang nub phyogs de lta min/ /gtsug lag khang gi gnas khang dang / /tshal dang ri rtse rdo leb dang / /khang bzangs kyi (1)ni steng phyogs dang / /dur khrod dang ni lha yi khyim/ /sa yi cha ni ji snyed pa//rgyud rnams kun la bsngags tshon pa yin/ /sa yi mtshan nyid shes par bya yang na yid ni gar dga' bar/ /de rnams su ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /dman (kyisogs dngos grub bye brag gis/ /pus mo chu so lte ba'i bar/ /brkos la phub ma rdo dang ni/ /gyo mo sol ba zug rngu dang / /tsher ma la sogs bsal la bcag /phyi nas mtho gang tshad du brko/ /de ni chu yis rab bkang (gel/ /shar du bltas te gom brgyar 'gro/ /slar log las ni brtag (5)par bya/ /chu ni gang bar gnas na shis/ /bskams 6rin sngags pas spang bar bya/ /sngon du 'bru la sogs pa gzhug /de ltar sa yi 75cha sbyangs la/ /lo (8)gyi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /gos dang rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs9)/ /zhal gcig (1 )phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /'od zer ser po kun tu 'bar/ /sa yi lha mo lag pa na/lha/ /gser gyi bum pa thogs pa ni/ /lus phyed sa la gnas pa ru/ /bltas te lag pa g.yas pa ni/ /sa la rag na 1 bskul bar bya/ /oṃ e h+ye hi 51snyem hā de bi thra bī 19lo ka mā ta res/ sarba rat+na si puṇ+ḍa di bya a laṅgā ra bhū ṣi te hā ra nu pu ra ni ṣa badz+ra sa twa pra pū dzi te kṛ tī tā/ i rda a a smin sa: nyi to bha ba hrīḥhi hi hi hi 8swā hā/ me tog dri la sogs mchod nas/ /de nyid du ni thim par bsam/ /khang bzangs ⑩rdo leb gzhi 1 dang ni/ /gtsug lag khang dang zhabs kyis bcag917 /ba glang ni )lhas dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /lag pa sa la bzhag zumanas su/ /rang gi snying po brgyad brgyar bzla/ /der ni brko sogs bya mi dgos/ /de ltar sbyangs pa'i sa 78wa 230

gzhi ①la/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni rjes mthun pa'i(5)/ /rin chen la misogs bzhi 'gyur gyi/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni khang pa bya/ /oṃ āḥlo hūm̐ zhes brjod nas/ /sa 'og rdo rje'i dngos por bya/ /oṃ me di 0ni badz+re 5/bha ba hūm̐/ /khung ni rim pa 'di yis dgang / /de dbus khro bo chen po ni/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba bsgom6)ske/ /de nas khra yi 9)gdong sogs ni/ /steng ni khro mo'i gzugs can la/ /lte ba man chad rtse gcig pa/ /rdo rje yi ni gzugs su spro/ /bgegs kyi tshogs la 'og gzigs pa'i/ /bsgyings bcas sngags ni zlos tshon bzhin du/ /de rnams snying gar ⑨gdab par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sarba bi na a nu myu da ya tī la (1 1ya rtsu phaṭa/ de nas sngar bstan sa dbus su/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen sbyor 1lhab yis/ /bdag nyid nye bar gnas nas ni/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs par bsgomanye / /don dam la ni lta ba ste/ /'di ni srung nya ba'i dam pa mchog /gang zhig srung miba'i cho ga kun/ /'di nyid du ni brtags pa yin/ /de nas rdo rje mda' yi ni/ /dra ba rdo rje ra ba dang / /rdo rje'i rang bzhin sa ru bya/ /rgyal po chen por bsgyings byas la/ /dkyil 'khor sa la hūm̐ zhes brjod/ /rdo rje'i 'gros kyis kun tu bskor/ /bdud rtsi lngas ni kun tu byug /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /tsan+dan sogs pas gru bzhir bya/ /phal pa yi ni gnas rnams su/ /so sor rlum por byas nas ni/ /lha yi 'khor lo cho ga bzhin/ /me tog sogs pas mchod par bya/ /de nas rin chen gser dang dngul/ /zangs sam 'jim pa dag kyang rung / /ji ltar 'byor pa'i rjes mthun 35par/ /bum pa dag ni bya ba ste/ /rtsa ba nag po la sogs spang 37/ /lto yang nya rmebum pa bzang po'i dbyibs / / byā gyi seng gri kyi nodabyug pa yi/ /ut+pa la dang gzhan mi thub/ /sa 78wa 231

ha de ba'i sman chen bcas/ /gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / /mu men byi ①ru rin chen lnga/ /til dang nas dang gro dang ni/ /mon sran gre'u dang mud gar (mibacas / /ga bur na)tsan+dan dmar po sogs/ /sman gyi chu yis dgang bar bya/ /de ltar dam tshig chen po yi/ /me tog chu dang ldan par bya/ /dngos po rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /yid 'ong mi 'ong brtag mi bya/ /dngos kun rtog pa las libyung bas/ /yid 'ong mi 'ong dpyad mi bya/ /rdzas kyi ⑤nus pa bsam mi khyab / /sangs rgyas nyid du 'bab par 'gyur/ /dper na spa yi rtsa ba ni/ /dkar po nag po rna ba dang / /dpral bar byugs ⑥pas bud med kyi/ /zla mtshan 'dzag pa zhi bar 'gyur/ /glang chen gcin dang ga bak+ṣa/ /dkar po'i sa bon mig bskus na/ /lto ni 'khru bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /'dir yang yo byad khyad par can/ /sbyangs la nye bar spyod pa yis/ /khyad ⑦par 'bras bu 'thob spri par 'gyur/ /dper na sngags kyis sbyangs pa'i dug /zos pas nad rnams thams cad ni/ /'joms shing bcud len nyid du 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dir yang brtag par bya/ /thams cad rang rang mtshan ma dang / /so so'i sngags kyis mngon par bzla/ /mtshan mar rang rang mdog tu bya/ /mgrin par ras zung sar ⑨pas dkri/ /kha ni shing lo sar ⑩pas dgab⑩/ /ku sha'i chun po 'og tu gding / /kha dog btsos pa'i skud pas brgyan/ /lhag par gnas shing mchod byas nas/ /bdug spos dag ni phul nas su/ /'khor lo'i dbus su gzhag par bya/ /de nas pus mo g.yas pa ni/ /sa la btsugs 8te spyis gtugs la/ /'di skad brjod de mkhyen par gsol/ /dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed (snyernams la yang 78—232

mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni de ring 'dri ①bar 'tshal/ /ji bzhin re ba bkang ②ba dang / /sems can rnams la sman slad du/ /mgon pos gus ldan bdag la ni/ /bka' drin dag ni gnang bar gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod bya zhing / /bum pa sta gon gnas nas su/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ /de ring bdag la brtse bas chadagongs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gang gzhan sngags kyi lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /bstan pa la ni dga' ba yi/ /'byung po rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / /gang yang lha yi spyan can rnamasang)/ /rdo rje can bdag rdoge'adi zhes byas/ /dkyil 'khor dge ba 'di zhes pa/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa yis ni/ /de ⑥ring 'dri ⑦bar 'tshal lags na/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni bcas pa yi/ /bdag dang slob ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /kun gyis 98)byin rlob (7nye bar bzhugs/ /cho ga bzhin du lan gsum brjod/ /de nas sar 7pa legs par bsgril/ /tshad ldan shin tu mdzes pa yis7/ /skud pas shes rab can lhonyethig lho gdab/ /cho ga bzhin du me tog mchodabo/ /nyi shu rtsa lngar phye ba yi/ /skud pa dag ni brkyang bar bya / /shar dang nub dang byang dang lhor/ /thig skud brkyang ba'i rim pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni cha brgyad bya/ /phyed ni lag 8par bsdogs nas su/ /thig gdab cho ga ⑩brtsam par bya/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur ni/ /lte bar bzhag ste gzung ⑩bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu ci bder bya/ /sngags pa shar du kha bltas te/ /phyogs kun mnyam par dmigs nas su/ /mnyam zhing tshad dang ldan pa 1)ru/ /tshangs pa'i thig gnyis bri bar bya/ /me mtshams gnas te rlung dang ni/ /bden bral gyur yiganas dbang ldan du/ /sngags pa shar dang lhor bltas la/ /78—233

skud pa dag ni gdab par bya/ /'dir (1)ni slob dpon slob ma dag /g.yas phyogs su ni bskor bar bya/ /slob ma med na rang nyid kyis/ /phur bur btags 2)te bri bar bya/ /nyis 'gyur byas te phur bur gdab/ /nang gi 'khor lo rdo rje ra/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor rim gnyis su/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas brtsams tsho )nas ni/ /g.yas skor 3)du ni skud pa bskor/ /sgo ni dkyil 'khor brgyad cha ru/ /mu khyud med par 'dod pa yin ra/ /sgo yi tshad kyis sgo khyud de56kyi//de yi phyed kyis 'gram pa bya/ /sgo yi sum 'gyur twa ra na(7)/ /ba dan dril bur ldan pa yin shen/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan ri dgas bcas/ /kha khyer tshad dang ldan par bya/ /twa ra na 9)yi phyi rol du/ /tshon gyi sa yi nyis 'gyur du/ /phyi yi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bya/ /'khor lo de yi phyi rol du/ /shing la 7sogs pa'i 7dur khrod bya/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo'i rjes mthun nyu2par/ /ji ltar mdzes par rab tu brtag /thig skud chad na slob dpon 'chi/ /dman dang lhag pas nad 'byung ste/ /phyogs ni cho1ge'akhrul na slob ma myos/ /de bas skyon med shes par bya/ /ye shes thig skud gshegs gsol nas/ /de nas las 'di brtsams (7par bya/ /'dod dang thar pa rab ster ba'i/ / tshon rtsi ri(gedag ni bskyed 8par bya/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /kun gyi nang rol nag po ru/ /tshon / rmegyi cha ni rim bzhin dgye/ /de nas slob mas ci dgar dgye/ /tshon rtsi re re'i zheng 512du ni/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha yi tshad/ /gal te tshon rtsi mi mnyam zhing / /yo dang dma' bar gyur na ni/ /ri mo dma' bas dngos mi 'grub/ /yon po gdung ba skyed nyugebyed pas/ /dpangs )ni mthe'u zhu)chung gang tsam du/ /mtho zhing drang bar 2bri bar bya/ /de la sbom na nad 'byung ste dge/ /dma' na nor ni 78wa 234

zad par 'gyur/ /yon pos phan tshun sdang 'gyur te/ /chad na bla ma slob ma dag /gnyi ga ①'chi bar shes par bya/ /g.yas skor nam yin bris na ni/ /rdul tshon phur bus btab par 'gyur/ /shar ni shin tu dkar ba'i mdog /lho ni dmar po'i mdog tu bya/ /nub phyogs ser por bya ba ste/ /byang ni ljang khu nyid du byami/ /cho ga dag ni de dag gis/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi gdan bzhugs pal/ /rdo rje la sogs dpa' rnal 'byor/ /'dab 5ma'i mkha' 'gro la sogs pas / /khwa (9)gdong la sogs dbye bar bya/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma ni/ /ge sar dang ni ldan pa la/ /mtshams rnams su ni thod pa'o/ /dkar dang dmar dang de bzhin sngo/ /sku la (7)sogs pa'i kha dog dbye/ /de ltar 'khor lo lha mo che / /dpa' bo rnams ni mchod par bya/ /sngar bshad sa yi mtshan nyid la/ /dbus su mtho bar bri bar bya/ /shar dang byang du gzhol ba ni/ /sngags pa rnams kyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas dag 'thob/ /byang du mtho bas 'chi 'gyur ram/ /nor rnams brlag par 'gyur ba ste/ /yang na nad kyis 'debs par 'gyur/ /ji skad bshad pa'i shar mtho bas/ /myur du rigs rnams zad par 'gyur/ /dbus su dma' ba'i rang bzhin sa/ /sgrub pa po ni 'joms dang ldan/ /de nyid bsdus dang bde mchog dang / /gsang dang rdo rje 'jigs byed du/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rgyal po 'di/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bshad dang ma bshad gang ci'ang rung / /thams cad he ru ka la gnas/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 8'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /78—235

rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las sa gzung hu)ba dang / sta gon la gnas pa dang / thig bri ba'i cho ga'i gerim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o // //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mos mchod cing phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rim par phye ba bcu bdun par/ /khyod kyis khams kyi bcud len ②gsungs / /phyi rol rnam pa du zhig dang / /nang ni rnam pa du ru dbye/ /dgra dang mdza' bshes bar ma dang / /de bzhin gzhan yang tshad dbye dang / /skams (rmenas dang ni rlan can yul/ /khams kyi sde tshan bsdus pa dag /ngo mtshar chen po 'di dag la/ /bdag ni the tshom skye bar gyur⑤/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal (6/pa/ /da ni sde tshan rnams dang ni/ /'brel ⑦ba rab tu bshad kyis 58)nyon/ /sbom po phra mo'i sbyor ba yis/ /chung ngu la sogs bye brag dag /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun sogs/ /skyes ⑨pa dang ni bud med kyang / /re re zhing yang gsum gsum 'dod/ /nag po ser skya sngo sangs ⑩dang / /rtsub dang 'jam dang yan lag mkhrang / /mdzer ⑩pa can zhes bya ba yin/ /sbom thung bong tshod ran dang ring / /sngo sangs tsomatshungs rtsub mgrin pa ring / /mig ni zangs ltar dmar ba ste/ /phreng can thun mong nu ma med/ /mdog nyams sā li'i skodri dang ni/ /chang 8dang chang min myos pa'i 8dri/ /chang gnyis dang ni chang gsum ste/ /rked pa yi ni bye brag yin/ /sbrang rtsi ltar 'dzag sbrang rtsi'i dri/ /so sor bya yi gzhan du min/ /yid la sems pa'i 'khrul ⑩'khor gyis/ /bu mo'i bcud ni drangs te blugs0/ /'di ni so sor sgrub 8pa yin/ /bu mo gcig 78wa 236

dang gnyis dang ni/ /mang po'i bar du brtag par bya/ /yon tan gsal bar gyur pa ste/ /sgrub po'i dbang po'i yon tan byed/ /nyi shu'i bar du gzhon nu yin / /de rnams thabs kyis sbyang bar bya/ /stobs dang ldan pa gzung ba'i gnas / /de dang 'khyud las byung ba ni/ /rdzas rnams yongs su sbyong byed tsho1 yin/ /bya ba kun gyi mtshams ldan ni/ /byed po za ༷ po'i lam chen yin/ /dngul chu yi ni shing chen pome/ / des na mchu skyes yon tan lnga7de/ /rang skyon 'joms pa yid ches yin/ /de dag ni thun mong gi cho ga'o/ /lto skyes ma rnyings tshanardzas kyi lasasti / /skyed byed don ni rgas pa 'joms/ /lhang tsher dngul chu bcing ba'i 8)mchog /gser sgyur rtsi chen cho ga yis/ /rdzu 'phrul la sogs gsal bar 'gyur / /lhang tsher dang ni dngul chu bzhi/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i gzugs dang ni / /sbrul gyi gzugs dang sbal pa'i gzugs/ / sprin chen rnam pa'i rjes su 'grol/ /⑨gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /de yi tshad ni kun shes bya/ /de yang stobs ldan bcud bral na/ /sngon bzhin nyes pa sna tshogs 'gyur/ /dngul chu lhang tsher kha dog ni/ /sna tshogs dang ldan skyon yin te/ / de yis bad kun skyon dang ni/ /⑩mkhris pa dag kyang skyed 7par byedami / /dmar pos khrag ni skyed par byed/ /dkar pos gzer nad skyed 'gyur zhing / /srog ni 'joms par byed pa yin/ /ljang ser dag ni ma smin dang / /ser skyas bshang gci'i lam ni 'gag /nyis 'gyur cha ni shin du 'ching / /nyes pa dag ni brgyad ldan pas / /blo dang ldan pas dpyad de bza'/ /bcud len sngon por shes byas nas / /'bad pas de ltar bcud len rmonya spyad/ /gzhag 7pa me yi gnas dang ni / /chu yi shing la brten 7pa dang / /'bru yi dbus su gzhug 7pa dang / /bye 78wa 237

ma'i phung por 'khrul 'khor 'jug /gso la kha cig 'bras bu dang / /kha cig me tog 'dab ①mar bcas/ /shun pa dang ni rus pa sogs/ /sgrub po'i ②nye ba'i longs spyod ni/ /de nyid rig pas sbyar bar bya/ /cho ga du ma mthong ba yis(ge bcos ma'am bcos ma ma yin pa'i/ /yo byad dag ni rnyed gyur ④na/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ⑤ni gzhag pa yidang gso ba'i cho ga'o/ /lci ba dang ni rdo nang dang / /ba glang ⑦ma he'i ⑧lhas la sogs/ /cho ga bzhin du rnam brtags ⑨pa'i/ /bcud kyi rdzas ni gzhag ⑩par bya/ /bcud len sngon po shes byas nas1nye/ /'bad de de ltar bcud len bya/ /bcud brtag 8pa'i gnas kyi cho ga'o/ /glang chen mgo yi bcud blugs 8te/ /seng ger skibatso bar 7byas pa yis/ /'bras chan ster ⑩ba'i yon tan 'gyur/ / yang na gso ba'i thabs gzhan ni/ /⑩sha ri sha yi rtsa ba 8dang / /gser shog gis ni gso bar bya/ /mdog dmar dngul chu rmongs pa yis/ /pags shwe/pa dang ni shun pa dang / /me tog 'bras bur ldan pa yis/ /rnon por bcas te btsos tsu )pa dganarje /mnyes na dri ma'i rdul 'thor 'gyur/ /blo gros 'khrul pa med pa yis/ /rim gyis rko gerim gyis mnye 8)bar bya/ /'di dag ni 'jug pa'i cho ga'o / /de nas gci ba'i lan tshwa dang / /phag gi zhag dang tshil dang khrag /bcas pas mnyes na'ang nyes pa 'byang / /slar yang 'byung po'i skra dang ni/ /dza ni ta dang ral pa dmar/ /bin dza ra dang tsam pa dang / /smyo 0byed dag ni cha bsnyams ngate/ /de dang mnyam pa'i sbrang rtsi ru/ /mnyes na rtsi yi zhunyes zad 'gyur / / de nas ( tshom he'i mig par ni/ /char pa'i chu dang bcas pa la/ /zangs kyi phye ma khar 2nyebye dang / /mig 2)sman phye ma blugs shing btso/ /tshos nas 78wa 238

sbrang rtsi'i nang du gzhug /de yis bcings par 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas khrag ni cha bdun gyis/ /sbyangs na snum zhing rtsi la sogs/ /de yi stobs ni zad par ①'gyur / /slar yang cha mnyam khrag dang ni/ /mnyes pas snum zhing lci bar 'gyur / /ra gan tsu ta'i (kyeshing dang ni/ /zangs ma dang ni yung ba dang / /go ra sa ni dkar ③nag gnyis/ /drug pos nyes pa tshar gcod 'gyur/ /de nas tsan+d+ra'i ④shing dang ni/ /sbrang rtsi 'dzag dang sen mo dang / /thal ⑤sman 'bus zos shing phye dang / /ma ha yiha ha mak+ṣa stidang / /pus ka ra dang brta ki/ /ku (pe ba sid+dha ⑨ba ra'i phye/ /bcas par mi yi rkang du gzhug /cung zad bzhag ste phyung nas su/ /rdo gtun brdung ba sngar bshad nyidam/ /'od ma'i nang du blugs nas ni/ /de nas 'khrul 'khor nang du gzhug /btsos nas lhang tsher dngul phye dang ske/ /bcas par rtsi yi nang du blugs/ /lhang tsher dngul chu rnon po yiphonye /cho ga yis ni so sor bcing / /de dag zla ba las byung ba/ /a tra pa ta'i rus pa dang / /de bzhin du ni me tog bzung / /byā sgri 'o dang ni kun tu ru/ /sa ri pa dang sen mo dang / /nor bu zla 'od nā (2ge saratshe/ /skyu ru ra khu ka dmaphonya/ /tsam pa ki ri so pa dang / /shing hunyesho bil ba ut+pa la/ /rang skyur dang ni bcas pa ru/ /'dzag (medang dngul chu khu hu)tshos bya/ /phyung na sbrul gyi gzugs ltar 'gyur / /khrag dang smyo 3)byed yung ba blugs/ /skra dkar nyes pa kun 'joms byed / /mar dang mar nag bskol ba ni/ /gnyis po yang dang yang du bya/ /chu shing a ba marga dang / /snu sbyo )ha pa la sha yi 'dabardo lha/ /so pan tsa na'i bcud dang ni / /thal sman sde yis du )sbyang bar bya/ /sbyang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rang skyur zhucheyung ba dag /rnon po dngul zhustechu'i zas su sbyin( —snye/ /de nas 'og gi lam nas 78wa 239

ni / /'khrul 'khor gyis ni bkru sman bya/ /rgas dang mdze nad sel bar byed/ /rnon po thal sman bcas pa yis/ /bkrus shing bskus hunyen gzhang 'brum 'joms//rtsi dang bcud len rim gyis 'phel/ /rnon po dang ni lhang tsher la/ /thun mong du ni brten snyenas su/ /zha nye blugs pas 'dul 'gyur te/ /de tshe ro ni kha dang bska(2)rka/ /de nas rang skyur nang du ni/ /lci bas btsos na nyes pa 'byang ④/ /nyi ma'i 'od la bsros pas kyang / /spa dkar gyi ⑤ni nyes pa skyedayi/ /bcud ni shin tu bskol ba yi/ /'od kyis zhonasnying dang mig 'joms so/ /de la sbrang rtsi po son cha/ /thig le dag ni byin pas sbyang / /skyon sbyang cho ga sngon du ni/ /gser shog thal sman lan tshwas bsgrubs/ /ro ⑧ni bska ba dang bcas pa'i/ /lhang tsher dkar po'i skyo mas (9)blugs/ /cha ni nges pa dang bcas pas/ /yun ring du ni mnyes gyur na/ /nyes pa 'byang gi gzhan du min/ /gzhan yang cha dang cha can dang / /gi ri kuṇ+ḍa'i 0phye ma dang ⑪/ /drug cha dngul chu bya ba yin/ /cha ni tshad ldan nges par 'ching / /de tshe go zlog ⑩lam nas su/ /'khrul 'khor cho ga bzhin du blugs/ /zhi ga rje 'ur btso 8bar bya/ /de nas tu ru ska tshudang ni / /pa 1snye'i tsakra tshamar da yi/ /sa bon pa la ta ka dang / /ka shi shi gru'i ⑩'bras bu dang / /ba ri tsi 1 ta ka me tog /ut+pal mā nyu)li ka sa bon/ /rgya shug gi ni rus pa dang / /shi ri sha du )dang ku du nyas bon/ /sbrang rtsi po son cha dang ni / /pa la sha yi shun pa dag /cho ga shes pas zhi (srig rjer/ /tshos nas legs par blugs 22par bya/ /de nas cho ga bzhin bton nas/ /slar yang de dag btags pa yis( )/ /phye ma dang ni skyo ma blugs/ /btso ba dang ni bsreg ( snyepa dang ske/ /tshar bcad pa dang mnan dupa'o/ /btso ba thod pa'i 'khrul 'khor 78wa 240

dang | /'od ma bya rog mchu yi dbyibs/ /yib dang khros ①dang 'thor ba dang //chu yi nang du 'bros pa yin②/ /shin tu tshos pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /'dar ba dang ni rmongs pa dang / /du bar 'thul zhing khrol sgra 'byin/ /btsir dang mnye dang dkrug ③pa dang / /brdung ba dang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /sbrang rtsir btso dang bung bar btso/ /glang chen btso dang seng ger btso/ /rgod ma dang ni ka ran dang / /bong bu dang ni rnga mo'i kha/ /bcing ba dang ni tshar bcad la/ /'khrul 'khor 'di dag shin tu bsngags/ /'khrul 'khor gang zhig kha che ba/ /rdza rnga yi ni dbyibs 'dra dang / /'od ma lta bu la sogs pa/ /mtshon ④ca ral gri'i shubs 'dra dang / /gang ku'i mgrin pa bya rog mchu/ /gzhan yang bcing bar gang bshad pa/ /des ni tshar bcad ⑤rjes gzung ⑥bya/ /bzhi cha lus pa bskol chen te / /phyed lus stobs ldan bskol ba yin/ /rtsi la brten ⑦pa'i nyes pa dag⑧ /thun mong min pa de yis 'byang / /sbyang ba dang ni rtogs pa dang / /rmongs ⑨dang de bzhin gsad ⑩pa'o/ /lhang tsher sman ni bcings pa ru/ /dngul gyi phye ma blugs ⑩par bya/ /dpa' bo gcig dang skye gnyis rtsa/ /'bras bu chen po bska 8ba gsum/ /lhang tsher tsodang ni dngul chu bzhi/ /bdud rtsi yi ni snying po lnga/ /dus drug de bzhin drug cu 8ste/ /bdun po yal ga 'dab 7sogs bcas//tsha dang kha ba skam ⑩skyes mchog /mngar dang skyur ba rlan can bzang / /lan tshwa bska 0ba gnyi ga'ang 8rung / /nim pa ba ru ra dang ni/ /a ru ra yi ⑩'bras bu rnams/ /mar nag bskol na bya ba byed/ /skyu ru ra khus mkhris so )sel te/ /bud med 'o mar bskol ba ni/ /'tsho zhing nad med 'phel bar byed/ /tsam pa la dang ba ku la/ /nā 0ga ge sar ku mu da( ge/ /ut+pal she pha li geka 78—241

dang —/ /sbrang rtsi 'dzag dang pri yang kunyarmo/ /ku sum pa dang spri ka dang / /re'u nu ka dang bcu gcig ste/ /me tog gi ni sde ru brjod/ / shrī pha ra (kyel po son cha / /ka pit+tha ri dang la ku tsha/ /ku deb dang ni bar ta ki/ /a ru ra dang ba ru dang 5/ /pa la (6)ta ka (75sgyu ru ra/ /e la dzi dang pu na ka /e raṇ+ḍa dang ma ri tsi ——/ /pi pi ming dang bcu drug ste/ /'di dag 'bras bu'i sde tshan yin/ /bca' 9ba dang 57ni shu dag dang / /yung ba dang ni ru hunyerta dang / /bca' lga hunyedang ni sgog skya dang / /rlan can gyi ni do ba zhu dang / /nā 8 ga pā til dkar po dang ske/ /de bzhin rgan po gzhon nu 7byed/ /ba li ka zhu sdug mtshan mo'i shing / /bcu gnyis rtsa ba yi ni sde(spre'u/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'o/ /glang chen skra dang ri mdzes dang / /'dzag dang byis pa stug yopo dang / /ral ( )pa dmar po dha du 21ra/ /a shwa gan dha rna bdun po ni/ /sdong po yal ga rtsa bar bcas / /ka dmu 22dang gser shing ste/ /de bzhin du ni shi ri sha /ka ran dza dang shi gru 24dang / /nim pa dang ni pi la ( nyesi/ /de bzhin ka du ma dza ri/ /'di brgyad shun pa'i sde zhes brjod/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang a kur ni/ /nag po dang gsum sdong po bzung 27/ /bu ram phye 3nyam ka ra dang / /sbrang rtsi ik+ṣu 22lus 26ka ra/ /sha kha ra dang rnam pa drug /bcud kyi sde zhes bya ba yin/ /khu byug dang ni bya rog dang / /rma bya dang ni thi so )bya rnams/ /'di dag gi ni sha gzung ste / /nyams tsho dang stobs ni 'phel bar byed/ /zangs kyi gtsug pud ghar ka sa ra / /phug ron dang ni ne tso rnams/ /'di dag gi ni khu ba gzung mnya/ /sems can kun la stobs rab ster/ /ra 8)dang ri bong sha ba dang / /sa la gi gi dang phag dang ni/ /khyad par du ni byi ba rnams/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms 78wa 242

par byed/ /khyad par du ni rlung la bsngags/ /ri'u 1)nu ka dang bar thi ba/ /a mra 〈bil ba'i me tog dang / /ma dza ①ri dang 9)lha min dgra/ /su ra si dang ral pa can/ /pa par nā (geg pus pa dang / /ardza (6)ka yi 'dab ⑦ma dang / /ka tu dang ni bi sha na/ /sgron shing rig pa 'dzin pa dang / /yal ga rnam pa lngar ⑧bshad pa/ /'di dag mdza' bo'i sde zhes bya/ /par pa ri dang ga na dang / /dza la dang ni gya gyu dang / /u pi ta yi 6)shun pa dang / /rnag gi dri dang rkun po dang ske/ /khu tra lo ha shu ka ti/ /chur skyes shing dang brag zhun ⑩dang / /sbrang rtsi me tog sgring ga ⑩ra/ /ha ta she 8pa li dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni pa ya si/ /bar ma yi ni sde tshan yin/ /di ra da dang bo la dang / /zho dang kun dur ka da ⑫dza / /thang shing dang ni sra rtsi dang / /po son cha ④yi khu ba dang / /shu dag dang ni gan da 8dang / /tu 0nyi na dang ra las skyes/ /sri chag dang ni ba gu dz+ralhonye/ /sgog skya tu)dang ni mi si dang / /shing du )kun dang ni yung ba rnams/ /dgra bo'i sde zhes bya bar bshad/ /dgra bo yi ni rdzas la khyab/ /gu gul dang ni bṛ ṣa yidang //ki tang de bzhin 'o ma ste/ /bo ra dang ni rang skyur (snyedang / /ga pur dang ni sa la ki ⑫/ /dgu po de dag sla ba'i rdzas/ /mu ra ral pa dmar po dang / /dza la dang ni gya gyu dang / /stug po nad (nyedang ku thi ra/ /ni sha dang ni shi gru nunyedang / /shi ra gca' rdu stob shu dag rnams/ /bcu gnyis rtsa ba la 0skyes yin/ /pu so)thi dang ni ke so dang / /gla ba ( )dang ni sen mo ste/ /gan da ku 'i )ri zhes bya ba/ /lnga po srog chags las byung ba'i/ /dri ru sgrub pos shes par bya/ /shi ri sha dang gser shing dang / /lo da dang ni ji nyeka pit+thas)/ /na gi ka dang pi tsu shun/ /skyur rtsi chen po zhes bya ba/ /bdun po 'di dag shun pa'i sdeji nye/ /tsan+dan gsum dang 78wa 243

a kur nag1) /sgron shing dang ni shing (misha pa/ /drug po 'di dag sdong bu yi/ /sde zhes bya bar da kun tu bshad/ /sgyu ma kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes grags pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las bcud kyis len 94)gyi rdzas kyi dbang du byas pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mos mchod cing phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub pa'i/ /sbyin sreg (gekhyod kyis (6)sngar gsungs na/ /thab khung rnams kyi tshad dang ni/ /'dug stangs yam shing sogs ma 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sgyu ma kun gyis rnam rol pa'i/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che/ /dang po sa gzhi bzung 9)nas su/ /phyi nas hom khung brtsam par bya/ /zhi ba sa gzhi dkar po'i char/ /khru gang tshad la shin tu rlum/ /khru phyed thur du brko bar bya/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag (kyepa yis / /sor brgyad pa yi (9༄rdo rje ni/ /pad+ma'i steng du bri bas mtshan/ /khung nas sor bzhi bor nas ni/ /sor bzhi'i dpangs ha byedang zheng ldan pa'i/ /kha khyer gyis ni bskor bar bya/ /mtshams su rdo rje'i dbyibs lta bu'i/ /rtse gsum rdo rjes bskor bar bya/ /sa dkar nyu)dang ni ba gci sna yis/ /hom ri(2khung kun tu byug nyi par bya/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gnyi gar zhugayang / /dri ni dkar pos byugs nas su/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag nya6pa yis/ /me tog dkar pos gtor bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa la sogs pa'i/ /shar gyi phyogs su las 78—244

de brtsam/ /rgyas pa sa 7)gzhi ser po la/ /rin po che yi 9midabyibs 'dra'i thab/ /yang na gru bzhi pa yang rung / /khru do zabs su khru gang brko/ /de nang sor brgyad bor nas su/ /kha khyer sor brgyad tshad du bya/ /sor (kyebargyad dpangs 94)dang ldan pa la/ /rin chen phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /hom khung nang du 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs (ldebargyad ser po bris pa la/ /'og tu cha drug sor drug pa'i/ /rdo rje rin chen bri bar bya/ /sa ser dang ni dri ser gyis/ /hom khung kun du byugs nas su/ /me tog ser po la sogs pa'i/ /mchod pa dag ni ji bzhin bya(6)ske/ /'di ni rtag tu grong khyer sogs/ /byang gi phyogs char bya ba yin/ /dbang la sa gzhi dmar po la/ /pad+ma yis 7)ni mtshan pa (85yi/ /thab khung skye gnas dbyibs su bya/ /yang na zla phyed dbyibs lta bu/ /khung bu dang ni kha khyer sogasal/ /zhi ba yi ni tshad du bya/ /sa dmar dri dmar 9risogs byugs te/ /me tog dmar po la sogs gtor/ /'di ni grong khyer la sogs pa'i/ /nub kyi phyogs char rtag tu bya/ /mngon spyod pha mes nags dang ni/ /ma mo'i khyim du rtsub pa dang / /gas pa'i sa la bri bar bya/ /gru gsum sor mo nyi shu tshad/ /sor bcu thur du brko tshabar bya/ /rtse gsum khro bo'i rdo rje ni/ /char sprin gyi ni 'od dang mtshungs/ /sor brgyad pa yi tshad tsam du/ /de yi dbus su mtshan par bya/ /khung bu sor gsum bor ba tsho11ni/ /kha khyer sor gsum bskor nyusnyebar bya / /sa nag dur khrod thal ba sogs/ /ci nyu snyed pa yis byugs 47byas te/ /dkyil 'khor khang sogs lho phyogs bya/ /lhag ma yi ni las rnams kyang / /las bzhi'i khung bur 'dus mod kyi/ /slar yang de rnams khyad par gyi/ /khung bu nyage'adir ni bshad kyis 57nyon/ /dgug pa'i hom khung rdo rje ni/ /rtse gcig lta 78—245

bu'i dbyibs 3)su bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyus bskor ba la/ /lhag ma dag ni dbang dang mtshungs/ /bcing ba la ni gru bzhi ste/ /rmongs la rgyas pa lta bu yin/ /dbang ldan gyi ni phyogs cha ru/ /sa ni dkar dang ser por bya/ /bskrad la rimangon spyod lta bu ste/ /khyad par du ni rlung mtshams su/ /rnga mo'i lci ②bas byugs te bya/ /mdza' bo dag ni nyams nas su/ /phan tshun sdang bar bya ba la/ /de yang mngon par spyod pa yi(kye/ /cho ga ji bzhin blta ④bar bya/ /las rnams thams cad bsdus pa yi/ /cho ga de nas bshad bya ste/ /las kun de nyid rig pa yis/ /bsam ⑤pa la sogs bye brag dbye/ /las kyi rjes mthun ⑥sa gzhi la/ /las kyi rjes mthun (3)thab khung bya/ /sngags pa'i yid ni gar dga' ba'i/ /sa phyogs su ni sbyar yang rung / /khru gang pa yi (nyetshad du ni/ /pad+ma ut+pal ⑨dbyibs 'dra byabo/ /kha khyer pad+ma lta bu ste/ /khung dang kha khyer cung zad gdeng 'oste/ /nang du bor /rtasogs zhi ba 'dra/ /phyogs bzhir rdo rjes mtshan par bya / /rgyar ni sor brgyad nyunyetshad tsam la/ /dpangs ④ni sor gcig tshad tsam pa'i / /'khor lo 7rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri mtshon chas bskor ba yi/ /dbus su rdo rje'i mtshan ma bya/ /ngos su rdo rje'i ra ba yis/ /hom khung kun nas zlum po la/ /'og ni 'khor bar bri bar bya/ /hom khung gi ni mcho ga'o/ /yam shing pa la sha dang ni/ /u dum bā ⑩ra a mra chadang / /n+ya gro dha hukyedang pa la sha /ka dam ( )sogs 'o ma can/ /rtse mo ( nyecha las byas pa ste/ /sor ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /rlon zhing 'dab shusnyemar bcas pa ste/ /snying (nyadang rtse mo (stenyams pa dang / /shun pa med cing gas pa dang / /thung dang shin tu ring ba dang ske/ /phra dang sbom tsho snyedang 'khyog 4pa dang / /gas dang chag chadang 'bus zos 78wa 246

dang la/ /rtse mo cha ni gnyis yod cing / /srog chags ldan zhing skams ①pa dag /dge ba'i las rnams thams cad la/ /spangs te sdig pa'i las la shis/ /nas dang til dang 'o ma zho/ / sā lu'i ②'bras chan lasri yang ku/ /ku sha sngon po tsu ta'i 'dabadu/ /me tog tsan+dan dkar po dang / /sbrang rtsi mar dang yos bog dang ske/ /drar ⑤ba dri zhim khu ba rnams/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ⑤zhi ba la/ /ji ltar rnyed pas ⑦bsreg par bya/ /mchod sbyin gyi ni shing rnams la/ /bud shing thab las nidama' bar bya/ /nags kyi lci skam dag kyang rung / /srog chags ldan pa spang bar bya/ /zhi ba'i yam shing dang dhibud shing dang 'bru la 0sogs pa bsreg 0rdzas kyi cho ga'o/ /yam shing zhi ba'i lta bu ste/ /dbus kyi cha ni mdzes pa las / /srid du bcag khru gang du bya/ /dri ser chu yis bla gtor nas ni/ /zho dang 'o ma mar la sbagatso /mngar gsum la ni btags ④par bya/ /de nas zas mchog zho zan dang / /mar dang til ni nag po tsodang / /sha ta pus ⑩pa mar dang bcas/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni sā lu'i ⑩'bras/ /'bru rnams gzhan dang pad+ma dang ske/ /nā ga ge sar bil ba'i 'bras/ /de bzhin drur tsobar bcas pa dag /rgyas pa'i las la bsreg yipar bya/ /bud shing sngar bzhin khyad par du/ /'bras bu dang ni bcas pas bya/ /tsam pa dang ni a sho ka /pu na nā ga nā ṭu )ge sar/ /shin 0tu dmar zhing skyur zhu steb dang / /me tog dang ni 'bras bur bcas/ /yal ga yi ni cha las bya 3/ /sor lnga pa yi tshad du ni/ /dbang gi las kyi yam shing bya//bud shing yang ni skyur ba dang / /me tog bcas pa'i shing la bya/ /me tog dri ngan rnams dang ni/ /de bzhin 'bru ni nag po dang / /phub ma dag ni gtor bar bya/ /de bzhin mi rus phye ma dang / /dug la 2stesogs pa dbul bar bya /78—247

tsha zhing kha dang tsher mar bcas/ /dur khrod du ni skyes pa'i shing / /rtsa ba'i cha las byas pa ste/ /sor 3)mo bcu gnyis yam shing tshad/ /rtse mo rno la rtsub pa ste/ /rtse gnyis dug la 25sogs pa sbag(5) /'ug pa'i sgro la sprisogs pa'ang rung / /drag po'i las kyi bud shing bya/ /de nas mchod yon snod bsham gepa/ /gser dang dngul las byas pa 'am/ /dung dang nya phyis dag kyang rung / /zangs dang khar ba'i rdzas rnams dang / /sa dang shing lo dag kyang rung / /ji ltar 'byor pa bsham 96par bya/ /me tog 'o mar bcas pa yi/ /ar+gha'i (7snod ni mdun du gzhag(8 /dri zhim bdug pas bdugs (9)nas su/ /rang tegi sngags kyis lan bdun bzla/ /g.yon du chu snod gzhag nyastebya ste/ /zhi ba'i las kyi mchod yon yin / /zho dang til du bcas pa dang / /dri ser la sogs ldan pa'i chu/ /rang gi sngags kyis mngon bzlas pa/ /rgyas pa yi zhu ni ar+gha choho:yin/ /dbang la zangs kyi snod sogs 8par/ /dri dmar la sogs bcas pa'i chu/ /me tog dmar pos 'bar ba ste/ /yongs su bkang bas chags par bya/ /chu ni gnag 7cing dri mi zhim / /khrag dang ldan pas bya ba 'am/ /rang skyur dang ⑩ni ba glang ho tshogacin/ /yang na mi yi gci ba 'am/ /yang na bong bu'i gcin yang rung / /phaṭa dang spel ba'i sngags bzlas pa/ /g.yas kyi phyogs nya)su bzhag nas ni/ /drag po'i /rtelas la sbyar bar bya/ /ar+gha'i 3 )cho ga'o/ /nad sogs zhi phyir zhi ba ni/ /snying rjer 31ldan pas dgongs ri rtamo bya/ /dpa' bo shar du bltas 2snyenas su/ /me tog phreng sogs rgyan dang ni/ /bgo sno rib dag ni dkar por bya/ /'jam pa'i stan (snyel gnas nas ni/ /pad+ma'i skyil krung bcas 39nas su/ /dpal ldan rnam snang mdzad bsgoms te/ /rtse sne tshodang ldan pas mi smra bar/ /bsgrub 2bya yi ge oṃ byung 78—248

ba'i / / chu yi 1)dkyil 'khor dkar po la/ /seng ge pad+ma zla ba yi(2)/ /stan la gnas pa dmigs nas su/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i rim pa yis sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /swā hā'i mtha' can sngags bzlas la/ /rtag tu zhi ba'i las rnams bya/ /dbul dang rid pyon)sogs rgyas pa'i las/ /dga' dang ldan pas snga dro bya/ /gos ser la sogs brgyan nas ④ni/ /byang phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /bzang po yi ni 'dug stangs 9nasam/ /yang na rol pa'i stabs 56 kyis gnas/ /'bras chan medakar po zho dang ni/ /bcas 8ri/bza' de nyid rig pa yis/ /bza' dang btung 97bas tshim nas su/ /rin chen 'byung bar bsgoms nas ni/ /yi ge lo las byung ba yi/ /dbang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor la / /glang chen steng du gnas pa yi/ /bsgrub par bya ba dmigs nas 7su/ /sngags kyi 17mthar ni oṃ brjod cing / /rgyas par bya ba'i cho ga sbyar/ /dbang gi don du 'di gsungs te/ /mtshan mo chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas la/ /dmar po'i rgyan gyis bklubs nyusnyenas ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung 1snyeganas nas su/ /rdo rje chags pa mchog tu bsgomasar+sha/ /yo las byung ba'i rlung dkyil la/ /btsun mo'i pad+ma 'jam ldan par/ /bsgrub par bya ba dmigs nas su/ /sngags kyi mthar ni hoḥ5gebazlas te/ /'od zer dmar pos bskul nas su/ /zur mig 3gyilta bas sbyin sreg na1 / /bud med rnams ni rmongs par 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa dang / /dam tshig 'das shing khro ba la/ /snang ba'i sems kyis lhor bltas te/ /mtshan phyed dam ni nyin 18phyed la/ /gos sogs sngon pos brgyan nas su ste/ /mkhrang zhing rtsub ci tshopa'i stan la ni/ /khro bo'i skyil krung tsho lhaganas nas su/ /rdo rje khro bor na bsgom par bya/ /78wa 249

raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bsgrub par bya ba dmigs nas su/ /rtsu dang phaṭa ces bya ba ni/ /'brug gi sgra ltar grags pa ste/ /thog ma dbus mtha' sbyar bar bya/ /bsgrub bya'i las kyi cho ga'o/ /de nas sgrub ①po dpal ldan pas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan nas su/ /gsang ba gnyis kyi ting 'dzin gnas/ /sbyin sreg ②las ni brtsam par bya/ / chu yi ①snod ni g.yon du gzhag④ /g.yas su bsreg 0rdzas gzhag 6)par bya/ /las kun byed pas bzlas pa yisasti/ /rdzas rnams kun la bsang ⑧gtor te/ /de nas bkra shis bcas pa yis/ /g.yas nas bskor la ku sha dgram/ /rtse mo'i cha las byas pa ni/ /dri ma med cing ma nyams pa / /'dab nyamar bcas shing kha dog sngo/ /shin tu ring min thung ba minam/ /'dud ⑩par byas pa g.yas skor rmonyadagram/ /de nas las kyi rjes mthun ⑫par / /thab khung phyogs kyi bye brag gis/ /gzhan yang ⑩shar phyogs skebastan te dgram / /de yis sgor ni bkram nas su/ /de nas thab kyi nang du ni/ /sgrub pa po yis 7ku sha sbyin/ /ku sha'i las ni rdzogs nas su/ /me yi las ni brtsam par bya / /gtsub shing las byung me 'am ni/ /yang na las kyi bye brag gis/ /skye gnyis la sogs me yang rung / /rlung yab kyis ni sbar nas su/ /'o mar ldan pa'i bud shing sogs/ /me ni gsal bar sbar bar bya/ /me ni 'bar bar shes nas su/ /de nas me lha dgug par bya/ /me yi phyogs nas spyan drang ba/ /drang srong gi ni 'khor gyis bskor/ /yi ge raṃ las ⑩yang dag byung / /oṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma ni/ /mdzes pa'i lug gi steng ⑩gnas pa/ /bsam gtan la bzhugs yang dag bsam/ /mdog dang na bza' rgyan la sogs/ /las kyi rjes su mthun hunyepar bya/ /me yi khams kyi rang bzhin te/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba rgya chen 78—250

bcas / /zhal gcig dang ni phyag bzhir ldan/ /rdo rje rtse gsum dbyig pa dang ske/ /bgrang phreng ril ba spyi blugs ni①/ /g.yas dang g.yon du rim bzhin bsam/ /rdo rje lame ni byon pa dang / /thab kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas ar+gha ②sogs byin te/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod par bya/ /las kun byed pa'i chu yis ni/ /bsang (kyegator byas nas zhal bsil sbyin/ /dngos grub bslang ④ba'i bsam pa yis/ /de yi khar ni dgang blugs dbul/ /dge ba'i las la gru mo ni/ /pus mo'i bar du bcug ste bsreg⑤ /drag po'i las la lag pa g.yon/ /phyi ru phyung ste bsreg par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā khyu ta dzā 6)la ya sarba bha smo rjo ku ru sab dusnyi bisdi byas phaṭa/ me yi sngags ni de nyid la/ /las dang rjes su mthun tu)par spel/ /oṃ sarba tsosaspa de 0swā hā/ zho zan 12gyi'onyunye/ /oṃ asna ④ye swā hā/ mar blagyi'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ya hu9swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni ku sha'i'o⑩/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ 8da ha tunyen badzā ya 8 )swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni til gyis sdig pa bsreg par bya ba'i'o me/ /oṃ badz+ra 0ā yu ṣe 37 hā/ zhes bya ba ni drur ④ba'i ste/ tshe spel bar bya ba'i'o ⑤/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa (lhaye swā hā/zhes bya ba ni 'bras kyi ste/ khyim rgyas par bya ba'i'o/ /'bru la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang 'dir mar gyis bsgos te bsreg par bya'o/ /de 'og bsang sum̐ gtor zhal bsil sogs/ /me ni tshim byas 'bar ba yi/ /rnam par yongs su thim par 'gyurazhunye/ /de nas me dbus bdag gi lha/ /rgyan dang na bza' kha dog sogs/ /las kyi rjes su mthun zhu par ni/ /bsam zhing me yi mtshan ma brtag /gser la zhu sogs pa'i kha dog gis/ /me yi mdog 0ni shes par bya /zhi la kha dog dkar po shisadun/ /rgyas pa la ni gser lta bu/ /dbang la byi ru 78—251

bcag pa'i mdog /mngon spyod la ni nag po dang / /sngo sogs mtshan mar shes par bya/ /dbyibs ni dpal gyi be'u dang (1)/ /rdo rje 'khor lo la sogs pa//rang gi mtshan mas brgyan pa shis/ /me ni shin tu dri zhim na/ /dge ba'i las kyi dngos grub ster/ /mi ro'i dri dang nya yi dri/ /du ba che zhing sgra dang ldan/ /me stag gis ni sngags pa sreg /me yi mtshan ma ngan pa ste/ /mi dge ba yi 3)mtshan ma ni/ /mi dge ba yi las la shis/ /de nyid shis pa'i las rnams la/ /shis pa'i mtshan ma ma yin no/ /de nas bgegs ni bskrad nas su/ /de nas slar yang sbyin sreg ( rinabartsam/ /de nas rang gi sngags kyis ni/ /me la bsang 4)gtor byas nas su/ /dgang gzar 'a/cho ga bzhin bkang (6tshol/ /dgang blugs (be lan gsum sbyin par bya/ /oṃ asna (8)ye a mu ka su shārnyi (9)ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /lha rnams tshim par bya ba'i phyir yi ge gsum gyi sngags sngon ski du bzlas pa dang / rang gi sngags spel te rim pa bzhin du bsreg par bya'o/ /de la bsreg nyunyepa'i go rims rmo ni 'di yin te/ dang por ni yam shing ngo / /de'i 'og tu ni mar ro/ /de nas gro dang til /snyel sogs pa'o/ /de nas bza' ba la sogs pa'o/ /de nas zan no/ /de nas zho dang / 'o ma dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa dang / bldag skepa dang / btung rinyelhab la sogs pa'i tshogs bsregs la/ de nas rnal 'byor pas me tog dang / so rtsi la sogs pa skyedabul lo / /de bzhin du rang gi lha yang mchod nas 'dod pa'i don gyi dngos grub gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas mgon po gshegs su gsol nas/ slar yang slob mas me lha mchod de gshegs su gsol na rnal 'byor pa la 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg 3)gi cho ga'o/ /gser ram dngul lam zangs ma 78—252

'am / /mchod sbyin gyi ni shing yang rung / /dgang gzar skyu lho)dang dbyig pa sogs / /tshad dang dbyibs la sogs pa bshad/ /steng du sor bzhi dang ldan pa9kye / /dkyus ②ni gru bzhir bya ba ste/ /zabs su sor gnyis brko bar bya/ /dkyil du ye shes rdo rjes brgyan/ /de yi steng du mchu nga sor bzhi/ /pad+ma'i 'dab (5)ma lta bur bya/ /de dbus bcud ni 'dzag pa yi/ /bu ga mthe'u chung tshad du bya/ /de nas 'og tu dbyug pa ste/ /rdo rje rin chen sor drug brgyan/ /dgang gzar chos ni ster ba'i ma/ /blugs gzar ro ldan thabs yin te/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa/ /rgya ru sor gnyis zabs ⑥sor gcig /kha ni pad+ma'i 'dab (31ma 'dra/ /dbus su rdo rjes mdzes pa ste/ /lhag 98)ma sngon bzhin mtshon par bya/ /sor mo lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /gang ba'i sbyin sreg rishesabya bar brjod / /sor mo gsum dang ldan pa yisanyu dī/ /sbyin sreg cig 11shos bya bar brjod / /zhi ba byang chub mchog gis gzung / /nor bu'i khu tshur rgyas pa la/ /dbang dang dgug pa dag la ni/ /de bzhin pad+ma'i khu tshur gzung 8/ /drag po'i las la 'bad pa yis/ /de bzhin khro bo'i khu tshur bya/ /dgang gzar rtsonablugs gzar gyi cho ga'o/ /dgang blugs zhes bya ba ni gang ba'i sbyin sreg la rmo skusogs pa'o/ /de yi cho ga gzhan bshad bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas dang dbang / /dge ba yi ni las rnams la/ /gdong ni 'dzum 'osnyedang bcas par bya/ /drag po'i las la khro gdong gis/ /yam shing la sogs bsreg par bya/ /de nyid bsdus 97dang bde mchog dang / /gsang dang rdo rje 'jigs byed bcas/ /ti la ka sogs ma bshad pa/ /sbyin sreg 57mdo ru bsdus pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de 78—253

bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las las thams cad kyi gsang chen ①sbyin sreg ②gi cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //slar yang lha mos gar byas te/ /tshig 'di dag ni gsol bar 'gyuradu/ /chung ngu la sogs ji lta bu/ /de rnams bye brag ji ltar lags/ /khams kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs la/ /rdzas kyi mtshan nyid gang bshad pa/ /de dag bdag ni the tshom skyes/ /thub pa chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /da ④ni chung ngu la sogs kyi/ /bye brag la sogs bshad par bya/ /yon tan ldan pa'i rdzas mtshan nyid/ /bshad kyis ⑤shes rab lha mo nyon/ /chung ngu la sogs pa gang dag gi yin pa de dag ni chung ngu la sogs pa buste/ sogs pa'i sgras bar ma dang chen po dang chen po'i chen po dag ⑦la bya ste/ gnas skabs kyi dbye ba rnam pa bzhis rnam pa bzhir dbye bar bya'o/ /rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kun la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi dbye bas bud med dang skyes pa dag bye brag tu shes par bya ste/ /rdzas rnams sbyar ⑧bar bya'o/ /de yang rlung can la ni snum pa'i rdzas sbyin par bya la/ mkhris pa can la ni bsil ba'i rdzas byin na phan 7te/ bad kun can la ni kha ba dang bska ba'i rdzas sbyin no/ /yang rtsub pa dang bsil 0 ba dang snum pa rnams rlung dang mkhris pa dang 0bad kun can la ⑫so sor bsngags so/ /skyes pa dang ni bud med kyang / /re re zhing yang gsum gsum tso'adod/ /ces bya ba ni khams kyi rang bzhin gyis nges pa gsum 8du 'dod pa'o/ /kyang zhes bya ba ni brtag ⑩pa ste/ ma ning la ni bcud kyis len 78—254

mi sbyin pa'i ①phyir ro/ /nag po ni kha dog nag po ste/ 'dzag pa la bsngags so/ /ser skya yang kha dog ste 'pho ba la'o/ /sngo sangs ②ni nag po dang ser po gnyis 'dus pa ste/ 'dzag pa dang 'pho ba gnyis ka dula'o/ /dang zhes bya ba ni rim pa bzhin du sbyar ba'i don to/ /rtsub pa ④zhes bya ba ni ba lang ⑤gi lce ltar rtsub pa'o/ /'jam pa ni pad+ma can zhes bya ba'o/ /mkhrang ba ni khu ba sra ba ste / gang gi khu ba 'thas par gyur pa'o/ /mdzer ⑥pa can ni dung can ma ste/pad+ma la sha mdzer ⑦yod pa'o/ /bud med 'di dag ni bcud bcing ba la dbang bar gyur pa ⑧yin no/ /sbom zhes bya ba ni gdong dang kha dang nu ma 'phel 0kha che zhing sbom pa'o/ /thung zhes bya ba ni bong thung ba dang skra thung zhing chang gi dri dang ldan la 'dod pas myos pa ste/ de dag ni bong tshod ran zhes bya bar bshad 7do//ring ba ni tshugadong dang lag pa dang rkang pa'i dkyus ring ba'o/ /gzhan yang nya'i dri dang ldan pa'i khu ba tsoring du 'dzag pa ste/ dung can ma'o/ /sngo sangs ⑫mtshungs zhes bya ba ④ni dbyangs mi snyan zhing yan lag dang skra thung ba'o/ /yan lag rtsub ces bya ba ni dri mi zhim zhing 'gros dal ba ste/ ri mo can ma'o/ /mgrin pa ring ba ni gang 8gi mgrin yipa mtho ba de mgrin pa ring ba ste/ pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i 'od yod cing yid du 'ong la dus rtag tu rdul gyi dri zhim pa dang /ri dgas kyi mig 'dra la ri dgas ltar lta zhing mgrin pa dang lto 0ri dgas 'dra la rked (nyepa ri dgas kyi rgyal po lta bu ste/ pad+ma can du shes par bya'o/ /mig ni zangs ltar dmar ba zhes bya ba ni mig dang rkang pa dang lag pa shin tu dmar zhing mā ⑩li ku'i dri dang ldan pa dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs la dga' zhing de bzhin du bde ba'i dngos grub ster ba'o/ /pi no un+ta zhes bya ba ni pi na 78—255

ni 'o ma 'dzin pa ste/ de mkhrang zhing skra li ba dang bzhin kun nas zlum pa dang /lte ba'i dbus na ri mo gsum yod pa de ni phreng ba can du shes par bya ba'o0)/ /thun 92)mong ma pu ni gang gi rgyu sbyin par byed pa'o/ /nu ma med ces bya ba ni ngang tshul ngan pa dang skyes pa ltar nu ma spangs pa ste/ yan lag ma tshang ba zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /mdog nyams ④zhes bya ba ni mdangs rtsub pa'o/ / sā li 97dri zhes bya ba ni sā li 765ltar yid du 'ong ba'i dri yod pa'o/ /chang ni stobs te⑦/dam tshig dang spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'o/ /chang min dri zhes bya ba ni khyad par du mi ro'i dri'i rjes su 'gro ba'o/ /myos pa ni shin tu khyad par du tsho gyur pa'o/ /cha gnyis pa ni cha gnyis te cha 1steganyis gnyis bsdus pa'o / /cha gsum ni cha gnyis po de 7gsum du bsgyur ba yinyeste/ spu med pa dang /sha che ba dang / ru 12sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba dang / glang po che'i ze ba ltar mkhrang ba dang / skye gnas yangs pa dang khrag dang khu ba rtag tu 'dzag pa ste/drug po de dag ni skal bzang ma ste/ su bha ga yin la de dag ni sgrub tunyepa po la mchog ster ba yin no/ /de dag ni rked pa'i bye brag go/ /de nyid kyis sbrang rtsi ltar 'dzag sbrang rtsi'i dri 3steste/ sbrang rtsi'i rang bzhin can no/ /so so ni dam tshig gi don dang gzhan skyel so so ste tha dad par sbyar gyi/ gzhan du ste sems can gyi don du ra sā 17ya na la sogs pa las gzhan du ni nam yang ma yin te/gzhan du ni tshig tsam yang sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /'dir ni so sor bsgrub (1pa ste/yid la sems pa'i 18'khrul 'khor gyis zhes bya ba la yid las byung ba ni yid la sems pa ste/ 'khrul 'khor ni shing dang pags 36pa'i rang bzhin gyis shu )'khrul 'khor ro/ /bsgrub 21pa ni des bsgrub par bya'o/ /bu mo gcig ni dang po ste/78wa 256

byang chub dang thar pa'i don du'o/ /gnyis ni dam tshig gi don du'o/ /mang po ni nor gyi don du brtag par 0)zhes bya ba ni khyad par du rdzas bcwa ②brgyad kyi ste/gsal (sde)bar gyur pa ni gcig nyid mtha' yas pa'i yon tan ster ba'i phyir ro/ /su la zhe na sgrub pa'i dbang po la ste/ yon tan byed pa ni de nyid kyis bya'i gdong pa'i rtsa'i bdud rtsis yon tan de yang dang yang du goms par bya bas so/ /byis pa zhes bya ba ni shed ma bye ba ste/ bu mo gzhon nu ma'o/ /nyi shu zhes bya ba lo nyi shu'i bar du'o/ /de rnams thabs kyis sbyang bar bya zhes bya ba ni de rnams nyid sa bon gdab pa'i zhing du gyur pas sbyang bar bya ba yin la/ de rnams nyid thabs yin te mngon par 'dod pa'i don nye bar gtod 90cing ster la 'bras bu mngon sum du byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /phra mo ni yid du 'ong ba ste nam mkha' lta bu'i spyod yul lo/ /stobs ldan gzung ba yi ni gnas (gezhes bya ba la stobs ldan ni nus pa yod pa'o/ /gzung tsurab ni bdag gir bya ba'o/ /gnas ni dbyibs te thur du 'bebs pa dang gyen du 'phen pa'i do la dang kusba (pel sogs pa'o/ /rdzas ni yongs su sbyong zhes bya ba la rdzas ni srid pa'i rgya mtsho'o(lde)/ /de las gru ltar sbyong zhing phan 'dogs par byed pas na yongs su sbyong ba'o/ /kun gab ces bya ba ni srog chags ne'u le ltar kun du 'khyud 99)pa dang / phug ron ltar 'o byed cing sos ma mchu bzung ste 'jib pa dang skra nas gzung 7ba dang /sen mo 'debs pa dang khu tshur snun 17pa dang / sos 'debs shing 'dral ba dang mchan (7nyakhung dang nu ma dang / rked hurtepa dang brla gnyis dang mgrin pa dang rgyab tu sen mos 'dral zhing sid ces bya ba'i sgra chadang bcas par sngags pas sngon du bya zhing / gzhan yang nu ma mnye ba la sogs pas de'i sems 32rnam par 78—257

'dul ba'i bya ba de dag so sor byed pa'i tshul rnam pa brgyad dang sbyar ro/ /sen mo 'debs 4)pa de yang 'jam zhing gzhon nu la ni ku sha'i tshad tsam du gdab pa dang dral bar byas te/ rked (gepa dang rgyab dang bha ga'i steng dang ③spa dang 'gram pa la sogs pa rnams su 'bras kyi gzegs byama'i tshad tsam gyi ri ⑤me ci rigs par chags pa stod pa rnams la gdab bo/ /de yang sen mo 'ba' zhig ⑥ni ma yin gyi/ 'o bya ba la sogs pa ⑦rnams kyis tshim par bya'o/ /gang zhig chags pa sra ba rnams la ni sor mo (8)ring po gsum sbrul gyi mgo ltar byas la/ mo mtshan gyi bu gar bcug 9nyenas/ sid ces bya ba'i sngags 'byung gi bar du brud par byas pas rgan mo la sogs pa tshim par bya ba ni rdo rje sor timo zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig gzhon zhing mnyen pa rnams la ni rang gi mtshan ma dang 'od dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi r+shakāsems 'bab pa'i rtsar lce bcug ⑩ste tsobasgril 8ba tsam gyis dga' bar bya ste rdo rje lce'i thur ma zhes bya'o/ /de ltar sgrub 8pa pos yang dang yang du bsgul bas snying 'dar ba dang dga' bas myos shing sems kyi rdul phra mo'i chu 'dzag la/ ngo tsha la sogs pa dang bral te ba spu langs nas shin tu chags pas lta zhing 'khyud pa la gus par gyur cing sid ⑩ces zer ba dang / de nas skyil krung ( 7bcings la rdo rje dang pad+mo mnyam par sbyor bas do la dang / kub ṇa 'ostedang /su //tsi dang ud k+ṣe 7pa dang su pra sa ri dang / gra ma nā zhunyeg dunyar dang / breng ⑫khe na dang u ru spo da dzo 0zhes bya ba la sogs pa ji snyed bstan bcos thams cad las 'byung ni ba'i kuṇ+ḍa bstan thupar bya ste/ de dag kun kyang rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgyar brjod do/ /de dag gis rang gi don gyi yidangos grub rab tu sgrub pas na de dag sbyo /kun dga' )ba las byung ba'i (bye rdzas ni yongs su sbyong byed yin zhes 78—258

bya ba nyid za ba mo ①zhes bya ste/ de yang ji srid du yul rnams kyi ra sā ②ya na la skyes ①bus dman par spyod cing ④dga' ba'i 'khor lor zhugs nas kyang /skyes bu dman par spyod pa ni/ mi 'pho zhes bya'o/ /bya ba kun gyi lam gyis ni zhes bya ⑤ba ni byang chub kyi lam ste za ba po ⑥zhes bya ba phyi dang nang gi mig la sogs pa'i dbang po dang / gzugs la sogs pa'i yul thams cad gcig tu ⑦bsdus shing rang rang gi tshul dang rang rang gi cha la gnas pa'i nye ba'i longs spyod pa thams cad bsdus te nyams su bstar (8)ba yin gyi7/ gzhan du so so bas ni thams cad la nye bar longs spyod par mi 'gyur ro/ /nye bar longs spyod pa de nyid khrid par byed pas na lam mo/ /dngul chu yi ni shing chen po zhes bya ba ni ji ltar dpag bsam gyi shing 'dod pa'i don thams cad ster ba ltar byang chub kyi sems 'dis kyang 'bras bu thams cad spyod yul du byed pa'i phyir ro/ / des na ⑩chu skyes yon tan ldan/ /rang skyon 'joms pa'i yid ches yin/ /zhes bya ba la gang gis don ston cing gsal bar byed pas na yid ches te/ de kho na nyid la lta bar byed pa'o/ /de yang 'dir phyag rgya'i ye shes kyi nyunyedabang bskur bas dbugs phyung ba yin la/ phyag rgya'i ye shes kyang rnam hu pa gnyis te/ dngos grub sna tshogs dang bde ba 'jug pas rig pa dang rig par bya bar 'ostegazung ngo / /de ltar na dbang po kun las skyes pa'i yid ches pa des dpal dang na so dang nad med pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te/ dpal dang na so dang chags pa dang ldan pa'i zla ba la sogs pa la nye bar spyad pas dbang phyug dang nad med pa dang stobs 'phel ba dang / sems can gyi don du yun ring du 'tsho ④zhing bde ba dam pa de nyid kyis de kho na nyid la blta yonyezhing yid ches pas phyin ci ma 78—259

log pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /rang gi zhes bya ba ni rang gi khu ba ste/ des zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang dgug pa la sogs pa kun du 'gyur te/ de nyid ni rtsi zhes bya ba ra sā 0)ya na'i gtso bor bshad do/ /lto skyes ma rnyings nardzas kyi las zhes bya ba la ma rnyings (lde)pa ni ma rgas pa ste/ 'bu ④la sogs pa dang bral zhing mtshan nyid ldan pa'o(3/ /lto skyes ni mngal nas dang po 6byung ba (7shi ba'o/ /las ni de'i bya ba ste mi snang ba la sogs pa dang gzhan yang gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur 8)ba dang / rtsi la sogs pa'i bya ba thams cad sbyar (9bar bya'o/ /skyed byed don ni rgas pa 'joms zhes bya ba la bdag nyid kyi mthu gang gis skyed byed kyi don rga ba 57'joms pa ste/ skyed byed ni 'byin pa po'o17/ /rdzas des 15skyed byed kyi don nyid rga ba 'joms pa'o/ /rgas pa 'joms pa la sogs pa 1steyang dbang pos o 6tsa ma'i nad rnams la zla ba brgyad du mngal na gnas pa'i byis pa'i ros bcom pa la 12sogs pa yin no/ /lhang tsher dngul chu bcing ba'i mchog ces bya ba la/ mchog ni gsal ba dang mngon sum du gyur pa zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /rtsi ni rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i cha zhes bya ba la/ rdzu 'phrul ni nam mkhar 'phur ba la sogs pa'o/ /cha ni cha shas tshete skyon gyi tshogs yin la/ de dang bral ba las 1 'grub pa'o/ /dngul chu bzhi zhes bya ba ni pa ra ta 18dang / nye ba'i bcud dang / bcud can dang rtsi'i dbang po rnams so/ /lhang tsher bzhi 19zhes bya ba ni dkar po dang ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po'i bye brag gis so/ /de re re zhing yang )rnam pa bzhi ste/ rma bya'i mgrin pa dang sbrul dang sbal pa dang sprin gyi bye brag gis so/ /de la rma bya'i mgrin pa ni mgrin 1pa'i spu ltar sngon dmar du 'dug pa'o/ /sngon po ni bcud 78wa 260

chen po ste lhag par gzung 6)bar bya'o/ /sbrul gyi gzugs ni bye brag tu 'phel bas sbrul gyi dbyibs ltar gyur pa'o/ /sbal pa'i gzugs ni sbal pa'i 'gros lta bu'o / /sprin gyi gzugs ni chu 'dzin gyi 'gros lta bu'o/ /stobs ldan sogs bcud bral na ni/ sngon bzhin nyes pa sna tshogs 'gyur zhes bya ba la/ stobs ldan ni mu zi ste/ de'i skyon ni lci ba dang snum pa dang sra ba dag yin te/ skyon des snga mkho bzhin du 'gyur ba'o/ /nag (0pa dang g.yo ba dang lci ba ni lhang tsher 'a)dang rtsi'i skyon no/ /rdo dang rlan dang lci ba dang srog chags kyis zos pa lta bu dang rtul ba ni rnon po'i skyon te skyon lnga po des snga ma bzhin no/ /rdo dang bcas pa yang mu zi'i skyon no/ / ba bla yi ④ni ser skya'o/ /mu tig gi yang ser skya ste/snying po med pa'o/ /byi ru'i ni snum bag med pa'o/ /khar ba'i ni gser rdo'o / /mu men gyi ni gser med pa'o/ /nor bu'i ni phug pa'o/ /gser gyi ni bcos ma'i lhad do/ /dngul gyi ni 'gas pa dang sra ba la sogs pa'o/ /zha nye'i ni yan lag la gnod pa'o/ / ro nye'i ni sbrul ltar ring ba'o/ /khar ba dang (5)g.yu dang byi stim la la (khesogs pa ni skya (8)bo'o/ /skyon de dag thams cad kyis kyang snga ma bzhin te rin po che'i cho ga'o/ /ma lus pa zhes bya ba ni gzhan srog chags dang rtsa ba la sogs pa yang ste(9ste/ swa sti'i 'dab ⑩ma'i yang nyuteser skya'o/ / ba da zhunyesi'i rlig pa'i yang bcos ma dang ser skya'o/ /sman sen mo'i ni phag pa'i rna ba lta bu'o/ /ri dgas kyi skyon chen po ni nya dang thal sman la sogs pa'i dri lta bu dang / bsregs na myur du thal bar 'gyur ba ste spang bar bya'o/ /rgya mtsho'i sdig pa'i yang cung zad ser zhing skya ba ste/ las thams cad la spang bar bya'o / /tso yung ba'i 8ni mdog med pa dang skya bo dang phra ba'o/ /shu dag gi ni 78—261

ljang gur ④sgrub pa pos shes par bya'o/ /ru rta'i ni bcag na rgya mtsho'i dbu ②ba lta bu'o/ /ka ko la'i ni sbal pa'i gzugs ltar mi mnyam la spun pa ltar yang ba'o / /dzā ti pha la'i skyon ni skya ba dang snum med pa dang sgra chung ②ba'o/ /sug smel dang 'bras bu gsum gyi skyon ni spun pa ltar yang ba ste/ nyes pa gsum skyed par byed do/ /re'u ④nu ku'i ni na le sham ltar chu'i steng na 'phyo ba'o/ /pri ⑤yang ku'i ni ljang gu ste 'gal lo/ /gur gyegum gyi ni ①blo dang ldan pas phra ba dang seng ldeng lta bu dang / ge sar chung ba dang cung zad ser ba dang mar nag ltar mdog med pa'o/ /②u shi ra'i 0skyon ni 'od ljang gur 'dug pa dang / thung ba ste rtag tu spang bar bya'o/ /ke bar ti'i 0gla sgang gi ni chu rtog ma 7can las skyes pa dang zi ma'i 8nang nas skyes pa ste spang bar 0bya'o/ /gla sgang gi ni rlan can las skyes pa'o/ /tshi 8tra ku'i ni kha dog ljang gu'o/ /se ha li'i ni rtsa ba med pa'o/ /ku su ma'i phra ba'o/ /tsam pa ku'i ⑤ni kha cher bye bar shes par ⑩bya'o / /ke ta ki'i hunyeni bu mang ba'o/ /nyon cig lha mo skal chen matso/ /rtsi dang rdzas rnams skye ba'i yul/ /ri kha ba can gyi rtse mo dang / ri bo dbang chen dang /'bigs byed kyi brag las byung ba dang / gzhan yang nags ⑩kyi tshang tshing gang nas mig sman lta bu'i chu rgyun du 'bab pa'i brag las skyes pa ste/ gang dag gis rtsi byin gyis rlob pa'i gnas kyang bshad par bya'o/ /bung ba'i tshogs kyis nam mkha'i ngos su brgyan pa dang / /rlung tshogs mi rgyu de nyid rlung skyes ⑥ kha ba 'babaske/ /sna tshogs shing bu gel ba'i dri yis bsgos 0pa dang / /mkha' las dulha tshogs sangs rgyas sgra yis gsal byed pa/ /sna tshogs dri zhim dri yis rol ba'i yid du 'ong / /sna tshogs shing gi 'bras bu brul bas sa gzhi 0brgyan/ /de lta'i 78—262

ri shod chu 'bab ①bcud ni skye ba'i gnas su bshad/ /de la brag dkar po las ni shel dang chu shel la sogs pa'i nor bu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /brag ser po chu ser po 'bab pa las ni byi ru dang btsag dang brgya byin gyi gzhu lta bu'i nor bu dang nor bu dzi ba ②ni ri dmar po dag las ⑤skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ri'i ljongs gang ljang ⑤sngon du 'dug cing dro ba dang bcas la rlangs pa du ba lta bu yod cing sa rdo gnag pa ⑤las ni (nagaser rdo tsokhar ba dang gzhan dag dang lcags khab len gyi rigs rnam pa bzhi skye bar la'agyur ro/ /brag ljang sngon las ni byi ma ⑨la la sogs pa rnams dang mu men dang nor bu stam pa la sogs pa sna tshogs dag skye bar 'gyur ro/ /brag kha dog sngon dmar sna tshogs su 'dug pa las ni ldong ros dang ba 0bla dang mu zi la sogs pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /brag sum ⑩zhing srog chags dang 8bcas pa las ni tsha la la sogs pa thal sman rnams skye bar 'gyur ro//de dag blang ba yang dang po gtor ma byin la ku 6)ba'i snod du blang bar bya'o/ /dngul chu gang rdo las gci (marlon gyi sbyor bas bsgrubs pa de ni mchog go/ /rig pa de dag lha mo che/ /sbyor ba kun gyi dam pa yin/ /tshangs pa brgya byin sogs 'grub nas/ /gzhan dag la lta smos ci dgos/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba / /bskal ⑩pa dang po bde ba che/ /der ni rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /lhag pa yi ni lha gcig bzhugs/ /lha min grub ⑩pa sogs mthong ste/ /lha yi hunyetshogs ni skrag ⑩gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas ni/ /myur du nga la skul 9 )bar byed/ /thig ler ninyezhu las lha mo che/ /bdud kyis kun du gtor ba ni/ /thams cad rmongs par byed pa yi/ /dngul chu zhes ni bya bar grags/ /chu gting las byung dman pa ste/ /de bzhin ri las skyes pa mchog /da ③ni dri yi 78—263

sbyor ba dga.a /slar yang bshad kyis (5)lha mo nyon/ /dkar po dang ni dmar po dang ske/ /khyad par du ni ser po ste/ /de rnams dbye ba ①bshad par bya/ /mchog dang dman dang bar ma yin/ /ke ta ka 94)ltar dri zhim zhing / /yang na (byesnum pa gla rtsi'i mchog / kha da (6)si ni skam skyes pa'i/ /rlig pa sha chen zlum po (7)shisal/ /sdig pa sngo zhing snum pa dang / /rgya mtsho las ni byung ba bzang sen mo tshon) rta yi mig (9'dra dang / /glang po che yi rna lta bu/ /ba da ri si ut+pal dang ske/ /'dab (1 )ma lta bu rnam pa bzhi/ /gnyis gnyis shing ni bdug par ⑪ sbyar / /a ka aru ni lci ba dang / /snum zhing bya rog mchu 'dra shis/ /gca' ⑫ba sor mo'i dbyibs (7'dra zhing / /dri ma med pa shin du bsngags3nye/ /mu ra ser po nyastomachog yin te/ /skya ⑩bo dag ni dman shes bya/ /shu dag sbom zhing phyi rol ser/ /nang na dkar po yod pa bzang / /nang dbang sha ba'i rwa r+shanya'adra bar / /mdzes pa yon tan ldan pa yin/ /yung ba ku ta na)tsa ltar ser/ /sbom zhing tshigs ni che ba dang / /bcag na mig sman mdog 'dra ba/ /rtsi yi rngo )las la dge ba yin/ /cung zad mdog ni sngo ba dang / /bcag naspen sa ha ra du rteyi dri/ /yung ba de ni mar tsha snyenag dang / /rtsi sayi las la dman par bshad/ /ra na sran ma muṅga tsho 2ltar/ /sngo ba mchog ni yin par bshad/ /pri yang ku ni nags caskyes shing ske/ /sa ha de ba'i 'dab — tsho'adra mchog /gur gum ku sum ( 3dmar 'dra zhing 3)/ /snum la do )ge sar srab pa mchog /ge sar sbom zhing ser ba dang 9/ /sbrang rtsi'i dri ldan 'bring po yin/ /dzā ti pha la sgra che zhing / /rtsi la snum pa shin tu gces/ / rkak+ko la ni 22snyoms pa dang / /lci zhing sgra med bzang ba yin/ /u si na ra ni dkar ba dang / /ring zhing sra ba de bzhin bsngags ste/ /ke bar ti 78wa 264

mud gla sgang ni/ /chu bo'i 'gram dang mtsho ①'gram dang / /dri ma med pa'i chu la rdzunasaskyes / /zi ma 'dab ①bu la sogs bral/ /shin tu dri zhim yid 'ong mchog /tsha ti ba ni gi wang gi/ /mdog ltar 'tshod 0pa bsngags pa yin/ /gla sgang skam skyes mkhregs pa bzang / /rlan snyoms yul nas skyes pa 'bring / /a ru ra ni 'bigs byed kyi/ /nags dang ri bo (snyedabang chen skyes/ /nar ma dā (7yi chu skyes mchog /gzhan dag dman dang 'bring po yin/ /smyung po khyodang ni 'jigs med dang / /'tsho dang de bzhin bdud rtsi ste/ /gtsang ma dang ni 'phel (0ba dang / /rnam par rgyal ba bdun du brjod/ /ri mo gsum po smyung po ste/ /'jigs med ⑨ri mo lnga pa yin/ /'tsho ba gser mdog shes par bya/ /bdud rtsi sha chen zhes bya ste/ /de bzhin gtsang ma sha med yin/ /ser skya 'phel ba zhes bya ste/ /ku ⑩ba lta bu rnam par rgyal/ /dri la smyung po sbyar bya ste/ /bcud kyis len pa (7bdud rtsi bsngags/ /'jigs med rnam par rgyal ba 'bring / /lhag ma rnams ni don med do/ /skyu ru ra ni sha che zhing / /rus pa chung la 'o)ro dang ldan/ /rdo ba can gyi ri las 32skyes/ /shin tu smin pa mchog tu bshad/ /ba ru ra ④ni tha mal pa'i/ /ri las skyes pa'am gzhan yang rung / /a ru rkang 7ni snum zhing sngo/ /lci zhing mar dang bcas pa bzang / /da lani de dag re re zhing ske/ /gzung thabar bya ba bshad kyis //nyon/ /rdzas ni dus bzhin skyes pa dang ske/ /bcud dang bcas pa gzung 19bya ste/ /mthun ripas phan pa nyid 'gyur gyi / /bzlog shunyepas gnod pa nyid du 'gyur/ /da ( nyani tshim par bya ba yidage/ /cho ga bshad kyis 2stelha mo nyon/ /ma dhi dang ni pe〉 snyedang / /de bzhin go 2nidhi dza ka ri lhal / /de dag 'bru dang bcos pa'i chang / /ro yi bye brag sna tshogs de/ /rim 78wa 265

pa de dag brjod pa yin/ /ma dhi rnam pa lngar bshad de/ /pe〉 ①rnam pa brgyad du brjod/ /go di ②rnam pa bdun yin te/ /de bzhin dza ga la ni gsum/ /btso chadang sbyor ba'i cho ga dag /da ni rab tu bshad kyis ④nyon/ /sbrang rtsi las byung dang po ste/ /khardza ra yi ⑤gnyis pa yin/ /rgyan 'brum dulas byung gsum pa ste/ / bcud tshogs 9)las byung bzhi pa yin/ /lnga pa dbang chen zhes bya ste/ /thams cad kyi ni gtso bor brjod/ /rab tu gdang dang ser skya dang / /myos par byed pa thams cad 'byung / /lo di khrulas byung mdog bzang dang / /mchog tu gser po)dang dzi bo dang / /zhi ba dang ni rnam pa phokye brgyad/ /de brgyad peṣ+ṭi 7las byung ba/ /mdor bsdus nas ni brjod pa yin/ /yis skyelas byung dang po ste/ /si tu yi nyunyeni gnyis pa yin/ /gsum pa bu ram gnyis las byung / /bzhi pa skya bo zhes bya ste/ /sna tshogs dang ni de bzhin gzhan/ /mi 'jigs zhes bya dang ni bdun/ /'bras bu yi ni khu ba dang / /me tog dang ni de bzhin gzhan / /nya bu can gyi 'bras bu dang / /tsa kra ang ga ④bzung nas ni/ /na le sham ni drug cu bzhi0/ /skyu ru ra khu srang bcu dang / /po son cha ⑩ni srang phyed bcas/ /chu bre gang du mnyes nas ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od la btso rka/ snabar bya/ /sa har da dri'i me tog dang / /'u su sha ta pus pa dang / /ma la ya dang u shi ra / /ri las skyes pa'i gzhon nu ma/ /dzā ti shing tsha po son catso/ /de dag so sor zho gnyis gnyis/ /bur lho)shing khu ba srang brgyad dang / /chu ni de yi rdzu )bzhi 'gyur bcas/ /sngon po kuṇ+ḍa 9 nyeka ri dang / /rgya spos sug smel 3ta ma la/ /btsod (nyedang nā ga ge sar dang / /u shi ra dang na le sham/ / glang po zhunyeche yi pi pi ling / /bu ram srang ni gcig dang bcas/ /chu ni srang bdun nang du 78wa 266

blugs / /rgya spos brag zhun ②ta ma la/ /rgya spos ru rta ②cha re bya/ /'bru chang bre gang nang du ni/ /thams cad bcas ri te nyin bdun du/ /nyi ma'i 'od la btso bar bya/ /de nas sbrang rtsi de mnyam dang / / 'dzam bu'i ④shing ni (57cha brgyad bcas / /slar yang snga ma bzhin du ni/ /nyi ma la ni btso ⑥byas te/ /sbrang rtsi tsam zhig lus pa dang / / bdug spos (7)kyis ni bdug par bya/ /de nas zla ba gcig tu ni/ /'bras kyi so ba'i nang du gzhug(8) /de nas sa yi 'og tu ni/ /zla ba gcig dang nyin bzhi gzhag⑨ /thog ma tha ma mnyam pa ste/ /bar ma bzhi 'gyur du ni blugs0 / /du hi ga bur gla rtsis bdug /de ni sgeg mo zhes bya yin / /da tri'i 0me tog srang phyed dang / /chang dang mnyam pa'i bu ram dang / /lhag ma'i cha ni rdzogs nas su/ /phyi nas gcig tu bsre bar bya/ /chang gi bcu drug cha dang ni/ /da tri'i me tog ji snyed pa/ /dri zhim gyi ni skyo hu ma dang / /de rnams thams cad gcig tu spyo/ /zla ba re re spel bya ste/ / de yi 91snyenang du sgeg mo blugasasko/ /dang por mnyam por blugs tsobya ste/ /zla ba gnyis la nyis po'agyur bya8/ /de ltar gsum bzhi lnga drug bdun/ /la sogs lo gcig bar du spel / /de nas zla ba drug tu ni/ /kha bcad nas ni sba bar bya/ /bu ram khu bas spel bya ste/ /rab tu myos byed gso bar bshad/ /chu shing smin pa 12rdog ma brgyad / /de bzhin sgeg mo srang brgyad dang / /phur mo'i phye ma srang gcig dang ske/ /'od rtso)ma'i nang du blugs nas su/ / 'bru yi 3 nonang du 31zla phyed gzhag( nye /chags can mchog ces bshad pa yin/ /'bras bu gsum dang sha shi —snyedang ske/ / a ka dzu steru dang ardzu na/ /dzā ti me tog bcas pa'i rdzas/ /phye 2snyem srang gcig bzung nas su/ /slar yang sgeg mo srang brgyad bcas/ /nyi ma 78wa 267

bdun du gzhag lho)par bya/ /me tog myos byed zhes bya yin/ /rgyan 'brum ②ka rta shing dbang phyug /khardza (ba ri yi 9pekhu ba dang / / spa yi 6)rtsa ba rnam pa gnyis/ /pa ta me tog la sogs bcas/ /rnam pa brgyad ni sbyar ⑥bar bya/ /phabs ni bcos ⑦pa'i cho ga yin/ /peṣ+ṭi (shelas byung myos byed de/ /zan las byung ba chu can mchog /tsu (9keta la sogs shun pa las/ /byung ba chang zhes bya ba yin/ /dza ga la ni 'bru chang brjod/ /rgyan 'brum 7sbrang rtsi dpa' bo gcig /skyur po g.yon can zan 517mo yin/ /tsin rtso tsa rtsa ba las byung gang / /nya phyis can zhes bya bar grags/ /me tog gis bsgos nyunyerab myos yin/ /dri zhim dang bcas sgeg mor bshad/ /kha zas mi len rid pa dang / /mkhris skipa can la dza gal ⑫phan / /bad kun can la zan chang phan/ /gnyi ga la ni dzi bo bsngags/ /sbyor bas bcud len ro yi mchog /tsaka ⑩spru ang ga 'o 7sbrang rtsi dang / /ru rta dang ni gla sgang 8gi/ /khu ba dang ni tsu ta dang / /kum pa la sogs gzhan dag kyang / /chang gi phabs su sbyar bar bya/ /chang dang phabs kyi cho ga'o/ /gla sgang dang ni ku tsa phyedang / /yung ba dang ni sgog skya zhu )rnams/ /sings po'i nang du zhag gsum sbangs nye/ /de nas lo ma lnga pa yi/ /khu ba'i nang du bskol bar bya/ /'bras phye dang ni bu ram bcas/ / shi gru'i ( nyekhu ba ra gcin gyis/ /bkrus na dag par 'gyur ba yin/ /sho ban dza dang ra gcin rgya du/ /gla rtsi dag ni sbangs ④byas na/ /de yis dri dang 'bral mi 'gyur/ /kha da si yi rlig pa ni/ /dang po thal bas spu phyi la/ /de nas lo ma lnga pa yi/ /khu 3gebar khwa tshos byas nas ni/ /slar yang shi gru'i 56khu ba dang / /ra yi gcin du sbangs nas ni/ /ke ta ki yi sa snanang bcug la/ /so pan tsa tsoyi rtsa bar gzhug0 /de tsu )ni kha da si rlig sbyang / /78wa 268

shu dag dang ni yung ba gnyis/ /yungs lho)mar rdo rje'i 'o ma dang / /sings po cha mnyam nang bskol bas/ /dag 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom tsho kyimed/ /e ran da (kyeyi khu ba dang / /brag zhun gyi ni chur bcas pas/ /se hal le ni bkrus nas su/ /'dab (snyimar btums te ge'i bas byug phyi /sa yi 'og tu sbas pas 'dag /ku su ma dang 'bras bu rnams/ /dang po ta krar sbangs nas ni/ /bkrus nas shi ri pha (pel yi/ /nang du bcug nas bsros pas 'dag /mu zi tshon mar khus dag 'gyur te/ /ba 99nabla ba lang tshesha yis 'dag / byā gh+ri /1ba lang lci 412bas sbyang / /ldong ros rang skyur gyis ni 'dag /gur gum lho mar gyis 'dag par 'gyur/ /gca' r+sha/ba glang 32gi gcin gyis tenyu9/ /a ka 1 ru ni khrag gis sbyang / /si h+la bu mo'i khrag gis 'dag /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mos mchod cing phyag byas te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcud kyis len ni 18rab sbyor ba/ /gnas ni gang du brtsam par bgyi/ /sde tshan rnams ni sngar bshad pa'i/ /'brel pa dag ni ji ltar lags/ /sbyor ba'i 39rim pa khyod bshad pa'i/ /dgos 3 pa dag ni ci zhig lags/ /mar nag btso ba tsho 1cho ga dang / /yul dang 'brel pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /khams ni bcwa bebargyad bstan pa yi/ /phan tshun bsdus pa ji lta bu/ /'khrul 'khor bye brag bshad pa dag /phyi dang nang ni ji ltar lags/ /nad rnams sna tshogs byung ba dag /ji ltar smin pas 'bras bur 'gyur/ /sbom po'i bye brag du zhig mchis/ /phra mo yi ni khyad par ci/ /rdzas dang bcud len mi 'tshal te/ /khyod kyis sbyor ba gang bshad pa'i/ /dus kyi khyad 0par ji lta bu / /de rnams bdag ni the tshom skyes/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bka' stsal pa/ sgyu ma kun gyis rnam rol pa/ /nyon cig lha mo sgyu ma che/ /sbrang rtsi lta 78wa 269

bur bcud bsdus pa/ /rgyud rnams kun du gsang ba yin/ /gnas sogs ji bzhin mchod nas su/ /bde mchog sngags kyi bsnyen par bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi ①cher mchod ②nas/ /rnal 'byor chen po de yis ni/ /bcud len sman gyi sbyor ba brtsamadu/ /rig ④pa 'dzin pa'i grogs po ni/ /sngags kyi bsnyen par gus pa dang / /skyo dub ⑤med cing dogs dupa med / /dam tshig spyod la gus pa ste/ /dpa' zhing brtan la g.yo sgyu med/ /'jam zhing bla ma'i bsnyen bkur brtson/ /de dang lhan cig bsgrub par bya/ /sgrub pos gzhan du byas na ⑦ni/ /dngos grub 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ /sngar bshad rig pa sbyang ⑧byas te/ /dang po dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /gcer bu'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yis/ /gnyis pas ming sogs dbang ni bskur/ /dbang bskur nas ni de nyid bstan/ /stong dang stong min sogs spangs pa'i/ / ro ni khyimi mchog gis rtogs bya/ /sgo dgu las ni byung ba'i rdzas/ /sbom po zhes ni bya ba ste/ /rdzas ni 'ju bar byed pa yin/ /bcud ni dngul gyi lhag ma yin / /len pa snying stobs zhes byar bshad/ /snying stobs rdzas zhes bya ba ste/ /dngul ni zhu ba zhes byar brjod/ /de ltar rdzas dang zhu ba ni/ /bsdus pa len pa zhes bya'o/ /mun pa phra mo zhes bya ste/ /phra mo nam mkha'i khams mtshan nyid/ /phung po la sogs khyad par dang / /khams rnams thams cad 'tshod pa yin/ /sna tshogs gzugs rnams 'byin pa ni/ /nga yi ye shes kyis bskul yin/ /de dag lha mo skal ༅chen mo/ /rdzas dang khams ni bsdus pa ste/ /brtson 'grus dman zhing tha shal dang / /bsod nams dman pas mthong mi 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus bcud kun gnas yin pas/ /de bas brtson 'grus brtsam par bya/ /78—270

bcud ni bcing dang gso ba dag /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad pa yin/ /yongs su smin pa'i mchog gis ni/ /mnyam med bcud la brten pa yi/ /rnam bcing la sogs nyes pa brgya'o/ /blo dang ldan pas dpyad de (gyedagag /bcud ni nag po sngon po ste/ /bcud ni yongs su grub pa yin/ /dngul chu lhang tsher cho ga yis/ /ji srid bcud chen grub kyi bar/ /de srid du ni 'bad de chadapyad//'khrul 'khor gang zhig kha che ba/ /de ni ka ran rgod ma'i kha/ /'khrul 'khor gang zhig rdza rnga 'dra/ /de nyid bong bu rnga mo'i kha/ /rgod ma'i kha ni 'od ma yi/ /sbu gu yis ni brgyan par bya/ /ka ran da yi ④'khrul 'khor ni/ /ral gri shubs phyikyis brgyan par bya/ /'khrul 'khor bong bu'i kha zhes pa/ /kung ma'i mgrin pa'i sbu gur sbyar/ /rnga mo'i kha yi 'khrul 'khor ni/ /bya rog mchu dang mtshungs par sbyar⑥/ /tshar gcad tso)pa ni sbal ba ste/ /'od ma can gyis sbrang rtsir btso/ /bya rog mchu can bung bar btso/ /rdo leb 'bar zhing 'od dang bcas/ /kung ku'i mchu can glang chen btso/ /ral gri shubs (8)can 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /seng ge ru ni btso ba yin/ /bcud chen yib dang khros pa dang / / 'thor zhing ⑨shin tu tshos pa yis/ /chu yi nang du 'bros par 'gyur/ /de nas glang chen mgo bcud dang / /mu zi la sogs byin nas ni/ /bsregs pas tshar gcad ⑩mnan pa dang / /'og tu sa la bor /larnyanas su/ /'dar zhing rmongs la du bar 'thul8/ /khrol khrol gyi ni sgra 'byin no/ /de nas a shwa gan da lhonyedang / /ba la tsakra mar da tsodang / /ba la ta ka shi gru ste7/ / pa ri tsotsha da ku mu taname/ / ut+pal mā ⑩li ka sa bon/ /rgya shug rus pa ki ḍa/)sa bon/ /ku du ba'i sa bon ma du dang / /po son zhunyepa la sha chaba'i shun/ /phye du snyem skyo mar byas pa yis/ /nang 78—271
