du de nas brdung bar bya/ /cha ni nges dang bcas pas 'ching / /rdzas ni drug cha sbyin par bya/ /de nas rdo yi gtun du mnye/ /dang po re zhig 3)sbyang bar bya/ /de nas gci ba'i lan tshwa (2chidang / /phag gi zhag dang khrag tu bcas/ /dkrugs pas nyes pa gzhom par bya/ /'khrul 'khor gzhug pa bshad par bya/ /tsan+da (pethal sman la sogs dang / /bcas pa rkang gi nang du gzhug / dang po ④brgya rtsa brgyad par bya/ /phyi nas sto skyes bcas pa'i bcud/ /'od ma'i nang du bcug (lde)nas su/ /sngar bshad gnas su gzhag 6)par bya/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu zhes bya ba ni so pan rdo/dza la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang 'bras bu'o/ /ka tu ma dzardza lal sogs pa'i ni me tog dang 'dab 99rim dang rus pa la sogs pa gzung 7ngo / /bcud btso ba'i sbyor ba'i cho ga'o/ /lhang tsher (1)phyogs kyi cha dang ni/ /bcud ni dbang po'i cha dang bcas/ /cha yi 1 nges pas 'ching 'gyur te/ /cha bcus rim gyis spel bar bya/ /dri zhim zla ba re re sbyin/ /gser gyis 0mdog ni bzang nyubyupor 'gyur/ /dngul gyis 15so ni bzang por 'gyur/ /mu tig mig ni dag par 'gyur / / mu men nya9ska dang spu la phan/ /rdo rjes thog ni zlog nyu 'gyur te/ /lcags kyis chu dang mtshon rnams zloganyi /sna tshogs dbang phyug sems dang ni/ /lhang tsher gyis (1spuni brgya byin dang / /me dang gshin rje chu lha dang / /lus ngan la sogs bgegs kun zlogan /nā ga par ni mar sar rtselhadang / /rgya mtsho lan tshur bcas pa yi/ /dngul chu'i sbyor ba mchog 'di yis/ /rgas pa dang ni mdze nad 'joms snye/ /ba lang lce yi na sman dang ni/ /dngul chur bcas pa byugs pa yis/ /gzhang 'brum nad ni sel bar byed/ /ka ri ke sas gso ba ste/ /gi 24ri kur ni ka dang ni/ /ral pa dmar pos bzhu 3nyezhing gsadabu/ /'dzag 78wa 272

dang a shwa gan da 0)dang / /nā ga ba la ba li ka /cha mnyam gyis ni rmongs par bya / / dha du ②ra yi khu ba yis(ge/ /rang gi yon tan ma lus byed/ /de nas snying po kun bsdus pa'i/ /mar khu'i rigecho ga bshad par bya/ /mar khu (5)rnam pa gnyis gsungs te/ /snod dang sems can las byung ba'o/ /dang po snod kyi bshad bya ste/ /'bras bu chen po gsum gyi (7chus/ /snum ster rnams la yang yang bsgo/ /de ni 9)legs par bskams (8)byas la/ /rdul la sogs pa'i skyon bral ba'i/ /sa yi char ni sngags pas bskyed/ /legs par smin cing snum pa dang ske/ /skya 6)bo la sogs skyon spangs gnagabe /legs par brdung zhing 37bsros nas su/ /skyu ru ra khu char chus sbangasanyu2/ /sra ba de yi bdug hu)pas bsgo/ /du med me yis ran par bdug6 /de nas 'khrul 'khor dag gis btsir(lha /dpyid dang sos ka ston dus gsum/ /nyi ma'i 'od la sman mar btso / /dgun stod dgun smad dbyar dang gsum/ /mar khu me yis lte ran par btso4snye/ /gan da pa tra twa tsa dang / /sug smel nā ga pus par bcas/ /ral pa dang ni sa li 3)la / /de dag phye mar byas pa ni/ /til las byung ba'i nang blugs te/ /chu ni mar khu'i bzhi 'gyur bya/ /a ga tsho snaru ni srang phyed dang / /sman gyi bzhi ༷ nya'agyur byas nas su(nye/ /de nas me ni ran pas bskol/ /slar yang ral pa gla sgang dang ske/ /tsan+dan shing tsha ba trar bcas/ /sngar bshad phye ma mnyam por bya/ /de bzhin snga ma bzhin du btso/ /slar yang sih+la dkar min lha/ /ru rta dza la ba thar bcas/ /thams cad bsres pa srang gcig btang 2lha/ /mar khu srang ni brgyad dang bcas/ /'od ma'i nang du blugs nas ni/ /nyi ma bdun du nyi mar btso / /yid 'ong skal rtso ribazang stobs rab ster/ /'dod pa'i don ni phun sum 78wa 273

tshogs / /gal te tshangs pa'i mar khur bcas/ /rnal 'byor can la mchog ster 'gyur / /gzhan yang sba la sug smel dang / /pa ta sgring ①ga rā dza dang / /sen mo ru rta pi sha tsa/ /so sor cha bzhi cha drug bdun/ /cha ni bcu gnyis dag dang bcas/ /'di rnams sman gyi skyo ma ni/ / sngar bshad pa yi tshad dang bcas / /du sngar bshad 'od ma'i cho gas btso/ /gang tshe rkang gi mar khur bcasal/ /nad rnams thams cad 'phrog par 'gyur/ /de nas sha chen mar khu dang ske/ /lhan cig bsres te sbrang rtsi yig/ /snod du blugs te nyi mar bsro/ /nyi ma bdun ni tshun chad kyis/ /ri dgas lte ba dang mtshungs 'gyur/ /sbyor ba 'di ni dam pa ste/ /bsrung bub kun gyi ⑤bla na med/ /ti tra tsa yi 'bras bu dang ske/ /tsan+dan (6༄sih+la shing tshar bcas/ /sngar bshad pa yi mar khu de/ /rkang gi mar dang bsres nas ni/ /sngar bzhin sbrang rtsi'i snod gzhag ⑦sogs/ /de ni ga bur mtshungs 'gyur te/ /skye bo thams cad rmongs par byed/ /de nas ri skyes mar khur bcas/ /'bras gsum gla sgang shu dag dang / /pu ti ta dkar ku su ma(8ri/ /se tsadapa la yi ngar pa dang / /gur gum ⑩dang ni lhan cig bcas/ /sbrang rtsi'i snod du blugs nas su/ /nyin bdun nyi ma'i drod la btso/ /skal ⑪bzang stobs 'phel mdangs dang ldan/ /rtag tu 'o ma btung 'bya zhing / /bsam gtan bzlas la 'bad par bya/ /tshangs par spyod la rtag gnas nas/ /khu ba dag ni dgag par bya/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni bcas pa ru/ /sgrub pos phra mo zla drug bza'/ /de yi bshang ba kun blangs la/ /phra 9/nyemo lhan cig phye mar bya/ /rdza ma sar par bzhag chenas su/ /tsha 8gsum tso ra'i 0phye ma ni/ /nyis ⑩'gyur du na ho byas pa dang / /'byin byed phye ma bcu char bsre4)/ /bu ram gyis zhu 78wa 274

ni ril bu ①bya/ /sgrub po shin tu mnyam bzhag pas(snye/ /nyi ma re re zho gnyis gnyis / /zos na nad rnams thams cad ni/ /'jig 'gyur khyad par gzhang 'brum 'joms/ /mes po yi (7ni cha bzhi dang / /sgog skya (pedang ni bcu drug bsre / /'o ma dang ni lhan cig btung / /nyi ma bdun ni tshun chad kyis/ /gzer nad klad nad (nye'ajoms par 'gyur/ /sings po dang ni lhan cig tu/ /snga ma bzhin du 'thungs yin ni/ /nad rnams thams cad sel bar byed/ /zla drug sbyor ba goms pa yis/ /skra dkar dang ni gnyer ma 'phrog /'bras ni dmar po'i phye ma dang / /ba la'i (7)rtsa ba 'dab (8)mar bcas/ /sgog skya zho gnyis lhan cig tu/ /btags te ril bu 99)byas nas 7ni/ /mar ram mar nag nang du btso/ /zos nas gcin 31dang 'tsham par btung / /des ni rus pa chag pa dag /'byor zhing stobs dang nyams 1lha'aphel 'gyur/ /sgring ga rā yi dza tshangs pa ni/ /rlon pa gci ba dang bcas bza'/ /de yis dug ni 'phrog par byed / /yung ba'i khu ba zho gnyis dang / /de dang mnyam pa'i gci bar bcas /'thungs tson rgyu ba'i dug dang ni/ /shu ba dang ni nad kun 'joms/ / yung ba'i 8khu ba ⑩ba lang hunyegacinas / /de bzhin 'byung po'i gtso bo ste/ /rig byed grangs dang mnyam pa'i srang / /de la zho ni gnyis gnyis btung (ho/ /dpyid kyi dus su cung zad bskyed/ /sbyor ba'i gtso bo 'di yis ni/ /dug dang rims rnams rdzu )sel bar byed/ /gla sgang skyu ru ra dang ni/ /dri rnon dang ni zhag chen dang ske/ /sbrang rtsi cha mnyam phye ma ni/ /khab len lcags kyi snod du gzhag /sbyor ba'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /srang ni sum brgya'i bar du bya/ / ba si (1ta zhes bya ba (nyeste/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /lo gcig bar du sbyor ba yis/ /78—275

yid 'ong yid ni gzhungs par 'gyur/ /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /gnyer ma dang ni skra dkar sel/ /dus kyi rlung dang nyi tshan hu)sogs/ /bsten kyang 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /sbyor ba gzhan la brten (kyepa ni/ /'bras bu med cing log par 'gyur/ /rtag tu bsam gtan bzlas byas nas/ /lo ni sum brgya'i bar du 'tsho/ /pi pi ling dang gur gum ( —)ni/ /cha ni mnyam por byas nas su/ /so ci)ka'i dus su bza' bar bya/ /de rjes gci ba dro 'thungs na⑤/ /kha zas yi gar (6)'ong zhing 'ju/ /nir rku di 9)yi khu ba dang / /gci bar bcas pa sna sman sbyin/ /bad kun las gyur nad rnams 'phrog /de nyid pad+ma'i dri ma dang ske/ /bcas par byugs na glang shu sel/ /ma ra ka da'i (nyertsa ba dang / /so dang sen mo'i rdul du (9skabasre/ /rma ni dang po mar gyis bkru/ /de rjes sman des byugs na ni/ /rma ni 'drub ⑩par byed pa'i mchog /so phag rdul dang sug spel phye(lha / /gi ri kuṇ+ḍa'i hunyekhu ba ru/ /mnyes te mig la byugs na ni/ /rab rib dag ni 'joms pa'i mchog /'bras bu gsum gyi khu bas sbyang / /ma ha ha ta ⑫ka yi 'dabatso/ /'o ma dang ni lig bu mig /'byung po'i chu dang bcas pa ru/ /mig tu blugs nas lo dha yis8/ /bdugs 7na dri ma med par 'gyur/ / yung ba 3 gnyis kyi cha mnyam phye/ /ba yi dar ba nyanyebre dor bcas/ /bre gang lus kyi bar du bskol/ /zhag bdun du ni de 'thungs yin/ /de yis lus ni rgyas 'gyur te( sta/ /bcud kyis len gyi sbyor ba 'di/ /dpa' bo rang 0nyid bshad pa yin/ / yung ba 8gyedang ni so phag dang / /de bzhin btsag shurnyedang smyo byed khu/ /rlung med gnas su gnas nas ni/ /lus la dril phyis byas na ni/ /rtag tu stobs ni 'phel byed cing / /dngul chu bcing ba dag la phan/ /ru rta mur ba 78wa 276

shuka ti gzhi) /shing tsha cha mnyam phye dang ni/ /mang si (0tsha ni nyis (mi'agyur bcas / /dril phyis byas na 'dod pa 'grub/ /brag zhun dang ni so phag dang / /nir gun di ④dang e la tsha/ /cha ni mnyam por byas pa yi/ / yung ba (5)dag ni bzhi 6)'gyur bcas/ /gser shing khu ba cha phyed kyis/ /dril phyis byas na (3)dug 'phrog cing / /gci bar bcas pa'i dril phyis kyis/ /khyi rngo dang ni mdze nad 'joms / /khye'u ngad 6)bu mo gzhon nu'i sha /mar dang bcas pa ci rigs par//rgyun du zos na tshe ring 'gyur/ /mdzes ma las byung me tog ni/ /zos na rim gyis rga ba zhu'o)'joms/ /rtag tu ga bur tsan+dan dag /bsten na nad rnams sel ba'i mchog /de bzhin bzhi mnyam gci bar 1 ribacas/ /sna sman byin na'ang nad kun sel/ /sha shang (7ka dang yung ba sna dang / /kha ba yi ni snying po dag /pad+ma can gyi pad+ma ni/ /sgyung po yi ni khu ba dang / /sems kyi dbang phyug lag mthil du/ /mnyes te rim gyis bsten na ni/ /nad rnams kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed par/ /gdon mi za bar ngas bshad de/ /dpyid kyi dus su bskul bar bya/ /mkhrang ma zhes bya chen po'i chen// de yi hunyegaci ba'i lan tshwa dang / /de yi khrag dang khu bar bcas/ /dngul chu dang ni sbrang rtsir bsre/ /sbyor ba chen po 'di dag ni/ /mdzes ma'i gdong can khyod la bshad/ /rtag tu nad med stobs ldan 'gyur/ /bad kun can gyi 7mi rnams la/ /tsha ba'i rdzas dang lhan cig sbyin/ /thung ngu'i pad+ma las byung ba/ /dang po mkhas pas gzung skobar bya/ /lce dang dkar por bcas pa las/ /sbyor ba pos ni ril bu 7bya/ /zla ba drug tu bsten 3 pa yis/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas par 'ching / /ji srid lus ni gnas kyi bar/ /dug kyang 'pho bar mi 'gyur 78wa 277

rol/ /mkhrang ma las byung me tog gzung ①/ /de bzhin khu gdong bdud rtsir bcas / /sha chen dag ni nyis 'gyur bya/ /rang las byung ba'i sems dang bcas / /de ni zos shing bsten pa yis/ /tshe dang nad med phun sum tshogs/ /rim 'di rtag tu bsten byas na②/ /lo ni sum brgyar 'tsho ②'gyur zhing / /skra dkar dang ni gnyer ma sel/ /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs med 'gyur/ /bshang ba'i phye ma zho gnyis dang / /a pa marga'i thal ba dag /mi yi gcin dang ma he'i gcin/ /bcas par mkhas pas blud na ni/ /stobs rnams bde bar skye 'gyur bar/ /ngas bshad pa la the tshom ④med/ /rdo rje bla ma mchod nas ni/ /de 'og las ni brtsam par bya/ / yung ba ⑤she ka rar bcas pas/ /khrag dang mkhris pa'ang sel bar byed/ /mi mo'i 'o ma srang brgya 6)dang / /rdo rje'i 'o ma srang brgyar bcas/ /skyu ru'i tshikhu ba'ang de tsam ste/ /ba yi 'o ma kham lor gang ske/ /yung ba sbrang rtsi tsan+dan dmar/ /srang gcig dang ni pa tha dgadu /sngar bshad mtshan nyid ldan pa ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni gzung ⑨bar bya/ /sngon bzhin ran par btso 7byas la/ /khyim gyi me tog dkar por bcas/ /dpyid kyi dus su bskul bar bya/ /sbom po la sogs lnga yi ni/ /las kyi cho ga bshad par bya / /nu ma med pa rtsub mo dang / /mdzer 7pa can te gsum pa yi/ /gci ba'i lan tshwa bzung nas su/ /mthe bo 8yi ni khrag dang bcas/ /'gugs par byed pa'i dam pa yin/ /rdzas la rta dang ma te'i khrag /khro bo yi ni khrag dang bcas/ /de bzhin du ni tha chung giphoste/ /khrag dang bcas pas gsad pa'ang 'grub/ /thung ngu yi ni lan tshwa dang / /de nyid kyi ni khu bar bcas/ /ring po'i khrag dang bcas pa yis/ /rgyas pa chen por 'gyur ba yin/ /de nyid srin lag 'byung 78—278

po'i bdag /don yod dbang du sdud pa yin/ /dri yi chu ni rgyal mtshan gyi/ /khrag dang lhan cig bcas nas su/ /lag mthil du ni mnyes la bza'/ /'dod don thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /pad+ma las byung ma rnyed na/ /ro yi lag pa las byung gzung ①/ /rnal 'byor don gnyer dbul po yisal/ /lag pa'i mchod pas yid 'dod bya / /rgyud rnams kun du gang sbas pa/ /de dag thams cad khyod la bshad/ /dbang bskur (pelag tu bkod nas ni/ /mkhas pas rgyab tu gshegs su gsol/ /mdzes ma kun du ru'i sa bon/ /phag gi mche bas ⑤mnyes nas su/ /thig ler byas na rgyu mi rgyu'i/ /'gro ba dbang du byed par 'gyur / /gi ri kuṇ+ḍa ⑥dkar po dang / /pri yang ku ru bcas te blagatso /nyams stobs dag ⑧ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /bu mo gzhon nu'i ④mig rnag dang / /ldong ros bcas pa bsten yin ni/ /sna tshogs dug rnams 'joms par byed/ / bu mo yisngo bsangs mig rnag dang / /klad hunyepa yi ni zhag tu bcas/ /de ni bsten ⑫pa tsam gyis su/ /skra dkar 'joms par 8the tshom med/ /lce dang khrag ni cha bsnyams tsol/ /bu ram 'ol se bzhi char bcas/ /gzhan yang khu ba mar dang ni/ /dngul chu sngar ni bshad bzhin bzung ⑩/ /mu zi bzang por bcas pa ni/ /bsten tson sbyor ba'i dam pa ste/ /zla drug tsam du nges par ni/ /rga dang na las grol 'gyur zhing / /lo ni sum brgyar lho )'tsho bar 'gyur/ /rkang gi zhag dang mu zi ni/ /zho ni phyed phyed sbyar byas la/ /lo gcig bar du bsten na ni/ /lha yi gzugs 'gyur the tshom med/ /nam mkha'i me ni mnyes byed pa/ /su si ra yi ⑪tshad dang mnyam/ /'di ni sbyor ba chen po ste/ /tshe dang nad med 'phel byed yin / /rtsi bsad dang ni bkra shis bcas/ /lhag pa'i lha yi sems par ldan/ /78—279

bldag ①dang gzhib dang sna sman gyis/ /rdo rje'i lus 'gyur the tshom med/ /ce memyang tsha (gyidang gser shing dang / /smyo byed dag la bzhi char bcas/ /tsag ④ka marda sen mo'i rdul/ /so ma ra dza ⑤yung ba dag /thams cad gcig tu sbyor 6)ba yi / /rdzas ni srang gcig bzung ⑦nas su/ /sngar bshad cho ga bzhin du ni/ /mar khu dag ni btso (8)bar bya/ /mi rgyal ta spul sa h+ya de/ /'bras bu yi ni chu dang bcas/ /bzhi dang lnga dang drug bdun cha/ /de dag ji snyed mar de snyed/ /lcags kyi dri ma pri mayang ku/ /so 7dang sen mo yung bar bcas/ /de dag slar yang mar khur btso/she/ /gsal zhing nad med 'phel bar byed/ /mgo bsku ba yi nartecho ga'o/ /pri yiyang ku dang tsan+d+ra 8dang / /kun 7te la ba na'i me tog /sbrang rtsi 'dzag dang ku mu ta'o sna/ /ut+pal chu yi do bar bcas/ /skyer par bcas pa'i skyo ma ni/ / srang gcig tshad du gzung bar bya/ /8'dod pa'i me 〈peni 'bar byed de/ /skal tsu )bzang stobs ni 'phel bar 0byed/ /tsam pa dang ni gur kum dudang / / ba bla'i rdunyekhu bar bcas pa bsku/ /bsku byug gi cho ga'o/ /'byin byed gcig dang mar khu gnyis/ /dbang po gsum dang ldan par bya/ /bska ④ba zhes bya skyu ru ra/ /kri ri ma la e la dzi/ /tsam pa ka dang tsan+dan dang / /nā ga ge sar ru rta ( nyedang / /pad+ma rag ta 0pri rdzu nye dar bcas/ /sbrang rtsi me tog pri 3yang ku/ /pa na ma la phur mo dang / /a pra da di pus par bcas/ /chu yi do ba dpa' bo gcig /sha ta pus pa du cedza la gsum/ /rgya spos dag ni mchog yin te/ /mar khu btso ba'i ṭaṃ )cho gas ni/ /sna sman btung phyedang bsku byug bya/ /sna sman srang chabacu sbyin bya ste/ /btung ba srang ni rnam pa brgya/ /nyi shu lhag pa ༷ mgor bsku buyin/ /dril phyis srang ni sum brgyar bya/ /sman bskol cho ga bshad 78wa 280

bya ste/ /sman ni ji snyed yod pa yi〉kyi/ /chu ni bcu drug 'gyur du btso/ /sman dang mnyam pa'i chu lus pa/ /bskol ba'i cho ga'i mchog tu bshad/ /ki da dang ni ma tshan (kyedi/ /sa la dzang dang gu gul dang / /kun du ru dang a ka rin)ru/ /mar du ④bcas pa bdug spos kyi/ /sbyor 55ba'i mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /sum cu yigasum ⑦pa'ang mchod par byed/ /brag zhun ga bur ru rta dang / /tsan+dan sen mo pi pi ling / /gla rin)sgang bcas pa sngar bshad pa'i/ /rdzas dang lhan cig bsres nas ni/ /bye lam kha ra mar dang bcas/ /bu ram dag ni spang 7bar bya//kham phor 7thod pa'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /ta 12la'i 'bras bu'i nang du gzhuganyin /bdug spos kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis kyi cho ga'o/ /birgyu thukran da kha da si/ /ral pa dmar po pri yang gsum/ /shing tsha 7sen mo ru rta dang / /gla sgang rgya spos 'dag gu ni/ /bud med khrus kyi 'dag chal tshamachog /da ni bud med mngal gang nas/ /rnag dang thal ba nya dri 'byung / /de rnams sbyang bar bya ba bshad/ /dang po dri zhim chu yis bkru/ /de nas lo da 1 bskol bas bkru/ /de nas khri steng bzhag nas su/ /kham por bdug spos kha sbyar te/ /bug pa dag ni dbug par bya/ /de ru sbu gu bcug nas ni/ /skye gnas nang du bdug par bya/ /n+ya gro dha yi shing bu ni/ /mthe'u chung tshad tsam blangs nas su/ /ba yi gcin zhunyegyi nang du ni/ /zhag gcig bar du sbang bar bya/ /de yis 16so ni brud nas su/ /de 'og ru rta a ru ra/ /cha mnyam dri yis so la bsgo/ /kha yi dri ma sel ba'i mchog /gla sgang ru rta e la dang / /sug smel 'u su shing mngar 2 )rnams/ /zos na rnag 0dang sgog dri dang / /chang gi dri ni 'phrog pa'i mchog /pa la ba ni rnam gnyis kyis/ /sbang ba dang ni bsgo tsho )byas na/ /me tog dang ni skyur po 78wa 281

sogs / /sbyang zhing dri yis bsgo ①ba'i mchog /ral pa dmar po ba la dang / /sug smel rgya spos gi'u su bcas/ /sen mo dang ni gla sgang la/ /skyu ru ra ni sum 'gyur blugs / /'di ni khrus kyi sbyar ④ba'i mchog /shing tsha gla sgang rgya spos dang ske/ /pa tra ke par ti yi ⑤ni/ /gla sgang yiru rta sen mor bcas/ /skyu ru ra ni cha gsum bya/ /de dag bkru ba'i 'dag chal ⑦mchog /rgyal po la sogs phyi rol sbyor/ /drug cu (nyertsa bzhi'i rim pa ni/ /bdag las skyes pa lnga ⑨dang bsre/ /rgyal po la sogs bcu drug bya/ /a i o a ste dang po'o/ /bla bo.u e ṛ ⑩gnyis pa'o / /yī i a o ⑩ni gsum pa'o/ / u lī rī i hunyeni bzhi pa'o/ /lha yi gzugs su byed pa yi/ /sman ni de dag bstan 8pa yin/ /dbyangs tshad cho ga shes pa yisasnyi/ /de dag thams cad shes par bya/ /a ni sa yi bdag po ste/ /i ni sa ha de ba yin/ /o ⑩ni rma bya'i cod pan te/ /ā 0ni ngan par sbyor ma yin / /lo snyigi kri hunyeta a dzā li/ /u ni ral pa dmar po yin/ /e ni rtag tu du ba ste/ /ṛ 9 )ni gi ri kuṇ+ḍi 0ka /khri ni tsag kra ang ga 3yin/ /i ni sha si she kha sbyo cher/ /o 0zhes bya ba nyi ma'i shing / /au ⑤zhes bya ba la dzu ba/ /u ni smyo 36byed ces bya ste/ /lī ⑩ni mgo yi lcug 'am yin/ /rī ⑥ni ma he'i rwa ⑥yin te/ /e zhes bya ba rdo rje can/ /ka ni gu gul lo/ /kha ni rdo rje can no/ /ga ni smyo ⑰ byed do/ /gha ni ra ma'o/ /nga dang tsa ni sa ra pod ka dang a ta pa ri'o / /tsha dang dza ni si rmā chadang tsam pa ku'o/ /dzha ni kun tu ru'o(nye/ /nya dang ṭa ni ang ko la dang son tsi 0ka'o/ /ṭha rinyeni ldong ros so/ /ḍa ni a ka tsoru'o/ /nye ni lug ru'o/ /ṇa ni drur chab dkar po'o/ /ta dang tha ni nya dang gan dhi 9ku'o / /da dang dha ni gur kum ⑥dang ro tsa na'o/ /na ni paṃ shrī'o( )/ /pa dang pha 78wa 282

ni sha kha ra dang li shi'o/ /ba hu)ni pri yang ku'o/ /bha ni nā ga ge sar ro yi ma ni sen mo'o/ /ya ra la wa bzhi po ni(kye/ /rlung la sogs pa'i sbyor ba mchog /dzong ④ka an dza li dang ni/ /ral pa dmar po sa ha de/ /dpral bar thig le byas pa yige/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas rmongs byed/ /su ta pa ti ma ('uyu ra/ / ti ka ⑦dza la gzhan mi thubage/ /de dag bha gar byugs 9nyen ni/ / lan cig 7tsam gyis 0bka' nyan 'gyur/ /badzi me sha a ka dang / /a dan dza le 1 thal sman mchog /ral pa ka tam smyo byed dang / /kun ta'i ril bus asnyedabang du byed/ /na ni na ra an dza lis/ /la dza lar ni bcas pa yis/ /chu la shākya'i dbang po bzhin / /rgyal po kri ta an dza li/ /na ri dang ni de ster 8bcas me ni bcing ⑩ba'i dam pa yin/ /bi nyunyesdu he ma badzi dang / /gli /tsho snyedur bcas pa khar bcug na/ /de yi mod la ngal sos 'gyur/ /rgyal po blon po la ta dang / /pa na rdo rje mkhrang ⑩ba'i mchog /pa na sa ha shi kha dang / /me shar bcas pas dug 'joms byed/ /par+ya 9 ci su pa me sha 0dang / /sdi ha bha gar sa blugs na ni/ /mngal na gnas pa skye bar 'gyur/ /ma he'i rwa du nyedang la ta dang / /na ri a nu ba nar bcas pa/ /lag pas 'byugs na rgyan rgyal 'gyur/ /pri thuta tsan di na ra dang ske/ /sa ha de ba khar bcug na/ /mtshan mo dag ni 'jigs med rgyu/ /skag dang rgyal rtsa mkhris ⑦pa dang / /ban du blon po de bzhin te/ /pu 'dra hūṃ /ar thi cha bsnyams 5 )pa/ /'dod dang ldan zhing mngal 'dzin 'gyur/ /sha ta sring ga sa1hasta dang / /tsan+dan gyi ni phye ma dag /sems can thams cad dbang du byed/ /bud med kun la bde ba ster/ /ni ta ke ke dupe ya dang / /skyes bus bha ga byugs na ni/ /dbang du sdud nanyapar byed pa'i mchog /rtsa mkhris ral pa dmar 78wa 283

po dang / /da la dang ni ba dur ①bcas/ / ril bu ②kha ru bcug na ni/ /'khrig ①dus khu ba 'dzin pa'i mchog /ma yu rtsir dang a shu dang / /ar ka me shi (lde)phye mas ni/ /dgra bo rlag (6 par byed pa yin/ /rmongs byed kun ta ⑦gzhan mi thub/ /sa yi bdag por yang dag ldan/ /smig lam yi ni sa bon bcas/ /bya ba kun byed dge ba yin/ /ga ri du hi kra ma dang / /bu dan yi)tsa ri rdo rje can / /rang khrag bcas pa'i skyo ma yis/ /sta re 'bar ba'ang gangs su 0byed/ /a mānyunye/ i khrirtso / u u/ ṛ rī/ bla 'a3ste/ e e/ o yoci/ oṃ āḥtso/a la sogs pas lus byugs na/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mchod 'gyur na/ /sa stengs ⑩skye bo smos ci dgos/ /yang a i o aḥbirnams ni/ /yid 'ong bdug pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / lī u ṛ rka/nyam rnams ni/ /dril phyis sbyor ba'i dam pa yin/ /ā i e khri rnams ni/ /mig sman la sogs cho ga'o/ /u '-i ṛ e 7rnams ni/ /khrus kyi bya ba'i cho ga'i mchog /ka sogs bdud rtsi lnga ldan pa/ /dbang du bya ba'i cho ga mchog /tsa la r+sha )sogs dang bdud rtsi lngas/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs sogs/ /skyes pa bud med dbang du byed/ /ṭa la sogs dang 0bdud rtsi lngas / /dmangs rigs dag ni dbang du byed/ /ta la sogs dang til chen gyis / /dpral bar thig ler byas na ni/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas rmongs byed/ /pa la sogs dang bdud rtsi lngas/ /tsan+dan bcas ( gepas dbang du byed/ /sha ṣa sa ha rnams kyis ni/ /rlung dang me dang dbang chen chu/ /ya la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga ji bzhin rig pa yis/ / bskrad pa tsho snyel sogs byed par 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can 78—284

gyis gsungs4)/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las bcud kyis len gyi sbyor ba dang / sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim par phye ba ste/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// //gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs la/ /gsang chen du ni legs bzhugs pa'i/ /der ni lha mos 'di skad gsungs/ /lha khyod kyis ②ni sngar bshad pa'i/ /mtshon cha lnga yi cho ga dang / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin pad+ma'i nags tshal dang / /gnas bzhi khyod kyis gsungs pa yi/ /dgos pa dag ni ji lta bu/ /bsdus pa'i ming ni ji ltar lags / /de bzhin gzhan yang bri ba ci/ /khyod kyis tsho ba dan gsum bshad pa'i / /mchod pa yi ni khyad par ci/ /de dag bdag ni the tshom gyur / thub pa chen pos bshad du gsol/ /sgyu ma kun gyis rnam rol pa'i/ /rgyud rnams kun du sbas pa gang / /de dag thams cad zhu 'dod pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo legs so legs/ /nang gi sbyor ba'i sdom pa ni/ /rab tu bshad kyis 5lha mo nyon / /stong rgyud sbyor ba la sogs tshogs/ /me tog dag ni bsdus pa 'dra/ /rna drung bar du 'gengs pa dag /lcags kyu zhags pa sogs 76pa'ang sbyar/ /mda' ni myur ba mgyogs pa ste/ /'phen pa mda' yi shugs yin no/ /g.yas dang g.yon ni gnyi ga (7yis/ /'gengs pa mchog ma'i bar du yin / /'dzin pa cung zad gnas pa ste/ /mi 'da' bar ni 'phang bar bya/ / mda' yi 9cho ga brjod mi lang / /da boni phyag rgya brjod par bya/ /sa ni phyag rgyas gdab par bya / /mnyam pa rkang gnyis gshibs 11pa ste/ /yangs pa rgya cher skyed tsho rtapa yin/ /78—285

zlum po dkyil 'khor lta bur ①bya/ /g.yon pa cung zad bskums pa ni/ /g.yas pa brkyang zhes bya ba ste/ /g.yon brkyang g.yon pa bsrang nas (kyeni/ /g.yas pa cung zad bskums pa'o/ /mda' gzhu rig ((byed cho ga yis/ /mtshon cha thams cad 'phang bar bya/ /'di ni dbyibs kyi phyag rgya yin/ /da ④ni lus kyi ⑤mtshan nyid rnams/ /phyag rgya rab tu bshad par bya/ /grims ⑥pa ni mi lhod pa ste snying stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /sran la'adzugs pa ni brtan zhing brtson 'grus ⑧dang ldan pa'o/ /mnyen pa zhes bya ba ni mdzes shing snyan ⑨par smra ba'o/ /yan lag brtan zhes bya ba ni phyag rgyas rma srol cher 'dod pa'i ngang tshul can no/ /rgya cher 'gengs shing rnam par dag zhes bya ba la 'gengs pa ni yongs su rdzogs pa ste / tshad dang ldan zhing yid du 'ong ba'i lus 'dzum pa dang bcas shing mthun ⑩par 'jug pa'o/ /lus kyi phyag rgya bde blag can/ /zhes bya ba ni rab tu rdzogs pa'i ngang tshul can no/ /rims dang 'dug dang dbyig dug dang / /bsam gtan sbyor bas dbug par bya/ /khro bo'i 6shegazugs su bsgoms nas su/ /lha yi dbang por gzhur byas nas/ /klu dbang ba su ta 8yi rgyud/ /glog ni mda' ru bsam bya ste/ /me lce 'bar ba mde rdzi'ur bya/ /sgro ni rlung zhes bya ba ste/ /rnam pa lngar ni 'bugs pa yin/ /lag pa g.yas pa zhes bya ba ni sna sgo g.yas pa ste/de nas spro bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa ni sna sgo g.yon pa ste bsdu ba'o/ /chang pas 'ben ni bsgribs nas su zhes bya ba ni dbang du bya ba'i don to8/ /'gyed pa zhes bya ba ni dgug pa'o⑩/ /de la chang pa zhes bya ba ni rnam par shes pa dang rlung ngo / /mig gdangs pa ni bzhin 'dzum la ⑩dang bcas pa'o/ /lta ba chang pa la gtad ces bya ba ni shi ba rnams kyang 'tsho bar byed pa'i mchog go/ /mda' 78—286

gzhus rnam par tu)rgyal ba yi/ /'bugs pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /smin ma'i dkyus ni gzhu yin te/ /bzlog ②ste lta ba mda' yin no/ /'bugs pa rang gi sems kyis ni/ /gzhan sems don la gtad pa yin/ /rol pa 'gros ni dal ba ste/ /'o ma 'dzin pa mkhrang ba ni/ /bo no u na ta zhes bya/ /bu mo 'di ni yid 'phrog ma/ /thams cad dngos po gsum yin te/ /yan lag mi gsal 'od ldan gang / /de ①ni yang dag gsal zhing 'bar/ /snying gis (pethams cad 'dzin pa gang / /de ni ⑤yan lag bsgrub par stibarjod/ /snying ni pad+ma zhes bshad de/ /pad+ma de ni kun gyis mchod/ /thams cad 'dzin pa mgo bo yin/ /klad 9)pa nas ni kun du rgyu/ /gang gi stobs ni gang yin pa/ /de ni de tshe sbyar bar bya/ /gnas ni rnam pa du mar bshad/ /sha dang pus kur bung ba sogs/ /'dir yang rim pa de nyid kyis/ /sems ni dgug ⑤pa sngon 'gro ba'i / /bdag gi ⑨gdan la sogs pa yin⑩/ /rang nyid kyis ⑩ni rtogs par sla / /brda yis bshad pa brjod par bya/ /gru bzhi la sogs zhes bya la'/ /gru bzhi pa hunyani zur bzhi ste/ /la yig dbang chen dkyil 'khor ro/ /'dab skem can ni 'gru gsum ste/ /me 0yi dkyil 'khor ro las byung / /de bzhin kun nas skum po ni/ /ba dang ya zhes bya bar bshad/ /bsgrub rka/)par bya la dkyil 'khor dag /yi ge dang bcas bsams te bsgrubasaphonya/ /g.yas phyogs nas ni bskor yib ni/ /bsgrub bya'i yan lag kun bsams 'i )pa'o/ /rim gyis gnon sonyacing 'gro bya ste/ /sgrub 9 )po shin tu mnyam bzhag pas( nya/ /rdo rje chags par bdag bsgoms na/ /rgyal srid thams cad longs spyod 'gyur/ /slar yang e ni gzhur byas te/ /ba zhes bya ba mda' yin no/ /mda' gzhu'i rig byed sbyor ba 78—287

yis / /sngar bshad ji bzhin gnas par bya/ /bsgrub par bya ba 'od dmar 'gyur / /mdun du bltas pa nya)bsam par bya/ /gsang ba'i gnas kyi nges pa ni / /sha yi 'bugs par ngas bshad de/ /lte ba'i dbugs ni pus ka ra/ /snying ga (5)bung ba zhes bya ste/ /ge sar 'bugs pa dpral ba yin/ /mig sogs g.yo ba zhes bya ste/ /dbang po'i tshogs ni g.yul 'gyed ①pa/ /mi yi bdag po gsad par gi)bya/ /de dag kun gyi man ngag ni/ /bla ma'i kha las nges par bya/ /'khrul 'khor gyis 55)'phen mi 'phen dang / /zhes bya ba la 'khrul 'khor ni ta la'i 'dab (6)ma dang / gro ga dang ras la sogs pa la ral gri dang / pad+ma dang /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor sngags dang bcas par bris pa stiste/ de ni 'khrul 'khor gyis 'phen pa'o/ /mi 'phen pa zhes bya ba ni rang gi snying ga'i yig ni'abru las sna sgo'i lam nas byung ste dgug pa dang / gzhug ⑨pa dang / bcing ba dang ske/ dbang du bya ba'o/ /lag pas 'phen pa zhes bya ba ni rang gi lhar dmigs te dam tshiganyu ) /dbang du bya ba'i phyir 'gro ba dang 'ong bar byed pa'otusto//'phangs nas /5slar ni gzung 3lheb dang zhes bya ba ni phyag rgyar bcug ste bslang 〈penas thal bar byas la/ slar yang gzung 8ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i yi shes ⑩rang nyid bkug nas bslang ste/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas nam mkha'i ngos thams cad yongs su khyab pa'i du ba lta bu'i ye shes der bkug cing gsos nya cite dam bca'o/ /de nas dgra bo'i gzugs brnyan hunyebyas te/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa ci rigs par bsams nas rkang pa dang rkang par/ lag pa dang lag par/ kha dang khar/ lus dang lus su/ ngag dang ngag tu/ lta po/ba dang lta 3 dībar 'thab cing 'ching bar bsgom par bya ba 'di ni lag dzo 7pas 'gyed 78wa 288

pa ste rnam pa lnga'o/ /ā li kā ①mi mnyam byas nas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ i dzi/zhi tshe/ oṃ i aḥ(ba ka tsa ṭa lata pa ya sha rnams te/ /rab tu sbyor ba ④rgyas par ni/ / bsgrub pa sgrub ༷po rnams la bshad/ /pad+ma gar dbang bsgyur nas su / /bu mo'i gnas la 'dug par bsam/ /e 6)zhes bya dang baṃ zhes pa/ /la zhes bya ba gsum pa ste/ /sgrub gapos 'dir ni yi ge bsam/ /me mar gyi ni rtse ltar bya⑤/ /rtse mo lta bu zhes bya ba la/ shi kha ni mgo ste klad ⑨pa'i gong bu'o/ /rtse mo ni me'i rtse mo ste/ des mar sar kyibum par btsos pa ltar thams cad du bzhu ⑩/bar bya'o/ / de ltar byas pas 'bras bu ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/8 sngags kyi tsomar me 'di yis ni/ /skad cig gis ni 'dar bar 'gyur/ /bu mo chags ⑫pas gdungs nas su/ /ji srid 'tsho bar dbang du 'gyur/ /lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /lugs ma 'am ni bris pa la/ /de yi ming ni bris nas su/ /blo ldan snying gar 0bcug ste bsgomatshe/ /nyi ma bdun ni tshun chod hunyekyis/ /mar me yi ni cho ga yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom tsunyemed/ /gang gi tunyedabang po rdzas yin te/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ste bsgrubadu sta/ /dbang po mig la sogs sgonyepa yin / /rigs rngo nyapa'i sbyor ba lam yin te/ /gang dang gang gi rang bzhin te/ /de dang de yi dngos po yis/ /bde ba nyid du bsgrub zhunyepar bya/ /bde ba sems zhes bya ba ste/ /de nyid du ni bdag bde sogs/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni 'grub mi 'gyur / /bde ba yis ji nyeni 'grub par bshad/ /shin tu bde ba'i sgrub ⑥thabs ni / /thos dang bsam gtan sogs spangs pa'i/ /dman pa dag ni gang gis kyang ske/ /bsgrub 0par nus pa ma yin te/ /skye bo thabs dang bral bas na0/ /tshul ngan dman pa dka' bas bsgrubs/ /bdag nyid sgrub ⑥pa dang bral bas/ /78wa 289

skal med ngal ba don med cing / /de la dngos grub zhes mi brjod/ /a sa ma zhes bya ba ni dpe dang zla med pa'o/ /a dhi (1)ta zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sbyor ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun du rang nyid 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni dngos po thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su mtshon ②cing 'jug pa'o/ /pra ta haṃ zhes bya ba ni nyi ma re re zhing ngo 4)/ /yang na zla re ste zla ba nya la'o/ /yang na lo re zhing ste gal te ma 'byor pa'am/ skal ba med pa dang / 'das pa'i dbang gis kyang rung ste/ de dag gis ni lo re zhing bya'o/ /de bzhin zhes bya ba ni dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ltar (snyebya ba'o/ /yang na de bzhin te slob dpon gzhan med na ji bzhin byin gyis brlabs 6༄nas zhes bya ba la de la byin gyis brlabs nas zhes 7bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi sdom pa ste/ de rnyed nas bdag dang lhan cig tu gar bya ba'o ge/ /sangs rgyas sdom pa ni sangs rgyas dang 'brel pa ste / de su zhig ce na/ gzugs la sogs pa dang / lang 7tsho phun sum tshogs pa'i bu mo'o/ /gar zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas ri spyad par bya zhes bya ba'i don to/ /des ni 'di skad bstan par 'gyur te/ phyag rgya la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams ji nyunyeste rgyun du ma 'byor na des bde ba slar yang rjes su gzung skoba'i phyir/ rim pa 'dis mchod pa bya zhing dam tshig bsrung nyu zhing bskyang bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gzhan yang brdas bshad pa'i don bstan par bya ste/ pra ta haṃ zhes bya ba ni rab tu mang po'o/ /de ci zhig zhe na/ khams bcwa 8brgyad kyi tsamanyam par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i bar du'o / /zla re zhes bya ba ni zla ba dang / dmar po'o/ /lo re zhes bya ba ni lo bcu gcig ma nas brtsams tshete/ nyi shu rtsa lnga ma'i bar du'o/ /gal te de dag 78wa 290

kyang ma 'byor na ji bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas zhes bya ba ①bdag nyid gcig pus bde ba'i sbyor bas dam tshig bskyang bar bya zhes bya ba'i don to/ /phyag rgyas ②dngos grub 'jug par 'gyur zhes bya ba la 'jug pa ni nyams su len pa'o/ /sgrub pa po yi lag g.yon gyis/ /pad+ma'i snod ni bzung (minas su/ /zhes bya ba la pad+ma'i snod ni dum bu gcig pa'i thod pa ste/ de la ka zhes bya ba ni lus so9) / /pā la zhes bya ba ni skyong (geb ste/ dum bu gcig pa zhes bya ba ni ma nyams ⑥shing shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /de la pad+ma zhes bya ba ni pad+ma can nam/ rigs gzhan gyi bu mo yang rung ste/ snod ni de'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi pad+ma yin la de nyid ma nyams ⑦pa ste/ rma med pa zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /lag pa zhes bya ba ⑧ni brtan pa ⑨zhes bya bar 'jug pa'o/ /g.yon pa zhes bya ba ni zur mig g.yon du lta ba'o/ /ba dan gsum zhes bya ba ni bu mo'i bcud 'dzag pa ste de ⑩bza' ba'ol/ /lag pa g.yas pa zhes bya ba la lag pa ni lo nyi shu rtsa lnga hunyama'i bar yin la/ bshes gnyen tsodang ldan pa'i phyir g.yas pa'o/ /de nyid ni g.yon pa ste/ de las byung ba de longs spyad 8par bya ba'o/ /de la longs chaspyad pa zhes bya ba ni ji ltar bla mas nyams su bstar tsob de ltar spyad pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa pos de ltar nges par shes par byas la de nas dus bcing bar bya'i/gzhan du na ⑩thong bar 'gyur ro/ /lhung ba zhes bya ba ni dam tshig las 'das pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /sngags ni bla mas bstan pa ste/ /phyag rgya de la bstan pa yin / /de nyid rtag tu sbyor ba yisam/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor hunyebar 'gyur/ /'di dag thams cad mi rtog pa/ /mi rtog pa yang ma yin te/ /rtog pa med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /mi rtog pa ni brtags pa yin/ /dus drug tu ni bstan 78—291

pa dag /rtag tu rnam par mi rtog gnas/ /rdo rje sems sogs rgyal ba ru/ /de yi rang bzhin yongs shes bya/ /sos ①ka dang ni dbyar dang ston/ /dgun stod dgun smad de bzhin dpyid/ /de dag ma 'dres shes byas (kyel/ /'dis ni las rnams thams cad bya/ /sos ①ka'i dus ni rta mchog ste/ /de bzhin dbyar ni he ru ka /rdo rje nyi ma ston yin te/ /pad+mas rol pa dgun stod yin/ /dgun smad rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /dpyid ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /sos ④ka mar mes mchod (na/bya ste/ /de bzhin dbyar ni chu yis mchod/ /ston ni mar khus mchod bya ste/ /dgun stod de bzhin me tog dbul/ /dgun smad ga bur bza' bya ste/ /khyad par du ni bzhi mnyam gyis/ /dpyid kyi dus su mchod par byarka/ /dus kyi mchod dang mnyam med de(ye/ /sbyor ba kun gyi (7)dam pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma ni thams cad dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang ma mo mnyes/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /mchod na mchod pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rang bzhin de dag rdzogs par ni/ /gang zhig gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sgrub po rnams kyi las rnams ni/ /thams cad byed 'gyur gdon mi za/ /de dag rang bzhin grub pa ste/ /dus zhes bya bar brjod pa yin/ /dus la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yang dag bzhugs/ /dus kun sems la gnas mod kyi/ /de ltar na yang rnam par 'khrul/ /mi shigs pa zhes bya ba ni yi ge rtsu ste/ de yang bdag nyid kyi (8)lus la gnas pa'i hūṃ ngo / /de nyid ni yi ge mchog ces bya ste/ yi ge mchog de'i phyag rgya ni rtsa gsum nas bde ba chen po'i sgor sna'i sgo gnyis nas rlung ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug pa yin la/ de nyid ni ā li kā li ste/ g.yas dang g.yon du'o/ /des 'di skad bstan par 'gyur te/78—292

lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'jug pa yin la/ de'i steng du ni chu'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas ni me'o/ /de nas ni sa'onyu)/ /de'i steng du ni pad+ma'o/ /de'i steng du (ciganas pa'i sa bon ni mi shigs pa dang yi ge'i mchog ces brjod do/ /dbang po kun las byung ba ni(kye / /dam tshig thod pa zhes byar gobarjod/ /mdzes pa phreng ba zhes bshad de(5kyi//de kho na nyid dbu 6)rgyan yin/ /gtsug gi nor bu dbang bskur (7)te/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya rjes gnang yin/ /he ru ka yi dbang bskur (8)ba'o/ /thod pa lus zhes bya ba ste/ /rked (7)pa phreng ba'i ming can yin/ /dbu rgyan bha ga zhes byar brjod / /sangs rgyas khu ba zhes brjod do/ /gtsug gi nor bu bde bar bshad/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i dbang bskur ba'o / /slar yang bshad par bya ba ste/ /thod pa dbang gnyis dam tshig ste/ /phreng ba sngags kyi bdag por brjod/ /bcu drug thig gis 0btab pa'o/ /stong pa dbu rgyan zhes byar bshad/ /a la sogs pa'i ma mo rnams/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra ru brjod/ /de rnams dbus kyi bde ba gang ske/ /de ni gtsug gi nor bur brjod/ /rigs rnams kun gyis thams cad du / /rtag tu dbang bskur (12de lta bu/ /dpal zhes bya ba dga' ba ste/ /bde ba sangs rgyas su ni brjod/ /pad+ma pad+ma nyid yin la/ /nags ni skya reng 1nyazhes byar grags/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems yin no/ /yang na pad+ma lte ba'i 'khor lo ste / /nags ni a sogs ma mo yin/ /rtsa ba thar ba ster byed pa'i/ /brda yis sangs rgyas phyag rgya yin/ /yang na lte ba mtsho rje)sa zhes bya ste/ /nags zhes bya ba ngag yin la/ /rtsa ba lus kyi bla dgas yin/ /sangs rgyas sems kyi brda 914yin no/ /gcig pu nges pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ /dben pa rtog pa spangs pa 78wa 293

ste / /sbas pa gsal bar ma byas pa'o/ /nags ni sngar bshad khams rnams te/ /lhan cig mchog tu 'jug pas na/ /bsdus pa zhes ni ①bya bar brjod/ /lha zhes bya bar rang ming brjod/ /gza' dang skar ma la ②sogs lha/ /a gra ①zhes bya'i sgra brjod pa/ /de ni rnal 'byor shes pa min④/ /a gra ⑤gtso bo zhes brjod cing / /a gra yidam pa zhes bya la/ /a gra 9)dang po zhes bshad cing / /a gra (she)spyi bor gnas pa'o/ /rang gi ming dang ldan pa yis/ /sdig pa dag ni sel bar byed/ /yang na sa ni a sogs te/ /de rnams a gra 0ha zhes bya/ /mgor gnas 'og tu bltas nas ni/ /yi ge tha snyad char ⑩du 'bebs/ /tha snyad ces bya ba ni dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams te de rnams kyis (nya'atsho bar gyur pa'o'i/ /dbyangs zhes bya ba la swa nyunyeni rang nyid kyis so/ /ra ni mdzes pa ste des na me snyig ra'o/ /ha ni skal bzang 8yi ge ste/ /rnam pa'i mchog kun ldan pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis bklubs ⑩pa yi8/ /rdo rje sems sogs lha rnams su/ /bdag gi lus ni bsam par bya/ /bsam tsogatan sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /bsod nams kun dang ldan pa ru / /dngos po gsum ni yang dag gnas/ /bris pas bsod yinams gang mthong ba/ /bsams ‘ )pas kyang ni de bzhin mthong / /slob ma bdag nyid chen po la/ /'di yis dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /dbang bskur yidam pa bsgom byar tso'adod / /gang dang gang gi lha yi mchog /de dang de ni slob dpon 'gro/ /gang dang gang la lhag mos pa/ /de dang de yis 2nyadabang bskur trī stebya/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi dag tu/ /yang dang yang du so tsosor bshad/ /gang zhig sngar ni bshad pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis tsha nyabarjod pa yin/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs 78—294

bya'i phyir/ /bcos ma yi ni sgom ①pa dang / /bcos ma yi ni bzlas pa bya/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs gyur na/ /bcos ma'i sbyor ba phyi rol nas/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs gyur pas/ /bcos ma dag ni mi bya'o/ /dper na gzings la 'jus nas ni/ /chu yi pha rol 'gro bar byed/ /pha rol phyin nas 'dor ba ltar / /bcos ma dag kyang de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs las gang ni/ /bcos ma'i sems kyis gang byed pa/ /phyi rol las rnams gsal byed pas/ /dang po'i las can rnams la bsngagasal/ /dngos grub de kun 'dir gnas pas//rgyal ba'i dngos nyid rig la min/ /gang yang sgra shes bstan bcos rnams/ /drang srong rnams kyis byas pa ltar/ /rang gi sems ni 'jug byed pa'i/ /skyes bu'i bcos ma'i bya ba rnams/ /rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs dunas ni/ /'bad pas sdug bsngal slong bar byed/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ /bya ba'i cho ga la 'bad pa/ /thar pa dang bral phyi rol te/ /skyes bu nyon mongs (pe'aba' zhig (gyebyed / /mi rtog ⑥pas ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /rtog dang bcas pas kyang de bzhin/ /shin tu rnam dag yongs shes na/ /yid 'dod rnams kyi de nyid 'gyur/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin ni/ /dam pa nyid du yod min cing / /rang bzhin gsal ba nyid kyi phyir/ /stong pa nyid kyang ma yin no/ /rang bzhin dbye ba thams cad kyi/ /rnam pa dag ni rnam gnas pa/ /rgya mtsho la ni rin chen bzhin / /thog mtha' med pa'i tshul can yin/ /'jig rten rtag tu tha snyad spyod / /'jig rten las 'das de dang 'gal/ /yod dang med ces bya ba ni/ /rang bzhin nyid du shes pa min/ / 'di yi gatshul gyis rab rtogs pa/ /rdzogs dang bral bas grol ba min/ /rnal ma'i lam la brten na (3)ni/ /thams cad 78—295

byas kyang rnam par grol/ /skyon dang yon tan 'phel byed pa'i/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /bde ba dang ni sdug bsngal dngos/ /lhan cig skyes tunyepar yang dag gnas/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro (kyelas rdo rje sems dpa'i dbugs (5)dbyung ba dang / rang bzhin nyid (henges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste lnga bcu pa'o// //rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdzogs sgos// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ga 6)ya dha ra dang / bod kyi zhu chen gyi lots+tsha chub 'gos lhas rin btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te/ dpe gnyis la gtugs nas gtan shā phab pa9 / tsho

bsdur mchan/2 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉tā/ la〈〈khu 〉〉dza/④〈〈snar 〉〉dgyis/ ⑤〈〈li 〉〉rtags/ yi〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉cig 〈〈snar 〉〉gsal/ (chos
