༄༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ḍā ka nā ma ut+ta ra tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i rgyud phyi ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo / /gsang dang mchog dang dgyes pa dang / /thams cad bdag nyid la rtag bzhugs / /mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ste/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /'di nyid gcig pu lhag pa'i lha/ /'byung gnas sgra gzugs las nges 'byung / /dam tshig spyod yul bcom ldan rnams/ /thog mtha' dbus mthar yang dag gnas/ /'jig rten gsum rnams na rnyed dka'/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs ②pa med/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya bud med kun/ /gnyis med ye shes dam pa yin/ /spyod na ma yang 'grub 'gyur te/ /bde dang spro bas thams cad 'thob/ /nam mkha' kun du spyod 'grub pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes 78—372

rab tu grags/ /sna tshogs phyag rgya thams cad dang / /kun nas sna tshogs sdom pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror rab tu grags/ /so so'i lha la dmigs pa ni/ /de nyid bsam bral rnal 'byor te/ /dbang bskur ba las nges par skye/ /gzugs brnyan rang bzhin rnal 'byor te/ /rnal 'byor chen po byang chub sems/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdag po rang / /byang chub sems ni rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin phyir/ /de phyir kun nas 'bad pa yis/ /sna tshogs rang bzhin la mchod bya/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba khyab par gnas/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang bdag dang ni/ /sems can dang ni nus ldan rnams/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor pas/ /bsgrub bya'i bdag nyid de yi phyir/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /nus ldan kun gyi de nyid ni/ /thams cad rdo rje 'dzin nyid du / /skye ba 'dir ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog / mkha' 'gro thams cad ①mnyam sbyor te/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /nam mkha' pa yi mtshan nyid du/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dang / /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa rnams/ /thams cad sgyu ma ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba kun du gnas pa rnams/ /'ga' yang dmigs pa ma yin no/ /rnal 'byor pa yi phyag rgya 'dis/ /'jig rten gsum du rgyu bar byed/ /rmongs pa gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /mkhas pas de yi rol pas grol/ /tshogs gnas gang ba'i sems can rnams/ /gzhan dang gzhan du gsal skye zhing / /gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma 78—373

yin/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /de bzhin 'du byed rdo rje rgyal/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror ①rab tu grags/ /de dag 'byung chen gcig pu ste/ /thams cad bde ba stsol ba'o/ /rdul dang rdul med du brjod pa/ /sgyu ma chen mo'i ②rang bzhin nyid/ /sa ni ltung bar byed ma ste/ /chu khams gsod par byed ma'o/ /me yi khams ni 'gugs byed ma/ /gar dbang phyug ma de bzhin rlung / /nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /sgyu ma chen mo'i rang bzhin no/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /gtso bo rdo rje de bzhugs so/ /'byung ba kun dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /mkha' 'gro ma mchog 'bar ma'o/ /mig la gti mug rdo rjer bshad/ /thos byed zhe sdang rdo rjer bshad/ /ser sna rdo rje de bzhin sna/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rjer brjod/ /reg la phrag dog rdo rje ste/ /skye mched thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /mig gis mthong sogs stong bas na/ /'di kun stong pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam par rtog med mthong ba yis/ /de ni thogs pa med par 'gyur/ /'di dag nam mkha'i rang bzhin te/ /thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin sems/ /bsgoms ①pa thogs med dang ldan na/ /rnam par mi rtog durab tu skye/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas de skad ⑤bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thogs pa med pa don yod pa'i bde ba chen po'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim par bya ba gsungs pa/ ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas na mkhyen pa mchog dang ldan pa bzhugs par gyur pa de srid du sems can gyi don thams cad nus pa mtshungs pa med par mi ldog ste/ 'di 78—374

nyid kyis na sems can dam pa de srid pa'i zhags pa ni rtag tu mi 'jigs pa dang / brtson 'grus kyis ①sems can gyi don mi 'dor bar rtag tu myur bar byed pa dang / smon lam dag pa'i phyir na nam mkha'i gnas gzhi ji tsam du gyur pa dang / srid pa dag phyir sems can gyi don sems kyi ②'dod pa'i nus pa can te/ de dag ni lha'i bu rnams rtag tu chags pa'i dga' ba can rnams dang /gzhan yang 'dod chags can rnams kyi don du chags pa rnam par dag pa'i phyir na bskal par yang mi zad pa'i bde ba chen po rnam par dag pa sbyin par bya ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas gnas gzhi med pa bskal pa la sogs pa thams cad du bstan pa mngon du gdod ma nas byung ba bskal pa thog ma nas bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'ang der lhag pa'i lha gcig pur yod de/ sems can thams cad skyed par byed pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams ①cad kyi rtse mo ste/ glu dang dbyangs sogs rol mo dang / /dngos po kun bdag de yi phyir/ /da ni kun du bde bar bzhugs/ /sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa yin/ /'dod la chags pa rnam bral ba/ /der byung ba yi sems dpa' rnams/ /gdul bya de rnams mkhyen pa ste/ /yi ge las byung rnam par spangs/ /ye shes 'di de mchod par bya/ /de yongs mchod na mchod par bya/ /de yongs mchod na srid pa zad//'o na ye shes las srid byung / /rang bzhin dngos po bems ④po min/ /de ltar na nga tshor ba ste/ /'gro ba rnam shes tsam du brjod/ /rang rig pas na gang 'di dag /ye shes bdag nyid las gzhan med/ /tshangs pa'i sgong brjod rang bzhin med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam bdag med de/ /sems can mang yang 'ga' yis kyang / /sems can don gang yod min la/ /bla med sangs rgyas 78—375

don yang med/ /bdag don dang ni gzhan don dang / /de las gzhan pa'i nus pa med/ /stong pa nyid la rtag gnas na/ /de las 'gro ba'i don du 'ong / /de med sems can don kun med/ /dmyal bar yang ni 'gro 'gyur te/ /de nas gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi/ /khams rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas ni/ /nga la myur du bskul bar byas/ /ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥ.aḥ bam̐ hoḥcha su ra ta sdig/ nga la 'di yis bskul ma thag /kun la bde ba stsol ba'o/ /'dod pa dag pa don grub pa/ /'gro ba thams cad bde ba bskyedadu/ /nga ni 'dod pa mchog gi gzugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /nga yang chos kyi 'dod pa can/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'dod chags che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde chen po//sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung dbyangs yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sems chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal po che/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi bdag /rin chen kun bdag dbang phyug ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni thams cad dang / /mnyam pa nyid du rab sbyor phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun kyang mnyam sbyor yin/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ⑤rab tu brjod/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba dkyil 'khor thams cad bri bar bya ste/ de dbus ji lta'i tshul du ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam dgod de/ /zla ba'i mdog la 'dzum bag can/ /de bzhin 'od zer dmar po 'khrigs/ /sangs rgyas phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /rig ma bzhi dang mnyam 78—376

par ldan/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyis nye bar mdzes/ /g.yas zhal zhi ba dkar po yin/ /de bzhin g.yon pa ①dmar po mchog /nub kyi yang ni ser po ②mtshungs/ /thod pa la bzhugs gar dang ldan/ /lha rnams 'jigs par mdzad pa po②/ /rdo rje dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ du'adzin/ /dril bu thod pa de bzhin no/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang mnyam ldan/ /rgya chen por ni bri bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang mnyam mol/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ma dang cha blangs ma nyid dang / /gnyen mo de bzhin bzho byas la/ /gnyis gnyis sbyor bas 'dod spyad nas/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster/ /ba lang sha dang rta sha sogs/ /thogs pa med par bza' bar bya /'jig rten la rtag g.yon la spyad/ /'bad rjode g.yon pas bsnyen bkur rgyabya/ /brtan dang g.yo la sogs pa yi/ /'gro kun g.yon las byung bas na/ /pho nya mo la chags bral bas/ /grol ba nyid du 'gro ba min/ /rtag tu pho nya mor chags grolani/ /'di la the tshom ⑨yod ma yin/ /sgrub pos de la 'bad byas na/ /brtul zhugs med na'ang brtul zhugs rdzogs/ /dam tshig gzhung lugs la spyod cing / /zas gcig tu ni mdzes par bza'/ /rigs gcig gi ni mtshan nyid phyir/ /rigs lnga la ni mnyam par spyod/ /sbrang rtsi mtshal dang ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar po dang sbyar te/ /rdo rje las byung mnyam ldan pa/ /'di dag bdud rtsi lnga yin te/ /dngos grub kun ni rab stsol ⑩mdzad/ /sbom po mtha' ltag kha sbyar bas/ /rtag 7tu rnal 'byor bzhin blangs te/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na/ /dngos grub rtag par 'thob 8par 'gyur/ /mchog gi dam 78—377

tshig 'di rnams ni/ /zhal bzang mo khyod la bshad yin/ /thabs dang bcas pa'i las rnams kun/ /thogs chags med par rtag tu spyod/ /rnam par rtog ①med bsgoms ②pa yis/ /brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rnam par rtog med bsgoms pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad rtag tu bya/ /thogs pa med pas spyod pa ni/ /de bzhin dka' ②thub rnams kyi mchog /thogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /skra shad 'dzings pa 'dra bar ni/ /yid la yul rnams rten dubyed pa/ /de ni 'da' dka'i dka' thub yin/ /gang zhig las rnams thams cad la/ /shes rab kyis ni nges par spyad/ /stong pa'i man ngag can de ni/ /bdag nyid chen po'i dka' thub 'di'o/ /shes rab gzugs brnyan lta bu la / /rnam rtog med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /don la thogs pa med spyod ma/ /de yi dka' ⑤thub bdag nyid yin/ /shes rab thabs las gzhan pa min/ /gang gis dusems ni gnas mi bya/ /de 'drar yang dag gnas byas na/ /byang chub chen po nye bar ster/ /rnam par mi rtog rjes gnas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa la mngon ldan na/ /de rnams kyi ni 'byung ba kun/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par nges/ /shes rab me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /'dus byas dngos po de 'dra bar/ /shes rab blo yis dran par bya/ /de yi rnam rtog med sems ni/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang / /rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur bzhin/ /mig ⑦'phrul lta bur blta ba ni/ /de ni gtso bo yin par bshad/ /glog dang dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /'dus byas 'di dag rnam par smin/ /'di ltar dngos rnams rab gsal bar/ /gang de'i rnam grangs rtse mo mchog /des na sems ni gang zhig tu/ /gnas pa yod par gzhag pa min/ /'di dag lta bur kun du 78—378

byung ba'i dngos po rnams kyang sgyu ma khyad par can rnams yang dag par rdzogs par longs spyod pa bskyed de/ bde bas yongs su bzhu bas khyad par can 'ga' zhig tu rdzogs par longs spyod pa skye'o/ /bzang po yongs su gyur pas ni 'bras bu khyad par can 'ga' 'thob bo/ /des ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po rnams grib ma lta bu las gzhan 'ga' ci yang ma mthong ngo / /gang yang khyad par 'di dag bsgom pa goms pa'i stobs las bde ba mchog tu zhi ba la sogs pa'i khyad par can gyi dgos pa bskyed na bla na med pa'i 'bras bu mngon du thob par byed pa'i rgyu'i dngos por 'gyur ba de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das skyon 'ga' yang ma mchis so/ /de'i phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rab tu mchod par kun du gnas / /dka' thub sdug bsngal drag po yis/ /rmongs pa brkams ①shing sdug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs pa/ /g.yengs pa yis ni dngos grub med/ /bde ba kun du brtan 'gyur ba/ /sems kyi rang bzhin brtan 'gyur gyi/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yo zhing / /'gog par yang ni lhag par 'gro/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ /bde bar gnas na byang chub 'thob/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang / /dmyal bar nges par ltung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin ②rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las/mchog gi de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa dang / yul la shes pa 'jug pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //78—379

de nas bcom ldan 'das la yang lha mos mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /snying po gang gis gdug pa can rab tu 'dul ba ste/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa la smod pa'i gdug pa can thams cad 'dul ba dang / lha gdug pa can la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad gdul zhing zhi ba'i gnas la brtul ①te/ byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du gdug pa byed par mi 'gyur bar gnas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag pos 'di glur blangs te bka' stsal to/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad gzhag /de rjes rjod byed ②tha ma ste/ /rgyu ba der lhung nga ③yis mthong / /snying po'i spyi bor gsum pas brgyan/ /la yi mtha' na gnas pa la/ /steng du yi ge sa dang ldan/ /gnyis pa yis ni mnyes bya 0ste/ /snying po de la a yig ldan/ /sa mtha' kun dngos de nyid do/ /rjod byed dang ni rjod byed stedu/ /rjod byed lnga pas gdan du byas/ /zla phyed thig les brgyan pa can/ /dbus gnas pa las zha bor ldan/ /sreg pa'i mtha' yis yongs su brgyan/ /sa yi de ma thag gnas pa/ /rlung gzugs su gnas 'og tu sbyar/ /de 'og lhu lhu ༷thung ngu gnyis / /yi ge phaṭa dang bcas rdzogs pa/ /i dngos yi ger rdzogs par ldan/ /lnga pa'i dbus na gnas de la/ /gzhan pa'i i yis steng du brgyan/ /de nas rjod ⑦byed ra la zhon/ /spyi gtsug tu gnas dbang phyug dang / /rjod nibyed pa yi 'khor 'gyur ba/ /yang dang yang du gzhag par bya/ /rjod byed ra la bskyon pa dang / /e yig rna ba dag la brgyan/ /de nas rjod byed ra nyid ni/ /yang ni lnga pa dag la bskyon/ /'di yang thams cad pa nyid de/ /rjod ⑨byed mgo 78—380

bor zla phyed brgyan/ /lnga pa dang ldan nyis 'gyur bya/ /kun gyi mgon po de nyid mchog /phaṭa dang rin chen dag gis brgyan/ /ha ni mjug thogs nyid du'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi tshogs kun la yongs su mnyes par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas dpa' bo drug dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i sdom pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yang 'dir hūṃ yig las byung bar/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi dkyil 'khor/ /las kyi rdo rje dbus gnas par/ /de nyid r+ghaṃ ni rnam bsgoms te/ /'od phreng du ma ldan pa yi / /mkha' 'gro yi ni 'khor lo spro/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /kha dog dmar mo 'jigs chen mo/ /'jigs pa'i dngos po'i nga ro can/ /spyan gsum dbu skra kham ser gyen/ /na so gzhon byed phun tshogs ma/ /stag gi pags ①pa'i smad dkris can/ /'jigs byed chen po ljags 'dril ma/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs mdzad ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun dang mnyam sbyor/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror ②rab grub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sngon gyi rim pa ji bzhin dang / /me dang mnyam pa gnyis brjod dang / /ka ra ka ra bdun pa sbyar/ /brnya de bzhin dgra snying ste/ /'di yang lan gnyis rjod nipar byed/ /sa sde la ni ma dang a/ /'jig rten gzugs bral gyi mthar gnas/ /rang bzhin 'di yang gnyis su brjod/ /gzhan dang gzhan dang ldan par bya/ /bha dza dag dang nyer gnas pa/ /de ni lan gnyis dag tu brjod/ /rjod byed la ni gsum pa dang / /khong na gnas pas ldan par bya/ /de nas zla ba gzhon nu phyed/ /yongs su gang bas brgyan ④par bya/ /de dag yang dang yang du brjod/ /78—381

nyin mor byed pa'i rang bzhin dang / /yongs su ldan pa nyid du bya/ /rjod byed dang ni gshegs gsol gnas/ /lnga par ldan pa nyis ①'gyur ro/ /phe yig drag cing myur ba la/ /zla ba gzhon nu dang ldan pa/ /yang gcig kyang ni brjod par bya / /drag myur brjod pa phaṭa gnyis so/ /rnam rtog kun gyi bud shing ni/ /bsreg pas da ha da ha ste/ /de skad ces pa bod ②pa'i sngags/ /lnga pa'i nye cher duganyis par sbyar/ /a nyi dang yang yang dag ldan/ /rjod byed gtso dang yang ldan pa/ /yang dang yang du brjod par bya/ /bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa zhes rjes su/ /ba sa ru dhi ra dang ni/ /an+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi ne/ /groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa dag dang ni/ /sap+ta bā tā la ka tad dusbyar/ /bhu dzaṅga dang sabras/ /tardza ya ni gnyis brjod do/ /ka yig sde las ka ⑤nyid la/ /gnyis pa dang ni bzhi pa sbyar/ /rlung gi ngo bor gnas pa'o/ /i mtha' sa mtha' zhes brjod la/ /nyi ma bdun gyis gnas par brgyan/ /rjod dubyed la ni bzhi pas brgyan/ /yang dang yang du brjod par bya / /ka sha o dang pa sde ⑦dang / /de 'og dang po dang ldan gzhag /ra dang har sbrel gnyis dag la/ /thig le gnyis gnyis rab tu sbyar/ /a dang sde tshan sa bon brjod/ /sde tshan gyi ni bzhi pa dang / /dang po ru ni ldan par bya/ /gsum pas kyang ni dang po ⑤sbyar/ /gsum pa la yang des mnyes bya/ /rjod byed kyang ni rjod byed ni/ /i yi stan du ldan par bya/ /sa sde la e ra yis brgyan / /zla dum dang ni thig ler ldan/ /de ni yang yang brjod par bya/ /de nyid e phyogs bzhi par ldan/ /de nas yang dang yang du bzlas/ /rjod byed dang ni bzhi pa sbyar/ /mtha' ru la gcig i dang sbyar/ /de yang yang dang yang du bzlas/ /rjod byed yi ge ha yang sbyar/ /de steng zla dum thig les bskyon/ /78—382

lnga pa yang ni mnyes par bya/ /de yang yang dang yang du bzlas/ /rnams ①mang mtha' yas rab bsgrub cing / /dge ba'i me tog mang spung ②pa/ /'di ni lha mo sgyu chen mo/ /dngos grub kun rab stsol ba'o/ /'dir ni gsungs ma thag tu yang / /'jig rten khams ni thams cad g.yos / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyang skrag /slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /mngon par byang chub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ri bo kun yang g.yo zhing du'ags/ /gdug pa kun 'dul dul zhing zhi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bkug nas bcug /dam tshig gis bcings dbang du 'dus/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gza' dang rims nad thams cad dang / /gnod sbyin srin po log 'dren dang / /sdig pa can dang dmyal ba kun/ /bkas shing bskyel te rnam par bshig⑤ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' 'gro ma thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gru dubazhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo skyong ⑦rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje bri/ /kha dog dmar po 'od chen po/ /phyi rol ri mo skum pos bskor/ /de yi dbus su bcom ldan 'das/ /khro bo chen po zhal bzhis mdzes/ /cung zad mche gtsigs 'jigs bag can/ /cung zad 'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i zhal/ /g.yas pa dkar po zhi ba ste/ /g.yon pa dmar po 'jigs pa che/ /nub kyi zhal ni mdangs ser po/ /lha mo bzhi dang mnyam ldan zhing / /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par mdzes/ /'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi mnan pa po/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyis nye bar mdzes/ /dpa' bo g.yas na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /thod pa yang ni g.yon na'o/ /g.yas na rdo rje 'bar dub bri/ /thod 78—383

pa yi ni khyad par ro/ /dpa' bo gzhu dang mda' 'dzin cing / /shes rab dga' mas rab tu mdzes/ /'bar ba dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ /sems dpa' 'bar ba 'khyil par ldan/ /'jigs pa chen po'i dus dang ni/ /dur khrod kyi ni me bzhin 'bar/ /dbu skra 'bar ba chen po gsal/ /dbu rgyan thod pas rnam par phye/ /rol pa thams cad 'tshogs pa na/ /he ru ka ni gar la spyod/ /ma mo'i 'khor lo'i gnas mchog tu/ /sa rnams kyi ni dbang phyug nyid / /kun nas kun tu thams cad pa/ /rang nyid rtag tu thams cad kun/ /mkha' 'gro kun kyang mnyam sbyor ba'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /bzlas dang bsgom pa'i rab sbyor gyis/ /'grub par ①'di la the tsom ②med/ /thun mtshams nas ni rab sbyor bas/ /mchog gi sdom pa bsgom par bya/ /'bum rdzogs nas ni rdo rje che/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dang mnyam 'gyur③/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yi/ /tshe dang mdog dang na so dang / /gzugs dang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang / /rdzu 'phrul grub pa chen por ldan/ /sems can don byed nus par 'gyur/ /yang na gsang sngags ting 'dzin gyis/ /cung zad tsam zhig bzlas pa bya/ /las ni ④brgya tsam byed par 'gyur/ /'di lta ste/ brtan pa dang / g.yo ba thams cad nges par gnon 0pa dang / ltung dubar byed pa dang rka/ 'jig par byed pa dang / rgyas 'debs pa dang / lkugs par byed pa dang / rengs par byed pa dang / dbugs ⑦'byin par byed pa dang /rmongs par byed pa dang / 'ching ba dang / 'gyes pa dang / dbang du byed pa dang / rnam par sgyur ⑧bar byed pa dang / smyo bar byed pa dang / rnam par 'gyur zhing skrod ⑨par byed pa dang / snang ba dang / nor rdzas 'joms 78—384

shing 'jigs par byed pa dang / ngud mo byed du 'jug pa dang / bsdigs ①par byed pa dang / bdag nyid bcings nas 'tshog pa ②dang / brdung ba dang / long bar byed pa dang / sa bon 'joms par byed pa dang / rims dang / khong nad dang / dug gis 'dzin pa dang / rang gis brkos ninas 'jug pa dang / dmyal bar ltung bar byed pa dang / dud 'gro'i gnas yongs su sgyur dubar byed pa dang / skyes pa bud med du byed pa dang / bu chung lto nas lhung ⑤byed pa dang / bha ga 'ching ba dang / ma ning du byed pa dang / 'dod pa la chags la snyom 0par byed pa dang / rgod cing 'ching ba dang gzhan gyis rang gsod du 'jug pa dang / mtshon rdug par byed pa dang / dgos dgu ⑦byed pa dang / yud kyis skrod ⑧pa dang / gcer bur byed pa dang / bha ga dang bshang lam sgrogs ⑨par byed pa dang / bha ga dang bshang lam rang lug tu byed pa dang / khu ba khrag tu byed pa dang / nad rnams myur du sel bar byed pa dang / khrag las gyur pa'i mdze nad la sogs pa sud par byed pa dang / mya ngan dang sdug bsngal gyis bcings shing gzir bar byed pa dang / dum bu dum bur byed pa dang / lus can thams cad phye mar byed cing gsad pa dang /thams cad rjes su chags pas dgug 0pa dang / gzhug 0pa dang / g.yo ba dang / 'dar ba dang / dgod 8pa dang / sems can thams cad la rgyun du ca blar smra ba dang / sngon gyi gnas so sor thob pa ltar ston pa dang / dbang du byed pa'i las thams cad la rab tu sbyor ba dang / bran du byed pa dang /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / log 'dren dang /'byung po dang / ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma thams cad 'dul bar byed pa 78—385

dang ske/ nor sbyin pa dang / sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang /nam mkha' thams cad ①bka' bsgo bar byed pa dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dag las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ba dang /chags pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa dang / rims dang / yams dang /dug dang / mkha' 'gro ma thams cad las grol bar byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chags pa dang bral ba 'bigs par byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'khor ba la skyo ba 'jig par byed pa ste/ de lta bur 'di dag ni lha mo thams cad grub par byed par brjod pa ste/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dag nyid ni ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa ste rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas mkha' 'gro ma'i sgyu ma thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rab tu 'grub pa de skad ces bka' stsal to//'di dag ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las las kyi tshogs thams cad kyi cho ga dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i sngags kyi cho ga'i le'u ste gnyis ga'o// //de nas gsang ba brjod par bya/ /mdor bsdus phyir na rgyas par min/ /thams cad sgyu mar mnyam sbyor na/ /las rnams thams cad mnyam par byed/ /dngos grub chen po sgyu ma kun/ /dbang phyug thams cad rab grub pa'o/ /rig pa rnam par 'phro byed pa/ /'byung po'i gdon rnams 'gugs par byed/ /hi ma ban+ta phye ut+ta re ṇa bha ba: bo na ma/ ma hā ma so/ so ba i a dha ma si haṃ be ②hi ma se hi ma se nyi ba ti budz+dza i/ i so/ ni do/ ma hi/ nī to/ kum+bha kuṇ+ḍa/78—386

sin+da do/ sā ga ra sa sat+ya pa ḍa be sin+da sin+da rda/ bas ①mi/ ku rur sam bi ḍa la sa/ tuṇ+ḍa bas me/ dzā ba su ra u ②da nini/ dza ba ra bi pa bha a dhi a ha to baṇ+ḍi dus nu ba da ⑤na sā dhu na/ ma ma ri a sarba si dha na swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas dubaka' stsal to/ /'dis tshulan bdun du mngon par brjod pas bsngags pa byas te/ khyim gyi thog du gzhag dun rjod ⑨par byed par 'gyur ro/ /ba sa ha to la i mi dzha a/ ba sa ba dza na mo hi a/ e sa bidz+dza tsa ha yin man+ta i irnya na/ ha a bā i dza be na giṇ+ḍa ṇi/ dha tam hi ma hā swa ba a na ne bo'i dho si/ rā ⑨dza ku la khaṇ+ḍa/ ḍa ṇi ḍa/ dze bā i ba dha/ ta dhi ṇa ta ṇa/ na maḥ0sidha na/ na maḥ0pu pa dza dza pā da na/ ma sa wa rā ṇi/ tabyad re ma hā daṇ+ḍi da ha he dun te he swā hā/'dis bye ma la lan bdun du bsngags pa byas te/ 'bru rnams la btab na ce ⑫spyang la sogs pa'i srog chags rnams kyis mi za zhing sprin rnam par zlog 0par byed/ rat+na ra ti/ oṃ a la la bar tsu li la tsor bsna ka na da sa bā mu ha bas mi swā hā/ shing bu sor bzhi pa la lan bdun du bzlas te/ rna ba g.yas pa la btags na chom rkun rnams rengs par byed do/ /i da si/ a ti ṇi dza ha a ka li lo hi di/ piṅga le/ ma me ga bha na i/ a haṃ si la u sa ri mi a ba ra bha ṇa i/ a haṃ bā da u sā ra ⑩mi a ba ra bha ṇa mi a ham du ha mi gi to badza pa0/mi lo lo ka li lo hi di paṅga li rgyu phaṭa/ glang gi rwa yis 'brus pa'i sa dbus ma blangs la sngags 'dis lan bdun du mngon par btab steyi/ nags khrod dang 'jigs pa'i lam dang / rgyal pos bkrabs pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis gnod pa byed par mi 'gyur te/ ba glang 0gi gdong pa can du byas nas cho ga 78—387

'di bya ste༅/ sa de lag par gzhag ②la/ ser ba 'bab pa la sogs pa la btab na/ ldog par 'gyur te 'di yi ③cho ga 'di'o/ /oṃ rdza bi li a ba a bikhyi su ti tha da si/ i su bha de su bha de o/ so ṇa o a ༷tsa la hi suṇ+ḍa pa da ne/i si la ba da ba ra ṣa badz+dza hi swā ñtsahā/ snod bzang por chu blugs te/ rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su 'dug ste/ lan bdun du bsngags nas chu de nam mkha' la gtor na/ ser ba dang rlung 'bab pa la sogs pa rengs par byed do/ /na a mo dhe/ bha ga ba ti/ ki gi ku re ṇa sha tra ya/ tha ma ke ha tha ka ral pā ke/ ni ta si ru bi ti bha tu ya/ ru dza ri ṭa ram ṭa ku ke to li ṭa lu ya/ lu haṃ hiṣ+ṭha le ka si ra le lo ti gra le bhi ṣi ṣa le ṇa si mu le kha a ya 0the sarba ha de sra na bhu dza ku bha na su the ra ṣa ya na pa meya ra ti ṣ+pe dha ya na sho pa bya ti ta ka su sa la ka kha se sid+dha ba hā la sa hi pa ṇa swā hā/ chu la lan bdun bsngags nas kha gdong bkrus na thams cad 'grub par byed do/ /rim pa bzhin du he ru ka dang 'dab ma rnams la mkha' 'gro ma rnams bkod de/ dbugs mi 'byung bar sbyar ba las/ /'grub par ni'adi la the tshom med/ /yang ni rnal 'byor cipa rnams 'dir/ /pad+ma la ni rab bsams te/ /yid ni rlabs med par byas te/ /sngags ni pho nya mor sbyar na/ /de yis rtag tu 'grub 'gyur ba/ /'di la sngags pa the tshom med/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyud chen po las le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rab tu rtogs bya'i dpa' bo drug /dpa' mo drug dang mnyam sbyor phyir/ /gnas rnams re re yi ge ste/ /dang po snying ga nyid du'o/ /mgo bo la ni gnyis par brjod/ /spyi gtsug la ni gsum pa 78—388

sbyin / /dpung pa go cha bzhi pa nyid/ /mig dag la ni lnga pa yin/ /drug pa thams cad ①la ni brjod/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams nyer 'dus mchog /gang du mnyes par 'gyur ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun rab sdom pa'o/ /yi dgas zhuganas bzhir rab sbyar ram/ /yang na rgya mtsho'i 'gram du 'am/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor rab bsgrub cing / /mchog rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /ri bo phug dang nags tshal dang / /de bzhin shing gcig tu brjod par/ /mtshan mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis rab bsgrubs nas/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa skye bar 'gyur/ /der ni rtag tu mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /lhan cig 'dug par sgrub po the tshom med/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u lnga pa'o// //sngar spyod cho ga'i rim pa rnams/ /rab tu bshad kyis nilha mo nyon/ /dka' thub rnal 'byor pas mi bya/ /gzhan pa kun dang gnas mi bya/ /lus la mchog tu'ang mchod mi bya/ /brnyas pa nyid du'ang mi bya ste/ /sna tshogs rang bzhin med mnyam lta/ /gseg ma sol bas bsgos bya zhing / /thal bas 'bad de brgyan par bya/ /bza' dang bza' min la sogs la/ /sngags pas kun du rtog mi bya/ /me tog rnyed rnyed thams cad kyis/ /rtag tu phreng ba nyid du bya/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u drug pa'o// //78—389

de nas go cha rnams kyi ni/ /las kyi tshogs rnams bshad bya ba/ /'jig rten gsum na bcud yod gang / /smyo byed 'bras skyes la bsres na①/ /de la skad cig gis kun grub/ /go cha bzlas bzhin 'gro byed na/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mi mthong zhing / /chom rkun stag sogs kyis mi 'jigs/ /go cha bzlos bzhin du rgyal po'i grong du byin gyis brlabs te/ zhugs na mi mthong bar yang 'dod pa de blangs nas slar yod pa dang / go cha bzlos bzhin bzlas pas gang la reg na de mdud bzhin du rengs par 'gyur ro/ /sum cu ②rtsa gsum pas kyang mi g.yos sol/ /sngags bzlas pa'i rkang pas bsnun na ni slar grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas rtsa ba'i sngags kyi las bshad de/ sha lnga las gzugs brnyan gyi rab tu sbyor ba las las thams cad byed pa yin te/ lha dang lha ma yin dang / klu dang gnod sbyin thams cad dang / dri za thams cad dang / lha'i skye gnas thams cad dran pa nyid kyis mchi'o/ /sprin rnams skrag par byed pa dang /char 'bebs par byed pa dang / zlog 0par byed pa dang / rgya mtsho skems ⑤par byed pa dang / chu bo rgyun phyogs las zlog 0par byed pa dang / ⑦dbang po zlog ⑧par byed pas dur khrod kyi sol ba la ji tsam 'dod pa bzlas nas gang la bsnun na/ de de'i skad cig ma nyid la ltung ngo / /dur khrod kyi sol ba la yongs su bzlas te/ gang la bsnun na de de'i skad cig nyid la sha zas 'dzin no//dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u brgyad pa'o// //78—390

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi spyod pa ste/ /dpa' bo'i dpa' dang cha blangs ma/ /gang gis pho nyar shes byas te/ /dpa' bos mdzes ma spyad par bya/ /sa ni rten du byas nas ni/ /dam pa'i spyod pa'i bzlas brjod bya/ /rim las bzlog ①pa'i ldang tshul dang / /kha yi rang bzhin 'jigs bag can/ /rtag tu smyon ma bsus pa'i gdong / /chos kyi rim pa myur shes pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rnam spyod yin/ /ri mo gsum po yongs skum por/ /rim dang rim bzlog ②ji bzhin shes/ /'gro dang 'ong bas mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /mtshan ma kun gyi mtshan nyid do/ /dgrol las bzhin gyi gnyer ma can/ /ji ①zhig gis ni slar ldog byed/ /de las rdo rje'i dgug pa gsal/ /de dbyangs ko ki dul yi skad/ /rnal 'byor dam pa de lta'i dngos/ /shes par byas na dngos grub ster/ /de la mtshan nyid bsam byas na/ /de yis de yi dngos por 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u dgu pa'o// //dngos grub kun ni rab ster ba/ /nga yis bshad kyis dulha mo nyon/ /lus ngag sems la rtag tu ni/ /yid kyi rdul dang bral bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor rnam bsam par/ /gang du'ang pho nya mo gnas min/ /yongs su bsgoms pas 'ong min gyi/ /dad pa tsam gyis gzung bya ste/ /mig dang lag pas ma yin no/ /gsang ba 'di gsal mi bya zhing / /rab tu 'bad de sba bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kun bsdus ltarjo/ /de phyir lus nyid du mi blta/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' ⑦'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u 78—391

bcu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul te/ /dam tshig rab bsrungs rab 'grub ste/ /dam tshig las ①ni sngags par gnas/ /rtag tu 'bras skyes stobs brten cing / /rnal 'byor ma rnams smad mi bya/ /rjes su 'jug rnams mi bzlog go/ /dam can mi rnams la mi smad/ /brtson ldan rnams la gnod mi bya/ /'di rnams dang ldan cig ②bder bya/ /grol bar 'dod pa de don du/ /dam tshig rnams ni spyad par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa la/ /cung zad tsam yang smad mi bya/ /khros te rab sbyor 'ga' ①mi bya/ /sngags la sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //rdo rje mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nga yis bshad kyis 0lha mo nyon/ /dang por bsgom bya ro nyid de'u/ /chos dbyings dag tu rig par bya/ /de yi steng nus rnal 'byor pa/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom 0byas te/ /de nyid du ni rnam par dgod/ /rang gi snying ga'i zla dbus su/ /'od las lha mo kun phyung ba / /phyag 'tshal mchod sogs 'di ltar gsungs/ /dang por snying gar zla dbus su/ /yi ge a yis zla dkyil 'khor/ /rnam par bsams rgyal de steng du/ /yi ge hūṃ ni rnam par bsgom/ /de nas byams pa'i sems byas te/ /de nas re zhig nidakyil 'khor bri/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /kha khyer rdo rjes nges par mtshan / /skud pa bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /'phan gyi phreng ba shin tu mdzes/ /78—392

dkyil 'khor kun gyi grwa rnams dang / /sgo khyud kyi ①ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin po ches mtshan par/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bol/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bo/ /'khor lo'i phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /de nang du yang pad+ma ni/ /mdog dkar rab tu mdzes pa bri/ /gzhan yang de yi steng du ni/ /mdog dmar pad+ma 'od dang ldan/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor bas so/ /sngags pas ③de yi nang du yang / /rdo rje phreng ④ba 'khrigs par bri/ /yang na pad chen 'dab brgyad pa/ /en+d+ra nī la'i 'od mnyam pa'o/ /de dbus dkyil 'khor lngas brgyan par/ /g.yas na rdo rje gtso bo ⑤bzhugs/ /ri rab ri yi steng du ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming che ge mo zhes pa/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob par/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ⑥pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ⑦ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud ⑧pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por so sor gzung / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor la/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba ni/ /nyin re zhing ni yang dang yang / /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /78—393

pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang ①gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos rnams so sor gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sdom pa thams cad gzung bgyi zhing //ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol②/ /dbugs ma phyin pa bdag gis dudagyeng / /sems can mya ngan 'das dul dgod//oṃ swa bhā ba eshud+dhāḥyi sarba dharmāḥ0swa bhā ba shurnyo3rtadu/ de nas thams cad bdag med pa gnas gzhi dang ngan par bral khyabar bltas te/ de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /kha dog sngon po drag po che/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par ⑩mdzes/ /yi dgas 0chen po gdan du mdzad/ /nyi ma la 8bzhugs gar bcas mdzad/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gzhu dang de bzhin gzhan mda'o⑩/ /de lta'i cho ga'i rim pa 'di/ /ye shes kyi ni rnam par bsgom/ /shar du dkar po sngo mdangs can/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ tsog dril bu/ /rdo rje thod pa de bzhin gzhan/ /byang na dmar po'am cung zad ser/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zhags pa/ /phyag g.yas cang te'u thod pa nyid/ /nub na dmar ba'am cung zad ser/ /'bad pas mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing / /thod pa sna tshogs pad+ma dag /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag na'o/ /lho na dkar ba'am ser ba 'am/ /g.yon phyag rtse gsum rin po che/ /g.yas na de bzhin thod pa'o/ /glang po dang ni ce 0spyang dang / /mi dang ba lang nyid dag ni⑩/ /thod pa rnams na cho ga 78—394

bzhin/ /dang por nyung bar byed ma ①nyid/ /gnyis pa gsod mar (mibyed ma ste//gsum pa 'gugs mar nibyed ma'o/ /bzhi pa gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /rig ma de dag dbu skra ni/ /gyen du 'bar zhing rgyan rnams kyis/ /brgyan nas gar mdzad bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir gnas pa'i thod par ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs lngas nye bar brgyan/ /btung ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /dang por yi ger yang dag ldan/ /skad cig las ni 'bar bar bsam/ /lha mo de ltar bsgom 0byas nas/ /'bras bu nor gyi dngos grub 'thob/ /rig pa chen po sbyor 'grub pa/ /yang dag mngon sum rab tu bsgom/ /mi snang bar gnas thams cad bdag /rnal 'byor pas ni yud kyis mthong / /lha mchog las skyes bu mo rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun la 'phrogs rgyanas spyod/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gang gā'i bye mnyam rnams/ /rang lag skyu ru ra bzhag dubazhin/ /rdo rje mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang gā'i bye mnyam sangs rgyas zhing / /sku gsung thugs rnams kyis mtshan pa'i/ /sems dngos gar mkhan dngos po ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid du mthong 'gyur/ /rgyud dang sngags rnams rnam bsgoms pa/ /yi ge phyin ci log tu sbyar/ /mchog tu gsang ba 'di dag ni/ /khyod la legs par bshad pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ⑦bde ba'i mameg /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes dude skad gsungs/ /'di dag ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro chen po bzhengs pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //78—395

de nas dngos grub kun ster ba/ /gang gis ①dngos grub myur byed cing / /the tshom med par bskyed ②pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying po bshad/ /mtshan ma gnyis la sngags mnyam sbyar/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma gnyis med/ /rab tu sbyor ba'i don 'di dag /rnal ③'byor ma la rab tu bsgrub/ /de las 'grub par rab tu grags/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas rnams/ /bsgrub bya rnams ni myur bar 'dis/ /ji bzhin rtag tu nye ba dang / /ring yang de bzhin myur bskyed de/ /'di dag nye bar 'gyur ba ni/ /de yi gzugs sku 'gugs par byed / /pad+ma'i lte bar rab gnas la/ /dbugs kyi brda yis bsgom par bya/ /der ni sna tshogs sku bsams te/ /sna tshogs sku la mchod bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni rtogs dubyas nas/ /bdag nyid rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /de la mkha' bzhin gnas par bya/ /'byung gnas thams cad de lta nyid/ /der ni mkha' 'gro ma kun no/ /gnas sogs 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ma/ /yul rnams kun la gnas pa yin/ /yul yul du ni skyes ldan mal/ /rang skye'i gnas su yang dag bshad/ /dkyil 'khor la zhugs mkha' 'gro ma/ /de nas mtshan mo shar nas bza'/ /de yis mnyam par rab sbyar nas/ /sngags pas rtag tu rab bsgrub bya/ /der ni rol pa chen spyod cing / /thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgrub/ /dam tshig rang bzhin du byas nas/ /de la sdom pa ⑤rab skye ba/ /snang med dga' bar rang rig pa'o/ /de dag ni dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud chen po las le'u bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dge ba dang / /lha 78—396

rnams kun gyi sgrub thabs kun/ /pho nya rnams kyi khyad par dang / /'byung po gdon dang rig pa che/ /lus srul po ni gang zhig dang / /de bzhin sngags kyi phreng ba dang / /de ltar ①bshad kyis ②lha mo nyonal/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo skyong rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes par bri bar bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan/ /nye bar spyod pa lnga yis brgyan/ /ri mo mkhan ni dam tshig can/ /sgrub po mchog gis 'dri byaru gzhug /ro la dkris pa'i ras dag gam/ /yang na mtshon gyis btab pa'i zas/ /'byung po dag gi ras dge ni/ /ba glang ②ko ba tsam zhig la//nag po'i dubargyad dam bcu bzhi la/ /'byung po rnams kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ /de nas 'bum gcig bzlas ④byin na/ /mdun du mngon sum nyid du 'gyur/ /tshangs pa mo dang shis byed ma/ /gzhon nu ma dang phag mo dang / /dbang po ma dang rgan byad ⑧ma/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug ma dang ni/ /byin za yi ni bdag can ma'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa dag la ni/ /tshangs dang gshin rje chu lha dang / /nor sbyin dang ni yi dgas ⑨dang / /byin za dang ni dbang ldan dang / /bden bral de bzhin rlung lha'o/ /rim pa gsum/ pa dag la ni/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang ske/ /mig dmar dang ni gza' lag dang / /phur bu dang ni pa ba sangs/ /spen pa sgra gcan 'dzin dag go/ /rim ⑩pa bzhi la sgo bzhir ni/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug de bzhin du/ /drag po dang ni kurti ka /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung ske/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi rnams so/ /rim pa dang po'i dbus nyid kyi/ /phyogs bzhi dang por mkha' 'gro ma/ /mar me ma dang mdzes pa mo/ /'jigs byed ma dang de bzhin du/ /dbus su khyab bdag nyid gnas so/ /yang dag 78—397

mtha' las mthar 'gyur ba'i/ /rang bzhin gyis ni cho ga bzhin/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bsgrub par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor de bzhin bri/ /dbus su yongs su skum po ru/ /ri mo shin tu mdzes pas bskor/ /lte ba sbas pa'i spyod yul can/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri bar bya/ /de dbus khro bo chen po ni/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa can/ /cung zad bzhad pa'i zhal dang ldan/ /kha dog sngon po gtsigs ①pa che/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /ro gcig gar ldan nyi mar bzhugs/ /lha rnams 'jigs par mdzad pa po/ /stag gi pags ②pa'i smad dkris can/ /spyan gsum gzugs ②mchog dang ldan pa/ /rdo rje 'bar ba phyag g.yas na/ /'phan lce gsum pa g.yon na'o/ /mda' gzhu de bzhin g.yas g.yon phyag /mkha' 'gro ma ni shar du bri/ /lho ru 'jigs byed ma nyid de/ /nub tu lha mo mdzes ma'o/ /byang du mar me ma dgod do/ /yi ge trīḥdulas byung ba yi/ /phag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /mda' gzhu dang ni de bzhin du/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni thod pa nyid/ /kha dog sngon mo 'jigs chen mo/ /phag gi gdong pas 'jigs par mdzad/ /yi ge phaṭa las shis byed ma/ /kha dog dmar mo phyag bzhi ma/ /thod pa dang ni lcags kyu nyid/ /de bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ cang ⑤te'u/ /yi ge ha las gzhon nu ma/ /kha dog ser mo phyag bzhi ma/ /rtse gsum dang ni 'phan lce gsum/ /de bzhin gzhu dang mda' nyid do/ /ho yig las ni rgan byad ma/ /kha dog nag mo phyag bzhi ma/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa nyid/ /de bzhin ral gri cang te'u/ /be+e yig las byung tshangs pa mo/ /kha dog dkar mo duphyag bzhi ma/ /pad+ma dang ni thod pa nyid/ /de bzhin gzhan na gzhu dang mda'//78—398

gha yig las byung tshogs dbang mo/ /sngo bsangs mdog la phyag bzhi ma/ /rtse gsum de bzhin thod pa dang / /bgrang phreng dang ni la du'o/ /po yig las ni khyab 'jug ma/ /kha dog sngon mo phyag bzhi ma/ /dbyug to ①dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /de bzhin zhags pa ral gri bzhin/ /yi ge las byung dbang po ma/ /kha dog ser mo phyag bzhi ma/ /rdo rje gsal shing thod pa dang / /sdigs mdzub dang ni zhags pa'o/ /kun kyang dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum dang ni ro la zhon/ /stag gi pags ②pa'i smad dkris can/ /shar gyi sgo ni tshangs pa bri/ /kha dog dkar po zhal bzhi pa/ /thod pa dang ni bgrang phreng dang / /garnya dang ni pad+ma'o/ /byang du de bzhin khyab 'jug ste/ /kha dog nag po lag bzhi pa/ /ral gri de bzhin 'khor lo dang / /thod pa dang ni dbyug pa'o/ /lho ru drag mo bri bya ste/ /du ba'i mdog la lag bzhi pa/ /rtse gsum nyid dang ka pā la/ /de bzhin zhags pa bgrang phreng 'dzin//nub tu kurti ka bri ste/ /kha dog ser po lag bzhi pa/ /dpa' bo gsal shing dbyug pa dang / /de bzhin thod pa bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /dbang ldan khyu mchog la zhon pa/ /kha dog dkar po lag bzhi pa/ /thod pa dang ni rtse gsum 'dzin/ /de bzhin gzhan ni thal mo sbyar/ /glang po zhon pa dbang po ste/ /kha dog ser po lag bzhi pa/ /rdo rje dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /gzhan ni thal mo kha sbyar byed/ /ra skyes zhon pa me phyogs 'dzin/ /kha dog dmar po lag bzhi pa/ /me thab dang ni thod par ldan/ /skrag nas gzhan ni thal mo sbyar/ /gshin rje ma ho la zhon pa/ /kha dog nag po lag bzhi pa/ /dbyug pa dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /de bzhin skrag nas thal mo byed/ /bden bral dang ni khyi la zhon/ /kha dog ljang gu 78—399

lag bzhi pa/ /ral gri nyid dang thod pa 'dzin/ /skrag nas gzhan dag thal mo sbyor / /chu yi phyogs ni chu srin zhon/ /kha dog dkar po lag bzhi pa/ /zhags pa dang ni thod par ldan/ /gzhan dag thal mo kha sbyor byed/ /rlung ni ri dgas ①zhon pa ste/ /du ba'i mdog can lag bzhi pa/ /ba dan dang ni thod par ldan/ /de bzhin gzhan ni thal mo sbyor/ /nor sbyin na ni gter la zhon/ /kha dog ser po lag bzhi pa/ /rin po che dang thod par ldan/ /gzhan dag thal mo sbyar ba'o / /gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad ni/ /so so'i dkyil 'khor la bsam bya/ /rang gi dam tshig las byung ba/ /stobs po che la rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /ma mo kun gyi yang ma mo/ /de bzhin rig par gyur pa'i mchog /nyon cig ②lha mo che chen mo/ /gtor ma re res gzung bar bya/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'i/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor gar spyod na/ /de la 'bad pas khur byed pa'i/ /pho nya'i sgrub thabs rab bshad pa/ /rgyud rnams kun nas rnyed dka' ba'i/ /de yis ldan byas dngos grub 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor gcig pas rtag gnas pas/ /'khor ba'i skyon dang nges par grol/ /pho nya mor chags rtag par grol/ /mchog gi rim pas spyad par bya/ /bsnyen bkur tsam ni bya min gyi/ /skye gnas dman pa'ang dga' bde'i gnas/ /ma dang sring ①mo bu mo dang / /chung ma yang ni pho nyar gnas/ /'jig rten la rtag g.yon pas spyod/ /rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du 'dor/ /lag pa g.yon pas yongs su bsgyur/ /g.yon pa dang por mchod par bya/ /g.yon pa phyogs kyis bsgyur bya zhing / /g.yon pas 'bad pas tshim par byed/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i snying po'i rgyud chen po las le'u bcu bzhi pa'o// //78wa 400

dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud phyi ma snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mchog gi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyis grom pa ru lag rgyang phu'i lha ri mo'i ①mgul gyi dben gnas su bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/372 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉dmig 72 ①〈〈li 〉〉thams cad mkha' 'gro thams cad/ 〈〈co 〉〉thams cad mkha' 'gro/374 ①〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉'gro/ ②〈〈co 〉〉po'i/ ③〈〈zhol 〉〉sgom/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉thog ⑤〈〈zhol 〉〉 ces/275 ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kyi/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉kyis/ ③〈〈zhol 〉〉 thams/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉bem/376 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉dza/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉lha/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉sto/ ③〈〈zhol 〉〉ste/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉skyed/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉'gror/377 7〈〈co 〉〉par/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉por/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉pa'o/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉(/ ⑤〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mnyam so/ ⑥〈〈li 〉〉'bed/ ⑦〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bskur/ ⑧〈〈co 〉〉bral/ ⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉tsom 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gsol/0〈〈co 〉〉tag 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉thob/378 ①〈〈li 〉〉stog ②〈〈co 〉〉bsgom/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉bka'/ 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brten/ ⑤〈〈zhol 〉〉bka'/0〈〈co 〉〉gi/ ⑦〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mi/379 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉bskams/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉 pa/38 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉btul/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉ces/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉ba/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉gnyes bya/ 〈〈khu 〉〉mnyes byas/0〈〈zhol 〉〉de/ ①〈〈co 〉〉 rgyu/ ⑦⑧⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brjod/381 ①〈〈li 〉〉lhags/ ②〈〈co 〉〉'gro/ ③〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brjod/ ④〈〈co 〉〉rgyan/282 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉nyid/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉'bod/ ②〈〈co 〉〉nyi cher/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉nye tsher/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉ta/ ⑤〈〈zhol 〉〉ga ⑥〈〈khu 〉〉brjod/ ⑦〈〈khu 〉〉ste/ 0〈〈khu 〉〉por/ 8 ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉rnam/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉spud/ ①〈〈khu 〉〉g.yo/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉shing / ⑤〈〈co 〉〉shig ⑥〈〈co 〉〉grub/ ⑦〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉skyongs/ ⑧〈〈khu 〉〉'ba'/384 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉tshom/ ③〈〈khu 〉〉sbyor/ ①〈〈co 〉〉'di/ ⑤〈〈zhol 〉〉mnon/ 0〈〈co 〉〉lhung / ⑦〈〈khu 〉〉'bugs/ ⑧〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsgyur/ ⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bskyod/78wa 401

399 ①〈〈mi 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉tho/ ②〈〈li 〉〉wags/4 ༷ ①〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dwags/ ②〈〈mi 〉〉gcig ③〈〈co 〉〉srin/4 1 ①〈〈co 〉〉mo/bskur 'azas re'u mig da 'bum/ (12)78wa 403

rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po zhes bya ba/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ḍā kāṇ+ḍi ②ba ma hā yo gi nī tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho (7rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ④zhes bya ba/ oṃ sangs rgyas dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das gsung gi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo chen po'i dbang phyug /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpa' bo'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ bha ga rnams su rtsen pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /der dpa' bo chen po'i dbang phyug gis bka' stsal pa/ bde ba chen po'i ting ⑤'dzin gyis/ /dbang po'i dra ba bdag gis (6)mthong / /'khor ba dang ni nges 'byung gis/ /mya ngan 'das pa so sor bskyed(pe/ / de yi ⑧dbus su sku chen po/ /bdag gi ⑨dbang po yis rig go/ /dpa' bo rang gi rang bzhin ni/ /ye shes rgya mtshor 78wa 404

mnyan par bgyi②/ /rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo dbus su/ /phag mo bdag ni 'dri ba'o / /dbang po'i dra ba ci ru bshad/ /bdag gis gang du bshad par bya/ /mthong ba dang ni chen po'i sgra/ /bde ba za ba de bzhin ci/ /ting 'dzin ming ci ②de la ni/ /byung ba nyams par byas pa dang / /'khor ba yang dag byung ③ba ni / /gang du thim par 'gyur ba yin/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i ming /ji ltar slar yang yongs su bskyed④/ /sku ⑤brjod pa ni gsung bar mdzod/ /nyid kyi dbang pos rig pa ni/ /bde ba chen por ⑥bzhugs gyur pa'iX/ /bdag gi ⑧bdag pos gsung bar mdzod/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug chen pos bka' stsal pa/ phag mo lha rdzas pad+ma can/ /lha mo rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /sngon du spyod pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /mdor bsdus pa yis bshad par bya/ /dbang po ⑨'jig rten mchog chos bshad/ /dra ba de la yid rol pa'o/ /bdag gi nga rgyal tsam gyis ni/ /dam tshig mchog gang byung ba'o/ /de phyir ye shes che mthong ste/ /thabs chen bde la bzhugs pas so/ /gang du dbang po rnams kyis za/ /de yis nga yi ming sngon song / /de tshe ting nge 'dzin tsam du/ /thub pa skyes mchog rnams kyis gsungs/ /yang dag lhag rtogs ye shes ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi lha dbang pos/ /de rnams su byung ba'i sbyor bas/ /mkha' 'gro mchog mang gis byas so/ /bde dang mi bde gnyis nyams las/ /slar yang 'dir ni byung ba ste/ /sgra yi gzugs las byung zhing thon0/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul lo/ /sems gsum rnams kyi dbye ba yis/ /grub spre)mo khyod kyis shes par gyis/ /'di yis rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom/ /byung 8dang 'byung ba'i 0dus su ni/ /yongs su gsal ba 'od 78wa 405

gsal ba'o/ /de phyir 'jig rten 'khor bar byed/ /de ni 'khor bar yongs su brjod/ /'dir ni sgyu ma skyes de bzhin/ /de ni thim pa'i dngos po'ang med//myang 'das gzhan pa'i rdzas yod yin/ /'khor ba yi ni phyi rol son/ /srid pa'i rtse mo gang 'dzin pa/ /de phyir mya ngan 'das par brjod/ /gzugs ni sgyu ma lta bu'i sku/ /de yi gnas la rnam par 'phro/ /bdag chen ye shes gzugs kyi ni/ /dbang pos gsal bar rig pa ste/ /lha dang sbyin byed la sogs pas/ /mi mthong mkha' la 'gro ba'i gzugs/ /lha khyod kyis ni gsung rnams kyi/ /ye shes chen po'i ros ①bdag tshim/ /de ring bdag la the tshom mchis/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi rang bzhin ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dpa' rnams thams cad rang bzhin te/ /rang bzhin de rnams chos can no/ /'dir ni 'dod pa'i ②dus brjod de/ /'dod pa sems las yongs su byung / /'dod dang sems gnyis dag las ni/ /byung ba gzugs ni gtso bo'o/ /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba/ /thog ma dbus mthar yang dag gnas/ /gang zhig mtha' ma rnams kyi sems/ /sems de ro mnyam gyur pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba las/ /mkha' 'gro de ni de phyir byung ③/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdag nyid che/ /sa gsum po ni bsgrub par bya/ /gang tshe sngon du yang dag byung / /'gro ba'i gtso bo tshangs pa'o/ /gnas dang de bzhin ji ltar stong / /mgon po sems can rnam dugrol byed/ /de tshe 'jig rten khams gzhan gyis/ /chung ngu 'dir ni bskul ba'o/ /gson gson byang chub spros son pa'i/ /sems can bsgral ba'i sems med pa/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin khyod bzhugs nas/ /khams gsum ma lus bsgral bar mdzod/ /yon tan dag ⑤'di thos nas ni/ /sems 78—406

can grol byed 'di ltar bsgom/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun rnam pa/ /'gro ba'i gtso bo he ru ka /dpal ni sngon du mngon brjod pas/ /rten la sogs ①pa bskyed pa ste/ /glu dang rol mo dri za dang / /gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams dang / /'gro ba'i sde dang las dang ②ni/ /de yi rgyun las yongs su byung / /de la sogs pa mtha' med dang / /stong phrag sum cu ②rtsa gsum mo/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug dang / /skye ba dang ni thim pa'i rgyu/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i de nyid/ /zla ba'i dbye bas 'gro ba'o/ /dga' ba rtag tu shes byas nas/ /tshes gcig zla ba 'phel bas so/ /nag po sogs dang dkar mthar ④yang / /thung ngu de bzhin 'dir shes bya/ /'di skad thos pa bdag gi ngag⑤ /gsang ba'i 'dod pa thams cad ster/ /de bzhin 'dir bdag the tshom mchis/ /gsang ba la 0sogs gsung ni ci/ /bdag gi bdag pos gsung bar mdzod/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed pa/ /lha mo chen mo bdag dga'o/ /sems can kun gyi dgos pa'i rgyur/ /mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad bya ste/ /rtse gcig pa yi ⑦sems kyis nyon/ /gsang ba khams thams cad kyi mtha'/ /dbang po'i gnas ni mchog yin la/ /rnam shes phun tshogs de rnams su/ /dgyes pa nam mkha' las byung ba'o/ /thams cad bdag nyid khams gsum gyi/ /khyab bya'i ⑧gzugs su yang dag son/ /rtag bzhugs gnyis su med pa'i chos/ /sgyu ma mi lam lta bu mchog /yang na bdag med bcu drug dang / /khyad par du yang snying rje'o/ /de yi rnam pa ye shes che/ /de kho na nyid kun 0du son/ /'dir ni skye bar go bya ba/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /thim pa sgrub pa gnyis dang 78—407

ni/ /de bzhin bsnyen pa gnyis kyang ngo / /rnal 'byor thig ler bshad pa ste/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'o①/ /dus kyis phyed ②dang zla ba yi③/ /rdzogs ldan gsum gnyis rtsod dus ④son/ /'di yi rdo rje'i zhal bzhi po/ /dga' ba brgyad gnyis su 'gyur te⑤/ /cha shas bcu drug rnam duldan pa'ig/ /phyogs kyi dbye bas 'gro ba'o/ /thung ngu nyi ma'i rgyu ba yis/ /de bzhin du ni cha shas zal/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgya/ /gnyis med ye shes bla na med/ /byang chub sems 'od chen por ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po nges par 'gro/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med de'-i/ /dngos rnams nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /sad pa na yang nyams pa ste/ /de gnas kun du gnas min pa'o/ /mi lam yul med las byung ba/ /dbang po kun las byung ba med/ /gnyid log pa yi stobs kyis ni / /sa gsum po ni bza' bar bya/ /gnyid mthug skyes pa'i dus de ltar/ /sad med gnyid med mi lam med/ /'das pa'i bde ba'i dus rnams su/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang lhag ⑩par gnas/ /mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mchog tu bde/ /las kyi yul ni bsnyen ⑩byas na/ /sum cu rtsa gsum du ltung ngo / /ma rig pas bslang 8nges par ni/ /'gro ba dmyal sogs 'jigs pa che/ /de 0phyir sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /rdzu 'phrul che 'dir rjes chags bya/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das bdag po/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi ni ming / /de ni bdag la sems pas gsungs/ /mkha' 'gro kun la bdag mchog tu/ /gsang ba der ni btud byas nas/ /phag mo lha rdzas rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis med tshig gis ji ltar zhes/ /de bzhin yang nas yang du dris/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ phra mo'i rnam pa rtsa 78—408

gsum ste/ /rnam par shes pa gsum gyi rgyu/ /de phyir phra mor rig bya ste/ /rtsa 'byung ba ni bdag nyid che/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnal 'byor ma/ /re re la ni de yongs ldan/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun der bshad de/ /gzhan yang de ltar ngo mtshar che/ /ming mdor bstan pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /de kun ji lta bzhin bshad bya/ /zla ba 'o ma snum pa mo/ /'jam ma 'dod ma ①kun sbyin ma/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang / /sring mo'i bu mo ne ne mo/ /gnyen mo pha yi ma dang ni/ /zhang po yi yang chung ma dang / /pad can dung can sna tshogs ma/ /glang po ma dang myos brlabs ②ma/ /gzugs ma sgra ma dri ma dang / /ro ma reg ma yid ma dang | /chos dbyings ma dang tshogs can ma/ /gnyid ①ma le 5lo ma gzhan gnon⑤/ /rlom pa mo dang sgeg mo dang / /bzang zhal ma dang drag mo ma/ /'thung ma ༷za ma 'jigs pa mo/ /ha ha sgrogs ma dur khrod ma/ /bcom ldan dgyes mar rtag tu bshad/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnal 'byor ma/ /las kyi cho ga ༷blangs pa yis/ /gzhan gyi ming yang shes par bya/ /gang zhig gang gir nimangon brjod pa'i/ /rtsa de 'dir ni brjod pa'o/ /de rnams sems dpa' bde rang bzhin/ /mthar gyur mchog tu zhi ba'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dngos po yang / /mchog tu zag med rnal 'byor ldan/ /mdog dang phyag sogs rnam pa ru/ /srid pa'i 'khor lor yang dag byung / /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs 'dir/ /pukhri ra sogs dbus su'o/ /gang zhig gang gi lha'i bdag po/ /de ni de dang des rgyas gdab/ /nyid dang bdag tu rtsen gyur pa'i7/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /'di yis rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu de bzhin dang po'i lha/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun bde ster ba'i/ /bcom ldan rdo 78—409

rjes ①'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha' thog ma tha ma med/ /gang 'drar mchog tu 'du shes pa/ /de 'drar bdag ni rig pa ste/ /snang med par yang yongs su gsal/ /der ni 'byung ba'ang yod min te/ /'jig rten pa yi tha snyad mchog /ji ltar mkha' las me ①byung ba/ /bla med me ni'adir de bzhin no/ /ro bro ba ni gcig dngos la/ /de yi nang na dngos mang po/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin 'dis/ /thams cad ro ste ro'i khyab bdag /pho nya rnams kyi bdag po yis/ /sa gsum po ni mchog tu za/ /thabs dang shes rab snying rje che/ /lha yi bdag po gzhan med do/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar duyang ni mi dmigs so/ /de ltar brtag ⑤shes rnal 'byor pas/ /'dod bya kun la longs spyadabyabya/ /rtag tu nang du gyur byas nas/ /kha dog rnams ni zhal las byung / /rtag tu lus kyis ⑦phyin pa ste/ /sems las byung ba spang bar bya / /de ltar 'dod chags sgyu mtha' la/ /rol pa mchog gi go 'phang ngo / /'dod chags bral ba dga' ba gsum/ /spangs pa dbu ma zag pa med/ /gzung dubar bya ba min pa ste/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin 'dod chags min/ /bral ba'i dga' ba nyams pa ste/ /de la'ang dga' bar mi bya'o/ /de gnyis dbus na gnas pa yisal/ /chos de la yang dga' dmigs med/ /dbye ba med pa yi ni chos/ /rdo rje la ni dga' bar gyis0/ /lha yi rnam pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig mngon 7sum byed pa'o/ /lugs ma la sogs rnal 'byor gyis / /rnam par byas pa'i dbyibs su 'gyur/ /stong nyid rang bzhin gzugs rnal 'byor/ /rang byin rlabs 8pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /bdag byin rlabs ⑫dang bral rnal 'byor/ /spun skogs tsodum bu bzhin shes bya/ /'di 'dra'i 78—410

mtshan nyid mchog gyur pa/ /skye bo phyugs rnoms kyis mi shes/ /de phyir sgyu 'phrul 'di bsgoms na/ /byang chub bla na med pa 'thobasti/ /skye ba 'di la glen pa nyid/ /shes rab snyan dngags skyes bur 'gyur/ /'di 'dra'i yon tan tshogs ldan pas/ /mi lam dang ni mnyam par ltos/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i ②rgyud du③/ /'gro ste de phyir 'jig rten pa'o/ /mngon sum rang nyid sngags kyi sku/ /'khor lo gsum rnams nyis du'agyur ro/ /gcig la 'khor lo gsum bshad de/ /gnyis pa nyis ⑤'gyur du ni 'dod/ /'khor lo gsum po thabs shes rab/ /snyoms par 'jug par 'chad pa'o/ /de ni nyis 'gyur shes 6)bya ste/ /'khor lo nyis 'gyur des bshad do/ /khams gsum gyi ⑦ni gnas chen po/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom ⑧pa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo je sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' ⑨dbang che/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes ⑩'di gsungs so/ /chos dang chos min gang du nub/ /byang chub der ni sems gzung gis7/ /grub pa lha dang lha ma yin/ /dbang po dang ni yul dang ni/ /khams dang skye mched thams cad ni/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag pa ste/ /rmongs pa 'ching zhing mkhas pa ni/ /yongs su shes pas grol ba'o/ /sems 'di rang nyid mngon sum du/ /khams gsum du ni rnam par gnas/ /bdag dang mchog khyod gnyis med las/ /tshogs pa'i gtso bo byung ba'o/ /spyod lam la sogs bye brag chos/ /mdo sde rnam shes dbu ma pa/ /mos pa'i sems can rnams bshad de/ /bden pa ma yin rdzun pa min/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis dang ldan te/ /de bzhin zhal ni bzhi pa'o/ /kha dog nam mkha' sngon po la/ /spyan gsum brkyang bskum ldan pa ste/ /'phrog byed dkar mo 78—411

mnyam par mnan/ /gzhan ni 'bum tsho stong phrag gi①/ /gang dang gang gi rgyud kyi ni/ /phyi dang gsang ba nang bdag nyid/ /de dang de yi gzugs nges par /lha ni he ru ku'i bdag nyid/ /rgyud dang rgyud kyi nang mchog tu/ /dbye ba mos pa'i dbang gis te/ /ming ni de 'drar shes par bya/ /'on kyang he ru ka bsres pa'o/ /kha dog de dang 'drar shes bya/ /bzhugs tshul ho ru ku'i rnam pa/ /sa ni bcu gnyis rnams kyi rgyu/ /de yis ⑤he ru ka dang 'dra/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las/ ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa ste 'di ni le'u dang po'o// //phag mo lha rdzas rnal ①'byor mas/ /slar yang rdo rje mchod byas te/ /bcom ldan bdag pos bstan par mdzod/ /phag mo ci yis yongs su byung / /skyed ④pa gang gis bskyed pa yin/ /rang bzhin ji ltar du ni 'dod/ /bdag byung ba yi rgyu mtshan cizhu/ /'dir ni dgos pa ji ltar yin/ /dbang po dang ni yul thams cad/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du rab zhugs/ /spyi bo'i rdo rje gur du ni / /steng du kha bltas rlung 'bab bo/ /'dod chags nyi ma'i dbus su ni/ /skad cig gis ni sprul thim gyur/ /der skyes pa yi phag mo ni/ /bha ga liṅga yid las byung / /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin khams/ /de rnams las ni sngon du skyes / /rang bzhin bdag med gcig pu ste/ /mkha' mnyam rnal 'byor gzugs can no/ /rgyu mtshan skye bo sgrol dub dang / /snying rje'i gzugs rang 78—412

bzhin du byung / /'dir ni dgos pa gnyis rig ste/ /phyag rgya sbyor ba rab sgrub ①pa'o/ /khyod ni lha mo'i bdag po ste/ /kun du spyod pa mang spyod pa'o/ /sngags kyi phreng ba brje byas nas/ /a yig la sogs de'i khyab bdag /yang na phag mo'i rtsa ba dang / /go cha'i sngags rnams kyis ldan te/ /yi ge re re'i sngags kyi ni/ /spyod pa sdom par son pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog skye ba ni/ /rtsa yi mchog gi grong du ste/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /dbus ma a ba dhū tī'o②/ /dbu ma 'di ltar thams cad kyi/ /khyab byed du ni rnam par gnas/ /de phyir phag mo gtso mo yi / /go ④'phang mchog bzhin shes par bya/ /rdo rje la sogs ming thog mar/ /a rdo rje dang ka rdo rje/ /sngags mthar de la sogs pa ste / /yang na so so tha dad du'o/ /gang gis ⑤dus su sngags zlos pa/ /de'i ⑥dus rnams su rnal 'byor ldan/ /lte ba laspyi bo snying gyen du/ /'di ltar 'gro dang 'ong ba med/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma gtso mo/ /de ni bdag nyid rnam par 'phro/ /rang gi 'khor ldan rnal 'byor ma/ /zhing dang zhing rnams su ni 'gro / /lha mo khyod ni bdag po ste/ /nga dang lhan cig kha sbyor ro/ /dus dang dus ni ma yin par/ /nam mkha'i bu ga'i nang 'dug nas/ /de bzhin skye gnas lam 'thon nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i sa bon 'dzag /der ni 'pho med ye shes bya/ /nyig phyed yi shes bsgom bya ste/ /mi mo skyes bu'i dus su yang / /mchog tu zag med mngon par bya/ /de byung ba yi rig ma che/ /sgom ⑧pa'i bdag nyid kyis bri'o/ /thog mar rnam snang mgon po ste/ /ri mo gsum bskor lte spu'og gnas/ /langs nas mgrin pa'i bar du 'gro/ /sa gsum sgron ma lta bur son/ /gzhan pa'i sngags ⑩ni sa mtha' 'dra/ /de las zla 'bab g.yon 78—413

nas so/ /sngags 'di thig les brgyan ①pa ste/ /sngags ni rnal 'byor ma bskyed pa'o②/ /slar yang sa bon gnyis pa brjod/ /g.yas pa nyi ma bskyed pa ste/ /logs su gnyis phye mgor thig le/ /ya sde'i mtha' yi sa bon ni/ /byang chub sems chen 'bab lam mo/ /'di ni phag mo'i sa bon yin/ /ā ③yi yi gis mthar dubargyan pa/ /bcu drug zla phyed nyi mas brgyan/ /ya sde'i dang po'i sa bon ni/ /sbyor bas sa gsum rlung yon tan/ /dbyangs kyi bcu gsum pas rgyas gdabargya/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyis dumago bor brgyan/ /thig le dang ni bcas pa 'bar/ /dga' ba bzhi po dag pa'o/ /pa spasde'i mtha' ma bde ba'i gzugs/ /o yi yi ge zhon ldan pa/ /mgo bor zla byed nyi mas mnan/ /sa yi pha rol gzhom med pasal/ /nyi ma yi ni gdan la gnas/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pa rna ⑨drung bzung / /mgo bor zla phyed thig les brgyan/ /'dod chags mtha' yi rang bzhin no/ /ye shes sa bon nyis 'gyur dbye/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu bas skyes/ /'og dang steng du gnas pa yisakyi/ /mgon po longs spyod rdzogs 'dzin pa/ /snying ga yidang ni chu ⑩skyes su/ /don gyi cho ga yongs rdzogs pa'o/ /yongs su skrag byed ma sa bon/ /pa mtha'i yi ge bzung tsonas ni/ /slar yang de bzhin brjod par bya/ / o byen 8'bar ba 'dzin grong gi/ /bu gar gtum mo sbor ba'o/ /byang chub sems kyis sa gsum 'gongs/ /de ltar bshad pa'i sngags gang ni/ /rim pas yi ge rnams mi mthun/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ming ldan par/ /las dus de ltar rtogs 8par bya/ /re re'i che ba'i bdag nyid ni/ /yi ge yi ni grangs kyis so/ /bdag nyid chen po rnam par 'phro/ /byang chub cha shas cha rgyu'o/ /thog mar rnam snang phyag 'tshal ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni bya ba'i 78—414

gzugs/ /ta sde'i lnga pa'i yi ge ni/ /lnga pa yi ni sde tshan no/ /rnal 'byor ma gzugs nam mkha' brten①/ /pa mtha'i sa bon o dbyangs ldan/ /gti mug 'joms par byed ma ste/ /rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs spro ba'o/ /de yi bzhi pa'i sa bon no②/ /sa gsum du ni khyab pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma ni spro ba'o/ /thog ma'i sde yi gsum pa ste/ /'gro ba drug po nyams byed pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo spro/ /ya sde'i mtha' ma'i sa bon ni/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /lnga pa'i sde yi thog ma ste/ /de bzhin nyid kyi sa bon te/ /i yi dbyangs kyis mgo la reg /chu yi yi ge yongs bsngags ③pa/ /thams cad byed pa'i rang bzhin no/ /tsa ①sde'i dbus gnas bzung nas ni/ /nyi ma ⑤yi ni gdan ldan pa/ /las kyi dus su khyad par ldan/ /phag mo yi ni sa bon ni/ /a yi yi ge rna bar reg /sa gsum ye shes rang bzhin mnyam/ /me yi sa bon dbyangs gnyis ldan/ /'khor ba'i las kyi rang bzhin no/ /sa mtha'i rjomago la zhi ⑦dbyangs reg /rtag tu tshangs pa'i rang bzhin blta/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pa bzung ⑧nas ni/ /de ltar mkha' 'gro ma yi gzugs/ /sems can sgrol bar byed pa'o⑨/ /ya yig gnas pa ra dang ldan/ /slar yang khri 0yi dbyangs sbyar ro/ /khams gsum rnal 'byor ma spro'o/ /drug pa'i sde yi dang po ni/ /rnal 'byor ma sngags kun rang bzhin/ /ra gnas pa ni a dbyangs ldan/ /snang ⑩ba'i sems can gsod byed 'gyur/ /dza yi yi ge yongs bzung 8ste/ /i yi 'dabyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yongs ldan pa'o/ /so yi sa bon rna ba la/ /i ④yi dbyangs kyis reg pas dbye/ /klu yi sngags ni sbyar byas te/ /tre 8yi yi ⑩ge sa gsum kun/ /ye shes kyi ni khyad par sngags/ /la yi yi ge o dang ldan/ /78—415

'jig rten rnams kyi rten yin te/ /byang chub byed pa'i chos yin no/ /thog ma'i ka ni ya stan ldan/ /'chi dang lhan skyes dbye ba med/ /pa yi sde yi mtha' ma la/ /a yi yi ge'i dbyangs sbyar bya/ /sa gsum gyi ni ma rang bzhin/ /ta yig e yi yi ges brgyan/ /bde ba 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /slar yang pa ①sde'i mtha' ma ste/ /tshad med pa yi lhan skyes kyi/ /dbus na bzhugs pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sa yi mtha' ma ā dang ldan/ /rdor sems ye shes gzhom med pa'o//ya (misde'i mtha' ma i dbyangs ldan/ /mi shes rang bzhin 'joms byed pa'o/ /h+ye sngags chos dbyings rang bzhin te/ /thams cad rang bzhin du khyab pa'o/ /bu ga rnams nas 'dzag pa sa/ /'bab pa'i sa bon nyi ma ldan/ /chu srin dbang po yi ni sngags/ /ba sde (9bzhi pa'i sa bon ni/ /u dbyangs stan ④dang ldan pa ste / /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa nyams byed pa'o⑤/ /ta yi sngags kyis dgra nyams byed / /slar yang pa kunasde'i bzhi pa ni/ /sgra chen po ni sgrogs pa'o/ /rlung gi sa bon ā yig reg⑦ /sngags ni nor bur 'bab bzhin pa'o/ /chu yi sa bon rnar bzung 6)ba/ /sgyu ma yi ni rang bzhin no/ /sa yi pha rol e yig ldan/ /sa gsum gyi ni 'khrul 'joms rgyu/ /pa sde'i mtha' ma rkang rang bzhin/ /sa yi pha rol ā nyubyedang ldan/ /ngo mtshar che ba yi ni chos/ /ya yi sde yi mtha' ma ni/ /pad+ma'i sa bon mchog yig go/ /tsa 7yi dbus ma'i sa bon ni/ /ra ni ⑩mgo la gnas pa ste/ /e yig gis ni phye ba ni/ /lha dang lha min rang bzhin no/ /de ltar sngags tshig 8drug po ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs spro ba/ /las kun rang bzhin 'khor lo'o/ /snying rje'i 'dod par gyur pa yi/ /de kho na nyid tshig rgya che / /rnal 'byor thams cad rab 'gengs pa'i/ /bcom ldan mkha' 'gros ⑫78—416

'di gsungs so/ /'khrul 'khor 'khor lo bshad bya ste/ /khyod kyi 'khrul 'khor chung rgya che/ /kun nas yongs su zlum por ni/ /ri mo bcu gsum bri bar bya/ /lha mo dum bu bcu gnyis 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa drug rtsibs kyis brgyan/ /rtsibs re re la'ang yi ge ni/ /rim pas yongs su gsal bar sbyin/ /lhag ma nyi shu bzhi yi ge/ /thams cad lte ba'i snying po la'o/ /de rnams kyis ni bskyed pa'i rtsa/ /stong phrag bdun nyucu rtsa gnyis so/ /so so re re yi ni 'khor/ /nor dang mda' dang zla ba'o/ /kun la lhag pas dman pa ni/ /nor dang rig byed tshogs ②pa'o/ /der gnas pa la 'khrul 'khor btu/ /las gcig ①ji ltar mos pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i bzhon ④pa ni/ /rtsa thams cad du 'char dus su/ /der ni dbang po dang ni yul/ /las kyi dus su gsad par dubya/ /yid ces bya ba bskrad bya zhing / /sems ni dbang du bya ba ste/ /khams dang skye mched gzhan de bzhin/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas par bya/ /phung po kun dang de bzhin srog /dgug pa dang ni snang ba'o/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin sems/ /de rnams rengs par bya ba'o/ /las gzhan ji ltar rigs ⑥pa yis/ /brgyad kyis lhag pa'i brgya yang ngo / /yang na sa bon ci 'dra ba/ /de yi tshad dang mnyam las ⑦so/ /de dus bdag nyid che ba yis/ /yi shes bskyed nidang 'joms pa'o/ /phag mo rdo rje gtso mo yi/ /'khrul 'khor gnyis pa bshad bya ste/ /ya sde'i mtha' yi sa bon ni/ /byang chub sa bon rang bzhin no/ /lce gnyis yi ge ra yig ldan/ /rnal 'byor ma sngags ā ⑨yig dgang / /sa gnas pa ni mi g.yo ba'o/ /na yi yi ge e dang ldan/ /sems can kun sprul rgyu mtshan no/ /thog gnas dbyangs ni thog ma'i mgon/ /lce gnyis e ⑩dbyangs mgo la 78—417

reg /sa gsum khams kyi rang bzhin no/ /ta yi yi ge e dang ldan/ /lnga pa yi ni thog ma ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ①rang bzhin no/ /ya sde'i bzhir ②gnas pa'i sa bon/ /kun gyi gtso mo'i rang bzhin no/ /brgyad pa'i sde yi thog sa bon / /stong pa yis ni brgyan pa ste/ /khu ba'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /gnyis par gnas pa'i thog ma ni/ /keng rus thig le 'dzin pa'o/ /ya sde'i ③gnyis pa'i sa bon ni/ /i yi dbyangs dang ldan pa ste/ /rdo rje snying gnas dumagon po'o / /ta mtha' e (sheyi yi shes brgyan/ /skye gnas la ni spras 0pa'o/ /ta yig nyi ma dang ldan pa/ /rims 'joms pa yi rgyal po'o⑦/ /bha ni nyi laldan a yig brgyan/ /lte ba'i thab 7tu gnas pa'o/ /pa sde'i mtha' ma gnas rang bzhin / /ṭa mtha' i yis brgyan pa ni/ /'gugs pa yi ni rang bzhin no/ /bi sho ṣa ṣi sngags bzhi ste/ /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin gyisakyi/ /gter chen po yi sa bon no/ /ra yig o yi yi shes brgyan/ /rtsa drag po yi rang bzhin no/ /sha yi gnyis pa'i sa bon ni/ /snying po yi ni gzugs su'o/ /ṇi yig rang bzhin gyis bzung nyunyab/ /rnal 'byor ma tunyeyi de nyid do8/ /ka yig ra yig o yig ldan / /dbu ma brkyang tsom ro rang bzhin/ /ta pa'i bar gnas gzung bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyi ni/ /rkang pa brgyad pa bsgrub rang bzhin/ /ta sde'i mtha' ma i yig brgyan/ /thod pa'i dbus kyi rtsa rang bzhin/ /ka ru mngon brjod gzung bar bya/ /de yis las rnams zad par byed/ /ra yig a yi yi shes gzung / /mgo bo'i dbus nas sgra chen 'dzag /sa yi sa bon i yig ldan//gru gsum gyi ni dbus su'o/ /ta yi mtha' ma yis brgyan pa/ /sprul pa'i steng dang 'og tu'o/ /ta yig ra yig ā 8yig sbyar/ /chos kyi dbyings ni gru gsum 78—418

ste/ /de phyir sa gsum skyed ①pa'o/ /sa gzung ②dbus ma bcas sa bon/ /na yig i dang ldan rang bzhin/ /pa sde'i mtha' ma a yis brgyan/ /sgyu ma'i ngo bo pad+ma'i nirtsa/ /ra gang gnas pa rna rang bzhin/ /ṭa sde'i mtha' ma i dang ldan/ /ma lus dbyer med sems can gyi/ /khams 'dzin pa yi mgon po'o/ /de ltar sngags tshig bcu brjod de/ /dus bzhi yi ni tshad can no/ /rnal 'byor ma kun las kyi ni/ /'khor los sgyur dub longs spyod pa/ /dus kyi gzugs kyi rang bzhin can/ /bcom ldan lha yis 'di gsungs so/ /mkha' 'gro ma gnas 'du ba ni/ /'khor lo 'khor lor shes pa'o/ /nyi khri brgya phrag bcu drug gi/ /ye shes las ni de bzhin byed/ /yon por smra ba rnams kyi ⑤ni/ /de'i rdul grangs las skyes par 'dod/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i ming bzung yinas/ /phyi nas blo ldan gyis sngags sbyar④/ /sngon du pa la ra stan nino/ /thog ma yi ni chos gzugs so//de yi bzhi par gnas pa la/ /e yi yi ges rnar ⑨brgyan pa/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sngags so/ /ta sde'i dbus gnas ⑩ci 'dod ster⑩/ /na yig i 8yi yi ge ldan/ /sna tshogs sprul pa byed pa'o/ /pa yig spros pa dang bcas pa'o/ /ra yi yi ge a dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor los sgyur8/ /tsa 8sde'i dbus gnas tsos bon gzung ⑩/ /gang lta ⑩de lta'i rang bzhin no/ /rlung ⑫bsags pa ni e yig ldan/ /a haṃ yi ge'i rang bzhin no/ /ya yi sde yi mtha' ma la/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas mgo la brgyan/ /sna tshogs ye shes sngags rang bzhin/ /dza yi sa bon mtha' med par/ /'bar bar 'gyur ba yi ni gzugs/ /yi ge ya ni e yig ldan/ /theg pa kun gyi lta ba'i gzugs/ /tsa sde'i gsum pa'i sa bon ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs zhes bya/ /pa mtha' yide yi bzhi 78—419

pa la'o/ /sngags thams cad kyi bla ma'o/ /ta sde'i mtha' ma dbyangs gsum ldan / /ma lus sems can 'bod pa'i gzugs/ /dro ba'i gsum pa ta stan can / /'gro dang mi 'gro bcas 'gro sgrol/ /de bzhin sna'i yi ge bzung ①/ /sa ni bcu bzhi pa'i gzugs so/ /ni sngags rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /brda yis su ni 'jug pa'o/ /pa sde'i mtha' ma o yig reg /sna tshogs mi shes 'dzin ②pa'o/ /sa mtha' rdor sems rang bzhin no/ /ni yi yi ge chos dang ni/ /chos min sun 'byin pa yin no/ /ya yi sde yi mtha' ma ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ste nam mkha'i gzugs/ /dza yig ra yig stan can ni③/ /khu ba'i rang bzhin shar ba'o / /slar yang rlung gi mtha' ma ni/ /a ①yi yi ges gzi bskyed pa/ /tshangs pa pad+ma yi ni gzugs/ /ra yig a yig ⑤yi ge ldan/ /'gyur ba med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sa mtha' dbyangs gsum mgo la gnas/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams 'bab pa'i gzugs/ /ma ni dbus ma de nyid gzugs/ /sa mtha' a yis bkang ba (yeste/ /rnal 'byor ma gzugs kyi khar brjod/ /ya yig o yi cod pan gnas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ka sde'i dbus gnas dbyangs gsum brgyan/ /de nyid med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ni ⑦yi yi ge rang bzhin med/ /gnyis pa yi ni thog ma la/ /a yi yi ge ⑧gsal bar byed⑨/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin no/ /pa sde'i mtha' ma e dang ldan/ /thams cad sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /pa yi sa bon mthar sha ste/ /ya sde'i mtha' yig stan can ni/ /khu ba dang ni rlung dbyer med/ /i dbyangs mgor brgyan me sa bon / /grub pa sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /ka yi gnyis pa'i sa bon ni/ /nam mkha' rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs/ /sa bon de yi mtha'i 0yi ge/ /e yi yi ges 78—420

rnar brgyan pa/ / dpa' bo ①gcig pu mi bskyod pa'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo mkha' rang bzhin/ /de ltar rkang pa dgu po ni/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs yi ge ste / /khams gsum gyi ni sngags rang bzhin/ /sngags kun spyod pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la bzhugs nas/ /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol ②ba'i/ /bcom ldan lha yis 'di gsungs so/ /'khor lo gsum pa'i nus pa yis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i las bya'o/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi las dus su/ /sgyu mas thams cad rmongs par bya/ /rdo rje ma bdag slar langs nas/ /'khor lo gzhan gyi rnal 'byor ldan/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur gtso bo la/ /bdag med ma yis dam 'khyud do③/ /ta yi sngags ④kyis gnyis pa sbyor/ /bya duganas me dang rlung sa bon/ /bde ba chen po'i 'dod chags che/ /de yi gnyis pa'i yis bon ni/ /ā yi yi ges dgang ba'o/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi rang bzhin/ /pa yig ra yig o yig sbyar/ /gsum po rlung gi rang bzhin no/ /ta yi yi ge i ⑦yig ldan/ /slar yang rnam shes sa bon no/ /ka yi sde yi dbus gnas pa/ /e yi yi ges rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor ma'i phyag rgya rang bzhin/ /slar la yang ni brjod par bya'o/ /tshig 'di thabs shes dbyer med dngos/ /sa mtha' dang ni na yi sngags/ / slar la ⑧yang ni brjod par bya/ /skyed cing sdud par byed gzugs so/ /pa ra ā khyayig sa bon gcig /don dam pa yi yi ge'o/ /ṭa mtha' ā yi yi ge ldan/ /gzhom du med las skyes pa'o/ /ta yi mtha' ma kun 'joms pa'o/ /ka ka dang ni ṇi ⑩gnas la/ /dbyangs gsum sbyar zhing thig le sbyin/ /rnal 'byor ma kun 'bod pa'o/ /de bzhin du ni kha kha dang / /gsum pa ṇa ru gnas pa yi7/ /dub pa sel bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /dhu na yi ni 78—421

sngags kyi tshig① /lan gnyis su ni brjod par bya/ /rtog pa thams cad ②'joms par byed/ /ya sde'i mtha' ma yi ni sngags/ /rdo rje'i ③bu gar brgyan pa'o/ /tsa sde'i dbus gnas sa bon ni/ /ra yi stan la yongs su gnas/ /gti mug za bar ⑤byed pa'o/ /sa mtha' gzhom med dbus ma'o/ /sha ①sde'i gsum pa ha ④stan can/ /e yi yi ge rna bar brgyan/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma yi gzugs/ /'bod par byed pa yi ni sngags/ /sho ṣa ya yi sngags kyi tshig /lan gnyis su ni brjod par bya/ /ye shes can rlom nga rgyal 'joms/ /byang chub byang chub med de nyid/ /de ltar rkang pa bcu gnyis ni/ /sa dang rnal 'byor las rang bzhin/ /bcu gnyis sa ⑦rnams khyab bdag gi/ /bcom ldan lha yis 'di gsungs so/ /yi ge rnams kyi gnas sogs kyi/ /brda yis de nyid pha rol 'gro/ /bdag las sems can thams cad skyes/ /sems can las kyang bdag byung ngo / /bdag de rtag tu med gyur nas/ /sgyu ma mi lam de bzhin gshegs / /'khrul 'khor 'di ni stobs che ste/ /las rnams ji lta bar ni byung //rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i mtshan nyid du/ /dus ni'adir thams cad 'gyur ba'o/ /'khor lo lnga pa 'di rnams su/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang brjod par bya/ /lha sogs thams cad rgyun du gsod/ /de rnams thams cad rtag tu 'grol0/ /bka' stsal pa/ ka yi gnyis pa'i sa bon ni/ /rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs de nyid do/ /ṭa bzung pa mtha'i stan can te/ /i gis cod pan brgyan par bya/ /de la a yi yi gis dgang / /'gro ba drug gi rang bzhin no/ /ka sde'i dbus gnas sa bon ni/ /dug gis 0reg pa 'phrog par byed/ /ka yi sa bon stong rang bzhin/ /na yi mtha' ma ā 7yig ldan/ /me 'bar ba yis 8dbang ldan 78—422

te/ /'dzin pa yi ni sa bon ni/ /bskyod ①pa'i khyab bdag chen po'o/ /ta yi sde yi bzhi pa ni/ /ā ②yi dbyangs kyis brgyan pa'oni/ /srid pa dang bral ba yi gzugs/ /nyi ma e yig ldan ro langs/ /ta mtha'i sa bon gzung bar bya/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas mgo la brgyan/ /sa gsum thams cad gsod pa'o/ /pa sde mtha' yi sa bon ni/ /yid kyi dusmra ba rtog med byed/ /sa mtha'i ā yi ngag ldan pa/ /thar pa'i bshes ni rtog pa'o/ /ma gnyis ha gnyis brjod par bya/ /rmongs pa'i rang bzhin 'phrog cing 'phrog /pa yi sa bon i yig brgyan/ /pha nags kun nyams gzung de nyid/ /sha yi yi gis i dang ldan/ /seng ge za ba yi ni sngags/ /ta'i sngags slar yang 'chi med skye/ /pa mtha' i ⑤yi yi ges dgang / /thig les 0cod pan la reg pa'o/ /rgya la 'chi ba rtog ⑦pa yin/ /sa ⑧yig dbyangs gnyis brjod phyir brgyan/ /sngon du 'phrog par byed pa'o/ /sha gnas sa bon dur khrod del/ /ta mtha' i dang ldan pa ni/ /thams cad rang bzhin med pa'o/ /pa sde'i mtha' ma smi ⑩dbyangs ldan/ /snang ba'i yid ⑩ni 'dzin chen po/ /na yig u stan rtog kun sel/ /sha 8sde'i gnyis pa'i sa bon ni/ /ā yig mgor reg thig le gnas/ /byang chub sgrub pa yi ni sngags/ /thur du sel ba'i rlung gis so/ /ta dang ra yi yi ge gnyis/ /sa ni 'jigs par byed sngags so/ /pa ra ā 8yi sa bon gcig /sum cu rtsa gsum skyo dub 'joms/ /ya sde'i mtha' ma ri mnan ④pa/ /ye shes kyi ni dag byed do/ /ṇa yi 'gram gnas sa bon ni/ / i yis 8rna bar brgyan pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yi mi shes 'joms/ /sa yig e yi 8yi ges dgang / /dbugs 'chad pa ni nyams par byed/ / na sngags dbyangs ⑩gsum mgo la brgyan8/ /chos dang chos 78—423

min 6)spong rang bzhin/ /dha yig ya dang sbyar ba ste/ /bsam gtan sngags kyi rang bzhin no/ /ta lasde'i mtha' ma gzung ②bya ste/ /grong khyer ltar snang dudangos po med/ /ya sde'i gnyis pa'i sa bon ni/ /gti mug rang bzhin 'bar ba'o / /sa yig i yi yi ges dbye/ /seng ge ma he 'joms pa'o/ /nyi mar duyang ni gnas pa ni/ /rnal 'byor ma kun rgyal po'odu/ /pa sde'i mtha' ma ā ⑦dbyangs brgyanadu/ /sgyu mar sems can kun des 'dzin/ /'dzin pa'i sa bon a yig brgyan/ /de kho na yi ye shes thob/ /de ltar rkang pa bcu bzhi po/ /sems can kun gyis 0mi shes gsod/ /dam pa'i sngags dngos gzugs bdag nyid/ /'byin cing sdud par byed pa po/ /'byung po thams cad 'jigs byed pa/ /bcom ldan lha yis 0'di gsungs so/ /'khor lo'i tunyernam pa'i gzugs bdag nyid/ /phag mo'i thugs kur 8brgyan pa ste/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas8/ /gsod pa dang ni mi gsod pa'o④/ /ka sde'i dbus na ra stan ⑫can/ /gsum de'i mgo la thig le sbyin/ /theg pa mchog gi chos can no/ /ta sde'i gnyis pa'i yi ge ni/ /i yi dbyangs dang ldan pa'o/ /mu stegs rnal 'byor nyams byed pa'o/ /ta yig rtogs ⑩par byed pa'o/ /ta sde'i bzhir ⑩gnas ā dang ldan/ /byang chub mtha' med 'dzin pa'o/ /ra gnas pa la dbyangs gsum brgyan/ /rnal 'byor ma kun 'chad pa'o/ /na sngags i yig ⑫gis brgyan pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi lam mo/ /sum+bha na yi tshig rkang ste/ /lan gnyis su ni brjod par bya/ /tshig drug rtogs yipa'i de nyid do/ /de bzhin du ni sum+bha'i sngags/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dumachod rang bzhin/ /ha na'i sngags ni lan gnyis brjod/ /sdang ba'i theg pa nyams par byed/ /pa ra ā 078—424

yi yi ge gcig /dbang po rang rang ngo bo gzhan/ /ṇa a i ①gi yi ges dgang / /sa bon 'di ni yon tan sngags/ /sa yig rtsa kun (mi'adzag pa'o/ /ba yig ra yi yig brgyan ri/ /pa gnas nam mkha' la 'jug pa'o/ /sa yi yig gnas kun gyi gzugs/ /ya sde'i mtha' ma ā niyis dgang / /rlung ni srog gi ye shes so/ /na yig ā yi yi ges dgang / /byang chub gang du'ang mi rtog pa'o/ /thig le mgo la blta bar bya/ /ba sde'i mtha' ma sbrang chen gzugs/ /sa mtha' ā yis dgang dubar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ④tshogs srog go/ /pa mtha' a dang ldan pa la/ /i dugi cod pan ⑦brgyan pa'o/ /chos kun gyi ni sprin rang bzhin/ /sa yig dam chos mi shes gsod/ /ts+tsha sngags byang chub sems dpa'o⑧//song ba 'khor bar skye ba med/ /ta sde'i dbus gnas sa bon ni/ /nga ni don med pa snang ba'o/ /na la i dang ldan pa ste/ /'jig rten ma lus 'ching ba nyid/ /kro sngags gnon pas ⑨'khor ba gcod/ /dha yi sa bon 'gro kun 'joms/ /spros pa med par byed pa'o/ /mū 0yi yi ge sa bon ni/ /rmongs pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi las/ /de ltar phyed bcas tshig bcu bzhi/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo yi ni mtha'o/ /bum pa can la sogs pa'i las/ /rnal 'byor gang dang gang 'dod byed⑩/ /'khor lo drug gi rab sbyor bas/ /ci 'dod las kyi rang bzhin te/ /bdag po sbyor ba 'grub 8nus can/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di gsungs so/ /gtsug tor la sogs skye gnas mthar/ /lus ngag sems shes nam mkha' las/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog 8pa yis/ /de nyid byang chub rnams shes bya/ /'dir ni thabs kyi cha dang ni/ /shes rab kyi yang cha ru brjod/ /yang na yi ge re re yi/ /bar bar du ste slar yang ni/ /dhi sngags 78—425
