lhan skyes rang bzhin te/ /'khor lo yi ni khyad par gyi/ /nye ba'i las rnams byed pa'o/ / rda ṭī ①ka rā 0li yi sngags/ /'gro ba rnams kyi las ②rang bzhinaX / /ma sngags hā ⑤sngags mu dre'i ༷sngags/ /rna ba yi ni rang bzhin no/ /shrī ho ru ka de ba sgyu gra ma hi ṣi'i/ /sngags tshig sna yi rang bzhin no/ /sa ha sra shi tsore yi sngags/ /dbyangs kyi bdag po yi ni gzugs/ /sa ha dusra bā ha be yi//sngags kyi yi ge lus kyi gzugs/ /sha ta sa'i sngags 'khor lo gcig /mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags 'chi ba dang / /skye ba yi ni rang bzhin no/ /gnyis med rnam pa'i chos las ni/ /gnyis su sems can 'dzin pa ste/ /shes rab la ni bde ster ba/ /bcom ldan bla mas 'di gsungs so/ /nyan thos la sogs mu stegs rnams / /mi shes pa yi phyugs thams cad/ /de rnams ye shes 'thob ⑨bya'i phyir / /tshul lugs 'di ni bstan pa'o/ /ha sru ⑩na ne 0yi ni sngags/ /yul gyi gzugs la reg pa'o/ /dz+wa li ta te 8dza se'i sngags/ /sngags kyi tshig ni yid kyi yul/ /dz+wa 8la mu khri'i 8tshig lus yul/ /ping ga lo tsa na yi sngags/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa'o/ /badz+ra sha rī re'i 8sngags tshig /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'o / /badzā yis ne 7yi ni sngags/ /sna yi yul la reg pa'o/ /mi 8bla te yi yisngags kyi tshig /sna yi rnam par shes pa'o/ /tsi li te yi sngags kyi tshig /dbyangs kyi bdag po yi ni yul/ /he sngags gnyis brjod sgra yi yul/ /sgra dang dbyangs gnyis kyi rnam shes/ /de ltar sngags tshig phyed bcas bdun/ /'chi dang skye ba kun gyi gzugs/ /phag mo la ni bde dga' ba'i/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs te0 / /bo la rkak+kol 0sbyor bdag nyid/ /yul dang dbang dupo sogs gsod pa'o/ /sems can gang dang gang rnams kyi/ /yul gyi 78—426

chu skyes las skyes te/ /sems can de dang de rnams kyi/ /rang rang las rnams kyis gsod pa'o/ /yul la sogs pa 'joms pas na/ /shes rab 'khor lo ①de bshad do/ /rgyud ②dang rgyud rnams kyi ni las/ /sgrub pa'i snying po'i ①ye shes so/ /sa mtha' drug pa'i dbyangs stan can/ /zla dum thig les mgo la brgyan/ /lan duganyis su ni brjod par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gsang ba'i gzugs/ /kha gnyis dhu gnyis mu ru gnyis/ /las rnams kyi ni dngos po ste/ /srog dang mnyam du gnas pa'o/ /a dī ⑤te ma hā yo gi gristi/ /pa thi ta sidhe'i ⑦sngags kyi tshig /de yang lus mtha' yi ni gzugs/ / dre dhe tshig duganyis gro tshig gnyis/ /he yi tshig gnyis ha tshig gnyis/ /khro bcu'i yi ge gshin rje ni/ /mthar byed la sogs kyir go ⑨bya/ /pa sde'i bzhi pa'i sa bon la/ /khri yig mgo la reg pa'o/ /me sa'i sngags ni tshig kun te/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rang bzhin no / /de ltar sngags tshig bcu gnyis ni/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis slu ba ste/ /ston ⑩pa dam tshig chen po gtso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di gsungs so/ /rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /las kyis 7lhan cig rmugs byed pa'o/ /pho nya rnams bskyed pa'i yi ge/ /'khor lo'i rnam pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'khor lo yi ge min de ltar/ /pho nya'i rang bzhin med pa'o/ /rnam smin de las rnam skyes pa/ /so so'i ming du 'du shes te/ /'jam rdor la sogs dngos po yis/ /a ba ⑫ dhū tī'i tsomatshan nyid bya/ / hā sa hā dpa' bo ④gcig sngags tshig /de bzhin gshegs drug sa bon te/ /yon tan mtha' med 'chad pa'o/ /hā yi sa bon yi ge bzhi/ /ho gcig ho gnyis brjod par bya/ /yi ge bdun po lpags sogs 8khams/ /tre+e 8lo kya bi nā ⑩sha'i sngags/ /snang ba la ni go 78—427

cha'o① / /sha ta sa ha sra ②ko ṭi0/ /ta thā ga ta pa ri bā ro④/ /sa mtha' u yi dbyangs kyis spras/ /zla ba'i dum bu thig les brgyan/ /de ltar sngags kun nyer sdud zhi)pa'o/ /ha lca stirma sngags kyi rang bzhin/ /de ltar sngags kyi tshig ni bzhi / /rnal 'byor ma skyed dngos grub 'gyur/ /bkas gnang ⑦dngos grub rab 'jug pa/ /bcom ldan dpa' bos 'di gsungs so/ /mkha' 'gro sdom pa mngon brjod dang / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud rnams su gsungs pa'i/ /las kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub steral/ / bkas gnang ⑨'khor lo'i rab sbyor bas/ /'grub 'gyur sbyor ba gzhan gyis min/ /slar yang sa mtha' dbyangs lnga pa'i/ /drung na gnas pa'i stan can la/ /zla dum thig les brgyan pa'o/ /cho gas de kho na'i sa bon/ /pa drung gnas pa rnal 'byor ma'i/ /tshogs ni skyed ⑩par byed pa'o/ /ṭa yiyig 'bar bar byed pa'i sngagasal/ /sing ha ru pe khaḥsngags tshig /bgegs kyi gtso bo rlag 'byed pa'o/ /ga dza rū 7pe gaḥ0yi sngags/ /sems can kun gyi bgegs byed pa'o/ / tre+e lo kyo 8da re yi tshig /rab mchog pho nya kun skyed ⑩pa'o/ /sa mu dra me kha le ⑦gra ha gnyis kyi tshig /rgya mtsho lta bu'i ska rags spras/ /de ni sngags kyi ska rags sogs8ske/ /r+ghaṃ dang phaṭa kyi yi ge ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi khyab bdag go/ /bī rā dī 0te hūṃ sngags tshig /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med las/ /tha mal 'dus byas skyes pa'o/ /de ltar rkang pa bdun sngags te/ /ye shes sa yi rang bzhin gyizhu / /bcom ldan rdo rjes 'di gsungs te/ /sems can las 0las grub pa'i mthar/ /de yi go 'phang mchog tu 'gro/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang ba'i ming / /slar yang skye zhing lam la gnas/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa sgyu ma yinadu/ /78—428

rang gi bdag nyid so sor rig /hūṃ hā ①gnyis ma hā pa shu mo ha ni②/ /tshig ni 'khor ba'i rmongs pa'o/ / yo gī shwa rī two ①gi sngags/ /zhi ba yi ni gzugs su'o/ /ḍā duki nī lo kā ⑤rna ban dhā ni'i yitshig /'jig rten byang chub tu 'jug byed/ /sa t+ya me hūṃ phaṭa'i sngags kyi tshig /mtha' bzhi po ni ston pa'o/ /bhū ta tā mes ni yi tshig /mu stegs ye shes 'joms pa'o/ /de ltar sngags ⑧tshig bdun pos ni/ /las kyi dbye ba byed pa ste/ /pad lte'i 'dab khyam re re la / /sngags kyi yi ge rnams ⑩gnas pa'o/ /dpa' bo'i nyunyesngags kyi gzugs gnas pa'o⑩/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di gsungs so/ /'khrul 8'khor chen po bcu gnyis de/ /bdag gi mdza' bo yis ④ni gsungs/ /las thams cad kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ /bcu gnyis rnams kyis 8lhan cig bya/ /'khor lo chen po re re ru/ /nges par so so'i las bya'o/ /phrad pa rnams ni bcu gnyis su/ /bsgrub bya'i ming gis bsgrub par bya/ /pa mtha' sa mtha' ā ⑩dang ldan/ /ya mtha' khri yi dbyangs dang bcas/ /re hu)yig na mtha' ra yig dang / /pa mtha' dang ni sidhe'i tunyetshig /bibye'i ⑩tshig dang shwa ri'i sngags/ /pa'i drung ma dang ṭa sa bon/ /hū la zla dum thig les brgyan/ /bskyar la yang ni brjod par bya/ /pa'i rjo drung gnas dang ṭa yig ste/ /hūm̐ phaṭa dang ni swā hā bcas/ /sngags 'dis 0lte bar cho ga yis/ /bsgrub bya ming dang bcas par brjod/ /bcu gnyis rnams dang lte bcas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 'di gsungs so/ /sa bon yi ge nyi shu bzhi/ /pul+lī char sogs bsres 4)pa'o/ /dpal he ru ka rdor phag mo/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags 'di yi ni mthu stobs ni/ /bye ba stong phrag gsungs pa yi/ /mtha' med gzhung chalas dpa' ba ④yis /78—429

de bzhin snying po bsdus pa yin/ /rgyud gzhan du ni gsungs pa'i sngags/ /sngags 'di yi ①ni sgrub ②thabs so/ /bzlas med grangs med yi ge med/ /gzugs med bsam gtan de bzhin med/ /lha dran pa yi ye shes kyis/ /dngos grub thams cad skyed ①pa'o/ /dbugs 'jug pa yi dus su ni/ /yi ge thams cad gsad dupar bya/ /'byin pa rnams kyis ⑧sbyor kun byed0/ /'byung ba'i dus su shes par bya/ /gnas dus rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi⑦/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni 'dod mi bya/ /dbugs rgyu nide ltar shes bya ste/ /byis pa'i rnal 'byor pas mi rtogs/ /gang gi slob ma dbang bskur ba/ /de nyid bzhi ⑨rnams bcas pas so/ /theg pa chen por yongs smin la/ /phyi nas sngags ni rab bstan bya/ /sngon du phag mo'i ⑩dkyil 'khor ni/ /bri bya de nas 7he ru ku'i'o/ /rdo rje'i bu mo'am de nas gzhan/ /der ni shes rab gzhug 8par bya/ /rgyud gzhan du ni dbang bskur la/ /tshul 'di bstan par mi bya'o/ /ye shes shes bya'i tshurang bzhin can/ /a ba dhū tīr dkyil 'khor bya/ /ye shes rnam pa phag mo yis/ /shes bya dpal he ru kur 'khyud/ /spyan gsum drag po'i tsogazugs can ma/ /zhal bzhi mche ba gtsigs pa ste/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis rnams dang ldan / /dkar mo dang ni 'jigs byed gnon/ /sku la phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /'jig ⑩dus me lta'i 'od zer can/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje dang gri gug /dgra sta ḍā 8ru de bzhin du0/ /rtse gsum lus med pags 8pa ste/ /phyag g.yon pas kyang de bzhin no/ /g.yon du dril bu thod pa dang / /zhags ⑥pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang mgo / /dbu spa grol zhing gcer bu ma/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba 'dzin pa mo/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan rnams dang ni ldan/ /dbu la thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /'dod chags 78—430

rdo rjes ①rgyas btab ste/ /yang na he ru ka yis so/ /yan lag lha rdzas dris nyer byugs②/ /zhabs gdub dpung rgyan rnams dang ldan/ /lha rdzas me tog phreng bas bklubasal/ /rtse bran zlar duganas rdo rje ni/ /dpral bar rtag tu 'dzin pa mol/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs mdun du/ /sku las 'bar ba'i phreng ba spro/ /he ru 0ka mig sman nag po 'dra/ /ral pa'i cod pan mdun du'o/ /stag gi pags ⑦pa'i sham thabs can/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par bklubasal/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed ldan/ /spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa ste/ /zhal bzhi pa la 'jigs par byed/ /phyag bcu gnyis par rig par bya/ /brgya phyed mgo bos brgyan pa ste/ /mchod phyir thogs dang thal ba dang / /'bar ba'i phreng can gtsigs pa po/ /skye gnas phyag rgya phyag gnyis kyis/ /lhag ma rdo rje phag mo'i'o/ /gal te he ru ka gtso bo/ /de tshe phag mo'i phyag gnyis su'o/ /glang po'i pags ⑨pa 'dzin pa po/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid de/ /zag med rnal 'byor bde chen bzang / /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i gzugs/ /gnyis po snying por sbyin par bya/ /lhag ma rnal 'byor ma rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs rim ji ltar/ /thod dum tshul sogs sngags rig pas/ /dpa' bo kun kyang sbyin par bya/ /re re yi yang de yi rgyud/ /ji ltar sngon 0gyi rjes su'o/ /brkyang 8ma dang ni ro ma'i rtsa/ /shes rab dang ni thabs 'du ba'i/ /rten ni a ba dhū tī ⑫ste/ /gang der ro mnyam son pa'o/ /'khor lo gsum gnyis 'gyur shes bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs rim ji bzhin/ /he ru ka dang rdor phag mo/ /'bum tsho stong phrag phyag can te/ /phyag gnyis la sogs nas brtsams nas/ /gzhan ni 78—431

gang rnams de rnams so/ /dbang po'i yul ni mi lta ①zhing / /phyag dang bzhugs tshul la sogs min/ / bsgoms pas ②spros pa kun bzung ste/ /gti mug de ni spang bar gyis/ /skad cig rnam pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig la sogs de'i ②sbyor can/ /snying gar snyis bon rnam par dgod/ /spro dang bsdu ba la sogs bya/ /dkyil 'khor spyan drangs ⑤mchod pa dang / /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs te/ /stong nyid la sogs ri rab mthar/ /ra ba dang ni gur la sogasaX/ /sa yi char ni rdo rje'i thig /'khor lo drug tu bri ba'o/ /ji lta'i mngon rtogs mtshan ④nyid kyisakun)ske/ /rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad bya/ /thabs dang man ngag thams cad ni / /mdzes ma bdag gis kun bshad do/ /der ni gtor ma sbyin bya ste/ /sa sogs lnga rnams kyis mchod bya/ /yi ge 'bar ba'i yig rnams kyis/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa yang bya'o/ /'bar ba'i gnyis 'phel yig rnams kyis/ /srog gi ⑨gtum mo sbar tsobar bya/ /steng du kha bltas 0rtsa bsreg ste/ /de bzhin ye shes mkha' 'gro skyes/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs ma lus dang / /rnam par shes la sogs thim pas/ /bsregs pas 7ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rdo rje phag mo skyed 0pa dang gtso mo dang 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang / dkyil 'khor sgom pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin te/ 'di ni le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyi/ /ji ltar bskyed pa charab bshad bya/ /78wa 432

mkha' 'gro ma yi sbyor brten nas/ /bcom ldan 'das ni mchog tu rtsen①/ /phag mo'i gzugs ni mtha' yas pa'ang / /spros pa dra ba'i sdom pa'o/ /lus kyi dngos po'i dbye ba yis/ /mtha' yas gzugs can mkha' 'gro ma/ /lus kyi bde ba la brten nas/ /'dod pa ②rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /dga' ba gsum dang rtsa gsum ste/ /bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par 'dod/ /sangs rgyas sku yi nyams chen po/ /de'i rang bzhin las sna tshogs 'phro/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gnas brten nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin no/ /'dzam bu ③gling ni chen po yi/ /dum bu bcu gnyis kyi dbus su/ /shar gyi yul du gnas rjolha ⑤mo/ /dus sbyor ro nyi ta duchu srin⑦/ /rgyal dang nyi ma dga' skyed nidang / /rtsa yi dngos po srog 'bab pa'o/ /lha mo phyi nang bdag nyid du/ /bcom ldan gzugs can ma gnas te/ /phyag bzhi ma la kha dog gnag /spyan gsum pa la zhal gcig ma/ /mche ba gtsigs shing drag pa ⑨ste/ /phyag rgya lnga mngon 'dzin pa mo/ /ro la zhon ma skra ⑩grol ma/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs dang ldan pa mo/ /drag mo thod pa'i phreng can ma/ /g.yas pa ḍā 7ru gri gug can/ /g.yon par thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /spro zhing sdud pa'i sku can ma/ /sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhag 8par bya/ /snying po yi ge nyi shu gnyis/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas kha sbyor/ /oṃ shrī 0i badz+ra badz+ra he ḍā ho ki 8ru nī ru ye kai hūṃ ḍā 8rgyu ki pha nī ṭa dzā pha la ṭa saṃ swā ba hā ra 0rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dkyil 'khor pa yi lha mo rnams/ /yi ge rdo rje can du 'dod/ /mkha' 'gro ma thog ⑩'joms pa'i mtharatso/ /rigs kyi rtsar ni rab tu grags/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas bsgrubs yinas su/ /der ni phag mo gnas par 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa 78—433

bdun lha rnams ni/ /rang 'dra'i thabs dang gnyis med bde/ /ming gi sbyor bas shes bya ba/ /dgos pa rnam mang man ngag go/ /sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ni rgyud / /bde ba che las skyed hu)par 'gyur/ /gang phyir bdag po mkha' 'gro ma/ /rgyud de mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs so/ /bdag po khyod la bdag 'di'o②/ /ji ltar bdag gis (mibaskyed 'gyur ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma la bde ster ba'i/ /bcom ldan 'das ni mnyes byas nas/ /khyod bskyed ④pa ni bshad kyis ⑤nyon/ /rang gi rgyud ni ma nyams 4)pa/ /ḍā ⑦yig gsang ba'i bug bdag nyid/ /gzhu yi rnam pa srog dang ldan/ /lus kyi gzugs can yang dag pa/ /yul dang dbang po'i bdag nyid can/ /byang chub sems kyi thig le che/ /rgyud i zhes bya'i ming can te / /'gro dang 'ong ba'i pad chen du/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo la khyab 'gyurani/ /ka yig ka gzugs kyang de bzhin/ /'od gsal sprul bya sprul pa'o/ /phrin ⑨las kyi ⑩ni khams kun gyinyunye/ /zhi ba'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba che/ /dga' ba med mdzes mi 'gyur kyang / /brjod min lhan skyes tshon gyis 'tshed8/ /mi gzugs rtag tu bde chen pos/ /sgyu 'phrul nges par tha'aphro bar 'gyur/ /khri ni 'byung po che kun dang / /dbang phyug la sogs su ni ston/ /lug dang dmar ser yid bzang gis/ /de yi gzhi 8ni bskyed 8par 'gyur/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro ma yi ming ske/ /las ⑩kyi dus bzhin mtshon par bya/ /klu rnams yang dag dgug bya dang rka/ /char 'bebs gzhug 'o 7phyir bzhu ba dang / /lha rnams dang ni 'byung po kun / /rgyal po rnams kyi'ang 'phrul chen dang / /dbang dang mngon spyod rengs pa dang / /bsad 8dang bskrad pa la sogs pa/ /mngon spyod dus las shes par bya/ /rang rang gling du bskyed pa ste/ /shes rab thabs kyi snyoms 'jug 78wa 434

pas/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid kyi/ /rnal 'byor dbang pos sems phra zhing / /shin tu phra bas der 'jug 'gyur/ /sems can don du de dang der/ /rang bdag sbyor bas mdzad par 'gyur/ /stong gsum stong ni chen po ru/ /gang du khyab bdag kun spyod 'gyur/ /der ni dum bu bcu gnyis su/ /rang rang gtso mo rnal 'byor ma/ /thim dang longs ①spyod spyod rnams su/ /rdzu 'phrul che rnams kun spyod 'gyur/ /nyi khri brgya phrag bcu drug gi/ /dbugs rgyu bar ni shes par bya/ /brgya phrag bcwa ②brgyad srog rnams kyis/ /'pho rgyabar 'dir ni brjod par bya/ /bcu gnyis rnams ni nyin zhag 'gyur/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis rim las duso/ /dus sbyor gsum bsgyur byas ⑤nas kyang du/ /dus kyi pho nya mo kun spyod/ /dus brgya'i phyed kyis ༅pho nya mo/ /re re rnam par shes par bya /lnga dubacu gsum gyis ⑨yang dag par/ /nyin zhag gcig la spyod pa'o/ /de rnams yi ger yang dag bshad/ /a yig la sogs k+ṣa mtha' can/ /yon tan 'phar ma yin bstan pas/ /gsum bsgyur ⑩brgya phrag byed dang bcas/ /de rnams pho nya mor nges bshad/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro ma phyag rgyayi/ /mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod gzhan/ /sa 'og rnams na'ang gnas pa mo/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams rnam 8gsum ni/ /zhing sngags 8lhan cig skyes rang ④ngo / /gang zhig gang gis lhag gnas pa/ /de ni de yir gsal mthong 'gyur/ /rigs kyi khyad par la brten nas/ /'dod pa'i sbyor skyes gnas pa can/ /tsa ru'i bza' ba de rnams su/ /ye shes gzugs can phyugs chen po/ /bza' min bza' bya der yang ni/ /mtshon min gsal bar mtshon par bya/ /mtshan nyid mtshan nyid min pa spong / /de ni spong bar rab spong ba'o/ /rjes 'dzin tshar gcod til 78—435

chags pa'ang / /gang zhig gang gis rang rang dngos/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos gnas par①/ /byas te mngon sbyor ②sbyor ba yis/ /a ba dhū khri'i ⑤srog gi rlung / /brtan par liphag sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /ma brtan srog gi rlung rnams kyi/ /dngos grub gsal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lha mo rnam ⑤snang gis rgyas gdabarka/ /rdo rje 'dzin bdag mi bskyod ⑥pas/ /pho nya mo sngags sum cu drug /dus las rang dang rang gi rigs/ /ji ltar bdag mo'i rigs dang ni/ /phyag dang mtshan ma rim ji ltar/ /yang na nges par brjod pa ru/ /mngon rtogs mtshan nyid las shes bya/ /bol+la kusko ⑦la sbyor las/ /lha mo rang nyid zhu bar zhugs / /skad cig de la ma lus pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad ro mnyam lta/ /lha mo nam mkha'i nang snang bas/ /'di yis mnga' bdag bskul bar bya⑤/ /mchog tu bde ba chen po'i rdo rje rol cig rol/ /shes rab thabs kyi ⑨dgongs pa rab tu hu )grub par mdzod/ /'jig rten rnams la khyod kyi thugs rje bsgoms pa yisanyunya/ /ji ltar lha dang lha min ma lus sangs rgyas mdzod/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dzin pas bde chen gyis nyunyamanyes tsomadzod/ /khyod ni stong nyid ting nge 'dzin la zhugs sam ci/ /rdo rje pad+ma ④rol pas deng ni nges rtogs mdzod/ /gang gis lhan cig stong nyid ting 'dzin la khyod bzhugs/ /mnga' bdag khyod kyis khams bzhi'i sa bon 'dzag par mdzod8/ /a ba dhū tī'i tsorang bzhin gtum mo ldang bar 'gyur/ /sa gsum sreg ⑩par byed de gang du'ang mi mthong ngo / /mya ngan 'das pa'i ngo bos 'bar zhing 'bar bar 'gyur/ / mkha' 'gro ma rnams lhan skyes rang bzhin gyis dgar nyunyemadzod/ /dga' yib dang ni 'chi bar snang ba mi ⑥mthong ngo / /thugs kyi rgyal ba mgon pos ⑥'di dag sad par mdzod/ /sgyu ma 78—436

yi ni ①sems can khams ni bsgral bar mdzod/ /glu ②chen po ni 'di gsan nas / /rnal 'byor 'khor lo can rab sad/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i 'gro ba kun/ /brtan pa la sogs 'gro ba ni/ /mthong bzhin rang gi 'khor lo can/ / nam mkha' ②thim pa sku cher 'gyur/ /lhan skyes sogs kyis sprul pa can/ /gnyis po gcig pa'i sku chen po/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rang bzhin can/ /thams cad kyi ni chos kyi sku/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud thob nas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud rnams la yid ches/ /slob dpon sems kyi rdo rje yang / /dbu ma'i tshul gyi spyod yul lo/ /de nyid phyir bstan thob pa las/ /dbu ma chen po'i mtshan nyid do/ /grub mtha'i duman ngag spyod yul ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi'ang spyod yul min/ /grub mtha' mngon sum las shes bya/ /man ngag kyang ni rjes dpag las/ /shes bya bla ma'i zhal las kun/ /de mkhas sangs rgyas spyod yul lo/ /byis pa'i rigs kyi rnam dushes kyiyi/ /mngon nga rgyal can spyod yul min/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las mkha' 'gro ma skyed ⑦pa'i mtshan nyid dang / bde ba la kun du spyod pa'i las kyi de kho na nyid kyi rnam par gzhag pa'i cho ga ste 'di ni dule'u gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /lā 0ma ji ltar gnas pa ni/ /ji ltar sngon ⑩ gyi sangs rgyas kyis/ /gsungs 7pa bdag gis bogasal bya tsam/ /rdo rje sdom pa bcom ldan 'das/ /phag mo rnal 'byor sdom pa ste/ /'khor lo sdom pa mkha' 78—437

'gro ma/ /de bzhin dam tshig sdom pa ni/ /lā ma yis ni yang dag bstan①/ /pad+ma'i sdom par 'dod pa ni/ /dum skyes ma can gzugs can ma/ /rin chen sdom pa'o khyab bdag la/ /lā ma rang nyid kyis zhus pa/ /rdo rje sdom sogs ji lta bu/ /ngo mtshar bdag gi bdag po gye②/ /rdo rje dam tshig de bzhin sbyor③/ /pad 'khor de bzhin rin chen gyi/ /sdom pa yang ni ji ltar lags/ /de nas rdo rje can mchod nas④/ /mnyes pa bdag la yang dag gsungs/ /rdo rje pug ⑤'pho med ye shes/ /rtogs nas rdo rje gsum rnams suX/ /sdom pa rdo rje gsum rnams la/ /bskyed ⑦pa rdo rje sdom pa ni/ /dam tshig rtsa rnams thams cad kyir⑤ / /shes bya lam gyi rjes skyob pa'i/ /sdom pa'o ⑨'khor lo mchod pa ni/ /dam tshig sdom par 'dod pa yin/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa drug po ni/ /sbyor drug nam mkha'i bu ga ru/ /sdom pa bden pa'i dngos po kun/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor sdom pa'o/ /pad+ma a ba dhū tī'i 0rtsa/ /'khor lo bzhi la gnas pa ni/ /sdom pa'o hu)'khor lo de rnams su/ /pad+ma'i sdom par brjod par bya/ /'khor lo bde bar gshegs pa'i lam/ /dbang sogs rnams su bskyed pa yis/ /sdom pa'o chos de rnams su ni/ /'khor lo sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rdo rje mgo bo yi0/ /nor bur 0'bab pa 'ongs pa yis/ /sdom pa'o srog gi thig le yang | /rin chen sdom pa yin par 'dod/ /ma bshad pa las de rnams kyis/ /mkha' 'gro bdun ④pa ye shes mchog /khā 8gdong la sogs brgyad dang ni/ /'dren pa gnyis med mtshan nyid phyir/ /de ltar 0thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /gcig tu sdom pa'i mkha' 'gro yin/ /gtum mo 'bar ma tshul ni gzugs/ /rtsa so so dang dbu ma ste/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro de las bskyed/ /rnam pa kun rig 78—438

skad cig las/ /byang chub sems kyi dbus su ni/ /bdud rtsi gsang ba'i gzugs can gang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bshad do/ /nam mkhar 'gro ba yi ni mchog /blo ①bur byung ba bdag med pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po ②chu skyes gzugs//rnal 'byor rang sems sems med kyang / /rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro'i mtshan nyid do/ /'khor lo nang gi bdag nyid gzugs/ /thig le kun tu sbyar ba yis③/ /mtshan nyid gnad dang mtshams la ni/ /kun du sangs rgyas skye bar 'gyur/ /'du ba phyi dang nang bdag nyid/ /ye shes dngos rang bzhin las so/ /dam tshig sems dpa' gsum rig pa/ /skye dang 'chi dang bar rnams kyi/ /srid pa kun las shes par bya/ /spong bas dam tshig mkha' 'gro skye/ /bdag nyid kun gyis mi shes kyang / /'gro ba mkhas pa'i lam gyis 'gyur/ /'dod chags sgyu ma bcas nam mkha'/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro rang nyid gtso/ /dbyangs yig de bzhin rnal 'byor dang / /phyag rgya lhan skyes 'dod rnams kyi/ /bgrod bzhin du ni rtag tu skye/ /'bar ba rin chen dbang mkha' 'gro/ /de bzhin khams ni rnam pa bdun/ /rnam shes bdun gyi mtshan nyid do/ /chu gter ri dang gling rnams kyang / /rgya mtsho che der rab tu zhugs/ /de nyid nyi shu lnga bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes rgyus/ /'khor ④lug la sogs stong nyid dang / /rang bzhin skyes bu de bzhin du/ /'od gsal ba dang thams cad ming / /chos kyi dbyings dang rang mtshan nyid/ /thar rjodang sangs rgyas de bzhin du/ /ye shes rdo rje sems lam bdag /chos 'byung dang ni theg mechen dang / /gsang ba sngags tshul khyab bdag dang / /lhan skyes dang ni 'dus de bzhin/ /thugs rje chen po ⑦rang nyid dang / /bdag med ma dang kun de nyid/ /rang bzhin can 78—439

stong yang nas yang / /de phyir rgya mtsho'i ming dang yang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i gzugs kyis hu)ni/ /ā ②kun 'jigs dugazir sems can rnams/ /ngang dugis sangs rgyas yon tan ldan/ /ṇ+ḍi/ de rnams dge ba mngon 'dod la/ /dub dang yongs su ngal ba med/ /wa/ rtog pa ⑤thams cad spangs pa las/ /thob pa sgyu ma'i rang mtshan nyid/ /ma/ gsang sngags tshul gyi bdag nyid kun/ / hā / bskyed ⑥pa yi ni nyagazugs can no/ /sa/ de yi chos ni mi bden te/ /mu/ dngos po skad cig 'jig phyir ro/ /dra/ rdzas dang sna tshogs rang bstan ⑧chos / /rgya mtsho chen po'i mtshan nyid do/ /lā ma'i rang gi mtshan nyid sa/ /ji lta ba bzhin rim gyis te/ /rol pa'i myos las bskyed ⑨pa ni/ /rnal 'byor ma kun shes par bya/ /ma sogs kun gyi 'khor lo yi/ /rtsa yi lam nas rjes 'gro ma'o/ /yang na sgyu ma 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de ni sgyu ma che rang bzhin/ /bum pa'i rā si spyod pa yis/ /'pho ba'i grangs kyang gnyis pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo can lha mo/ /kun du spyod pa lā mar gnas/ /kha dog ljang snang lha mo ste/ /lhag ma mkha' 'gro ma dang mtshungs/ /sred pa dang ni sdang ⑩ba'i dngos/ /thams cad de yi steng du gnas/ /he ru ka yi mdog dang gzugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes 'gro rnams/ /lhag ma 'khor drug rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo rnams dang thams cad 'byung / /'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi dbus su sbyin/ /thugs sogs kha dog drug tu grags(2/ /'khor lo cha mnyam la bri bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor de bzhin/ /ral gri rin chen gri gug gi/ /phreng ba rtag tu rim shes bya/ /phyi rol sna tshogs 8rdo rje'i phreng / /mgo bo'i phreng ba thams cad du'o/ /lā ma byang gi sems las bskyed/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs gtso mo ste/ /dus kyi 8rjes 78wa 440

mthun ①sems can don/ /smon lam gyi ni mtshan nyid do②/ /bskal pa bzang po'i dbus su yang / /rdzogs ldan la ni rnam gzigs sogs/ /de yi dus su shes bya ba/ /de bzhin rnam gzigs byang gling du'o②/ /'dzam bu'i gling ni chu dun du'ang / /bdag ni shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro/ /lhag ma'i ༷gling lnga rnams su ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rigs rim pas so/ /de phyir lā ma 'gro ba kun/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi gnas mtha' len/ /ma ni rnal 'byor thams cad kyi/ /snying stobs bya ba byed pa gsal/ /sa yi dbang phyug zhag ⑤la ni/ /mchu yi zla ba can du 'dod/ /thur sel zhes bya'i rlung dang ni/ /'gro dang zla ba zhes bya'i ⑥rtsa/ /ji srid 'chi ba'i dus nyid bar/ /'dzin bzhin du ni mi nyams so/ /de ltar rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis/ /zla ba nyin zhag rlung rnams so/ /rtsa dang rtsa nas 'bab pa ste/ /mi ni skyed ⑦pa rnal 'byor ma/ /rtsa yi tshogs ni thams cad la/ /skad cig las ⑧ni srog 'pho 'gyur/ /rang bzhin de la shes byas nas/ /snang sogs yon tan gyis rim pas/ /des ni sna tshogs sprul bdag dang / /las kyis ⑨gnas ni mang po'o⑩/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos gcig ni/ /lā ma mya ngan 'das mtshan nyid/ /mya ngan 'das dang mtshon pa na'ang / /gnyis po zhugs gyur ming med pa/ /ji ltar mi shes de la ni/ /bdag gis mchog tu 'du shes so/ /sangs rgyas 7byang chub sems 8med ⑩'gyur/ /chos kyi sku sogs dngos po'o/ /dbang po rnams kyi drin gyis ni/ /skye ba can kun 'thob ④par 'gyur/ /dbang po'i dngos po bden min yang ⑫/ /de tshe mi bden pas 'thob ⑩'gyur/ /dbang po gnyis kyi dngos nyid ci/ /grib ma yi ni skyes bu mtshungs/ /grib ⑩ma'i dngos po de bden 8kyang / /skyes bu'i gzugs ni bden ma yin/ /78—441

de bzhin dbang po mi ①bden kyang / /de rgyadangos bden pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /man ngag rnam pa mang po gzhan/ /mchog tu bsngags ①par shes par bya/ /btung ba la sogs bdog pa kun/ /bla ma la ni 'bul ba bden/ /de ni mi bden pas spyad bya/ /de la brnyas par mi bya'o/ /'di la sngags kyang bshad bya ste / /lha mo kun gyi rgya mtsho 'dir/ /nye ba'i snying po sngags rnams la/ /kha sbyor mdzes pas brgyan pa'o/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /nye snying rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /lugs 'byung lugs la dubazlog pa yis/ /de bzhin dbus su lugs 'byung min/ / oṃ oṃ ba hrīḥ sa he lā he mā hūṃ yi rtsu hūṃ pha r+ghaṃ ṭa pha ṭa pha hūṃ ṭa hūṃ swā hā hā he hrīḥ.o oṃ r+ghaṃ he hūm̐ he hrīḥphaṭa oṃ ⑤zhes bya ba'o/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnams kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma rim las/ /rtsa dang tshig duni shes bya ste/ /yi ge brjod pa'i bdag nyid kyi/ /gnyis dang gsum gyi rtsa bskyed ⑦de / /yi ge re re yi yang ngo / /yang na thams cad bsdus pa yis/ /bdag nyid chen po'i dus 'di'o/ /de phyir sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma rtag re re skye/ /gal te sems dpa' che khros na/ /spros pa'i khro bo rnal 'byor ma/ /de bzhin gti mug 'dod chags sogs/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rtag tu spros(she/ /tshegs chung ba yis las 'grub pa/ /yum mchog lā ma'ang 'thob ⑨par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs te/ /yi ge re re rnal 'byor ma/ /ming ni de dang mnyam zhes bya/ /khyod la rdo rje mchog bsres pa'o/ /de ltar de nyid rtag brten nas/ /rnal 'byor phyag rgya dang lhan cig /rtsen cing rgya cher rol par bya/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das dbus su/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i ⑩mchog /rdo rje 78—442

mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las lā ma bskyed ①pa'i mtshan nyid dang sngags dgod pa dang / 'khor los sgyur (snyeb drug la sogs pa'i rang bzhin dang mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa'i rnam par gzhag ③pa ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas mchog tu rab bshad bya/ /sems can rnams la phan brtse bas /khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i sgroganas bzhugs dunas/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /'khor lo bzhi yi pad+mo ru/ /rtsa ni brgya dang nyi shu'o/ /de rnams ming ni ci rigs ⑥par/ /de kho na nyid snod la bshad/ /yul dbus ma ⑦dang ka ling ka ma dang / /o ṭa nim dang kuṇ+ḍi ṭa mo ma ru mo/ / sau rāṣ+ṭa ⑨me ma la ya ma bing ga ma/ /'gro lding ma dang ta dzi ⑩ga ka mo/ / mā la ba 0mo ma hā rakhyi ma/ /ba ren dra timo kā ma ru 0pi ma/ /ḍā hā li mo a ṭa li yul ma/ /bha ḍa ri mo lā ḍā ⑫dbus 'gyur ma/ /ti ra hu da ti mo dang dad da yir na ṭa ⑩ma dang bal yul ma//mnyan yod ma dang rā nye mo dang ḍi ka ka 0ri ma dang / /bhang tsog lā mo kha ḍa tshim dang ha ri ke la ma/ /gser gling ma dang sing ga li 0mo dang / /ḍa ma ḍa mo kun to ra ka mo/ /sin dhu kha ba'i gnas ma tsā ḍi gyomo/ /ku ④lu ta mo dza ḍa ra mo pa tha ma/ /dza dz+dza yu ta ma dang ba ru 'kho ma dang / / o ḍi yā ṇa cham dang lam pa ka ma dang / /dzā lan 0dha ra ma dang ar bu da ma dang / /kha che ma dang ko sa la mo kārtsi ma/ /dza yan ta mo tri shaka ta mo tsam bha ma/ /lu ha ra ma pu ra ho ri ka mo dang / /mus 0na ma kām po dza ma dang / /bhasto ma la gro 0ha de ba mo/ /78—443

pre ta pu ri ma dang bab bha ra ma dang / /pi la mo dang nye ba'i pi la mo/ /dur khrod ma dang nye ba'i dur khrod ma/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram ma kha sa mo/ /kla klo ma dang thams cad yul ma ste/ /rim pas ①drug cu bzhi lha mo/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo rnal 'byor ma/ /rigs kyi rtsar ni shes par bya/ /snying ga'i (kye'akhor lo ③de bzhin brgyad/ /pho nya mo kun 'gro ma ste/ /pra ya ga mo de bi ko ṭa ma/ /'phags rgyal ma dang dpal chen mo(pa/ /'bar ba'i gdong ma grub pa srim ⑤ba li mo dang / /ma hi la ma kau ma ri mo sau ra ma/ /de ltar thams cad snying gnas su / /sgyu ma'i rnam pa rang zhing ma'o/ /mgrin par 'khor lo'i lha mo yang / /gtso mo mchog ni bshad par bya/ /cha chen bcu drug nyid yin te/ /khams rnams bcu drug de bzhin no/ /khrag dang khu ba rkang dang ni/ /rngul dang tshil dang pags (9)pa dang / /sha dang rus pa rgyus pa dang / /rnag dang rgyu ⑦ma rang byung nidang / /bshang 6)gci mkhris pa mchil 0ma'o/ /ra ha su sogs tshil gyi ⑩khams / /de rnams myos byed 'bab ma'o/ /mgo bo ru ni lha mo che/ /'khor lo sum cu rtsa gnyis rtsa/ /zhag gi rim pa thams cad du/ /mtshams kun rmad byung chen mo'o3// /nag mo gtsigs ma 'jigs rung ma/ /dga' ma 'das ma log 'dren ma/ / tsā muṇ+ḍa 8dang drag gzugs ma/ /lha mo dka' zlog chadabyangs can ma / /nag bzang mo dang nag chen mos/ /nag sbom ma dang gzhan mi thub/ /rgyal ma dang ni ⑩rnam 8rgyal ma/ /mi pham ma /ḍanyedang rgyal ba mo/ /drag mo snang ma dbang mo dang / /zla ma 51)lam gyi bzhi mdo ma/ /grong gnas ma dang drag mig ma / /kum po dza ma khom bi ma/ /gtum mo dang ni gdol pa mo/ /bram ze mo dang dmangs rigs mo/ /rgyal po'i bu mo 'phrul chen mo/ /lha rdzas chang gis 78wa 444

'gengs byed ma'o/ /de ltar rtsa yi 'khor lo ru/ / khaṇ+ḍa ro tī ①nang 'gro ma'o/ /bdag 'dir ②'gro ba mo yin ci/ /rang gi bdag pos bka' stsol ①cig /lus rnams thams cad la ni khams/ /mkha' 'dra dngos po gcig tu 'gyur/ /sa gzhi cha bzhin shes bya ste/ /yul gyis ⑤bye yang sa gzhi gcig /dum bu dum bur gyur pa'i khams/ /yang na yul dang zhag dag 'gyur/ /ḍa yi yi ge bstan de'i phyir/ /sgo nga mngal gyi mtshan nyid las/ /'dir ni rnam shes bskyed par 'gyur / /gang 'dra'i gang gi khams rnams la/ /bzhir ni rnam par shes bya ste/ /las la dum skyes ma rang nyid/ /sdig pa chen po 'phrog bzhin ma/ / bsad pa ⑤khams ni thams cad do/ /des ni sems can pral (ne༄dum skyes/ /shin tu las kun mdzad pa mo/ /gtso mo mchog gi rnal 'byor ma/ /rang gi 'pho ba las bzhengs mchog /nya ( ni 'char ba'i dus dang ni/ /'dod dang rgyu skar gre 6)mchog dang / /nub kyi ba lang spyod gling du/ /'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin ma/ /dngos med byed pa min lha mo/ /gnyis med go 'phang la brten ma//sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /bskyed 'gyur rang gi sngags las skye/ /oṃ ba sa dz+ra rba kha bu ṇ+ḍa rtse ro ba hi dz+ra kā ḍā yi ke rtsu nī hūṃ ye phaṭa ba phaṭa ṇ+ḍi swā nī po)hā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā oṃ/ sngags 'di rab tu sbyor bar byed kyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dod pa thams cad la/ /lha mo re re rnams kyi ni/ /dbus su 'khor lo bzhi skyes ma/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /thams cad chos 'byung dbus su steyi/ /sgo bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rta babs kyis ni de rnams brgyan/ /sha chen po ni za bzhin du/ /'jigs byed sgra ni bsgrags pa'o/ /lā 32ma'i 'khor lo ba lang sha /mkha' 'gro ma la glang chen sha /phag mo la ni sha 78wa 445

thams cad/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i sbyor bas so/ /gsang sngags bden par shes byas nas/ /sngags kyi yi ge brjod pa min/ /sems can kun gyi ngag gang de/ /sngags ni ①rnal 'byor ma ru grags/ /gal te yi ge pa sngags yin/ /go ḍi'i ②yi ge pa dang mtshungs/ /rtsa yi bu ga bu ga ru/ /dbugs ni yi ger 'du shes pa'o/ /sngags kyi btung bas ②sems la ni/ /ji srid rkang mthar 'gog 0pa las/ /yul dang yul du kun du spyod/ /yul dbus su yang 'ongs pa las/ /tshim bya rang gi 'khrul 'khor du/ /bum pa bzhin du btung ba 'bab/ /dkyil 'khor rang gi stan khruganas nas/ /srog gi 'khor lo bzhin du bskor/ /sems dpas 'khor bzhin pa ru ni/ /nor bu'i bu gar btsir bar bya/ /bu ga dgu ru sa bon kyang / /rdo rje sogs pas bsgom ①par bya/ /yang na rtsa rnams thams cad du/ /sngags kyi yi ge 'di dgod bya/ /ma ka oṃ kā ma sau ma bi dra ta mā ma bha kā ḍā a bha lā ma ti da ne sru rā ḍi ba khā ha su si ḍā ka si nyi tsu ku dza pa dza ba au lo dzā a kā ko ṭ+wāṃ dza tri tsa lu pu sum̐/ ṭ+wāṃ bha gro bre ba pi u sma u kha sle zhes bya ba ni lte bar ro/ /pri de u ma dz+wa su ma kau zhes bya ba ni snying gar ro/ /ra shu ma ṭ+wā me tsa māṃ a sna pu a swa bi mū pi thre ⑦zhes bya ba ni mgrin pa'i'o/ / kṛ ka bla nā ti ③bi tsā gi o sa bha ma rtsa a dza bi a dza go du i tsa tsa grwa ro ṭ+wāṃ ḍi tsa mā thā sru rā ⑨zhes bya ba ni mgo bo'i 'khor lo la'o/ /yang na mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i ming can te/ de rnams kyi yang yig ⑩dang po/ /thams cad mgo bo'i 'khor lor sbyin/ /'khrul 'khor 'di ni blo chen po/ /srog gi rlung ni rnam 'dzin 'gyur/ /pad+ma bzhi yi 'dab ma'i dbyibs/ /re'u mig 'khor lo rim thig gdab/ /thams cad skum po'i rnam par ni/ /thig lnga rnams ni gdab par bya/ /brgyad dang bcu drug 78—446

drug cu bzhi/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis re'u ①mig 'dod/ /lte ba'i gnas ni thob nas su/ /srog gi nus pa rnams kyis 'khor/ /ji srid a ba dhū tī'i rlung / /de srid 'khrul 'khor 'dir brjod do/ /gal te ngag gis de ltar byed/ /sngags ni 'jam snyan gyis glu len/ /sgras ni srog nges phur btab nas/ /rtsa dgu po ni dgag ②par bya/ /nad med mi rgas mdze med cing / /rtag tu bkres dang skom pa med/ /de ltar la sogs mtha' yas pa/ /nad dang ③'chi ba'i mthar thug med/ /dkyil 'khor lngar ram 0yang na ni/ /'khrul 'khor can kun 'bab par bya/ /khams dang skye mched gzhan la sogs⑤/ /bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor ldan pas bza'/ /mdog dmar 'du shes lhag ma ni/ /lā ma'i duphyag dang gzugs can no/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin ⑦gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las dum skyes ma'i ⑧mtshan nyid dang skyed ⑨pa dang / 'khor lo ⑩bzhi'i rtsa'i rnam par gzhag pa'i ming mdor bstan pa dang /sngags dgod pa la sogs pa'i cho ga ⑩ste le'u lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan mchog bshad par bya/ /mdor bsdus pa ste rgyas par min/ /dpal te ru ku'i kun sbyor las/ /gzugs can ma yi mtshan nyid dge8/ /lus ldan dang ni las dang tshigs/ /sngon du gzugs can ma la brten8/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can gzugs su/ /bde la gnas pas 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni rkang lag thams cad la/ /tshigs ④ni bcu gnyis nyid yin no/ /lnga lnga ru ni 78—447

shes bya ste/ /bcu gnyis la rtsa drug cu'o/ /dkyil 'khor rnams la'ang 'bab pa mo/ /'pho ba bcu gnyis su 'dod do/ /g.yon pa dang ni g.yas pa la'ang / /sngon du lug dzo1)sogs sngags rig pas/ /lhag ma bu ga bzhi rnams so/ /lte ba mdoms (snyedang rtsib 2logs gnyis/ /gru gsum de bzhin shes bya ste/ /de yi sgo rnams rtsa drug cu/ /mtshams ni rnam pa lngar durab gsungs/ /nyi ma rgyu bar gang 'gro ba/ /de 'gro zla ba zla ⑤rnams sukhya/ /drug lnga sum cu'i cha rnams su/ /snying gar ri9)grags pa de bzhin gsungs/ /rtsa dgu ji ltar 'gro ba'o/ /mig la sogs pa'i bug rnams su/ /sgo la brten nas gnas par 'gyur/ /mgrin par gang rin 'dra ba yi khams/ /de ru gyur nas gnas pa'o/ /mi 0phyed ma sogs sum cu gnyis/ /rgyud mang por skyeni bsngags pa'o/ /de yi gzugs su gnas lha mo/ /gzugs can ma de'i rnam rtog pas/ /bcom ldan 'das la bdag 'dri'o/ /gzugs can ma yi ming ci 1 )gsungs/ /'gro ba thams cad gzugs med mdzod//rtsa yi bde sogs ming gis so/ /'gro ba'ang dbang po'i lam rnams su/ /gang 'dra'i gzugs kyi gzugs can ma/ /pha 3nyalas thob pa'i bde ba ni/ /dbang gnyis rnam pa'i sbyor las hunyeso/ /gang dang gang gi rigs gang ni/ /de dang de yi 'gro bar bshad/ /bden pa kun las 'dren par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi tshul las gzhan mi 'gro/ /de phyir gzugs can ma 'grogs ④las/ /lhan skyes rdzogs 8pa'i byang chub tshol/ /lha mo chen mo kha dog ser/ / lhag ma ⑩dum skyes ma dang mtshungs/ /'du byed phung po'i gzugs dang ni/ /ming ⑩dang bud med sogs gzugs can/ /mnyam med sems can don las phyir/ /gling 'di ru ni skye nyunya'agyur ro/ /lug ⑩dang bya ku la gnag pa'idu / /zla ba rā si'i rang 78wa 448

bzhin can/ /thabs dang shes rab bde bas kyang / /dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs pa'o/ /yang dag sum cu bdun bdag nyid/ /ji lta'i rim pas dpa' rnal 'byor/ /gsang sngags kha dog 0)sbyor ba ru/ /gzugs can gtso mo'i shes par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ⑧gro rū na pi maḥ nī hi yi oṃ ke swā rtsu hā rgyu hu/ pha oṃ ṭa bo pha ṣa ṭa ṭa he ṭ+wā hā r+ghaṃ hūm̐ hoḥ i ②phaṭa phaṭa haṃ/ de ltar rang bzhin las shes bya / /sngon gyi cho ga'i las kyis ni/ /dbus ④ma'i bu gar phyin nas ni/ /dbugs ni rnam shes ngo bo can/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni grangs med pa/ /ma lus skad cig de la mthong / /ma lus rang bdag ngo bo can/ /bsgoms dang thos dang mthong ba yang / /bgrod bzhin pa na rtogs mi 'gyur/ /'di ni sgyu ma'i rang mtshan nyid/ /gzugs kyi sku yang rnam gsum ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan nyid de/ /de ni 'dod dang gzugs gzugs med/ /me ⑤mong du ni gdod rdzogs pa/ /ji bzhin khams gsum la gnas nas⑥/ /de yi gzugs dang gzhan gzugs can/ /gzugs dang gzugs las gzugs brnyan te/ /grangs med pa yi 'jig rten khams/ /gzugs can sgyu mas bud med dang / /thabs ni skyes bu'i las can gyi/ /gnyis med bud med skyes bu gcig /gcig min gcig min min gzugs can/ /gzugs kyi yul (pel sogs dngos la/ /mtshon byed mtshon bya med gzugs can/ /mtshon dka' mtshon bya'o mtshon bya la//mtshon bya gzugs med mtshan nyid ma/ /mtshon med spyod yul de yang ni/ /mtshon pa po de'i spyod yul lo/ /ji ltar la lar zho)mi lam mthong / /rang nyid shi ba mthong 'gyur na'ang / /mthong bzhin du yang ngu bar byed/ /gzugs dang gzhan gyi gzugs can no/ /de ltar kun gyi rang bzhin du/ /rdo rje sems 78wa 449

dpa' rang gi dang / /sems dpa' chen po'i rang bzhin dang / /dam tshig sems dpa' chen po pa/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul sems dpa'/ /brtan dang 'gro ba sna tshogs so/ /de lta'i nyugazugs ni ji ltar sngon/ /rtog ge pa rnams kyis mi shes/ /byis pa'i rnal 'byor rtogs ②bya min/ /rnal 'byor ma yi mchog thob pas/ /skye ba 'di nyid la shes 'gyur/ /skye bo thams cad byang chub rang bzhin te/ /rmongs pa'i byis pas shes pa ma yin no/ /sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i ②de nyid/ /mi gang yin pa de ni rdo rje 'chang / /glu 'di blangs pas thams cad ni/ /skrag ste sa la brgyal bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gyel nas kyang / /chos kyi spyod yul ngo mtshar to/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs gtso/ /dpa' bo rnams kyis bskul mdzad nas/ /gson cig gson cig srin mo khyed④/ /sems can khams kyi rang bzhin grol byed ma/ /khyed dang sems can rnams la dbye ba med/ /dpa' bo thams cad sgrol bar mdzad pa mo//slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyi ni/ /sku la thams cad rab tu zhugs/ /slar yang spro ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gtso bo'i 8zhal nas spros par 'gyur/ /rnam snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rgyu⑥/ /slar yang zhal nas spro bar mdzad/ /bcom ldan thams cad bsdu stimadzad nas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud la ni/ /ched du brjod pas ched brjod mdzad/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kun la yang ngo / /rnam snang mdzad dang rin chen dbang / /'dir ni 'dod chags don yod grub/ /mi bskyod ⑧pa dang spyan ma'i rgyud/ /mā ma tī dang gos dkar mo/ /sgrol ma dang ni gzugs rdo rje / /sgra dang dri dang ro de bzhin/ /reg dang chos dbyings su grags dang / /sa snying nam mkha'i snying po dang / /phyag na rdo rje 'jig rten dbang / /sgrib ⑨78wa 450

kun sel dang bzang po dang / /'jam dpal dang ni byams pa dang / /gshin rje'i dgra ①dang shes mthar mdzad/ /pad+ma mthar mdzad bgegs mthar mdzad/ /mi g.yo ba dang dbyug sngon can/ /'dod dang stobs chen gnod mdzes dang / /gtsug tor ②'khor los sgyur ③ba dang / /khro gnyer ri khrod lo ma can/ /lhag ma rdo rje sems dpa'oX/ /de ltar rgyud kyi ming 'di ni/ /thabs kyi dngos po'i ⑤mtshan nyid do/ /shes rab rgyud ni rang byung 0nyid/ /rang gi rang bzhin rtag tu gnas/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams su/ /mi 'jig go 'phang rjes 'gro ba/ /bskal pa bsreg ⑦pa'i dus su ni/ /gzhan du song nas yang dag gnas/ /thod pa'i dum la ⑧sogs dpa' bo0/ /ming ni mi bskyod tshul sogs so/ /dngos po'i dbye ba'i rnam grangs kyis/ /rigs ni du ma 'byung ba'o/ /gzugs can ma yi gnas brten nas/ /dpa' bo sa la bsgyings par 'gyur/ /gzugs ni gzugs med gyur pa'i gzugs/ /bde mchog dang ni mnyam par 'khyer/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las gzugs can ma'i mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin/ rtsa'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhin dang gnas kyi rnam par gzhag pa dang rgyud kyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga ste le'u drug pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor mchog gi sa/ /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis te/ /gang gis khā skyegadong ma byung 8ba/ /de yi 8cho gas thar 'gro ma/ /nye ba'i gling du 78—451

gnas ma ste/ /khyu mchog 'pho dang bzang po ma/ /sa ga'i zla bar shes bya ste/ /sa lnga par ni 'dod pa yin①/ /lha mo sgo na gnas pa mo/ /kā ni chos dbyings ②mar 'du shes/ /gnyis pa chos kyi sku dang ni/ /de las longs ③spyod rdzogs 'byung ba/ /kyā ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ /lte snying mgrin pa mgo bo las/ /bu ga bzhi rnams shes bya ste/ /bya rog 'dra ba'i srog gdong can/ /de la rtag tu mngon spyod ni/ /srog chags rnams ni skad cig gsod/ /klu rnams dgug par bya ba dang / /char dbab pa dang rengs pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings dang byang chub che/ /rnal 'byor ma kun rang bzhin ma/ /chos dang longs ①spyod sprul pa la⑤ / /bde ba 'dod pas 'gro ba mo/ /sngags bden las kyi bdag nyid can/ /bya rog gtso mo de la brten/ /rdo rje phag mo de la ni/ /bya rog ma ni gnas su son / /sum cu rtsa bdun rnal 'byor ma/ /sngags 'di las ni byung ba yin/ /oṃ ba na dz+ra mo kā bha kā ga kyā ba ya te ke bī rgyu re hūṃ shā pha ya ṭa rgyu pha hūṃ ṭa pha swā ṭa hā pha oṃ ṭa swā r+ghaṃ hā yi// 'di ⑦ni ring thung dbye ba las/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /thung ngu thabs kyi nirang bzhin ⑨dang / /ring po shes rab mngon par brjod/ /kha dog nag mo 0drag chen mo/ /lhag ma mkha' 'gro ma dang mtshungs/ /gang phyir byang chub sems zhu ba/ /de tshe bya rog las rgyal mayi/ /nam mkhar 8bya rog bzhin 'khor ba/ /bya rog gdong ma'i rlung gis so/ /gang phyir 'phur zhing steng 'phur ba/ /de phyir 'og dang steng du lta/ /bya rog bzhin du ring 'phur nas/ /bya rog gling du slar 'ong ba'o/ /der son pa ni bde chen po / /lus kyis nyams su myong ba'o/ /bsod nams las kyis skye bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor gong nas gong tsodu'o/ /bsod nams min 8ldan de bzhin 'dir/ /78—452

dmyal ba bya rog dum bu can/ /pha rol phyin tshul rnams kyi yang / /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin par 'dod/ /ma byin len pas dmyal ba pa/ /bya rog bzhin du rtag tu bkres/ /de yi de ltar las dus su/ /mi gang ngang gis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma ni de bsgoms nas/ /bde chen nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma yi spyod ①kun kyang / /rang gis rang ni 'thob ②par 'gyur / /las ma byas na gang gi ①ni/ /las can med cing las byed med/ /rang sems 'pho ba las yin te/ /las de las byed pa yang de/ /lus kyi dbyibs dang gzugs bdag nyid/ /sems med pa ni sems dpa' dumachog /lag pa rkang pa thams cad kyis/ /gang byas las byed pa rang ngo / /de kun gyi nar khyer ba ni/ /yang dag las mtha'i mtshan nyid do/ /las kyang dge ba rgyu don gnyer/ /mi dge rang gis spang bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi mchod pa'am/ /de bzhin bza' ba 'du ba ni/ /grong dang grong khyer gnas pa dang / /ri la sogs pa'i rtse chen du/ /dam tshig don du mchod par bya/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub 'bras rab steradu/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi ⑥gzugs brnyan kyang / /khyab gnas rlung gi ming can te/ /srog dang thur sel mnyam gnas dang / /khyab byed ji lta'i rim gnyis kyis/ /mkha' 'gro de bzhin lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /'ug gdong khyi dang phag gdong ma/ /rim pas klu dang rus ⑦sngal rtsangs/ /lha sbyin dang ni nor las rgyal/ /rtag tu brtan ma pho nya gnyis/ /dga' dang skyo ba zhes bya ba/ /mche ma dang ni 'joms ma mchog /mdor bstan pa yi tshig 'di yang / /rgyas bshad kun nas brjod par bya / /phag mos mchod pa byas nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la zhus pa/ /ji 78—453

srid srog sogs rlung rnams kyi/ /so so re re'i ming 'du shes/ /bdag gi ston pa ngo mtshar che/ /dus kun du ni skye bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por gtso bo can 'dzin pa/ /stong pa'i ngo bos grol bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje lta bu'i rlung dgod bya/ /rten ni snod kyi 'jig rten la'o/ /gang phyir 'jig pa thim 'gyur ba/ /de yi dbyibs tshul kyang med pa/ /de phyir thur ①sel zhes bya yang / /'gro ba dang ni 'ong bar bstan/ /mnyam gnas rigs su song ②nas ni/ /sngon du gang dang gang rnams kyis/ /ngag tu brjod pa smra bar 'gyur/ /sngon du bag chags ma lus pa'o/ /khyab byed 'gro ba thams cad la/ /rgyas 'debs pas na las kyi rlung / /klu ni khro bo'i ngo bo nyid/ /khyab byed de bzhin tshig gnyis te/ /rus ①sbal ser sna'i ngo bo ni/ /smra ba yi ni mtshan nyid do/ /rtsangs pa 'dod chags mnyam gnas so/ /thur sel phrag dudog lha sbyin no/ /nor rgyal gti mug bdag nyid do/ /srog gi rlung ni grangs gnyis las/ /dga' ba'i ye shes can shes bya/ /skyo ba de yi ⑤btags pa'o/ /de phyir mkhas pas so sor shes pa yis/ /gang phyir srog gi rlung ni thams cad bdag nyid skye/ /ji ltar sa ni bcu gnyis las/ /thog ma de nyid bcu gnyis pa'o/ /bcu po rnams kyis de shes bya/ /gang phyir sa bcu'i dbang phyug go/ /sa gcig rang bzhin rnams kyis ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma chen mor du'adod/ /sbyin sogs pha rol phyin pa gang / /lhan skyes yang dag byang chub nyid/ /thams cad kyi ni nang son pas/ /rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug ma mchog /bshad dang ma bshad gang ci'ang rung / /de kun byang chub tshul can no/ /slar yang bya rog dbyibs lha mo/ /de nas ⑦byed pa'i gzugs can ma'o/ /byed pa phyogs kyi 78—454

gnas la ①ste/ /rtsa gnas ②kun gyi bu ga'o③/ /thim dang de las langs bsam gtan/ /khā dugadong ming du 'du shes so/ /de ltar rnal 'byor gter thams cad/ /bla ma'i zhal las gsal 'thob ⑤'gyur/ /bla ma gang de mi brnyas dushing / /ston byed ⑦de nyid 'dod par bya/ /'phags pa'i go 'phang ma thob na//mnar med la sogs rnams su 'tshed/ /kun nas bla ⑧ma gus pa las/ /byang chub rab tu 'thob ⑨par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las khā gdong ma la sogs pa'i srog skyed ⑩pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga ste le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan gyi mtshan nyid mchog /'ug gdong la sogs gang gsal ba/ /byed pa yang dag bya ba dang / /thams cad mtshams ni bshad par bya/ /'khrig pa sdig pa snron rnams ni/ /zla ba'i sbyor bas rtag tu gnas/ /'ug gdong ye shes thob nas ni/ /rtsa ni lam yigasum 'gro ba mo/ /u/ drag shul gzi brjid gtsigs pa mo/ /ye shes lam dbang bza' ba las/ /lū/ 'dod la dga' ba sgyu 'phrul che/ /lha min la sogs skye rnams la/ /rkang pa'i mtheb mthar bcu gnyis su/ /ka /mda' yi shugs kyis 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'ug gdong ma yi ming la 8yang / /u ni o can 8bu gar 'dod/ /la/ pul+lī ra ma la yar grags/ / lca ni mus 8ni zhing ngo / /kā ni 8kā ma rū ⑩pa ste/ /de bzhin sgyu 'dir zhing kun 'dod/ /zhing kun dbugs 0su gyur pa ni/ /gru gsum rnam 78—455

pa'i bde ba'i mtha'/ /gang phyir gnas lnga'i bdag nyid kyi/ /mi zad he ru ku'i go 'phang / /yang na bdag gi gdan sogs su/ /dpal nye ru ka rdo rje rang / /skye gnas gnas lnga'i bdag nyid de/ /snying lte rkan dang mgo bo dang / /gsang ba ru yang rtsa kun gyi/ /skye gnas bu ga lnga'i bdag nyid/ /sgong skyes dang ni drod gsher skyes/ /mngal skyes brdzus ①te skyes pa rnams/ /sems can sangs rgyas yon tan bdag /rigs lnga rab tu ston pa'o/ /nye ba'i gling du gnas ma yang / /gtso mo'i gzugs can yang dag gnas/ /sngags kyi phreng ba las skyes rnams/ /sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid skyes②/ /oṃ ba ma dz+ra hā ③u ka lū wa likā a ⑤snga g+ni ya saṃ ke ni hūṃ bhā hūṃ ya pha du ⑦ṭa hūṃ pha pha ṭa ṭa ṭ+wā pha hā ṭa dum swā rgyu hā/ de ltar sngags de kho na'i bdag /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /kha dog ljang ser drag chen mo/ /lhag ma lā ma dang ni mtshungs/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bsgoms ⑨byas nas/ /dur khrod gnas dang gnyis med pa/ /kun spyod 0rtsa rnams thams cad kyi0/ /rgyas pa'i dga' ba'i spyod yul lo8/ /'di ni 'tsho ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /'od gsal rnam pa'i chos nyid do/ /bskrad pa'i las dang rnal 'byor ma/ /'jig rten gyi ni 'dren pa mo/ /rang bstan chos las gsungs pa yi8/ /sna tshogs las kyang bya ba'o/ /kun gyi rnal 'byor yongs rdzogs nas/ /rgyud 'di yi ni spyod yul lo/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor de kun kyang / /mdor bsdus tshul ni tshig 'di yin/ /so sor sdud chadang de bzhin du/ /bsam gtan srog rtsol 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting 'dzin te/ /sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid rnam drug ⑩go/ /so sor sdud pa khwa gdong ma/ /lug gdong ma ni bsam gtan 'dod/ /srog rtsol ⑩du ni 78—456

gnas pa khyi/ /'dzin pa la ni phag mo'o/ /rjes dran gnas pa pho nya mo/ /ting nge 'dzin ni brtan mar ①'dod/ /mche ba ma ni rgyas bstan thob②/ /'joms ma 'bras bu kun bdag skyes/ /'khor ba las ni grol gyur pa/ /rang gi sku ni sgyu ma mnyam/ /bdag byin rlabs ①'di phra mo dang / /rdo rje bzlas rang mtshan nyid do/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems kyi gter/ /de las ༷lhag ma zung 'jug go / /mya ngan 'das zhes bya ba'ang 'di/ /lam thams cad kyis ②mya ngan 'das/ /theg chen kun la rab 'jug pa/ /sngags kyi theg pa ru ni byed/ /bya ba bstan bcos rjodage sna tshogs/ /snying rje mnyes gshin pa yis byed/ /gang 'dra'i dngos dang dngos po la/ /ye shes rnam pa'i ⑦rang byung ④gis/ /de 'dra ba yi sems rgyun las/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor rnams kyis mthong / /lus kyi mtshan nyid yang dag pa/ /rtsa yi gur ni bshad par bya/ /spyi gtsug nas ni nor bu'i mthar⑨/ /mtshams dang mgrin pa rnam gnyis 'dod/ /rkang pa'i mthe bo ⑩mtshams mtha' dang / /smin dbus de bzhin sgro ba ste/ /mtshan ma'i rtsa ba dpral ba dag /mig dang rkang pa'i sor mo gnyis/ /ming med pas 0ni pus mor 8shes/ /byin pa rna ba gnyis dag dang / /rkang pa'i mthil dang snying ga ⑫dag /lte ba dang ni rgyab gzhung dang / /bshang ④lam dang ni rkan shes bya/ /rkang pa'i tshigs tsodang mchu dag dang / / mkhur ba mkhur 0tshos dag dang ni/ /mdoms ⑩dang mchan khung gnyis dang ni/ /lag pa'i tshigs dang rkang pa dag /dpung pa'i tshigs dang nu ma gnyis/ /mjing phy-i/pa thal gong 'dir mtshams so/ /mjug ma nor bu gnyis dag dang / /rked pa'i tshigs dang mgrin pa dang ⑩/ /dpral ba dang ni tshigs gnyis dag /rna bug dag dang rtsa ba dang / /brang dag 78—457

gnyis kyi mtshams su 'dod/ /stan dag dang ni smin khugs dang / /lce ①dang mi yi sna gang dag /de bzhin du ni rkan dang rtse/ /bol+la /lko la gnyis dag /de la sogs pa du ma ni/ /rtsa dang tshigs kyi gnad du 'gyur/ /rang rang spyod pa btsir ②bya ste/ /byang sems bdag nyid che rnams kyi/ /btsan thabs sbyor ba'i cho ga ru/ /shes bya bla ma'i gsung gis so/ /zla ba zla ba'i tshes gang du/ /tshes grangs de la rtsa ba'i rtsal/ /dkar po'i tshes gcig la 0sogs nas/ /ji srid nag po'i mthar thug par/ /shes bya byang chub 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /'ug mo sgo la spyod pa mo/ /gang dang 'dra ba'i gdong de yi/ /de 'dra'i sor mo'i phyag rgya ni/ /dbugs ni de dang 'dra bar bya/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid 'dod/ /yang na rtsa rnams thams cad ni/ /btsir bya bcu gnyis kyis lhag pa'i/ /brgya yi tshigs ⑤rnams thams cad ni/ /ji ltar gdong gis rim pas so/ /de dang der ni ā 0li 'bar/ /drag po'i ④sgyu ma dus kun du/ /de phyir a zhes bya ba'i ⑧sgo/ /tshig tu rtog pas brtags pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung bar/ /rdo rje 'chang ltar brtag ⑨pa'o/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /rtsa ni gti mug chen por 'gyur⑩/ /de yis ⑩de yi rang bzhin gyur/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi rin chen bzhin/ /rmongs dang mkhas rnams kyi dag la/ /mnga' bdag thar pa chen po 8bzhugs/ /byed pa 'byung po thams cad kyi/ /dbang phyug skye bo sna tshogs rnams/ /de phyir rtag tu las nyams pa/ /sngon byas sdig pa'i las kyis te/ /nyams 'gyur bstan pa 'di la ni/ /bgrod bya sangs rgyas nyid 'thob 'gyur/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom 78—458

ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las 'ug gdong ma'i nges pa'i tshul dang yang dag pa'i cho ga las skyed ①pa dang srog la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid de ②le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan ni don che ba/ /khyi gdong rgyu yi dbye bshad bya/ /gang zhig rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis ①mchog 'grub 'gyur/ /shāsti/khyi ni rnal 'byor ma dbugs 'byin/ /rang gis 'jug dang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dus kun du ni gnyid log dang / /sad pa bde ba yon tan che/ /na⑤/ sna tshogs gnas su song yinas ni/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bde reg ⑦'gyur/ /brgya la nyi shus lhag pa ni/ /nges tshig bstan bya'i mtshan nyid do/ /de ltar khyi yi ming du ni/ /bde ba sbyin pa por shes bya/ /pad+ma'i skye gnas de rnams su/ /usul / pad+ma'i kha ni rab rgyas pa/ /gtong ngang stilongs spyod gar chen po/ /glu dang rol mo gnyid log dang / /reg dang gos dang rgyan dag dang / /me tog la sogs bsung 0can 'dod/ /mthun yipar lte 8ba'i ma la sogs/ /mdzes ma rnams kyi tingag can te/ /sangs rgyas mchod sogs thams cad du/ /su ra'i btung la 'thung 'gyur dang / /skyed ④mos tshal dang rdzing bu'i 'gram/ /bste gnas 'gro ba la sogs kyis/ /tshim dang ston mo 'dod pa ltar/ /bla ma'i gsung ni bde chen po/ /mi dang mi mo'i sgeg 7pa dang / /dgod ⑩dang sgeg pa'i bya ba gang / /mkhas pa rnams kyi yid ⑩dam pa/ /skye bo dbang phyug nyid du'o / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /mchod dang phyag byed la sogs 78—459

pas / /bla ma gus las ①bde ba ste/ /yon 'bul ②ba dang bud med do/ /spyod lam la sogs chos rnams la/ /las thams cad la mi 'jug go/ /rgol ba rnams ni gzhom pa dang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams gzhag ③pa dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang bza' btung dang / /sgom dang dga' ba bskyed dupa dang / /dbang po gnyis kyi bdag nyid skyes/ /sbyin sogs pha rol phyin rnams kyi/ /las kyis skyid pa btsal bya dang / /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /kun gyi tha mar btang snyoms dang / /ye shes rnam shes smra ba dang / /dbu ma'i tshul ni gzhag ⑤pa las/ /kun la dbugs dbyung sbyin pa dang / /skur pa 'debs pa dgag pa dang / /dge ba bcu yi las dang ni/ /klog dang kha ton dubyed mchog las/ /byang chub lam la gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo gnyis med blta ba'i ⑦phyir / /lus la ltos pa med pa yis/ /grong dang grong du gnas rnams kyi/ /de ltar gnas skabs gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa slar yang bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rgyud la dga'/ /don dam rnams la gsal ba yisal/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gnas su/ /dngos grub gtam rnams brjod pa dang / /chos ni don chen 'du shes la/ /dus su 'du shes sgom pa po/ /'gro drug 0spong ba'i 'du shes ni/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i ming can no/ /dngos rnams sgyu ma'i 'du shes dang / /zhi sogs las kyis ⑩bde ba dang / /pha dang bu las gcig min dang / /gnas sogs 'gro bar spro ba can/ /nyon mongs phung po yongs gtong dang / /ye shes phung po skyed ⑩pa dang / /slar yang 'khor bar mi 'ong dang ske/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /rtog pa po yi tshig bzung nas/ /rtogs 8ldan min pa'i tshig spang bya/ /dbang po rnams kyi mi mthun min/ /rang 78wa 460

bzhin gyis ni mdzes pa yi/ /lhan cig skyes dang longs ①spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa dang ni chos sku ②yang / /'du shes sad pa la sogs su/ /gang phyir srid mtshor kun spang bya/ /lhag ma dga' ba bzhi po ni/ /smon lam rdzogs ldan la sogs la/ /rdzogs ldan dus su rang bzhin skye/ /dga' ba sangs rgyas rdzogs ldan gang ske/ /sems can gsum ldan la phra 0skyes/ /rig pa de dul sbom po skyes/ /gnyis ldan la ni bde ba med/ /rtsod dus cha yi rags ⑤pa'o/ /thams cad sangs rgyas yon tan thob/ /smon lam gyis ni rang gi 'bras/ /de ltar bde skabs rnams kyis ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis rmad 6)byung che/ /gnas skabs gsum pa'i bde ba la/ /dga' ba bcu drug rtag brtags pas/ /khams bcu drug tu shes par bya/ /rang bzhin skyes par gyur pa gsal/ /sman dang 'dra bar shes par bya/ /bdud rtsi zos pas pha rol 'gro/ /pad can dung dang sna tshogs can/ /glang po ma dang bung ba'i ⑦ming / /'khor lo rdo rje skya snar ma/ /du ba mo dang bu skye tshe/ /nyang rtsi ⑧pas dang ngo tsha dang / /glog dang tsan+dan nyi ma skyes / /dmar po de bzhin sbrul gyi mig /sman mchog tu ni shes par bya/ /bde bas dga' ba'i dus su ni/ /khab sogs byed pa'i skad cig ⑨las/ /bya ba de dag zhar la dran/ /sgom pa'i skad cig mthar 'gro ba'o/ /gnas skabs bzhi la bshad pa ni/ /yid can rnams kyi grangs brgyad de'i/ /'gro dang 'pho 'gyur de bzhin du/ /skyug 'gyur gnyid yur 'gyur de bzhin/ /ltung 'gyur 'dzag 'gyur dang ni 'dir/ /g.yo 'gyur 'gyel bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad dkar mo sogs/ /bde ba'i rgyu yis hunyeganas skabs so/ /de ltar gnas skabs rnam bzhi la/ /khyi gdong ming gis 'du shes gyur/ /yang 78—461

dag dran pa'i go 'phang 'dir/ /gang dang su yir gnas par 'gyur/ /yang dag rtsol ①ba la gnas nas/ /khyi ni gzhan gyi grong du'o/ /sngags bden ②sbyor ba'i ③bdag nyid de/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su sgom 0pa'o/ /oṃ ba dza dz+ra ṭā shā ma na ta ā ku kyā ṭa ya u ke ta hūm̐ ka ⑤ ṭā pha ya ṭa rgyu pha hūṃ ṭa pha ༷swā ṭa hā pha oṃ ṭa swā hā/ sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid sngags/ /shes rab thabs te dngos grub ster/ /kha dog dmar po drag chen mo/ /lhag ma dum skyes ma dang mtshungs//chu stong /rka ṭa ⑦yugs sa/ /rang ②gi bdag po rab gnas ma/ /nye ba'i gling du gnas ma ste/ /sems can rang rang bzhin du skyes/ /dbang gi las la lha mo ste/ /lha dang lha min sogs sngags rig⑨ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sgrol ⑩ma che/ /mchod pa las rnams thams cad la'o/ /snying gzhi ⑩pad+mar yongs bkug nas/ /bdud rtsi tshig 8kun las skyes pa/ /rdo rje sbru gu'i rab sbyor bas/ /sbar dang bsro ba la sogs pas/ /sku rdo rje sogs sngags kyis ni/ /byin gyis brlab par byas pa la'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las8/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las khyi gdong ma'i mtshan nyid dang bde ba la sogs pa'i gnas skabs kyi cho ga ste le'u ④dgu pa'o// //de nas phag gdong ma yi ni/ /nyung ba rgya cher bshad par bya/ /dngos po kun la rab 'jug dang / /dngos po de las ldog pa'o/ /phag mo rengs pa'i las rnams la/ /mi shes ri bo 'joms ma'o/ /srubya/ khab ni rdo rje'i gdong de 78—462

yang / /skud pa bzhin du kun 'gro ma/ /byang chub sems kyi dga' chen po/ //nyu /keng rus bdud rtsi 'byin pa'o②/ /de'i rang bzhin 'dod chags ③sogs kunadu/ /bzhi pa las 'das mi 'gyur ma/ /de nas lha mo chen mo brgyad//mngal sogs bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /thog mar bya rog bzhin sa bon/ /ma yi pad+ma la lhung ba'o/ /nub gcig gis ni phye ba yis/ /phyi nas 'ug par gnas dang 'dra/ /zla ba gcig tu gnas nas ni/ /khyi yi dbugs ni 'phel ba las/ /phag tu'ang yan lag bdag nyid can/ /brtan mas skye gnas dral ba las/ /pho nya byis pa dang 'chi ⑤phyis/ /mche ba mo ni las bcom pas/ /'joms ma byang chub yan lag dgyes/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras 'byung dum/ /yang dag pa yi rtsol ⑦ba 'di/ /gzhan gyi lta ba nya sogs kyisani/ /'jug pa thams cad bden pa ste/ /'jug med de dngos spyod yul lo/ /rkang gnyis rkang bzhi la sogs pa'i/ /rtsol ba'i yan lag 'joms ⑨ma'o mthong ba dang ni reg pas kyang / /'jug med de nyid rtag tu'o/ /kha dog ser mo drag chen mo/ /lhag ma gzugs can ma dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i 0dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /seng ge gro bzhin yichu srin la/ /nye ba'i gling du gnas pa mo/ /sngags las bzhengs 8pa'i lha mo rnams/ /rang rang zhing dang nyid 8zhing ma'o/ /oṃ ba rda dz+ra ṭī sru ka ka rā rā lo sgyu gra yi mu rgyu kha rgyu gi pha ṣa ṭa ṇa pha ④ya ṭa rgyu swā rgyu hā pha oṃ ṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid kyibya/ /gtso mo mchog gi rnal 'byor ma/ /dkyil 'khor thig gdab la sogs ni/ /bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba'i ma yi ste/ /thig chen gnyis ni btab nas su/ /shar dang so sor 'dod thig dang / /zur gyi thig 78—463

gnyis btab byas nas/ /phur bu nyagadab par bya ba ste/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi logs nas (2)ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis pa gnyis gdab/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /lte rigeba'i pad+ma de dang mnyam/ /snying po'i 'dab ma'i ngos nas ni/ /cha gsum du yang de shes bya/ /de yi cha gcig 'khor lo gsum/ /lhag ma tshon rjogyi sa gzhi'o'adi/ /de yi sum cha phreng ba ste/ /rdo rje pad+ma dang 'khor lo/ /rtsibs rnams 'khor lo dbus ma las/ /dman te gnyis gcig bsdams 0pas sbom/ /ka ba rnams ni kun du sbyin/ /brgyad gsum 'khor lo gsum du'o/ /sgo las sum 'gyur rta babs te/ /sgo khyud sgo yi cha can no/ /stegs bu rnams ni de'i phyed de(7)/ /'gram dang (8༄logs ni de bzhin no/ /gzungs kyi snam bu dang ni 'dir / /rin chen phreng phyed snam bu'o/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba de yi phyed/ /mun pa'i snam bu de bzhin no/ /ka ba'i rtse las 'thon rtse mo/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od chen po'o/ /dril chung dra ba gos rnams dang / /ba dan dril bu sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /de'i phyi chu skyes thams cad du/ /snying po la sogs yang dag bri/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng dang 'dir/ /lhag mar 'bar ba'i phreng ba'o/ /de yi phyi rol khor yug ni/ /sa gzhi'i 9༄rim pas bri bar bya/ /gri gug phreng ba sbyin bya zhing / /mgo dang lag pa dag de bzhin/ /snying po'i pad+ma'i phyi rol du/ /rin chen phreng ba yang dag bri/ /dur khrod brgyad po bri bya ste/ /kun nas gtum drag la sogs sol/ /sa bon rnam par dgod par bya/ /thams cad gri gug las byung ba'o/ /yang na sku sogs rnams kyi ni/ /yi ge rnams kyis yidakyil 'khor kun/ /de bzhin skad cig rnam pas kyang / /sa bon rnams kyis yidakyil 'khor dbyung / /mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi thod pa ni/ /bum pa'i steng du 78wa 464

sbyin bya ste/ /sum cu rtsa bdun gzhan bya'o/ /gnag dang rtsa ba spangs pa ste/ /mchu ①ni 'phyang zhing mgrin pa mtho/ /mgrin pa rnams su gos zung ste/ /rin chen lnga dang 'bru dang sman/ /dri yi chu dang 'dab ma'i rtse/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams kyis dgang bya/ /gtor ma las rnams kun la ste/ /kun nas sgom ②pa la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje lha mo rnams dang ni/ /zhing skyong dang ni khro rnams la/ /bdud rtsi lnga sogs rdzas rnams 'bul②/ /tshim bya phyi la sogs rnams kyis/ /bgegs med yang dag 'phel bar 'gyur/ /phyi nas tshulas ni yang dag brtsam/ /du ma'i dud 'gro'i zhal lha mo/ /sum cu rtsa bdun gzugs can rnams/ /las kyi rdo rje 'joms ⑤byas nas/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor ldan/ / bdun cu duganyis phyag drag mo ste/ /zhabs bcwa ⑦brgyad ni rnams kyis ②ldan/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni phag zhal te⑨/ /ngos gnyis dag tu dgu dgu'o/ /de yi steng du bdun bdun te/ /phyi nas gsum ni gzhag ⑩par bya/ /g.yas su khyi dang ce ⑪spyang dang / /byi la stag dang seng ge dang / /'jigs byed mche 8can rta bong bu / /de ltar ji ltar rim pas so/ /g.yon du ba lang ma he sbyang / /rus 8sngal chu srin ri bong dang / /bse dang g.yag dang mun dza dang / /ji lta'i rim pas mtshon par bya/ /sbrul dang sre mo tsangs pa dang / /sram dang byi ba dang ni dom/ /mkha' lding bya rgod bya rog dang / /'ug pa bya gar 8khra dang ni/ /srin bya dang ni ngur pa dang / /rma bya zangs kyi gtsug pud 8can/ /phug ron 'di rnams thams cad la/ /rang bzhin mdog tu 'dod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyis ⑩bya nges par ni/ /rang bzhin gang gi ⑩khams la'o/ /yon tan sum cu gsum bdag ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de yi gzugs brnyan gyi 78wa 465

ni zhal/ /'gro la byang chub byed bdag nyid/ /zhabs rnams kyis ni 'byung po'i tshogs/ /me yi dbus su son pa gnon/ /g.yas pas khyab 'jug drag po dang ske/ /tshangs pa nyi ma me dang ni/ /dbang po rlung dang bden bral dang / /nor hu)sbyin ji lta'i rim pa'o/ /g.yon pas ②gshin rje 'dod pa dang / /zla ba chu lha nor ces dang / /sa dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /smin drug bu dang 'khor sgyur 47te/ /de ltar bcwa dubargyad dbyibs rnams ni/ /'dus pa rmad byung bsngags pa'o/ /'dzin 'gyur rang gi sems kyis ni/ /lha mo'i zhabs ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yas par mtshon cha'i tshogs kyang ni/ /rdo rje ral gri mdung dbal can/ /dgra sta gri gug mda' dang ni/ /gsal shing phub ⑤dang tho ba dang | /'khor lo ḍam 6)ru chu gri dang / /dbyug pa dang ni mtshon rtse gcig /dung dang zangs dung medabyug gu dang / /rma bya'i mjug ⑧ma de bzhin te/ /bya rog sgro dang pir dang ni/ /me yi thab dang ri bo dang / /dbyug pa me long pi wang dang / /rkang mgo lag pa glo ba dang / /rgyu ⑨ma sgra gcan lcags sgrog dang / /gdos dang sgrog skyedang nya rgya dang / /mgo gcad ⑩'bar ba mar nag dang / /'jigs byed gzugs te rim pas so/ /g.yon par dril bu phub rings mche/ /tho ba zhags pa thod pa dang / /gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga po titri/ /phub chung yu can sdigs mdzub /snyedang / /g.yer ku'i 0phreng dang lcags sgrog dang / /brag dang dur khrod rdul dang ni/ /bho rka 87 ka lpags 0rlon dang / /skra yi thag pa 'phyang ba dang / /skul byed ro yi shing bu dang / /brag dang phub dang mgo bo dang / /keng rus zor ba de bzhin te/ /mig tsodang mkhal ma gnye ma dang / /spen 8pa dang ni phur pa dang / /sa bon gang dang sog yile dang / /khab dang lus kyi 78wa 466

pags ①pa dang / /sprin char 'bab dang shing ral gri/ /de ltar rim pas shes byas pas/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis rgyud kyi rtsa'o/ /gnyis ②lhag pa yi phyag gnyis kyis / /glang po'i pags ②pa steng bgos pa'o/ /khams gsum glang po la bzhugs pa/ /dral ba bgegs ni bcom pa'o④/ /kun gyi kha dog rang bzhin te / /yang na gtso mo'i ⑤kha dog bzhin/ /mgo bo'i phreng sogs thams cad dang ske/ /gos dang rgyan rnams lus skyes pa'o/ /de ltar yang dag pa'i rtsol ⑥ba'i / /gzugs brnyan can mar shes par bya/ /yang dag dran pa'i rang bzhin gyis / /dngos dbye rkang gnyis bdag nyid do/ /ting 'dzin dra bas kun bkang nas / /'od gsal ba la kun thim byos/ /rtogs ⑦nas sangs rgyas nyid 'thob 'gyur / /sna tshogs dud 'gro sogs skye'o/ /rang rang skad kyis chos kyang ni/ /rang rigs ⑤skyes la ston par 'gyur/ /sru yi yi ges 'gro kun rgyas btab ste/ /lhan skyes rang bzhin de 0nyid dran par bya/ /slar yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'ong ngo / /phyugs gang yin pa'i skye bo 0rnams sangs rgyas7/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las phag gdong ma skyed hu)pa dang dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa la sogs pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas brtan ma'i sbyor 'osteb 'dir/ /bshad kyis ④sgom pa po rnams nyon/ /kun nas dus ni bzhi rnams su/ /zla ba gsum gsum pa ni bzhi/ /bgrod dang mnyam pas bcings pa yi/ /mtshams de rnams ni rab bshad bya/ /byang du 78—467

bgrod pa la sogs pa/ /brtan ma la sogs mtshams gnas ma/ /nye ba'i gling du gnas pa mo/ /mgo yi zla ba dang ni gzhu/ /mo hi ta ni rtag tu de'i/ /las gnyis dag tu shes bya ste/ /sgom po rnams kyi dus min pa'i/ /'chi ba mche ①bas gcod ma gang / /de yis gshin rje'i mcher shes bya/ /thog mar yi ge gnyis can no/ /bcom ldan dus min 'chi ba ni/ /mi rnams la ni ji ltar 'byung ske/ /gang gi 9kyedrin gyis bdag rig 'gyur/ /su zhig bdag la sprul par 'gyur / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /brtan ma dus min 'chi ba ni / /sems can rang rang las kyis so/ /skye bo kun la 'tshe ①ba yi/ /sdig gang bdag nyid kyis byas pa/ /de yis ④de ni dus min 'chi/ /khams dang dbugs ni 'chad (5)par 'gyur/ /gzhan rnams kyis ni gcad dupa yis/ /bza' ⑦btung phyin ci log tu 'gyur/ /sbyin pa rnyed pa dang bcas sbyin/ /dus min gyis ni nyams mi 'gyur/ /sbyin pa rnam pa gnyis su bshad/ /lus dudang bsam pa las kyang ngo / /g.yon gyi sna yi sgo ru ni/ /zla ba rgyu ba'i rim pa yis/ /bgrod pa'i srog ni nyi ma'i ste(9da/ /a ba dhū tī'i ⑩rlung rim pas/ /de yis ya yi yi ge bshad/ /ma yi yi ge dbus 'bab ma'o/ /dā yig g.yas su song nas ni / /re zhig 'o/dbus ma rgyu bar 'gyur/ /a yi yi ges gnas pa 'thob slu ba nam nyunyemakhar 'gro ba mo/ /rtsa ni bde kun bdag nyid rnams/ /snyi 0yi yi ge'i ming du shes/ /mdor bsdus pa yi yi ge ni/ /dkyil 'khor lnga rnams su ni brjod / /de rnams dngos las khyod bskyod de8/ /dus min blu 8bar rig par bya / /de ltar bsod nams gcig nyid po/ /gnas gnas bgrod pa'i lus can no / /'chi ba zhes 'di rnam rtog ste/ /mkha' spyod go 'phang 'khrid par 'gyur/ /78—468

'dir ni kha dog gnyis su 'gyur/ /lus bsgom ①pa ni de bzhin no②/ /ji ltar mkha' 'gro ma'i rim pas/ /mtshan nim mtshon cha sogs 'gyur ro/ /spong ba'i chos shes bya bar gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gtso mo'o/ /rnal 'byor sum cu bdun bdag nyid/ /sngags las byung ba'i bdag nyid kyis④/ /oṃ āḥkhyas rtsu ha ba sra tsasti/ bhu ya dza ma bhā dā su snyi rā kā ya yi ⑦ rgyu rtsu rgyu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa / swā ༷swā hā hā ⑨ma/ 'di ni shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo'i gtso/ /gshin rje 0mche ba'i rab sbyor bas/ /skye ba mthar byed bza' bar bya/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las gshin rje brtan ⑩ma'i rnam par gzhag pa dang skyed 8pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba ste le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas gshin rje pho nya 'chad/ /gang gis 'chi ba dbang 'gyur ba'o/ /brirtsi 0ka ru yang dag byung / /smin drug can dang bzang por ldan/ /dpyid kyis mnyam pa'i dus kyis ni/ /pho nya ma bskyed ④mtshan nyid do/ /gshin rje gsod ma 8de yi ni/ /'chi ba blu ⑩ba'i 'khor lo la/ /rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo cher/ /lan gsum du ni bskor bar bya/ /lnga rnams nyi shu rtsa lngar ni/ /bcu gsum bar du bri bar bya/ /slar yang sum cu gnyis rnams su/ /gsum gnyis gcig ni lo yin no/ /dus tshod me dang gnyis zla ba/ /zla ba'o 0tshes phyogs de bzhin mda'/ /gsum gnyis gcig gi skabs su ni/ /rim pas phyi 78—469

nas nyi phyed sogs/ /nyi ma gcig dang zhag dang gnyis/ /gsum bzhi sa dang nyi ma phyogs/ /nor ro chu phyogs rim pas te/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid gsal ba'o/ /srog gi nus par shes bya ba/ /bcu dgu yi ni bdag nyid do/ /bcu dgu slar yang 'di ru ni/ /'joms pa'i bdag nyid nus can no/ /nyi mar bdun po mnyam 3)son par/ /skye ba'i skar ma dang zla ba/ /gcig tu spyod par rtag rgyu las/ /rgyas pa'i dus ni yang dag 'thob/ /bar gyi nyi ma rnams nyid ni/ /bcu drug grangs su shes byas ②la/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis rim pa yis/ /lo yi rim pas yang dag sbyoraris// /de phyir pho nya'i lha mo yang / /dkyil 'khor bdag nyid can bsgom bya/ /gang du rtsa ni srog spangs pa/ /der duni 'di de 'bab par bya/ /steng du yal 'dab steng rtsa ba/ /gsang ba yis ni dbugs bya ba'o / /de ni mnyam pa mtshams kun te/ /mnyam pa ya yig gis du'agugs ma'o / /de nas gnad bcings pas nyams pa(6)/ /ma yi yi ges thams cad bshad / /'og dang steng du bskyod byas nas/ /rnon po'i me ni rab 'bar ②bya/ /nad rnams dang ni sdig mang rnams/ /las kyis durang nyid nyams par 'gyur/ /der ni sbyin pa sbyin bya ste/ /ba lang ma te zhon sogs so/ /byang chub sems kyi ⑨lam du ni/ /mdzes ma rnams kyi de tshe btung 0/ /der yang rang gi yan lag lasanyunye / /byung ba'i sna sman gtang pho bar bya/ /'o ma dang mnyam bza' bya ste/ /glo ba la sogs ma tshos pa'o/ /g.yul ngor (snyerang nyid 'gyel ba yi/ / gal te ④rnyed na khrag chen po/ /the tshom spangs nas btung bya zhing / /de yi sha yang bza' 8bar bya/ /yang na gang gi sa gnas su/ /'chi ltas 7zad nas song bar durdzortel/ /bza' ba 'o mas byas na bde/ /yang na sha rnams thams cad do/ /78—470

gos 'jam rnams kyis yongs g.yogs nas/ /bdag nyid la ni dus kun du/ /der ni gnas pa bsro ①bya zhing / /me dang lhan cig nges gnas bya/ /der ni chu dron ①kyang btung ①zhing / /bza' ba chung ngu nyung ngu'o/ /gshin rje'i pho nya bsgom bya ste/ /sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid rang / /gsang sngags kha sbyor bdag nyid can/ /ser dmar gnyis kyi kha dog can/ /ser pos 'chi ba rengs par byed/ /dmar pos dbang du 'gugs par byed/ /lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub dngos kyisaX/ /lte 'og mgrin pa rkan 'gro rnams/ /zab pas srog ni gzhan 'gro ba/ /phan tshun phug ⑤rnams su 'du 'gyur/ /de phyir kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsgom ⑥ste/ /yan lag kha ṭ+wāṃ sbyor bas so/ /snying ga'i ⑦pad dbus su sems kyis / /dkyil 'khor sngon cha'i cha can no/ /lha mo ④mo'i mdog ni sngon can te/ /dbyibs sogs gzugs can ma dang mtshungs/ /oṃ ba pa dz+ra ra ya shu ma pā dru shwa tī bya ye ta hūṃ shu rgyu la phaṭa kha phaṭa ṭ+wāṃ swā ga hā dhā ri ṇi ⑨ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa ⑩ga hā oṃ rgyu / shes rab thabs bdag nyid du skyes/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rang bzhin can / /rnal 'byor ma ni 'di rnams kun/ /bdud rtsi'i gzugs su bsgom par bya / /de rnams snying gar skyedakar ba ④ni/ /'khor lo thams cad rnam bsgom ⑫bya / /de rnams nang du rang ming yang ske/ /kha dog dkar po 'od ⑩bcas pa /rtsa yi bu ga so so yi/ /nang du'ang rnam par bsgom par bya/ /rlon dang btsos pa'i ra'i 'o ⑩ma/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang rang byung 0ni/ /rdo rje'i rtse mos 'thungs pas kyang / /dus su 'chi ba nyams par 'gyur/ /zag med de nyid thob pas na / /de la dus min 'chi ming ci/ /de phyir yang dag rab spong ba'i/ /chos nyid gshin rje'i pho nyar shes/ /rdo rjes (3btung byas rab bshad pa/ /las kyis 78—471

rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /gcig ni phyi rol gyir bshad de①/ /gnyis po nang gi bdag nyid 'dod/ /rdo rje rtse gsum bsgom bya ba/ /rtsa drug dus ni rgyu ba mo/ /ngang (kyepa'i rgyu bar 'dzin pa'i srog /'og gi chu ni 'thung ba yi/ /bdud rtsi lnga sogs gang cung zad/ /de yi dbus su rab tu zhugs/ /'thungs pas rgas dang 'chi ba 55)'bros/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gdams ④ngag go/ /gshin rje'i ⑤rdzo nya ma yi rnal 'byor ma khyod bzhugs/ /de yis slar duyang rgas dang 'chi ba med pa 'thob/ /'chi ba slong bar byed pa'i rnal 'byor ma bla med/ /rnal 'byor ma la sdig dang bsod nams mi ldan no/ /de ni mnyam pa'o mnyam srog las/ /g.yon dang g.yas dang dbu ma yi/ /rtsol ba g.yo med dngos po las/ /slar yang ya ma'i yi ge 'dod/ /pho nya phyogs gnyis kyi ngang pa⑦/ /dbu mar zad pa'i go 'phang ngo / /de ltar rnam pa mang po ni/ /brtan pa'i blo ldan gyis mtshon bya/ /'dir mang bshad pas ci bya ste/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin sogs pa//dge ba'i las kyang bsnyen 3)bya ste/ /lus gcig lus mang po can no/ /rnal 'byor ma la mchod bya zhing / /dpa' bo rnams la rjed ⑨par bya/ /gang zhig gang slong la yang dag /de phyir de rnams la nges sbyin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las gshin rje pho nya mo skyed hukye pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang 'chi ba bslu ⑩ba'i 'khor lo bsgom ⑫pa'i man ngag mdor bsdus pa ste le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //78—472

de nas gshin rje mche gtsigs ma/ /bshad kyis da ①ni mnyan par gyis/ /sems can rnams kyi bag chags kyi/ /skyon gyis gur la 'bigs dang bsreg(mi /gang zhig gang la las byas pas/ /de yi dus su 'jigs par 'dod/ /brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnad rnams ni/ /gang dang der ni gnas rnams kyang / /'di ②rnams dbus su bya ba ste/ /dge dang dman pa mtshon par bya/ /mi dge ba ni 'chir dogs pas/ /gnad du na bas mtshon par bya/ /gal te dus ni gcig la ni/ /rkan gsum du ni gzer ba na/ /de tshe zhag gsum na 'chi bar/ /rig bya 'di la the tshom med/ /rkang pa'i brang bar ④gzer ba dang / /gal te lte bar gzer ba nadu/ /lha mo zhag gnyis na 'chi bar/ /skye bo rnams ni 'gyur ba'o/ /rkang pa gnyis kyi brang mthil rjodang / /gal te mig tu gzer ba na/ /de tshe zla ba gsum du ④yang / /'chi byed kyi ni dbang du 'gro/ /rkang pa'i mthil ⑧ni gzer ba dang / /gal te sna ni gzer ba na/ /zhag gsum na ni 'chi 'gyur bar / /'di la yang ni the tshom med/ / bshang dang gci ⑨ba'i dus su ni/ /gal te sbrid pa 0byung ba na/ /de yi de ltar dus tshod kyi/ /lo na nges par 'chi ba'o/ /snga dro yi ni nyin lnga dang / /dbus ma'i gung la bcu de bzhin/ /gzhan gyi gung la zla phyed gcig /nam phyed la yang zla ba ste/ /'di tshe'i de ltar dus su ni/ /gal te srid byung sngon bzhin te/ /dus kyi nges par 'chi tso'agyur bas/ /'di la the tshom med pa'o/ /ltag pa yi ni bdud ⑩khung du/ /gzer na lo ni lnga rnams na/ /de ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba 0ni/ /shes bya 'di la the tshom 0med/ /lha mo lce rtse ma mthong na/ /de phyir zhag ni gsum na 'chi/ /nyan pa yi ni rtse mor gzer/ /'chi ba zla ba bzhi na'o/ /mig g.yon pa yi 'bras bu ni/ /me 78—473

long la ni ma mthong na/ /de tshe zhag bdun na 'chi bar/ /sngon gyi skye bar bshad pa'o/ /dkar po yi ni tshes gcig la/ /gal te khu ba dkar min 'gyur//zla ba drug na de 'chi ste/ /dmar pos nang du nges par 'gyur/ /bha ga ling ga yongs sbyar ba'i/ /mtha' ru gal te sbrid pa ni/ /byung na zla ba lnga na ni/ /de tshe ltung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /sbyor ba'i dus su dril bu'i sgra/ /rna dag la byung 'chi gsal bar/ /gal te brgya byin mnyam gyur pa/ /zla ba lnga na the tshom med/ /de bzhin dus ni gcig gi tshe/ /gal te zla ba nyi ma dag /gang gi sems can la gzer ba/ /zla ba gcig tu 'tsho bcas pa'o/ /rkang lag dag gi tshigs bzhi dang ske/ /mthe'u 0)chung gi ni sor mo la/ /gang gi dus gcig la gzer ba/ /nges par zla ba gcig na 'chi/ /bsnun pa gsum gyis gzer ba na②/ /gal te nus stobs bdag mnyam pa/ /rkang pa'i mthe bong dudag las dpa'/ /sa gsum du ni skye bo rnams/ /mdud pa'i rgyal po lta bu'i tshul/ /dpe ④des rtag tu bshad pa'o/ /de tshe zla drug na 'chi bar/ /gal te drag po mnyam kyang 'gyurage / /snying ga'i (yidabus dang de bzhin sngon/ /'dir yang mgrin pa'i spyod yul te/ /zla phyed gsum na 'chi bar ni/ /rnam dpyad ④spyod yul 'di la med/ /slar yang mgo bo'i rtse mor gzer/ /grong khyer gsum gyi rgya mtsho bsreg⑧ /'phral du 'chi bar shes bya bar/ /lus kyi gur du bshad pa'o/ /rna ba'i rtsa bar de bzhin gzer/ /'phral du 'chi bar nges par bshad/ /smin ma'i dbus su de bzhin gzer/ /de yi skad cig la 'chi 'gyur/ /sna yi rtse mor rlung grang mor / /gyur na yongs rdzogs dus yin no/ /de ltar 'chi ba thams cad ni/ /mche gtsigs go 'phang gis bslu'o⑨/ /gang gi dus su 'di 'gyur ba'i/ /78—474

gzer ni de ①tshe'i dus 'dir 'gyur/ /gzer ba'i gnas ni gsal mtshon nas//rtsa ba bcu yis ②mnye bar bya/ /khyab 'jug ces bya'i ①mar khu ni/ /mgo bor rtag tu gzung bar bya/ /sna nas rnam snang mar khu dang / /mar dang khrag tu yongs ldan pa'o/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis mi gdung ste④/ /skye bo dang bral khyim dron ⑤por / /sbyor ba'i rgya mtsho che gzung yibs/ /rnal 'byor ma de yang bsgom bya/ /yal / gang gi dkyil 'khor chen por ni/ /ma/ dbu ma'i mtha' yi ⑧mtshan nyid las/ /g.yas su bgrod pa'i dus su ni/ /rda yig tshigs stimatshams kun du'o / /bu ga gzer byed phug nas ni/ /de'i skad cig tshul dbyug gu dbyug /ṭa7ske/ hril hril por ni 'gyur bzhin 8pa/ /ṣa0/ snying ga'i 0rdzing bu la ⑫sogs gtso/ /shes bya mtshams kun du yang ste/ /gzer ba'i 'chi ba slu ⑩ba la/ /yi / dbang po yis ni thams cad la'ang ⑫/ /yid ni de bzhin nges par gnasal/ /sbyi yiyi yi ge zhes bya ba/ /de ltar tshigs bcad gnyis kyis gsungs//der ni ting 'dzin zhes bya ba/ /dbang po sbyangs pas thob par gyis/ /pad snal skud pas du nor bu dang / /spyi gtsug kyang ni gcig tu bya/ /rnam shes brgyad po der gnas par/ /bsgom bya myos byed 'bab pa mo/ /kun du skud pa ⑩de btang bas/ /gshin rje'i du nyamache ba 'joms pa mo/ /de yis nī zhuyi yig bshad do④/ /gzer ba thams cad rnam 'joms ma'o/ /kha dog dmar dang sngo ba ste/ /'chi ba 'joms ma byang chub 'gro/ /de yi dumatshon char 'gyur ba ni//dum skyes rnal 'byor ma yi'o/ /rdo rje'i phyedakyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid mchog /oṃ ba byā dz+ra gh+ra 0ya dzi tsom na rda ardzi sba tsā phyor ya dha ke rā hūṃ ya hūṃ rtsu zhu pha hūṃ ṭa pha pha ṭa ṭa phaṭa swā swā hā hā 0i/ shes rab thabs 78—475

kyi rang bzhin du'ang / /skud pa'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /tha skar zla ba de bzhin du/ /srang dang khyu mchog rā si'i'o(7/ /'dis ni byed bzhin pa yis ni/ /'chi ba slu nasab dge ba'o/ /gzhan ni de la de ltar bya/ /pho nya ma ni gsal bar brjodarka/ /gzhan gyi 'chi ba blu darab yang / /brgya phrag 'bum rnams shes par bya/ /'on kyang kun stong gnas byas nas/ /bla mchog mnyes par ④byas pas so/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor sa)las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las gshin rje mche ba ma'i rab tu sbyor ba la 'jug pa ⑥'chi ba bslu ⑦ba la sogs pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas 'joms ma'i 'jug pa ni/ /gang gis pha rol 'gro bshad bya/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams 'dus byas nas/ /gzhi las 'dri bar byed pa ste/ /'jug pa zhes bya ci ru bshad/ /khyab bdag pha rol ming ni ci/ /shin tu ngo mtshar ston pas blagasungs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bka' drin mdzod/ /nyon cig sgyu ma'i 'jug pa yang / /mi bden pa ni bden btags te⑨/ /lha mo dbang po'i dra ba ltar/ /'joms ma yi yang 'jug pa ste/ /mthong ba na yang de la med/ /chu yi zla ba lta bu mchog /rang gi rang bzhin la 'jug 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor de nyid 'dzin rnams kyi'o/ /dus kyi 'chi ba'i dngos po yang / /las kyis su ni blu ⑩ba ste/ /'khor ba las ni pha rol 'gro/ /'chi med blu 7ba yang ni med/ /ston gyi nam nyin mnyam dus su/ /sna yi nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rlung ni rnam 78—476
