rgyal po chen po las rtsa ba'i sngags btu ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan lhur 1 bshad bya ba/ /lus can rnams kyi go cha ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying ga tshonaru/ /ā ri li dang sbyor (4)rgyas gdab bya/ /rdo rje snying po'i ye shes dang / /sems dpa' nam mkha' dang gcig pa/ /snying ga ⑤rnam par shes phra mo/ /ā 6/li gtum mo yum yin te/ /sbyor ba'ang mi 'gyur zhes bya ba/ /'di ltar dbang po kun rgyas gdab/ /de phyir srung (7)ba'ang oṃ ha yi(8)/ /yig gang rtag tu 'joms med pa'o9/ /lhag ma rnam snang brjod pa'i mthar/ /rdo rje bskyod pa las sgra'o/ /de'i phyir ji ltar mngon par ni/ /brjod pa las ni bzhengs pa'i gzugs/ /mi rnams kyi ni snying dbus su/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dkyil 'khor/ /rdo rje phag mos bo'akhyud pa yang hurte/ /lte ba'i 'khor lor srung 12ba derme / /oṃ baṃ gyi 10ni sngags kyi gzugs/ / dbu ma nyunyemadzes tsodang rdo rje 'dzin/ /kha sbyar 'di ni srung hu ba che/ /ma byung dang por yang dag byung ske/ /'khor lo kun gyi gsang sngags kyang / /dngos grub kun gsol 8bshad par bya/ /oṃ ha baṃ hā ṭ+wāṃ hi bi 194gli bī hu bu hū bru he be hai be+e tsha )ho bo ho bo ri )rta rba haḥbaḥ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā swā hā/ thung dang ring po'i rang bzhin gyis/ / thams cad na shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /gang tshe burdo rje phag mo ni/ /gtso mo'i rnam par gnas pa ni/ /oṃ nudi zhes bya thul sogs pa'i/ /sngags kyi'ang yi ge sbyin zhu par bya/ /ye shes 'khor lo skye gnas te/ /gdan kyang 58gsang ba par 'dod do/ /thams cad bde ba'i rnam par 'gyur/ /bde 78wa 530

ba brtan dang 'gro ba dang / /bde ba dkar po bde ba gnag /bde ba kun du skyes de bzhin/ /bde ba shes rab bde ba thabs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar dran①/ /rang byung bde ba mi rnams la/ /rang nyid ②dkyil 'khor rdzogs ldan du'o/ /rdzogs ldan rgyud du srung 'di ni / /rdzogs ldan nyid ni 'byung ba'o / /'jig rten sna tshogs rdzogs ldan shes/ /sna tshogs khams rdzogs ldan de bzhin / /sna tshogs 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /de ltar dus kun shes par bya / /dus gcig la ni rdzogs ldan sogs/ /'jig rten khams rnams su 'byung min / /bcom ldan 'das ni bsnyen byas pas/ /kun du bde bas khyab par spyod / /gang du rtsod dus der rdzogs ldan/ /gang du rdzogs ldan der rtsod dusal/ /der ni ④gsum ldan dang gnyis ldan/ /re re yi ⑤ni gnyis ldan te/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni sum cu drug /ma lus 'dus las yang byung ba'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs sol/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rdo rje sems dpa' dang phag mo'i go cha skyed ⑥pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga ste/ le'u bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas slar yang go cha yi/ /srung meb rnam snang mdzad kyi ste/ /mgo bor rgyas gdab de yi ni/ /gsang sngags na maḥ(nyegyi nyid do/ /gyen du 'gro dus rnal 'byor ni/ /gang gang bde las byung ba'i las/ /de de'i dus su shes bya ste/ /gus pas mngon par bsrung ⑨ba'i sngags/ /dri med mgo ⑩bor sbyar bya ste/ /78—531

'di ni bde chen 'khor lo'o/ /rnal 'byor gdan du shes bya ste/ /gshin rje ma yis 'khyud de bzhin/ /oṃ yaṃ (1sngags las skyes bdag nyid/ /shes rab thabs bdag rgyu yis ni/ / yā ro/ sī tsa/ nī nin/ de ltar khams 'a༄rnams (zhenasbyar bar 5)bya/ /lus la sogs pa kun thim pa/ /zung dang zung du 'byung bar 'gyur / /de phyir gsum pa'i ye shes ni/ /gshin rje ma yini 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'pho ba lta bu bde ba'i thabs/ /gsum ldan rkang pa gcig las so/ /snang ba gang du 'dod par ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad rang nyid 'gro/ /gtso bo'i rnam pa yi ni gzugs/ /slar yang sum cu bdun dag tu'o4med/ /sngags rnams kyi yig las byung ba/ /dpral ba'i dbus su shes par bya/ /sngon du bshad pa'i sngags la 'dir/ /gang zhig gang gi dang po'i yig /'di yi sngags kun rim pa yis/ /de ni de dang de'i 8shes bya/ /lhag ma thams cad mnyam pa ste/ /bsgom 9)pa dang ni bzlas pa mchog /thams cad yod min med pa'ang min/ /kun 'gro thams cad pa min pa'o/ /sgyu ma yis 57ni thams cad rmongs/ /mkhas pa sgyu ma nyid kyis grol/ /phan pa sgyu ma phan ye shes/ /sems bskyed 7pa yang phan pa'o / /de ltar na maḥ12nyi'i don to/ /mkhas pa lhag ma bde ba ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'bar 'gyur bas15/ /bde de rnam par snang mdzad kyi'o/ /gshin rje gnon pa'i rig ma stes/ /gshin rje ma de brjod par 'gyur/ /gang phyir srung 1geb 'di dran pas/ /dus kun du ni bya ba byas/ /snying ga dpral nya ba'i ye shes ni/ /gnyis med ye shes mtshan nyid do/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams don chen phyir/ /rgyud rnams kun ni bskyed pa'o/ /rgyud thams cad du gzhan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 41shedag byed yod ma yin519/ /rgyud 'di yi ni rnal 'byor 78—532

che6)ske/ /rgyud thams cad du dag byed yin/ /dkyil 'khor gtso mo gshin rje mas / /de nas slar yang bya ba yang / /mngal du zhugs las grol ba dang / /skyed ②pa dang ni 'pho ba gnyis/ /gshin rje ma dang rnam snang mdzad/ /der ni gzugs dang gzugs med 'gyur/ /bde dang sdug bsngal can ye shes/ /lha rdzas phyag rgyas dun)ro mnyam mo/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i go cha srung nya༄ba'i cho ga ste/ le'u bcwa (zhenabargyad pa'o// //de nas pad+ma gar dbang gi/ /go cha'i srung (6)ba bka' stsal pa/ /'dod chags me ni gsal bzhin pa/ /spyi bor 'gro ba stobs chen te/ /swā hā rtsu gi sngags yig dang / /hro oṃ rmongs ma'i sgyu tsho7)ma yis/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i gtso bo'o/ /kha yi pad+mar rmongs byed ma'ang (she/ /ro dang ro min can srung 99 cib/ /lce dang lce ni 'dus pa la/ /thig le de myang rnal 'byor pas/ /mchog 7tu dga' ba skyes pa na17/ /ye shes can med 8ldan pa'ang ho med/ /mi dang mi mo la bsten 8pas/ /'dul ba zhes bya rang sems so/ /dga' ba'i ngag gi tshogs rnams ni/ /chos sgrogs pa yi 15rgyu yis so/ /byang chub sems kyi bu ga ni/ /de ru dbugs ni rgyu ba'o/ /bu ga rnam pa sna tshogs bshad/ /de rnams su dbugs mngon rgyus so/ /bu ga kun du hro 0sbyin bya/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu zhi ba'o/ /oṃ 3 yaṃ zhing ste mgo 18po la mi 78—533

'gyur mchog las 91'du ba'o/ /rmongs pa yis ni srid sbyor ba/ /yang dag lam du rab 'dzud byed/ / des na 5rmongs byed mar grags te/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo 'joms ma'o/ /srid med srid pa mchog kyang med/ /de ni kha sbyar du brjod do / /sngags de nyid kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor sum cu bdun bdag nyid/ /gtso bo dpa' bo'am lha mo ste/ /spyi gtsug dang ni kha'i dbus su/ /thams cad du ni srung ri nibyed dang / /rtog pa tsam ni 'joms byed pa'o/ /pad+ma don dam pa'i ye shes/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub gzugs/ /kun rdzob shes byed shes bya ni/ /gar dbang phyug tu brjod pa nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzugs/ /byang chub rang gis thams cad rtogs/ /sprul pa kun du rmongs gyur pas/ /lha mo rmongs byed mar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma chos kyi 'byung gnas 'gyur/ /gar gyi dbang po rdo rje yin/ /dbang phyug lhan skyes shes bya ste/ /byang chub sems ni g.yo ba'o/ /rang bzhin med dang bde rtag ④nyid/ /de ni kha sbyar du brjod do5ci/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 56)bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug la sogs pa'i srung ba (dzodago cha'i sngags gtan la dbab 8)pa ste le'u ri9)bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas te ru ku'i srung bob/ /go cha slar yang bshad par bya/ /mgrin dang dpung par 'ong ba ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mgo bor ro/ /bo hunyeg ṭa he sngags mnyam med pa/ /'byung dang 'byung las byung la srung ⑫/ / hro hro 0kun du 78—534

bskyod ma'i sngags/ /de phyir shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /ho ni sems bdag nyid rnal 'byor/ /slar yang ru ni ngag hu)bdag nyid/ /ka /lus kyi ②rang bzhin nyid rnal 'byor/ /sa 'og sa steng mtho 'jig rten/ /bde ba'i thog mtha' dbus su ni/ /bo ṣa ṭa he na)rnams sa bon can/ /sgro hro 'og dang steng shes bya/ /srog gi rlung ni bskyod pa yin/ /gtong dang dga' ④ba la goms dang / /bum pa can gyi sbyor ba'i dus/ /de yi dus su 'khor lo ni/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid shes bya/ /de ltar dus ni bzhi rnams kyi/ /ji lta'i rim par de ⑤'dod do/ /sngags de nyid kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /mchod pa mchog tu rmad du byung / /de ltar rnam shes brgyad rnams kyi/ /gcig dang gnyis dang gsum dang lnga/ /le'u bzhi yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji lta'i rim pas rtogs pa'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni gsum pa yi/ /le'u ru ni byung ba dang / /bya ba le'u bzhi pa ru / /rgyud ni rang nyid bskyod pa dang / /de kho na nyid gdan skyes pa/ /slar yang gsum par brjod pa yin/ /bzhi pa ru ni gzhan gyi gdan/ /skyes pa ye shes pha rol 'gro/ /bsrung ⑥ba 'gro ba bzhi rnams kyi/ /lha dang mi dang 'dre dang ni/ /klu yi 'gro bar mkhas pa yis/ /shes bya kun du rgyu rnams kyi'o/ /de de'i rang bzhin ⑦dus rnams ni/ /bskal pa bzang por chud pa yil/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'grongs ④mi 'gyur/ /slar yang 'grongs med skye mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin shes par gyur nas ni/ /sems can rang gi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /lta ba bdun cu gnyis rnams ni/ /kun du skyod ma'i malas kyis so/ /nyan thos rnams kyi lta ba lnga/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi lta ba gnyis/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa pa yi bdun/ /dbu ma pa mchog rnams kyi nyastobargyad/ /bcu drug pha rol phyin rnams 78—535

kyil/ /gsang sngags theg pa'i tsho1sum cu drug /bdun dang brgyad pa'i gnyis kyis dman/ /kun kyang sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /rtsa yi kun spyod rtsa ba can/ /bla ma'i drin las shes par bya/ /he ru ka ma rtsa ba mdzad/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das dbus bzhugs/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 2las he ru ka la sogs pa'i srung ba'i go cha'i cho ga'i ri le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas rdo rje nyi ma yi/ /srung 4ba bshad par bya ba ni/ /rtsu rtsu ho yi sngags 'di yis/ /mig gi dbang po'i dbus su ste5ci/ /rtsu yig gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /lta ba thams cad mthong gyur pa'o/ /ye shes rnam shes mchi ma yis/ /'og dang steng du thim pa las/ /lta ba bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /dus gcig tu ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /mgrin pa'i bu snyog ru ni lnga/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje can du gnyis/ /bdun ni snying gar 7yang dag bshad/ /brgyad ni klad pa'i (8༄rgyas su'o/ /bcu drug gtsug tor du ni 'gyur/ /lte 9dkyil 'khor du 57sum cu drug /ma lus rang gi las kyis bskyed/ /rang gi lta ba 'dir mthong 'gyur/ /'di de bdag gi gdan yin te/ /sa gsum lta bur mthong ba yin/ /ho yig sems dpa' ma kun gyi/ /mtha' yas pa yi sangs rgyas zhing / /rdo rje nyi mas khyab par gyuranyu1/ /de phyir mig ni srung 51 byed pa'o/ /kun du skrag byed mas 'khyud pa/ /rtsu rtsu gsang sngags sgra sgrogs ma/ /skrag pa yi ge gnyis kyis ni/ /sdig pa thams cad 78—536

mthar byed pa'o/ /sum cu bdun bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbus su gnyis ni bsgom par bya/ /sngon gsang 0)sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /lta (kyernams kun du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /re re yi ni lta ba yis/ /de la srung chib byed par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma yis nam mkha' gang / /slar yang lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub/ /rnal 'byor ma ni lhan skyes gzugs/ /lhan skyes yi ge rnal 'byor ma/ /rnal 'byor ma yis ④lhan skyes zos/ /slar yang rnal 'byor ma za 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs can ma/ /gnas kyi gzugs ni rnal 'byor ma/ /byas dang byed po'ang de genyid do/ /bsgrub bya mthong bar (6)ster bar 'gyur/ /go cha'i yi ge sgom pa la'o/ /sgrub po ci dang ci 'dod pa/ /de rnams kyis (7)ni ster bar 'gyur/ /tshul 'di sgom (8)pa med pa yi / /sems can de rnams rmongs par 'gyur/ /yi ge bkod pa tsam gyis ni/ /las rgyal thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rdo rje nyi ma la sogs pa'i go cha'i srung (shespuba'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas rta mchog gi srung 7ba/ /thams cad bya ba byed dge ba'o/ /phaṭa haṃ sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /kun nas mgo dang rkang pa'i mthar/ /mdzod spu'i 11dbus su dgod bya ste/ /spyi gtsug dbus su rnal 'byor ma/ /mgo bor kun skrag ma shes nas/ /tshig kun dang ni mkha' zhes byar/ /gtum mo'i gsang 78—537

sngags phaṭa phaṭa ste/ /ye shes gdan dbang phyug mar 'dod/ /rta mchog ting 'dzin dag tu yang / /rnal 'byor dngos grub smos ci dgos/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'khor ba 1dral/ /slar yang mya ngan 'das bkas pa'o/ /ye shes zhes bya'i rnam rtog kyang / /sngags pas gnyis su med pas bkas/ /haṃ (kyeyig kun mkhyen yod min na/ /skye bo thams cad smos ci dgos/ / bkur sti nibyed pa yod pa dang ske/ /dbang po tshar gcod yod pa ste ra/ /rnal 'byor gtum mo'i yon tan ldan / /de ni bdud rtsir mngon par brjod/ /bde bcas the tshom med par ni/ /dbang po thams cad zos pas so/ /dkyil 'khor sngon du gsungs pa yi(de)/ /dbus su dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /sngags la sogs pa thams cad kyang / /kun gyis kun du bya ba'o56/ /las kyi bag chags rang gis bza'/ /phra mo'ang kun du bcom bar du'o/ /ngan pa thams cad sbar (7)byas na/ /ras bal ltar yang pha rol 'gro/ /de ni gtum byed mar shes bya/ /phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o / /zla bar brtsi tshon ba'i skar ma yis/ /skar ma'i bdag po snying rjes zhu/ /slar yang mdor bsdus bshad pa ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni drug rnams dang / /dpa' bo gnyis su byar med nyid/ /dgos pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis/ /re re'i gnas su shes par bya/ /der ni gar yang byed du gzhug /lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub mtshan nyid/ /lus can kun gyi bde ba ni/ /dbang gnyis dus las shes par bya/ /bug drug bum pa can byas pas/ /de dang 'dra ba'i bde thob 'gyur/ /lte ba'i 'og gi bu ga gsum / /de yi steng du gsum de bzhin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba gnyis gnyis te/ /go cha bcu gnyis der de bzhin/ /dbang po ri()yul gyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /dngos 78—538

po'i bdag nyid der gar byed/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi nyid 'thung 'gyur/ /zang zing khams rnams za ba ste/ /steng dang 'og tu mtshon ri1)bltas pas/ /lhan skyes bdag nyid rtsen par byed/ /rjes dran drug gi sbyor ba yis/ /sgrub pa po yis bya ba yin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rta mchog la sogs pa'i go cha'i srung tsho ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas gtor ma'i de nyid bshad/ /mthar gyis ji lta ba bzhin no/ /chos 'byung dbus su son par ni/ /ji lta'i cho gas gtor ma sbyin/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mkha' 'gro'i gzugs/ /slar yang go cha sogs pas bsrung (da/ /de'i yang ting nge 'dzin dmigs bya/ /pad+ma'i (47snod ni gzhag 95 bya ste/ /phyi dang nang bdag nyid du bya/ /a ba dhū 6)khrir skye gnas 'dri / /lte ba'i 'og dang steng bu ga /pad+ma'i snod du brtag par bya/ /nam mkha' lnga yi bdud rtsi ni/ /thams cad ro mnyam par bya'o/ /phung po go ku da ha na(2)/ /skye mched rnams ni sha kun te/ / sbar ba tso)bde ba'i sems kyis te/ /'dod chags me yis bsro ba'o / /sbyang ba mchog ni bdag nyid la'o/ /slar yang bdud rtsir byed pa ste/ /bsam gtan phyag rgya rgyun du der/ /sku gsum du ni byin gyis brlab/ /sngags bodang phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan nyurtadrang bya/ /rtse mo mdud byas nges par ni/ /gung mo rtse sbyar mtheb /2rdo rje/ /brtan par yang 78—539

dag btsir byas nas/ /dpral ba'i phyogs su yongs bzhag pas/ /bzlas shing bskyar bas 'khor bar bya/ /rkang pa mnan cing steng du blta/ /sngags pas de byas pa (1tshomachog sten/ /spyi bor pho yig sgra yis ni/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /snying gar 4phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag gnyis kyis/ /bskor 5ba mkha' 'gro ma'i de bde/ /oṃ ā ra gli hoshi/dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ7 badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki 8r+sā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ ri9 sh+ya hoḥ'i rdo rje thal mo gyen la bye11/ /mtshan mo phyed na gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa nyartes bhū 1 ta 1 bre ta pi shā tsor+sā 15bā pa sma 1phyir ḍā ka ḍā ki kyā da nyu ya i mi ba lo kṛ ṇ+ḍas 18sarba sidhisme 19sra 2 yats+tshan tu ya the baṃ ya the 17myu bhuñdza tha dzi gh+ra tha ri shespru risnyeb tha mā ti kra ma tha ma ma sarba kurtu ya sarlu khaṃ na bi shud+dha ye 57ma ma sā na hā yi ka da bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa 0swā hā/ sngags kyi 'jug pa ji srid du/ /bum pa can gyis gnas mi 'gyur/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 0'thob 'gyur te/ /dga' skyes bde ba'ang smon da ci dgos/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi gtor ston mo/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams la de bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /bla ma gtso bo ru ni bya / /rnal 'byor ma rnams ming dgang gang / /dpa' bo rnams kyi'ang sa de bzhin du / /de dang de la sha dbul da bya/ /myos byed bde chen ster ba'ori snyu /'khor lo mngon par gzung du bya/ /yang na sngags par zung du'o/ /gdan ni stag gi pags pa ste/ /ston mo mi yi pags 9par ro/ /snod chen rnams su btung ba dang / /sngags pa skra grol ba yis so/ /snod ni rnal 'byor mas shes bya / /yang na gzhon nu ma yis so/ / de bzhin )rnal 'byor ma rnams kyiri rke/ /78—540

'khor lo 0)dpa' bo rnams kyis te/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi gzhi dag rin)la/ /snod ni gzhon nu ma yis so/ /dar phreng dbu rgyan dag dang ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dri de bzhin/ /glu len gar byed sil snyan dang / /drug ldan ri sogs dang dman rnams dang / /gtor ma'i snod rnams thams cad ni/ /sngags pas shar gyi phyogs nas su/ /chang thams cad dang mchod pa yi/ /snod rnams der ni gzhag par bya/ /mchod bya mchod pa mchod pa'i rgyu/ /mchod pa byed sku po phan tshun du'o/ /'khor lo 5)rang gi slob ma byas/ /yang na mnyam gzhag 6)gzhan rnams so/ /sngags pas skal med thams cad dang / /mu stegs la sogs spang bar bya/ /'gro ba kun ni mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas kyis/ /a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ /sham bu/ sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ /snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol bar byos༄7/ /a re/ gang gis don dam la ni ma bsgoms pas/ /de yis nasangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin no/ /a re/ nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par shes par gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re / de la sogs pa thams cad ni/ /gang dang der ni blangs pa'o(9 nga yi rgyud dang rtogs 7pa yis/ /sngags pa'i gnang pas 3lhaklu blang bya/ /de la phyag ni byas nas su/ /gar dang glu yang bya ba yin/ /snod ni pad+ma'i phyag tu ni/ /rang nyid brtul zhugs tsho12can gyis dbul/ /pad+ma'i lag par gzung bya ste/ /de nyid kyis ni sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams phud chang bu/ /so sor bsdu bar bya ba yin/ /zos pa yi ni lhag ma yang / /'byung po thams cad la sbyin bya/ /ji 78—541

ltar yang dag 'byor pa yi1/ /de rnams la ni yon dbul bya/ /de ltar nyi ma re rer nabya/ /yang na zla ba zla bar ro/ /dam tshig bsrung phyir lo gcig la/ /nyi ma gcig ni bya ba'o/ /der ni sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad bklag(5) /bkra shis pa yi ngag kyang bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la mchod pa dang / /dpa' bo rnams la bza' dang btung ba khyod kyis drangs/ /khyod la rtag tu bsrung dang mchog gi 'byor pa dang / /yang na yid la 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par shog /skye ba kun du mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yib/ /grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro bar 'gyur bar gshog /dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni / /sdig pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur bar shog /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las gtor ma dang 'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan pa 6rab bshad de sku/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni thig gdab dang / /sbyin sreg 8thab dang de bzhin du/ /slob dpon rang nyid mchod bshad bya/ /slar yang sa gzhi cha mnyam la/ /dkyil 'khor khru ni brgyad pa ste/ /ri yi steng la sogs pa dang / /dag pa'i sa yi mthil du bya/ /der ni pus mo tsam du brko//slar yang mtho gang tsam brkos nas/ /chu yis dgang bar bya ba ste/ /ji srid du ni ma zad par/ /de srid du ni rtsa ba'i sngags/ /mkhas pas 'dir ni bzlas par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi khyim bya ste/ /skye ba 59)thams cad bsreg tshepar 78—542

'gyur / /der ni dkyil 'khor bri bya ste/ /thig gnyis kyang ni gdab par bya/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi logs gnyis su/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis gdab bya/ /slar yang de yi dbus btab pas/ /thig rnams drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de rnams dbus su de mnyam pa/ /slar yang de rnams su gdab bya/ /mdor na 'khor lo bzhi po la/ /nyis brgya 3)lnga bcu rtsa drug go/ /kun nas dum bu bcu drug las/ /tshon rtsi yis ni ri ②mo bya/ /lhag ma sgo yi tshad du ni/ /dbus ma'i pad+ma la sogs bya/ /'on kyang dbus kyi pad+ma der/ /sor ni bcu gnyis bya ba'o/ /'khor lo gsum ni bzhi po la/ /dum bu gsum gsum bya ba yin/ /dum bu re re la ni khru/ /gnyis gnyis mkhas rnams kyis shes bya/ /tshon sna lnga yi skud pa ni / /de phyir dkyil 'khor gnyis tshon)'gyur ro/ /sboms su sgo las nyi shur ni/ /gcig gis ma tshang tshad can no/ /dri zhim po dang dri spos kyis/ /ye shes thig skud la bdug bya/ /gtor ma chen po byin nas ni/ /phyi nas thig las 'dir brjod kyisasti/ /rdo rje ( phur bu sa gzhi la/ /mkhas pas spro ba yis 6ni bya/ /rang gi slob ma thig 'dzin gzhug /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis lte bar/ /sngags pa yis ni bzung (7)byas nas/ /steng du yang ni gdab par bya/ /de bzhin du ni gdab pa ni/ /g.yon skor (2)du ni bya ba'o/ /'jug pa dang ni 'byung ba na/ /gtor ma byin la bcag 6)par bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni brjod pa yis/ /ri mo bar snang la gdeg 0bya/ /phyi dang nang du shes pa yi/ /sngags pas bdud rtsi btung bar bya/ /sa ni nam mkhar nyustegashegs bya zhing / /slar yang de nyid du dgug bya/ /me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rdo rje'i gom pas gar bya'o/ /lag pas rdo rje gsor bya zhing / /ma sogs rnal 'byor ma dang rol/ /'di kun 78—543

gri gug mtshan ma rnams/ /dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis 1bya'o/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /slob dpon dri yis khrus byas pa/ /dri ma med bkrus legs bdugs pa'i/ /gos ni yongs su gyon nas ni/ /dril bu'i sgra ni rab bya zhing / /rnal 'byor ma rnams glu len dang / /sna tshogs sil snyan snod rnams dang / /ca co yi ni sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /dbang bskur ba ni sbyin bya zhing / /rang slob ma la phyi dang gsang / /rgyal po rkun mo sogs spangs pa'i/ /skye bo dang bral phyogs su bya / /'dir ni cho ga'i skyon mang pos/ /mnar med sogs su ltung (gyibar 'gyur / /zhi dang rgyas pa la sogs pa'i/ /sbyin sreg rme rnams kyi thab bya'o/ /skum po zhi ba yi ni thab/ /gru bzhi pa ni rgyas pa la/ /gru gsum pa ni dbang las la / /mngon spyod la ni zur drug pa/ /zur bdun pa ni bskrad pa la/ /sdang bar bya la gru brgyad pa/ /zur dgu pa ni rengs pa la/ /gsad 0pa la ni zur lnga ste/ /las thams cad la zur bcu pa/ /kha dog rang (gebadag sbyor bas so/ /rang gi bdag gyur mtshan ma ni/ /thab rnams kyi ni dbus su bya/ /'khor pad rdo rje dang gri gug /ral gri rin chen sna tshogs rdor/ /mda' gzhu de bzhin thab la ni/ /phreng ba de rnams su bya'o/ /khru gcig pa dang khru gnyis pa/ /khru phyed de yi phyed dang ni/ /slar yang khru gnyis gsum dang bzhi/ /lnga drug bdun dang brgyad dang dgu/ /khru bcu ru ni yang dag bshad/ /thab kun ji lta'i rim pas so/ /yam shing dang ni rdzas rnams dang / / sreg blugs me 57tog thams cad dang / /phyi nang bdag nyid sbyor rnams kyis/ /rang rang gi ni las 7bya'o / /mngon par brjod par 8bshad pa'i las/ /rtsa ba'i sngags sogs thams cad can/ /de yi 7sbyor ba'i cho ga'i las/ /rgyud rnams kun du shes 78—544

byed do/ /cung zad 'chad par 'gyur nyid du/ /rgyud thams cad kyi bshad par bya/ /skum po lte bar skyes pa'i thab/ /snying ga 0)ru ni gru bzhi pa/ /nor bu'i bu gar grwa ((drug pa/ /mgrin par grwa ni bdun pa ste/ /zur brgyad pa ni mgo bo la/ /zur dgu ru ni smin dbus su/ /gtsug tor du ni zur lnga pa/ /zur bcu pa ni dbral bar te/ /rlung las byung ba'i rtsa ba can/ /bsreg rdo rdzas khams rnams ④thams cad ni/ /rlung 'bab pa la bsreg par bya/ /de nyid dus su phyi rol gyi/ /blo ldan gyis las chung ngu'o/ /la la nā (57dang ra sa nā / /dgang gzar blugs gzar gnyis de bzhin/ /mar snod a ba dhū tsho tī ste/ /thab ni de'i bar (8)bar dag tu'o/ /las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg 99ni/ /'jig rten 'di la bya ba yin/ /der ni rdzas rnams thams cad kyi / /the tsom nyu1med par bsreg par bibya/ /dgang gzar khru gang du 'gyur te/ /rgyar ni sor mo bzhi pa las/ /der ni sor mo gnyis brko bya/ /mchu yi spug 32mo sor mo phyed/ /dbus su rdo rje pad+ma dang / /mchu spug 7rdo rje ldan pa can/ /rtsa bar rdo rje sor drug pa/ /yu ba'i steng du dgang gzar sogs/ /blugs gzar kyang ni de'i tshad la/ /steng du pad 'dab (2lta bu yin/ /gang gi thab 15rnams kyi ni 1 tshad/ /khru gang pa'am khru do pa/ /de'i phyed thur du brko bya ba/ /bcu po rnams la rab tu bshad/ /thog ma dang ni dbus dang mthar/ /sngags pas gang ba'i sreg blugs rtsonyedabul/ /me ni dgug bya de yang ni/ /ku sha'i bam po la gzhag 1rtabya/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil ni ri/ /sna tshogs mngon par bsngags nas dbulam/ /der ni nya phyis phor pa gsum/ /lo ma'i steng du gzhag 21par bya/ /'o ma'i snod ni yang bzhag rtenas/ /de nas gos ni de'i steng du'o/ /sa gzhir 78wa 545

drur (1)ba sbyin bya ba/ /sngon du kha mngon phyogs par ro/ /thams cad du ni g.yas phyogs su/ /der ni rdzas rnams gzhag (gepar bya/ /sa gzhi ④ri mo gsum bri ste/ /sgo gcig pa ni nub tu'o/ /'grub bya'i dngos kun thams cad dang / /rgyal po nas brtsams gzhug par bya/ /thams cad nye bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje bla ma la dbul du kyibya/ /drang srong phyag bzhi bsam bya ba/ /dbyug pa thab ⑤dang spyi blugs dang / /bgrang phreng lug la zhin pa yi/ /kha dog dmar po rnam bsam byam/ / oṃ e h+ye hi asna (65ye ro sarba sid dhim (7)pra yats+tsha dz+wa la dz+wa la hol/ ma hā ṛ (peṣi sarba de ba mu kha pū ri las smin sani hi to bha wa /974/ me lha 8spyan drang ba'i rka/snyesngags so/ /oṃ āḥpā 1 byi hu tā sa nā ya groṇ+ḍa dzo/ge / zhabs bsil gyi sngags so/oṃ baṃ ā tsa ma rna ṛ ṣa ye 15pra yats+tsha r+ghaṃ/ zhal yibasil gyi sngags so/ oṃ 8rgyu ḍā ka 3rjeḍā ki ni 2 nyes ma yā: da dā mi hūm̐ rtsu ro ro swā hā/ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /oṃ de ba ṛ ma'i pa ra ma sau ga ta kā 2ru ṇi kā tsho 3 dzaḥrgyu bo hoḥs ha ha da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa dz+wa la dz+wa la ha na ha na rna rtsu hūm̐/ me dgyes par byed pa'i sngags so/ /rdzas thams cad la oṃ gyi yi ge dang āḥrinyadang dbus su ming dang yang dag par ldan pa dang mthar rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa 2 kyi yi ge dang swā hā sbyin par bya'o/ /rdzas thams cad kyi sngags so/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo dang bcas pa/ /drang srong snying gar tsobasgom par bya/ /dam tshig me ni ro las rdzogs/ /ye shes me lha de dang mnyam/ /yang na 'bar bar bsgom 27pa ste/ /zhi ba la sogs mdog tu'o/ /me ni de ru thim bsam bya/ /sngags pas 'od kyi khyad par ni/ /so so'i snang ba'i mer shes bya / /rnal 'byor me sa )lha'i bdag nyid kyi/ /gnyis med rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis / /mkhas pa yis ni bya ba yin/ /nang bdag nyid ye shes gang 'dra/ /phyi 78wa 546

rol yang ni de 'drar bya/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi rgyud don dang / /ye shes tshogs rdzogs bya phyir ro/ /der ni tsa ru gyo)bsgrub bya ste/ /me la bshos su dbul bya zhing / /cung zad bdag nyid kyis spyad dang / /sbyin bdag rnams la'ang sbyin par bya/ /gzhon nu ma (gyemadzes chagar byed dang / /sna tshogs sil snyan rnams dkrol byali/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan rnams kyi/ /skye bo chen po rtsen (gebazhin dang / /me tog spos sogs kyis spro bar/ /'dus pa'i dbus su bya ba'o//tam bu la kun thams cad la6)/ /dgyes byed sbyin par bya ba yin/ /lhag ma gos dang so rtsi dang / /gang ba'i sreg blugs ⑦phyin par bya/ /rdo zho dang gral rin)so rtsi dang / /zhal ⑨bsil ba ni mjug tu'o/ /ye shes me ni gshegs gsol te//sngags brjod pa yi mabashos gsol bya/ /oṃ asna nyamayi sarba san to ṣa ṇi 32ku ru me ya thā kā le sirnyi dā gats+tsha 32tu rtsu r+ghaṃ swā hā/ me chagashegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /dman dang chang sogs gang cung zad/ /de thams cad ni bzod pa mdzod/ /kun gyi lhag ma yi ni 'brusnyi/ /thams cad thab tu bsreg par bya/ /zhes bya dkyil 'khor thig mdor bstan/ /sbyin sreg tsothab dang cho ga mchog /slob dpon mchod bya yang dag par/ /rdo rje 'chang du byas nas ni/ /mu tig gser dang rin chen rnams/ /glang rta sa gzhi yul ljongs dang / /bran pho 3 tshobran mo 'khor rnams dang / /chung ma phun sum tshogs kun dang / /gos zung du ma rnams dang ni/ /dgyes pa'am sa la gang cung zad/ /bdag tu lta ba dang bral bas/ /dbul bya gtso bo zhi bar gyis/ /bdag nyid dngos po thams cad kyis / /phyag byas nas ni dbul bar bya/ /me tog spos sogs thams cad rnams / /ston pa'i mdun du dbul bar bya/ /maṇ+ḍal mdun du bya ba ni/ /de 78—547

nas dgu yi bdag nyid 'di/ /dbus su bla ma rdo rje ste/ /mdun du thams cad mdzes ma ste/ /byang du dga' ba'i mchog ma dang / /nub tu shin tu rtse ma ①dang ske/ /lho ru rol napa'i rdo rje ma/ /snying rje la sogs grwa bzhir ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa gu ru pā 5)de bh+yaḥ sarba sa 4to pa kā ra ṇa ya swā hā/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams rang ming ni/ /brjod bya oṃ thog swā hā mtha'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i 5rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las dkyil 'khor dang sbyin sreg ⑥dang slob dpon mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba ste le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa ni/ /sgrol byed rab gnas bshad par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 7rgyud rgyal du/ /nye na bar mkho ba thams cad rnams/ /slob dpon gyis ni rtag gzung bya/ /bya bar 'os pa gzhan de bzhin/ /'jig rten smod 9pa bsrung phyir yin/ /slar yang rang bzhin las skyes pa/ /rab gnas sgyu ma yis gzung bya/ /lugs ma 'am ni thang ga 'amatshe/ /rang gis shigazugs nyugeni phyi rol spro/ /gang gi dus nyid la 'byung ba/ /gang gang lha ni lhag gnas pa'i/ /de yi gzugs ni de'i dus kyi'o/ /bde ba'i bdag nyid spros pa ste/ /sa bon gang gi dang po'i yig /'char ba dbugs rgyu ba'i bdag nyid/ /rlung dang rnam shes 'dus las so/ /de sna tshe dus su gang gi gzugs/ /phun sum tshogs kun byed pa 1 yin/ /gnyis med ye shes bral min la/ /lugs ma rab tu gnas pa med / /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las/ /'khor ba pa yi rab gnas bya/ /78—548

thar bde mngon par 'dod rnams kyi/ /'di la bde ba'i bde ba che/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dgar gnas la/ /de las byung bar bya ba yin/ /lugs ma'am 1)ni thang sku la 'am(mi/ /yang dag rig pas ro rnams byug /bdud rtsi lnga yis rdzas rnams la/ /bsreg (ge par gyur ④cigs khrus bya'o/ /blo dang ldan pas bum pa gzhag⑤ /lha ni dkyil 'khor ba dang bcas/ /dam chos la sogs thams cad rnams / /chos kyi 'byung gnas nang du ste/ /bzhugs pa gang gi gnas rnams su / /dus thams cad du rab gnas pa'o/ /e yi yi ge'i gnas bsgrubs nas/ /baṃ yig rdo rje sems dpa' can/ /ma yig rab tu gnas pa der/ /bzhi 96)pa thog ma med snar grags/ /thos pa gcig pa sngags kyi don/ /brda yi yi ge'i sngags can no/ /dus su bcom ldan 'das rang gis/ /rab bzhugs rab tu mi gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tshig /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi tshig rnams kyis97kyi/ /rnal 'byor ma'i gtso ri rigazhan gyi min/ /bha ga rnams su rgyud lnga rnams/ /bya ba la sogs bla med mthar / /bzhugs pa de ltar du ni ci/ /rab tu gnas pa'am 99ske mi gnas pa'o/ /sems can bsgral ba byas nas ni/ /rab tu gnas pa rgyud kun du'otshe/ /gang tshe lhag mos rnal 'byor ma'i/ /rgyud du gnyis med rab tu gnas/ /las dang las bya gnyis byas nas/ /'on kyang rang gis rig pa can/ /rang gis rig pa'i ye shes che/ /rang gis rig pa'i bdag nyid lha/ /rang gis rig pa'i rang bzhin las/ /rab gnas de ni rab tu bsngags11/ /skye bo rnams la snying brtse bas / /gzhan yang de bzhin rab smra bya/ /yang dag ye shes dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha yi rnam rtso par dag pa'o/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis phyag rnams ni/ /rgyud dag 78—549

par ni rnam par brjod/ /phyag bzhi dgod 0)pa la sogs pa/ /bzhi po rnams ni dag par 'dod/ /zhal rnams dag pa'i dngos po ni/ /lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub bcu drug /bcu bdun pa'i zhal yid du bshad/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das zhabs gnyis/ /thams cad rgyan gyi dag pa ni/ /chos dang chos pa'i skye rnams so/ /lhag ma 'jig rten khams kyi ni/ /rnam dag gsal dang mi gsal ba'odus / /rtsa ba'i sngags sogs dag pa yang / /theg pa thams cad don ston pa'ol/ /rdo rje pad+ma sogs thams cad/ /'dir ni mngal skyes brjod pa po'o / /dkyil 'khor dag pa thams cad kyang / /chos bsdus ston pa po yin no/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rnam dag pa/ /'khor los sgyur ④ba bcu gnyis so/ /cha shas bcu drug rnams kyi bar/ /dur khrod dag par shes par bya/ /rgyud sang bdag las byung ba de/ /thams cad dag par shes par bya/ /kun mkhyen ye shes can thams cad/ /de yi dag pa rimangon brjod pa'o/ /rdzas 'du shes nyid dang ye shes / /so so'i ye shes smra rnams kyi/ /ming dzormebarjod pa yi dag pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i skye 97da'agro kun/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgyu ma'i ngo / /gsungs pa rang gis rig ye shes/ /gang dang der ni mngon brjod pa'o/ /sgyu ma'i 8grub mtha'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las kun shes bya/ /man ngag gis ni bgrod bzhin pa/ /so so'i 9)mtshams la bde ba che/ /de tshe'i dus su dag pa gang / /sangs rgyas spyod yul las de dag /de phyir rtsa ba'i gsang sngags kyang / /bde ba 'dod la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yi ge re rer btags pa las/ /dngos po'i gzugs kyi 7de dag 'gyur/ /phag mo'i gsang sngags nyid bshad pa/ /dngos po thams cad de'i dag pa'o/ /dbang po 78—550

dang yul mi bden parasti/ /ro mnyam de nyid sbyor rnams kyi/ /chos kyi sku can dag par 'gyur/ /ngag ni longs spyod rdzogs sku can/ /sems ni sprul pa'i sku yi ste/ /lus ni lhan skyes sku can no/ /dri med la sogs slar yang der/ /bzhi rnams kyi yang dag par 'dod/ /go cha'i sngags kyi dag chen ni/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi spyod pa'o/ /snying po dang ni nye snying du/ /kha sbyor rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'o / /'byung dang 'byung las byung 'dus pa/ /gtor ma'i sngags kyi dag par 'gyur / /gnod mdzes sngags kyi dag pa (2)gang / /rnam rtog kun la phur 'debs pa'o/ /sna tshogs las kyi dag pa gang / /de yi dag pa don dam can/ /khams thams cad kyi lha rnams ni/ /pags 9 nodang sha sogs dag par 'gyur/ /'dir mang 0smras pas ci bya ste/ /bde ba thams cad rnam dag pa'o/ /gang gang (pedabang po'i lam (nyarnams su/ /gang gang de rtsode'i rang bzhin gyis/ /mchog tu phan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /thams cad sangs rgyas rang bzhin mnos98)ske/ /dag pa mchog tu shes bya ste/ /gzhan gyi dag ⑨pa mi smra'o/ /dbang phyug la sogs lta bar ni/ /mdor bsdus dag par shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du/ /de ni 'grub 'gyur gzhan du min/ /byang chub lam du gnas pa gang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dngos po can/ /de yi ⑩ma rig mngon skyon gyis/ /dbang phyug la sogs su blta'o/ /de 31phyir rang gis rig rang bzhin/ /rnam dag 'di ni bshad pa yin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las/ bcom ldan 78—551

'das zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa dang de bzhin du rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas phyag rgya lhan cig skyes/ /byed rnams mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /mi phyed ma sogs rtsa rnams la'ang 1/ /bzhi yis lhag pa bshad pa yin/ /mi phyed ma dang phra gzugs ma/ /bzang mo g.yon ma g.yon phyogs ma/ /rus ri sbal skyes ma sgom pa mo/ /dbang ma skyon ma non ma ma/ /spyi lam dang ni rgyu sbyin 'tsho ma/ /dngos ma su ma na (5)de bzhin/ /la la nā 6dang ra sa nā4)/ /a ba dhū risatā spro ba'i ngag /pra ban dro ma 95grub ma dang / /rgan mo skye bo kun mthun 7ma/ /'dar ba mo dang snying po ma/ /ngang pa sum skor 'dod ma klu/ /gtum mo bdud kyi bu mo dang / /zla ba nyi ma me rā hu11/ /sum cu rtsa drug rtsa rnams la/ /re re la ni bcu gnyis te/ /thams cad dbye bas phye ba ni/ /slar yang phyag rgya mdor bstan pa'o/ /sor mo gcig ni bstan bya ste/ /de yi sor mo gnyis bstan bya/ /'og dang steng du mnyam par gnasanyurta/ /slar yang mthe bong bstan par bya/ /'di rnams rtsa ni thams cad rnams/ /'og dang steng du mnyam rengs pa'o /thams cad mkhyen pas 'gro bya mchog /sna tshogs rim pas shes par bya/ /de yi mthe'u chung rab bstan bya/ /de dang yang dag gnas byed pa'o/ /gang gi ming med nyunyeston pa na/ /de yi rab tu ston skopa ster/ /rdo rje nyi ma he ru ka /brkyang tshem snying ga'i 15pad+mar ro/ /gang gi sdigs mdzub hūṃ tshoston pa na/ /gung mo rab tu bstan 12par bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i rab sbyor bas/ /bde ba steng du 'phang bar bya/ /gang gi dpral bar ston pa na/ /de yi dar dpyangs rab 78—552

bstan bya/ /rang gis rig pa'i bde ba der/ /phyag rgya dang bcas 'ching bar 'gyur / /gang gi 'khor lo ston pa na/ /de yi sa gzhi rab bstan bya/ /gtsug tor dang ni lter 'gro ba/ /lag pa gnyis kyis rengs par bya/ /gang gi mig ①ni ston pa dang ②/ /de yi me dulong rab bstan bya/ /lha rdzas dbang po rnams kyi ④rgyus/ /'od sa)gsal ba ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang gi lto bar rdeg (6)byed pa / /de yi lte bar (perab bstan bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du/ /rnam shes brgyad po snang bar 'gyur/ /gang gi nam mkha' ston pa na/ /de yi nyi ma rab bstan bya/ /stong nyid snying rje yang dag par/ /rtsa yi rnal 'byor nyid kyis mthong / /gang gi khro gnyer ston pa na/ /de yi mtshams kyi mtha' bstan bya / /bdag nyid yang dag sbyor rol cing / /rang gis rjes su myong ba shes/ /gang gi chu bo ston pa na/ /de yi rgya mtsho rab bstan bya/ /sa gcig gi ni rab sbyor bas/ /thams cad sar ni rab tu bsngags/ /gang gi 8)pus mo ston pa na/ /de yi rkang pa rab bstan bya/ /bde 'gror 'gro ba'i dus su ni/ /dbang po'i dngos po de 'gro'o/ /gang gi nu ma ston pa na/ /de yi gdan ni rab bstan bya/ /bde ba longs spyod bdag nyid skyes/ /kun nas srid pa 'dzag bar du'o/ /gang gi dpung pa ston pa na/ /de yi lag pa rab bstan bya/ /'bar ba (9)dbyug pa bzhin snang la/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsreg par bya/ /gang gi brla ni ston pa na / /de yi gsang ba rab bstan bya/ /gzhu yi dbyug pa'i rnam pa'i srog /dbu ⑩ma rnams su'ang thim pa'o/ /gang gi lce ni ston pa na/ /de yi rkan ni rab bstan bya/ /gtum mo thams cad rtsa ru ni/ /bsdus nas rnam par gnas pa yin/ /gang gi mchu ni ston rmolhapa na/ /de yi kos ko rab bstan bya/ /78—553

thams cad chos nyid brjod med pa/ /dbang po kun gyi dran pa bral/ /gang gi nyanyesor mo'i rtse ②ston pa/ /de yi sen 9bamo rab bstan bya/ /srid pa'i rtse mor ④bde ba'i gzugs/ /gcod par nges par mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang gi skra ni ston pa na/ /de yi phreng ba rab bstan bya/ /g.yo can sems can gyi ni ste(5)/ /ye shes gzugs can du blta'o/ /gang gi spyi gtsug ston pa na/ /de yi rkang mtheb kunarab bstan bya/ /nor bu'i skud 9)༄pa bzhin du srog /dbu mar 'ong ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang gi mgrin pa ston pa na/ /de yi skye ba rab bstan bya/ /spyi blugs bdud rtsi ji lta bar78kyi/ /pad+mar skye 'gro thams cad mthong / /gang gis tho)nyi ma ston pa na/ /de yi nam mkha' bstan par bya/ /snying ga 7las byung 'jig rten kun/ /mchog tu zag med las shes 'gyur/ /gang gi rtsoms ni ston pa na/ /rkang pa'i mthil ni rab bstan bya/ /pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra'i chu yis ni/ /bdud rtsi'i myu gu 'dzag par 'gyur/ /gang gi mur gong 8ston pa na/ /de yi mkhur nyusnyeb rab bstan bya/ /sems can kun gyi rtsa rnams kyi0/ /nus pas nam mkha'i gnas rnams su'o/ /gang gi ling ga ston pa na/ /de yi rlig pa rab bstan bya/ /'gyur med 'gyur bar 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de ni rlig mtshams phyag rgya 8skyes/ /gang gi spyi blugs ston pa na/ /ri bo de yi rab bstan bya/ /ri las thur mdu chu bo bzhin/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni 'dzag par 'gyur/ /bud med gang zhig rna bar reg /rgyab kyi rgyud ni rab bstan bya/ /gang gis lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub/ /thos pa'i spyod yul du 'thob 8'gyur/ /gang gi tsogos ni ston pa na / /de yi tshon rtsi rab bstan bya/ /chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin du/ /skad cig gis ni bdag med mthong / /gang zhig so yis mchu 'dzin ma0/ /so ni 78—554

krig krig bstan par bya/ /bza' ba thams cad med pa nyid/ /bag chags stobs kyis rnam par 'phel/ /gang gi lce ni bskyod pa na/ /za ba'i lag pa rab bstan bya/ /bde ba lho)kun gyis (0tshim pa ni/ /don yod pa las 'thob par 'gyur / /gang gi lag pa'i mkhrig zhum ston/ /de yi thal gong rab bstan bya/ /srog gi rlung rnams la brdung ④ba/ /bum can 'khrul (snye'akhor sogs kyis so/ /gang gi rtsib 0logs ston pa na⑦/ /de yi mchan (lde)khung rab bstan bya/ /nang du lhan cig skyes pa dang / /snying rje la yang rig (7pa'o/ /gang gi lag pa'i dbus reg pa/ /lag pa'i rgyab ni bstan par bya/ /bdag gis gzhan dang rang gi dus / /mchog ma kye he mi shes pa'o/ /gang gi rgod 7pa ston pa na/ /de yi du ba rab bstan bya/ /mchog tu gnyis med zhugs pa las37/ /'dod chags 'dod chags bral ba'ang nyams/ /gang gi lhonyagar ni ston pa na/ /de yi glu 3steni rab bstan ④bya/ /khams gsum thams cad sgyu ma ru/ /gnyis kyi dngos po las mthong 'gyur/ /gang gi keng rus ston pa na/ /de yi rtse mo rab bstan lho bya/ /rtsa gsum po ni 'bar ba yis/ /'chi ba blu ༅bar 'ong ba yin3 sna/ /de ltar phyag rgya sum cu drug /phyag rgya'i lan ni de bzhin mchog /spun dang sring mor spyod par 8ni/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lor (sheshes par bya/ /rab gtum rigs kyi bdag mor ni/ /gnas kyi gtso mor shes par bya/ /rab tu gsal ba'i mthar gyur gzugs / /srid pa'i rgya mtshor dz+nya )'byung bar 'gyur/ /ji nga )srid gnyis su med spyod yul/ /g.yo ba'i chos kyang shes par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma tshogs ma lus pa//lhan cig skyes pa'i rgya mtshor 'dus/ /rab gtum yi ge tsho mishes par bya thams cad bud med sgyu ma'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya kun gyis na 'dun pa yin )/ /rdzu 'phrul 78—555

rkang pa'i rang bzhin du/ /gsungs pa'i de ①bzhin ma lus pa/ /de ni rdzu 'phrul rkang par 'dod/ /phyag rgya'i brda ni ma lus pa/ /rnal 'byor ma bskyed ②mtshan nyid do/ /sngon bshad chung ngu ( skabade mchog gi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus su ste((no/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /sngags 'di thams cad rnal 'byor ma'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs bcu gnyis kyil/ /dus sbyor chu srin la sogs te/ /rab gtum la 56༄sogs nyi shu bzhi/ /dus de rnams su 'byung ba yin/ /skad cig yud tsam la sogs pas/ /thams cad kyi ⑦ni 'pho ba gcig /shin tu phra dang rags 8rnams kyi/ /skye bo rnams kyi dus kyis ni/ /(gelor 'gyur ba yi 7tshad kyis ni511/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor ma rnams rtsis/ /kha ra sogs su dus byas nas/ /ldog pa gnyis dag gis ni mtshon/ /gnyis dag bcu yis bsgre 512byas pa/ /lo yi chu tshod de bzhin no/ /brgyad cu rtsa lngas lhag pa'i brgya/ /chu tshod lnga la shes par bya/ /nyi ma gcig gi tshad phortekyang ni/ /nam mkha' mig dang 1gelag pa mig /zla ba gcig gi tshad kyang ni/ /mkha' mkha' ro dang dus tshod ro1ge/ /lo gcig gi ni tshad kyang ni/ /mkha' stong mig dang bug tsode bzhin/ / bug pa dang ni ri bo'o/ /tsomakha' 'gro ma kun shes par bya/ /gsang sngags kha sbyor bdag nyid de1snye/ /rtsa ba'i sngags rnams kyi ni yang / /rkang pa gnyis gnyis mnyam par ni/ /rnal 'byor ma'i de 4)rkang pa gcig /de rnams las ni lhag gyur gang / /hūṃ phaṭa la sogs spang bar bya/ /oṃ tri na (2 bhu maḥnistob shrī ṇa ba ri rka dz+ra pa ḍā tsho lhan ka nisnye'i ma ba hā ṇa bī sgonyeya ra rtsu bī r+ghaṃ rī du 9phaṭa shwa phaṭa rā swā ya hā hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍi ru rte rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/zhes bya ba ni sngags so/ /kha dog nag mo phyag bzhi ma/ /skra grol 'jigs par 78—556

mdzad pa mo/ /lha mo shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /lhag ma sngon lho)bshad mtshan nyid do/ /lha mo 'di rnams thams cad ni/ /slar yang rtag tu rgya mtsho mnyam/ /rab mchog bde ba thob pa na/ /dgos pa mang po yang dag rig /ye shes zla ba'i rang bzhin du/ /'di ni 'char dang nub pa yin(snye/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nga'i 'od gzugs gang / /'od zer mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma/ /'od zer zhes bya rab bcings pa'ang zhu)/ /ye shes 'bab par rab tu nus/ /ri mo'ang linam mkha'i dbus rnams su/ /bgrod bya rang gi ma las skyes/ /de ltar rab gtum ma'i yon tan/ /rab mchog la sogs su mtshon bya/ /dus thams cad du kun spyod pa/ /sngags las byung ba shes par bya/ /mchog gi dngos grub rgyu yis ni/ /'du ba rnal 'byor mar rab gsungs/ /dngos grub rmi lam du ster ma/ /stes na dus kyis shes par bya/ /las ni gang dang gang 'dra ba/ /de dang de 'dra'i 'bras bu ste/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel nyid pas/ /rang nyid rnal 'byor pas skye ⑤'gyur/ /rgyu med cing ni 'bras bu med/ /mngon sum mngon sum min de bzhin/ /'di 'dra'i bden pa smra rnams kyi/ /tshad ma'i bstan bcos las shes bya/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las/ rab tu gtum mo bdag po'i dkyil 'khor du rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo rnams kyi phyag rgya'i brda yis gnas pa'i mtshan (6)nyid kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i spyod yul gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //78—557

de nas gtum mig ma'i phyag rgya/ /rgyud gzhan na med bshad par bya/ /mig gi brdar ni shes bya ste/ /'di thams cad kyang kha sbyar yin/ /btsums pa dang ni ma 1btsums pa/ /g.yas dang g.yon dang g.yas 'gro dang / /gyen du bskyod dang sna rtser dang / /sar lta dngos po'i mig can dang / /khro dang zhum dang mthun (5)bud med/ /bu dang gnyen dang spun rnams dang / /gti mug zhe sdang chags phrag na dog /skyon dang nga rgyal cher rlom dang / /'dod dang snying rje glen pa dang / /sgyu mar lta dang ring du lta/ /'gro dang bsam gtan phyed phyed dang ske/ /thams cad phye cadang dga' ba dang / /tshad (snyedang nad dang g.yul ngo dang ske/ /chos dang bcas par lta ba mchog /gal te sum cu drug lta rdo rab/ /'di nyid rnal 'byor mas ster na/ /de ri nyid kyi ni phyag rgya'i lan/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis rtag sbyin pa/ /me long chu dang mchod pa dang / /ral gri mar me mthe bong nadang / /nam mkha' pad+ma ku mu da(pe/ /mda' dang zla ba nyi ma dang ske/ /nor bu mu tig byi 1 ru dang / /bzhu ba'i gser dang dra nyuheb dang / /'bar ba grib ma ras bal dang / /bla ma rta glang sa ra bha/ /gar dang skrag dang 'dar ba dang / /'khrig pa rtsod smra nyu༄nye bar dang / /gtor ma ri nyunyemo dkyil 'khor dang / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /gsad 8pa dang ni bskrad rnams kyisanyuge/ /lta ba ru ni bshad gyur pa/ /brda ni sum cu rtsa drug poyi/ /ji lta'i rim pas sbyin par bya/ /'di rmo 47nyid rnal 'byor pa'i 'brel pahunye/ /de rnams dgos pa bshad par bya/ /zla ba'i rgyu bar son pa'i srog /g.yon par rgyu ba yi ni mchog /sum cu rtsa drug sems 'bab pa/ /de rnams ngo bor shes par bya/ /mig gi phyag rgya gang 'dra bar/ /de 'dra'i srog 37ni rgyu bar bya/ /78wa 558

mgo la sogs pa'i tshigs kun du/ /rtsa rnams gnas ni bsgrubs 0)byas nas/ /mi phyed ma sogs steng 'og tu/ /der ni blta ba chen po bya/ /de ltar bdun cu gnyis shes bya/ /phun sum tshogs kun 'thob par 'gyur/ /gtum mig rnal 'byor ma'i bdag mo/ /snang ba tshar gcod mdzad ma yin/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos su yang / /rnal 'byor ma kun shes 'gyur ba/ /gtum mig rnal 'byor ma rtag tu/ /brtson 'grus rdzu 'phrul rkang pa gnyis(2)/ /gtum mo'i rnam par rtog kun la/ /mig gi lta ba za ba yin/ /g.yo ba'i sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /sems gcig tu ni 'ching ba yin/ /tho co'i (bsgyu spyod 'jig rten du/ /'joms pa phyag rgya mkha' 'gro skyes/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam par(4ni/ /long med par ni gnyis med byed/ /gnyis med mig ni 'dir de nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni snang ba (༄byed/ /rtsa rnams thams cad rab tu ston/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /tshul 'di bsgom par bya ba yin/ /gtum mig ma ni thabs ldan pa/ /sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid can/ /de yi tshul ni 6)mngon brjod pas/ /thams cad byang chub rang bzhin can/ /sngags kyi yi ge las skyes pa/ /kun spyod rtsa 97༄yi bdag nyid can//de yi ji ltar kha dog gzugs/ /rab gtum rnal 'byor ma yi'o/ /oṃ sha dzā ta sbyo sa ṅka ha ṭa sra dhī ne ṣa tā ṇa ya lha r+ghaṃ ra hūm̐ bā pha ya ṭa rtsu pha hūm̐ ṭa pha swā 981ṭa hā phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa spyi (4)ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gang ba'i ri yi gnas su yang ske/ /rab tu gtum mo dus kun skyes/ /zla ba nya la dpral ba ru/ /ri bo chen por zla ba 'char/ /'bar ba 'dzin par gtum mig ma/ /rā hu yis ni zas su byas/ /tshes gcig tu ni yang dag bshad/ /nyi ma'i rjes 'gror nges 78—559

bshad pa'o/ /de ltar rnal 'byor ma re re'i/ /rang gi zhing du ming ①rgya che/ /re re yi yang nyi shu bzhi/ /slar yang gnas dang nye gnas so/ /bsam gtan sngags kyi bzlas pa'ang ②med/ /yi ge las byung spangs pa yin/ /dus dang dus min ngo bo'i bdag /rtsu phaṭa yi ges 'dod par gyis/ /yi ge las byung ba'i gzugs kyi/ /ho yi rdo rje'i rdo dbadud rtsi 'byung / /spun gyi spyod par tsum ④pa gang ske/ /'jug dang ldog par byed pa mo/ /snying ga'i (ge'akhor lor shes bya ste / /mig gi rang bzhin can snying gnyunye /snying gar stiganas rang ⑧rnal 'byor ma / /gtum mo lte ba'i steng nas 'bar/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las / /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs / /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po (9kelas gtum mig ma'i mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya dang bdag po'i rang bzhin gyi cho ga zhes bya ba ste le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /ji lta'i cho gas brda'i yig ge'o'i/ /rnal 'byor 'khor ba'i 'ching ba las/ /shes nas myur du nges par grol/ /ḍā dā li ka /nā ma dang nyunyerna pi ṣi lta'oge/ rā dzi kā/ ba ṭabla 0kyi pi ṭa ka /28/kun tu ruski/ ka ra tshig ra/ sil+la kai /swa tsoyo bhu/ ka stu ri kā/ ha 8ho hu)sa ma/ bol+las )/ /lko loshugle/ kā 3deli nya dza raṃ/ shā li shī raṃ bus pya kai/ pi skṛ ④ba rna byadzi rna/ mā la tin dha rna/ rat+na busam+bha baṃ/ go/ ku/ da/ ha/ na/bil/ su( 9/ shu/ ra/ ma/ de ltar rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /de bzhin 78wa 560

dpa' bo spun rnams brda/ /rnal 'byor ma de'i dgongs pa ni0)/ /kha yis rjod (5)pa byed par 'gyur/ /skyes bu/ rnal 'byor ma/ bud med/ chang (mi/ sha /lce / pa khu ba/ cang te'u/ bud med kyi/ 'khrig ④pa/ khu ba/ khrag /sha las skyes/ khrag /bud med kyi gcin/ bshang ba/ ling ga /pad+ma/'dus pa'am⑤/ skal ldan/ skyes (6)gnyis kyi sha /shi ba'i ro/ /rgyal po'i skyes bu/ /dur khrod/ nya'i sha /bya'i sha /g.yul ngo'i khrag /ba lang / khyi/glang po che/ rta/ mi/ bshang ba/ gci ba/ khu ba/ khrag /rkang mar/de ltar yang ni brda yi lan/ /sngags pas rtag tu shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor dngos po shes rnams kyi/ /dus rnams kun tu bskyed pa ni/ /sprul pa sems can sgrol ba po/ /zhing dang zhing du skye bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni zhu ba'i khams / /sum cu rtsa drug grangs kyang ni/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /nam mkha' dang ni ye shes khams/ /de'i yang khams ni drug drug 'gyur/ /mngon pa'i gzugs sogs shes mthar ro/ /nges par bshad don smra ba po'i/ /rang bzhin gyi (7ni brdar shes bya/ /re re'i bar du lha mo ni/ /'od ldan ye shes gzugs can no②/ /sum cu rtsa drug khams rnams kyi/ /'char ba'i dus mtha' mkha' spyod ma/ /ye shes 'od zer de bsgrubs nas/ /bde ba kun gyi gnas la bzhugs / /gos kyi 6)mtha' nas bzung nas ni/ /gnad dang gnad du rtse bar bya/ /ye shes kun rdzob spangs pa las/ /bsgom 7pa'ang rnam nyustortog bdag nyid do/ /rdo rje sa 'og sbyor bdag nyid/ /rtsa 8thams cad ni gzhig par bya/ /rnon por sreg pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /mkhas pas 'od ldan yi ge'o/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ste/ / au then nyertaganas su de bzhin du'o/ /dkyil 'khor 78—561

'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /lha yi bdag mo mchog bsgom bya/ /gsang sngags bden pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /sna tshogs yi ge rnams dbus son/ /sum cu rtsa bdun lha rnams ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid nyid/ /oṃ kai bi kā da la yu mā ta lā lidzi bha ha ra bā ṇa ya u na rtsu grwa hūṃ ya phaṭa (mi pha rtsu ṭa pha ④su ṭa hā phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ pra bhā shewa tī ye r+ghaṃ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa (yeswā hā/ kha dog gzugs ni sngon bzhin no/ /rang gi 'od kyis rnal 'byor 'grub/ /oṃ ⑦yig phyi mo 'byung ba'i bdag /srog gi rlung ni bskyod cing bskyod(kye/ /skar ma'i bdag po kun mkhyen rnams / /dbang po sogs kyi'ang spangs pa yin/ /ya yig dang ni a yig gzugs / /rkang pa'i mtha' dang mgo bo can/ /nā da tsam la thams cad brten(9ra / /rang 'byung ri chos brjod pa yin no/ /de ltar yi ge bzhi rnams ni/ /chos kyi sku la sogs pa'ang yin/ /mi ni yid de'i cha'i ye shes/ /de yod pas ni dpyod pa ste/ /'jig rten dbus dang sa la ༅ni/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas spyod lam byedage/ /yon tan kun gyi 'khor lor yang / /thar pa'i rgyu yis ster bar 'gyur / /yon tan kun bdag stong pa nyid/ /'khor bar rtso)'di las thabs gzhan med/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor chalas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las 'od ldan ma'i mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya'i cho ga zhes bya ba ste le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor ma 8mchog gtsotshe/ /mtshon cha'i brda ni bshad bya ste/ /78—562

sna chen ma yi ①rab sbyor bas/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i rang bzhin can/ /'di la dril bu phub ②mche ba/ /gtun shing zhags pa thod pa dang / /gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga po ti/ /phub chung dang ni sdigs mdzub (1)dang / /g.yer ku'i ⑤phreng dang lcags thag dang / /brag dang dur khrod rdul dang ni/ /mdung dang rnga dang pags (de)rlon dang / /skra yi thag pa dpyangs pa dang / /ro sreg skul (nyaba'i shing dang ni/ /ga ta'i dbyug pa phub dang mgo/ /keng rus dang ni zor ba nyid/ /mig dang mkhal ma gnye ma dang / /spen pa yi ni phur bu dang / /sa bon gar (pedang sog ⑧le dang / /khab dang slud stibashus pags 0pa dang / /sprin char 'bab dang shing lcags kyu/ /de ltar rnal 'byor mas ster na/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brjod bya ba/ /rdo rje ral gri mdung ring (skyedang / /rtse gsum dgra sta gri gug mda'/ /gsal shing phub tsodang tho ba dang / /'khor lo cang te'u chu gri dang / /dbyug pa dang ni mtshon 8rtse gcig /dung dang zangs dung dbyug 8gu gsum/ /der ni rma bya'i mjug skem dang / /bya rog sgro dang pir dang ni/ /me yi thab dang ri bo dang ske/ /dbyug thung me long pi wang dang / /rkang mgo lag mgo glo ba dang / /rgyu ma sgra gcan lcags sgrog tsodang / / gdos dang skogs 'o tshodang nya rgya dang / /mgo med mar nag 'bar ba dang / /'jigs byed gzugs can zhes bya ba/ /phyag rgya'i lan du mngon brjod yin/ /rlung gi rang bzhin ma lus pa/ /de'i rigs tsornal 'byor ma'i khyim du'o/ /gang dag hunyegang gi phyag rgya'i dbyibs/ /de de rnal 'byor ma yi ( )lus/ /de yi rang bzhin rjes bzung 2hongam/ /tshar gcod pa yang byed par 'gyur/ /stong pa nyid ni bcwa ( sebargyad dang / /khyad par du yang snying rje dang / /sangs rgyas chos ni ma 'dres dang / /de bzhin du 78—563

ni khams bcwa 3)brgyad/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgya mtshan nyid/ /skye bo thams cad shes par bya/ /sna chen ma yi rab sbyor bar/ /rang gi mtshan nyid gsungs pa yin / /'byung po thams cad kyi ni ma/ /mngon par sna tshogs nor bu bzhin/ /hā yig bskyod pa'i nā da'i bdag /de bzhin kha 'og bltas par 'phyang nā dar gnas pa'i skud pa yang / /bde (rigazugs gnyis med phreng ba can/ /sgrub thabs man ngag sbyor bdag nyid/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed las sngon byung ske/ /chos dang las dang dam tshig dang / /phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin can / /yi ge bzhi yi rtog pa las/ /phyag rgya bzhi mngon brjod nyid do/ /gnas ni a ra bu dar (5)zhes bya/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul rkang de bzhin/ /lha rdzas rnal 'byor ma 'dus pa/ /nam mkha'i (ge'akhor lor grags pa yin/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid de yi/ /bdag mo sna chen ma yin no/ /sna yi thog ma tha mar dbugs / /'jug dang gnas dang ldang ba can/ /dbus su mtshon bya mtshan nyid bral/ /rnal 'byor ma kun rtse bar 'gyur/ /nu baṃ (lde)la ni dbyangs can 'grol/ /dbus su gang gang 'bab pa mo/ /gzhu 'gengs pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /srog dang thur sel can 'dzin pa'o/ /rnam shes brda ru shes byas nas/ /mtshon bya (9༄de yang gzhom par bya/ /gang du sems ni gtong ba na/ /der ni rdzu 'phrul gyis dpag bya/ /ye shes ma yi mngal nyid do(3)/ /thams cad du ni rnam par dpyad/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /'dir ni slar yang bsgom par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin ni/ /gsang sngags yi ge rnams las byung / /mdog dang dbyibs ni sngon gyi ste/ /'jigs byed mtshan mo nag mo can/ /oṃ dza ko bā ṭi (0lā la bak+ṣa dzina'i bhu bye mdzā la ya ga r+ghaṃ nā rgyu ya 78—564

phaṭa hūṃ phaṭa rtsu ①su phaṭa hā phaṭa ②swā hā/ oṃ ho ཿlam hā nā se rgyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā / zhes bya'i gsang sngags las rdzogs pa/ /'dod pa kun gyi rang bzhin can / /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las sna chen ma'i mtshan nyid kyi brda'i cho ga'i nges pa zhes bya ba ste le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas lus kyi ts+tsha ⑤ma ni/ /mdzes pa'i spyod pa bshad par bya/ /dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'i sbyor bas/ /lha rdzas lus skyes 'thob par 'gyur/ /mgo dang spyi gtsug dpral ba dang / /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i rna ba dang / /rgyab kyi rgyud dang dpung pa gnyis/ /sna dang smin ma mig dang kha/ /rkan dang snying ga (nyalag pa dang / /mchan spyikhung nu ma rtsib logs dang / /lte ba mdoms 9kyedang 'phongs 79)ling ga /brla dang pus mo byin rkang pa/ /sor mo mtheb chen long bu dang / /rkang pa'i mthil du thams cad du/ /rlig pa lag pa glang po'i pags/ /mkhrig bom dpral ba'i ngos dang ni/ /mtshams dang lto bar shes bya ste/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor mas ster na/ /phyag rgya'i lan gyur rnal 'byor pas/ /ji lta'i nyastorim pas yigesbyin bya ba/ /gling bu pi wang 'khar skornga dang / /glu dang mardza rnga rol mo dang / /phreng ba sgeg pa gar zangs dung / /spos dang dri dang lha bshos dang / /'bras bu ma chags 'bras dang snod/ /zhabs bsil memachod yon mar me bum / /gos dang me long gdugs dang ni/ /bla re rnga yab de bzhin du/ /ba dan me 78—565

tog phreng ba dang / /rgyal mtshan dang ni dri gtsang khang / /mdung thung phreng ba phreng phyed dang / /slar yang dril chung dra ba dang / /seng ge ①gdan dang cod pan dang / /rin chen sna tshogs de bzhin no/ /go dā ba ri'i (banye gnas gzhug( ri /dad pa'i dbang po'i rang bzhin can/ /dpa' ①blo ma yi rab sbyor bas / /phyag rgya thams cad rab tu bshad/ /lhan skyes skad kyis bī (5)zhes bya/ /sum cu drug dngos bdag nyid can/ /phung po khams dang yul dang ni/ /dbang po las dang las can te/ /yul gyi sgra ni de bzhin 'dir/ /kun la drug drug rim ji bzhin/ /de rnams nang du song ye shes/ /lhan skyes gzhan gyi dngos po min/ /mtshan mo nyin mo'i rab sbyor bas/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid do/ /lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma de rnams/ /sum cu rtsa drug dbye bas phye / /dam tshig chen po 'dus pa ni/ /pad+ma'i lte bar rig par bya/ /de las skyes pa'i rang phyag rgya/ /yul dang yul du rnam par gzhag(6) /rang rig rnal 'byor ma'i bde ba/ /'di ni sangs rgyas spyod yul yin3)/ /'jig bzhin pa ni chen po nyid/ /bcu gnyis mi rnams nang du son/ /rdo rje'i rlung ni rab zhugs (nyepa'i / /der ni kun dur rnal 'byor skyes/ /'od zer slong ba'i bde ba yi5)/ /'pho med rnams kyis bgrod par byos/ /de ltar go dā yib ri shes byas nas/ /dad pa'i dbang po'i rdo rje can/ /dpa' blo ma yi rang bzhin shes/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gtso mo yin/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid rdo rje4te/ /rang ming gsang sngags ldan par ro/ /sna tshogs rnam 12rtog zas can ni/ /lhan skyes brtson 'grus ming gis so/ /oṃ ka pā la ra r+pā shu ta pā dhū sho mru r+ya u ta gra shu ba lā pu ya ṣā r+ghaṃ ya hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā phaṭa hā be swā hās/ oṃ bī ra ma tī ye rtsu 78—566

hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa 1)swā hā/ kha dog dang dbyibs sngon /migyi ru/ /rnal 'byor ma kun gyi ni bya/ /gang phyir brtson 'grus yang dag 'pho/ /mngon par brjod pa yang dag 'byung / /nam mkha' lding gi sbyor ldan pas/ /'dir ni the tsom (gemed par byed/ /sngon du bstan pa'i ts+tsha ma ka /mchog gi lce ru shes par bya phyag rgya'i lan ni gzhan med de/ /lan gyi lce ni dbang gnyis kyi'o/ /sna tshogs rgyud dang lung rnams su/ /nga yis khyod la ma ④bshad do/ /rgyud 'di yi ni rab sbyor ba / /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ma rig pa dang sdang (5)sems dang / /skye bo rmongs gang yul spyod na/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mi 'thob cing nges par dmyal bar 'tshed par 'gyur/ /de phyir gus pa'i sems bdag yigis/ /bya ba gus pas legs rig bya/ /sngon gyi rmongs pa med 'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas nyid 'thob yun ⑦mi ring / /mos pas rgyun tu gzhol (shegyur pas/ /tshe dang nad med 'phel ba yin/ /rlung gi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma/ /stobs ldan dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ /rdo rje'i rlung dbye (9)rab ldan pas/ /sems chen por ni thim par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las phyag rgya tshedang phyag rgya'i lan dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid hunyekyi ming zhes bya ba ste le'u sum cu pa'o// //khams thams cad kyi ts+tsha nyugem ka /bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan rtso du gsol/ /gang zhig dri med dngos po'i brda/ /bshad kyis 8sgrub mo mnyan 8par gyis/ /78—567

so yis mchu ni yongs bzung ①nas/ /bde bas bol+la 'jib ②par byed/ /phyin /rinanas ye shes rab ④ston pa'i/ /'di skad kyi ni tshig smras so/ /phyi mo'i ⑤yi ge'i sbyor ba yis/ /bcu po gsum la drug ldan yipa'i/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan gyis ni/ /'di las dam tshig dbye bar bya/ /ka kha ga gha nga kai/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya rtsa/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bye ṇa 〈(7ri/ ta tha da dha na lta/ pa pha ba bha ma paṃ/ ya ra la wa ha yaṃ/ /zhes bya rin rnal 'byor mas ster na/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni slar yang 'di / /kā khā gā ghā ngu kuḥ tsā tsā dzā dz+nyā dhihā tsaḥ ṭā ṭhā ḍā ⑩ sgyu ṇa ṭa/hoḥtā thā dā dhā nā taḥhu pā pā bā bhā mā paḥ yā rā lā wā hā yahu ཿ de ltar phyag rgya'i khyad shes nas/ /lus can kun gyi sgo glegs yin/ /bu ga gnyis kyi rab sbyor bar/ /thams cad kyang ni yi ge 'dra/ /'og dang steng du 'dus byas nas//rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma gnyis med/ /skad cig bzhi yi ④bden rnams kyis/ /de nyid dga' ba bzhi de bzhin/ / sde pa bzhi mdang 'khor lo bzhi/ /e baṃ ma yā tshesku rnams ni/ /rgyud 'dir mdo ru bstan pa ste/ /rgyas bshad gzhan du rtogs par hu bya/ /mi'u nyugethung ma yi rab sbyor bas/ /cho ga sngags pas shes par bya / /nam mkha' dang mnyam sgo glegs phreng / /mkha' spyod ma ru spyod pa rang nyurte/ /ngag kyang skad kyi rang bzhin bdag /'gog par nye bar 'gro bar gyis / /gsang chen sems dang sems byung rnams/ /mtha' ma gsal bar 'thob 3 stapa yis/ /rin chen rdo rje las dga'i gzugs/ /bltas pa'i mtshams su mthong bar 'gyur/ /thams cad bden pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /bzhi po bzhi yi bdag nyid can/ /rā sa)me shwa ra dang dbang por/ /mchog tu rmad byung shes par bya/ /'dod chags chags bral rnam 22bsres pa/ /de'i 0skad cig las 78—568

byung ba ①min/ /'byung ba lnga'i bdag can yin ②las/ /me ni dbus su bdud rtsi'i gnas/ /dbugs kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bde'i(2)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bza' bar bya/ /lha dang klu rnams bud med la/ /mkhas pa yis ni rol pa yin/ /de rnams kyis ④ni dus kun du/ /lus can kun gyi 'pho ba yang ske/ /sgo dgu'i bdag nyid nam mkha' la/ /de rnams bzhi 'gyur du shes bya//de ltar ④sgo glegs gnas (nyarnams ni/ /rtag tu sum cu rtsa drug 'gyur/ /sgo yi dbye ba mi shes la/ /skyon dang yon tan ji ltar lags/ /'pho ba'i dus tshod kyi ni tshad/ /yang dag rab tu sbyor ba nyon/ /mdzes pa'i gnas ni lam bzang pos / /lam ⑦ngan gyis ni srid pa'i skyon/ /thig le lte ba steng rnams dang / /mig dang sna dang rna ba dag /bshang ba dang ni gci ba'i sgo/ /sgo dgu yi ni mtshan nyid do/ /lte bas 3)'dod pa'i mtho ris dang / /thig les gzugs kyi lus can rnams/ /steng gis steng gi gnas kyi ni/ /'gro dang 'ong bar rab tu grags / /gnod sbyin dngos po sna las so/ /rna ba dag gis grub pa'i lha/ /gal te mi gnas ye shes bgrod/ /mi rnams mi bdag sgyur 99)rnams 'gyur/ /srid pa'i sgo yis yi dgas ⑩rnams/ / gci bas nyamadud 'gro de bzhin no/ /dmyal ba brgyad kyi dngos rnams kyi'i/ /lus can rnams ni bshang ba las/ /gzhan gyi sgo ni 8gsum gsum ste/ /mkhas pas rtsa yi kun spyod can/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun rnams kyang ni/ /smin drug la sogs rgyu skar ro/ /rnam dag ye shes gsum po ni/ /re re'i sgo ma rnams kyi'o/ /brtson 'grus dbang po'i dngos rnams kyis/ /thams cad nyer spyod mtshan nyid do/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus subya/ /sngon gyi mdog can bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje dkar mo sogs sa 78—569

bon / /sgo glegs gnas su gzhag par bya/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid lha mo/ /sa yi 'khor lo'i sbyor bas so/ /sngags kyi yi ge rnams su gyur pa ①ni/ oṃ mā bi tri ka ga ṭa ṇa mu pa kha meri hā pū (dpehā ri ra ta bā ma yarnga ④rgyu ya rtsu hūm̐ pha rtsu ṭa pha phaṭa ṭa pha swā ṭa hā swā hā/ oṃ kharba rī ye hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar sngags las yang dag byung (she/ /don dam sbyor ba las skyes pa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las mi'u yithung ma'i yi ge'i brda'i mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi ye shes zhes bya ba ste le'u sum cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //slar yang mchod pa byas nas ni/ /yang dang yang du zhus pa nyid/ /dngos po ye shes kyis phyag rgya/ /bcom ldan gtso bo ji ltar lags/ /bdag ⑦gis mtshan nyid bshad bya yisanas/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas nyon/ /lhan skyes bde dang stong ba dang / /rang gis rig dang bde ba che/ /chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa dang ni rmad byung (khache/ /'od gsal sems dang bsam pa dang ske/ /zhi dang myang 'das sbyor skyes dang / /pha rol phyin dang gnyis med dang ske/ /thar pa dang ni don dam dang / /ye shes rnam shes byang chub dang / /chos dbyings grong khyer de bzhin du/ /pad+ma dang ni chos 'byung dang / /slar yang bdag med mtho ris dang / /zhi dang sgra dang bla ma dang / /rig dang 'khrul med rtog spangs dang / /bcud len dang ni smra bshad de/ /mkhas pas 78—570

ts+tsha tshima'i rnam grangs so/ /ji ltar de ltar yig dang po/ /thams cad lan (0gyi : (kyem yin/ /ji ltar yi ge de bzhin don/ /dmyal ba la sdang shes par bya/ lang ku'i dbang phyug ma'i sbyor bar/ /rnal 'byor pa khyod kyis bya'o/ /'phyang bar gyur pa'i sa bon gyi/ /der ni smo bo)ma thams cad de/ /ge 9shesar ye shes khams kyi ni/ /rang gi rang bzhin du mtshan nyid/ /rang yod de mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /pad+ma'i snying po ri ⑥ni gnas/ /ri ni rnam shes 'gro ba ste/ /yid kyi stikhams rnams thams cad du'o/ /lang kur bdag nyid skye ba ste/ /dngos po'i ye shes rnams kyis byung / /dbang phyug 'byung po thams cad kyi/ /ye shes min pa dngos kun skyes/ /de bi ko ṭa'i gnas su ste7she/ /slar yang byang chub dran dbang po/ /gang du ye shes bsam med pa/ /der ni bstan pas thos par 'gyur / /'dod chags bral bas gang dag phyogi/ /bi ni kun 'gro'i ye shes so/ /rlung rnams kyi ni mkha' 0rnams su/ /dbang po rnams kyi bde de bzhin/ /ṭi ni rdo rje'i nus par grags/ /yul rnams kyi ni grong du bgrod/ /dran pa lhan cig skyes ye shes/ /gang du yid ni rab brjod pa/ /der ni dbang po'i byang chub kyang / /shes nas 0rdo rje'i tshul bdag nyid/ /de ltar de nyid nges shes nasal/ /rang gi rang bzhin du gnas bya/ /chos dang 'jig rten bcas pa spang //cung zad mig 0med gzud par be/bya/ /yang na dngos po kun bdag nyid/ /yang na thams cad rnam par spang / /dngos dang dngos po can yod min/ /dngos po med pa gsal mthong tshe'agyur/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol//thams cad mi bden las skyes blta/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin zhal las/ /brgyud pa'i rim pas phrad par 8gyis/ /me yi dkyil 'khor du lha mo/ /de phyir de yi 78—571

rang bzhin lus/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /sngon gyi gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /thams cad thabs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi yi ge las byung ba'o/ /oṃ rtsu sa hūṃ ha kā dza ro su/ ts+tshan+da ra rī ṇa ①pa mul+la khā ba ②ya ka rtsu rā (kyergyu ya phaṭa rtsu phaṭa hūm̐ tshon)swā phaṭa hā phaṭa swā hāX5)/ oṃ lasko shwa rī ye rtsu rgyu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar shes byas gsang sngags che/ /dngos grub yang ⑥bas byed pa yin / /las thams cad kyi rang bzhin te/ /brgya la na yang gzhan du min/ /dngos grub ri yi ming can ni/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad sman du'o/ /smin drug dang ni snar mar 'gyur/ /mgo bo dang ni lag de bzhin/ /nab ⑦so dang ni rgyal nyid dang ske/ /skag dang mchu dang gzhan pa ni/ /shar gyi gre dang byang gi dbo/ /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang / /sa ga dang ni lha mtshams dang / /snron (gyedang snrubs ⑨dang chu stod (7dang / /chu smad dang ni byi bzhin dang / /gro bzhin 0mon gru de bzhin du/ /mon gre dang ni khrums stod dang / /khrums smad dang ni nam gru dang ske/ /tha skar de bzhin bra nye dang / /zla ba nyi ma rā hu dang / /sa'i 0ma nyid dang spen hunyepa rnams/ /rang rang dus nyid shes par bya/ /the tsom ④med pas bzung bas so/ /thams cad zla ba'i sbyor 8bdag nyid/ /nam mkha' la ni mnyam par gnas/ /'chad bzhin pa yi rab sbyor bas/ /sngags pas cho ga shes par bya/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las lang ma'i dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgya'i brda'i mtshan nyid dang dkyil 'khor gyi phoga'akhor lo'i rang bzhin dang ming gi cho ga'i ye shes kyi le'u 78—572

ste ①sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //slar yang gzhan pa bshad bya ste/ /dgos dang byed pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub pos dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zla ba nyi ma gzas gzung ②bar/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sngags mtshan nyid/ /po rta gi ni gsang por (mismra ba ste/ /pra ti po tai gi ni lan yin no/ /ga mu 'gro ba'o lum pa ni/ /'ong ngo zhes ni bya ba nyid/ /de hi grong khyer ro tsa ṭu rka zhes bya/ / zung shig ④pa'o skṛ da (snyeya ni dpa' bo yin/ /kau ra ba ni song cig pa nyid de/ /kurnyi (3ka ni dril bu'o a li byed pa'o/ /shi ra 'khyil pa'i spa (peyin te/ /sra (she)ba ⑨rna ba'o gzhan pa ni/ /man tha na ni bdud rtsi ste/ /na ra phrad pa'o tā li ka yang ni⑩la/ /mkha' 'gro ma'o na ra kai dkyil 'khor/ /a mu kai ni dur khrod te⑩/ /kā khi la sgo'o swa sa rna/ /bram ze'o ba ri rgyal po'i rigs/ /bir 'o ti rje'u rigs 'akru ra ni/ /dmangs so 8an ta gdol pa can/ /ā 8 li ka 2phyugs ḍā ki ni0/ /sring mo'o mu da ka tshil/ /lce yis phyagaso reg de 6)bzhin du/ /zas 4 )kyis ltogs par rig par bya/ /tre sna dri yis bsgos pa ste/ /ā 31)ga ma na zhes bya gnas gang nas/ /che ge mo'o ki ra du 3kho me tog go/ /lam zhu pa lto ba dan ta rgod ④pa ste/ /ni ro dhe char ro bi dzha na pa ti tshim pa'o/ /dhu mra zhes bya sprin de bzhin / /dhu mra pri 0ya ri bo ste/ /sā nu sā rdo tshori ta chu klung / /ang gu l+ya ni cha shas te/ /ba da na rā tsodzi ka lce/ /a dha ra so yin paṃ ka ti/ /rgyal mtshan tshan do 0phreng de sno )bzhin/ /tsa la rlung ngo srig ginyepa 8)ti phyugs rte/ /maṇ+ḍa la ni mnyam pa ste/ /swā sa duzilam gyi bzhi mdor shes par bya/ /skye ba phal gi gu sham mo ma hā 78wa 573

k+ṣa raṃ 0ni/ /phyugs chen no na ts+tsha ni ra skyes so/ /na (5 ni mi'o ba ni glang yin no/ /ma ni ma he bha ni za ba ste/ /si ni seng ge byā ④ni stag de bzhin/ /s+thā dugeni gnas pa'o kha la reg pa zos pa yin/ /so la reg pa tshim (thu/pa yin/ /hri ka ngo tsha stong pa la reg pa/ /'khrig pa'o brla la reg pa ni/ /de ltar da ltar ⑦gyis zhes par / /mchog tu mthun 9)ma shes par bya/ /'dir ni dgos pa slar bshad pa/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsrub par 7bya/ /byed pa rnal 'byor mar shes bya / /dpa' bo kun tu dgos pa'o/ /sna tshogs dngos po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /ye shes shes bya'i rang bzhin bdag /bskyed pa srid pa'i sbyor ba dang / /sbyor bral kun rdzob de bzhin du/ /sgyu ma mthun hustepa 'khor ba dang / /brtse ba rang bzhin brtags pa dang / /gzhan gyi dbang dang yongs grub dang / /tu ri nyugeyo 'khor lo bsgom 1 pa dang / /sems dga' bobyas dang tshul khrims dang / /gtong ba brtul 15ba dpa' de bzhin/ /skar rtsis mkhan dang sman pa nyid/ /bzo dang khams dang smra ba po/ /lhag ma rten 'brel yan lag ni/ /bcu gnyis ma rig sogs shes bya/ /mā la 16ba yi nye gnas su/ /shing grib ma yi rab sbyor bsal/ /ting 'dzin dbang po'i phyogs rnams su/ /'jug pa med dang 'jug pa mtshungs / /dbang po 'dod chags chags bral dag /yang dag phun sum tshogs bdag po/ /mā ma tī 1 rdo rje'i bu gar ni/ /spyi gtsug gnas su yongs gnas bya//'phyang bzhin pa kha 'og tu ste/ /kum nyu8po dzi 17yi phyag rgya'i tshul/ /ba ni yang dag rig ripa'i rgyud/ /rang bzhin sgyu ma'i rang mtshan nyid/ /de ltar byas dang ma byas kun/ /mkhas pas dbu 21mar mi snang ngo / /zhi na ba'i dngos po'i ye shes 'dir/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi sku can te/ /smig rgyu dang ni 'dra ba'i 78—574

gzugs / /bdag nyid gzugs can mthong hu)bar 'gyur/ /ye shes shin tu bas g.yogs pasal/ /kun 'gro ba yi lhar dran bya kye/ /gang 'dra'i bsnying rje gnyis byar med/ /de 'dra'i dngos por skye (2dran bya/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /sngon can grags pa bsgom 96dpar bya/ /gsang sngags bden pa'i gzungs bdag nyid/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus tsho7)son pa'o/ /oṃ sa ma rba hā sgru (kyebla ta shā si na tā (7bri sa yā na ya ka hūṃ rā bos ya pha hūm̐ ṭa hūm̐ pha pha ṭa ṭa swā pha hā ṭa swā hā/ oṃ dru ma ts+tsha 37ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar sngags gzugs bdag nyid du/ /kun du 'gro ma 'osnyecan shes bya/ /mchod pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du / /lhan skyes mdzes ma 'dus pa'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dngos bdag /rnal 'byor nam mkha' hu)gtso bo yin/ /dbugs nyageni sba ba byas nas ni/ /slar yang o can 0kun du 'gro/ /sa gsum po 7yi ris su ni/ /gzugs kyi gtso mo bsgom par bya/ /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgom par bya/ /slar yang rdo rje phag mo yitshi/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rigs ldan mchod8 / /lha rdzas mi yi bde ba ni/ /bsdus byas pa bas de mchog go/ /ma mo'i grong khyer nyams dga' ba/ /'gro ba'i gtso bo bsgom par bya 'di 'dra'i dus kyis ye shes ni/ /mkhas pas a ba dhū tī'i nyi nang du'o/ /rnal 'byor pas bsgoms sems bdag nyid/ /stong pa nyid gzugs dmigs pa can//de yis tsu )thams cad rig sa byas nas/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rang mtshan nyid/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las shing grib 78—575

ma'i rang gi mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya'i brda'i cho ga'i nges pa zhes bya ba ste le'u sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das bdag pos①/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro khyab bdag che/ /phyag rgya yang dag rig pa'i gzugs/ /ji lta'i rigs pas bstan du gsol/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi merab sbyor bas/ /re re la ni dgu dgu ste/ /las dang chos dang dam tshig dang / /phyag rgya chen po bzhi pa yin/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar bud med gang ske/ /pad+ma'i dri ni gtong bu ba yin/ /pad+ma dang ni ut+pal dri/ /kha dog tsam ka yi yin/ / dza ti dang ④ni tsama'i dri/ /de yi gzugs dang mdog 'dzin ma'o / /ga pur 55sku/dang ni tsan+dan dri/ /pad+ma dkar po'i pags stican ma'o/ /ri dgas lte ba dang mnyam dri/ /ut+pal lasngon po'i mdog can ma'o/ /ut+pal ⑤sngo 'dab ljang gu ri9la/ /dri ni de nyid kyis mtshon bya/ /mkhri ka dang ut+pal dri / /mu men dang ni mtshungs ma'o/ /ke ta ka 8yi dri shes bya/ /dmar po ban dhu sprika lta bu'o/ /pa nyugeṭa li mkhri ku'i dri/ /slar yang nam mkha'i kha dog go/ /de ltar 3 las kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /chos kyi phyag rgya bshad par bya/ /bde gshegs tshogs pa la dga' ba/ /mthar skyes rnal 'byor ma mchog yin/ /bsam gtan bzlas la rgyun du dga'/ /bram ze mo ru rab tu bshad/ /rtag tu khrus dang gtsang sbra chadaga'/ /rje'u rigs kyi ni tsobud med do/ /rnam rtog med bdag nyid ni 8mo/ /rtul cing dpa' bo la rtse zhing / /rgyal rigs kyi ni rang bzhin te/ /'di ni mchog tu gtam dga' ma'o②/ /las la yongs su rtse ba ste/ /dmangs rigs kyi ni rnal 'byor ma'o/ /bde gshegs 'dus 8la rjes su 78—576

chags / /mchog tu mthun ①ma'i rnal 'byor ma'o/ /mkhas pa yi ni phyogs su gzhol②ske/ /chos kyi gnas su khro med ma'o/ /dpa' bo yi ①ni rigs su skyes/ /rtag par sha ni za ma yin/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i lam srung ma/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsam par lnga)byed/ /khro ba rnams ⑤la mi khro zhing / /mnyes par byed pa'i khur khyer ma'o/ /de ltar chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ /dam tshig phyag rgya mngon brjod bya/ /gtor ma mchod pa la dga' ma/ /dam tshig can du de mngon brjod / /rab gnas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / /don dam pa la dga' ba ⑥ma'o / /'gro ba rnams la dbang bskur ma/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig can mar grags / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor 0zhing / /rtag tu dam tshig skyong ma'o/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs dbus su/ /mchog tu rmad byung rtsen ma'o/ /dus thams cad du dga' dang bcas/ /rab tu rgyas pa'i bzhin byed ma'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bu bzhin snang / /rdo rje rnal 'byor mar de shes/ /dus kun du ni dub med lam/ /mtshon cha 'bebs pa'i ming can ma'o/ /mi mo rtag tu 'gro bzhin du/ /dam tshig brda tshini skyong ma ste/ /de ltar dam tshig phyag rgya yin/ /phyag rgya chen mor charab bshad bya/ /lhan skyes zhing skyes lha mo dang / /sngags skyes 'jig rten mgon po dang 1nya/ /sbyor skyes gnas skyes de bzhin du/ /dam tshig lha rdzas rnal 'byor ma/ /pad can ma ni dus kun du/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsngags pa'o/ /de ltar phyag rgya'i rang bzhin te/ /de mngon tshul bdag phyag rgya'i lan/ /gang zhig gang gi mdog dang dri/ /de yi de ltar tshul dran bya/ /sa srung 8ma yi rab sbyor bas/ /kā ma ru 8pa shes rab dbang / /sems can kun gyi dgos pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bsgrub par bya/ /e yig ye shes rlung 78—577

rnams ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rab bzhugs6)/ /'dod chags me yi ②rang bzhin bdag /thugs kyi 'khor lo rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje gsang ba las bzhengs tsarmo ci/ /khams thams cad ma 'pho med ma'o/ /'das dang ma byon sangs rgyas rnams/ /de dag 4)sems can cha can no/ /sems ni re re la yang ni / /sum cu rtsa drug las can ma'o/ /lus can gzugs ni des de (gebazhin/ /zhing du ka la sogs pa'i 6)gzugs/ /chen po'i sngags kyi tshul bdag tu/ /sa la da ltar 53)nyid rol 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs la yang / /gzugs dang gzugs med shes mi 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi gzugs su byas lha mo/ /sangs rgyas lam ni shes byed ma'o/ /dbang po kun du 'gro sangs rgyas/ /gang phyir shes rab pha rol phyin/ /de ltar de ⑧nyid nges shes pas/ /rnal 'byor ma ⑨yi gzugs dang mtshungs/ /ye shes 'khor lor lha mo rnams/ /bdag mo 'dod pa kun sbyin ma/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sngags kyi gzugs can du byung ba'o/ /oṃ dza ma ṭā hā ka ka lā la pa pā mun+ta 0ku ga ṭā huḥni ya te hūṃ dzā hunyergyu ya 51 phaṭa hūm̐ phaṭa hūṃ swā phaṭa hā 8phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ i rā 7ba tī ⑩le rtsu rgyu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ tsho/ zhes bya'i cho18sngags kyi sa bon du/ /mchog sbyin ma ni byung ba ste/ /kha dog dbyibs nyu7ni sngon gyi can/ /ji ltar kun nas thams cad du'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las sa srung ma'i ri )sku'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ste le'u sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //78—578

de nas lha mos mchod byas nas/ /'di skad kyi ni tshig smras so/ /gang gis 'byung po thams cad sogs/ /mthong bas kun tu skrag pa yi/ /thams cad bden pa yi ni brda/ /bcom ldan mkha' 'gro nyid kyis gsungs/ /phyag rgya kun gyi nang son pa/ /snying po'i phyag rgya de nyon cig /rgyud gang du yang ma bshad pa/ /de ni khyod kyis hu)bskul ba ste(mi/ /rdo rje me yi rab sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya thams cad rab tu brjod/ /lte ba'i 'khor lor lha mo gang / /shing reg mtha' yi spyod yul can/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i rim pa ni/ /sna tshogs rtsa yi rim pas so/ /thig le nyi mar ①son phyag rgya/ /bsam dang sems ni dbyangs gsal te/ /sum cu rtsa drug ring dang thung / /phyag rgya de ni mngon ster ma/ /phyag rgya dang ni phyag rgya'i lan/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /byang chub sems son pa yi dbugs/ /'di 4)kun sems can la thim pa'o/ /'jigs byed chen mo'i (7sbyor ba yis/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub par bya phyi mo de nyams myong byas nas/ /gang dang gang gi 6)dag las byung / /hā hā rnams kyis rgod (1)kun rnams/ /ljon shing rtsa ba can du bya/ /dga' bas der ni 'du ba ni/ /khams dang skye mched rnams kyang ngo / /bag chags thams cad dang bral ba/ /'jigs byed 'chang (8)bzhin pa yin no/ / o ḍi'i gnas 3)su dad pa'i 7stobs/ /ji lta'i grangs kyi spyod yul can/ /nye bar 'jal ba'i khyim dbus su/ /de'i nyunyaphyir brtan dang 'gro ba ni/ /thim pa'ang dngos po kun gyi bdag /mkhas pas phyag rgya rnams kyis brlan/ /nam mkha' ru ni 'phur bzhin pas/ste/ /'gro ba kun las ye shes mchog /dad pa'i shugs las shes 78—579
