byas nas/ /lus can kun gyi stobs ldan yin/ /sha chen po la za bzhin dang / /yid kyis 411khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /he ru ka mar byed rig ma/ /sngon shing drung du yang dag zhugs/ /de ni dkyil 'khor 'khor dbus su/ /'jigs byed chen mo rnam par bsgom(0/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sngags rnams yi ge tshon/las byung ba'o/ /oṃ ma kha hā ṭa sa ṭ+wāṃ 0mu ga dra (geka me pā yis la lā shu 9)ya la rtsu bhi rtsu n+da pha dhā ṭa (8)ri phaṭa ṇi swā hūṃ hā hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā lha 6)ra bī ye hūṃ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya'i gsang sngags sbyor chen las/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sku thugs can/ /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar byed/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las 'jigs byed chen mo'i bonang gi phyag rgya'i cho ga 'chad pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga zhes bya ba (17ste le'u sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas 'dod ma'i rnal 'byor ma/ /phyag rgya yi ni brda yi rgyud8/ /snying rjes bshad bya rnal 'byor pa'i/ /mthong ba yis ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /snang ba rnams su gang tshe dngos/ /dbang po'i spyod yul du mthong 'gyur/ /gnag ⑫dang dkar dang dmar ba dang / /sngo 8dang dmar ser ljang gu rtsonyedang / /ser dang sngo skya khra 8bor snang / /sna tshogs pa dang du ba'i mdog /sngo dang dmar ser 'dres pa dang / /slar la yang ni dkar nag mdog /dmar ser dang ni ljang sngo skya/ /sngo ba dang ni dmar ba'i tsomadog /dkar sngo dang ni dmar ljang 78wa 580

dang ske/ /sprin dang sna tshogs mdog can dang / /sna tshogs dang ni ser po'i mdog /du ba dang ni gser 0)mdog can/ /ser ljang dang ni ljang ser dang / /dmar po dang ni dung mdog can/ /dud kha (kyedakar po sna tshogs sngo/ /ser dang dmar ba bsres (kyepa can/ / dud kha ④dang ni sngo skya'i mdog /dkar dang sna tshogs pa'i (semadog can(6)/ /skya bo dang ni du ba'i mdog /skya dkar dang ni dmar skya dang / /sprin dang skya bo ljang skya dang / /sna tshogs pa dang skya bo'i mdog /thams cad mdog gi kha dog tu/ /khams bcu gnyis kyi kha dog can/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs dang lcags/ /'khar (7 ba dang ni ra gan te/ /phan tshun 'dres pa'i kha dog gis/ /brtse (8)ba chen po de bcu gnyis/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi khams thams cad/ /der ni snang ba skye bar 'gyur/ /de yis snang ba'i dus ⑨su ni/ /'phrul chen mo ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya gnyis dag rnam shes pas/ /kha dog mthong bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngon dang phyis ni bsdus pa las/ /gal te lhan skyes sbyor bdag nyid/ /rlung shugs ma yi rab sbyor bas/ /tri sha ku ni'i 8gnas su ni/ /lha mo brtson 'grus stobs su ste37/ /de ltar yi ge'i don rnams kyang / /ba ni dbu mar 'bab pa ste/ /bag chags stobs kyis hunye'achi bar 'gyur/ /dus 'dzom thams cad chos rnams su/ /slar yang mthong lam bdag nyid yin/ /be ni yul dang ldan pa nyid/ /bdag nyid rnams kyi bsgom 8pa'i lam/ /de kho 8nyid mas dam bo'akhyud tshepa/ /skyob pa rnams kyi grol ba'i lam/ /mtho ris mi yul sa 'og gi/ /'gro 1 ba rnam pa gsum zhes bya/ /mnyam pa'i bde ba mthong 'gyur ba'ang / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshams tson gnas/ /bum pa can nyurtasogs byas gang phyir/ /gtum mo phra ba'i 78—581

rtsa can no/ /pad+mar rtsa ni thams cad can/ /de dang 'dra ba'i ye shes med/ /de phyir brtson 'grus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /stobs su ye shes ye shes can/ /de ltar shes byas 14)rtag rnal 'byor/ /'dod can ma la 'dod spyad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni bdag mo dang / /gsang sngags yi ger yang dag byung / /lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub mchog tu/ /lha mo chen mo skye bar 'gyur/ /oṃ be byā tā gh+ra la tsa saṃ rmā lhas ma ra d+dha du d+ma ṇa ri ka ṇi rā hūm̐ ya hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa hūṃ phaṭa (khuphaṭa swā phaṭa hā (peswā hā / oṃ bā yu be ge hūm̐ 55)rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ kha dog gzugs ni sngon ji bzhin/ /sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dbus su / /khams gsum snying po'i phyag rgya yis/ /gang de nus pa rdzogs par grags/ /gsung gi 'khor lo gsang ba cher/ /bdag gis gang zhig rim pa yis/ /thams cad bden par shes par bya/ /de phyir rdo rje 'chang dbugs dbyung / /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rlung shugs ma'i kha dog gi phyag rgya'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba ste le'u sum cu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas rdo rje phag mo yis/ /ji lta'i cho gas mchod byas pas77)/ /nyon cig lha mo bshad bya ba58ri/ /bla ma rang gis lha'i phyag rgya/ /'o byed de bzhin lā ma dang ske/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gzugs can ma/ /yongs 'gyur ma dang rjes 'jug ma/ /rnal 'byor ri9ri par phyin drug de bzhin/ /lag pa g.yon pa yi 57ni brdal/ /rnal 'byor dbye bas ston byed pa/ /re re la yang rnam gsum 'gyur/ /78—582

dpa' bo'i rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rdo rje nyid/ /ā ro lika 1)dang rta mchog dang / /he ru ka rnams lag g.yon la'o/ /mkhas pas gnyis sbyar rnal 'byor te/ /spyan ma dang ni mā ma khririn / /sgrol ma gos dkar bdag med ma/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbyings (5)dbang phyug /pha rol phyin drug tu shes bya/ /de ltar rnam gsum shes bya ba/ / dpa' bo 4)'gro ba kun gyi bdag /sa yi snying po la sogs der/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro sogs gtso bo/ /lha mo lag pa'i rgyab son te/ /sor mo rnams la de bzhin gshegs/ /de bzhin lha mo dbus tshigs su/ /lag pa'i mthil (5)du de bzhin gshegs/ /dpa' bo de bzhin sen skogs (nyal/ /lag gdub ri7zhiganas su rnal 'byor ma/ /lag pa'i rtse mos brda bya ste(8)/ /mkhas pas rgyab tu gshegs gsol bya/ /gang zhig gang gi bdag po nyid/ /de yi de nyid kyis (9)mtshon bya/ /chang 'thung ma yi borab sbyor bas / /ko sa la dang sna'i rtse mo/ /dran pa'i stobs kyi (11bdag nyid kyis/ /bza' ba dang ni ston mo bya/ /gnyid log dus kun las skyes par/ /phyag rgya chen po legs par zung / / rā hu dus 12me nyi ma ru/ /zos 32pa sna yi rtser de bzhin / /phra mo gnyis su med gzugs bolas/ /yul kyang bza' bar byas nas ni / /me tog sems kyi sa bon las/ /k+ṣi ni bdud rtsi'i tsheskud pa 'dzagatso /de ltar nges byed rnal 'byor pa/ /lte ba'i chang nya tshosngon song las so/ /gzhu yi lho dbyug par son pa'i sems/ /rang gzugs yang dag rig pa tsamanyarte/ /ro mnyam pa ni myong sa )ba yang / /the tsom 1med par 'dir byed 'gyur/ /brkyang 9 lhema'i bde ba'i nus pa yis/ /sa bon zag pa med par son/ /dus de nyid du rtag phyag rgya/ /dpa' bo'i brda yis 'thob 3 par 'gyur/ /byang chub 'khor lo 78—583

dga' bcas su/ /'jug 'gyur mchog gi zhal can ma/ /brda yidang bral na 'khor ba ru/ /grol ba'i thabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs bdag mo/ /chang 'thung grags pa chen mo ②yin/ /sum cu rtsa bdun 'khor lo cher / /gsang sngags las byung mchog zhal mo(kye/ /oṃ sha ma tū (pehā ni bi su gha m+bha na na (snyeni ka bā 9berā ri ya 7rte hūm̐ hūṃ hūṃ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa (kyephaṭa swā swā dzikehā hā/ oṃ su rā bha k+ṣi 0ye rtsu (11rdu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar sngags rgyal mngon par ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'byin dang sdud pa dag gis ni/ /gnyis gnyis kyis yo ni rkang par gsungs/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid lha mo/ /kha dog dbyibs (12ni sngon can no/ /kun mkhyen bgrod bya phyag rgya'i lan/ /mngon par shes pas sbyin mi bya/ /ma 8shes pa yis rnal 'byor ma'i/ /phyag rgya chen po 'di 'grub 'gyur/ /sbrul dang rkun sogs pas bsad nas/ /dmyal ba sogs su 'gro ba yin/ /sna tshogs lung 'dzin dpa' rnams la/ /yang dag yid ches bya phyir ster/ /bla ma'i drin gyis yod pa der8/ /mkhas pa de yi rkyen gyis brda//dngos grub dngos po bdag nyid kyis/ /byed 'gyur gzhan du ma yin no/ /de yi drin gyis grol ba ste/ /mkhas pas zhing du gnas par bya/ /bla ma'i man ngag zhing yin te/ /de ni gnas dang byang chub phyogs/ /gnas pa ts+tsha tsom ka rnams te / /rang bzhin med pa : nyu tshoma'i lan/ /yang na 'di kun bla ma 'am/ /bla ma thams cad thams cad pa'o/ /man ngag dang bcas ye shes 38/ /ngag gi lam ⑪'das spyod yul can/ /sku yi 'khor lor dngos grub che/ /theg pa kun gyi bde bar bzhugs/ /bde med bde ba med pa'ang med/ /thams cad der ni gnyis med che ge/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde 78—584

ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las chang 'thung ma'i rab tu sbyor ba'i brda'i rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga zhes bya ba ste le'u sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas phag mo pad bzung ①mo'i/ /lha mos mchod pa byas nas ni/ /las dang rnal 'byor ma'i bdag po/ /rdo rje chen pos bdag la gsungs/ /sems can kun gyi dgos byed pa/ /lha rdzas las ni bshad par bya/ /gang gis thams cad dbang sogs su/ /lha sogs thams cad de bzhin 'ong / /thog mar rdo rje phag mo yige/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags kyi ni las/ /ka ling ga rten ru ljang lha mo'i/ /mngon par bka' bsgo labyed par 'gyur/ /de yi (snyerigs rnams su skyes pa/ /bdag dang bdag gir yiganang bas so/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /mchog gi dbang phyug ma bsgom bya/ /rkang pa gnyis kyi rtsa sngags su/ /sa bon yi ge las skyes pa'o/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /de 77)dang bral bas dngos grub med/ /oṃ sha (8natri ta sā sa zhu)ha ha sra sra ma mu hā khā sa ya ha hūṃ sre hūm̐ ka phaṭa ro swā mā hā ba lja n+ta brti ṇi hūm̐ 0rtsu phaṭa 0swā hā/ oṃ byā 12ma de bī ye 0rgyu 6hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni mchog 'di ni/ /bsgom bya bzlas dang bsam gtan no/ /rdo rje phag mo gnyis byar med/ /'bad pas rtsa ba'i sngags rnams su'o/ /zla mtshan gyi ni me tog gis/ /brlan bopa'i gos ni legs bskams lam/ /garga ṭa yi brun gyis 6)ni/ /dngos grub 'dod pas bdug spos sbyin / /sngags pas bdug spos 'di yis ni/ /bcom ldan 'das ma nye bar bya/ /78—585

phag mo nya༄yi ni sbyor ldan pas/ /'di skad kyi ni tshig 9basmras so/ /mthun (kyepa'i rtsa dang 'dus pa las/ /'gro ba thams cad g.yon las byung / /rang gi rgyud ni mdzes bzhin pa/ /zla mtshan gyi ni rdul gos so/ /brun kyang 'jig rten gsum po dang / /ye shes bsres pas spos su 'gyur/ /byi la bzhin du bzhag pa'i sems/ /t+yā yi yi ger tshig 'di'o/ /ljang gu'ang 90snying rje'i sbyor ba ste/ /lha mo de bzhin dbu ma'o/ /ci zhig bde ba rig pa ci/ /ci zhig don dam pa'i spyod yul/ /gos bzhin pa ni rnal 'byor cher(zhe/ /rnam par shes pa lha mor 'dod / /skye bo kun gyi bdag nyid ches/ /bgrod pa mtshams rnams kun du'o(yi//thod pa kha sbyor 97rabacing byas nas/ /spa rnams kyis ni sbyin sreg (kyebarjod/ /'di ni me tog tu grags te/ /dam tshig so sor skyong bar byed/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor ma mchod bya/ /zhi ba'i btung ba phyoganyin rer ro/ /de ltar byed pa'i sngags shes pa1 nol/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster po/ /ba lang sha ni chang btags yipa/ /lag pa g.yon pas sbyin sreg 1 bya/ /lha thams cad dang rgyu skar bcas/ /klu nyurtesogs sum cu'i gnas pa dang / /sangs rgyas kyang ni dbang 'gyur na/ /phra mo'i mi ni slar yang ci1 sku/ /lud pa dang ni so shing dang / /rang lus dril phyis de bzhin du/ /ming gis chang btags sbyin sreg gis/ /'jig rten medang bcas dbang du byed/ /zla mtshan gyi ni khrag dang ni/ /bza' ba zos pa'i skyugs nyastepa ni/ /mi yi skra dang yongs ldan pas/ /da lta nyid du 'gugs byed mchog /rang lus mar gyi skyugs pa dang / /rang gi skra ni mkhas pas bsreg(1 tsho /nim pa'i me ni 'bar ba yis/ /mod la snang bar byed pa'i mchog /bya rog gshog (1nyepas sbyin sreg 517byed/ /mnyam gzhag zhu sidha du sne/ra yi mes/ /mar nag 78—586

tshan de 1)yongs ldan pas/ /mod la gsod dang (2)skyod pa yin/ /stong phrag dgu yi sreg blugs 9kyikyis/ /yun mi ring pas rgyal po 'thob/ /gang zhig bsreg pa'i sreg blugs gyoni/ /mkhas pas brgya ni sha yis te/ /de la zla ba gsum rjes la / /skad cig la ni phongs pa 'joms/ /gang gis rgyun du dran byed na/ /de (5)ni skye bo'i mthun (6)par 'gyur/ /mtshan mo nyi shu rtsa gcig gis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom (gemed/ /lus med tshogs mchog bud med rnams/ /myos pa'i bsam can 'grub 'gyur ro/ /'dod pas myos pa'i 'jig rten rnams/ /mi 'jigs pa ni sbyin par byed/ /bud med bye bas yongs bskor nas/ /grub pa sa yi steng du rol/ /(sherdo rje phag mo sbyor ldan pa/ /dpal ho ru ku'i rnal 'byor mnyam / /rdo rje slob dpon gzhan dang 'dir/ /dpa' bo kun gyis phyag byed de99)la/ /dam tshig spyod pa srun pa yi71 dī/ /'jig rten gsum la dngos grub ster/ /sngon bshad rnal 'byor sbyor ba yis/ /de ltar sbyin sreg byas pas 'grub/ /rnal 'byor las gzhan las med de/ /las dang bral bas sbyor ba med/ /'pho ba bcu gnyis rnams kyi malas/ /rlung 'bab pa ni de rnams son/ /gnyis kyi mtshams ni 'dus pa las/ /sbyin sreg thab kyi kyi nang du blta/ /lte ba gnyis ni 'dus par te/ /slar yang mtshams rnams thams cad du'o/ /de yi dus su shes bya ba/ /sngags kyang yi ge la 'bum phragazhus /bzlas byas bskul ba gsang ba yis / /byas pas kun nas dngos grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i 'khrul 'khor rab byas teyi / /de nas gcig gis dman lnga bcu/ /re'u mig sa la gzhag 7par bya/ /sngags pas gnod mdzes rgyal po'i sngags/ /de la thog mar rnam snang mdzad/ /bdun pa la yang slar de'o/ /dgu par su yi sa yi ge sbyin/ /bcu gsum pa la gri 1 78—587

yig go/ /bcu bdun pa ①ni bha yig ste/ /slar yang bcu dgu pa la ṇ+ḍal/ /sum cu gcig par gri (8)yig sbyin/ /sum cu gsum par ni yig go/ /sum cu bdun par sbyin bya ba/ /mkhas pas ṇ+ḍa'i ④yi ger (5)sbyar/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa 'dir ni/ /de bzhin su yi yi ge sbyin/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gsum par de bzhin/ /ye shes sa bon sbyar bar bya/ /bzhi bcu rtsa dgu par sbyin pa/ /thams cad ⑥shes pas sta'i yig /dum bu gnyis par sbyin bya ba/ /rig byed rnams kyi thog ⑦dbyangs so/ /dum bu drug par de bzhin 'dir/ /rlung ni dus thams cad du'o / /bcu par gri (85yi yi ge sbyin/ /bcu gnyis pa la ba yig go/ /bcwa ⑨brgyad pa la r+gha 57yig ste/ /sum cu gnyis par ya yig go/ /sum cu brgyad par smra husteyig ste/ /bzhi bcu pa la ya'i tunyes bon/ /bzhi bcu rtsa 8bzhi 8de bzhin 'dir / /gri hodeyi yi ge slar sbyin bya/ /bzhi bcu brgyad par sngags pa yis/ /rtag tu r+ghaṃ yig gzhom 17med pa'o/ /brgyad par de bzhin du ni 'dir/ /slar yang yi ge kun 1 tshodabang phyug /bzhi bcu pa ru dza yig ste/ /bcu drug pa la bha yig go/ /nyi shu pa la ā'i nyu yi ge/ /nyi shu bzhi par ga yig go/ /nyi shu drug par 37na slar sbyin/ /sum cu pa la wān zhu sbyar bya/ /sum cu bzhi par ya sbyin te//rā sdo nyeyig sum cu drug de bzhin/ /bzhi bcu gnyis par rtsu sbyin bya/ /rdo rje 'khrul 'khor bsdus pa'o/ /dum bu bcu gnyis rnams la ni/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i ming gzhug bya/ /rtsu yig dum bu thams cad kyi/ /bsgrub bya rnams kyi dbus su bri/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis yongs su bskor/ /rdo rje yi ni phreng ba bya/ /'khor lo zung ni bri snga )bya ste/ /dbang la kham 3lor sa mthil la'o/ /'khrul 'khor rdo rje las byung ba/ /dbang gi rdzas kyis yang dag bri/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 78—588

'chang ba yang / /de tshe myur du byon par 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams phab pa las / /dam tshig der ni bya ba yin/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg stigis/ /sngags kyi gtso mo shes par bya/ /dpa' bo gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /de las las mchog bshad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi gsang mchod pa/ /rtag tu 'khyud pas mchog rab byed/ /mtshan mo kun du sgrub pa po/ /de nas pho nya mchod par bya/ /sha za'i rtsa ba khar bcug nas②/ /ji srid 'dod pa'i bar du ni / /de srid ling ga las rung 'gyur/ /gzhan du nga yis ma bshad do/ /sa yi lcag ①ma til mar du/ /btsos ④pas rkang pa byug par bya/ /mkhas pa de yi mtshan ma ni/ /dus thams cad du rengs pa (shemakhas/ /pā tha ka ṭu ka ro hi ni0la/ /rta yi medri dang 'di rnams ni/ /cha rnams mnyam par bya ba ste/ /brtse chen cho ga'i lhag ma ni/ /arka'i (nye'o ma dang btags nas/ /de yis ling ga dril phyis bya/ /gang gi tshad du 'dod pa yi/ /de yi tshad du 'gyur zhes bya/ /myur ba ru ni chu dron gyis/ /bkru ba byas na sngon gyi tshad/ /pad+ma dkar po'i ke sa ra/ /sbrang dang btags pa'i byung ba ni/ /byin na ling ga brtan ⑨pa ru/ /de 'gyur 'dod ma la spyod do/ /pad+ma dkar po'i ge sar ni/ /til dkar po dang de bzhin gzhan/ /mar sar dang ni dpa' gcig gi/ /rtsa ba sbrang dang lhan cig tu/ /btags nas lte bar byug byas na/ /de srid ling ga mi ltung ngo / /rdul can ma dang yung ba gnyis/ /yongs 8bzung ba yi dar ba dang / /bre do gdu bar bya ba ste/ /bre gang ma gyur bar du'o/ /de ltar 'thungs pas 17nyin bdun na/ /bcud len rdzogs par byed pa yin/ /de ltar sbyor ba mchog gtso bo / /yang dag dpa' bos gsungs pa'o/ / spre'u'i mchin pa 8bzung nas ni/ /78—589

phye 1ma zhib mo ru ni bya/ /rang gi dbang po yang dag ldan/ / dbang du ( byed pa bla med pa'o/ /gang dang gang du gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje phag mo buzlos gyur nas54 / /lan cig bzlas 5pa'i sdigs mdzub ༷yikyis/ /g.yon dang g.yas su bskor bar 7bya/ /gang gang bsam dun pa thams cad rnams/ /de ni thams cad rab ster byed/ /so ba gos dang gser dang ni/ /bza' ston zas dang btung (peb ste/ /de thams cad ni 'thob byed de/ /sngags pas de bzung yongs rdzogs byed / /rnam 'gyur med pa dang ni khrag /sgrub pos gcig tu byas nas ni/ /rig pa lan bdun bzlas pa yis/ /de nas mi la bskus pa yis/ /reg pas skyes bu rnams phye bar/ /'gyur te tshig ni gzhan du min/ /'di yi rig pa lan cig 7ni/ /bzlas pa'i chu yis grol ba yin/ /de ltar gang dang gang gi ni/ /sems can gyi khrag khrag 11gis ni/ /bsgos pa'i skud pa bcings pa yis /bzlas pas gzugs ni 'dzin pa ste/ /'di rnams thams cad chus grol bar/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tsom 12med/ /bud med gzugs mdzes rgyal po dang / /sa yi bdag po la bltas na/ /sgrub pos nyusnyem mthong ba yang ni/ /de rnams thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags 7byas na/ /de yi mtshan mo 'ong ba ste/ /nub bdun na ni mda' shugs kyis/ /'ong ba la ni the tsom 32med/ /de ltar bya dang bya min pa'i/ /las kun rdo rje'i nor son par/ /rang gis rig pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /ye shes pha rol son pa 'grub/ /'khrul 'khor khams kyi re'u mig tu/ /rtsa ni phra mo'i gzugs can ma/ /yi ge 7rlung chen po yin te/ /lha ni kun du 'gro ba'o/ /ljang gu kyi gnyis med bdag chen mo//lha mo ye shes rgya mtsho yin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje 78—590

sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med pa'i ljang lha mo'i dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg tsa)dang 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba ste le'u sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan mkha' 'gro yirin// /bdag po yis ni slar gsungs pa/ /lam pa ka yis (kyerab sbyor bas/ /shin 4)bzang rnal 'byor ma'i sbyor ba/ /shes rab stobs su shes bya ste/ /'khrul 'khor rta yi 'gros de bzhin/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sbyor bas (snyebazhugs/ /rtsa sngags rnal 'byor pa yis so/ /ye shes ldan pa dbugs rgyu'i bdag /kun rdzob bden pa kun nas 'dzin/ /rtsa yi kun du spyod lugs las/ /stobs ni las rnams thams cad du'o/ /gnyid 6log pa yis rab zhugs ⑦pa'i/ /srog thams cad ni de'i nang du'o/ /las chen po la za bzhin pa/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis 98)byas nas ni/ /bdud rtsi dron mo bzhu byas nas / /de'i dbus rtsa (9ri rnams kyis 'khor lo7/ /de ni sum cu bdun bdag nyid / /'phyang bzhin pa ni byang chub skyes/ /me yi rnam par rtag lha mo/ /gtso mo rnams kyis snying bdag nyid/ /keng rus rlung dang rnam shes /kāl/ /phyin nas dur khrod bdag nyid rnams/ /de yi sa bon yig shes nas/ /pho nya rnams kyis rtag tu bskyed/ /re re yi ni sa bon gyi/ /mtha' 12ni rtsa ba'i gsang sngags so/ /oṃ ma dz+nyā hā na pi sā shig ta 12ra ru pra dhi bhā 1 ra ya ba hūm̐ swā 15rgyu hā pha ri ṭa ṇi pha hūṃ ṭa rtsu swā phaṭa hā phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ su bha dre hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar sngags 78—591

las yang dag byung / /las kyis 0)kha dog dang ni gzugs/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ /gsang ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /gtor ma dang ni sbyin sreg (2)bya/ /phyi nas las ni 'di (midag btsam/ /sngags pas lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /'bum phrag bzlas pa byas nas ni/ /sems can kun la bde 'byung ba'i / /'khrul 'khor 'khor lo bshad par bya/ /'khor lo sngon ma'i gzugs can ni/ /byas nas gsang sngags 'dir dgod bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad thog mar te/ /gnyis par de nas ni dgod bya/ /gsum par hūṃ yig sbyin bya ste/ /lnga par oṃ gyi yi ge'o/ /drug pa gri 4)yi yi ge sbyin/ /rtsu gi yi ge bdun pa ru'o(snye//brgyad par sta'i yi ge sbyin/ /bcu par su yiyi yi ge'o/ /bcu gnyis par ni hūṃ yig sbyin/ /bcu bzhi par ni gri yig go/ / bcwa lngar ⑦sna'i yi ge ste/ /bcu drug de bzhin hūm̐ yig go/ /bcu bdun pa ru su yig ste/ /bcu dgu pa ru ṇ+ḍa (kyesbyar bya/ /nyi shur 9)phaṭa yig sbyin par bya/ / ṇ+ḍa yig 7nyi shu rtsa gcig par/ /nyi shu dgu par rnam 11snang mdzad/ /sum cu pa ya'i 'o yi ge gnyis/ /sum cu gcig par slar de'o/ /rig byed dang po sum cu gsum/ /sum cu bzhi par ya ⑫yig ste/ /rā dza'i yig dag sum cu lngar/ /sum cu drug par za 8yig sbyin/ /sum cu brgyad par gri yig go/ /bzhi bcu par ni wan sbyin bya/ /bzhi bcu gnyis par ā 8de bzhin/ /bzhi bcu gsum pa ru ni 28/ /bzhi bcu bzhi pa hūṃ hūṃ dag /bzhi bcu lnga pa ru ni grit+na tsho/ /bzhi bcu bdun pa ru na ni8/ /bzhi bcu brgyad par sbyin bya ba/ /hūm̐ hūṃ gi ni yig gnyis so/ /bha ga'i sgra ni slar sbyin te/ /bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa la'o/ /lhag ma la ni rtsa sngags bri/ /'khor lo bzhi ru bsgrub bya'o/ /kun nas yongs su 'khor bar ni/ /sngags pas rta 78—592

mgrin ②bri bar bya/ /gnyis pas (kyegayon du bskor ba ste/ /'khrul 'khor kha sbyar 'khrul 'khor bya/ /gsang ba'i yi ge las skyes par/ /shes bya lhan skyes rnal 'byor pas/ /klu dgug pa dang dbang dang ni/ /lha la sogs pa gsad pa yin② / /rnal 'byor brtse ④bdag nyid can gyis/ /rang sems rtag tu gsad par ⑤bya/ /gar yiyang de'i yang snang ba ni/ /de yis thams cad bsad pa yin / /sdang sems can gyis gzhan du na/ / bsad pas (7)dngos grub rnams mi 'thob/ /bde mchog phyi ma'i las gang ni/ /de kun nges par byed par 6)'gyur / /re re yi ni las cung zad/ /mdor bsdus 'di ni bshad par bya/ /klu yi rgyal po de bzhin brgyad/ /mtha' yas rim pas bsgom par bya/ /nor rgyas srog tu shes par bya/ /thur du sel ba dung skyong ngo / /mnyam gnas ⑩pad+ma yi ni klu/ /bsam gtan pad+ma chen po'o/ /khyab gnas 'jog po yi ni klu/ /klu ni slar yang 0hu lu'o/ /rus 'o)sbal mtha' yas shes par bya/ /tsangs pa rgyal ba yi ni klu/ /lha sbyin rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /mtha' yas nor las rgyal ba'o / /'jug pa yis ni dgug pa ste/ /btang nya༄ba yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /bum pa can gyis char dbab pa/ /mnyam pa'i rlung gis bsal rnguba'o/ /rnam shes brgyad po de bzhin du/ /'dir ni klu mor shes par bya/ /ye shes nam mkha' dang gnyis gzhan/ /rnam par shes pa bcu yi rgyu/ /phuḥ8yi yi ge brgyad sbyin bya/ /ting 'dzin sna tshogs de bzhin no/ /phan tshun skyes tshabs dkris pa ste / /klu mo de yi mchan na 1khung du'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gzugs chen gyis/ /klu yi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /ji lta'i rim pas kha dog rnams/ /thun mtshams gnyis kyi thun tshod brgyadahunye/ /rtsa sngags mngon par brjod pa hu)nyid/ /78—593

klu dang klu mor shes par bya/ /dbang po thim par byas nas ni/ /yi ge la 'bum bzlas pa nyid/ /gang gang las ni phyi rol gyi/ /de de'i las kyi dbang tshul bya/ /gzugs ni gang 'dod par bya ste/ /khro bo'am zhi ba'i gzugs dag tu'o / /sems ni gzugs su yang dag grags/ /de phyir shin bzang ming can rnal/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun gyi bdag /de yis lha ni byed par 'gyur/ /slar yang phyi nang bdag nyid kyishi)/ /gzhan pa'i lha ni ma bshad do/ /de yis thams cad mngon brjod pas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gang 'dod 'gro/ /sems can rnams kyi bag chags skyon/ /phyi rol du yang sprin mthong 'gyur/ /bag chags zad pa'i dus su ni/ /sprin dang klu rnams mthong mi 'gyur/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags dang / shin tu bzang mo gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i bdag nyid can rta'i sngags mdor bstan pa rigs kyi klu'i las kyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba ste le'u sum cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas de phyir slar la yang / /lha mos mchod pa 'dir byas te/ /phag mo'i 'dod chags bcas pas so/ /mnyes nas lha yis ston pa mdzad/ /rta rna ma yi rab sbyor nasarin / /dus kun du ni kārtsir ri ro/ /ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag dang / /snying ga rtsa ru ni yang dag bzhugs/ /ha yig nā dang lus kun dul/ /snying ga'i (5dbus las kyang ni langs/ /yi ri yig bskyod pa yi ni srog /78—594

rdo rje'i rlung gis 3)bskyod pa yin/ /du tsam de bde dang bcas pa/ /slar yang 'dab 'dab (snyel gsum gsum/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi chos/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'dab zhi)ma brgyad/ /bcu gnyis lte ba'i pad+ma ru/ /rnal 'byor ma rtag sum cu drug /de tshe re re'i 'dir (4)rnams kyi(5ra/ /mtshams (6)kyis rta la sogs pa rnams / / ṇa yig (7)lha mo de ma yin/ /gsal dang mi gsal rang bzhin can/ /'dod pa'i khams su'ang skyes pa mo/ /thar pa'i gzugs kyi las can no/ /tsā yig 'pho ba yi ni chos/ /thams cad rig pa'i mtshams (8)las grol/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /gsod pa'i las la brtson par bya/ /gang gang gsod pa'i las rnams kyis/ /bla ma gsod la byed par 'gyur/ /bstan pa la ni gnod byed pa'am/ /de bzhin mtshams med lnga byed la9)/ /dug dang ske 1 rim lan tshwa hunyadang / /dha tu dur 51lhadur khrod sol ba dang / /rang gi sdigs mdzub 1 tshokhrag gis ni/ /'khor lo 'bad pas bri bar bya/ /gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor rtag tu de'i/ /byed 'gyur gzhan du ma yin no/ /sngon bshad re'u mig shes byas nas/ /gsang sngags phreng ba 'di dgod bya/ /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad de'i/ /gnyis par su lani rnam par brjod/ /gsum par sta'i yi ge brjod / /rig byed dang po lngar de bzhin/ /drug par gri yig de bzhin te/ /slar yang bdun 3 1par ṇ+ḍa 1 yig go/ /brgyad pa la ni hūm̐ yig gnyis/ /dgu par phaṭa yig de bzhin no/ /bcu par ni yig de bzhin te/ /slar yang bcu gnyis par rtsu yig /bcu gsum par ni phaṭa yig ste/ /gri yig bcu bzhi par de'o/ /rtsu gi yi ge bcwa nyu)lnga par/ /sta'i na /yi ge bcu drug par/ /bcu bdun pa ru su yig ste/ /hūṃ yig bcu dgu pa la'o/ /nyi shu pa la hūm̐ yig sbyin/ /ṇ+ḍa 21yig nyi 78—595

shu rtsa gcig par/ /rnam par snang mdzad nyi shu dgur/ /sum cu pa ②slar gri yig go/ /sum cu gcig par smra ②yig ste/ /sum cu gsum par rnam snang mdzad / /sum cu bzhi par ā ④yig dang / / na yi yi ge der ⑤sbyar bya/ /sum cu lnga par ya'i sa bon/ /ho yig der ni sbyin par bya/ /sum cu drug par rtsu gnyis rdo sbyin96)/ /sum cu bdun par phaṭa yig go/ /sum cu brgyad par pa ya gnyis / /bzhi bcur hūṃ gnyis de bzhin no/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa la phaṭa/ /bzhi bcu gnyis par bha ga gnyis/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa la ni/ /pa ya gnyis dag yi ge'o/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa la sna(7na/ /bzhi bcu lnga par gri yig go/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa la ni/ /rā dza'i sgra ni sbyar bar bya/ /bit+yā'i sgra ni slar sngags (8)pas/ /dum bu bzhi bcu brgyad par ro/ /wān yig slar yang sbyin bya ba / /bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa la'o/ /lhag ma rnams la go cha'i sngags/ /bsgrub bya'i ming nang bcug pa'o/ /gshin rje'i gdong ni grwa kun du/ /lag pa rkang pa phyogs su dgod/ /snying ga 79rigashin rje'i sa gzhi ⑩ni/ /de yi dbus su bsgom par bya/ /ye shes rnam shes sbyor bdag nyid/ /mkhas pas sngags kyi kun spyod byam/ /bla ma dam tshig la brnyas pa'ang / /rnam par shes dang blo dman pa'o/ /bstan pa phosprel ni gnod byed pa/ /mig la sogs pa'i skye mched do/ /mtshams ⑫med lnga po byed pa ni/ /phung po khams dang de bzhin gzhan/ /sems can thams cad gcig pa yi/ /rigs ni phung po sogs dang khams/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyis te(1snye/ /bsad par sems can khams bsad pa'o/ /gang dang gang gi blagadong bltas nas/ /de dang de'i bdag nyid gzugs can/ /bag chags ye shes kyis bsad par8/ /'gyur ro sems can gzhan bsad 78—596

min / /de rnams gsod ①pa'i las sam yang / /byas pas (gebasad pa de dang 'dra / /sbyin sreg ②dug la sogs rdzas kyis/ /yang dag rig gzugs can gyis bya / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo der dran bya/ /bsreg (4)pa gtum mo la ni'o/ /sa bon yi ge las skyes pa/ /dkyil 'khor rta rna ma yi'o/ /kha dog dang ni dbyibs sngon gyirgya/ /shes rab thabs kyi mchod pa che(6)/ /oṃ shrī sa: (7)rba si mā (8)tā 6)ra ra ba kā la ra lha kā si ya ne 74 hūm̐ rtsu hūṃ 'phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā swā hā hā/ oṃ ha hunayā /rje 0rgyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor rnams ngo mtshar skyes nas ni/ /skrag nas sa la 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /kye ma tshul 'di mi shes pa'isnyi/ /'jig rten rnams ni rmongs pa nyid/ /gang gi bde kun la gnas nas/ /srog gis 'di la tshar gcod 7pa'o/ /mtshar tsonas sems can sar 'gyel bas/ /lag na rdo rje sogs bzhengs nas/ /pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs hu snanas/ /bdag nyid chen po bdag 'dri'o/ /ci yis bdag dang gang gi nyid/ / de rnams bsad pa'am las sam yang / /8'bras bu dang ni rgyu'i rang bzhin3ste/ /bcom ldan gang du rnam par gzhag /gal te nyid kyi 'bras rnams kyis/ /gsod ( )pa de dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /yang na 0rgyu ni 32bcom ldan tsho phul/ /'bras bu skyes bu gsod pa yin / /bdag gi bdag pos bka' stsol cig /the tsom 9 —stebasal bar mdzad du gsol / /bka' stsal pa/ rtse gcig pa yis tshig de la/ /rdo rje khyed kyis mnyan 2)par gyis/ /'bras bu las kyi rjes su mthun25/ /bdag ni bde ba kun gyi gnas/ /de'i las dbang gis sangs rgyas dang bla tsho/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed du)rnams so/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin ni/ /gnyis su med pas gcig tu gyur0/ /de ni dngos po kun gyi rgyu/ /mkhas pa las ni rkyen yin no/ /78wa 597

dmag dpung la sogs sa chen la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis mthong ba yis/ /thams cad gnyis med bdag nyid bya/ /de'i phyir gsod pa dang ldan pa'o/ /bdag nyid bsad pas 1sangs rgyas nyid/ /skye bo gzhan kun gyis ma yin/ /dus kyi nadabang gis rgyal 3srid na/ /tshegs ri4)chung las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de yi phyir na 55)sngon gyi las/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis brtags byas nas(6)/ /khams ni dpa' bo'i rang bzhin du/ /de dang der ni gdags par bya/ /de yis bdag nyid bsad pa yis/ /sems can khams rnams de nyid do/ /'bad pas brtse ba bskyed byas nas/ /nges par gsad (7)par bya ba yin/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /brtse ba dman pas 'grub mi 'gyur / /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rta rna ma dang dpa' bo gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas go cha dang rtsa ba'i sngags kyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi bsad ri9pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi bcu pa'o// //de nas smyo bar byed pa yi1 / /sbyor ba kun du rnyed dka' ba/ /bya gdong ma yi rab sbyor bas/ /mdor bsdus pa yis bshad par bya/ /brtson 'grus byang chub yan lag chos/ / hi mā 11la yar yang dag zhugs12/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /'khor lo'i gtso 1 mo bsgom par bya/ /mkha' gzugs nyid bdag pho nya mo/ /rkan dang rdo rje chu skyes dbus/ /rnam shes rlung dang lhan cig tu/ /mda' yi 1 shugs kyis gyen du 'phangasanyu5/ /lus ni 'dar 78wa 598

'dar bya ba ste/ /drag shul sbyar 1bas bya ba yin/ /rtag tu byed bzhin rnal 'byor pa/ /mchog tu zag med 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ji srid mi 'dod par/ /rlung dang rnam shes g.yo nami 'gyur/ /sna yi bu gar son dasrog la / /lte ba'i dbus su bskyod par bya/ /lte ba sna nya gnyis sbyor ba yis/ /'dzin 55)bzhin pa yis g.yo mi 'gyur/ /rlung dang rnam shes lhan cig tu/ /de ni smyo bas 'khor ba yin/ /de'i 'dus sbyor ba'i bdag nyid la'ang 7/ /dngos po thams cad mthong ba gang / /de dang 'dra ba'i dngos por 'gyur/ /dha du ra'i me'i sbyin sreg na gis/ /shing la dpyangs pa'i skra 9dang ni/ /sha za'i nya rtsa ba bsreg par bya/ /'di yi las kyi rab sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas skad cig gis smyo 'gyur/ /de phyir brtson 'grus byang yan 11lag /de rnams las ni mngon par bya/ /brtson 'grus rdzogs byang chub mthong bas/ /rtag tu myur du thob nyartepar 'gyur/ /hi yig 'phyang ba'i ye shes su/ /rang nyid dpa' bos bshad pa yin/ /mā 1lhayig kyang ni rang rig pa/ /bdag nyid rnam pa'i gnas bzhugs de'i/ /thim dang longs spyod rnam pa'i gzugs/ /sangs rgyas sku can skye bar 'gyur/ /rang gis lorig bdag rig pa rnams/ /sems can don byas nas gshegs 'gyur/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /las kyi lornal 'byor ma bsgom 11bya/ /mdog dang gzugs ni sngon gyi bzhin/ /gsang sngags sbyor las yang dag byung / /oṃ a sa n+t+ra rba mā nā lā gā dhā rmā 18ri sho 19rte ṣa rdu ṇa 2 t+t+waṃ sta phaṭa spe m+bha phaṭa 25na swā bi hā r+sā 2lhab ṇa ya hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kha gā na ne hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya'i sngags kyi sbyor bdag nyid/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /ji lta ba ni sngon gyi bzhin/ /'khrul 'khor 'khor 78—599

lo bshad par bya/ /yi dgas 'khor lor rtag tu ni/ /sngags kyi phreng ba 'di dgod bya/ /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad de/ /gnyis par m+bha sbyar bar bya/ /gsum par de nyid de ltar sbyin/ /lnga par rig byed rnams dang po/ /ṇ+ḍa ①yig drug par sbyin par bya/ /hūṃ gi yi ge bdun par dgod/ /brgyad par su yi yi ge ste/ /dgu par de nyid sbyin par bya/ /bcu par hūṃ gnyis sbyin bya ste/ /gri yig slar yang bcu gnyis par/ /bcu gsum pa la ṇ+ḍa'i yi ge(27/ /bcu bzhi pa la hūm̐ yig ( go/ /bcwa rigelnga pa la ni yig ste/ /hūṃ yig bcu drug pa la dgod/ /bcu bdun pa la phaṭa yig ste/ /gri yig bcu dgu pa la'o/ /rgyu yig nyi shu pa la sbyin / /phaṭa yig nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /rnam snang mdzad pa nyi shu dgur/ /sum cur ṇ+ḍa (5)yig slar dgod bya/ /sum cu gcig par gyo)de nyid sbyin/ /sum cu gsum par rnam snang mdzad/ /sum cu bzhi par ya 57)ho gnyis/ /sum cu lnga par rā dza gnyis/ /gri yig sum cu drug par sbyin/ /sum cu bdun par de nyid do/ /sum cu brgyad par hūm̐ t+t+waṃ gnyis/ /bzhi bcur ā (8)na ya yi tshig /bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa la wān594)/ /hūm̐ gnyis bzhi bcu gnyis pa la/ /bzhi bcu gsum par pa ya ste/ /bzhi bcu bzhi par de nyid do/ /bzhi bcu lnga par hūṃ dang phaṭa/ /bha ga bzhi bcu bdun par ro/ /bzhi bcu brgyad pa 7ru ni rgyu/ /bzhi bcu rtsa nyurnyedagu pa la hunyephaṭa/ /stong par /stesnying po yi ni sngags/ /bsgrub bya'i ming nang bcug pa'o/ /kha yis 'khrul 'khor la 'dzin pa'i/ /thams cad du ni yi dgas bri/ /dur khrod kyi ni ras la ni/ /kha masbyar rnam par bya ba yin/ /lte ba'i gnas su 'khor lo 'di/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /yi dgas chos dbyings ngo bo nyid/ /rtog pa gsol phyir gshin rtsonarje yin/ /rta yang gnas 78wa 600

dang gnas min du'o/ /snying po'i byang chub kyis hu༄rdo rje/ /klu'i 'gros theg pa che rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin skye bo thams cad kyi'o/ /dge dang mi dge ro langs te / /sems can bslu ②bas bgrod pa'o/ /gzhan ni theg pa gsum po yang / /sngon gyi las ①can ston pa yin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ / 'di ni 'a)dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las bya gdong ma dang dpa' bo gnyis su med ⑤pa'i smyo bar byed pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i snying po'i sngags dang bcas pa'i las zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas 'khor shugs ma'i sbyor bas/ /brang 'gro'i 'khor lo bshad par bya/ /pre ⑥ta pu rir byang yan lag /dga' ba zhes bya mdor bsdus pas/ /stobs rnams thams cad rengs byed pal/ /'khor los sgyur (8)sogs las can no/ /yung ba rgya skyegs bsres ⑨pa yis/ /'khrul ⑩'khor thod pa la bri bya/ /spyod do dus ni thams cad du/ /lte ba sogs su phyed bcas gsum/ /ro langs kyi 3)ni gzugs bdag nyid/ /'gro dang 'ong ba rengs byed pa'o/ /bud med phyag rgya bzang bcas pas/ /rim gyis dbugs ni dbyung bar bya/ /kun bdag gtso bo rnam par shes/ /bde ba rnams su thim par 'gyur/ /de ni g.yo bar mi 'gyur te / /blo ldan dus rnams thams cad du'o/ /'di yi bya ba kun med pa/ /byas pa'i bdag nyid 8rab 'byung ba8/ /las kyis skosangs rgyas kyi ni zhing / /de yi 78—601

gnas ni dpag par bya/ /rnal 'byor pas dngos gang gang dran/ /de de da ltar rengs par byed/ /de yi las kyis spyod nyapa yis/ /slar yang las gzhan dran mi bya/ /de dang der ni byang chub che/ /skye bo thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /slar yang yongs su mya ngan 2'das pa'ang / /byas nas bde ba che las 'jug /rī dani 'dod chags rang bzhin 'dir/ /skye bo thams cad byed pa'o/ /byang chub yan lag dga' las skyes/ /rang bzhin der ni byung parib yin/ /'khor shugs ma yi gnas bzhugs 5te/ /de ltar rengs pa'i las bya'o/ /kha dog dbyibs ni sngon gyi ste/ /'khor lo'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag nyid/ /de yi gnas la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /oṃ kro su dha me bi ru gra 7ka ha ma dhā /pi ra ta ṇa nā 99ri ya dā hūm̐ ya rtsu rtsu pha rgyu ṭa pha pha ṭa ṭa pha swā ṭa hā swā hā/ o tsakra be ge 1 ris hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo chen mo gsang sngags 'di/ /mchog las shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /'khor lo'ang sngon gyi (1bshad pa ste/ /gcig gis dman pa'i lnga bcu'i bdag /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad de/ /su yig slar yang gnyis par ro/ /gsum pa'i dum bur m+bha sbyin bya/ /ni yig bzhi par de bzhin no/ /lnga par su yig sbyin par bya/ /slar yang drug par sta'i yig go/ /hūm̐ yig bdun par sbyin bya ste/ /rlung gi yi ge brgyad par ro12/ /gri yig dgu par sbyin par bya/ /bcu par ṇ+ḍa 1 yig de bzhin no / /bcu gcig pa ru pa sbyin te/ /de nas bcu gnyis par ya yig /rtsu gi yi ge bcu gsum par/ /bcu bzhi pa ru rtsu yig go/ /pa yi yi ge bcwa bolnga par/ /baṃ yig bcu drug par dgod bya/ /bi yi yi ge bcu bdun par/ /slar yang byā yig bcwa 1gebargyad par/ /gcig gis dman pa'i nyi shur rā/ /nyi shu pa la hūṃ 7 78wa 602

slar dgod4)/ /nyi shu gcig par de nyid sbyin/ /smya 2yig nyi shu gnyis par dgod / /ga yig nyi shu gsum par te rko/ /nyi shu bzhi par phaṭa yig go/ /nyi shu drug par dza yig sbyin/ /hūṃ yig nyi shu bdun par ro/ /nyi shu brgyad par phaṭa yig ste/ /gri yig nyi shu dgu pa la'o ci/ /sum cu pa la bha yig ste/ /sum cu gcig par hūṃ yig go/ /sum cu gnyis par de nyid sbyin/ /hūṃ yig sum cu gsum par ro/ /phaṭa yig sum cu bzhi par te/ /sum cu lnga par oṃ dgod bya/ /sum cu drug par de nyid sbyin/ /sum cu bdun par ho de bzhin/ /ya yi gsum cu rtsa brgyad par(5/ /sum cu rtsa dgu pa la ni/ /bzhi bcu pa la ā sbyin byam/ /bzhi bcu gcig pu nel ni oṃ/ /gri yig bzhi bcu gnyis par te/ /bzhi bcu gsum par phaṭa dgod bya/ /rtsu yig bzhi bcu bzhi par te/ /bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa ru 97)rgyu/ /bzhi bcu drug par rtsu sbyin bya/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa la ṇ+ḍi/ /gri (8 yig bzhi bcu brgyad par te/ /gcig dman lnga bcu pa la ṇ+ḍa9/ /de ltar 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo ni/ /mgrin pa 1 las skyes rtag dgod bya/ /rengs pa thams cad lus chen las/ /srog ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin che/ /sbyor bar 11byas pa gang de ltaralho / /sems can gnod byed rengs pa'oti / /grol ba sems can thams cad la/ /rnal 'byor pa'i yang yid kyis so/ /lo gcig tu ni goms pa las / /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tsom 1 med/ /nye ba yi ni snying po'i sngags/ /re'u mig dbus mar yang dag bri/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni nang bcug nas/ /rlung dang rnam shes thim par bya/ /brang 'gro 'khyil par grags pa ste/ /'khrul 'khor yang lus can rnams kyi'o/ /ri bo phung por 'gro ba ste/ /byang chub sems ni thod pa'o/ /de yi steng du ster ba nyid/ /mkhas pa 15'khrul 'khor 78wa 603

gang gis so/ /yi ge thams cad rang bzhin te/ /nyin zhag las kyang shes par bya / /sems kyi bran po chen po yi/ /dba' 0)rlabs rengs par bya ba yin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'i rengs par bya ba'i las dpa' bo dang gnyis su med (mipa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin ①zhes bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas dum skyes ma'i sbyor bas/ /ji lta'i las ni gsal bshad bya/ /las thams cad pa'i thab (4༄byas nas/ /ji lta'i cho gas sbyin sreg ⑤ste/ /las kyi cho ga rnams mthong bas/ /bskrad pa'i las ni bsgrub par bya/ /gri ha de ba tā gnas su/ /shin sbyangs byang chub yan lag tu'o/ /nam mkha'i bu ga'i byang sems kyang / /'dzin pa chen po steng 'phen 'gyur/ /bskam bya aḥyiyi rnam pas te/ /mgo bor rnam par gzung bar bya/ /ṇ+ḍa ⑦yi shes 'gro bya ste/ /mda' yi (8)shugs kyis yongs su 'khor/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor can bsgoms nasal/ /mgo bo'i dbus su rgyal mtshan te/ /rnam shes de ni bskyed ⑨par 'gyur / /dpag tshad 'bum phrag stong phrag can/ /sangs rgyas nyid ma lus pa 'thoba'i / /rnal 'byor pa de sa gsum du/ /hā hā he he rnam brgyad du/ /mkha' 'gro'i sbyor bas dgod pa'o/ /mkha' spyod 'gro ba'i bya ba yis/ /rnal 'byor ma ni der byed do/ /rang gis chung rtag gyen bgrod las/ /khyim du 'chi rtsom78—604

bar shes par bya/ /'phrog pa sdig pa thams cad de/ /snang ba'i dbang po'i cho ga can/ /sbyin bya theg pa chen po kun/ /rtag tu sbas pa med rgyus so/ /rdo rje 'dzin ①pa'i dbugs dbyung ba'ang/ /sems can thams cad la sbyor bya/ /de srid rdo rje rnal 'byor che/ /ji srid bsgrub byar mi spyod par/ /shin tu sbyangs pa chos kun du/ /ye shes shes bya'i bdag nyid du(2)/ /byang chub yan lag nyid ③kyis blta / /yid ④de chos can thams cad do/ /de ltar bye brag chos shes pa⑤/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu bstan(6)/ /theg pa chen por bskrad pa ste/ /sbyin sreg ⑦'di yis rdzogs par bya/ /bya rog sha gshog (8)chu rgyus dang / /bya rgod tshad stan mngon par ni/ /de yi sems kyis bsreg par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang skyod ⑨byed na/ /sa gzhi'i mchung ngu'i 'jig rten pa'i/ /skye 'gro kun la smos ci dgos/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dbus su/ /sngon du bshad pa can bsgom bya/ /sngags kyi yi ge las byung ba/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /oṃ bu ma dha hunyehā ko kā ṭi sha sa ti ha (2la sra kā k+ṣa t+ma hunye'o ne ④ni rtsu t+pā 8rgyu da 0phaṭa nā 7phaṭa ya swā hūṃ hā rdu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi (snye r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya'i sngags las yang dag byung / /'khrul 'khor sngon bdag nyid dngos can/ /gcig dman lnga bcu'i bdag nyid kyi'o)/ /re'u mig gnod mdzes sngags gnas su/ /rnam par snang mdzad thog mar teso )/ /gnyis par de nyid sbyin par bya/ /ā ( sheyig gsum par sbyin bya ste/ / bzhi par na yi yi ge'o/ /sogalnga pa ya dzo steyi yi ge'o/ /drug par ya yig sbyin bya bste/ /bdun par su yi yi ge'o/ /brgyad par phaṭa kyi yi ge ste/ /dgu par su yig de bzhin rnal/ /bcu par rnam par snang mdzad de/ /gri 69yig bcu gcig par dgod bya/ /78—605

bcu gnyis pa la smya yig 1ge/ /bcu gsum pa la m+bha yi 2yig /bcu bzhi pa la na'i sa bon/ /bcwa )lngar t+t+waṃ gnyis de bzhin no/ /bcu drug pa la hūṃ phaṭa te/ /bcu bdun pa la rnam snang mdzad/ /bcwa 4brgyad pa la tsho'i yig 5dge/ /bcu dgu pa la gri dgod bya/ /nyi shu pa la pa yig (6)sbyin/ /nyi shu gcig par ya 7sbyar bya/ /nyi shu gsum par hūṃ yig ste/ /nyi shu bzhi par hūm̐ phaṭa dgod/ /hūṃ yig nyi shu drug par sbyin/ /nyi shu bdun par ya sbyor bya/ /r+ghaṃ yig nyi shu dgu par te/ /dza yig dang por sbyin par bya/ /sum cu pa la de nyid sbyin/ /gri yig sum cu rtsa gcig par / /sum cu gnyis par hūm̐ yig ste/ /ṇ+ḍi 9ri yig sum cu gsum par ro/ /sum cu bzhi par gri 1 sbyin bya/ /sum cu lnga par ho dgod bya / /sum cu drug par rā yig ste/ /sum cu bdun par rtsu phaṭa gnyis/ /sum cu brgyad par ya sa bon/ /gcig dman bzhi bcu pa la ya/ /bzhi bcu pa la ṇ+ḍi 11sbyin bya/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa la rgyu/ /bha yig bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis par3na//bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa la ni/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa la byā/ /bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa la bi / /bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa la wānanyuge/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa la gci /m+bha yig bzhi bcu dgu par te/ /'khrul 'khor ro langs su gzhug bya/ /le'u tshe lnga ru bsgrub bya dang / /rnal 'byor ma drug go char bcas/ /gsang sngags nang du chud bya ste/ /ro langs kha ru dgod par bya/ /gang dang gang gi ming gis ni/ /'khrul 'khor brtse chen gyis bre 15bya/ /de dang de yir shes bya ste/ /mkhas pa yis ni bskrad 7pa'o/ /gsang ba chen po mi bstan no/ /skye ba 'di nyid la 'grub pa'o/ /gsang sngags brjod pa ma byas shing / /bsgom 51 bral rnal 'byor pa yang ngo / /bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i 1 gnang bas/ /khyab bdag ji ltar 'dod 78wa 606

par spyod/ /de phyir bla ma bsnyen bya zhing / /bdag chen rnams kyis mnyes par bya/ /de yis dgyes pas 'thob pa ste/ /las kyis 3)byang chub 'byung ba'o/ /'khrul 'khor 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /mgo bor nasarnam par bsgom par bya/ /des mngon grub par 5)shes bya ste44kyi/ /dus gzhan 5rnams su 'grub pa min/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las dum skyes ma'i rab tu sbyor ba sgom 6pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskrad pa'i las rnal 'byor ma drug gi go cha'i sngags kyi cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba ste le'u bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas ro langs zung gi ni/ /sdang byed 'khrul 'khor de bzhin du/ /chang 'tshong ma yi rab sbyor bas/ /mdor bsdus pa yis rab bshad bya/ / sau rāṣ+ṭa 777yi gnas bsgrubs nas/ /yan lag rab tu rnam 'byed chos/ /byang chub the tshom med 'thob par/ /mchog gi 'dod 8ma shes par bya/ /myos byed chen por 9sbyor byed par/ /sho yi 7yi ges rab tu bshad/ /bcud len dngos po dam pa 11yang ske/ /mchog gi pad+ma dag 12tu 'dzin/ /smin ma'i dbus su snal ma gang / /rdo rje kyi nor bu'i nang phyin nas/ /snyoms par 'jug las skye bzhin par/ /ṇ+ḍi yig rang gis reg mi btu/ /reg med der ni rnam shes kyis/ /mchog gi chu mimo btung bar bya/ /bdag med pa yi nang du ste/ /de ni nī yi yi ges 15bshad/ /ye shes 'di 'dra btung byas pas/ /dbang po thams cad rab myos te/ /dbye 78—607

ba de tshe de rnams su/ /yid kyis rtsod pa byed par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po la rol pa/ /sau yi yi ge ①bdag gis bshad/ /ro ma bsdams pa'i sbyor ba yis /ma mchu 'jib par bya ba yin/ /rta dang ma he'i 'khrul 'khor du/ /dbye du ba srog dang thur sel la'o/ /ṣ+ṭa yig tshigs pa thams cad du/ /shes par byed par the tsom lamed/ /yan lag rab tu rnam 'byed ④des/ /chos bdag med pa'i byang chub rtogs/ /'di dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dbye ba dang ni gsad (snyepa ste/ /dbang po dang ni yul thams cad/ /mi bskyod pa yi 'jig rten spyod/ /brtse bas de rnams bsad pa 6)yis/ /bdag nyid kyis ni grol rgyu can / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /mchog gi gtso mo bsgom ⑦pa yin / /smin dbus phyogs su gzugs rnams ni/ /dkar ba'am dmar dang mtshon cha rnams/ /de'i dus nyid du yang dag byung / /sum cu rtsa bdun yig rnams su/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid gzugs/ /mchog gi gtso bo dushes par bya/ /oṃ sa dz+nyā rba nā ka mṛ stim ta pra ba bas rta ⑩pa nā ṇa ya hunyeya ne rtsu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa pho phaṭa swā swā hā hā/ /oṃ shoṇ+ḍi nī ye hūṃ 8rgyu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/bsgom ④bdag nyid can rnal 'byor ches/ /ji ltar yid 'dod las bya 8ste/ /dur khrod sol ba'i snag tsha tsheyis/ /mi yi rus pas bri bar bya/ /sman thams cad kyi hu 7rgyu skar ni/ /rgyal sogs khams rnams mnyam pas so/ /'khor lo mngon hu du brjod pa ste/ /dum bu'ang gcig dman 9/kyelnga bcu'o/ /phan tshun zung gi gsang sngags su/ /yi ge'ang mkhas pas dgod par bya/ /grwa bzhir rnam par snang mdzad deng )/ /sgo bzhi rnams ni stong pa'o/ /lhag ma du nyethog ma'i phreng la ni/ /dum bzhi rnams su rim pas gang / /ṇ+ḍa tsosam+bha gri dgod par bya/ /78wa 608

de la gnyis pa'i dum bdun la/ /gri (2)ya hoḥgri ②bha ga pa ya/ /bā na bi phaṭa ②rim bzhin bri/ /gsum pa dbus ma'i logs su ni/ /gsum gsum rnams ni sbyin bya ste/ /phaṭa ṇ+ḍa byas r+ghaṃ r+gha tsosbyin bya/ /bzhi par dbus las thams cad du//phyogs su re re dor ba 6)dang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi sgo gnyis kyi/ /dbus su yi ge gnyis gnyis te/ / pa ya byā rā (7)sbyin par bya/ /phreng lnga pa la dgod bya brka/ /dbus nima'i logs su gsum gsum ste/ /hūṃ pa ya (74 hūm̐ gri 7su dgod deyi / /'di rnams ji lta'i 'dir rim pas/ /drug pa'i phreng la shes bya ba'ormoge/ /ṇ+ḍi 8an hūṃ rtsu rtsu phaṭa de bzhin/ /phaṭa dza hūm̐ phaṭa 91 )rim ji ltar/ /sngags thams cad ni sbyin bya ba/ /dum bu bdun pa rnams la bshad/ /sgo spangs pa la rim pa yis/ /sbyin bya hūṃ rtsu m+bha 8rgyu/ /'khrul 'khor chen po'i tsochen po'o/ /dbus kyi dum bu lnga rnams dang / /de bzhin du ni sgo bzhi ru/ /bsgrub bya'i ming nang bcug pa yi/ /rkang pa brgya tu tshopa'i sngags bcas pa'o ro langs 'thab par 'gyur ba ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni gzung 8bya'o/ /de dag lto 39bar 'khrul 'khor te/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom du )med/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las chang 'tshong ma'i rab tu sbyor bas dbye ba'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas 'khor lo'i go cha ma'i/ /ting 'dzin gsal bar bshad bya ste/ /78—609

'khor lo'i go cha ma'i 91)sbyor bas/ /lkugs par bcing ba'i sbyor ba'o/mi/ /gser gling gi ni gnas dang ni/ /de nas dran byang chub yan lag /srin po'i rnam pa'i 'khrul 'khor te/ /cho ga gzhan du rab 'jug 'gyur/ /spyi gtsug mthil gyi sa gzhi la/ /mkhas pa yis ni bya ba yin/ /lha dang lha min 'thab mo cher / /mi 94)smrar gyur to mi'i 5ci'ajug pa/ /de yi dus su gzugs chen po/ /'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bltas/ /yi ge gnyis kyis 'chad pa ni/ /g.yo ba'i sems ni 'ching ba ste/ /gnon pa rnam par shes pa'i chos/ /gzugs kyi dbus su thim par gyis/ /rgyud 96du dam pa'i chos bstan pa/ /'dir ni phyag rgya gnyis kyis bshad/ /de bzhin sngon gyi spyod pas kyang / /sbyor ba'i phyag rgya spyod par 'gyur/ /thams cad man ngag le'u ru/ /de yi rgyu can bsgoms pa yis57ske/ /rim pas na'adi kun zab mor ni/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsang byas te9nol/ /nam mkha' mkha' med nam mkha' che/ /shin tu nam mkha' nam mkha'i ⑫min / /gyen du phyogs pa'i rtsar 'bab ste/ /ji srid ri mo mi mthong bar de srid rgyun mi 'chad par 11'thob/ /dga' skyes bde ba'ang cis mi 'bab/ /dngos dang dngos med 'dres pa yis/ /skye bo kun nas byung ba yin/rta/ /dngos med gzugs bdag nyid ma yin/ /dngos med thams cad las skyes bde/ /lam la gnas par 1/'khyer 'gyur te/ /gang der ji ltar de bzhin no/ /ye shes lkugs pa bzhin du gnas/ /'ching ba cho1 rang gi phyag rgya skyes/ /'di yis lkugs par 'gro ba ste/ /dgra bzhin du ni kun la 'bigs/lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin kyang lkugs nyid na/ /skye 'gro phra mo slar ci dgos/ /thams cad rig pas byed po byed/ /byed po gzhan ni srid ma yin/ /yid bzang ma dang gang zag nyid/ /78—610

bdag med rig 'gyur skad cig las/ /rdo rje theg par de tshe gnas/ /rang bzhin bdag med par 'dod do/ /brjod pa bdag med brjod pa yang / /rnal 'byor mthong bas 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de las langs pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /ṇ+ḍa 0)yig gzhan dngos rnams kyis min/ /gnyis dag (2)bsrub cing bsrub pa ni/ / dang po zhi)spyi gtsug rkang mthar ro/ /rnam 4)gnyis rjes su sbyor ba yis/ /dbus kyi mda' ni sngags skyes so/ /mtshon bya mtshon 5pas gang mtshon pa/ /mtshon par bya dang mtshon byed med(6ci/ /bad 7snal lta bu'i skud pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mtha'i gnas phyin/ /mda' dang gzhu ni mi mthong ste/ /gang du btang kun)zhing 'gro bar bya/ /de tshe srog kun lkugs par ni/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom 9pa ste/ /de yi dbus su 'di dgod pa/ /'khor lo'i go cha ma lha mo/ /mdog dang dbyibs ni sngon gyi can/ /sngags yig rnams las byung ba ni/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid can mchog /oṃ sa ba rba rnya bi na 7ka ka la rā pa ya /1bha rtsu lja 12rdu na pha ka ṭa rā pha ya ṭa hūṃ swā hūm̐ hā phaṭa phaṭa 32ga hā/ mi.o tsa kra bami tsā 15ye hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya sngags rab sbyor bdag nyid/ /lkugs pa'i rnam shes bsgrub par bya/ /sngon gyi 'khrul 'khor bris nas ni/ /gsang sngags phreng ba 'di dgod bya/ /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad de/ /gnyis par wan ni rnam par sbyin/ /bi 515yig gsum par sbyin par bya/ /bzhi par hūm̐ gi yi ge'o/ /lnga par bya yi 1 yi ge ste/ /dum bu drug par rā sbyin bya/ /bdun par gri 18yi yi ge ste/ /brgyad par ga yi yi ge'o / /dgu par m+bha yi 919yig sbyin bya/ /bcu par ṇ+ḍi rna )yig slar dgod do/ /gri ri )yig bcu gcig pa ru ste lha/ /rtsu yig bcu gnyis dgod par na bya/ /bcu 78—611

gsum pa ru gri 91)yig ste(nad/ /bcu bzhi pa la dza yig go/ /bco selnga pa la bha yig ④ste / /pa ya gnyis dgod bcu drug par/ /bcu bdun pa la su yig ste/ / pha yig bcwa (5)brgyad par dgod bya/ /gcig nyung nyi shur hūm̐ 96)sbyin no/ /nyi shu pa la ṭa'i yi ge/ /nyi shu gcig par yi ge hūm̐/ /nyi shu gnyis par rtsu 'gyur ro/ /nyi shu gsum par gri yig ste/ /hūm̐ yig nyi shu bzhi par ro/ /nyi shu drug par ṭa yig sbyin/ /nyi shu bdun par pa'i yi ge/ /hūm̐ yig nyi shu brgyad par te/ /hoḥyig nyi shu rtsa dgu par/ /sum cu pa la smya dzo yig sbyin/ /sum cu gcig par ṇ+ḍa (3)dgod bya/ /hūṃ yig sum cu gnyis par sbyin/ /sum cu gsum 'dir m+bha ⑨yig go / /sum cu bzhi par hūm̐ yig ste/ /de nyid sum cu lnga par ro/ /sum cu drug par yi 7yig sbyin/ / r+gha yig 11sum cu bdun par tehu / /sum cu brgyad par hunyepa ya tshaganyis/ /gcig dman bzhi bcu pa la hūṃ/ /bzhi bcu pa la r+ghaṃ sbyin bya/ /bzhi bcu gcig par ni bha yi ge'o51lha/ /hūṃ yig bzhi bcu gnyis par sbyin/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa 17la oṃ/ /ya na'i yig gnyis sbyin bya ba/ /dum bu bzhi bcu bzhi par ro/ /bzhi bcu lnga par ā na ste3)/ /bzhi bcu drug par phaṭa de bzhin / /bzhi bcu bdun pa la ni oṃ/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa la phaṭa/ /bzhi bcu dgu par su sbyin bya1 / /thams cad ji lta'i rim pas so/ /dum bu dbus mar bsgrub bya'i ming / /ka ra ka ra sogs nang bcug /thams cad bsdus nas shes byas nas/ /lkugs par bcing bar bya ba ni/ /byi ba steng du 'gro ba'i sgor19/ /'khrul 'khor glang mig 5 stabacas par sba/ /a ba dhū tīr yig du —nyebyas nas/ /de yi dbus su rab tu gzhug /phyogs thams cad du srin po ni/ /byas nas 'khrul 'khor bsgrub dpa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /78—612

rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las 'khor lo'i go cha ma'i lkugs par bya ba'i rab tu sbyor ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid dang 'khor lo sgom (1)pa dang dpa' bo dang (2/gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor srin po'i rnam pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas shin tu dpa' mo'i las/ /zhi bar byed pa gsal bshad bya/ /rab sbyor de rnams kyis bya ste/ /na ga rar ri ni yang dag bzhugs/ /btang snyoms byang chub yan lag ste/ /lha yi 'khor lo rdzu 'phrul cher90/ /dpral ba'i gnas su lha mo ni/ /skye 'gro'i 95)bdag mo bsgom par bya/ /dbang gnyis yang dag 'dus pa las/ /rtsa chen po ni bde bas gang / /bcu gnyis mtha' ru bskyod pa las / /'dir ni sa bon g.yo ba med/ /dbang po la sogs thams cad ni/ /'dod chags bral ba nyid 'thob ne 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po mnyam pa'i bde//slar yang bde ba'i rang bzhin med/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mun dri ma/ /rnam bral pha rol son pa che/ /'thob bo dga' ba de yis ni/ /skyes bu dang ni gnyis med rtse/ /theg pa gsum las 97gzhan med de/ /de rnams kyis ni blta dus kun(kye/ /'gro dang nyal dang za ba ni99/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub 7pas spangs pa yin/ /dga' rol rtsed mo rtse ba dang / /glu len pa yis gos pa med/ /de phyir btang snyoms byang yan lag /gnas skabs kun rjes spangs pas so/ /de 17ltar zhi don du byas pas/ /don yod mthong bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang 78—613

dang gang gi sems can ni/ /nad pa la sogs la bltas pas1)/ /de dang de yi sems can gyi / /zhi ba'i las can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang myur du na/ /phra mo'i las ni smos ci dgos/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs dbus su/ /shin tu dpa' mo bsgom par bya/ /lha mo rtag tu mdog dkar mo/ /lhag ma sngon ma lta bu mchog /gsang sngags phreng ba'i rab sbyor bas/ /shes rab dang ni thabs byung ba'o/ /gtor ma sbyin sreg tsho cho ga yis/ /blo ldan zhi rdzas rnams kyis te/ /zho mar 'o ma zas rnams kyi ca/ /'dir ni dgang blugs 95)dbul bar bya / /ga pur tsan+dan la sogs pas/ /'khrul 'khor sngon gyi bri bar bya/ /oṃ pa mu ra ṇ+ḍa kṛ 6ba 7ta lī ya la n+t+ra (8ga ma na n+t+ra 9sha nā rī sha rā nā ya ya hūṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā swā hā hā/ oṃ su bī rī 1 ye rtsu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya sngags yig sa bon te/ /skye ba dang ni gnas pa'i rgyu/ /ye shes sa bon thams cad rnams/ /sngags pas dpral 1lhab sogs par ro/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams rtse dus las/ /bskyed 1 par 'gyur zhing 'gag 32par 'gyur/ /dum bu bzhi bcu rtsa dgu ru/ /sngags kyi phreng ba 'di dgod bya/ /dum dbus phyi rol brgyad rnams su/ /phyogs mtshams ji lta'i rim pa 1 skuyis/ /rnam par snang mdzad sa bon bzhi/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge bzhi rnams so/ /de phyi dum bu bcu drug tu/ /phyogs mtshams rim pa ji bzhin pas/ /ju yig brgyad ni dgod bya zhing / /de nas griṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍa'i 15tshig /sum+bha ni su'o dum lhag ma/ /de yi phyi rol nyi shu (9bzhir/ /m+bha gri snra 17pa ya gri snra 18pa ya/ /'dir ni bri bar bya ba ste/ /ā na ya ā na ya hoḥ'i 19tshig /bha ga bā na 2 bi t+yā rā dza dang / /phaṭa yig de nas bri bar bya/ /dbus ma'i dum bur bsgrub bya ni/ /gnod mdzes sngags kyi nang bcug pa'o/ /78—614

lha yi gzugs kyi khar bri bya/ /de ltar lha yi 'khrul 'khor ni/ / ling ga'i 1gnas su gzhag (gepar bya/ /kun tu spyod kun shes par bya/ /gzhan gyi dus su mi 'grub bo/ /thig le sgra yi dus su ni/ /rlung gi dbyibs ni brtan pa yis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyi/ /zhi ba mya ngan 'das 'gro na / /slar yang sa gzhi'i 'jig rten pa'i/ /zhi ba'i dgos 4byed smos ci dgos/ /de byed rnal 'byor dbang phyug ni/ /lha dang lha min rnams kyis 5mchod/ /de yang sangs rgyas nyid 'thob phyin/ /de zhabs 'bring 7byed smos ci dgos/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas sogs chen pos/ /de ni phyag 'os mchod 'os so/ /bsam gtan sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / /sbyin sreg ya ga nasogs mchog tu/ /zhi dang byang chub kyi ni sems/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni bzlas pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pas/ /kun mkhyen skye ba 'di 9la'o/ /dpal he ru ka gnyis med 1 pa'i / /rdo rje phag mo mthong bar 'gyur/ /de yi 11mchog ni ster byed de/ /rang gi 'khor los sgyur 12thim pa'o/ /de rnams phyag rgya'i grub byed par/ /mchog tu rmad du byung bar 'gro/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang gnas pa/ /gnas dang gnas rnams su 'thob bo/ /he ru ka sngags 'khrul 'khor dang / /las nyugethams cad ni ma 1 rishes na/ /de ni don med yongs ngal te/ /'gro ba drug tu 'khyam 1ge'agyur zhing / /skye ba bye ba brgya phrag tu16/ /'jig rten 'gro kun grol ba min/ /dpal te ru sga'i go 'phang 1 gnas1 / /sngags kyi nus pas grol ba'o/ /brtse ba chen pos phag mo sogs/ /rnal 'byor ma bsnyen shes par bya / /gnyis sbyor bde ba'i rnam pa ni/ /bud med skyes pa ma ning min/ /78wa 615

dngos po tsam du sems can la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bstan/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las shin tu dpa' mo'i zhi ba'i las kyi rab tu sbyor ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid kyi 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo sgom 17pa dang gnod mdzes kyi sngags kyi las kyi tshogs zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas lha mos mchod byas nas/ /'di skad kyi ni tshig dris so/ /thams cad bsrung rinaba'i las chen po/ /khyab bdag bdag gis mi 'tshal lo/ /phag mo lha rdzas pad can gyi/ /lha mo nyon cig rab bshad bya/ /stobs chen ma yi rdzun)rab sbyor bas/ /sin dhu yi ni gnas bsgrubs te/ /yang dag lta ba'i rang bzhin du/ /mchog gi ma mo shes par bya/ /de ltar de nyid nges par byang)/ /mchog gi bsgom par 'jug par bya/ /ma mo'i 'khor lo'i grong nyams dgar(ge/ /dpa' bo'i gtso mo bsgom (6༄par bya/ /lhan skyes byang chub rigs pa yis/ /de'i bdag nyid du gang mtshon bya7)/ /sngon du hā ste bgrod (nyepa bzhin/ /drag shul sbyor ba'i mtshan ri9nanyid do/ /rnal 'byor thams cad yongs dmigs nas7/ /phung po'i rtsa ba las gzhon can/ /spyi bo yi ni thod par bzung / / o byen lhonyebu gar son pa ste/ /lte ba yi ni gnas thob nas/ /byang chub sa bon rnams kyis 'dzin / /mtshan mo 12yis ni gzung bar ni/ /khams thams cad kyis gang bar byas/ /la la nā yi lam son nas/ /sngon gyi gnas su yang dag rig /78—616

me yis bzhu ba'i khams kyis ni/ /rtsa sbubs ri74)thams cad dgang bar bya /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /skad cig la ni lta zhing mthong / /zla ba 'gro ba'i dbus su ni/ /sgor 'phyang ba ni blta bar bya/ /sbyor mchog shes byas bsgrubs (kyebyas la/ /de yi rang bzhin can bsam bya/ /mdzod spur son pa'i bu ga ru/ /rlung gi lce ni gzhug par bya/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi bsgom ②rim pas/ /yang dag lta bar ④shis par bya/ /sum cu rtsa bdun bdag nyid mchog /shes rab rnal 'byor ma bsgom bya/ /sngags kyi yi ge las byung ba/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid mchog go/ /oṃ du ma ṣa hā ṭā tshogacir ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣu phyi bi ka dā rā la ya ne rtsu r+ghaṃ rgyu hūm̐ pha pha ṭa ṭa pha pha ṭa ṭa swā swā hā hā dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ i ma hā ba le rtsu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya'i sngags las lha mo che ri/ /ye shes sku ni yang dag byung / /gru bzhi skum po dang bcas pa'i/ /byang chub 'khrul 'khor rtag nabri ste1/ /dum bu bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la/ /gsang sngags bzhi po yang dag par / /dum bu re rer bri bar bya/ /dum bu lnga ru sgrub po ste11/ /gha gha la sogs nang bcug nyi pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 8phyag tu ni/ / gi wang 'am mini yang na ni/ / gi wang chen 8pos bri bya bang/nye/ /gro gar 'khrul 'khor thams cad ni/ /las kyi khyad par gyis 0bri ste/ /g.yul 18ngo chen po'i ras la ni/ /las thams cad pa bya 1rtab yin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las stobs chen ma'i sbyor bas srung thob chen po nalhaphur bu'i sngags kyi las byang chub sems dpa'i 'khrul 'khor sgom 2pa'i man ngag gi cho ga'i mtshan 78—617

nyid ces bya ba tsho1 ste le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas las mchog thams cad ni/ /sems can kun la 'byung bshad bya/ /'khor los sgyur 2ma'i rab sbyor bar/ /ma ru'i gnas su bsgrub par bya/ /yang dag rtog pa byang chub kyi/ /phyogs su gnas bzhin par bya'o/ /rgyas pa bsgrub bya phyi nas ni/ /mkhas pas las ni bya ba yin/ /gtum mo lte bar sbar ba yis/ /tshigs thams cad ni sreg pa ste/ /mig la sogs pa bsregs nas ni//bsregs pas rkan las thig le 'dzag /'gro'o (༄de ni mtshams kun du/ /pad snal skud pa'i dra mu ba'o/ /'bigs 6shing 'gro bas ro myang ste(7na/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis la'o/ /'thom 8dang rmugs pa'i ye shes ni/ /'gro ba med kyang 9sku'ong bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di yi rnal 'byor pa/ /lo yi sbyor bas de 'grub 'gyur/ /de dang 'di yis yang dag ldan/ /las rnams tharmes cad byed par 'gyur/ /dga' ba 'jig rten thams cad du/ /zhes bya 'gro 'gyur de'i bdag nyid/ /rnam par rtog pa de 'khyer 7te/ /gom pa gcig ni 'gro mi 'gyur / /tshigs kun ngo bor gyur nas ni/ /bdag gi gdan ni de mthong 'gyur / /'chi bas mi 'jigs 'di yi phyir/ /gzhan gyi gdan du yang dag gnas / /gang gang las la bltas rnams kyis/ /de de thams cad du byed do/ / 'chi ba'i 11dus las shes byas pa/ ci/de ni rnal 'byor gdan du 'dod/ /kun mkhyen thams cad las can ni/ /gang phyir gsang ba'i gdan mchog yin/ /yang dag rtog pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /byang chub phyogs su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ba lang rta dang mi dang khyi/ /glang po ma he bong bu dang / /rnga mo byi chung byi la 78—618

dang ske/ /phag pa 3)dang ni spre'u rnams kyi/ /sha ni skyur po la btags pa/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin sreg 5)bya/ /rang bzhin dngos grub 'thob (8)'gyur na / /dngos grub brgyad po slar cis min/ /ral gri mig sman rkang byug dang / / ri lu ri ridangul chu mchil lham 95)dang / /bcud len dang ni sa 'og dang / /dgug pa yang ni 'grub pa'o/ /ro langs bslang ba'i dngos grub tshone ni/ /khyi (7rinag mo yi 'o ma dang / /mā 8cig nag po'i thug pa yis9ci / /yi dgas bcu bzhi'i mtshan mo 'am/ /sngags pas tshes 1 )brgyad la ro yi/ /kha ru sbyin sreg bya de 37bzhin/ /dur khrod kyi ni yungs kur nyu2mar/ /mar khu 1 'bad pas bzung ’ nas ni/ /des 512kyang dpa' bo byug 17bya ste/ / de tshe'i ’ tshonub mor rnam par brjod / /yi dgas chen po de langs nas/ /dbang chen mthil la phye 18mar byed / /des nyu)rtag 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /rang rkyen 2 sbyor bas bskyed pa yin//til lam til mar gzhan yang ni/ /gang rung ci rung bzung 1byas nas/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis tsho shesems can rgyur lha/ /byin pas thams cad du 'gro'o/ /sgrol sa )ma tsun dā tsho ge'od zer can/ /khro gnyer ri khrod lo ma dang / /gshin mthar bcas sogs khro bo che/ /sgom 27dang sngags kyi bzlas pa ni/ /'bum phrag gcig gis sdig 'joms te/ /bye tsho bas 'jal 8ba 'thob par byed/ /dngos grub ci 'dra ba 'dod pa/ /stsal nas rgyun du zhugs pa yin/ /yang na snyan dngags /rig pa ste )/ /lung gi don ni 'chad pa'i'o 1/ /kun shes gang thams cad kyi skad/ /ma mthong ba rnams shes par 'gyur/ /tshar gcad 22rjes gzung thams cad ni/ /chos bya chos can thams cad byed/ /sgrol sogs rnal 'byor ma mchog rnams/ /rang bdag gzugs gzhan shes bya nyid/ /'di 78wa 619

rnams kun bsdus gzugs nyid pas/ /'khor los sgyur ma bsgom hu)par gyis/ /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs 'dzin te ri/ /de rnams kyis ni 'khor sgyur rdo dma'o o tā re tut+ta 4 re tu re swā hā/ oṃ tsun+de (peswā hā/ oṃ mā ri rtsu ri snaswā hā/ oṃ smṛ (7ku ṭī swā hā/ oṃ paṇ+ḍi sha ba rī 8daswā hā/ de ltar kun gyi 'khrul 'khor kyang / /sngags kyi yi ge rnams kyis bya/ /bskyed pa dang ni gnas pa'i rgyur/ /ji lta'i rigs postepas bsgrub par bya/ /'od zer phreng bas kun 'khrigs pa/ /snying ga'i tshe'akhor lor gzung bar bya/ /'di yis 'chi ba'i 'jigs 'joms te/ /rgas dang 'chi ba med 'thob byed/ /'khor los sgyur 37ma'i lha mo ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid mchog /mdog dang dbyibs ni rang gi ste/ /sngags yig rnams las yang dag byung / /oṃ kro dha dharmo s+thā dha ra 12ya sī ka ra rā ḍā ya 1 ya hūm̐ rtsu hūṃ 7t+t+waṃ pha pha ṭa ṭa pha pha ṭa ṭa swā swā hā hā/ oṃ 1 tsakra bsto nī ye r+ghaṃ hūm̐ nyu5phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/de ltar sngags las yang dag byung / /mkha' 51 'gro ma yi 18'khor lo sgyur16/ /lha min 'khrul 'khor bri bya ste/ /gcig dman lnga bcu'i dum bu la/ /ji ltar lha rnams kyi ni sngags/ /bsgrub bya'i ming nang bcug pa yi/ /phag mo yi ni snying po yang ske/ /dum bu so so la bri'o/ /phyi rol du ni sngags kun gyis/ /'dir ni rtag tu bskor bar bya/ /g.yul ngo yi noni ras 21la ni/ /rdzas kun gyis ni yongs bris nas/ /'khrul 'khor las ni thams cad pa ge/ /lha ma yin gyi khar sbyin bya/ /lo yi nyin zhag sbyor ba can/ /thun mtshams so sor bsgom par bya/ /gshin dgra'i 'khrul 'khor bri bya ste/ /dum bu bcu bdun pa la ni/ /phyi rol bcu drug sbyin bya ba/ / hrīḥthi na sngags 'di dgod par bya/ /ya ma me da k+ṣe rā dzā tsho zus do/ /ru ṇa yo ni rā ya ts+tsha ni/ /de ltar sngags chen bris nas ni/ /las 78—620

thams cad ni bsgrub ①par bya/ /yi ge re re'i gtso bo yis/ /las rnams kyang ni bcu bdun no/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni nang bcug nas/ /gshin rje'i snying po'i sngags rnams ni/ /lugs bzlog yi ge phyi rol du/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bri bar bya/ /'jigs dang rgyal po'i rigs dang ni/ /dgra thams cad ni rnam par 'joms/ /gzhan yang rdza rnga bcing ba yi/ /khyab bdag rang gi nasngags btu pa/ /sa gzhi cha mnyam nyams dga' bar/ /tsan+dan la sogs byugs pa ru / /sgrub 9shepa po yis yang bya ste/ /ri mo dgu pa (5legs zlum por/ /gcig dman lnga bcu'i dum bu la/ /gcig gnyis gsum dang bzhi yi khar/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa yis/ /sngags kyi yi 6ge rnams gzhag 77bya/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po yi ni sngags/ /sngags pas de nas yang dag btun/ /de ni tshigs kun de (9 shes bya/ /rgyud gzhan du ni ma bshad do/ /de yi yi ge rtsa mirnams su/ /re re yi ni tshigs mtshams ni/ /gcig dman lnga bcu yi ni mtshams / /mkha' dus me yi tshogs can no/ /gang gang chos 11su yongs bshad pa / /mnyam par gzhag 12pas de de'i tshigs/ /gang du yi ge gcig blangs nas / /der ni yi ge thams cad de/ /rtsis kyi rim 15rnams kyis btu bar/ /bde mchog 'bum par gsungs ༅ pa yin/ /phyi dang nang bdag nyid 'khrul 'khor / /rnal 'byor rnams kyis 15kun sgrub sapa'o/ /gsang sngags bde bas bsgrub par bya/ /khyad par du yang 'khrul 'khor ro/ /de yis dngos grub 'thob nyu tsho'agyur bar/ /'dir ni som nyid nya srid ma yin/ /rten dang brten 1rtapa'i gzugs can te/ /ji lta'i rim par rna tshoming dang gnas/ /gnas ni rten gyi gzugs su ste/ /rten 27pa'i ming ni rnal 'byor ma/ /'di dag mnyam par 78—621

snyoms 1'jug pa/ /las thams cad par tshonamangon par brjod/ /de yis rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /rten pa thabs kyi spyod yul lo/ /gang phyir sa gzhi rten yin pas/ /de'i 4phyir thabs ni 5rnal 'byor ma/ /yang na thams cad thabs yin la/ /yang na thams cad shes rab bo/ /shes rab thabs bral de rnams kyis / /sangs rgyas sku ni mya ngan 'das/ /theg pa mchog 'di 6shes rab dang / /bral bas thams cad srid par 'gro/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das gang chos/ /de rnams spangs pas chos med do/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las 'khor los sgyur 7ma'i rab tu sbyor ba la sogs pa las sna tshogs bsgrub 8pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo sgom 95pa'i lam dang rdza rnga'i sngags mdor bstan pa'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba ste le'u bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan pa ’ mchog gtso bo/ /'khor los sgyur 11sogs rgyas pa ni/ /phan pa thams cad ster ba'i las/ /mdor bsdus pa yis bshad par bya/ /brtson chen ma yi rab sbyor bas/ /ku lu tār 12ni yongs su bzhugs/ /byang chub phyogs ni yang dag ngag /'khrul 'khor mi yi gzugs can no/ /'phyang ba la ni yongs brten nas/ /bsam med byang chub 'thob par byed/ /de ni las kun gtso bo ste/ /rang byung phyag rgya chen po'o/ /khams thams cad las yang dag byung / /de ni 'phyang bar mngon par brjod1na/ /dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi 78—622

rnams 1la/ /re re la ni rnam pa brgyad/ /khams thams cad la'ang shes bya ba/ /mig dang bu ga zla ba'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad so so yi/ /re re'i ming du'ang brjod par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor sum cu rtsa bdun du/ /dpa' bo re re bsgom par bya/ /khams brgyad po ni thams cad du/ /rnam pa gsum du'ang mtshon par bya/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs kyi/ /rab sbyor ming mdor bstan pas te ri/ /phag mo sogs su yongs gnas pa'i/ /brtson chen ming nang shes par bya/ /dal gyis khams la bsnun pa yis/ /gnyid log pa las sad par bya//dpa' bo'i ral gri gang 'dra bas/ /stobs po che la 'bigs par 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i 'phyang ba'i ral gri ni/ /khams thams cad la 'bigs par 'gyur/ /hā yi 4rmomador bstan shes byas nas/ /tshigs mtshams kun du gnas par gyis/ /de las bskyed pa'i dpa' bo rnams/ /bye ba 'bum tsho stong phrag go/ /byang chub sa bon rang bzhin can/ /rnal 'byor ma ni de'i rigs grags/ /khams thams cad du rgyas 'debs pa/ /nges 'byung dus su yang dag byung / /'phyang 5bzhin par ni de shes bya/ /rang gzhan yang dag rig pa spangs/ /rigs ni khams rnams thams cad de/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rigs can yin/ /gnyis po yang dag sbyor ba ru/ /'phyang ba lto bar rab zhugs bya/ /khams thams cad kyi ro'i bar du/ /de ni chad pa nyid du 'gyur/ /bcud kyis len ni bsgrubs pa yis/ /skye bo kun la rgyas pa yin/ /de rnams kun du gnas pa med/ /mkha' spyod nyid du nye bar 'gro/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams ni/ /dbus su zag pa med par bzhugs/ /de ltar yon tan gter thams cad/ /yang dag ngag gi go 'phang gnas/ /brjod min pa yi sngags chen po/ /bsnams 6zhing skye bo kun 78—623

la sgrogs/ /gzhom du med par de shes bya/ /sa ni rdo rje 'dzin ma 4)rang / /khams rnams kyi dngos ma lus pa/ /ming gis dpa' bor yang dag gnas/ /thod pa'i dum bu yi ni khams/ /rang nyid so sor bshad par bya/ /sen mo dang ni so 'bab pa/ /re re'i brgyad du phye ba can/ /sa la sogs pa'i khams bzhi dang —/ /de bzhin dngos po bzhi dag go/ /de ltar gnas ni gsum gsum du/ /dpa' bo thams cad sbyar bar 5bya/ /skra dang ba spu 'bab pa dang / /pags lapa dang ni dri 94rim 'bab/ /sha dang sha red 'bab pa dang / /chu rgyus dang ni rtsa 'bab dang / /rus pa dang ni pags (pe'abab dang / /mkhal ma dang ni stobs 'bab dang / /snying dang dra ba 'bab pa dang / /mig dang chu ser 'bab pa dang rka/ /mkhris pa dang ni rlung 'bab dang / /glo ba dang ni rtsa 'bab dang / /der 'bab pa yi dngos po ni/ /gnye ma dang ni mchin 46)pa 'bab/ /lto ba dang ni dbugs 'bab dang / /bshang dang gci (3)ba 'bab pa dang / /mtshams kyi tshonanamatha' dang dri ma 'bab/ /rgyu shun dang ni mchil ma 'bab/ /rnag (9)dang chu ser 'bab 1 pa dang / /khrag dang me tog 'bab pa dang / /rdul 11dang rlangs nyanapa 'bab pa dang / /tshil dang lto tshil 'bab pa dang / /mchi 1snyem dang ni khu ba 'bab / /lud pa dang ni rims med 'bab/ /snabs dang rkang mar 'bab pa ste / /dpa' rnams khams kyi mtshan nyid do/ /de ltar dum bu dum bu nyid/ /khams ni gzhan du 'jug par 'gyur/ /re re yi yang rang bzhin kyang / /zad pa'i rlung gis thod pa can/ /bde ba kun (7gyi nang thim par/ /keng rus chen po 'gro ba yin/ /sems dang bsam pa de yi phyir/ /keng rus kun du stong pa nyid / /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa yis(2/ /thams cad gnyis med lhan skyes 78—624

gsal / /lha yi dgra ni chen po'i gzugs/ /rnam shes lha dang lha can rnamatsho/ /'od dpag med ni (mitshig med pa/ /rdo rje'i 'od zer rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje'i nirang bzhin gyi ni sku/ /rdo rje'i sku ni der shes bya/ /myu gu can ni dngos po kun④/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dga' byed pa'o/ / rnam shes (5)bems (6)por 'ching ⑦bar ni/ /rdo rje ral pa can 'gro'o/ /sa gsum zas kyi (2)mchog tu ni/ /dpa' bo chen po'i bgrod pas (9)byas/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas sdod par/ /rdo rje rtsu mdzad 'gro ba'o/ /shin tu bzang po thob med pa/ /'jig rten 'jig rten pa 0spangs pa'o/ /skye 'gro kun du rang byung ba/ /rdo rje bzang po de 37grags pa'o/ /'jigs nyu2byed chen po'i go 'phang gis/ /las kyi bag chags thal bas bsgos/ /mig mi bzang gis ma bltas nyu kyang / /thams cad mtshan nyid mthong bar 'gyur/ /stobs po che ni sngags thams cad/ /rnam pa gsum gyi bdag nyid do/ /rin chen rdo rje smra bcad boche/ /zag med khams ni tham/sa cad du'o/ /rta mgrin sa gzhi chen po la/ /srog son kun la sbyar bar bya/ /srog kun dgang bar 7bya ba ste/ /de yis nam mkha'i snying por bshad/ /dpal he ru ka rtag tu stong / /sku bzhi yi ni rang bzhin can/ /pad+ma gar tshadabang phyug dang tshigazugs/ /gzugs med rnal 'byor du 'gro ba'o18/ /bde ba chen pos snang byed pas/ /rnam snang mdzad du mngon par brjod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgyings byas pa/ /mchog tu bde bar brjod pa yin/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /khams thams cad kyi nang du'o/ /skad cig yud tsam thang cig tu/ /ro myang mtshan nyid shes par / bya/ /khams 'di rnams ni thams cad kyil/ /zad nyid mchog tu ngo mtshar che/ /rang bzhin khams kyi grangs rnams 2 778—625

ni / /dus tshod dang ni klu dang 1mda'/ /de rnams rnal 'byor mar yongs grags / /brgyud pa'i 2rim pa las 'ongs pa'o/ /khams kyang rnam par dpyad bzhin pas/ /thams cad bdag nyid kyis 'byung min/ /rnam shes ma yin ye shes min/ /thams cad stong pa'o yod pa min ge)/ /gser 'gyur rtsi ni ma rig pas / /mchog tu bde ba rig pa min/ /rang gis 'didagos pa byed pa ni/ /spar sha'i rigs lha'i rimatshan nyid do/ /brtson 'grus chen por mngon brjod pa'i / /de phyir rnal 'byor ma bsgom bya/ /khams thams cad du rgyas (6)'debs pa / /rnal 'byor gdan du yang dag byung / /gang zhig kun nas kun du ni/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs par mthong / /mkha' 'gro dang ni sdom rgyud dang / /nges par brjod pa phyi ma dang / /kun spyod 'byung ba'i rgyud rnams su/ /dngos po las ni rab tu bstan/ /de yis rgyud ni chen po 'di/ /thub pa skyes bu mchog gis 7gsungs/ /dum bu dum bur yongs gnas pa'i/ /las chen po ni der drang bya/ /phra mo'i bya ba mngon brjod pa/ /khams rnams kyi ni gnas la'o//ji lta'i rim pas khams 2blang ste/ /yongs bsdus spyod yul bar du'o/ /tshigs bcad thog ma sogs pas kyang / /ji srid rdzogs pa'i spyod yul du/ /rgyud 'di rnal 'byor gtso bo ste/ /las rnams rgya che ba min no/ /yang na rnal 'byor thams cad ni/ /las kyi tshogs su 'dod par bya/ /bdag gi de nyid 9rtag tu las / /byas pa'am 1 gal te ma byas pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi sbyor mtshan nyid / /rang bzhin las su yang dag bshad/ /de ltar rgyud rnams thams cad du / /sngags 11pas mchog tu shes par bya/ /yang na gang dang 'dra'i rnal 'byor / /de dang 'dra bar khams gnas te/ /bcud kyis len gyi rdzas rnams 78—626

ni / /sman chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi por/ /sbyar byas 6)dpa' bo nyid rnams kyis/ /grol bar bgrod pa gsungs pa sbyo yin/ /gsang ba mchog tu dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /bcu drug de rnams rdzas chen te/ /brgyad gnyis tshigs du ri)bcad phyed kyis so/ /sgra dang gzugs su yang dag byung / /'jig rten gsum du rnyed pa (gedaka'/ /srub 15)dang bsrub (6)pa'i kun sbyor ba'i/ /dbus ma bla na med pa'i gzugs(7)/ / ril bu (8)rtag tu mchod bya ste/ /pho nya lhan cig skyes bdag nyid/ /yid ni nang du son pa yis/ /rang khu'i phyirasangs rgyas thig le can/ /sbrang rtsi khrag dang ga bur bcas/ /tshogs kyi dbus su rab tu zhugs/ /ming med mthe bo (ho )dag gis 31khar/ /zla ba'i btung ba myang bar gyis / /bdud rtsi lngar gyur 'di rnams kyis/ /mchod pa bzhi ni de bzhin bya/ /lha dang mi rnams bde ba pas/ /bcu drug cha shas rin che'o/ /de ltar tshigs bcad 'di kun gyis/ /khams lnga rab tu bshad par 'gyur/ /ra yi yi ges khrag gi khams/ /hā yig ri skyes su 'dod de/ /su 32yig dri yi lo ma ste/ /pa yig pags mi pa ru ni 'dod/ /ra yig ghan dha kur skarab bshad/ /me yig me tog tu dran bya/ /ra yig rā bi ṇa de bzhin/ /slar 15yang me yi yi ge sha /sa yig kun tu ru tshelas skyes/ / r+pā yi nya yi ge rtsar 'dod do/ / t+ma yi 18yi ge sbug 19skyes bshad/ /na 3 )yig dri yi spemar khu'o/ /sa yi yi ge so yi rdul/ /dā yi yi ge rgya mtsho skyes/ /sbri yig ba mo de bzhin du/ /ta yig snying po'i ga pur tsharo/ /sgra dang gzugs su yongs byung ba/ /khrag khu nor bu'i na bar dag tu'o/ /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba/ /rang rig pad+ma ra son pa'o/ /srub sridang bsrub pa'i sbyor rnams kyis/ /rang 'byung gis ni rnam bsres pa'o/ /dbus ma'i 78wa 627

mchog gi dbugs kyang ni/ /skad cig dbu mar bzung ba'o/ / ril bu ①rtag tu mchod pa ni/ /bdud rtsi gsang ba'i chu yin no/ /pho nya lhan skyes bdag nyid ni / /dbang gnyis sbyor las rtse ba'o/ /yid ni nang du song ba ni/ /khams rnams kyang ni zhu ba'o/ /rang khu thig le ②sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhu gang sbyor ba las byung ba'o/ /sbrang rtsi khrag dang ga bur bcas/ /bcu drug 'dod ma las byung ba'o/ /tshogs dbus rab tu bzhugs ((rnams kyis/ /'di kun lhan skyes la sbyar ba'o/ /ming med mthe bos khar gzhug ④pa/ /snyoms par 'jug las khrag byung ba'o/ /zhi ba'i btung ba myang ba ni/ /'pho ba'i dus las ma lus gang ske/ /'di rnams bdud rtsi lngar 'gyur ba/ /'phos las byung ba'i mi'i mar khul/ /mchod bzhi de bzhin bya ba ni/ /bzhi mnyam ga bur bcas pa'o lha dang mi rnams bde ba ni/ /dga' ba kun las gang rdogebyung ba'o/ /bcu drug cha shas rin che ba/ /thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ /de ltar dpa' bo thams cad ni/ /khams kyi rdzas rnams su sbyar bya/ /bcud len de las byung ba ste / /gtso bo ye shes me rlung gis/ /'dzad (6༄pa dang ni bsad 7byas nas/ /'pho ba dang ni gzag 98de bzhin/ /'dzad (9)pa byang chub 'dzag 7pa ste/ /bsad 11pa yis kyang 'pho med 'gyur/ /'pho ba rtsa rnams kun du ste/ /gzag pa lte ba'i pad+mar ro/ /de rnams bcing ba byas pa yis/ /khams thams cad du gzag 12par bya/ / bsad pa 51snyedangos po gzhom pa ste/ /rgyas pa 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sbyin sreg 1 nicho ga der shes nas/ /'khor los sgyur nyu2nyid 'thob par gyis/ /thab 7tu bdud rtsi bsreg 51 bya ste/ /'jam pa'i nyasherdo rje mngon sum du/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas mthong bar 37'gyur/ /sa thams cad la 78wa 628

'khyer bar byed/ /srog ni gang gi chos can che/ /chos ni kun du 'gro bar 'gyural/ /de yi tshirang bzhin brtson chen ma na/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid mchog tu/ /dkyil 'khor sngags las des rdzogs pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid mchog /lha mo chen mo na/kha dog dkar/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las byung ma/ /sems can thams cad dbang 'gyur dang / /'khor los sgyur 4)ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /oṃ ga i ra n+d+ra sa dzā ta la bā sa da rba pra sa bā 95)tā da t+ma ma ne hā hūm̐ ma hūṃ te phaṭa hūm̐ phaṭa hūṃ swā phaṭa hā phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā bir+sā yi tsho6)rgyu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar sngags kyi de nyid bdag /lha thams cad kyi sa bon no/ /'khrul 'khor 'khor lo de (7)tshe ni/ /re'u mig gcig dman lnga bcu ste/ /kha ches yang dag bri byas nas/ /gsang sngags phreng ba 'di dgod 92)bya/ /lugs las bzlog pas gnod mdzes sngags/ /ji lta'i rim pas dgod par bya/ /de tshe mi yi ⑨gzugs byas nas/ /slar yang zlum po sbyin par bya/ /de la rtsa ba'i sngags bris nas/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni nang bcug pa'o/ /dbus kyi dum bu bebasgrub bya ni/ /de yi sngags kyi nang bcug pa'o/ /gro ga sogs su sngags pas bri / /phyi dang gsang bar mtshon par bya/ /de lta'i 'khrul 'khor rab sbyar bas/ /sa gsum po la bsgom par bya/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las brtson 'grus chen mo'i rab tu sbyor ba'i cho ga'i mtshan nyid gsang ba'i bcud len la sogs pa dang rgyas pa'i las dpal yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin he ru ku'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi cho ga zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi 78—629
