bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas dpa' bo phyag rdor sogs/ /sngags pa thams cad bzhengs rnams kyis / /bstod dang mchod dang phyag bcas pas/ /phag mo rab tu sad par byed / /bdag gi ma yi lha mo kye41)/ /lha mo kun gyis rab mchod ma/ /khyod ni 'di rnams kun gyi ma/ /ye shes snying mo ri phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sems can kun la snying rje yin / /gzugs su rang gis sprul pa mo/ /bdag la kun du thugs rje yi / /bka' drin chen po mdzad par rigs/ /bde ba chen po yongs bzhugs pa'i / /bcom ldan bdag po la 'dri'ori4/ /rgyud thams cad kyi las tshogs kyi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni mi 'tshal to/ /gal te ji srid rgyud rgyud du/ /las thams cad ni bstan pa ni/ /rnam dag ye shes thob nga rnams kyi/ /de tshe der 'di ci (6)phyir gsungs/ /rgyud 'di 57༄nyid du 'jug 'gyur bar/ /skye bo thams cad mi rigs so/ /slar yang bshad pa skyon dang bcas/ /bdag gis ma shes the tshom (8)mchisal/ /phag mo ci yang mi gsung bas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal zhugs nas / /de yi ye shes su 'gyur (9te/ /de yis len 1 ni gsung bar mdzad/ /bcom ldan chos kun bdag nyid kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yid du ni/ /byas nas gsung ni rjod 11byed pa/ /phag mo'i ris thams cad kyis so/ /kye kye dpa' bo thams cad rnams/ /ye shes shes bya gnyis 'dres 12pa'i/ / khyed kyis tu ye shes gang mthong ba/ /de ni de dang de ru thim/ /'on kyang so sor 'jug byed pa/ /sems can sna tshogs bsam pas so/ /dbye ba med nyid rgyud chen por/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sdom pa dang / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor rgyud rnams ni/ /'dus pa 78wa 630

la sogs don chen po/ /de (17rnams kyis ni rgyud 'di yi9ge/ /sna tshogs don ni mngon brjod pa/ /de thams cad kyis las kyi tshogs/ /ldan pas rab tu gsal bar byed/ /rgyud du brjod bya rjod tsho ci pa por/ /de yis phra mor 'jug par byed/ /re re'i mtshan nyid bdag nyid can/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs ldan / /de la rnam par shes pa'i chos/ /thod pa yi ni dum bur bshad/ /sems can kun gyi las dang ni/ /nyon mongs bde bar shes par bya/ /gzhan du kun mkhyen rgyud la ni/ /yi ge skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lo gcig gi ni bar gyi ni / /zla ba bcu gnyis de shes bya/ /dus tshod drug gi 'khor los sgyur(4 / /sems can rmi lam lta bu mchog /mi shes dri mas bsgos tshor pa yis/ /de rnams kyis ni bde mi rig /hā ra do tsho la'i rim pa yis/ /rnam par shes pa shes bzhin par/ /khri phrag gnyis la stong dang ni/ /drug brgya yis ni lhag pa'o/ /dbugs kyi chu tso)tshod drug cu la/ /zhag gcig tu ni rab tu grags/ /hā ra do la'i dbugs rnams kyis/ /bsgyur bas do la la rdo rimatshan pa'o/ /gnyis kyi dbugs ni blo ldan gyis/ /phyir 'byung nang 'jug thim par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dgongs 'gyur te/ /kun mkhyen nyid du nyer 'ong min/ /phra zhing phra ba'i rnal 'byor du/ /gnas nas thams cad rnam par spyadapodī/ /de yi 7ang ka phyi rol du/ /sa la bcu gnyis gzhag 37par bya/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i dbye bshad pa'i / /yan lag bcu gnyis kyang de bzhin/ /rgyu skar dang ni gza' rnams kyi/ /'char ba dus thams cad du'o/ /re re yi ni khams kyi ni/ /rang gi dus su'ang 'char bar 'gyur/ /dus su 'chi dang de bzhin gzhan/ /rim pa 'di yis 'chad par 'gyur/ / dā sgyu 1 la sogs sbyor shes pas/ /'di ni 78—631

sbyor ba phyi mo la'o/ /nyi ma byang du bgrod pa yi/ /rgyal gyi zla ba sogs brtsams nas1 / /zla ba bcu gnyis de ltar du/ /rim pa rim pas gzhag (gepar bya/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs brtsams nas/ /snga dro (kyenas brtsi blo ldan gyis/ /gsum pa 4 bcu gsum de bzhin te/ /bzhi pa yang ni bcu bzhi pa/ /lnga pa bcwa 'a)lnga pa ru ni/ /bshad par bya yis ri skud lta nyon/ /'di rnams mnyam zhing mnyam ldan par/ /sgrub pos mthun (7ripar bya ba yin/ /de la ma rig 'du byed dang / /rnam par shes dang ming dang gzugs/ /skye mched drug dang reg pa dang / /tshor ba dang ni sred de bzhin/ /nye bar len dang srid pa dang / /skye ba dang ni rga shi'o/ /de bzhin ro hi ta (8nasogs kyis/ /chu srin la sogs rā si rnams/ /bcu gnyis nyid du 'dod par bya/ /thog mar ma rig 94)chu srin dang / /ro hi ta'o de bzhin gzhan/ /gnyis par mo hi ta bibum pa/ /'du byed du ni gsal bar 'gro/ /gsum par bzang po dang ni nya/ /rnam par shes par de rig bya/ /bzhi par khyu mchog dang ni lug /ming dang gzugs su 'dod par bya/ /lnga pa ru ni rus sbal 17te/ /bri tsog skye mched drug chog nya go/ /drug par chu srin dang 'khrig 14pa/ /rtag tu reg 8pa ru ni 'gro/ /bdun par raṇ+ḍa 16tshe/ /de bzhin du ni tshor ba mchog /brgyad par mi ki ra seng ge/ /mchog tu mthun ⑩ma sred pa'o/ /dgu par bi dri 8dang bu mo/ /nye bar len pa ru ni 'dod/ /bcu par (17sems g.yengs pa dang srang / /srid pa ru —rteni rab tu brjod/ /bcu gcig pa ru rmi lam dang / /briṣ+ṭi 27ka dang skye de bzhin/ /bcu gnyis pa ( ri ru sa'i dbang phyug /gzhu dang rgas shing shi ba'o/ —snye/ /de ltar sa'i dbang phyug sogs dang / /mi lam la sogs shustede bzhin gzhan/ /g.yeng phyesogs bhi dri ka la 78wa 632

sogs / /de bzhin mi ki ra sogs dang / /raṇ+ḍa sogs dang chu srin sogs/ /rus hu)sbal sogs dang khyu mchog sogs/ /bzang po sogs dang rmongs pa sogs//de phyir zla ba rnams bcu gnyis/ /'di rnams nyi mar gang naskyes pa/ /de yi mtshan nyid du ni 'dod/ /skad cig thang cig yud tsam du/ /tshad ri pa'i shing du mtshon par bya/ /mig phye ④btsums par son pas kyang / /shin 5tu phra ba'i dus las so/ /gal te sems ni ting 'dzin gnas/ /rim gyis sa bcu gnyis par ro/ /yang na ting 'dzin mi gnas pa/ /bar ma yi ni 'gro bar 'dod/ /dman pas dmyal ba la sogs pa'i/ /skye bo thams cad 'gro ba'o/ /'dren ma 6rnams kyi bde sdug bsngal/ /las kyis 977kun du longs 8 spyod do/ /gnyis su med pa'i dus can gyis/ /thams cad rang bzhin sa 99la skye/ /de lta 1 yin kyang der skyes pa'i/ /rang gi las kyis 'bras bu za/ /de ltar rnam par gzung tsam gyis/ /thod pa'i dum bu'i nyu1rnal 'byor ldan/ /sngon du bshad pa'i rigs pa yis/ /khams kyi dbus su 'bab pa'o/ /rlung gi kun spyod dus su ni/ /rnal 'byor pa ni skye bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma dgu dang zla ba dang / /lo na mkhas pas 'chi shes bya/ /de la rgyal srid rtsom par 'gyur/ /de lta nyid du the tshom 12med / /ro hi ta yi 32nya com skyes/ /sa yi dbang phyug la 'chi 'gyur/ /sa yi kun spyod dus skyes pa/ /nyi ma brgyad dang zla ba dang / /lo gcig na ni ma shi na / /byang chub sems dpar 32the tshom med/ /rmi lam kun spyod dus su ni/ /dpa' ⑩zhing rtul 'o phod pha rol gnon/ /bsod nams dang ni sdig nyid 'dres / /lnga bcu rtsa bzhi na 'chi'o/ /sems g.yeng ba la dgra yis gsod/ /de yi nyi mar skyes pa po/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'o zla bcu na/ /gal te shi bar ma gyur 78wa 633

na / /de ni 'byor chung phyi nas ni/ /phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba ste/ /bhi tri'i (17nyin mo 'chi ba yin/ /de'i tshe'i tshon)nyi ma la skyes pa/ /lnga pa gnyis dang gsum gcig gi/ /lo na rin shi bar ma gyur na/ /de la 'dod don kun dman zhing ske/ /pha dang ma ni gsod (4)pa ste/ /dka' thub dang ni 'dres pa yis mi ki ra la rang khyim 'chi/ /gang zhig de nyin (snye'adir skyes pa/ /gnyis lnga gsum dgu'i lo na ni/ /de ltar gal te ma shi na/ /de ni thams cad mkhyen pa mnyam/ /yugs sa mo la chur 'chi'o/ /gang zhig de'i tshe nyi mar skyes/ /gnyis dang gsum gyi lo na ni/ /ma shi na ni blo ldan te/ /sdig pa byed po nad dang ldan/ /mi dang mi mo rnams skal bzang / /chu srin la 'chi de nyid la/ /skyes pa bcu (6)lnga gsum lnga yi/ /nyi ma zla ba lo rnams la/ /ma shi na ni mdor na yang 57)/ /yon tan thams cad yongs rdzogs te/ /mtha' skyong ba yi rin rgyal por 'gro/ /rus 99nisbal dang ni 'khrig par 'chi/ /de'i tshe nyi ma la skyes pa/ /gnyis brgyad dgu yi lo na 'chi/ /de ni shi bar ma gyur na/ /tha mal sems can du shes bya/ /dman dang gtso bor 'gro ba'o/ /khyu mchog la ni rang khyim 'chi/ /de yi nyi ma la skyes pa/ /gnyis dang brgyad dang dgu yi ni/ /lo na mkhas pas ma shi na/ /dbang phyug thams cad phun tshogs shing / /khro sogs dang ni lta ba ngan/ /bzang po la ni bsad nas 'chi/ /de nyid nyi ma la skyes pa/ /lnga dang dgu dang bcu na ni/ /skye bo 'dir ni ma shi na/ /phongs shing chos ni phun sum tshogs/ /thams cad kyis ni brgyan mapa ste/ /gti mug la ni chur 'pho'o/ /de yi nyi ma la skyes pa/ /gnyis 3)dgu'i zla ba dang po la/ /gal te de tshe ma shi na/ /thams cad dman zhing dmyal bar te/ /bsam ngan sdig pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rkun 78—634

mo la sogs pas bsad nas/ /ro hi ta nya༄yi nyi mar 'chi/ /de ltar mdor bsdus shes bya ste/ /gal te ting 'dzin ma thob na'o/ /skye rnams mngon sum byed pa yi/ /las rnams gzhan du 'thob pa yin/ /de nyid nye bar gang zhig na / /de ni legs par bsrung bya ste/ /bshad pa'i rim pa'i nyi ma la/ /'grol bar la'adi la the tshom med/ /thod pa'i dum bu rang nyid ni/ /'di rnams shis byed bsgom par bya/ /mkha' 'gror bgrod pa'i gang zhig rtsa/ /de'i dbus bdag nyid spyod par byed/ /de ni sgo nga'i tshon/rigs shes bya/ / gtor ba bskyod tsho pas bsrung bar bya/ /rnal 'byor pa lus 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'dir ni mthe'u chung bskyod par bya/ /rkang mthil dang ni spyi bo'i sgo/ /mtshams rnams kun du bsrung bar bya/ /ā li kā geli mnyam byas nas/ /khams rnams la ni thim par bya / /rnam par shes pa mi g.yo ste/ /thams cad de'i rang bzhin du bya/ /mgo bo'i dbus las nges par yang / /'og tu kha bltas 'bab 'gyur 'gro/ /de'i dbus phyogs su ༅phun tshogs pa/ /rnal 'byor pa de srid mthar 'gro/ /a ba dhū tī medus grangs su/ /ji ltar gsal bar bshad par 'gyur/ /zla phyed lo gsum shes bya ba/ /skye bo'i (8)dus su 'chi ba yin/ /lo brgya rnams kyi gang zhig tshad / /de rnams dbus su brtag par bya/ /ro ma rkyang po nom gnyis dag gi'ang 'i/ /skye ba'i zla ba nyid mtshon bya/ /zla ba zla bar 'joms 'gyur ba/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i cha can noho:/ /dbugs ni gcig gi grangs kyang ni/ /de phyir lo gnyis las gnyis 'gyur/ /sum 'gyur sogs pas thams cad rnams/ /de nas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i 'gyur/ /mkha' bug mig tu shes par bya/ /phyi nas chu tshod rnams su 'gro/ /lo ni na bcu gnyis bar du ni/ /lnga lnga yi yang chu tshod do/ /78—635

drug cu'i lo nas nyi ma 'phel/ /sum cu rtsa bdun zla phyed gsum/ /lnga lnga ru ni 'phel ba rnams/ /nyin mo'i chu tshod ang ka bya/ /skye bo kun gyi 'chi ba ni/ /zla phyed gsum dang lo na shes/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lo rnams kyis/ /gang phyir mi rnams dpyod hu)ldan 'gro/ /sa yi khyim du zhugs nas ni/ /yid kyis ②'chi ba blu (kyeb ste④/ /dpal he ru ka gnas zhugs pa'i(snye/ /thod pa'i dum bu bsam par bya(nyam/ /bgrang ba'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /nyin zhag chu tshod mtshon par bya / /ji lta'i dus su mtshan 77pa yis/ /rim gyis (8)rim gyis bya ba yin/ /byang du bgrod pa'i dus tshod du/ /lha mo rgyal dzinasogs rim pa'o/ /bcu 7la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang bzhi/ /mkhas pas nyi ma'i nyu1chu tshod do/ /mnyam pa'i dus su shes bya ba/ /rang gi dus sbyor du 'chad 'gyur/ /bcu po gsum dang drug po ste/ /mtshan mo'i chu tshod rtsom par byed/ /brgya la dus kyi bye brag gis/ /de yi dbus las shes par bya/ /bcu la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang drug /nyin rnams chu tshod ang ka bya/ /bcu la gsum gyis bsgyur dang bzhi/ /mtshan mo'i chu tshod du ni brtag /bcu la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang brgyad/ /nyi ma rnams kyi chu tshod bzhin/ /bcu la gsum bsgyur gnyis gcig pu/ /mtshan mo'i chu tshod du ni brtagatunye /mnyam dus dbus su gnyis sbyar nas/ /sum cu gcig pur rab tu brtagatso /sum cu rnam pa gnyis rnams kyis/ /nyin re dag gi chu tshod 'byed / /bcu po rnam gsum gnyis gcig pu/ /nyin mo rnams kyi nyi mar brtagaske /bcu po gnyis rnams dang nyu ni brgyad/ /mtshan mo yi ni ang ka bya/ /bcu po rnam gsum ang ka la/ /bzhi dang yang dag ldan pa'o/ /bcu la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang drug /mtshan mo'i chu tshod ang ka bya/ /bcu la gsum gyis 78—636

bsgyur dang drug /nyin dag ye shes can ①gyi'ang nyin/ /bcu la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang bzhi/ /rdul can rnams kyi chu tshod grags/ /lho ru bgrod par rab bshad del/ / nam zla'i (gyidus kyis shes par 'gyur/ /bcu la gsum gyis bsgyur dang bzhi/ /nyin phyed chu tshod yongs su bshad/ /bcu la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang drug /mtshan mo'i de bzhin mtshon par bya/ /bcu la gsum bsgyur gnyis gcig pu/ /nyin rnams chu tshod de bzhin no/ /bcu la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang drug /mtshan mo'i chu tshod du ni grags/ /bcu la gsum bsgyur pas mtshon pa/ /mnyam sogs chu tshod de bzhin te/ /bcu la gsum bsgyur mtshan rnams kyi/ /bi shu'i dbus su gnyis de bzhin/ /bcu la gnyis kyis bsgyur dang brgyad/ /nyin rnams kyi ni nyin mor semasasku/ /bcu po sum 'gyur rdziganyis gcig pu/ /rdul can chu tshod du brtags so/ /bcu po gnyis 'gyur dang ni drug /nyin rnams chu tshod rim pas so/ /bcu po sum 'gyur (6 dang ni bzhi / /rdul can chu tshod rnams de bzhin/ /sum brgya de bzhin drug cu ni/ /chu tshod rnams kyi dbugs bkang (pengo / /chu tshod grangs ni drug cu ni/ /zhag gcig tu ni rnam par brjod/ /zla rnams rim pa ji lta bas/ /de bzhin rim ⑧rnams kyis mtshan no/ /chu tshod dbugs sogs yongs rdzogs pa/ /rim pas 'phel dang 'chad pa ste/ /las dang las min khyad par gyis/ /dbugs ni rim pas yongs su gzung / /de ltar tsonamakha' mkha' ro 7de bzhin/ /zla mig chu tshod de bzhin du/ /lo gcig gir 7ni shes par bya/ /zhag rnams chu tshod mtshon pas so/ /de ltar byas pas rnal 'byor pa/ /dus kyi 'chi ba blu 32bar 'gyur / /lte (7ba'i dbus su pad+ma che/ /ji ltar rdo rje phag mo'o/ /mtshams kun 78—637

son pa'i pad+ma la/ /ba mo dang 'dra 'dzag 3)par bya/ /lte ba'i dbus mtha' bcu gnyis su/ /'gro ba tshona'ong ba byed pa nyid/ /srog gi thig le sbyobade bgrod pa'ang ske/ /mtshams kun du ni 'bab pa can/ /blo ldan lo gcig sbyor ba yis/ /de nyid du ni thim par bya/ /til mar me ni 'bar ba yi/ /gzugs can kha (peni 'og tu bltas/ /chu shing me tog dang 'dra ba/ /mkhas pa yis ni 'phyang bzhin pa'o / /lte bar a 5yi rnam pa'i gzugs/ /thung ngu ring 77po 'phar (7)ma'i bdag /phyag rgya lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs/ /dbyangs dang phyi mo gnyis med gnas / / bsgom dang sgrub 8pa mo bshad pa/ /rtul po bar ma rnon po dang / /lhag par rno dang shin 994lhag rno/ /thams cad de rnams su brtags so/ /gang phyir rang bdag nyid kyis bsgrubs/ /de phyir gzhan gyis kyang bsgrub bya/ /nus mthu 'jig rten 'di nyid la/ /skye bo kun la yid ches byed/ /phyi nas gdul byar 'gro ba yin/ /rang gzhan 11don gyis sems brlan nyi pas/ /dbyangs bcu gnyis ni thob byas nas/ /dge dang mi dge bshad par bya/ /'khor lo bcu gnyis rnams su ni/ /dbyangs kyi bdag po mtshon par bya/ /a yig gis ni ye lho shes dang / /mkhas pa chos don thams cad 'thob/ / ā yi yi skogis 'tshir ba dang / /gos dang 'chi bar rnam nges bshad/ /srid 32pa'i 'jigs pa ma lus pa/ /mthong 'gyur lam las nyams par 'gyur/ /i yi yi ge yongs thob pas / /sa yi dbang phyug tu ni 'gro/ /khri yi yi ge yang dag 'thob/ /myur ba nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /u nya9yi yi ge thob pa yis/ /skye ba dran par 'gyur 'gro ba'o/ /u yi yi ge gal te 'thob/ /yul la zhen pa can du 'gro/ /i 8yi yi ge yang dag 'thob/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid du 'gro/ /e nyu8yi yi ge 78—638

sems rmongs zhing 51)/ /'gro ba drug sogs 'jigs ri par 'gyur/ /o yig pha rol phyin pa yi9kye/ /der ni sa 'thob rnam des ston/ /au yi ang 4ka thob pa yis / /dam tshig nyams par 'gro ba yin/ /e 95 yig byang chub sems dpa' rnams / /mthong bas skad cig la grol 6)'gyur/ /aḥ7༄yig yang dag thob pa yis / /phung po khams la the tshom za/ /de la sogs pa ma lus pa/ /ma gsungs kyang ni bsgrub par bya/ /bla ma bstan bcos rang nyid de/ /rnam gsum chos kyis yid ches bya/ /zhes bya ba ni tshonas thod pa'i (9 dum bu can gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid kyi sgrub 97pa'i thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub 517thabs kyi ming can te thog ma'i tshig go/ /rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //de nas keng 3 rus chen po yi/ /mtshan nyid bdag gis bshad bya ste/ / bong 'dra'i 1nyarnal 'byor bdag nyid kyis/ /yid kyi shugs ni 'jug med bya/ /khams mnyam nyugepa yi ri bo ni/ /spyi bo'i gnas su bsgoms pa nyid/ /pad snal skud pa kha 'og 35bltas/ /glog ni kun du 'gro ba mo/ /de yi dbus su dpa' mo che / /bong bu'i dbyibs can bsgom par bya/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad yang dag rdzogs/lha/ /mchod pa chen po bsam par bya/ /de yi dbus su dpa' chen po / /keng rus chen po'i sbyor bas so/ /skud pa rnams kyis 1 lte dbus su/ /srub (snyedang bsrub pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /hā 16yig rnam pa yi ni gzugs/ /mgo las sne )skud pa gcig po ste/ /me long rnam pa'i sems tsho 1kyis ni/ /thod 2lhapa'i dbus su ngal bso 32bya/ /bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun rnams kyis / /khung bu'i dbus su'ang 'dzag nasnyepar 'gyur/ /thim dang longs spyod sogs dngos 78—639

pos / /sems kyi bgrod pa bstan par bya/ /khung der bong 0)bu'i rnal 'byor gyisal/ /skye ba bdun yang mthong bar (kye'agyur/ /ma las byung ba'i dbyibs gsum dang / /pha tshilas byung ba gi gsum de bzhin/ /khams thams cad dang bdun po de/ /rnal 'byor bsgoms (5)pas mthong bar 'gyur/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin khams kun gyis/ /keng rus chen po yang dag byung / /lā ma la ⑥sogs bsgoms pa yis/ /de la gnas pa'i gzugs mthong 'gyur/ /bong bu'i rnam pa'i rnal 'byor du(7)/ /khrag gi zhal can (shertse gsum can(9)/ /tshe son pa yang rnam par shes/ /tshe ring ba yang mthong bar 'gyur/ /snga mar glang po che sogs pa / /dpa' rang bdag nyid kyis de mthong / /chen po'i rtsa rnams thams cad du / /keng rus srog ni yongs ri 'gro bya/ /de bskyod bong bu nyu1shes bya ste/ /sna tshogs rang bzhin de mthong 'gyur/ /sā pho)lu la sogs bza' ba'i dngos/ /de dang 'dra bar dngos po kun/ /mthong ste de na yod pa min/ /khams thams cad kyang 'khrul pa'o/ /ji ltar skyes bur dus rnams kyis/ /glang chen khams kyis shes par bya/ /de bzhin keng rus che rnams kyis/ /sā hu)li la sogs khams rkyen gyis/ /rang bzhin 'jig rten pa dmigs pas/ /rang bdag nyid kyi gzugs de mthong / /rnam pa sna tshogs rigs de rnams/ /rnal 'byor 'dzin rnams kyis shes bya/ /ma rig sogs nyin so so la/ /de rnams kyis ni nad du grags/ /rims la sogs pa'i nad tsam gyis/ /nad chen rnam par mtshon par bya/ /de la ma rig nyi ma'i nad/ /legs pa rnams kyis de bsrung bya / /'pho ba bcwa 8lnga pa la ni/ /'chi 'am las ni dge mi dge'i/ /ye shes me tso yi bdag nyid ches/ /nub lnga rnams na nyu tshogrol bar 'gyur/ /rga shi yi ni dus su 78wa 640

ni / /'pho ba gsum na 'chi ba ste/ /yang na dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /las kyi bag chags mthong bar 'gyur/ /rang rig bde ba gzung ba yis/ /nub bdun na ni grol bar 'gyur/ /skye ba'i nyi ma'i 'chi ba ni/ /'pho ba gsum pa na yang ste/ /las ni dge mi dger 'gro ba/ /nub bdun na ①ni grol bar 'gyur / /srid pa yi ni 'pho gsum ni②/ /'chi bar 'gyur ro mtshan mo ni/ /lnga na de rnams grol bar 'gyur/ /yang na de ni mi grol te/ /'das pa bzhi pa'i dus rnams su/ /bde ba de kun rtogs par gyis/ /de lta'i rigs 'gyur de rnams su/ /ji lta'i rim ③pas shes par bya/ /lan ④pa'i 'chi ba'i 'pho ba ni / /gsum pa dang ni bzhi pa na'o/ /gal te las ni dge mi dges/ /mtshan mo bcu na grol bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams phun sum tshogs kun dang / /blo dang ldan pas 'pho med bsgrub⑤/ /sred pa'i 'pho ba gsum na 'chi/ /las ni dge dang mi dge ste/ /nor bu'i nang son la blta bya/ /mtshan mo bdun na nges grol te/ /nga yi ngag la the tshom med/ /tshor ba'i 'pho ba lnga na ni/ /'chi 'gyur las kyang ngo de bzhin/ /dgu dang bcu dag na grol te/ /rdo rje pad dbus son pas so/ /reg pa'i nyin mo'i 'pho ba ni/ /brgyad na 'chi bar shes par bya/ /de ltar las dge mi dge srid/ /yan lag drug gis thim par bya/ /gcig dman nyi shu'i nyi ma na/ /grol ba'am yang na mi grol lo/ /skye mched drug gi 'chi ba ni/ /las dge mi dges blta bya ste/ /'pho ba brgyad ni sbyonashes par bya / /khams kyi nad rnams de mthong ⑦'gyur/ /nub bcu na ni grol 'gyur te/ /'khor lo bzhi ru thim par bya/ /ming dang gzugs la 'chi ba'i las/ /gsum pa 'am ni lnga pa yi/ /'pho ba dag ni 2shes par bya/ /mtshan mo brgyad na 'grol ⑨78—641

ba'ol/ /sems ni thig le'i gnas son par/ /brten 0)par 'gyur ba'i ②cho ga bya / /rnam par shes pa'i 'chi ba'i las/ /slar yang brgyad dang bcu pa yi/ /'pho bar sa la shes par bya/ /yang na de nyid la 'grol 57te/ /bcu drug phyed phyed kyi gzugs can/ /ye shes rlung gis ④gzung bar bya/ /'du byed kyi ni 'chi ba'i las/ /gsum dang bdun gyi de bzhin du/ /bltas par gyur pas 'pho ba yin/ /de yi lta bas grol bar 'gyur/ /thig le gnyis ni shes byas nas / /steng du 'gro bas thim par bya/ /'di yis nad dang 'chi med 'gyur/ /de phyir sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /sum cu bdun bdag nyid dge ba/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /keng rus chen po'i gtso bo yi/ /rnal 'byor pa yis thams cad mthong / /zhes bya ba ni bong bu'i rnal 'byor la keng rus chen po sgom (gepa po'i man ngag de kho na nyid dang ldan pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas keng rus kyi sbyor bas/ /yul yul rang gi skye gnas skyes/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' gtso mo/ /ye shes ldan pas shes par bya/ /a skyor dgod par rdul lha mo/ /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi gtso/ /de yi gnas su gnas lha mo/ /ka dam shing la dril chen ma/ /lha mo de yi rtag pa'o(nen/ /zhing skyong zhal chen po yin no/ /keng rus bde ba'i sgyu ma yin97)/ /bdag nyid che las nges (8)'byung 'gyur / /de rnams keng rus kyis rgyas btab/ / o byen dzinyebu ga las steng son//rang khams las bzhengs rnam par shes/ /rim gyis yul thams cad du 'gro/ /ko lha'i ri dang ba ru 67/ /de bi ko ṭa skobar dza kai/ /e ru 2 hunyedang de nas 78—642

grong ske/ /e ①la'i grong dang kha che dang / /ma ru'i ④grong dang de bzhin du/ /puṇ+ḍa ba dha na yi zhing ①/ /dza yarnyi dang dṛṣ+ṭa'i ④grong / /sau pa re dang spyod de bzhin / / o byon ⑤dang ni 'bar ba 'dzin/ /k+ṣe yire ke dang sgyu ma'i grong / /e bu ke dang rgyal po'i khab/ /bod kyi yul dang de bzhin du/ /mā la ba 9)dang pu lir dusogs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas yin no/ /ri yi rtse dang tā la'i shing / /pa dhiṭa a mra gser de bzhin/ /ral pa'i shing dang gzhan gnon dang / /ri yi rtse mor yang dag rten/ /thang chen po dang rtsa khung dang / /a shad tha tsodang khang pa brtsegs7/ /u dum bā hunyer shal nyusnyem li(7/ /ka rañdza 7skya ngan med la brtenatso / /gser shing dang ni sā ⑩la dang / /tsu ta dhā tu dil la ki/ /brag brtsegs pa dang sbrang rtsi'i shing / /sngon du yang dag brten phonyepa'o/ /rdul gyi skye gnas chol 17pa'i lus/ /stobs chen dang ni rnal 'byor gnas/ /thod pa las dang rdul rab gtumadu )/ /skye gnas dpa' bo chol ( nyepa'i lus/ /stobs chen rnams dang khrag de bzhin/ /dpa' bo'i skye zhunyaganas nus 8stelas byung / /skye gnas zla ba las byung dang / /stobs chen rigs las byung ba dang / /'jigs byed khrag las byung de bzhin/ /tshil dang g.yul ngo 0che las skyes/ /me tog skye ( snyeganas gnyis de bzhin/ /slar yang de nyid tshig dran bya/ /'di rnams rigs las byung lha mo/ /lhan cig skyes gzugs bu mo yin/ /dpal chen mo dang me yi kha / /zhing skyong mchog gi zhal can te/ /me yi gdong can zhes grags pa/ /keng rus bde ba rig du stepa po'o kū/ /de yi 'pho ba 'dzin pa ni/ /rnal 'byor ma gnyis spro bar byed/ /de yis 9de 'dod sbyor ba yis/ /dpa' bo gnyis med yang dag brten kū/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /rdo rje'i sro )dkyil 78—643

'khor du gnas te/ /kun tu spyod pa'i ①bgrod gzugs kyis/ /yul thams cad du 'gro ba yin/ /lang dbang phyug ma gyen brjes ②skra/ /zhing skyong gtsigs ②pa chen po ste/ /gyen brjes ④spa zhes bshad pa ni/ /keng rus bde ba'i rgyu can te / /rnal 'byor ma mchog khyad par ni/ /lhag ma sngon gsungs bzhin shes bya/ /rna ba gcus (shedang drag mo ste/ /zhing skyong ba ni lus chen no/ /de nas yang na rgyu can dang / /mchog dbang phyug ma drag chen pozhin/ /keng rus bde ba'i stong pa yis/ /go 'phang mchog tu shes par bya/ /zhi ba'i gzugs dang me dang ni/ /zhing skyong a skyor dgod pa'o/ /me dang 'khrul tsochen dag dang ni/ /sgra chen por yang shes par bya/ /keng rus kyi ni gtum mo ni/ /'bar ba'i dbus su bde ba che/ /me yi gdong ⑧dang brtson chen ma/ /zhing skyong ba ni dril bu'i sgra/ /brtson 'grus chen mo zhes grags pa/ /keng rus bde ba'i 'byung gnas yin/ /dmar ser grags dang 'jigs mig ma/ /zhing skyong byin pa chen po ste/ /'jigs byed ma dang spyan ma 'am/ /keng rus bde ba'i (9)'gengs byed pa'o/ /'jigs chen ma dang stobs chen ma/ /zhing skyong glang po chen po ste/ /yang na glang po'i rna ma 7dang / /zhing skyong glang po'i rna can te/ /keng rus bde ba la zhon pa51lha/ /rtsa thams cad du de'i rang bzhin/ /ba lang rna ma ri'i rtse ma/ /zhing skyong 'jigs byed chen po ste/ /de nas slar yang sbug ma'i byin8/ /keng rus bde ba la thim pa'o/ /bgrod pa mo dang 'jigs zhal ma/ /zhing skyong ba ni gtsigs pa ste/ /rmongs par byed ma zhal chen po/ /keng rus bde ba la chags pa'o / /ro langs ma dang 32bzhin bzang mo/ /zhing skyong ba spu'i byin pa can/ /yang na gyen gtsigs chen po ste/ /keng rus bde ba la za'o0/ / tsā muṇ+ḍa tsodang 78—644

lha chen mo/ /zhing skyong bum pa'i rlig pa can/ /yang na lha mo chen mo dang / /zhing skyong bum pa'i grul can te/ /yang na lha chen po yin no/ /keng rus bde bar gar ①byed pa'o/ /rab gus ma dang ral gsum ma/ /zhing skyong gtsigs pa chen po ste/ /yang na ral pa gsum shes bya/ /keng rus bde ba'i pha rol phyin / /glog gi gdong ma dril sgra ma/ /zhing skyong lug pa'i gdong can te/ /dril bu'i sgra ru nges grags pa/ /'dir ni keng rus bde za ba'o/ /me zhal ma dang lha chen mo/ /zhing skyong 'jigs par byed pa ste/ /yang na lha chen por shes bya / /keng rus bde ba'i gzi can no/ /ka rañdza ②gnas ma de bzhin/ /gzhan yang dril bu chen mor grags/ /zhing skyong ba ni stobs chen te/ /keng rus bde bas mdzes pa yin/ /gsang grags ma dang lha chen mo/ /drag (ldegazugs ma dang stobs chen ma/ /zhing skyong sgra chen po dang ni/ /drag ④po'i gzugs dang stobs chen te/ /keng rus bde las yongs byung ba'i/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur rnal 'byor ldan/ /gtum mo dang ni drag mo dang / /zhing skyong ba ni 'bar bar grags / /de nas yang na drag po'i gzugs/ /keng rus bde ba'i cha lugs can / /'jig rten gyi ma gyen skra mo/ /zhing skyong ri rab chen po ste/ /de nas yang na gyen brjes skra/ /keng rus bde ba sgom ⑤pa po'o/ /'jigs pa mo dang stobs chen mayi/ /zhing skyong 'jigs pa de bzhin te/ /stobs po che dang 'jigs gzugs ma/ /keng rus bde ba'i snying po can/ /srul mo 97)dang ni lha chen mo/ /zhing skyong brtul zhugs rdokhyachen po ste/ /keng rus bde ba'i nus pa yis / /de phyir dbang po kun bde ba'o/ /bi pan sa ma dril nyali sgra/ /⑩zhing skyong rna ba chen po can/ /yang na dril li sgrogs pa ste/ /keng rus bde ba 78—645

'dzag 0)pa'o/ /lhan skyes grags ma 'byor grags ma/ /dpa' bo chen po de bzhin mchog /zhing skyong shin tu thub dka' ste/ /keng rus bde ba dpog byed pa'ol/ /dbang bskur rinamanyam ma skyes dbang phyug /zhing skyong sna tshogs dbang phyug ste/ /keng rus bde ba la gnas pas/ /rang nyid 'dod pa'i bde bar 'gyur / /rdo rje mgo bo 90rtse gsum dang / /dar dang rdo rje mdung thung dang / /gtun shing zhags pa de bzhin du/ /rdo rje'i lcags sgrog (na/lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa gshol 5dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 6cig /rdo rje lcags sgrog (7phyag can dang / /dbyug pa mdung thung gri gug dang / /mdung thung rdo rje lcags sgrog zhusacan/ /gri gug ral gri de bzhin du/ /rdo rje dang ni mdung thung gshol/ /ga da rdo rje kyo 6)de bzhin / /chu srin rgyal mtshan tho ba'o/ /zhi ba'i zhal du shes bya dang / /gtsigs ma dang ni rab 'jigs ma/ /chos kyi dbang phyug rab ster ma/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun mchog ma/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug rab ster ma/ /yang dag rmongs pa'i zhing ster ma/ /gtsigs ma rmongs pa'i zhing ma dang / /'jigs chen ma dang de bzhin gzhan/ /gtum zhal ma dang dgra 'joms ma/ /rmongs pa'i zhing gi 'jigs byed ma/ /dpa' bo kun la mchog ster ma/ /longs spyod grol ba sdig 1 tsho'ajoms ma/ /bde ba kun gyi mchog ster ma/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed ma/ /gtsigs shinam drag cing 'jigs pa mo/ /sha yi gdan can ma dang gzhan/ /bde ba'i dbang phyug mchog ster ma/ /mdzes shing thams cad dgos ma dang / /'jig rten dngos grub ster ba mo/ /lha mo gtsigs ma 'jigs par byed/ /shin tu drag mo gzugs bzang mo8/ /dbang phyug thams cad rab ster ma/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ma/ /'jigs 78—646

ma sgrub ma grags ster ma/ /nag po'i 0)gzugs dang drag chen po(ge/ /dgra thams cad kyi 'jigs pa zhon/ /thams cad dbang du byed ma 9kyedang / /sems can thams cad 'jigs byed ma/ /'khor lo kun rgyal ma nyid dang / /'jigs par byed dang de bzhin gzhan/ /zhi ba'i zhal ma gzugs bzang ma/ /sgrub ④po rnams la mthun (shebyed ma/ /snyan grags ma (6stedang rab stod rtsonam/ /de ltar thams cad rim bzhin no/ /askyor dgod pa'i (khu'akhor lor bzhugs/ /ko la'i rir ni ro la bzhugs/ /ba ru rtse 1〉sid+dha sau pa ḍir7/ /lha mo'i mkhar du yi dgas gnas/ /bi ra dza ru mashing leb bzhugs/ / e ra n+ya 3 ru phag 3nyal bzhugs / /de nas grong du yi dgas bzhugs/ /e le'i grong du bong bur gnasal/ /kha cher nor sbyin la ni gnas/ /ma ru'i yul du ma her gnas/ /grong du mgo yi rgyab tu ste/ /puṇ+ḍa 8ba dhar ro la gnas/ /dza yan t+ya ru keng rus gnas/ /priṣ+ṭi'i ⑩grong du brtsegs ri par gnas/ /so pā red par 3 7ta la gnas / /ka rañdzar tshiganas tsa ri trīr/ /o byen 0du ni bdud la bzhugs/ /'bar ba 'dzin par ro la gnas/ /k+ṣi ri kur ni me la gnas/ / sgyu yi 2 )grong du re 0yi steng / /e bu ke ru 3seng ger gnas/ /rgyal po'i khab tu 'khor lor gnas / /bod kyi yul du yi dgas gnas/ /ror gnas ma 3)la bar de bzhin/ /keng rus kyi ni rab sbyor bas/ /de lta'i zhing du dngos grub 'gyur/ /keng rus las byung bde ba ni/ /rtsa yi (stertsa ba las yongs langs mi/ /mtshams rnams kun du khyab par ni/ /ye shes khu ba de mthong 'gyur/ /mgo med las byung ba'i ngag 'di / /khams de nyid ni za ba'o/ /dbang po gnyis kyi mkha' 5gnas las/ /de yis bde ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /thams cad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /78—647

mkhas rnams cung zad med par 'gyur/ /de'i rang bzhin 'gro sgyu mar ①ni/ /lto ba bsdus 90pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /'phyang ba yis (sne)ni thams cad du/ /bdud rtsi de ni 'gro dang 'ong (ge/ /'dzag bzhin pa yis rnal 'byor ma/ /rang gi zhing skyes rnam par spro/ /phyi nang bdag nyid gsang ba yi(nye/ /de rnams la ni mchod chen bya/ /mi shes ri bo gcod pa yis6)/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngon bshad dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /de nas keng rus bsgom par bya/ /skye 'gro'i gtso bo'i dpa' bo yang / /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can / /gsungs pa'i yul du rnal 'byor ma/ /de nas rab gtum sogs ming ste / /sgrub ri pa pos ni dngos grub rgyur(8)/ /der ni 'du ba yang bya'o/ /bza' dang btung sogs yang dag brtsamaṇi/ /nyer spyod lnga sogs mchod pa dang / /nyer spyad tshegator ma'i snod rnams ni/ /rlon pa'i sha dang nya la sogs/ /bza' ⑪dang rdzas rnams thams cad dang / /bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin gzhan/ /g.yon par snod rnams bzhag pho byas nas/ /g.yas su khro bo bstan par bya/ /shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dam/ /ri dang khrod dang khyim dang ni/ /grong dang grong khyer ngos hu rnams dang / /khang stong lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / /chu la 'gro dang thang la rgyu/ /sa dang ma mo'i khyim chadang 'gram/ /nag mo drag mo drag chen mol/ /lha sbyin yang dag rten tsom dang / /nag mo gtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang ske/ /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren dang / /tsā muṇ+ḍi tsodang drag gzugs ma/ /lha mo dbu ma dang ni ma/ /rgyal ma rnam par rgyal ma dang / /mi ⑩thub ma dang gzhan mi thub/ /bzang nag mo dang nag chen mo/ /sbom nag mo dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo /8zla ba mo drag rtso)mo/ /snang ma 'phyang ma du sum 78—648

cu'i dbang / /kum po dzam me ma 'jib ①ma/ /grong du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /drag gzugs ma dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ma (shedrag mo gcigs pa mo/ /lha mo thod pa'i phreng can dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ chag ni 'dzin ma dang / /mi'u ④thung ma dang dgra sta'i phyag /rdo rje'i phyag can de bzhin gzhu/ /mkha' 'gro ma lnga de nyid che/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub sprim/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mo dang / /rdor dbang phyug ma gtso de bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /rdul med rnal 'byor stong pa nyid/ /rdo rje'i dbang phyug bka' yis ni / /kun nas 'dir ni spyan 'dren no/ /oṃ ⑨ka k+ka ku na ba bla (pebarnya na kha k+ṣa ⑧'a da na sarba dugle ⑨na ha na ha na ghā ta ya ghā ta ya che ge mo'i dgos pa mdzod cig /rtsu tso/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ bdud rtsi'i themakha ni yongs bkang nas/ /lha thams cad ni mnyes par bya/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma bsgom bya/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ bha k+ṣa sarba yo gi 12sha rī rtsu nyu rgyu dzaḥswā hā / ji lta'i las 8sogs yongs spyor 8ba/ /gtor ma'i las (19sogs yongs sbyar bya/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /dgug dang gsad ri dang dbye ba dang ske/ /rengs pa gtor ma'i de nyid kyis8/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi las rnams kun / /bsgrub bya'o ye shes lcags kyu yis/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i lha tshim bya/ /zhing dang gnas dang de bzhin grong / /grong khyer ram ni ri bo ru/ /'byung po mang po rab tu bsdu/ /de yi tshogs ni 'du ba'o/ /rtsa thams cad kyi kun spyod kyis / /de yi srog kyang bsdu ba'o/ /rang gi mdud pa'i gnas 'dus nyu7pa/ /de nas zhu lte ba snying gar ༷ 0nya'adod/ /rnal 'byor ma la gus 'dud pas / /sgrub pa pos ni mchog 'thob ( 3'gyur/ /rtag tu gnas dang nye gnas su/ /sdod la lha 78wa 649

yis mchog ster 'gyur/ /gnas der nyams pa dang ldan pa/ /sngon gyi cho gas bsgrub par bya/ /bug rdol dang ni rgas ①pa dang / /shu ba mdze sogs spang ba ni / /'byung po'i (0nyi ma thob byas nas/ /de ltar legs mnyam bzhag ④pas bsgrubage / /lha yi chu yis khrus byas te/ /khyad par du yang bdud rtsi lngas/ /yan lag mar nag chen pos byug /de nyid kyi (9ni bdug spos 0sbyin/ /nges par gru bzhi gru 9pegasum pa'i(8༄/ /dbus su 'bad pas 99)bya ba yin/ /ji lta bar ni sngon bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gsan du gzhug /gad nya )mo rnam pa brgyad bya ste/ /hā hā tī tī hū hū phonyuhe nyam/ /zhes bya 8sgrub 0pa po yis so me 33yi sa bon yang dag zhonatso/ /rlung gis su ni phye ba yin)/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu sbyar byas nas/ /sa yi mthil du mchod byas nas/ /skye gnas dbus su dgod bya ste//'bad pas zhu ba blta nyurtebar bya/ /skye gnas dbus su rim ji bzhin/ /bdag nyid bsam bya rnal 'byor pas/ /pho nya'i ⑨ 'od zer kun nas 'khrigs )/ /'bar ba'i phreng lhab rgya mtsho blta/ /de ltar rnam par bsam ( —9gyur pas/ /rnal 'byor thams cad bde ba'i dgeganas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs//bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni keng rus kyi cho ga ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas mche ba rnam 2stegatsigs pa'i/ /ting 'dzin sbyor gnas bshad bya ste/ /gzhu 'gengs rim pa 'ong ba ni/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor pas yod de/ /srog gi thig le son bsam pa/ /mtshams thams cad du de brgyud de(snye/ /gzhu dbyug mtshan mar bsam par bya/ /sgra thams cad ni skul 0ba yis/ /kun nas 'gengs 78—650

bzhin pa yi mda'/ /dbus ma'i lte (7bar 'dzom ②pa yis/ /rnam par shes pa'i 'ben gzhom bya/ /'byung gnas thams cad gsad pa tsho(yin/ /bgrod bzhin pa yi 0bde ba cher/ /der rig pa yis gzhan du 'gro/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa yi/ /rab sbyor rnams kyis nges 'byung 'gyur/ /mtshon bya phyizad pa med 'joms pa/ /skye bo rnams (yel 'jug par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i spyod yul las/ /gzhan gyi ⑦grong rnams su 'jug pa'o/ /sngon gyi sprul pa'i bag chags ni/ /de la rgyun du 'joms par byed/ /rnam par zhu ba'i bdag nyid che/ /zhi ba'i gzugs su ster bar 'gyur/ /nyi 9shezhes rkang pa'i mthil ⑨bar du/ /nor bu'i skud pa bzhin du bgrod/ /na de mtshams kyi don dam par//sa gsum po la lta bar 'gyur/ /de phyir skye bo thams cad la/ /mtshon bya mtshan nyid kyis 'byed do/ /dbang po de rnams thams cad la/ /bdag nyid kyis 'bugs 0slar ci 7smos/ /'gro ba gzhan du rab 'jug par/ /mchog tu rmad byung 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bar yang dag gnas/ /skye ba 32kun la rnam par blta/ /mig sogs rnam par shes pa ni/ /nang rnams su ni bskyod ⑫par byos8/ /mkha' 'gro'i rnam par de shes bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gzugs kyi gtso / /dkyil 'khor sngon du sprul par ni/ /mche gtsigs la sogs bsgom par bya / /rang gi khams ni bde ba'i gzugs/ /rang rang gtso bor bya ba yin/ /de las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro che/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa'i gzugs/ /thams cad chos 'byung sna tshogs pa'i/ /snying por gzhom du med zhi ba/ /chos kun gcig tu yongs bsdus pa/ /sngags pas cho ga bzhin du bri/ /ā li kā li mnyam byas 1snonas/ /sde tshan rnams kyis yongs brjes pa/ /'dod don 78—651

thams cad sgrub 0)byed pa/ /der gnas dpa' bos yang dag btu/ /ye shes lha ⑧sogs sku bzhi po/ /zhes bya 'thob 'gyur the tshom med/ /steng 'og rtag tu dngos grub ster/ /bdag nyid pho nya kun 'gros so/ /yi ge lnga bcu sde tshan brgyad / /de nyid mkha' 'gro mchog rmad byung / /sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor yang na ni / /chung ngu'i rgyud dang 'dra ba mchog /yi ge thams cad kyi ni tshad/ /sdom pa sogs su mtshon par bya/ /yi ge rnams dang ming rnams dang / /sdom pa rnams su de brjod do/ /dkyil 'khor rnams dang rgyud rnams dang / /le'u rnams dang ci)de bzhin du/ /las tshogs rnams ni thams cad de/ /nyis 'gyur thung ngu ring ba'o⑤/ /de nyid du ni kun nges rgyal/ /'byin cing sdud par byed pa po/ /sems can rigs zhes 'dir de bshad/ /re re yi ni mtshan nyid do/ /re re yi ni bsgom (7pa ni/ /ji lta'i rim pas shes par bya/ /yi ge yi ni ming dang gzugs/ /de ni sems can gzugs su 'dod/ /gsang sngags de ni zlos bzhin pa/ /de nyid du ni rab gzhug bya/ /a yig thig le dang bral ba/ /dmar po phyi mo rnam par spangs/ /a yig thig le dang bcas pa/ /de phyir mtshal (7gyi rigs can no/ /guñdza'i me tog dang 'uramanyam par/ /i ⑨yig la ni brgyan par 'dod0/ /khri ༅yig sid+dha 57ra yi mdog /bzang po lnga par shes par bya/ /u yig dbang po'i gzhu yi 'od/ /u yi 51geyi ge drug pa nyid/ /glog ④gnyis dang ni 'dra ba'o/ /ṛ tsoyig du ba'i kha dog ste/ /phra mo lus ni spangs pa'o / /rī 0yi yi ge mun pa'i gzugs/ /bla 'o tshoni bya rog gshog 8pa mtshungs/ /lī 7yi yi ge mtshal gyi mdog /i sno )yi yi ge dmar skya ste hūṃ/ /i sid+dha ra dmar mdog ma/ /o yi yi ge nyi ma 'dra/ /'od zer stong phrag gyen du 'bar/ /au 78—652

yi yi ge rtag 'bar ba/ /nyi ma bye ba ①dang mnyam 'od/ /zla phyed de bzhin du thig le/ /i ②yig sngon du bshad pa can/ /zla ba gnyis dang tsheg drag ste/ /aḥ yig rgyal po de bzhin rnal/ /de ltar stong pa nyid bcu drug /las rnams kyi ni dag ⑤pa'i rgyu/ /myos dang brlab gdol (nyarmongs pa dang / /sems bral dang po'i ⑦stong nyid do/ /rmongs pa dang 'khrugs dbang dang ni/ /myur du thams cad ster ba'o/ /bsam bral ba dang myos pa dang / /brlab gdon (kyedu ni bsal ⑨ba'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi las bsgoms pas/ /de ni rmugs dang dbang du 'ong / /yang dag rmongs dang rnam marmongs 'gyur/ /lus brlan pa dang sems pa (nyebral/ /dbang 3nyedu 'od dang dgug pa dang / /ye shes shes bya can mchog go/ /bskrad pa dang ni bzhu beba'i las/ /rnam pa bdun du 'dod pa yin / /sa yi zil gnon 'dzin bzhin dang / /bsngags 8min pa dang rmongs pa'i sems/ /skye ba 'di la nam du yang / /de yi slar yang 'ong min pa'o/ /rnam par sdang dang thams cad kyi/ /'jig rten gyis ni smod pa'o/ /'jig rten kun dang mthun snyimed la/ /skad cig gnas pa spangs pa'o/ /yid kyi las ni thams cad rnams/ /de phyir 'jig rten gsum gang 'gyur/ /bde ba kha yis bkug byas nas/ /dbugs med ri mo 'dzag pa nub/ /phyi mo'i yal ga rnams kyis bya/ /dam tshig dbang phyug ma'i gnas kyis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin ni/ /gnyis stong mchog tu zag pa med/ /sangs rgyas ri mo steng 'og tu/ /pad+ma'i snal 7can rab tu gnas/ / ā li kā boli mdor bsdus pa/ /bcud len khams kyi lus las so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha/ /zhal du yongs su 'gyur ba'o/ /de yi 'og dang gang gzhan du/ /yi ge thams cad nges 78—653

par gnas/ /so sor snang ba ma byung bar/ /srung 19ba gyis zhes bdag gis bshad / /sems ni rjes mthun na)dbyangs su 'gyur/ /sems ni stong pa'i rang bzhin can/ /zla gnyis yang dag sbyor ba ni/ /phyag rgya mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'o//de ltar khams kyi rang bzhin kyang / /ji ltar 'dod pa'i las bya'o/ /slar yang thams cad byed pa yi/ /stong pa nyid ni so sor dgod/ /thog (kyem gnyis ni rkang gnyis dgod/ /brla dang gsang ba rked pa dang / /lte ba snying ga ④steng dang ni/ /mgrin pa dang ni rkan de bzhin/ /kha dang sna dang rna dag dang / /dpral ba mgo bo rgyab tu ste(5/ /rang gi khams ming 'du shes kyis/ /dbang la sogs pa'i las byed do/ /slar yang re re yi yang ni/ /las ni nyi shu lnga'i bdag nyid/ /stong nyid de nyid rig byed pa/ /rgyun du nang du bsgom par bya /ka yig la sogs ma yig mthar/ /lha mo bdag nyid chen mos nyon/ /gang gis sa gsum gyi ni lha/ /thams cad lha ma yin dang mi/ / sgrub po'i 56legs par nges par ni/ /de rnams thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /de nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ /ka yig sogs su 'du shes so/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor lus dang ni/ /lha dang bla ma dang ni sngags/ /rnam shes ye shes snying po dang / /dus dang rgyu dang rdzi'abras de bzhin / /dbugs ('o dang bcud len las dang ni/ /gtor ma sa dang phyag rgya gzhan/ /dbang po dbu ma sgyu ma dang / /mtshams 7dang rigs rus de bzhin te/ /lung ni rjes su rig pa dang / /mig 'phrul 'dra ba rim ji ltar / /de ltar de nyid las mdzes pa/ /shes rab chen pos shes par bya/ /rang bzhin gyis 11ni brjod pa'i las/ /dus kyi me yi mdog can no/ /ji ltar dbang la 12sogs pa'i las/ /lnga lnga ru ni gsal ba yin/ /dmar dang gnag 78—654

dang de bzhin dkar0)/ /ser dang ljang gu (gede bzhin no/ /sgrub po'i bsgrub bya'i 'dod pa ni/ /de rnams de nyid 'gyur gyis 'ong / /ya yig la sogs dgu rnams kyi(kye/ /ji lta'i cho gas yi ge rnams/ /phung po khams kyi rigs rnams dang ske/ /yan lag dgu rnams bla)brjod pa'o(5)/ /ji lta'i rim pas blo ldan gyis / /dgu dgu ru ni shes par bya/ /las ni de rnams shes bya ste/ /'dus pa bde mchog bla ma dang / /bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /'byung ba de nyid 'dus pa dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed saṃ bu ṭa76ci/ /ji lta'i cho gas gzhan du yang (7da/ /de ltar nges brjod 'bum gsum las/ /phyung ba bde mchog chung ngu ste/ /a yig la sogs k+ṣaḥ(2)yig mthar/ /le'u rnams ji lta'i rim pa yis/ /de kho na nyid dhildan par sbyar ⑩/ /sdom pa rgya mtsho mkha' 'gro skyes/ /mkha' mnyam nang du rab bshad pa'i/ /de yi sgrub snamathabs bshad par bya/ /ji ltar 12dbus ma'i pad+mar ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni gsal bar bsgom32/ /sku yi rgya mtsho ser sna rgya mtsho dang / /'dod chags rgya mtsho phrag dog rgya mtsho ste/ /phyogs bzhi por ni bsgom par bya/ /pad bo'adab bornams su rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje rgya mtsho rin chen rgya mtsho ma/ /pad+ma rgya mtsho sna tshogs rgya mtsho ma/ /g.yon skor podu ni bsgom bya ste/ /'dab 1 ma bzhi la thod pa ni/ /rgya mtsho bzhi po yi ni gzugs / /dngos kun bdud rtsir son pa'o/ /slar yang grwa bzhi po rnams su/ /ji lta'i rim pas dgod bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ye shes de kho na/ /thar pa'i rgya mtsho g.yon skor nyunyedu'o/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg dang chos dang yid dang sems/ /kun kyang rgya mtshor shes bya ste/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyis dgod par bya/ /sa dang nam mkha' lce dang ni/ /rna ba thams cad rgya mtsho ste/ /78wa 655

ye shes shes bya'i rgya mtsho dag /sngon gyi rim pas dgod par bya/ /sgo skyong ma ①yi lha mo che/ /g.yon skor (bdu ni dgod bya ba / /glang po rgya mtsho rta rgya mtsho/ /seng ge rgya mtsho ma ho mtshong)/ /grwa la gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ /sgyu ma rgya mtsho mi lam rgya mtsho ma/ /gsang snang rgya mtsho snang ba'i rgya mtsho ma/ /kha dog 'khor lo gzhan gyi bzhin/ /byang chub chung ngu bdag nyid che'i(pe/ /dkyil 'khor de yir (yeshes par bya/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi rim pas ni/ /sgrub (7)thabs rim ⑧pas bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi zhal nas ni/ /pad+ma'i yu ba nges par 'thon/ /kha dog dkar po 'bar chen po/ /pad+ma 'dab stim stong phrag can/ /de yi dbus su bsgom bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bde mchog ste/ /phyag stong pa ni rnam par bsgom0/ /zhal ni sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /zhabs bcwa lhokyebargyad kyis gar du mdzad/ /spyan gsum pa la sna tshogs mdog /ral pa'i cod pan can gyis hurtegazugs/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed can/ /rgyab tu dbang phyug chen po 'dzin / /lhag mar dpa' bo dpa' tsodabang mo/ /bcu gnyis bdag nyid can 'khor lor/ /ji ltar bdag gis sngon bshad pa'o/ /shes rab phyag g.yon du bshad termu/ /g.yas par rgyun du thabs yin no/ /khyab 'jug drag po de bzhin tshangs / /gshin rje dang ni log 'dren dang / /bden bral dang ni thags bzangs 8ris/ /dbang po tshogs bdag kur ti 8ka / dgra gcan ⑩zla ba nyi ma dang / /bla ma skyob pa bla de bzhin/ /nor rgyas dang ni skyes bu men / /myos pa zhabs kyis gnon pa ste/ /rang rang khyim thab 3)yang dag ldan/ /mdog dang mtshon cha yang bya'o/ /phag mo yis ni 'khyud pa ste/ /de'i gzugs can nam phyag gnyis skyes/ /sna tshogs gzugs 'dzin rab myur ma/ /slar yang rang 78—656

'dra'i gzugs can ma'o/ /'dab 6)ma stong du bsgom bya ba/ /rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma kun te/ /bcom ldan kha dog gang 'dra ba/ /de 'drar de rnams mtshon par bya/ /thung ngu ring po yon tan 'phar/ /a yig la sogs sde brgyad de②ske/ /phyi mo bcu gnyis kyis phye ba/ /stong phrag rnal 'byor ma'i yang ngo ka rdo rje sogs shes bya ste/ /khams kyi rkyen gyi yid kyis so/ /'khor lo drug bdag rnal 'byor can/ /de thams cad ni gar du mdzad/ /thams cad kyis ni ro la gnon / /phyag gnyis pa 'am mkha' 'gro'i bdag /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga (mi'adzin ma / /bde chen rnam pa'i gzugs can mtho/ /sangs rgyas thugs ka stinas spro ba / /'khor lo gsum spro ⑤'od zer phreng / /srog ni 'og dang steng lta (7bas/ /sdom ⑦pa rgya mtsho dgug ⑧par bya/ /slar yang dbugs ④kyis dbyung ba ni/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gnyis med bdag /thams cad sdom pa'i sgrub 0thabs su/ /ji lta'i rnal 'byor gzhan bya'o/ /de ltar byed bzhin pa nyid kyis/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub skye bar 'gyur/ /gzhung thams cad ni blta nyunyebar bya/ /gzhan pa'i rnal 'byor dmigs mi bya/ /dam tshig gi ni spyod pa canahurte/ /sdom pa chung thangur rab tu bshad/ /thams cad sog tsom bzhin dor la/ /thams cad sdom pa gzung bar gyis/ /mche ba rnams 8gtsigs rab sbyor bas/ /gzhu 'gengs rim pas 'ong bar gyis/ /de yi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yang / /sngon gyi sbyor ⑩bas bsgom par bya/ /'og dang steng gnyis byamache ba gnyis/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dag /rang ming brjod pa'i gsang sngags la/ /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge mthar sbyor 8gyis/ /yang dag ting 'dzin rdo rje yi/ /gsang sngags thams cad la bya'o/ /thams cad rgyan 0ni rab bshad pa'ang / /sngags rig pa yis 78—657

sngon bzhin no/ /bdag gi ①bdag pos rgyud 'di ni/ /gsungs pas yang dag dga' bar 'gyur/ /nyid dang lhan cig bya ba byas/ /phyag rgya 'og ste ji ltar lags / /khyod kyis 'og dang steng phyag rgya/ /rab bshad bya yis (gyilha mo nyon/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho shes rab che/ /thabs ni sdom pa rgya mtsho'o/ /'og dang steng ( snadu snyoms 'jug pas/ /de ni phyag rgya mngon ④brjod 'gyur/ /zhal las nges par 'thon yu ba/ /ngag gis bsgos ( pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de ni mkha' 'gro spyod de yang / /rnam par shes dang thams cad 'ong / /zhu ba'i gzugs ni snying ga (6)ru/ /'od kyis thams cad sdom par gyis/ /de ni theg pa cher sdom pa/ /bdag nyid chen po ye shes gzugs/ /de ltar gnyis su byar med gzugs/ /de ni phyag rgyar lnga)mngon par brjod/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor lasani/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho che/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ / zhes bya ba ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i cho ga ste 97rab tu byed pa bzhi pa'o// //de nas lha mos mchod byas nas/ /phyag byas nas ni 'di skad gsol/ /sems can rnams kyi sdom byung ba/ /bcom ldan bdag po nyid kyis gsungs/ /lha dgra yi ni rab sbyor bas/ /rab bshad bya yis 7lha mo nyon/ /byang chub sems kyi cha can gyi/ /bde ba 'ong ba'i 517gang zhig rtsa/ /sdom pa sems can smin byed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor der ni rnam par spro/ /'dod chags chags bral rnam 'dres pa/ /sdom pa skye (1 'gro'i gzugs can no/ /gang phyir de nyid kyis sdom pa/ /sngon gyi spyod pa'i nyu)sdom pa'o/ / be+e yi blanam mkha' nam mkhar te/ /78—658

sku gsum rnams kyi yang dag bzhugs/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ /'thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gang tshe sems ni 'gro bzhin pa/ /gzugs kyi dbus su thim par gyis/ /rang rig bdag nyid byang chub ldan/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku 'thob lho)'gyur/ /ting 'dzin skad cig rig med pa/ /gang gi srid gsum la thim gyis/ /de ni 'byung bar shes bya ste/ /lus can gzhan rnams kyi sdom min/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi gsang sdom pa/ /de ltar de nyid nges shes bya/ /nang gi bdag nyid nyin zhag gi'ang 95)/ /de yis sdom par bshad par 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs ldan pa'i/ /ā tshuli kā (pe'i sogs sde tshan/ /dang po'i yi ge'i (de/cha la sogs/ /gang du (6)ming ni nges par mthong ske/ /rigs ni de ru shes bya ste/ /ang ku'ang (7)sems can yang dag ldan/ /mtha' yas la sogs klu gang dang / /nyi ma la sogs gza' de bzhin/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i ming thog byas nas/ /ma mo de rnams su rab grags/ /lha rnams kun gyis bskyed 'u)pa dang / /sngags rnams kyi dang rgyud nyid kyi'ang 6)/ /'jig rten kun gyi ma yin te/ /de yis ma la yang dag brten/ /rtsa ni dgu po 'gog pa las/ /srog rgyu rnams su shes par bya/ /a ā ka tsa ṭa ta pa dang ⑩/ /ya sha'i sde tshan yi ge dgu/ /i khri kha tsha ṭha tha pha31/ /ra ṣa gnyis par brjod pa'o/ /u u ga dza ḍa da bzhunye/ /la sa sde tshan gsum pa'o/ /e e gha dzha bha nyi dha bhayi/ / wa ha 8sde tshan bzhi pa'o/ /o au e aḥng nya ṇa / /na ma de ltar dgu'i bdag nyid / /bzhi po yongs su grags pa ste/ /nyi can lnga rnams kyis de bzhin/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun tunyegyi de/ /sdud pa dang ni 'byin par gnas/ /sgyu chen bcu gnyis de rnams kyis/ /sa bon gzugs kyi tshogs nya2dran bya/ /de rnams rā 3rta78—659

sir yang dag grags/ /rgyu skar kun dang yang dag ldan/ /zla ba dang ni nyi ma'i chas / /'og dang steng gi kha 1)de bzhin/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba gnyis/ /rgyu skar dang ni rā sir bshad/ /srog zung ngu ni de bzhin grags(1/ /ring dang thung 98)ngu rgyal dang pham/ /steng du de yi rgyal bar bshad/ /'og tu 'chi ba mnyam mi mnyam/ /nyi ma'i rgyu bar son pa kun/ /rgyu skar rā si cigaza' de bzhin / /rā si ra rnam gsum spyod yigang phyir/ /nyi mar gnas par 'char bar 'gyur / /srog 'char ba dang yang dag ldan/ /rā si kun gyis shes par bya/ /kun ṭa seng 7bu mo dang / /bum pa rigs (lde)drug yang dag ldan/ /'char bar 'gyur dang shar ba yang / /ji lta'i rim dag gza' kun (9)gyis/ /brirtsi ka dang rta nyid dang / /ri dgas bum par yang dag ldan/ /cha shas lnga yi tshad kyis ⑩ ni / /gza' shar ba yis 'char bar 'gyur/ /ri bong lug de bzhin nyid dang //skan da ru ni son 11de bzhin/ /cha shas kyang ni bzhi pa nyid/ /'char ba 'ong bar 'char bar 'gyur/ /zhag gi 'char ba ma lus pa'ang / /'bras bu'i ming dang yang dag ldan/ /nag mo sogs nas 'jib ma'i mthar/ /yongs su rim pas nyi shu bzhi/ /gang dang 'dra ba'i ming de 'dra'ohuX/ /de rnams 'bras bur (nyeshes par bya/ /nyis 'gyur longs spyod bris pa dang / /dbang po rnams kyi 7cha dang ldan/ /thob pa zhag tshetu shes bya ste/ /bdag gi rtag tu zhag lha mo/ /bdag nyid kyis ni dgos kun dang / /gzhan rnams la yang de ltar sbyar/ /de phyir phyi dang nang rnams su/ /dge dang mi dge'i las shes bya/ /sdom pa 'byung ba'i dus su ni/ /rnam rtog med pas mtshon par bya/ /gza' gang de rnams dbyangs shes bya/ /dbyangs gang de rnams rā si'o/ /dbyangs dang rā si 78wa 660

de bzhin skar/ /rang gi gzugs rnams kyang blta'o/ /dngos grub 'bras bu ster ba po/ /yang dag sbyor dang bral na med/ /g.yo ba'i 'char bas g.yo ba'i las/ /nges par brtan pas g.yo med 'gyur/ /'dren ma yis 0)ni 'dren mar 'gyur/ /sems can rnams kyi bsod nams rgyus(mi/ /lha rnams (bgrol ba'i rgyu nyid pas/ /lha yis ④dgra ni bsgom par bya/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub byed pa'i gtso/ /kha dog dang ni mtshan nyid dbyibs/ /las rjes 'brangs (5)pas bsgom par bya/ /lha 'am lha min sbyin zhinabyed kyi/ /dgra ni 'khor lo sdom pa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad snyoms 'jug pas / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro lha yi dgra/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni lha dgra yi cho ga ste 97)rab tu byed pa lnga pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor ma thams cad/ /'dus par byas nas 'dri ba ni/ /lha dang sbyin byed sems can gyi/ /sdug bsngal ster po tsho sheji ltar lags/ /gal te kun rang bzhin ston pa/ /dge dang mi dge de 'dri ba/ /de nas bcom ldan lha la sogs/ /sems can kun ster po ci lags/ /'di la bdag ni the tshom mchis / /gtso bo gsal bar mdzod cig kye/ /phag mo la sogs mang po yi/ /lha mo sgyu ⑨ma chen mo nyon/ /rang rang las kyi rjes 'brangs pas/ /lha dang sbyin byed sems can gyi/ /bdag gi rang bzhin du ni med/ /byang chub chen por zhu las yod/ /rang gi rang bzhin yon tan nyid/ /bdag gi las kyis boyang dag 'byung ske/ /de phyir dge dang mi dge blta/ /sna tshogs kun rtog nya 'thob par 78—661

byed / /de yis lha dang sbyin byed rnams/ /gza' dang rā si rgyu skar can/ /rang gi las 'bras la za ba/ /ster ro gzhan du ci yang med/ /ston pa ji ltar grol bar 'gyur/ /glu 1'di yis ni dgyes par byed/ /a mi tā bha dza ni tā ma ciltas mā rgya mā ga mā ga mā dhā 34)nya/ ma pā banya rī sā (5)mā nya ri ga mā sā nya mā rī gi ma bhū tshogaciya te/ sa rī re sā rī re sa rī rī sā nī sā nya shu ta ni sā mā nya sā nī/ shī rī bha ga mā dhā me smra dha smra ri sā nya ri9 pā yā bem pā pā 11ma da tsomi te/ 'od dpag med kyi rab sbyor bas/ /'di 'dra'i grol ba bsgrub par bya/ /a ba dhū tī'i phonyedabus su ni la/ /rnam shes grol ri snyeb la mtshon bya/ /srog la sogs pa'i rlung thams cad/ /rnam 'gyur byas pa'i bar thim bya/ /rnam par shes pa 'dres gyur pa'ang / /khams thams cad kyi bcud len te/ /'thungs pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur//dbang po rnam nyi bgrod mtshan nyid las/ /rkan rtso 7gyi phyogs su gnas pa'i lce/ /a ba dhū tīr 1 de rab bshad/ /cha shas can gyi tha ma yi/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni 'dzag par 'gyur/ /rtsa thams cad du bkang ba ste/ /yang dag rig pa'i gzugs su thim/ /mdor bsdus pas ni khams lnga ste/ /gzhan gyi dngos po 'dir ma brjod/ /dbang chen la ni me yis bsregaci19 /chu yi tsu )dbus su rab tu thim / /myur du zhu nas 'gro 2nyebar 'gyur/ /rlung gi nam mkha' la gnas so/ /chu yi tshogs ni bskams na byas pas/ /de nyid du ni thim nas 'gro/ /sems ni stong nyid la son bya/ /stong nyid nam mkha'i khams la'o/ /nam mkha' ye shes la 'jug bya/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i rang mtshan nyid/ /mkhas pas ye shes shes bya'i ni bdag /de ltar 'od dpag med pa bsgoman / /rtsibs brgyad legs par brgyan pa yi/ /shes bya'i 'khor lo 'di bsgom bya/ /25bu med bri ba mi u ku/ /dha si 78wa 662

mer (1)ro ma ga rdzu 'drer/ /rlung du tu ka bi mi te(dkyi/ /dbang ldan du ni (4༄rā si'o zhes / / de rnams kha'akhor lo rim ji bzhin/ /de bzhin 'di la 'di rnams dgod / /a 77)yi u e o'i (8༄sa bon9/ /bkra shis la sogs gza' lnga ni/ /shar la sogs par dgod par bya/ /ring po de nyid du ri1 byedagod bya/ /e aḥrtso)nyi ma zlar shes bya/ /nyi ma zla ba 'dir 32grol ba/ /ku li 1stere la nyi ma ste/ /gza' lhag gdong lnga pa 'dir gnas/ /mthar ni gang zhig lhag 1 nom yi so so'i cho gas za bar 'gyur/ /rā si skornams kyis tsobargyan pa yi/ /'gro kun la phan 'khor lo de/ /tsho/ tshode ltar do la'i 'khor lor 'gyur/ /rgyu skar rā si dus dang zhag /lug hu rnams ro hi ti 519sogs dang / /zla ba dang ni nyi ma rnams/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa ni/ /mdor bsdus 3 )pa yis bshad par bya/ /rgyu skar dus tshod ⑥yang dag ldan/ /gza' dang nad ni de bzhin te 2/ / do la nisnyerā si'i tshad kyis ni/ /skye ba'i las su brjod pa yin/ /kārti 2 1ka dang bzang po'i tshe/ /mig dmar de bzhin smin drug ste/ /de la 'chi tsho gebar shes par bya/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa —9med na'o/ /mṛ rka tshog shir+ṣa na mgo dang ni/ /gza' lhag nyi ma la smyo ba/ /mgul pa'i nad kyis 37nyin bzhi na tsho/ /khyu mchog la ni rtag tu 'chi / /rgyal dang sri ga'i rgyu skar dang / /gza' lhag 'khrig pa la 'chi'o ku li ra mchu'i (1tshes brgyad kyi/ /tho rangs pa sangs la 'chi'o/ /gre dang mchu yi rgyu skar dang / /tshes bcu spen pa seng ge la/ /nub mo 'chi bar shes bya ste/ /gal te brgya byin mnyam gyur kyang ༷ / /bu mo nyi mar gul mas 'chi/ /sa ga dang ni bcu bzhi dang / /gzhu dang phur bu'i re ra mo dang / /gal te sangs rgyas mnyam gyur pa/ /sung la 'chi bar shes zhi par bya/ /snron dang bcu gcig (snye78—663

nag pa ridzodang / /phur bu sdig pa la 'chi'o/ /chu stod chu smad tshes dgu dang / /gro bzhin gzhu 95dang pa sangs 'chi/ /gro bzhin (5)tshes bdun zla ba dang / /④rgyal dang chu srin lag 5)nor med/ /khrums stod khrums smad bcu gsum pa/ /zla ba mon gre bum pas 'dzad76)/ /tha skar brgyad pa nam gru dang / /spen pa dang ni nya la 'chi/ /sems can kun gyi skye ba'i rtsis/ /dus smra bas 3)ni shes par bya/ /sa bon gcig las skyes yon tan/ /gnyis pa skye ba'i dus kyis so/ /rigs gnyis su ni shes byas nas/ /de'i dus skye rtsis brtsam par bya/ /sngon las rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mkhas pas de'i rigs su skye'o/ /de yi 'bras bu (sheshes bya ste / /mtshan nyid kyis ni rjes su gnas/ /rā si sogs 'khor 'brel pa de/ /rnam shes kun gyi mtshan nyid do/ /'od dpag med kyi rab sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom par bya/ /dbus su 'od dpag med mgon po/ /lhag mar mkha' 'gro ma sogs so/ /de ni rnam shes skye 99gsal bar/ /las kyi 'bras bu 7de dran bya/ /thams cad bde ba kun sbyor las/ /de tshe gnyis med la brten 511pa'i/ /'od dpag med kyi sbyor ldan pa/ /bcom ldan ston pas 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni 'od dpag med kyi cho ga ste zhugerab tu byed pa drug pa'o// //rdo rje 'od kyi rab sbyor bas/ /ye shes de kho nyid bshad bya/ /lha mos slar yang mchod byas nas/ /de kho na nyid ye shes zhus/ /sems can rnams kyi rnam nges pas/lha/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid gang 'dra ba/ /de 'dra bdag gis bshad bya yis30la/ /rtse gcig pa yi yid kyis 8nyon/ /lus la rtsa rnams mtshan ma ni/ /78—664

de rnams ji ltar gsal bar dbye/ /rtsa chen sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ /de rnams kyi ni gtso bo mchog /bcu gnyis de bzhin du lha mo/ /dbyangs rnams bgrod pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /dkar po nag po'i phyogs kyis ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi ru ni brjod / /der ni snying po hu)dgu po mchog /lus kyi mtshan ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /'chi ba'i dus lta bur gnas so/ /dbugs ni rnam par spros tsam gyis/ /lus can 'pho ba drug gnyis na②/ /snga dro ro hi ta yi char/ /de yi rtags ni mtshon par bya/ /sna dang mig gi phyogs dang ni/ /'gram pa dang ni rna ba'i rtsar/ /lce dang mche ba'i mtshams dang ni/ /mgrin pa rtsib ②logs de bzhin du/ /snying gi gur dang lte ba dang / /brla dang byin pa de bzhin gzhan/ /mdoms ④dang ling ga dag de bzhin/ /mgo bo dang ni spyi bo'i phyogs / /mtshams ni de rnams thams cad du/ /dbugs ni 'chad 97cing 'chad pa'o/ /lus kyi mtshan ma dgu rnams te/ /'chi ba'i dus ni bstan pa yin / /nyi ma'i tshad kyi grangs rnams ni/ /'khor lo dus bdag nyid can dga' / /gang tshe nyi ma drug rnams zhon/ /gcig brjod pa ni brgyan pa yin/ /der ni lo gsum 'gyur can te/ /sum brgya drug cu rnams de bzhin/ /cha shas de ltar gyi ni tshad⑥/ /mdor bsdus pa yis bshad par bya/ /nyi ma bdun ni yongs thob nas/ /gang tshe rlung ni (7)'bab pa na/ /lo gnyis yang dag brjod pa dang ⑧/ /dus kyi grangs can zla ba dang / /nyi ma rnams ni bcwa (7brgyad kyi/ /gang zhig tshad du yang dag brjod/ /zhag brgyad rnams su yongs gtong bas/ /rlung ni gang tshe 'bab pa na7/ /lo gnyis su ni yongs bshad par/ /de yi 'tsho ba yi ni grangs/ /nges par de hunyetshe 'chi ba ni/ /de yi zla ba rig byed grangs/ /78—665

nyi ma nyi shu rtsa bzhir bshad/ /'tsho ba yi ni dus grangs so/ /lha mo nyi ma dgur 'bab na/ /lo gnyis su ni de 'tsho ste/ /zla gnyis nyi ma nyi ma yi/ /tshad ni shiXsbyor ba'i lus can no/ /lha mo nyi ma bcu rnams kyis/ /lo gnyis su ni de 'tsho'o / /nyi ma bcu gcig de bzhin du/ /gang tshe rtsa ni rab 'jug na/ /lo gcig gi ni lam bcas pas/ /zla ba yang ni dgu'i grangs kyis/ /nyi ma bcwa gebargyad rab tu bshad/ /the tshom med par bshad pa'o/ /zhag ni bcu gnyis rab 'bab pas/ /lo gcig tu ni rab tu grags/ /zla ba yang ni lo'i grangs can / /nyi ma rnams ni dus kyis mdzes/ /bcu gsum du ni gang tshe rtsa/ /g.yas su bgrod pa (da 'bab pa na/ /lor 3)ni yang dag bshad pa ste/ /zla ba yang ni rig byed grangs na / /nyi ma rnams ni dgu'i grangs na/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'o/ /lha mo gang tshe bdun gnyis su/ /rtag tu rlung ni (6'bab pa na / /lo ni tshe ru yang dag bshad/ /zla ba'i tsher ni yang dag grags/ /nyi ma rnams ni bcu gnyis temo/ /de yi 'tsho ba'i tshad yin no/ /gang tshe lnga bcu (8)nyi mar ni/ /rlung ni de bzhin 'bab pa natho)/ /de tshe 'chi bar shes bya ba/ /lo gcig na ni the tshom med/ /nyi ma mchog ni phan pa yi/ /gang tshe brgyad gnyis su 'bab na/ /'tsho ba zla ba bcu dang ni/ /nyi ma rnams ni mchog grangs kyi/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nyi 7rnams kyi/ /tshad du bdag gis 11bshad pa'o/ /nyi ma rnams ni bcu bdun du/ /nges par gang tshe rlung 'bab na/ /de tshe de yi tshad kyis (1rteni / /zla ba rnams ni dgu dang ni/ /nyi ma bcwa honyabargyad na de bzhin/ /'chi ba'i dus la the tshom med/ /nyi ma bcwa bobargyad rgyu ba yis/ /zla ba yang ni brgyad na yang 7/ /nyi ma rnams kyang nyi ma'i grangs/ /dus kyi grangs ni bshad pa'o/ /78wa 666

gang tshe gcig dman nyi shur ni/ /dri la zhon pa spyod pa na/ /nyi ma yang dag bshad bya ba/ /'tsho ba zla ba bdun dang ni/ /nyi ma rnams ni dus grangs bshad / /dus 'di rnams kyis 91tshomachog gdong can/ /gang tshe nyi shu ru ni spyod/ /zla ba drug na tshe dang 'bral/ /nyi ma nyi shu gcig rnams su/ /gang tshe nyi ma rab 'bab na/ /zla ba lnga ru yongs 'tsho ste/ /nyi ma rnams ni nyi ma'i grangs/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis (2)gang tshe 'bab/ /zla ba'i rig byed na tshe ri )'gro/ /nyi ma rnams ni nyi shu bzhi/ /zla ba ri kyirig byed du bshad do/ /lha mo gang tshe nyi shu gsum/ /rlung ni rgyun ri du 'bab pa ni(6/ /de ni zla ba bzhir 'tsho ste/ /nyi ma dus rnams su dran bya/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir rab 'bab pas/ /zla ba gsum du bshad pa ste/ /nyin bcu gcig na de bzhin du/ /'chi ba'i dus su rnam par brjod/ /dus kyi grangs ni mdor bsdus (7)nas/ /gong du sngon du bshad de'i phyir(8sa/ /bar gyi nyi ma ma bshad gang / /bcu gnyis nyid kyi grangs kyis ni/ /cha yi rim pas de 99/sbyangs nas/ /bar ni tshegasal bar byed 11pa yin/ /blo dman rnams kyis rtogs don du/ /dus 'di rnams ni rab tu bstan/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams shin phra mo'i/ /mthun 9nye ma dus 1geni bdag gis bshad/ /lha mo de rnams kyis yid ches/ /khams ni mnyam pa can du 'gro/ /sna yi sha ni rnam chad cing / /steng bltas ma ni de bzhin 'bab/ /de yi 'tsho bar shes bya bas/ /nyi ma bdun na the tshom med/ /mig gis spugos ni yang dag chad/ /gyen kha bltas ma mchog de bzhin/ /cha shas dgu la yang dag zhon/ /lngas lhag pa na 'chad de bzhin/ /go dā ba r+ya mkhur 97ba yi/ /ngos su steng du 'gro ba mo/ /nyi ma bcu ru shes bya ste / /nub gcig gis lhag de bzhin no/ /rna ba g.yas la 1 yongs brten /snanas//78wa 667

bzang mo steng du yang dag brten4)/ /bcu gcig cha shas la zhon te/ /'chad pa bcwa ②brgyad na de bzhin/ /bcu gnyis de bzhin du lha mo/ /lce la ri ①mo nag po can/ /lus can kun gyi 'chi ba ni/ /nam zla'i mtshan mos ④shis par bya / /bcu gsum so yi bar du ni/ /gdong nag mo ni reg de bzhin/ /nam zla'i grangs kyi nyi rnams kyis/ /'byung po rnams kyi bgrod pa yin/ /rgyun du mchi ma 'bab gang rtsa/ /steng bltas mar ni rab tu grags/ /bcu bzhi pa yi dbyangs la zhon/ /bcu phyed kyis ni the tshom med/ /snying ga'i (zhe/gzeb ni zhom pa dang / /steng du lta ma yide mchog ma/ /gsum dang lnga ru mdzes lha mo/ /zla ba phyed du the tshom medaspri/ /lte ba'i dbus su son lha mo/ /bcu drug cha bdag can yongs rdzogs/ /sen mo'i khrag med nide bzhin zhag /nyin rnams bcu ru the tshom za/ /bcu bdun pa yi rtsa yang ni/ /brla yi steng du skams ⑨pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir yang dag grags/ /nyin gzhan nyin la the tshom med/ /byin pa zung gi gang zhig rtsa/ /steng du bltas ma de bzhin mchog /bcwa ⑩brgyad pa ru shes bya ste/ /nyi ma rnams kyang nyi grangs ⑩kyis/ /gcig gis dman pa'i nyi shu 'doms / / 'chi ba'o 3nyesteng du kha bltas mchog /mnyam pas 'chad par 'gyur ba la/ /'di yis 'tsho bar 8the tshom med/ /mtshan mar rol ldan mar grags ma/ /steng bgrod mchog gi dbang phyug ma/ /bcu gnyis su ni yang dag grags / /nyin rnams dus tshod the tshom za/ /bar gyi nyi ma gang bshad pa/ /bcu gnyis nyid la the tshom med/ /lo yi rim pas de sbyangs nas/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis rim yipa yis8/ /drug dang sum cu bcwa (chubargyad bcu/ /'di ni ⑩zla bas rim ji ltar/ /shes bya de ltar lha chen mo/ /rim gyis phonyerim gyis yidabye 78wa 668

ba'o / /lhag ma nyid ni bsdus 'gyur bar/ /'tsho ba yir ni shes par bya /yang dag cho ga 'di rnams kyis/ /rdo rje 'od ni bsgom par bya/ /rab tu sbyor bas srog bkang pas/ /sangs rgyas lus la 'chi ci 7smos/ /rab tu sbyor ba 'di brten nas/ /mdor bsdus pa yis 'chad par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i lam nas son pa'i srog /snal ma bcu gnyis mtha' bar du'o/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran sbyor bas/ /'dod pa lnga can la za 'gyur/ /gsang sngags chen po'i 'od ②la ni / /gnas nas kun du bgrod par bya/ /sgyu ma'i bdag nyid 'chi med 'gyur/ /rnam pa dri za'i ris ②can no/ / rtswa yis chakun nas 'gengs bzhin pa/ /dngos po kun la gnas pa yin/ /skye bo kun gyi khams rnams ni/ /ye shes rnam par 'thob par byed/ /chos bdag med pa 'dzag snyipar 'gyur/ /gang zag rnams la dgod (nyapar 'gyur/ /gnyis ka sgyu ma chen mo stiste/ /snying rje'i dbang gis bzhugs pa yin/ /mthar thug pa yi sbyor bas sems/ /mtshams rnams kun du 'chi ba yin/ /'chi ba chen po sangs rgyas gzugs/ /rnal 'byor rnams la bde ster byed/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad gzung ba yi(༅ thams cad bde ba'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /'khor lo'i rim pa'i rab sbyor bas/ /bde ba dam pa yang dag myong ⑨/ /rdo rje 7'od ni bsgom par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs mtshungs ma/ /lha ni mngon rtogs gzugs can te/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can/ /srog kun yang dag sbyor ba las/ /mchog tu zag med bzhugs ldan pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dus 'khor grags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje 'od kyi cho ga ste sh-i/rab tu byed pa bdun pa'o// //78—669

de nas phyag na rdo rje sogs/ /byang sems de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /mchod pa byas shing phyag byas nas1)/ /'di skad du ni gsol ba'o/ /gtso bo lha rnams sgrub na thabs dang / /de rnams rang sngags bdag la gsungs/ /gang gis dathams cad dbang gyur pa/ /gang gis rab sbyor nyid kyis lags/ /lha la sogs pa'i sgrub 4pa'i thabs/ /rdo rje sku yi rgyal po nyon/ /gang gis yang dag cho ga yis/ /myur du dngos grub rab tu 'jug /dkyil 'khor bri ba byas nas ni / /sku bsgom bya ba 'dir bshad de(5)/ /de la ma mo lha rnams dang / /pho nya 'byung po gza' de bzhin/ /lus srul po ni chen po dang / /rig (6pa'i gsang sngags 'dir brjod bya/ /dbus ma yi (3)ni nang gnas pa/ /srid pa dag pas bsgrubs pa yin/ /dus thams cad du bskyed pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab 'bab can/ /ma mo dbang chen bsgrub bya dang / /lha ni chu yi rdo skudakyil 'khor dul/ /'byung po me la bsgrub bya ba/ /gza' ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ /lus srul po ni nam mkha' ste 9no/ /rdo rje'i bosku yi rab sbyor bar/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor cha yis 11ni/ /a ba dhū tīr phorte'abab pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor lnga rnams kyi tha ma/ /de yi dus su shes nyusnyepar bya/ /de bltas nas ni phyi rol du/ /ras bris la sogs dkyil 'khor dgod/ /nag pa'i 1 brgyad dang bcu bzhi la/ /'byung po'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /'bum phrag bzlas pas de nas ni/ /ster 1ge'agyur mdun du mngon sum du'o/ /tshangs ma zhi ba tsomo de bzhinas tsho/ /gzhon nu ma dang phag mo dang / /dbang mo nyid dang tsa lha muṇ+ḍi/ /tshogs kyi dbang mo me 1rtagadan mo/ /gnyis pa'i dum bur dbang po dang / /gshin rje chu 78wa 670

lha lus ngan dang / /yi dgas dbang dang mi stan 4)can/ /bden bral dang ni rlung de bzhin/ /dum bu gsum par dgod bya ba/ /nyi ma zla ba mig dmar dang ske/ /gza' lag ((phur bu pa sangs dang / /spen pa dang ni rā hu'od / /bzhi par tshangs khyab 'jug de bzhin/ /drag po gzhon nu nges par bskor / /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /'byung ba chen po'i khams rnams dang / /mkha' 'gro mar me 'jib ma dang / /kum po dzī 5khyab bdag de bzhin/ /'byung po 'byung po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /rtag tu cho ga bzhin bsgrub bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /kun nas phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri/ /ri mo sum skor 6)dbus byin (7)pas/ /brtul zhugs can gyis mdzes par bya/ /pad+ma 'dab 8)brgyad bri bar bya/ /lte ba zab pa'i spyod yul can/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje'i 9)skul/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /cung zad mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal / /bzhad pa'i zhal la khro dang bcas/ /kha dog sngon po 31drag chen po/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /nyi mar gar mdzad ro la bzhugs/ /sum cu pa rnams 'jigs par mdzadanyan/ /stag gi pags sna pa'i na bza' 'dzin/ /bzang po'i gzugs can spyan gsum pa/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /cang te'u bogri gug gis ni brgyan/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang ni/ /byang du rim pa ji lta bas / /mkha' 'gro kum po ṭī 15nyid ma/ /'jib ma dang ni mar me ma'o de ltar rdo rje sku yi don/ /mdor bsdus pa kyi yis brjod par bya/ /lte bar rdo rje'i rnam par 'gyur/ /pho nya rkang pa drug bgrod ma'i/ /snying ga nyi gsang ba mgrin pa ru/ /de nyid rnam par (12slar dgod bya/ /de nas srog ni 'dzin bzhin pas/ /bsam gtan sems te gzhan gyis min/ /lha rdzas 'od zer bskyed 1 par 'gyur//78wa 671

dkyil 'khor pa rnams rang lus skyes/ /las dang po yi sbyor ba yis/ /phyogs bcur rnam par spro bar 'gyur/ /hrīḥ7yig las byung ba'i lha mo/ /phag mo phyag ni bzhi ma (geste/ /gzhu dang mda' nyid de bzhin du/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni thod pa nyid/ /kha dog sngon mo drag chen mo/ /phag gi gdong 9kyican 'jigs rung ma'o / /dze yig gis bris zhi ba mo/ /kha dog dmar mo 'od chen mo/ /thod pa dang ni lcags kyu nyid/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍa lam ru de bzhin/ /hrīḥ5༄yi yi ges gzhon nu ma / /kha dog ser mo phyag bzhi ma/ /rtse gsum pa dang ba dan gsum/ /gzhu dang mda' nyid de bzhin no/ / hoḥyi (7yi ge sa tsa (3)muṇ+ḍi/ /kha dog nag mo ⑧phyag bzhi ma/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyid thod pa dang / /cang te'u chang snod de bzhin no/ /oṃ yig las ni tshangs pa mo/ /kha dog dkar mo (7phyag bzhi ma/ /pad+ma nyid dang thod pa dang / /gzhu dang mda' ni de bzhin mchog /gi yig las ni tshogs dbang mo/ /kha dog ljang gu 8phyag bzhi ma/ /rtse gsum po nyu)dang thod pa dang / /bgrang phreng dang ni la du'o/ /bi 8yig las ni khyab 'jug ma/ /kha dog sngon mo ⑫phyag bzhi mthu/ /'khor lo tsodang ni thod pa dang / /zhags pa ral gri de bzhin mchog /khri tsheyig las byung ba dbang mo/ /kha dog ser mo phyag bzhi ma/ /rdo rje mdung thung thod pa dang / / sdigs mdzub hu bcas zhags yonyede bzhin no/ /thams cad 'bar bzhin gyen brdzes skra/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs37ske/ /ro la zhon ma spyan gsum ma/ /rked 5 stapar stag gi pags ( nyepa dkris / /shar sgor tshangs pa bri ⑤bya ba/ /kha dog dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ /sa thod pa dang ni bgrang phreng dang / /spyi blugs pad+ma de bzhin no/ /byang du de bzhin khyab 2ge'ajug ni/ /kha dog nag po phyag bzhi pa/ /ral gri de bzhin 78wa 672

'khor lo dang / /thod pa dbyug pa de bzhin no/ /lho ru drag po bri bya ste/ /du ba'i stimadog can phyag bzhi pa/ /rtse gsum thod pa de bzhin du/ /zhags pa phreng ba 'dzin de bzhin/ /nub tu gzhon nu bri bar bya/ /kha dog ser po phyag bzhi pa/ /dpa' bo mdung thung dbyug pa 'dzin/ /thod pa (kyebagrang phreng 'dzin de bzhin(ba/ /dbang ldan khyu mchog la zhon pa/ /kha dog dkar po phyag bzhi ste/ /thod pa dang ni rtse gsum 'dzin/ /phyag gzhan thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /dbang po glang po la zhon pa/ /kha dog ser po phyag bzhi ste/ /rdo rje dang ni thod pa dang / /thal mo sbyar ba byas pa mchog /me ru lug la zhon pa ni/ /kha dog dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ /me yi thab dang thod pa dang / /skrag nas de bzhin lag thal sbyar / /gshin rjer ma he la zhon pa/ /kha dog nag po phyag bzhi pa/ /dbyug pa de bzhin thod pa dang / /kun du skrag nas thal sbyar 'dzin/ /bden bral mi li la zhon pa ste/ /kha dog sngo skya phyag bzhi pa/ /ral gri dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /kun nas skrag pas thal sbyar mchog /chu lhar chu srin la zhon pa/ /kha dog dkar po phyag bzhi ste/ /zhags pa de bzhin thod pa dang / /thal mo sbyar ba de bzhin gzhan/ /rlung lha (na)ri dgas la zhon pa/ /du ba'i mdog can phyag bzhi ste / /ba dan dang ni thod pa dang / /de bzhin thal sbyar 'dzin pa mchog /lus ngan du ni gter la zhon/ /kha dog ser po phyag bzhi pa/ /rin po che dang thod pa 'dzin/ /thal sbyar byas pa'o de bzhin gzhan/ /thams cad rgyu skar dang ni gza'/ /rang dkyil 'khor la gnas pa bsgom(6)/ /rang gi dam tshig las byung ba/ /de rnams rdzu 'phrul ldan stobs che/ /ma mo rnams dang kun gyi ma / /'byung po rig ma de bzhin gzhan/ /de lta'i cho ga'i bya ba yis/ /de phyir 78—673

re re bsgom ri1par bya/ /dur khrod la sogs gnas rnams su/ /sna tshogs dam tshig 5)za rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod (gyirtag dga' la/ /pho nya'i las ni yang dag brtsam/ /zla ba rdo rje'i go cha (peyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'byung bzhin no/ /sngags kyi rgyal pos bskul ba yis/ /de thams cad ni bran bzhin byed / /gnas sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi ru/ /de (9phyir rim pas mchod par bya/ /de nas dri 6 sogs dbul bya zhing / /sngags kyi bzlas pa yang bya ste/ /rang ming (lebarjod pa'i gsang sngags la/ /oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs nang bcug pa'o/ /dbus su bcom ldan 'das brjes nas/ /der ni thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /de nas gzhan brjes pa'i nang du/ /bcom ldan gzhan gyi (8)gzugs can te/ /ba dan gsum pa 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje thod pa rdul can mchog /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag gis 'phyar/ /lhag ma sngon gyi po)gzugs can te/ /lus dang zhal sogs sngon gyi don/ /nges par dbus ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i 1 bdag /thams cad lus kyi rang bzhin can/ /gzugs thams cad kyi nang bzhugs pa/ /bcom ldan gzugs kyis nyama'adi gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje sku'i cho ga ste 51gerab tu byed pa brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'dir ni bde rgyal po/ /rnal 'byor ma yis 3gesad mdzad nas/ /ngag ribo'adi yis ni 'dri bar mdzad/ /blo gros chen po dus hunyeci lags/ /kye rnal 'byor ma rnams khyed nyid dus/ /myu gu can gyis skyes pa'o/ /sna tshogs sa bon sems chen po/ /myu gu can gyi sbyor bas bshad/ /gza' dang rgyu tsheskar tshes 78—674

grangs ni/ /sems kyi dus su mngon par brjod/ /gzugs med grangs ni de yi dus/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi bde ba'i rgyu/ /'jig rten gyi ni dus tsam du/ /thub pa skyes mchog rnams kyis gsungs/ /de tshe myu gu can bsgom pa/ /sa bon sa bon gyi mtshan nyid/ /myu gu sems kyi gzugs can te/ /sems las byung ba myu gu can/ /rgyu skar rā si gza' gyo sogs pas/ /gang zhig tu ni myu gu skyes/ /de yis (0myu gu can nges bya(1)/ /lgokarang bzhin rang bzhin du sbyang (5)bya/ /dge ba 'am ni mi dge kun/ /tshes grangs rgyu skar gza' 'char ba/ /de rnams thams cad dus rnams su/ /thams cad bde bdag nyid skyes sgom/ /ro kṛ ma (6)ni rnyed byed pa'o/ /ma (ghabha ma nad (8)'joms pas spong po)/ /ku swa 〉ā dus byed gzugs su ste(2/ /tshes grangs 32de ni yongs su spang nyage/ /mo mibu mo bzang dang bkra shis so/ /ra bu ā 'joms par byed pa'o/ /bhu /2bu bha dus kyi gzugs kyis so/ /bha pū mgu rnyed pa byed pa'o1rte/ /mi gu dha nor la sogs par 'dzad512/ /tra gu a dus kyi 3)gzugs can no/ /bṛ py-i )shu pū dge ba rnams byed do/ /gi shu pū nad dang 'joms pa yin/ /bhu bha shu gshin rje'i mche 27can no/ /ku ma kri grags dang bsod nams 'thob/ /byā ma ā na gdung ba rdzo nyebyed pa'os )/ /pu ra ma 'chi ba'i dus can no/ /me'i gdan can 25du mi ki ra/ /slar yang gshin rjer raṇ+ḍa spang / /srin por bcu 29lnga pa nyid dang / /khyu mchog chu lhar spang bar bya /sems g.yengs rab tu 'joms nyid du/ /gter du mi lam can de bzhin/ /bzang ( — 7po mig gsum pa nyid du/ /'byung po'i nyi ma shar de bzhin/ /zla ba dang ni nyi sogs tshes/ /de rnams res mo rab bshad bya/ /bzang po yugs ni sa mo de bzhin/ /sems g.yengs na 'byung po'i nyi mar gnas/ /skye bo kun gyi 78wa 675

nyi 1)ma yi/ /cha yi rgyu bar shes par bya/ /khyu mchog mi ki ra nyid dang / /rmi lam bcwa (2)lnga pa de bzhin/ /zla ba'i rgyu bar yang dag grags/ /rim pa 'di rnams rnam par brjod/ /nyi ①la me ru yang dag gnas/ /stong la byarlung gi gnas su'o/ /de ltar de (5)dbus gnas pa ni(6)/ /phyogs su gdung byed yang dag gnas/ /zla ba nyi las dzi)byung ri mo/ /mnyam par lta bas mnyam par 'gro/ /zhi dang sdig pa bltas pa yis/ /shes rab can gyis tsho48des de spangasal/ /mche ba dang phrad tshem bltas pas/ /bden par 'chi bar byed pa yin/ /dus smra ba hunyeni mdor bsdus pa/ /rā hu'i 8rgyu bar grags pa yin/ /dkar dang cig 0shos cho ga yis/ /blo gros mthar thug pas shes 'gyur/ /rgyu skar sogs chadang mi mthun par/ /rmongs pa gang zhig smra bar byed/ /skye bo rang gis byas pa yis8/ /las 'di shes par ma gyur to/ /las de yis ni dus rnams ni/ /the tshom med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lus kyi tshogs pa ji srid pa/ /de srid du ni dus rab 'jug /rnal 'byor pa rnams nyams su myong / /yang dag byang chub gnas 'thob 'gyur/ /de ni myu gu can du grags/ /kha dog dmar po 'od chen po/ /myu gu myu gu'i gzugs can ni/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar gnas par 7bsgom/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i nang son pa/ /gzugs de lha rdzas kyi nyu tshoni gzugs/ /ye shes myu gu rnam bsgoms pas(snye/ /las rnams thams cad mthong mi 'gyur/ /thams cad bdag nyid sbyor chen las/ /sngon las rnam par 'joms mdzad pa/ /rgyu rnams su ni rtag bzhugs pa'i/ /rdo rje rgyu yis 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni phorte rdo rje myu gu can gyi cho ga ste ༷ )rab tu byed pa dgu pa'o// //78wa 676

de nas rdo rje'i gar byas nas/ /rnal 'byor mas ni 'di dris zhi)so/ /ji ltar ston pa sems dpa' che/ /las dang 'brel ②pas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sngon gyi las ni rnam nyams pas/ /rgyun nyams pas ni (2)'ong med pa/ /'di la bdag ni the tshom mchis/ /snying rje mnyes gshin pas bka' stsal(0/ /sems can chen po'i 'byung ba yang / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams gsungs pa/ /mdor bsdus pa yis bshad bya yis(5kyi/ /khyod ni yid gcig pa yis nyon/ /rdo rje ral pa can sbyor (6)bas/ /las kyi nang du bsgrub 7)par 'gyur/ /re re yi ni sbyor ba yi/ /de ni rang 'byung du gnas so/ /shin tu dad pa la gnas pas/ /dbang po thams cad 'du bar bya/ /de yi ral pas rtag 'jig rten/ /ral pa'i ming gis 'ching ba yin/ /dga' ba kun las khyad 'byed pa'o(8)/ /rdo rje'i sku khyod 'thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir bag chags thams cad dang / /dge ba'i las las zad par 'gyur/ /skye bo chen po de 'byung ba/ /gcig nyid lam gyis 'thob par 'gyur/ /rtog pa med las rtog par 'gyur/ /rtog pa yis ni rtog med 'gyur(7/ /dril bu'i sgra ni thob byas nas/ /de rnams mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /rtse dgu rtse mo gcig pa dang / /rtse lnga rtse mo gsum pa can/ /de ltar la sogs dril bu che/ /rtse mo stong gi bar du'o/ /sgra brjod pa yi 0dngos po yis / /spros pa med cing yi ge med/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dag /de yi sgra las rtog pa yang dag byung / /de nyid kyis ni rtog pa med lhonyapa'i bdag /gnas rnams gang la nges par zhugs pa yin/ /sngon bshad rtse can de rdo rje/ /gang du yid ni rnam 'phro ba/ /chos dang sprul pa'i ris sku can/ /de nyid du ni gsor bar bya/ / phyi yi hu dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dpa' bos 78wa 677

gsungs pa bshad par bya/ /ril 0)bu rtag tu cha gsum can/ /lha yis yang dag brgyan par bya / /re re yi ni lha'i bdag po/ /ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor du ji ltar/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis lhag mos pas/ /de bzhin thams cad zhal bya'o/ /lha mo de rnams kyi ni gdan/ /dril bu de la pad sogs bya/ /ji ltar de rnams kyis da ni brgyanari kyi/ /de bzhin dril bu'i ska rags 55)so/ /lha ni sgo dang grwa rnams su/ /phyogs brgyad rnams su bya ba nyid/ /ji ltar rnal 'byor pa'i mtshon bya / /de rnams zhal nas rtse mo 'thon(7)/ /bum pa sogs dang zhal gnyis po la'ang / /steng du rang rigs mtshan ma can/ /'di 'dra ba yi dril bu che / /tshad ni gzhan du bshad pa yin/ /de ni nang gi gzugs can dag(94) /de phyir sgra ni rnam mtshon bya / /thig le'i gzugs ni khyab bdag che/ /rdo rje'ang 1stode dang mnyam par bya/ /de ltar ral pa'i sbyor ba las/ /sems can thams cad bsgrub nyurtapar bya/ /ral can dril kyi bur yang dag grags/ /rdo rje rdo rjer brjod par 'gyur/ /rdo rje ral can bdag nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor du tsheyang bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro kun/ /de tshe nang du mngon par gzhug15 /thams cad gnyis pa yongs sbyor las/ /rdo rje ral pa can byung ba / /rdo rje dril bur 17yang dag brten1 / /bcom ldan dpa' bos 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje ral pa can gyi cho ga ste 38rab tu byed pa bcu pa'o// //de nas gzhan gyi sbyor ba che/ /dpa' bo chen po'i rab sbyor bas/ /bdag gis mngon sum du bshad kyis19/ /rnal 'byor ma kun mnyan 2 )par gyis/ /78wa 678

lus can kun gyi (1)lus gang la/ /gnad (2ni stong phrag gnas pa ste/ /de rnams la yig dgod pa ni/ /ka sogs ha yig mthar de bzhin/ /yon tan la sogs dbyangs rnams yig /khams re re la yi ge rnams/ /slar yang phyi mo bcu gnyis kyis/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dbye bar bya/ /gtum mo stong phrag bdag nyid can/ /mtshams kun du ni gnas pa 'bar/ /khams thams cad kyi bde gnas las/ /dpa' bo'i longs spyod 'thob (5par 'gyur/ /'od zer de rnams kyis bkug pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs chen po/ /bdag med pa yis rigebadag tu gzhag(ge /gnyis med chos 'byung nang du'o/ /de ltar stong phrag gi ni lce/ /dpa' bo chen po'i go 'phang (tshoganas/ /sman thams cad dang nye ba 57)yin / /sbas pa'i bcud len gsungs pa'o/ /phyi rol rnams kyi'ang tshon)yi ge'i (9rabadag /de'i ming nyid du shes par bya/ /me tog 'bras sogs sde tshan gyi/ /dang po'i ming ni stong phrag can/ /de rnams kyis 7ni bcud len bsgrub/ /gzhan du 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /ji lta'i rim pas rigs sogs kyi/ /ka sogs thams cad sman chen te/ /las smra ba yi rgyud gzhan du/ /der ni nges par gsal rig 17bya/ /dang po'i mgon po rnam nya bsgoms nas/ /rtags rnams thob par bya ba yin/ /yang na grub rnal 'byor rnams kyis32/ /bcud kyis len ni gang mthong ba/ /des kyang mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /bla med dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ /sde tshan rnam sapas yongs 15sbyor las/ /bdud rtsi'i tshigs mtsha mas gzugs rnam / pa'i/ /grub pa'i sman rnams rang bzhin can/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di nya 7gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpa' bo chen po'i cho ga ste 38rab tu byed pa bcu gcig pa'o// //78wa 679
