de nas rnal 'byor ma dpa' mo0)/ /'dres pas mchod pa byas nas ni/ /grong khyer gsum gyi nang byung ba/ /ston pa rdo rje che ci lags/ /gang gi gzugs kyis byon pa lags/ /sprul (2)pa gang du bzhud pa lags/ /chos nyan pa yi dus su yang / /ci zhig gis ni brtan par bya(kyi/ /lha dang lha ma yin dang mi/ /ci yi ngag gis 'gro dang 'ong / /mngon par tshigs mtshams mtshan nyid ni/ /sngon gyi ji bzhin bshad du gsol/ /mngon par tshigs rimatshams mtshan nyid ni//ji lta'i 7derim pas bshad kyis (6)nyon/ /shin tu zab mo'i don chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyis ma shes/ /sems can rnams kyi rang snang can/ /bdag gis (7nges par mdor bsdus tsho pas/ /rdo rje sems 'od gzhan nyid du/ /khams dang mtshan mar gnas min can/ /lus dang ngag sems dag pa yi7/ /grong khyer gsum rnams su byung boba'o/ /sngon gyi dngos por khyer nas 'ong ⑪/ /nges par las chung bar 'gro'o/ /yang na dus rnams thams cad du/ /ji ltar me long la bzhin mthong / /sngon du nyan pa thob byas nas/ /sems kyang de yi eganas la'o/ /rdo rje la sogs ting 'dzin gyis/ /lha la sogs pa de rnams mongs / /de yis 32rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi/ /rab tu sbyor bas rtag tu sprul/ /rdo rje'i rtse mor 'jig rten sprul/ /'od zer lcags kyu spro ba ste/ /hūṃ gi ④yi ge'i sgra yis ni/ /ston pas 'khor lo can mchog 35byas/ /chos 'byung khang pa brtsegs pa ru/ /nyi shu'i lhan cig skyes gdan du/ /ngag gi spyod pas mnyan ⑩par byed/ /der song (1 1nas ni de la thim/ /de ltar rnal 'byor dbang po yi/ /slob dpon khyab bdag ches 32shes bya/ /rdo rje la sogs de'i ming nyid/ /de yi mtshan 78wa 680

nyid bshad par bya/ /sems can kun la phan bdag nyid/ /mi 'jigs pa ni ster nyid dang / /sngags dang rgyud kyi 0)sbyor ba shes/ /sbyor ba bzo dang sgyu rtsal sogs / /mthun (nyapa'i ngag dang thams cad la/ /bu gcig pa ltar mthun tsho no/pa dang ske/ /gtong ba sogs la rtag tu dga'/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin de mchog gzhol④/ /ji ltar smras pa de bzhin byed/ /'tshe ba med cing bden pa'i (glengag /sems can kun la thugs brtse dang / /lam du 'dzud pa de mthar phyin / /kun mkhyen yon tan dang mnyam dang / /bstan bcos (6kun gyi pha rol son / /mgon med rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /phyag rgya brda ni (7byed pa po/ /de sogs yon tan rnams kyis gang / /skye ba 'di la de bzhin gshegs/ /rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo dbus su/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad bsgom (8)pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems kyi ste/ /bde ba'i rgyal po rnal 'byor ma/ /sgra rnams su ni sgra'i (9riye shes/ /rdo rje r+ghaṃ mdzad can khyab bdag /'phos pa'i lhag ma 'gyur 7ye shes / /dang po'i mgon po'i rgyu yin no/ /sems kyi nyams su myong ba ni/ /de phyir hunyephra mo'i rang bzhin can/ / spar sha'i nyunyekhams su yang dag grags/ /de nyid kyis ni khyer nas 'ongs/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor rtag nges par/ /sa gsum de yi rang bzhin byas/ /de ltar sbyor ba mchog gtso bo/ /shing srin nyunyegazhan ni sog ma bzhin/ / 'di yi bgrod bopa ma shes pas/ /byis pa mi shes pa yis bcings/ /mtha' yi mabade ba gsung ba po / /bstan bya ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /lhan cig skyes gzugs ston pa po/ /bcom ldan ye shes kyis 'di gsungs/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyi cho ga ste sna rab tu byed pa bcu gnyis pa'o// //78—681

de nas gang gis sgrub pa po/ /'grub pa'i bsam med sbyor bshad bya/ /de ni shin bzang rab sbyor bas/ /spyod dang brtul zhugs bshad par bya/ /lhun gyis grub 'gyur de'i spyod pa/ /dngos grub 'dod rnams kyis shes bya/ /phyi rol gnyis med sbyor bdag nyid/ /spyod pa de ni rab tu bsngagasardzi/ /kun gyi bdag nyid yid bzang la/ /dbang po'i (1)grong khyer yang dag brten95ra/ /grong de rnams su spyod pa dang rlo/ /yid kyis brtul zhugs bstan 55dpar bya/ /sring dang zhi ba'i gzugs rnams kyis/ /gang der bdag nyid kyis 'gro bya/ /bdag nyid gzugs kyi rang bzhin can/ /yang dag me long la mthong 'gyur/ /zhu ba'i sems la brten (65byas nas/ /lus ni lus la thim par gyis/ /sdom par bdag nyid kyis bsdams nas)kyi/ /phyag rgya chen por yang dag grags/ /phyag rgya lnga (8)sogs lus la gnas/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa za/ /lhan cig rnal 'byor ma rol ldan/ /chags pa'i sems kyis bsgom 99)pa ste/ /mi 'dod kyang ni de phyir 'gronyirte/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dngos po yis/ /yid 'di la ni gos pa med/ /'jigs med rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /mtshan mo dur khrod sogs par 'gro/ /sa bzhi 37)gang du spyod pa na/ /rnam shes brgyad du shes par bya/ /lnga 512ldan spyod 1 dang brtul 8zhugs ni/ /bde ba can du de rtsen to/ /dang po'i sbyor bar yongs brten nas/ /phyi nas yid kyis 1gerab tu bshad/ /srog thams cad ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /dbang po'i grong khyer bde ba yi / /ye shes sbyong ba'i 3 brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 18'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni shin tu bzang po'i cho ga ste 516rab 78wa 682

tu byed pa bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas skye bo'i rigs kyi ni/ /khyad par bshad kyis 1)mnyan par gyis/ /rdo rje bzang po'i rab sbyor bas/ /de rigs 'dir ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de la dang por (kyelnga dang bdun/ /brgyad dang bcu gsum bcwa (8)lnga dang / /bcu bdun dang ni nyi shu gnyis/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun de bzhin mchog /tha skar la sogs shes bya ste/ /lha rnams tshogs su dran par bya/ /bzhi pa dang ni shar ba gsum / /gnyis pa dang ni drug de bzhin/ /byang phyogs pa rnams de bzhin gsum / /mi yi tshogs su dran par bya/ /gsum pa dang ni bcu nyid dang / /dgu pa dang ni nyi shu gsum/ /bcu bzhi pa dang bcu drug pa/ /bcwa 4brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi de grags pa/ /srin po'i rigs su dran par bya / /ra'i ⑤rigs gsum pa rirme dang brgyad pa(7)/ /klu ni bzhi dang lnga pa'o/ /drug pa nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ /khyi yi dngos por bshad pa'o/ /bcu dang bcu gcig byi ba ste/ /byi la 2de bzhin dgu pa'o/ /bcu bzhi pa dang bcu drug pa/ /rtag tu de ltar brjod pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa dang nyi shu lnga/ /khyu mchog gi ni rigs 'thob bo/ /thog ma tha ma bong bu yin97/ /rigs su de rnams rab tu grags/ /bcu gsum pa dang bcwa ༅lnga pa/ /de ni ma her mngon par brjod/ /thog ma dang ni nyi shu drug /rta yi rigs su rab tu brjod/ /nyi shu pa dang nyi shu gnyis/ /spre'u zhes bya bar brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa dang ni mtha' de bzhin/ /glang po yi ni rigs su 'gro/ /nyi shu gsum dang nyi shu bzhi/ /mi ste stobs ni che ba yin/ /nyi shu gcig pa sre mo ste/ /mdor bsdus pa yis rab tu bshad/ /stobs dang 78wa 683

bdag byed pa'i rgyu skar/ /bshad kyis da ltar ①mnyan par gyis/ /mi rnams srog ni rgyu skar te/ /gzhan du rab tu 'thob pa min②/ /skar mar dus kyi rtsa son par/ /'dzin pa po ni nges par 'chi/ /lug dang srang dang /rka ṭa / /chu srin mthon po la dran bya/ /tī ṭa bum seng khyu mchog ni/ /brtan ④pa'i bya bar rab tu bstan⑤/ /nya dang 'khrig pa de bzhin 'dir/ /gzhu dang bu mo 'dren ma la'o/ /bla ma nyi ma sa'i yiskyes bu/ /ngan spong rā hu (7)zla ①bud med/ /gza' lhag bkra shis ma ning ste(shesi/ /mkha' dkyil 'khor la /7 )gza' gang yin/ /de ltar rigs rnams so gzhan du/ /byang chub sras po mi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje bzang por de bshad de/ /rab sbyor rnam hunyepa'i sems kyis ni/ /g.yon pa'i rtsa ru son pa'i sems/ /dbu ma'i tha ma'i sbyor bar ldan/ /byang chub sa bon rnams 'bab la'o/ /byang chub sems rnams kyi nasterigs so/ /snying rjer son pa'i yid kyis ni/ /las kyi nyi ma 'dzag ④pa yin/ /yang dag rab ster rtag tu ldan / /rigs med rigs can kyang med do/ /srid par rtsed hunyemo tsam du ni/ /bsam gtan rnam pa'i lus son pa/ /me long gi ni yul la gzugasatshe/ /gang 'dra mthong ste de med do/ /de 'drar byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba'i gzugs can no/ /de yi nang du zhu ba'i sems/ /de dang mnyam pa gzhan yod min3)/ /nges par dkyil 'khor rnams dbus su/ /rdo rje bzang po bsgom par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yisa'o)/ /gsang sngags mchod pa sngon gyi can/ /dus dang dus min cha'i bdag nyid/ /dngos med ma yin byed por bzhugs/ /byang chub gzugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /bcom ldan sems dpas po'adi gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje bzang po'i cho ga ste sum̐ )rab 78wa 684

tu byed pa bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas gsang ba'i sbyor gang gis/ /bde kun bdag nyid du skye 0)bshad/ /don dam pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /de bzhin nyid du rab 'jug bya/ /'jigs byed chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sngags kyi phreng bar rang nyid byon/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa nyid ni/ /sa rnams la ni rab tu bshad/ /'khor lo drug dbyibs ri mo ni/ /sa yi dbus su bya ba yin/ /thams cad du ni gsang sngags tshig /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad bri bar bya/ /de rnams sngags kyi gzugs rnams ni/ /srog ni yi ge'i rnam pa can/ /yi ge'i cha rnams bzang po ni/ /spangs nas dbus mar (miganas pa yin/ /stong par nges par thim byas nas/ /'og dang steng du blta bar bya/ /rkang pa'i mtha' nas mgo bo ru/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug de srid byed/ /khams kun rab tu zhugs pa la/ /sems kyi spyod pa can ci smos/ /de ltar gsang ba gyen gnon pa/ /dpa' bo chen po'i don can no/ /dbus mar rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /bsnun dang bsgrub ④pa la sogs spangs/ /'thor rlung 'dzin bzhin pa yis ni/ /nyi ma dang po zad med can/ /rdo rje'i lam ni (snyelangs pa'i sems/ /gang phyir brgyud (6)pa'i rim pas so/ /de ltar sgyu ma'i bzlas pa 'dir(3)/ /rtsa ba'i sngags sogs re'u mig can/ /dpa' bo kun gyi re'u mig rnams/ /sngags kyi 'khor lor dgod (8)par bya/ /ting 'dzin mgon po'i dpa' bo rnams/ /bcu gnyis rnams kyi'ang 'khor lor son/ /gang zhig gang gi ming sngon gyis/ /de dang de yi gnas su bri/ /gzhan gyi sngags kun 'di rnams la/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sku la sogs pa'i 78—685

bzlas kun dang / /de bzhin ngag sogs bzlas pa can37/ /sems sogs bzlas pa thams cad dang / /de bzhin ye shes sogs bzlas can/ /sngags kyi rgyal pos bskul pa yis/ /de nas dpa' bo (2༄'byung bar 'gyur/ /'jigs byed chen po dbus rnams su/ /me yi gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /shes rab rigs kyi nus pa yis/ /'byung po'i tshogs de kun spyod bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas dang dbang / /drag po rengs 95)par byed yi ge/ /las dang rjes mthun ④ gzugs bsgoms te/ /'bar ba'i rnam pa sogs dgod bya/ /'chi ba slu (lde)zhing de nyid kyis/ /rnal 'byor dang ni ldan par 'gro/ /nā da nā dar 'dzom nyebya zhing ske/ /thig le 7thig ler thim par bya/ /de ltar cho ga'i bya ba yis/ /gsang sngags bzlas nas phur bu (8)gdab/ /'di rnams sngags kyi gtso bo yis/ /rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad de9ri/ oṃ hūṃ rtsu phaṭa kyi yi ge mtha'/ /ji lta'i rim pas 'di 1 tshokun la'o/ /na maḥshrī badz+ra ḍā ka 11ma hā bī ra bī rī shwa rā (12ya/ tri bhu wa ṇa kulpa /spra ba ḍā ya/ rdathon ṭa rtswa ṣa ṇa bhe re bā ya/ sha ta sa ha sra ne tā ya/bi byuta dzi hā ya/ kai kā la mā lā bha ra ṇi grwa ya/ ko ṭi la k+ṣa bhu dzā ya/ dzā lā ba lī bye lag nā ya/ par shu pā sho r+ya ta shu lā ya/ kum+bhi ta dhū sru gra ba pu ṣā ya/bi ka ṭa mu kha hā hā ra bā ya/ mā tre ga ṇa pa ri pū ri ta man tā ya/ sa ha dza sun dha rī bal+la bha ka rā ya/ r+ghaṃ rtsu kā ro ts+tsha ra ṇa mu khā ya/ ma hā thra shā na pri yā yal/ sarba bhū ta saṃ tā sa na ka rā ya/ ma hā /spran tā g+ni te dzā ya/ dza ṭā ka lā pa mu ku ṭā ya/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la shu la gin na dhā ri ṇi/ ma hā sa mu dra me kha lā ya / byā gh+ra tsasde bha ra dhā ri ṇi/ be tā la saṃ gha ma snya ṇa ka rā ya/ ma hā bisna ni bā ri ṇi/ sha tru ni sum̐ bha na ka rā ya/ tri sā hā sra ma hā sa ha sre ka ro mā ba sgyun+ta 78wa 686

brti ṇi/ sha ta sa ha sra mu khā ya/ dz+nyā na sā ga ra pra bhā ya/ ma hā pi shi ta ru dhi ra ba sā hā ri ṇi/ sarba mā ra ba la t+t+waṃ si ne/ shriṣ+ṭi saṃ hā ra kā ra kā ya/ sarba nā gā ṭ+wāṃ kho ṣa na ste bha na bi spyo ba ṇa ya/ an tra mā lā dhā ri ne/ su me ru rka pi ta nā dā ya/ kro dha bi gh+ra ha dhā ra ṇa ya/ ma hā kā sha ti la kā t+ma ne/ bud dha ko ṭi sa ha sra k+ṣa ḍā niṣ+ṭha da nā ya/ dz+nyā nā mṛ ta bas pa ṇa ya/ sarba kurma pra bsta nā ya ne/ baṃ da na ka rā ya/ sarba bi kulpa r+ghaṃ dza ṇa ka rā ya/ sum̐ ḍā ba li lasna sha rī rā ya/ pa ra kṛ ta yaṃ tra yaṃ tra nā sha nā ya/ ma hā rak+ṣa ka rā ya/ duhā ṭ+wāṃ bi dā la ne/ dharmo dha ya ka rā ya/ kro dha sī ra sī ra ṇa ya/ i dra dzā la sarba satād+ma nel/ grasta bā da pra bā 0)da ma hā ma te/ /de ltar la sogs gsang sngags gang / /rab tu mang ba rgya che'o/ /sna tshogs rnam pa du ma'i ming / /sems can ming gis shes par bya/ /sngags rnams thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /khams gsum rnams su yongs bzhugs (5)pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gtso/ /bcom ldan sngags pas 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni 'jigs byed chen po'i cho ga ste rdo nirab tu byed pa bcwa 9gelnga pa'o// //de nas mig 95)la sogs dbang po/ /kun gyi mngon shes cho ga bshad/ /mig mi bzang gi (yirab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje gsum ni rab bsgrub bya/ /gang du byang chub sems gnas pas/ /der ni mig gis nges par blta77/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi zag med mchog /sems ni mig tu shes par bya/ /rtsa rnams kyi ni rab sbyor bas/ /so sor rlung ni dbab par bya/ /gang nyid du ni skyes dus su/ /de yi dus su thim nas 'gro/ /de ni mngon shes mig rnams kyi/ /sems 'di 78wa 687

yis ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /skye 'gro'i nang du son 6)pa'i gzugs/ /yid kyis sgra ni nyan par 'gyur/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i cho ga ni/ /lha rdzas dri ru rjes mtshon bya / /lha rdzas ro yi (gecirab sbyor bas/ /lce ni dga' ba dang (kyebacas kyis/ /lce yi mngon shes la brten nas/ /dbu ma'i pho nya skyes pa yin/ /lus kyi reg pa'i rnam pa yis/ /mchog tu zag med de bsgrub bya/ /sngon gyi bag chags dran pa la / /de nyid rnal 'byor ldan par 'gro/ /nyin zhag mtshan mo mnyam byas nas/ /chu tshod drug cu nyid dang ni/ /chu'i srang drug cu tham pa dang / /gha ṭi kur yang sbyar bar bya/ /rgyar ni sor mo bcu gnyis la/ /dpangs su sor brgyad nyid yin te/ /guñdza (pedrug cu'i tshad la ni/ /sor bcu gnyis pa'i thur ma'o/ /skad cig thang cig yud tsam dang / /kānyi (gemig btsums phye ba dang / /se gol gtogs par shes bya ste/ /dbugs rgyu'i (nyamangon par shes pas so pha rol phyin drug tshul dag (7)gis/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mtshon par bya/ /dus dang dus min sel ba po(she/ /mig mi bzang ba bsgom par bya/ /mtshon bya mtshan snyinyid rnal 'byor ma'i/ /dkyil 'khor nang du byas pa nyid/ /sems 'di sna tshogs gzugs can te/ /srog chags rnams kyis tshegar bgrod nyunyepa/ /bdag med rang bzhin 'thob par 'gyur/ /mdud (12pa rnams kyi phrad pas gnas/ /gzugs su byed 'gyur de'i dngos po/ /mchog gi dang po bral mtha' can/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas gang gnas pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror 1stede shes bya/ /thur sel lam la rtag brten tsanas/ /slar yang re re'i nang du ste/ /srog la sogs pa'i rlung lnga yis/ /mig ni lnga ru shes par bya/ /'dzag 49pa med pa'i sa bon 'dzagatso /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sbyor ldan/ /sa bon lnga rnams thig le yiphonye mngon 78wa 688

shes byed po sogs lnga pa/ /de lta'i rnal 'byor mchog yongs rdzogs/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi'ang ①mchog yin no/ /dngos po'i ye ⑤shes can ma lus/ /ring du yongs su spangs pa yin/ /thams cad lus su mnyam sbyor las/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i spyan 'jug pa/ /dngos kun dngos po med mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mig gis ①'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni mig mi bzang gi cho ga ste byarab tu byed pa bcu drug pa'o// //de nas lha mos ⑤phyag byas nas/ /de bzhin mchod pa chen po byas/ /stobs po che yi sbyin sreg ⑥ni/ /bdag po chen pos bstan du gsol/ /mkhas pas rgyun du nang bdag gi/ /sbyin sreg (7)bshad kyis ⑧mnyan par gyis/ /stobs po che yi rab sbyor bas/ /khams rnams kun gyis dgang blugs 0te/ /bde ba thab tu yang dag 'thob⑩/ /nyi zla dgang gzar blugs yigazar ro/ /slob dpon gnyis med de de bil/ /yang dag rigs 0pa'i gzugs su bsregapho/sna tshogs mkha' 'gro rnams 'di meyi/ /gsang sngags rang bzhin mtshan nyid do / /yam 8shing rtsa ru yang dag grags/ /gang phyir sā 0li las skyes 'bras/ /tshil ni rtag tu zho zan yin/ /'di ru mar ni byang chub sems/ /khrag ni sbrang rtsir shes par bya/ /srog sogs rlung rnams dur rngi tshoba'o/ /gcin medang bshang ba dag de ltar/ /tsan+dan dang ni gla rtsi'o/ /me tog rtag tu khrag tu grags/ /mchil ma lud pa 'bras thug yin/ /bud shing so sen 1)rus pa'o/ /mdor bsdus pa yis pags 8 )pa gos/ /me yi 3lhathab kyi dbus su ni/ /spa dang ba spu lha ru 'gyur/ /sna tshogs phra mo'i khams gzhan ni/ /sna tshogs 'bru ste de la 78—689

bsreg1 /rim gyis mkha' 'gro rdzogs son pa/ /(gugang ba'i sreg 6)blugs su shes bya/ /dbang po thams cad gar byed de/ /de yi snyibag chags glu (5)len no/ /sna tshogs sgra chen pos rol mo/ /snying rje sogs pas ston mo yin/ /srog rnams 6)kun gyi bdag po yi/ /stobs po che ni bsgom par bya/ /las thams cad pas sbyin sreg tshomedani/ /des mnyes pa yi ⑧dngos grub 'gyur/ /'jig rten mchog gi khams kun du/ /yid ni de ru yang dag rol/ /gang tshe'i (9)dus su bde gyur pa//de 10tshe'i dus su rab tu gnas/ /sbyin sreg rang 31bdag nyid mthong bas /smod 1 dang rjes 'dzin byed pa yin/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das ye shes/ /de rnams dbus mar 'thob sna par bya/ / mtshams rnams 8kun du khong khro ba/ /sems chen po ni gsod nyu5par 'gyur/ /rtog nyu5pas sprul pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /de las byung ba bza' bar bya/ /mtshon bya mtshon byed rab bcom pas/ /gnyis dag shes par 'os pa yin/ /sgyu ma'i bdag nyid mtshan nyid ni/ /de la thim par byed par 'gyur/ /khams (1 tshokun yang dag sbyor ba las/ /ye shes gnyis byar med mtshan nyid/ /me yi gzugs su rtag bzhugs 38pa'i bcom ldan thab khung gis 'di gsungs19/ /zhes bya ba ni stobs po che'i cho ga ste dgerab tu byed pa bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas rdo rje pad 'du ba/ /ji bzhin bshad kyis 27mnyan par gyis/ /rin chen rdo rje'i rab sbyor bas/ /a ba dhū tī 22can dngos grub/ /rnal 'byor ma ni na yang dag rol/ /don dam pa yi nyams la gnas/ /de yi sbyor bas grol bar ni/ /gnyis med rgyu rnams kyis 'gyur ro/ /lus kyi nyams su myong bzhin 78wa 690

pa / /byis pa rnams kyi byang chub 'od/ /ha yig drug pa ①dang ldan pa'i(mi/ /sa bon rdo rje'i nor bur dgod/ /a ba dhū tī'i rtsar du'abab ste/ /steng du kha bltas 9)dpral bar son/ /srung (ldenyeba'i dus su blo ldan gyis/ /rang gi kyilag pas rdo rje gzung / /byang chub sems la rtsen byed la/ /rgas dang 'chi ba ring ba yin/ /srid pa'i skyon las 'goms (7pa yis/ /srid gsum de yi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor bas/ /nyi ma re re bsgrub par bya /de yi dus su gang mthong ba/ /dngos po kun la ltung bar bya/ /'dod chags chen po'i tshul bdag nyid/ /rtag tu bdag nyid la 'byung 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rgyu'i don du/ /bstan bya ston pa por 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud kyi ni/ /sems can don ni nges par byas(kye/ /sku bzhi po yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bden min bdag gis bshad mi bya/ /rin chen rdo rje'i 99)rang bzhin can/ /sbyor ⑩skyes ye shes gyen du bgrod/ /pho nya rnams kyi gtso nyid bya1ste/ /'dod chags me yis dgyes par bya1gye/ /byang chub sems ni rtag gzung ba/ /lce yis bya yi tsolag pas min/ /lhan skyes 'phos pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /mkha' lding phyag rgya nyid kyis cigazung / /phyag rgya'i kha nyid du sbyin te/ /de nas btung bobar bya ba yin/ /stobs thams cad kyi 7bza' bar bya/ /sā lto li skyes rtsonyesogs 'bad pas so/ / sbyin sreg tu)kun kyang de 2 )nyid kyis/ /dbang la sogs pa gang gang byedam/ /de de'i thod par bya ba ste/ /de nas sa bon gdab ( —1par bya/ /de rnams rdzas kyis spang sdo rnyeb dang / /gtor ma dang ni bsrung bar da bya/ /de yis bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /de dang 'dra ba'i gzungs 'jug 'gyur/ / ril bu sa 'am ni skud pa ni/ /dpa' bo rang nyid kyis gsungs pa'o sme/ /bha ga'i dbus 78—691

rnams su bsgom pasti/ /rin chen rdo rje (mican de sman/ /dkyil 'khor khams rnams kun gyi ste/ /spangs ⑧pa rab tu bstan ④pa yin/ /gang dang gang gi las kyi ni/ /de dang de'i (geming can sngags soyi/ /sa bon kun gyi yongs sbyor las/ /de ni rtag tu sman rnams te/ /bcom ldan 'das ⑦kyi phyag rgya ni/ /rtag tu 'ching bas 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni rin chen rdo rje'i cho ga ste nirab tu byed pa bcwa (9)brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'khor ba'i mthar gnas pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /rta mgrin gyi ni rab sbyor bas/ /pho nya'i mtshan nyid bsgrub ⑩par bya/ /ha yig skye naspeganas dbus su ste'i/ /ya yig mgo bor gnas pa'o/ / sgyi yig dbus tsoma'i pad+mar te/ /ba ④yi yi ge snying ga liru/ /rnal 'byor che la 'dzin bzhin patshe/ /dbyangs can ma dang 'dra bar byed/ /rmongs pa nyid ni thams cad 'phrog /gang phyir lho tshogazhung ni rjes 'jug 'gyur/ /mgrin par rtag tu tshigs bcad ni/ /mgrin par dag tu gnas pa nyid/ /'tsho ba rta yi dbyibs 'dir ni/ /gnas pa rnal 'byor lhag ma yin/ /de yi sbyor bas 'gro 'gyur ba//sngon du nyi nyunyama'i gdan du'o/ /nyi (/6de rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /khams gsum por ni bskor bar 'gyur/ /nam mkhar nyi mas mdzes ( )byas nas/ /byang chub yid kyis 'gro bar 'gyur/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo ma lus rtogs/ /rnal 'byor ma yi chu skyes mchog /sems can kun gyi rmongs nyid dang / /lam mthong 0ba ni thams cad zhugyel/ /de nyid nyi ma rtag snang bar/ /mtshan mo zho nyamun pa drag po 'phrogardo ge /rnal 'byor ma 'khor dbus son par/ /rta yi mgon po bsgoms pa 78wa 692

yin / /gang gi ①sangs rgyas su 'gro ba/ /sgrub thabs yan lag 'char bar 'gyur / /bgegs rnams rnam par nyams 'gyur te/ /sprin la sogs pa ②nyams par 'gyur/ /kun gyi sdig pa'ang 'phrog par byed/ /rang gi dga' ba shar mtshan nyid/ /mchod sbyin dus kyis 'jig rten du/ /thams cad skad cig la sgrub 'gyur/ /khams bdun rnam par bzung ba yis/ /de tshe sa 'og dngos grub 'gyur/ /bdag med 'di rnams de lha mo/ /yan lag gcig gi ②rol par byed / /sngags kyi bzlas pa mi bya ste/ /sbyin sreg ā ga sogs (pede bzhin/ /ji ltar bde bas rtogs (snyebya ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid 'thob (6)'gyur/ /'dod chags kyis ⑦ni 'dod chags sgodu/ /me yis tshig la gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags/ /bsten par gyur pas mi 'ching ngo de nyid thabs so yid kyi nyu)las/ /dge ba'i mtshan nyid can bya'o/ /nang du byed pa ma yin te/ /gus pa phyo )yid kyis dbu mar gnas/ /phyi rol ye shes can rnams kyis (teye shes/ /de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang ba sogs/ /sems can 'jig rten sogs 'byung ba/ /de rnams spangs pas sangs rgyas med/ /mu stegs can dang sangs rgyas par/ /kun du dbye ba yod ma yin/ /lung thams cad ni 'gal ba ste/ /tshad ma pa rnams tho cho 32can/ /thams cad tshig ni rnam shes pas/ /ye shes can rnams de'i phyir 3)shes/ /mkha' 'gro thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /nam mkha' rnams su bzhugs pa yinas/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten 'jig rten par/ /rtag tu bzhugs 7pas 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni rta mgrin gyi cho ga ste 7rab tu byed pa bcu dgu pa'o// //78—693

de nas rab tu 'joms yon tan/ /bshad kyis 47sgrub pa po rnams nyon/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje rlung gi mtshan nyid de/ /'chags pa dang ni 'jig rnams su/ /gang zhig stong pa de srog chags55)/ /khams rnams de 'drar shes bya ste/ / dul ba'i 5)sbyor bar yang dag gnas/ /zla ba'i gzugs su yongs grags pa'i/ /rang gi rang bzhin las skyes 'dzag /rnal 'byor lhag ma'i ye shes kyang / /de ni rab 'joms la brjod do/ /dus thams cad du g.yo ba med/ /g.yo ba'am 'dir ni mi mthong ngo / /de ni thams cad bdag nyid rlung ske/ /bsam pa thams cad rab ④'jug pa'o/ /do lā hā ra sogs sbyar bas/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi thar ster po(ge/ /sgra dang thig ler de shes bya/ /'od gsal ba dang snang ba gsum/ /de phyir nam mkha'i snying po yang / /mkha' 'gro'i sbyor rnams kyis shes bya/ /nang gi dbu (nama'i sbyor ba yis/ /srog de'ang rab tu bsngags pa yin/ /de yang kun gzhi (3)shes bya ste/ /me long du yang rab tu bshad/ /chos kyi ri nasku la sogs pa'ang (9)de/ /dmyal sogs 'gro ba de bzhin te / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyi/ /gnas ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rol/ /zla ba'i lam du gang tshe mkha'/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi ⑩lhag med 'pho/ / de'i dus 77rnam par gzhag 412med 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor byis nyu pas bgrod bya min / /nam mkha'i khams rnams thams cad kyi/ /de yi snying por charab tu bstan / /de dag shes rab thabs gnyis so/ /gnas skabs kyang ni gnyis nyid do / /srid pa rnam par 'phro ba nyidam/ /dbang po'i dbus su sbyar bar bya /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mtha' yas rnams/ /sa yi nang du rtsen par 'gyur/ /de ltar rnam bcas de nyid dang / /rnam pa med pa'i go 'phang bzhugs/ /78—694

sems dang rnam par shes pa'i rgyun/ /gnyis po nyid ni gnyis med 'gyur/ /dbu mar lta ①rnams kyis (mi'agrub ste/ /ye shes der 'di rdzogs pa'o/ /gal te sangs rgyas rjes chags (miyod/ /chos dge 'dun la de bzhin mchog /gal te mu stegs mkhas pa yibya/ /tshul chen chos de 'dod pa dang / /gal te shes rab thabs rnal 'byor/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /gal te thams cad mi rtag bdag /tshul 'di bsgom par bya ba yin/ /'dir mang smras pas (nyeci bya ste/ /chos dbyings gal te 'dod kyang ngo / /nam mkha'i snying po'i gzugs can gyi/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa bsgom par bya/ /shan (6)pa snyig (7)ma mkhan la sogs / / gsod pa'i (kyedon la yongs gnas pa/ /de kun de'i gnas nyams dga' bar/ /lam rjes skyob 3)rnams kyi grol 'thob/ /nges par dkyil 'khor dbus rnams su/ /gzugs su sdom ⑩pa bsgom par bya/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid dngos grub 'thob/ /rnam shes kun gyi sbyor bdag nyid/ /stong nyid snying po gcig pu pa/ /bcom ldan rab 'joms rnam pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la bzhugs (1pas 'di 9logasungs/ /zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i snying po'i cho ga ste 6nyerab tu byed pa nyi shu pa'o// //de nas lha mos mchod byas te/ /phyag byas nas 0ni 'di gsol to/ /rang gis 7rig pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes gsung bar tshimadzod/ /rang rig ye shes las byung ba/ /ji lta'i rigs pas bshad par bya/ /dpal te ru ku'i rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor zla ba'i bgrod pa dang 7/ /dkar po'i tshes 8gcig la sogs nas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'phel bar 'gyur/ /thog mar ye 78—695

shes skye bar 'gyur/ /gnyis par nam mkhar 'gro ba'i gzugs/ /gsum par mda' yi dbyibs dang 'dra/ /bzhi par 'ben 0)gyi gzugs can no/ /lnga par rtse mo lnga'i bdag nyid/ /drug par khams drug 'byung ba yin/ /bdun par rgya mtsho yi nani gzugs/ /brgyad par pad+mar rdo rabarjod pa yin/ /dgu pa ru ni bcud len te/ /bcu par lhan skyes gzugs kyis so/ /bcu gcig pa la zhi ba'i gzugs/ /bcu gnyis pa la 'khor lo'i gzugs/ /bcu gsum pa la nyi ma ste/ /bcu bzhir zla ba de bzhin no/ /bcwa la lnga pa nyid rā hu ste/ /thig le zhes byas 5rabacu drug pa'o56)/ /rnam pa bcu drug mtshan nyid ni/ /rang gis rig (7rapar shes par bya/ /dpal he ru ma'i sbyor ba 8)yis/ /'khor lo bzhi rnams su bsgrub 9)bya/ /rgas pa med cing 'chi ba med/ /nad dang mdze 7sogs spangs pa (17yin / /lte bar shrī yi yi ger gyur/ /he yig snying gar 1gedagod par bya/ /ru yig mgrin pa'i 'khor lor te snye/ /thod par ka yi yi ge'o/ /thig le bzhi yi rab sbyor bas/ /rang gis rig par 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug ni/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi mchog zag med/ /gnas dang gnas su 'pho ba nyid/ /dbu ma'i nang du rab tu gzhugaci'i /'khor lo bzhi yi 'dab bison nas / /rang gis rig pa mtha' yas mchog /rigs de rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi / /byung bar rnam par shes par bya/ /sems can 7po ni sad bzhin pas/ /don yod mthong ba thob 57par 'gyur/ /rtag tu rmi lam du 'gyur te/ /dus thams cad du nges par gnas/ /longs spyod sprul pa'i mtshan nyid du/ /gnyid log pa yis de tshe mthong / /bzhi pa rab mang 512bdag med de/khe/ /de phyir de rnams mtha'i longs spyod/ /de ltar 'khor lo bzhir gnas nas/ /nges par 78wa 696

lam du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /shes rab de nyid rtogs byas nas/ /nyi mas thabs kyi de nyid can/ /rdul gyi sbyor ba 'byung ba ste/ /nag po'i phyogs su gang 'dir yang / /bcu drug rnams kyi cha rnams kyi/ /nyi ma nyid ni bar 517du'o / /stong nyid snying rje'i sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'bar zhing 'bar/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor rdzun lo'i dbus rnams su/ /dpal he ru ka bsam par bya/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje'i dga' bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gnas skabs thams cad yang dag sbyor/ /gtso bo rang rig ri )bdag nyid can / /bcom ldan 'das pa'i bzhi pa'i mthar/ /rtag tu bzhugs pas 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni dpal he ru ma'i cho ga ste 4/rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas lus sogs lha rnams kyi5/ /ston mo mngon par 5bshad par bya/ /pad+ma gar dbang phyug nyid kyi/ /rab tu sbyor ba'i de 977byung ngo / /rtsa ni pad+mar yang dag grags/ /srog gi rlung gis gar byed do/ /byang chub sems kyis dbang phyug ste/ /de rnams kyi ni nang du bzhugs/ /rang gis 8)rig pa bza' bar bya/ /snying rje'i kha yis btung 97bar bya/ /gnyis med rnal 'byor ma dang rol / /sgyu ma'i rjes su 'gro rnams 'grub/ /thams cad de yi rang bzhin du/ /bza' ba bza' ba med par bya/ /pad+ma gar dbang bsgom par bya / /ji lta'i rim pas mtshon par bya/ /pa yig gzhan gyi grong du 'gro/ /brtan pa thams cad t+ma 1nyeyi yig /na yig g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor te/ /rte yig bde ba'i lha can yin / /shwa yig ta mal sogs pa'i stobs/ /ra yig dga' rol rgyu can yin/ /78—697

srid dang mya ngan 'das kun la/ /de yi 1nyerab tu sbyor bar (5)bya/ /mtshams kyi skad ni 'di rnams kun/ /bde mchog phyi mar shes par bya/ /bgrod pa 'di rnams la brten ( cinas/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rang / /he ru ka dang bde mchog nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sogs gtso bo/ /pad+ma gar dbang phyug de yang ske/ /sbyor ba kun la (4 shes par bya/ /pad+ma ye shes yang dag grags/ /gar gyi dbang phyug rnam shes can/ /gnyis po 75)gnyis med yang dag byung / /lha kun 'dir ni byung ba yin/ /shes po 6thams cad de la gnas/ /khams gsum du ni gar dbang phyug /gar byed pa yi sku chen la/ /de nas rtags ⑦ni mtshon par bya/ /nam mkhar zhen pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mchog tu rmad du byung bar 'gro / /rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo dbus su ri/ /lhan skyes gzugs kyis rol par gyis/ /'di yis rtag tu dbang gi (gelas/ /de rnams kyis ni dga' ba tebyed / /gang dag 11gang gi (1 las rnams la/ /de 12dang de yir ribobasgom par bya / /sgrub po rnams kyi byang chub rtsar/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang tsodu 'ong ske/ /de nas bdud ni bcom byas nas/ /gar byed skobazhin pas pad+ma 'dzin / /sdig pa thams cad rab 'joms shing / /che 1 son pa rnams gnas par byed/ /'dod pa thams cad 'grub 'gyur zhing /she/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi srid la //sbyong / /rang gi ri ci )sems kyis dngos grub 'thob/ /rnam rtog nyid du mi bya'o / /gzhan du srid pa'i sbyor bdag nyid/ /sems samathams cad ni du gyerab 'jug pa/ /'khrul zhing chud zos mu stegs rnams/ /bstan pa rnams la rab 'jug bya/ /bag chags ngan dpa yongs spangs 2 nas/ /phyi nas rang bzhin bstan par bya/ /bza' ba thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /bza' ba med par 78wa 698

rtag tu gnas/ /bcom ldan pad+ma gar mdzad pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni pad+ma gar dbang gi cho ga ste 0nyerab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi naci/ /mtshan nyid bshad kyis (5)lha mo nyon/ /gzugs las 'das pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni ye shes chen por brjod/ /rnam par snang bzhin pa de bzhin/ /sems dpa' chen po'i ming can no/ /spu khung rtse rdogemo thams cad las/ /de rnams nges 'thon stobs chen po/ /de rnams bu gar rab (snyezhugs payi/ /'khor lo bzhi yi mtsho skyes son/ /ji ltar mar la mar zhugs pa/ /de bzhin du ni khams la zhugs/ /g.yo ba 'gog par byas pa yis//de 'drar thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang mthong ba ni de mthong nyid/ /gdong (7gis gdong ni blta 70bar gyis/ /mi dang mi mo lha sogs kyi79)/ /gzugs ni pad+ma'i 'dab chu bzhin/ /srog chen po der shes bya ste/ /shi ba'i lus las nges par 'thon/ / oṃ gyi 'iyi ge yid la bya/ /dbugs rgyu ba yis mtshon par bya/ /bdag nyid kyis ni t+t+waṃ yig spro/ /gsor ba yi ni rnal 'byor ldan / /sems la oṃ gyi yi ger 'gyur/ /lus la gnas par mtshon par bya/ /haṃ yig mchog gi dang po yis/ /ye shes dngos po rnams su sprul/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams kyi dbus su/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi bsgom 17pa'o/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa rnams kyis/ /sngags pa la ni 'bar bar 32bya/ /bye ba stong phrag grangs kyi ni/ /rnal 'byor ma la 'dod spyod 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams kyis mi 'pho lte ste/ /'dod na bde ba rnam par spro/ /de tshe rnal 'byor ma mnyes nas/ /78—699

dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed/ /sdug dang mi sdug rnam dpyod 6)pa/ /rnal 'byor ma la mi bya'o/ /myur bar stong phrag rnams (0kyi gzugs/ /rnam par snang mdzad du bsgrub bya/ /sna tshogs du ma'i skad kyis chos/ /de rnams lus ris can gyis nyan/ /rnam snang mdzad dang mi bskyod dang / /rin chen dbang dang (8)ā ro lika(4/ /don yod rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang la sogasal/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sogs kyang / /de rnams rnal 'byor ma las rig /'gro drug grol bar byed nyid dang / /bde 'gro rnams su 'jug pa posni/ /blo ldan so sor sems can don/ /gnyis med dngos por byed par 'gyur/ /mi shes nyon mongs gzhom don du/ /tshul 'di yang ni bsgom par bya/ /khams thams cad kyi til mar ni/ /dogs pa med pas bya ba yin/ /rnam snang sbyor bas btung bya 'am/ /byug pa yang ⑥de nyid kyis bya'o/ /de yis sna nas sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje'i lam du rtag tu'o/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs su 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yid 'ong / /gnyis pa thams cad kun sbyor las/ /rnal 'byor mas 'dod thar pa stsol(be/ /bcom ldan thams cad dag pa'i sku/ /rab grol mdzad pas 58)'di gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi cho ga ste (9nyerab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gsang chen bshad bya ste/ /mdor bsdus pa yis rgyas par 0min/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rab sbyor bas/ /gnas thams cad du yang dag bzhugs/ /rdo rje nyu)mi phyed ye shes te/ /sems dpa' snying po ston pa'o/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /rdo rje sems dpar skurab tu grags/ /zla ba rdo rje'i rab sbyor 78wa 700

bas / /gnas rnams bgrod pa bstan par bya/ /pul+lī zhi)ra las lte bar 'bab/ / dzā lan sedha rar yang dag gnas/ / o then (0du lani kun du spyod pa 'grub(ge/ /ar bu dar ni (6)bza' dang btung (7can no/ /go dā ba ra'i gnas su (8)rol ba ste / /rā ⑨me shwa 7rir rgyal dang pham pa'onyu7/ /de bī 8ko snyir rjes su 'dzin pa ste0/ /mā la wa ru 0rnal 'byor ma yi gtso/ /kā ma rū nyunyepar tshig ni yi'agrub pa'o / /o ḍir nyu tshomangon sum dngos grub ster ba ste/she/ /tri sha ku nar hu7dbang po ( )rnams kyi ni / /myur du dngos grub rab tu 'jug pa'ori she/ /ko sa la ru so rnal 'byor dngos grub ste/ /ka ling ka ru ri (phra mo'i dngos grub skye/ /lam pa ka ru rtag par 'grub par 'gyur ge/ / kāgyi ru ni bsad ( nyapa'i dngos grub bo//nyi ma la yar mthun par dzo tsho'agrub pa sten / /pre ta pu rir rang gi lta ba'o37/ /gri ha de ba tār ni so )bkas gnang ba/ /lhan skyes 'pho med sau rā jiru me/ /gser gling du ni rang gi (snyedon 'grub bodage/ /nā ga rar ni zhugeganas kyi dngos grub ster/ / sin dhu ra ru (lhastobs 'grub de bzhin du/ /ma rul 2nya'achi ba 8 snamed pa'i sashedangos grub bo/ /ku lu tar ni 37rang bzhin dngos grub tu/ /de nyid rnal 'byor rnams 6 )la skye ba'o81/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rtag bsgoms nas/ /thams cad dngos grub 'gro bar byos/ /gnas sogs rnal 'byor ma dbus su/ /khams su gyur pa'i ro chen po/ /gsang ba'i tshig 42tu shes par bya/ /mchog ni lhan cig skyes par dran/ /dgyes pa ye shes shes bya ste/ /thams cad bdag nyid yon tan gnas/ /rtag bzhugs gnyis med rnam pa ste/ /sems can 'jig rten las la 8ni/ /rnal 'byor ldan 69pa rnams kyi yang (snye/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid kyis/ /nā da'i dbus las yang dag byung / /de nyid du ni 78wa 701

thim 0)nas 'gro/ /gnas par de ②ni mngon par brjod/ /de ltar thams cad cho ga bzhin/ /dpa' bo mchog rnams kyis shes bya/ /de nyid nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag /de ni nus par rab tu bshad/ /skyes pa dang ni skye bzhin pa'i/ /nus pa thams cad rab 'jug gis/ /dngos med ma yin pa'i gzugs kyis/ /dbyangs dang phyi mo gsum spangs pa/ /thig le'i gzugs ni sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje sems dpar (b.rab tu grags/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams kun gyi gtso/ /sgyu ma'i gnas kyi dngos grub ni/ /'jug mdzad bcom ldan gyis 'di gsungs/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas thams cad kyi bdag nyid can gyi rab tu byed pa ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de ltar dpa' bo gtso bo yi/ /las kyi tshogs rnams shes par bya/ /nyi shu bzhi bdag nyid nyams dga'/ /thams cad gsang chen gyis (geganas su/ /gsang chen rgyas par bshad pa can/ /kun spyod cho ga bshad par (5)bya/ /sngon bshad khams kyi 'du shes ni/ /gsum gsum du ni bshad pa yin/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi gsum rnams can/ /de rnams brgyad brgyad shes par bya/ / dpa' bo ⑥nyi shu bzhi rnams kyi/ /re re'i nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ /skum pa'i (7rnam pa'i rnal 'byor du/ /thig le nyid ni gzhag ⑧par bya/ /de rnams dkyil 'khor phyi rol du / /bskor bas dziketing 'dzin rdo rjer ⑩'gyur/ /shar la hunyesogs pa rim bzhin du/ /rdo rje 8'khor lo sogs hunyepar 'phros/ /dkyil 'khor du ni lha thams cad/ /rnal 'byor ma kun shes par bya/ /bdun cu drug ④lhag pa'i lnga brgyal/ /nyin zhag rnams su yongs 'pho bya/ /re re yi ni srog 'gyur ba/ /78—702

sum cu rtsa bdun phyed bcas pa'o0)/ /nyi khri brgya phrag bcu drug ni/ /nyin zhag la ni shes par bya/ /lus can kun gyi rang bsam pa/ /de rnams kyi dus rab tu 'jug /rnal 'byor de dngos bsgom rnams la/ /sangs rgyas bsam pa rab tu bskor(kye/ /'di rnams kun nyid dpa' bo rnams/ /gnas sogs nyi shu bzhi can la/ /thim ①dang longs spyod bdag byed pas/4no/ /dus dang dus tshod za bar byed/ /'di ⑤lta'i cho ga'i bya ba yis/ /kun du gnas pa bdag ma yin/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs dang dpa' bo/ /de ni bdag dang bdag gi yirim bzhin no⑦ / /sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad du/ /bdag dang bdag gi (8)spyod yul med/ /yid ches tsam du myang 'das pa/ /gzhung smra ba la bstan pa'o/ /de kho na nyid ma rig pa yis 'jig rten rmongs79rin/ /de kho na nyid rnam par spangs pas dngos grub min7/ /rnal 'byor rnams la rgyud 31rgyal du/ /de dang de yi mchog 7yi shes/ /'od gsal sgyu ma bdag gis ni/ /sgyu ma'i 'jig rten la bshad do/ /kye lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin gcig pur bstan/ /lha dang lha min sa tsogasum 'joms la 'dudami/ /dbang po dang ni 'jig rten pa yis mi shes te/ /mchog tu bde ba chen po'i glu yis mchod par gyis/ /15las thams cad pa'i gzugs su bsgom par byosa'i/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das par 32ston pa na ci / /sgyu ma gti mug gis ni ri 1)mor gnas/ /sems can theg pa da dung nyams byed ci( )/ /de ltar yongs su dgyes pa'i mgur/ /bcom ldan rang nyid kyis gsungs so/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor rnams dang ni/ /byang chub dus su blang bar gyis/ / dpa' bo (lhathams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /78wa 703

bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ①las de kho na nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid rgyud thams cad kyi don ston pa po gsang chen thams cad pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo/ /rnam pa du ma'i 'khor gyis kyang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro khyab pa'i bdag /bcom ldan bdag po la bstod pa/ /khyod ni 'dod chags chen po'i tshul/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin can/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin gyi ni gzugs/ /chos rnams bstan pas tshim par 'gyur/ /chos dang chos min pa yi gzugs/ /chos dang chos pa khyod gnyis med/ /bdag gis sprul pa'i dngos po yis/ /'jig rten kun gyi'ang don (bcan te/ /bdag nyid chen po ster ba po/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'jug byed pa/ /khyod kyis dam tshig bstan ((pa ste/ /gzhan min dam tshig ri nyid las byung / /bdag gis bsod nams rin rjes bsgoms 6)pas/ /byang chub mchog tu (7yid bsgrubs sol/ /ston pa mchog tu bde la bzhugs/ /de yis sems can don mdzad pa'o/ /rtsu gi yi ge'i sgra sgrogs pas/ /nga rgyal can gyi bgegs skrag 'gyur/ /khyod kyis nye bar bsten pas ni/ /de rnams la ni skye 'chi med/ /bde ba'i rgyal po nyid du rtsen(8)/ /byang chub kyi ni yid du bgrod/ /khyod dang thabs cig ⑨'dres par 'gyur / /gong bu gcig pu 7gnyis med bzhugs/ /de ltar bstod pas rdo rje che / /mchod pa bzhi ni rab ston mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor bdag dang gnyis med nyidam/ /mchod pa rnams ni gnyis med byed/ /phyi dang nang bdag nyid can 78—704

rdzas / /gnyis ①pa yi ni mchod par dran②/ /bza' dang btung sogs la rol pa/ /gnyis med mchod pa gsum pa'o/ /bzhi pa chos dang rnal 'byor dag /'dzin pa yi ni mchod pa'o/ /de lta'i mchod pa la brten nas/ /thams cad byas pas las rgyal por/ /'gyur ro rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /gru gsum du ni mnyes bya ste/ /sngon du dkyil 'khor byas nas ni/ /lag pa g.yon pas thams cad du/ /pad+ma yi ①ni bskor nas byasnod/ /sngags pa rnams kyis gzung bar bya / /sngon du rnal 'byor ma la ni/ /skra grol ba yis gtor ma sbyin⑤/ /rnal 'byor ma kun chu skyes ni/ /kha yis bzung nas dkrug par bya/ /de yi lag par son pa'i dpal/ /gang su yis kyang dbrog (nyami nus/ /ji ltar bde bas bde ba gzung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog mnyes bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bskyang bar bya/ /spun gyi spyod pa'ang bsten ⑦par bya/ /snying rje'i mchog dbang gyur bya zhing / /dbang dupo rnams ni mi rtag par/ /bsgom bya snang ba med pa yil / /rang bzhin dbang du gyur par gnas/ /rdo rje pad+ma snyoms 'jug pas/ /phyag rgya nang gi bdag nyid mchog /stong nyid gnyis med rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos po thams cad spang bar bya/ /don dam can de nyid 'dir bya/ /rtag tu byang chub sems dran bya/ /man ngag gcig ni bsgoms pa yis/ /man ngag thams cad mtshon par bya/ /ji ltar sa gcig thob pa yis/ /sa thams cad ni 'thob ⑩par 'gyur/ /de bzhin man ngag thams cad kyang / /man ngag gcig gis 'thob par 'gyur/ /byis pa rnams dang rgan po dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams thams cad du/ /mnyam pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga yis/ /mkhas pa yis ni bya ba yin/ /mi mnyam pa yis dngos grub 'joms/ /dmyal ba sogs par ⑪78—705

ltung bar 'gyur/ /rgan po yon tan kun gnas pa/ /de rnams mnyes pas byang chub ster/ /khyad par mchod pa nyid ni 'dir/ /byis pa rnams dang de bzhin yang / /gnyis bcas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis51nye/ /me tog bskor ba la sogs bya/ /kun du smod pa'i ngag mi bya/ /'dod dang ri 'dod min sbyor bral bya/ /ma byin par yang blang bya zhing / /rtag tu srog chags gsad ②par bya/ /sems can rnams la brdzun smra zhing / /ma sogs rnal 'byor ma la bgrod ge/ /'khor lo mchod pa rgyun du bya/ /bza' bya 55)lnga la sogs pa sbyin/ /de yi bsod nams kyis 'thob pa/ /dus thams cad du bgegs med dang / /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma mthong bas/ /bsam pa gzhan (6)ni rab tu 'jug /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sku las bstod pa dang mchod pa bzhi la sogs pa gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig bstan (34)pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //rgyud 'di rab tu byung ba ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /mtshan nyid med pa thams cad spangs/ /sum cu bdun bdag nyid rnal 'byor/ /gnyis med mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / / gnyis med 5)rtsa 7rgyud hustergyud chen po/ /'dus pa'i rnam pa'i gzugs can te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyi/ /dus thams cad du zhal na gnas/ /yi ge kun gyi za ma tog /'bum phrag sum cu drug dang po/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rab bshad de/ /chen po nyu2chung ngur gsungs pa'o/ /ri rab kyi ni rdul tshad kyi/ /78wa 706

mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis gsungs so/ /mtha' yas shing ni mu med nyid/ /rtsod ①pa'i dus kyi sa'i nang du/ /bcom ldan mtha' yas pas 'di gsungs/ /shākya ②seng ges gsungs pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor pha rol son pa'o/ /nyan pa ston pa rang nyid de/ /'chad po skye bo gzhan kyang ngo / /legs par gsungs dang 'chad 'gyur bsti/ /de'i rang bzhin du'ang bgrod ④par 'gyur/ /bsdu ba mdzad pa sogs rnams kyis/ /bdag las bgrod pa de thob bo/ /ma mo thams cad 'dus rnams kyis/ /rdo rje'i gnas rnams su bsdus so/ /gcig la gcig gis ⑤bzhed pa ni/ /gsol ba 'debs shing gsol 'debs mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yi/ /tshig 'di la ni mngon par dga'/ /sdig pa rnams las grol bar 'gro/ /srid pa las ni 'gro bar byos/ /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam sbyor las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan bdag pos 'di gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ⑨las rgya mtsho drug la sogs pa la rnal 'byor dang ye shes dang sdom pa dang bya ba dang de kho na nyid rgya mtshor gyur pa dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las 'di rnams dang mi mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po zhes bya ba rdzogs so(7// //dpal bal yul grub pa'i gnas mchog 3)chen po yu tung lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi 79)ta chen po rdo rje slob dpon rtog ge pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dus deng bosang 'gran zla 17med pa/ snying rje chen pos thugs brlan 8pa'i ngang tshul can/ phyogs sna tshogs nas 'dus pa'i skye 'gro rnams la chos dang zang zing gi 12char gyis tshim par mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje 78—707

phag ①mo'i zhabs kyi chu skyes kyi rdul la reg pa shākya'i sras po rgyal ba'i sde'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong dharma ②yon tan gyis mnyan ①cing bsgyur ba'o// //phyis gang zag chos kyi spyan can dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje'i bka'i tshul dang yang bstun te zhu ④gtugs legs par byas so/ /mkha' mnyam bde rdzogs sna tshogs sprul pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /des gsungs dri med sna tshogs gdul bya'i bsam dbang gis/ /gsung gcig gis kyang sna tshogs don mang ston pas dpyad pa dka'⑤/ /de ltar yin yang ji ltar mi bdag shing rta cher zhugs nasal/ /g.yul ngor 'jug dus rkang gis bgrod rnams 'thab par mi brtson nam//de bzhin sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyi rjes 'brangs pas⑥/ /kho bos gzhan don nus pa (7min na'ang zhu)phan pa'i bsam pas bsgyur/ /'di la gzhung dang zhu)bla ma'i tshem yin tshomarang gi blo gros skyon gyis ni/ /sgra don 'gal bar gyur pa bcom ldan dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bstan dga'i lha rnams mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par rigs/ /'di las thob pa'i dge ba dri med cung zad des/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob gyur cig /bdag gis srol btod tsam 'di la/ /sgra don 'jug pa mkhyen rnams kyi/ge / /skad gnyis smra bas gzigs pa na/ /skyon du gyur snang bcos par zhu/ /phrag dog sgo nas mi 'phya hunyezhing / /rjes su yi rang ba yang mdzod/ / rdzogs so'i bla78—708

0398thug /dpal bde mchog 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/4)༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā sasbra ro da ya (getan+t+ra rā dzā sprinā ma/bod skad du/ dpal bde mchog zhesa'abyung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung ⑤dang /thugs rdo rje 56btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la 7rabazhugs 2te/ 'phags pa dga' bo la sogs pa 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyis bskor cing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug bye ba phrag brgyad cu'i rigedabus su phyag na rdo rje la gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad pa dang /phyag na rdo rje stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ kye rnam pa kun mchog sdom pa yim/ /bskyed 78—774

pa'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid dang / /rdzogs pa yang ni ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan lha las mnyan ①par 'tshal/ /rlung dang me dang chu dang sa/ /de bzhin nam mkha' ji ltar lags/ /rnam pa lnga ni ji ltar lha/ /gtso bo yul drug de bzhin ci/ /phyi dang nang du gnas pa yi/ /sku gsum byin rlabs (5)ji lta bu/ /lha yi sku ni ji ltar lags/ /gtso bos de bzhin lha mo gsungs/ /zla ba nyi ma ci ( stezhig lha/ /lam lnga po ni ji ltar lags/ /lus kyi rang bzhin ji lta bu/ /de bzhin rtsa yi gzugs ni ci/ /rtsa yi grangs kyi tshad ni du/ /de bzhin lus kyi gong bu ci/ /sbas pa'i dazlo tshig gi ni brda/ /gtso bos bdag la bshad du gsol / /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi/ /gnas la sogs pa'i brda du (4)zhig /ji ltar sa la sogs pa 'thob/ /mtshan ma ji ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /khyod (5)kyi las ni bcu gnyis gang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa ji ltar 'gyur/ /bgrang phreng dag ni ji ltar rigs/ /bzlas pa'i grangs ni du zhig lags/ /lha yi rnam pa'i rnal 'byor ci/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba du zhig mchis/ /sngags kyi dngos grub ci zhig lha/ /gzhon nu ma yi mchod pa ci/ /bya dang bya min nyi ma gang / /gtso bo myos byed gtor ma ci/ /bdud rtsi lnga sogs ji ltar lha/ /lcags kyu lnga sogs ji ltar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba bshad du gsol/ /thig gdab pa ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar sa ni yongs su sbyang / /srung rte'uba'i 'khor lo ji ltar 'gyur / /slob dpon gyi ni bya ba gang / /ji ltar slob ma yongs su gzung / /dbang bskur ba yi grangs ni du/ /bzhi pa yang ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /dus kyi nges pa ji lta bu/ /de bzhin 'chi ba blu 77ba gang / /dus bzhi'i ming ni du zhig mchis/ /gling bzhi pa ni ji ltar lags/ /dus dang dus min dngos grub ci/ /78—775

spyod pa ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ni du/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /mdo sde'i grangs ni ji lta bu/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa du/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg mchod sbyin dang / /sngags kyi dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur/ /bcud kyis 6)len ni ji ltar lha(ge/ /myos byed btung ba ji ltar 'gyur/ /gsang sngags ji ltar ①'byung 'gyur lha/ /sngags btu ba ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /tshar gcad (4)pa ni ci zhig lha(de/ /gtso bo rjes gzung ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan de nyid rnams ni ci/ /stong pa nyid dang snying rje gang / /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin ci/ /ji ltar de bzhin nyid rang bzhin/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs shes pa'i/ /sgom (6)pa'i mtshan nyid gtso bos gsungs/ /dpal bde mchog 'byung ba'i rgyud las zhus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje gsang ba 'byung ba 'di zhus pa legs so legs so/ /de nas de'i phyir skyed (7pa yi/ /rim pa'i sgom (depa yang dag bshad(9na/ /sna tshogs las kyi rang bzhin gyisam/ /skye gnas bzhi po rnams su 'gyur/ /sgong skyes mngal nas skyes pa dang / /drod gsher dang ni rdzus skyes rnams/ /ngang pa khrung khrung rma bya dang / /ne tso bzhad sogs tīsgong skyes te/ /glang po ma he ba lang rta'i/ /bong bu mi sogs mngal nas skyes/ /srin bu 'bu hunyedang phye ma leb/ /nya la risogs pa drod gsher skyes/ /lha dang dmyal ba'i sems can rnams/ /de bzhin bar do'i srid pa dang ④/ /bskal pa dang po pa la sogs/ /'di rnams rdzus 8skyes sems can no/ /shar gyi lus 'phags ba tshelang spyod/ /de bzhin byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /gling gsum po yi mi 78wa 776

rnams ni/ /longs spyod chen pos yang dag 'tsho/ /blun rmongs bye brag mi phyed cing ske/ /rtog med rnam par dpyod 0)med pa'o/ / 'dzam bu ((gling du legs skyes pa①/ /las kyi sa par rab tu grags/ /legs byas nyes par byas pa'i lasal/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma rnams/ /skye ba sngon gyi rnam smin 'dir/ /skye bo rnams la snang bar 'gyur(ge/ /rgyags dang ser sna gdug sems rnams/ /g.yo sgyu ⑤mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang / /chags sdang gti mug la sogs kyis/ /rims dang nad la sogs pas gzir/ / 'dzam bu (6)gling pa'i gtso bo mchog /yul dbus su ni skyes pa ste/ /sngon gyi dge ba la ltos nas/ /dbang po rno 'bring rtul por 'gyur/ /mi ru skyes pa 'bras bu'i dam pa dang po ste/ /rang gi khyim nas nges 'byung rnyed pa gnyis pa yin/ /rab tu byung nas dge ba sgrub (7pa gsum pa ste/ /rtse gcig yid ni thob par gyur pa bzhi par gsungs/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /mi rnams 2kyis rab mi shes te/ /thog med dus kyi nyon mongs kyi/ /bag chags rab tu bsags byas pas/ /de phyir sngon byas las kyis ni/ /skye dang 'chi ba yang dag 'byung / /tshogs pa ma rnyed de srid du/ /zhag bdun bar do'i srid par gnas/ /srid pa bar do'i sems can ni/ / 'gron po'i ⑨bgrod pa ji bzhin du/ /'di ltar las kyi zhags pa yis 'gro ba drug tu rab tu skye/ /pha ma'i kun du sbyor sogs ni/ /sred ⑩pa'i skye bos mthong gyur 7nas/ /rta la zhon bzhin rnam shes ni/ /rlung gi bzhon ⑩pa zhon ⑫nas su/ /skad cig thang cig nyid la ni/ /shin tu myur bar 'ongs gyur thunas/ /shin tu dga' dang bcas stobs kyis/ /kha yi lam nas 'jug par 'gyur/ /rtsa ni stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /rab bskul 8de yi skad cig la/ / ā li kā ⑩78—777

li zhu byas pas/ /mchog tu dga' ba yang dag 'thobasti/ /khu ba khrag de'i dbus su ni/ /thig le'i gzugs kyis yang dag gnas/ /dang po'i rnam pa nur nur po/ /mer mer po ni gnyis pa yin/ /ltar ltar por ②skyes gsum pa ste / /de bzhin bzhi pa gor gor po/ /rlung rnams kyis ni bskul tsam gyis/ /sha yi rnam pa lta bur 'gyur/ /zla ba lngar (5)gyur sa bon las/ /yan lag lnga ni rab tu skye/ /zla ba bdun na skra rtso)dang spu/ /sen mo rtags ni skye bar 'gyur/ /zla ba brgyad na dbang po dang / /lus kyi yan lag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zla ba dgu na yang dag rdzogs/ /zla ba bcu na sems dang ldan/ /nur nur rang bzhin mi bskyod pa/ /mer mer po ni rin chen 'byung / /'od dpag med mgon ltar ltar zhepo/ /gor gor po ni don yod grub/ /mkhrang gyur (6༄rnam par snang mdzad de/ /rnam pa lngar ni bstan pa yin/ /dri chu khrag ni mi bskyod pa / /sa bon rang bzhin 'od dpag med/ /gong bu rin chen 'byung ldan te/ /ro gcig 'dres pa rnam snang bzhugs/ /skye gnas dbus su rtsa gnyis te⑦/ /g.yas dang g.yon na de bzhin gnas/ /g.yon nas khu ba zhes bshad de/ /g.yas nas de bzhin khrag yin no/ /de dag gcig tu 'dus gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin no/ /las kyi sa bon dbang thob pas/ /rlung gis yang dag bsgyur nas su/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas sgo ru ni/ /gdong ni nges par phyogs par 'gyur/ /dku (8dgayas su ni brten nas su/ / tsog pur ⑨mngon par phyogs te gnas/ /dku tsogayon yang dag brten nas ni/ /shes rab stor ni mngon phyogs 'gyur/ /mkhas pas sa bon ltung skoba'i rim/ /dus kyi skad cig yang dag mtshon/ /g.yas na 7rlung ni rgyu ba gang / /thams cad du ni skyes 78—778

bur 'gyur/ /g.yon nas rlung ni rgyu ba gang / /nges par bud med rnams su 'gyur / / gnyis ku'i dbus ①rgyu'i sa bon gang / /rtag tu ma ning 'gyur ba'o//chu khams pha yir shes par bya/ /me yi khams ni ma yi'o(ba/ /pags (kyepa sha dang khrag rnams ni/ /ma las skyes zhes bshad pa ste/ /rgyus pa rkang dang khu ba rnams / /pha las skyes zhes (4skabashad pa yin/ /drug po 'di dag bsdus pa'i lus / /rdo rje sems dpas gang gsungs pa/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang ske/ /'du byed rnam shes de bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi rang bzhin du/ /phung po nges par skye ba yin/ /srid pa skyed (snyedapa'i rim shes pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob bya'i 6)phyir/ /'di ni phung po yongs mkhyen pa'i/ /de nyid gsungs pa ⑦rnams kyis bshad/ /'di ni skyed 90pa'i rim pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par dbye ⑨ba ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas gang zhig shes tsam gyis/ /myur du dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'i/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bsgom ⑩pa ni/ /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim bsgrubs pas/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs so/ /dbang po dman pas skyed 7rim gyi/ /dkyil 'khor bsgom 8zhing bsam par bya /dbang po rnon pos skad cig gir+shaste/ /rnam pas sems tsam dkyil 'khor bsamacha/ /skad cig rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni8/ /khams gsum gzhal yas khang bdag nyid/ /srog chags rnams ni dkyil 'khor pa / /de dbus skad cig rnam pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po rnal 'byor 78wa 779

ba'o / /oṃ āḥrgyu gi sngags kyis ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /mtho ris sa stengs ①sa 'og tu/ /skad cig gis ni sku gcig 'gyur/ /skad cig rnam pas rnal 'byor te/ /skad cig rnam pas gsang sngags 'don/ /dbang po kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba mchog /khams bzhi pa dang phung po lnga/ /de bzhin yul drug bdag nyid ni/ /khrag 'thung ②lha mo'i ye shes te/ /de la tha dad mi brtag go/ /dkyil 'khor de bzhin nyid rgyas btab / /de bzhin mkha' mnyam stong pa nyid/ /sna tshogs de bzhin nyid bdag medani / /thabs ni snying rje'i stobs yin te/ /zung du 'jug pa rnam rtog bral/ /dkyil 'khor snying po mchog yin no/ /rnam par mi rtog sbyor bsams kyang / /de tshe mi rtog bsam mi khyab/ /de yang rnam pa kun gyi mchog /bde ba'i dbang po rnam pa med/ /de nyid dngos dang dngos min bdag /rtag tu ⑥srid pas 'byung bar mdzad/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i rtog pa med/ /rtag tu 'byung ba bde ba che/ /skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /de las skye ba yang dag 'byung / /bems rgyapo min phyir bdag nyid rig /mi shes rnam par mi mthong bas/ /gzugs med gang du'ang mi gnas ⑥shing / /'gyur ba med phyir ⑦brtan pa'o/ /kun rdzob skye ba 'byung bas na/ /chad pa min phyir dngos med min/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang dngos su/ /chos rnams thams cad lhan cig skyes/ /bdag byin brlab pa rang ni'abyung ba/ /mi shigs 'jig ⑨pa med pa ste/ /skye ba med pa'i ro myong bas/ /sgom pa yang ni de nyid de/ /stong nyid so sor rtogs pas na / /bsam gtan shes rab tu yang 'gyur/ /chos kun yongs su shes pa yi/ /sgom ⑩pa de nyid sgom zhunyemed pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde ba che/ /phyag rgya 78—780

chen po mchog de bzhin/ /de nyid chos la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /de rnams ①dbye bas rab bstan pa/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis/ /gsal bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /e baṃ yi ge la rab gnas/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi lasarin/ /rnam kun mchog gi sdom pa'o/ /sdom pa byang chub bde mchog ste((/ /bltar med brjod du med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /'dus pa bde ba'i (4mchog yin te/ /bdag byin brlab (gepa'i rim pa 'di/ /bla ma'i drin gyis gsal bar 'gyur/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //de nas de phyir 'byung ba bzhi'i/ /mtshan nyid yang dag (6)bshad par bya/ /dngos po dag ni ma lus gang / /de ni 'byung ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sa de la ni dngos po brten⑦/ /mes ni thams cad 'tshed par byed/ /chu yis 'jig par 'u)byed pa ste/ /rlung gis lhan cig skyod tshoshe)par byed/ /nam mkha' yul gyis stong par gnas/ /der ni thams cad de las skye / /gang du gcig ni gnas pa der / /bzhi po kun kyang nye bar gnas/ /rtswa 11shing ljon pa tshe'akhril shing sogs//bems 8po lta bu'i rnam shes tsam/ /gang dag 'gro drug sems can rnams/ / tshigs dang tshigs ni thams cad du/ /lirnam shes bcas pa lta bur gnas/ /de ltar srid pa'i dngos po kun/ /blo dang ldan pas shes par bya/ /sems can rnams ni 'chi ba na/ /yan lag nying lag thams cad kyi/ /rlung ni thams cad bskyod par 'gyur/ /skad cig de la me drod 'dor/ /chu ni rtag tu skams ⑫gyur nas/ /de nas tshor ba med par 'gyur/ /lus la sogs pa'i sa khams kyi//78—781

sra ba nyid tsam gnas par 'gyur/ /skye ba dang ni 'chi ba dag /thams cad ①du ni 'byung bar 'gro/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams ni/ /'byung ba med par skye mi 'gyur / /lha yi 'jig rten skyong la sogs/ /thams cad la ni lhan cig gnas/ /rig byed grub mtha' thams cad kyi(mi/ /rtag tu 'dod cing bsgom ①pa ste④/ /gang phyir thams cad kun du 'gro/ /sa stengs ⑤skyes bu ⑥kun la gnas/ /'byung ba bzhi po gtso bo mchog /bstan bcos kun las yang dag bshad/ /rlung ni srog tu yang dag blta/ /me ni 'tsho ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /chu ni bdud rtsi'i ngo bo nyid/ /sa ni zhing tsam nyid 9)du gnas/ /de la rtag tu gnas pa'i lha / /rnam shes mchog gi dbang phyug ste/ /lha lnga yi ni rnam pa ru/ /rnam shes de ni yongs su 'gyur/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /de bzhin 'du byed rnam par shes/ /me long lta bu mnyam nyid dang / /so sor ⑧kun du rtog pa dang ske/ /de bzhin bya ba grub ponyepa dang / /chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag ste/ /ye shes 'di dag rab tu gnas/ /rnam snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung / /'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /de bzhin mi bskyod pa tshunyid de⑩/ /rnam lnga 0ro gcig rdzogs byang chub/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya chos de bzhin/ /yul drug tu ni shes bya ste/ /'di dag rnam par dag par bshad/ /khams ni bcwa 0brgyad shes bya ste/ /de dag phung po'i rang bzhin nyid/ /yi ge mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'thob ④bya'i phyir/ /mig sal sogs pa bsgom bya ste/ /mig gi dbang po'i rnam shes ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul yin/ /ngo bo nyid gsum rnam dag don/ /'od gsal ba yi go 'phang 'gyur/ /sgra dang rna ba rnam shes ni/ /dmigs pa med 78—782

pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sna dang dri dang rnam shes kyang / /de bzhin rnam dag shes par bya/ /ro dang lce dang rnam shes ni/ /don dam nyid du rnam par dag /lus dang reg bya rnam shes kyang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i ngo bor skyes/ /yid dang chos dang yid rnam shes/ /snying po nyid du rnam par dag /rnam shes drug ni kun gzhi ru/ /'jug pas de bzhin gshegs pa yin/ /'od gsal ba yi go 'phang thob / /he ru ka dpal yang dag gnas/ /yul dang yul can sbyor ba yis/ /rnam rtog med pa'i go 'phang 'gyur/ /rnam pa 1)kun gyi mchog gnas pas/ /yul ni rnam dag shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /gcig la de bzhin gsum du brtags②/ /skyabs gsum dang ni de nyid gsum/ /sku gsum rnam par grol ba nigasum/ /zhal gsum yig gsum lha gsum stesnyi/ /khams gsum pa yi rang bzhin nyid/ /dkyil 'khor gsum dang rnal 'byor gsum / /lam dugasum du ni bstan pa ste/ /dam tshig gsum dang dge ba gsum / /de bzhin sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /shes rab dang ni thabs nyid dang ske/ /de yi sbyor ba gsum pa ste/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas rang bzhin gyis/ /ji ltar gsang gsum mthong ba dang / /'khor gsum mi dmigs sbyor ba yis/ /sngags gsum gyi ni rang bzhin nyid/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi/ /rtsa gsum gyi ni rang gi dngos/ /phyi rol 'jig rten pa yi (7chos/ /lha la sogs pa'i bdag nyid nang / /phyi nang dag pa nyid kyi phyir/ /rnal 'byor pas ⑦ni sangs rgyas 'thobarjo/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du/ /lha ni mngon sum dmigs par bya/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog rang bzhin/ /lha mor yongs su brtag par bya/ /dang po'i lha yi rang bzhin du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ⑨rnam 78—783

par bzhugs/ /gnas dang zhing la sogs pa'i bad①/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i la'adus pa/ /de bzhin gnyis med mnyam sbyor la(gu/ /lha rnams yang dag 'phro ba ste/ /tshad med lha ④ni 'phro ba las/ /dkyil 'khor tshad can rnam par brtag /lha yi rnal 'byor bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas rol pa'ang bsam mi khyab / /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /he ru ka dpal yang dag sbyor/ /de dag mi phyed ngo bo nyid/ /bsgom (gepar nga yis bshad pa yin/ /de dag thams cad gnyis med thob/ /gzung dang 'dzin dang rnam bral ba/ /rags pa sgra zhes bshad pa ste/ /phra ba sems kyi rang bzhin 'gyur⑥/ /bsam dang bral ba'i de nyid ni/ /go 'phang mchog ces yongs su grags/ /'di ni 'byung ba bzhi dang rnam pa lnga dang / yul drug lha'i rnam par dag pa rim par phye ba ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas zla ba nyi ma yi/ /rab tu dbye ba yang dag bshad/ /g.yas dang g.yon du sbyor ba yis/ /rim pa ji bzhin rgyu ba ste/ /g.yon du rkan nas bzung nas ni/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'jug pa'i/ /zla ba'i rtsa ni 'og bltas parag / /ā li zla bar yang dag 'bab/ /g.yas su lte ⑧ba nas bzung nas/ /rkan gyi gnas su rab 'jug pa'i/ /nyi ma'i rtsa khani steng bltas 8te/ /kā li nyi mar rtag tu 'bab/ /sna yi sgo ni gnyis po nas/ /rtsa gnyis rgyu ba'i mtshan nyid ni / /rtsa g.yon 'jug pa'i lam yin te/ /g.yas pa 'byung ba'i lam yin no/ /nyi shar nas brtsams ji srid de/ /nub kyi bar ni nyin mo ste/ /nub pa hunyenas brtsams ji srid de/ /shar ba'i bar ni mtshan mor 'gyur/ /nyin dang mtshan 78—784

mo zhag yin te/ /mel tshe ①thun zhes brjod pa yin/ /thun bzhi nyin mor shes bya ste/ /de bzhin mtshan mo'ang thun bzhi'o/ /zhag gcig la ni 'pho ba yi /yan lag bcu drug rnams yin te/ /thun ni phyed phyed rtag tu rlung / /sna yi bu gar yang dag rgyu/ /yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas bzung lanas/ /nyin zhag gsum gyi thun phyed la/ /zla ba'i rlung ni rgyu ba ste/ /de nas zhag gsum nyi ma'i rlung / /go rims ③'dis ni ji srid du/ /yar tshes bcwa byalnga'i bar du'o/ /mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas bzung na⑤/ /nyin zhag gsum gyi 6)snga dro ni/ /nyi ma'i rlung du grags pa rgyu/ /de bzhin tshes ni bcwa ⑨lnga'i bar/ /thun re yi ni bzhi cha rnams//chu tshod du ni brjod pas na/ /nyin zhag gcig la rtsa rnams ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis shes par bya/ /nyin zhag gcig la dbyug (8)gu yi/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i tshad kyis ni/ /rtsa dang chu tshod phyed dbyug gu/ /thun gyi brgyad cha zhes su bshad/ /sna sgo'i rlung ni 'byung 'jug la/ /dbugs gcig tu ni rab tu grags/ /rlung khyagi sbyor ba la mkhas pas/ /dbugs drug srog tu shes par bya/ /srog ni 0lnga bcu tham pa dang / /dbugs gsum rkang pa'ang de dang ldan/ /nyi ma byang du rgyu dus kyi/ /nyi ma dang po'i dbyug 7gu yin/ /nyi ma lhor ni rgyu nya dus kyis / /mtshan mo yang ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /dbyug 0gu re re'i 'phel 'grib ni//dus kyi dbye bas 8shes par bya/ /dbugs ni drag tsopo bzhi char bcas 'pho ba so so'i 'phel 'grib yin/ /dbugs kyi sum cha ⑩de'i bzhi cha'i/ /drug chas nyi ma re rer 'gyur/ /thun ni phyed phyed rgyu ba las/ /phyin ci log tu 'phos gyur na8/ /rtsod pa la sogs nges 'gyur bas/ /mkhas pas 'di dag yang dag brtag /nyi ma gcig gnyis gsum dang bzhi/ /lnga dang drug tu 7gang 78—785

tshe rlung / /phyin ci log tu rtag rgyu na/ /de tshe rtsod pa chen por 'gyur/ /zla phyed rtag tu log par rgyu/ /nad ni chen po yang dag 'byung / /zla ba gcig tu log par rgyu/ /snying sdug gnyen ni brlag par 'gyur/ /phyed dang gnyis su log par rgyu/ /zla ba drug na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /thun mong dus su shes par bya/ /gzhan yang khyad par bshad bya ste/ /mnyam po bdun 0)du nyi ma song / /gang tshe skye ba'i nyin zla ba/ /de tshe rgyas pa zhes bya'i dus/ /'chi ba'i nges pa'i dus yin no/ /mi ni khyim gang las skyes pa/ /gang zhig gzhan yang bdun de'i phyir//der ni nyi ma mnyam bdun song (5)/ /mnyam po bdun zhes bya bar bshad/ /nyi ma'i lam nas thams cad du/ /rlung ni rtag tu rgyu ba dag /rgyun mi 'chad par yang dang yang / /mkhas pas dus ni mtshon par bya/ /dus kyi skad cig gang la rlung ske/ /bgrod pa gzhan du 'jug 'gyur na/ /dus de'i skad cig rdzogs pa na//'chi 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /nyin (0phyed dang por byas te nyi ma rdzogs dang de bzhin nyin zhag gcig gi bar/ /de las zhag gnyis zhag gsum dang ni de bzhin zhag ni (4na bzhi yi 5gebar dag tu/ /rlung ni gang zhig rtsa la brten 6)te g.yon (7pa min pa'i nyi ma'i lam nas rgyu/ /de las sa dang nyi ma phyogs dang bkra shis drug bzhi 'di dag shes par bya/ /lnga nas nyi shu rtsa lngar nyin zhag 'di dag lnga lngar spel bas bgrod par 'gyur/ /de las re res spel bas bcu ni sum 'gyur ji srid gsum gyis lhag (nyepa'i bar/ /de las rgyas pa'i dus su gsum mig zla ba'i lo dang drug gsum zung zla'i zla/ /lhag ma tshes dang phyogs mda' yon tan zung dang zla ba'i zhag tu 'tsho ba yin/ /re'u mig sum cu bdun bcas pa'i / /'khor lo rim gsum bris nas ni/ /tshe dang srog gi rlung dag dang / /78—786

nyin zhag mtshan ma rim bzhin bri/ /zhag lnga nas ni nyi shu lnga'i/ /bar bar gyi ni nyin zhag la/ /grangs ni bcu drug ma bshad gang / /de rnams tshang bar brjod par bya/ /zhag ni drug bdun brgyad dgu yi/ /rim pas gal te rlung rgyu na / /yon tan ldan yang nyin zhag ni/ /nyer bzhis ma tshang lo gsum na'o1)/ /drag po nyi ma yan lag sa'i/ /zhag ni rim pas rgyu na ni/ /yon tan ldan pa'ang nyin zhag ni/ /nyer bzhis ma tshang lo gnyis na'o/ /zhag ni bcu drug de bzhin du/ /bcu bdun dang ni bcwa tshon brgyad dang / /bcu dgu yi ni rim pa yis / /rlung rgyu yon tan can yang zhag /bcu gnyis gnyis 'gyur ma tshang ba'i / /lo gcig na ni skyabs med gang / /de ni gshin rje'i grong khyer du/ /the tshom med par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma nyi shu gcig gnyis gsum/ /nyer bzhi'i rim pas rlung rgyu na/ /yon tan ldan pa'ang zhag drug ni/ /ma tshang zla ba drug na 'chi/ /re'u mig sum cu gnyis ldan pa'i/ /rim gnyis 'khor lo bris nas ni/ /der ni tshe dang (0yan lag rlung / /grangs kyi mtshan ma rim bzhin bri//'chi ba'i rtags ni 'di dag kun/ /rnam pa thams cad shes byas nas/ /blo ldan 'chi ba blu bab yis/ /gal te brten 5pa'i go 'phang 'dod/ /rtsa ni yang dag sbyang byas pas/ /de srid rlung ni sbyang 6'gyur te/ /so so'i rim bzhin rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dang yang du mnan par bya/ /g.yon pa'i bu gar bcug nas ni/ /rtsa ni bsdams nas mnan bya zhing / /de bzhin du ni g.yas par 3)rlung / /bkug ste nasadal bus mnan 94par bya/ /sems can rnams kyi zhag gcig la/ /rgyu ba'i dbugs 7kyi grangs kyi tshul/ /brgya phrag drug gis lhag pa yi/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig go/ /dbang chen gyis ni rgyal srid de/ /chus 78—787

ni don rnams 3)yang dag 'byung / /me yi rlung ni rnam rgyu bas②/ /bkres skom dub (5)dang sdug bsngal nad/ /bya ba thams cad nyams 'gyur zhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa (snyamachog gis gsungs/ /rlung gis ⑤rtsod dang skyo yidang rmongs/ /nor nyams nyon ni mongs par byed/ /dbang chen nor dang 'bru la sogs/ /rnyed pa thob dang sdud byed pa'o/ /chu yi rlung ni rnam rgyu bas/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub kun byed pas/ /de yi sbyor ba mchog gtso bor/ /rdo rje sems dpas ⑦gang gsungs pa'o/ /rlung ni bcom ldan he ru ⑧ka'i/ /rang bzhin nyid de gsum (9༄du 'gyur/ /g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin te/ /g.yas pa snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /gnyis po mi phyed sbyor ba ⑩yang / / gnyi ga hunyenas ni rnam par rgyu / /de bas de nyid rig pas der8/ /dge mi dge sogs shes par bya/ /dug sogs gzhom dang lhag ma ni/ /bkra shis dpal ni bskyed pa la/ /shes rab bdag nyid rab tu bsngags/ /rtag tu dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /g.yul bsham rol rtsed ston mo dang / /gcad zhu)pa dang ni dbug pa dang / / bsreg dang rngubatso ba'i las la ni/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid rab tu bsngags/ /gzhan yang gnyis bdag rdo rje can/ /the tsom 8'gyur bar shes bya ste/ /dge dang mi dge nges med par/ /rlung rig pas ni 'dir mtshon 8bya/ /mgon po ji ste ā ⑩lir rgyu/ /'ga' zhig kā malir gnas 'dri 'am/ /kā ⑩li'i rgyu la ā du )lir gnas/ /de yi 'dod don nyams par 'gyur/ /gang nas mgon po de rgyu ba / /der gnas 'ga' zhig 'dri byed na/ /de yi don kun yang dag 'grub/ / gnyi gar zhusheganas las the tshom ( snye'agyur/ /rlung gi bdag nyid kyis mgon po'i/ /sku gsum por yang shes par bya/ /'jug pa chos kyi sku yin te/ /gnas pa 78wa 788

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /'byung ba sprul pa'i sku zhes bshad/ /'di dag sku ni gsum por bzhed/ /'dri ba po'am rang gi'ang rung / /chos skus thams cad dge ba ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs pas lho)the tshom 'gyur/ /sprul pas 'thab mor ston pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yi srog rtsol ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bor gnas / /g.yon dang g.yas kyi gnas gang na/ /rim pa ji bzhin rnam par rgyu(kye / /g.yas nas rnam par rgyu ba'i 'od/ /me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /nags 0kyi me tog lta bu'i mdog /de ni 'od dpag med pa'i lha/ /g.yon nas rnam par rgyu ba'i 'od/ /rtag tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /kha dog ljang gu (geltar snang ba/ /lha ni don yod mchog yin no/ /gnyi ga nas ni rgyu ba'i 'od/ /gser gyi 'od ltar snang ba ste/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor gyi ni rlung / /rtag tu rin chen 'byung ldan rgyu/ /'og nas dal bar rab rgyu ba(5/ /kun+da zla ba lta bur dkar / /chu yi yidakyil 'khor rgyu ba ste/ /'od chen rdo rje mgon po'o/ /lus kun la ni rjes 'gro'i rlung / /sems kun rab tu 'jug byed pa/ /mgon po rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /'byung bar rab tu grags pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mnyam gzhag 9)pas/ /'jug pa'i rlung ni bgrang bar bya/ /ji srid 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs/ /sgra dang bral bar rtag tu bzla/ / sgrub pos 2sgra dang bral bar ni/ /'bum bzlas yongs su rdzogs pa/na/ /tshe nyams pa yang lo lnga ru/ /'tsho bar 'dir ni the tshom med/ /rtag tu nang par langs nas rlung / /stong phrag gcig 6)tu bgrang bya ste/ /de bas rlung gi rnal 'byor la/ /rtag tu mnyam gzhag ⑩gnas par bya/ /yang na bum pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag tu 'chi bdag las rgyal bya/ /bdag nyid rig pas rkang /lhamathil bar/ /kun du rlung 78wa 789

gis dgang 51bya ste/ /bum pa can la brtan (5)byas nas/ /dbye ba gsum gyis gzhom ( par bshad/ /tha ma sum cu (partsa drug tsam/ /de yi nyis 'gyur 'bring de bzhin / /sum 'gyur chen por shes bya ste/ /bum pa can des rgyal bar bya/ /bum pa can sngar 55)shes byas nas/ /bdag nyid skyil mo krung (6)bcas te/ /lag pa lan gsum mnyes nas ni/ /de nas lan drug se (7)gol brdab/ /ji srid sum cu 58)rtsa drug bar/ /de srid bum pa can gyis bya/ /sum 'gyur chen pos gzhom pa ni/ /brgya 9kyilas rtsa brgyad lhag pas so/ /brtan pa'i go 'phang 'dod pas ni/ /brtson pas de nyid kyis rgyal bya/ /bum pa'i sbyor bas rgyal bas na/ /'chi bdag las ni ring du 'jug /bum pa can ni shes byas nas/ /'gog la brtan par gnas pa na/ /de la bskal pa stong du yang / /'chi bdag nye bar 'ong mi 'gyur/ /snying gi 7chu skyes dbus son rlung / /hūṃ yig dkar po'i rnam par ni/ /gang gis mnyam par gzhag nyu)bsams na/ /de la yul sogs dmigs mi 'gyur/ /rlung gis 'khor ba'i steng du 'gro/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og tu bgrod/ /snying ga /2yi ni chu skyes la/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das par gnasal/ /steng dang 'og tu rgyu ba'i rlung / /kha sbyar du ni yid kyis tu byas/ /de yi sbyor bas goms byed na/ /des ni brtan pa'i go 'phang 'thob57/ /rlung gi rnal 'byor mi shes pa'am/ /gang zhig shes kyang mi byed pa/ /de ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal tshogs/ /du mas gtses pa'i srin bur 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'gro dang 'ong ba'i rlung / /blo dang ldan pas brtag 'bya ste/ /rlung gis thams cad byin gyis brlabasaris/ /rlung ni kun du 'gro 'gyur ba'o/ /'di ni zla ba dang nyi ma'i man ngag gi rim par phye ba ste lnga pa'o// //78wa 790

de nas lam lnga bzang po mchog /rnam par nges par rab bshad bya/ /bdag gzhan don ni phun tshogs pa'i/ /sgrub pos dge dang mi dge brtag /me dang rlung ni nyid dag dang / /de bzhin dbang chen dang ni chu'i/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag rgyu ba las/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /de bzhin bsad ①dang bskrad pa yi/ /mtshan nyid mkhas pas brtag par bya/ /de yi sbyor ba mi shes pa/ /de ni ngal ba don med 'gyur/ /mes ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba ste/ /rlung gis nor rnams nyams par 'gyur/ /dbang chen gyis ni rgyal srid 'gyur/ /chus ni nor dang 'bru rnams ster(2)/ /g.yas pa nas ②ni rgyu ba'i khams/ /byin za'i dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba ni/ /pad+ma'i mgon po'i 'byung ba'o/ /g.yon pa nas ni rgyu ba'i khams/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /kha dog ljang zhing gsal ba ni/ /las kyi mgon po'i (4)'byung ba'o/ /gnyi (geg nas ni rgyu ba'i khams/ /gser gyi mdog ltar gsal ba ni / /dbang chen dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /rin chen mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /dal zhing rgyu ba med pa'i khams/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /dag pa'i shel ltar snang ba ni/ /rdo rje mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /khams rnams kun ni yang dag bsdus/ /rten dang brten (6)pa'ang yang dag 'dzin/ /rnam snang mdzad ni rlung chen te/ /'chi ba'i lus las rnam par rgyu/ /rlung gi de nyid mi shes par/ /las dang las min mi 'grub ste ni/ /rlung ni thams cad bgrod 'gyur bas/ /rtog ge pa yis mi shes so/ /rlung gi de nyid sngon 'gro bas/ /sngags kyi de nyid bsgrub par bya/ /sems can rnams kyi srog gyur pa/ /rlung zhes bya ba las kun 78—791

byed / /'di ni rnam shes bzhon pa ste/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob byed pa/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi ①gsang ba ste/ /byang chub rgyu yi thabs yin no/ /'di ni lam lnga nges par bstan ②pa'i rim par phye ba ste drug pa'o// //de nas rtsa yi 'khor lo ni/ /rim pa bzhin du rab bshad bya/ /lus kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i rtsa/ /stong phrag bdun cu (brtsa gnyis 'gyur/ /rtsa rnams dang ni nye ba'i rtsa/ /de dag gnas la brten ④pa ste/ /brgya las nyi shu lhag pa'i rtsa/ /gtso bo zhes ni bya bar brjod/ /rtsa yi gnas dang yul rnams ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i grangs yin te/ /de rnams dbus kyi rtsa gsum gang / /thams cad khyab cing brten ridepa'o/ /mgor ⑥ni pul+lī (per yin te/ /so dang sen mo 'bab par ⑧gnas / /spyi gtsug dzā lan (mudha ra ste0/ /skra dang spu ni 'bab par gnas/ / o byen 7rna ba g.yas pa'i rtsa/ /pags 8pa dang ni dri ma 'bab/ /mgo rgyab ar bu da yin te/ /sha ni yang dag 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /go dā ba rī 0rna ba g.yon//rgyus pa yang dag 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /smin dbus ra me shwa rī ④ste/ /rtag tu rus pa 'bab pa'o/ /mig ni de bi 8ko ṭir gnas/ /mchin pa 'bab pa'i rtsa yin no/ /mā tshel ba ni dpung pa gnyis/ /snying la hunye'abab pa'i 8tsa gnas so/ /mchan tsokhung kā ma rū ( — )pa ste/ /rtag tu mig ni yi'abab pa'o/ /nu ma gnyis ni o ḍi ⑫ste / /rtag tu mkhris pa 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /tri sha ku ni 0lte ba ste/ /rtsa rdzini glo ba 'bab pas gnas/ /sna rtse ko sa la yin te/ / rgyu ma'i ⑤phreng ba 'bab pas gnas / /kha ni ka ling ga 3yin te/ /rtag tu gnye ma ri nye'abab pas gnas/ /mgrin pa lam pā 9ka yin te/ /rtag tu lto ba 'bab pa'i rtsa/ / kārtsi snying ga'i hunye78wa 792

gnas yin te/ /bshang ba 'bab pa'i rtsa yin no/ /mdoms ①bar hi ma la ya stel/ / mchog ma'i ②mtshams ni 'bab pa'i rtsa/ / tre ta ④bu ri mtshan ma ste/ /bad kun 'bab pa'i rtsa yin no/ /gri ha de ba tā ⑤bshang lam ste/ /rtag tu rnag ⑥ni 'bab pa'o/ /brla ⑦gnyis sau rāṣ+ṭa (nyeyin te/ /rtag tu khrag ni 'bab pa'o /byin pa gnyis ni gser gling gnas/ /rdul 'bab pa yi rtsa yin no/ /rkang pa'i sor mo na ga ra/ /rtag tu tshil 'bab rtsar ①shes bya/ /rkang pa'i bol ni sin dhu yi ste / /mchi ma 'bab pa'i gzugs can ma/ /ma ru de sha snyi/mthe bong 7ste/ /rtag tu mchil ma 'bab pas gnas/ /kuslu ata ni pus mo ste/ /rtag tu sna chu 'bab pas ④gnas/ /de dag dbus na gnas pa'i rtsa/ /la snyil nār ⑩ni gci ba ⑩'bab/ /g.yas su khrag ni 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /ra sa nā phonyezhes grags pa yin/ /dbus kyi char ni yang dag 'jug /snying ga'i shwe/chu skyes dbus son pa/ /chu shing snye ma'i me tog bzhin/ /'phyang ba kha ni thur du bltas/ /til gyi mar me ltar 'bar zhing / /byang chub sems ni mnyam 'bab de0 / /a ba dhū tīr 8)shes bya stedu / /lhan cig skyes pa ster byed pa'o/ / la la nā dul sogs pa'i rtsa ④ /rtsa rnams kun gyi gtso bo ste/ /de bas 'dir ni gzhan bsten ④pa/ /gang gā (nyesin dhur zhugazhan 'jug bzhin/ /gcig 3gyur kha kha 0mu kha ste/ /de nyid skye gnas gzhan ma yin/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rang bzhin gyis/ /lus la brten 0par shes par bya/ /bud med rnams la'ang gtso bo gsum/ / la la nā shurnyesogs rtsa rnams yin/ /shes rab rang bzhin la la nātha/ /ra sa nā 0ni thabs su gnas/ /dbus nas a ba dhū tī dusteni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam 0spangs pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku la la nās/ /ra sa nā so ni sprul pa'i sku/ /a ba 78—793

dhū tī 1)chos sku ste/ /sku gsum por ni bshad pa yin/ /rtsa rnams de dag thams cad ni/ /lus ni dge bar byed pa ste/ /de yi tshogs las yang dag byung ske/ /gong bu lha yi bdag nyid do/ /gzugs las 'das pa gong bur 'gyur//gong bu las 'das lha nyid de/ /de phyir bsam mi khyab sbyor bas/ /de bzhin nyid bdag kun du 'gro/ /sgrub pos cho ga gang gang gis/ /gong bu las 'das go 'phang gnas/ /des ni de yi bdag nyid du/ /gyur pas sangs rgyas nyid 'thob (kye'agyur/ /'di ni rtsa'i (gyi'akhor lo'i thabs rim par phye ba ste bdun pa'ol// //de nas gang zhig shes tsam gyis/ /myur du dngos grub 'gyur ba yi/ /dam tshig rnams kyang rim pa bzhin/ /yang dag par ni bshad par bya/ /rang gi khyim mam 9gegasang ba'i gnas/ /dben zhing yid ni dga' ba dang / /ri bo tshang tshing ri sul dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang ni/ /ma mo'i khyim dang dur khrod dam/ /chu bo 'dus pa'i dbus su ni/ /bla med 'bras bu 'dod pa yis / /dkyil 'khor yang dag bri bar bya/ /yon bdag dad pa chen po yis/ /zhing skyes gnas skyes sngags (55skyes ma'i/ /rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor pa/ /slob dpon lha kun spyan drang bya/ /khyim pa 'am ni dge tshul lam(phyin/ /de bzhin dge slong slob dpon dege/ /slob dpon kha cig 'jig rten pa/ / bstan la duganas pa'i dge slong ngam(9ci/ /kha cig yon tan ldan pa 'am/ /de bzhin mngon shes thob pa'ang rung / /'di rnams nang na yon bdag ni/ /gang la dad pas gtso mchog bya/ /slob dpon sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor dge ba bri 78—794

byas te/ /slob dpon dbang bskur yon tan ldan/ 'jig rten rnams kyis ma smad cing / /mi dge bcu yongs spangs pa ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i gtso bor bya / /rtag tu yon bdag blo ldan gyis/ /snying rje med cing khro dang gdug /khengs dang brkam chags bdag nyid bstod6)/ /mnyam par ma bzhag (gyigis mi bya / /gang zhig khyim gnas longs spyod bsten / /gshol 'dzugs dang ni tshong pa dang / /rmongs pas dam chos 'tshong ba ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i gtso bor min / /'di ltar yon tan kun ldan zhing / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dul zhing brtson 'grus yang dag ldan/ /sred pa med cing nga rgyal med/ /rtag tu sems can bsten par ni/ /ltos bcas rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /thod pa'i rgyan la dga' ba dang / /rdo rje dril bu mnyam ldan pa'i / /mkhas pas g.yon gyi phyogs su ni/ /g.yon pa'ang rab tu gzhag ④par bya / /'di ltar yon tan ldan slob dpon/ /las phyinams kun la rab tu bsngags / /rim pa ji bzhin slob dpon dang / /lha rnams spyan drang (5)byon pa la / /ji ltar rnyed pa'i dri chu yis/ /zhabs bkru bas ni gtsang byas nas/ /sa yongs brtags rtsonapa'i gnas su ni/ /slob dpon sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /rgan dang gzhon pa'i dbye ba bzhin/ /zhugs nas gdan la gnas par bya/ /skal ba med dang nga rgyal can/ /de bzhin bla ma smod pa dang / /dam tshig ma mthong rang gi bu/ /de bzhin skyes pa bud med rnams/ /sgrub po dngos grub 'dod pa yis / /dam tshig der ni gzhug mi bya/ /gal te phyugs ni de rnams zhugs/ /dngos grub ring du 'jug par 'gyur/ /dam tshig smad pas lus sems ni/ /sdug bsngal de bzhin gnas nyams dang / /dpal 18)las ring zhing sna tshogs 78—795

pa'i/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni nyer 'tsher 'gyur/ /de ltar shes nas spang bya ste/ /mchod pa'i spyod yul can rnams bsdu/ /rgan dang gzhon pa'i rim bzhin du/ /me tog bdug pa stimar me dang / /tsan+dan dris ni khyad par du/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag mchod bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /gtor ma slob dpon gyis rab brtag /lha ni bsnyen phyir mchod bya zhing / /yon bdag yid la 'dod pa yi/ /gang zhig zhi dang rgyas pa'i las/ /dngos grub don du bris (snyenas ni/ /gang gang mngon par 'dod pa yi/ /las de byin gyis brlab par bya/ /sbrang chang bur ②chang khur duba'i chang / /ji ltar rnyed ⑤pa dbul bar bya / /gtsang zhing dul dang dpa' ba'i sems/ /sred dang gti mug rnam par spangs / /thams cad mtshungs par lta ba ni/ /las kyi rdo rjer rab tu brtag /bza' dang bca' ⑥dang de bzhin btung / /so rtsi dang ni yon ⑦de bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun nyid du/ /yon bdag gis ni dbul bya zhing / /phyi nas las kyi rdo rje ni/ /mkhas pas rdzas rnams yongs su spyad/ /thog mar lcags kyu nimanyam ldan pa'i/ /dam tshig yongs su spyad par bya/ /de nas thams cad yongs rdzogs par/ /slob dpon gyis ni byin gyis brlab/ /gnas dang nye gnas 6)zhing dang ni/ /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa'o/ /dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma kun la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo rnams kyi tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des bshad gsung ni mchog tu tshad mar gyur pa ste/ /bden par gyur pa des na lha mo rnams kyis 'dir/ /bdag ni rjes su gzung ba'i rgyur ⑩ni 'gyur bar nyunyeshog /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor mdun du ni/ /snying gar 8thal mo rab sbyar te/ /yon bdag gis kyang smon lam ni/ /yongs 78—796
