su bsngo ba nyid du bya/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa 'joms/ /khyed kyi ①dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ /mgon po thugs rje chu yi ljid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus/ /bdag la mdzod (kyecig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi ro gcig gsol bas thugs ni rnam par dag pa ste/ /gnas la sogs pa'i yul du bgrod pas sku ni rnam par dag pa yini/ /dpal ldan gnas kyi dbus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchog gi ④mgon po ni/ /bla ma mchog la rtag tu mgo bos btud de gus pas phyag 'tshal lo / /dpa' bo kun gyi sku ni rtag tu mdzes pa ste/ /lha mo rnams kyi rin chen sku yis 'khyud pas brgyan/ /'khor lor ⑧gnas mgon lhan cig skyes dga' dri med pa'i/ /rnal 'byor snying po bde mchog la yang rtag phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun mkhyen shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas/ /lha mo rnams ni lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas kyis mdzes/ /'dren pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba 'byung ba ste / /dri med lhan cig skyes pa mchog la 6)bdag gaphyag 'tshal/ /tshigs bcad gsum gyis yang dag bstod/ /ji ltar bde ⑧bar phyag kyang btsalasti/ /yid spro ji ltar bde bar ni/ /ca co'i spro ba chen po yis/ /me tog phreng bas rnam ⑩brgyan cing / /sna tshogs me tog gis mchod lus/ /chang gi ston mo'i dga' bcas pas/ /rdo rje'i 0grus ni dgang 8bar bya/ /mchog tu dga' bas tshigar bya zhing / /gnas kyi mtshan ma'i ④stangs stabs gar/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis gar bya'o/ /der ⑩ni pa ṭa 8ha sogs dang / /cang te'u dang ni bkra shis rnga/ /rnga rings ⑩la sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /rol mo yid 'ong bsgrag snyi/par bya/ /he ru ka 78—797

bcas dpa' ①bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma mchog g.yon pa ste/ /de rjes tshogs kyi gtso bo yis/ /yon bdag gi ni dge ba bsam/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma 'dus pas/ /skad cig shis pa brjod pa sbyin/ /bde ba phun tshogs ldan pa dang ske/ /nad med pa dang dge ba'i sems/ /'dod dang grol sogs yang dag 'thob / /dngos grub phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par spros pa ni/ /cho ga bshad bzhin bsdu bar bya/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma bsdus nas ni / /'byung po 'tshol ②ba rnams la sbyin/ /gnas dang zhing gnas rnal 'byor ma'i / /tshogs la dri zhim (mitshim par bya/ /spyan drangs ④dpa' bo thams cad ni//bde ba chen por gshegs su gsol/ /'di ni dam tshig gi brda'i cho ga rim par phye ba ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i brda/ /cung zad tsam ni bshad bya ste/ /sgrub bupos gang zhig shes tsam gyis/ /myur du dngos grub 'gyur ba'o/ /gang zhig sor mo gcig ston pa/ /de la gnyis bstan legs 'ongs lanayi/ /gang zhig g.yon pa'i sor mo bsdamasal/ /bde 'am zhes pa'i rgyar shes bya/ /gang zhig ming med ston byed pa/ /de la mthe'u (kyechung bstan par bya/ /gang zhig gung mo ston byed pa/ /de la mthe bo ⑨bstan par bya/ /gang zhig srin lag ston byed pa'i / /de la mgrin pa rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig ba ti nyunyes ston pa/ /de la rtse gsum bstan par bya/ /gang zhig nu ma ston byed pa/ /de la skra tsomatshams bstan par bya/ /gang zhig so ni ston byed pa/ /de la 'khor lo bstan par bya/ /gang zhig khro gnyer ston byed pa/ /de la gtsug phud 8bstan par bya/ /gang 78—798

zhig dpral ba ston byed pa/ /de la rol pa bstan par bya/ /bud med gang zhig g.yon nas 'gro/ /rnal 'byor ma rtag 6)g.yon nas te/ /skad ni chen pos rab tu smra/ /g.yon pa'i lta bas rnam lta ②zhing / /bud med rnams la dgar smra ba/ /de ni dam tshig ldan shes bya/ /bud med rnams la gsol btab na/ /rigs kyi sa bon rab smra zhing / /rigs kyi bya ba mi 'dor la/ /rang gi rigs kyi rig pa zlos/ /gang zhig rig pa rnam par 'dri/ /lag pa g.yon pas rang gi mgor//mgo la 'phrug par byed pa dang / /sgrub pa pos ni khyad par du/ /de yi rang rig ③dran par 'gyur/ /mkhur ④ba 'am ni kos ko 'am/ /sna dag tu ni sor mo ston/ /zur gyis (5)lta bas dus rtag tuyi/ /rang gi rigs nga)la rnam par blta(kye / /bden 'byung 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rnyed dka' nges par dam tshig can/ /rang gi khyim du thod pa dang / /dgra sta ral gri rgyal mtshan dang / /'khor lo dang ni rnga yab dung (9)/ /rtse gsum bris nas dga' byed cing / /rtag tu sha dang chang la dga'/ /'jigs dang ngo tsha 'joms byed gang / /mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs 7yang dag 'byung / /lhan cig skyes ma zhes byar bshad/ /yul dang yul du mngon par skye/ /sgrub po rnams kyis rtag tu bsten/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /de bzhin zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / /tshan sto nyamanye ba'i tshan dho 8ha/ /'dus pa nye ba'i 'dus pa dang / /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod de8 / / 'dzam bu'i 8gling na yang dag gnas/ /gnas ni pul+lī rar 0grags te / /de bzhin dzā lan dha tshera'ang gnas/ / u byen ⑩de bzhin gnas yin te//de bzhin mar bu da tsoyang gnas/ /nye gnas go da ba rī narteste/ /de bzhin rā me du shwa ri'i ming / /de bi ko ṭir mngon brjod dang / /mā spel ba tsho g.yang nye ba'i 78wa 799

gnas / /zhing ni kā ma ru'i 6)ming can te/ /o drir (snyemangon par brjod pa'ang zhing ske/ /nye zhing tri sha ku ni ste(kye/ /ko sa lā yang gi༄nye ba'i zhing / /ka ling ga (5)dang lam pā ④ka'ang / /de bzhin tshan sto gaha yin te/ /kārtsi dunyi ma la ya ni/ /khyad par nye ba'i tshan dho po)ha'o/ /'dus pa pre ta ba 0si ni/ /gri ha de ba yang de bzhinayi/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa /rnyedang gser gling gang ⑫/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa gnyis yin no/ /pa til pu tra dur khrod de/ /sin dhu'ang cide bzhin dur khrod do/ /ma ru ku lu tā 8gnyis ni/ /nye ba'i dur khrod gnas su bshad/ /de ltar phyi rol gnas su grags/ /nang gi gnas nyid lus su brjod/ /rang lus rtsa yi gzugs la 'dir/ /gnas kyi ming du rab tu grags/ /de gzugs lha yi rnam pa ste/ /des na nang gi bdag tu gnas/ /de phyir de yi gong bu'i gnas / /lus 'di sangs rgyas kun mtshungs pa'o/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od byed sa yin te/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro btu tsho/ /mngon du gyur pa tshan hor 8shes/ /nye ba'i tshan dho hu)sbyang dka' ba'o/ /'dus pa ring du song ba ste/ /mi g.yo bar grags nye ( 3 'dus pa/ /dur khrod de bzhin legs blo gros/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /gnas sogs sa yi rnam dag nyapa/ /rim pa ji bzhin bshad pa yin/ /gnas dang nye gnas sogs bsten pas/ /mi rnams dri ma med par 'gyur/ /blo ldan rnam rtog med pa ni/ /rgyu zhing mtshan ma yang dag brtag /sna tshogs gzugs dang 'jigs gzugs ma/ /drag cing mi bzad ( rnyedagod brtags la/ /rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor gyis snye/ /hūṃ gi sgra ni bsgrags zhunyepar bya/ /the tshom thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /sgrub pos seng ge bzhin du spyad/ /mthong ngam reg la 78wa 800

thos ①pas kyang / /myur du dngos grub rab 'gro ②'gyur/ /'di ni brda sridang gnas la sogs pa'i brdas byas rnams nges par bstan pa'i rim par ⑤bye ba ste dgu pa'o// //de nas gang zhig bris tsam ⑥gyis/ /sgrub pos dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'i/ /zhi ba la sogs rab sbyor ba/ /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /gur gum ⑦tsan+dan bsres pas gang / /yar ngo yi ni tshes zhol bri/ /'khor lo rtsibs drug bris nas ni/ /yi ge bdun pa'i sngags sbyar zhing / /phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ /dbus su ming ni rnam 0spel ba'o/ /dar ram ras ni gcang ⑩ma 'am//yang na kham phor kha sbyar la/ /gsang ste las ni bris nas kyang / /srad bu dkar pos dkri yibar bya/ /kha dog dkar pos shar bltas 8te/ /me tog dkar pos mchod par bya/ /mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgrub bya gnas par bltas la8/ bum pa dkar ④po zla ba'i bdud rtsi'i 0chus gang ⑩bas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /the tshom med pas thun gsum du/ /yi ge bdun pa'i sngags bzlas ⑩na/ /de ma thag tu zhi ba dang / /bde legs skyid dang tshe ring 'gyur / /rims nad dug dang 'tshe ba la/ /lag pa g.yon par bsgom na bya ste/ /'khor lo tsan+dan gyis bris la/ /me tog bdug pa 0mchod par bya/ /bsgrub bya shar du kha bstan te/ /mkhas pa yis ni sbyar bya ba/ /gtor ma chu dang de bzhin me/ /de yi dbus su drar ⑥ ba 'am/ /rma bya'i sgro 'am ku sha'i chus/ /khyad par du ni de la byabadu/ /gsang sngags 'di ni gtso bo sonyamachog /zhi nunyesogs cho ga rim bzhin byed/ /gur gum 0dri bzang bsres 2)pa yis/ /rgyas 78—801

pa'i 'khor lo bri (1)bya ste/ /swā hā'i yi ge dang spel bar/ /kham phor gnyis la bris nas ni/ /srad bu ser pos dkri byas la/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i nang du gzhug /byang du kha bltas thun gsum du/ /kha dog ser por bsgom byas (kyel/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ser po la/ /bsgrub bya gnas par mkhas pas bsam/ /bdud rtsi ser pos dbang bskur zhing / /me tog ser pos mchod par bya/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis ni/ /rgyas pa'i bsam pas bzla bya ste/ /che ge mo boji kai (bku ru swā hā/ /bo ṣaṭa ④sngags kyis spel bar bya/ /nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel ba dang / /dpal dang bkra shis mnyam par 'jug /las kyi sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rgyas par 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /tsan+dan dmar dang sen rtsi (5)dang / /ming med kyi rinani khrag bsres (me)te/ /ras sam gro ga'i 'dab rinasam 'am / /kham phor so ni ma btang bzung / /yi ge hoḥ(9)dang spel ba yis /'khor lo gnyis ni mnyam par bri/ /srad bu dmar pos bcings nas ni/ /me tog dmar pos mchod par bya/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i dbus gzhag ⑩la/ /nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas te/ /kha dog dmar por bsgom nyu)byas lanyuge/ /dkyil 'khor dmar po la gnas pa'i/ /bsgrub bya chags par rnam par bsam/ /rtag tu yig nyurtebadun 'byung ba ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bzlas bya ste/ /myos par 'gyur bas zhabs drung lhung / /de ni grub par rnam par bsam/ /gal te dbang du 'ong bar ma gyur na tsomar dang sbrang rtsi dang bral ba'i 'khrul 'khor seng ldeng gi 'dab ma skol gdung bar byas na/ gang su yang rung ba (7skal ba ngan pa yang hu 4skal ba bzang por 'gyur te gzhan du ma yin no/ /dur khrod kyi ras sam/zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i ras la/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba dang ldan pas yi ge dzaḥhrī ⑫78wa 802

dang spel ba'i 'khrul 'khor bri ba'am/ kham phor ram/ bud med kyi thod pa la grub pa'i 'khor lo bris la ①sbad bu dmar pos dkris te/ me tog dmar pos mchod la bsgrub bya'i snying ga phyinas lcags kyus dbug (kyecing mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcing bar bya'o/ /gang gis de ltar bsams ④kyang bsgrub bya nam yang 'ong bar ⑤ma gyur na seng ldeng gi shing las me sbar la bsros yipas 'khrul 'khor tshar gcad ⑦par bya zhing che ge mo ā kun+ta ya hrīḥdzaḥ(nyezhes bya ba des tsobasgrub bya skad cig tsam de nyid la dgug par bya ste/ rkang pas dgug 7pa bla na med pa'o/ /de nas gzhan yang mnan pa yi/ /cho ga bla med bshad par bya/ /ri mo brgyad brgyad mnyam sbyar bas/ /re'u mig bzhi bcu rtsa dgu ste/ /mkhas pas de yi bar gyi ⑩ni/ /re'u mig bcu gsum stong par bya/ /zur dang zur du re'u (2mig dgu/ /grwa 'bazhi la ni yang dag gnas/ /grwa bzhi kun gyi dbus kyi ni/ /re'u ④mig stong pa nyid byas las/ /dur khrod ras la zhal bzhi pa'i/ /sngags ni yang dag sbyar te bri/ /yung ba ldong ros bsres pa'i chus/ /'khor lo gnyis la bsgrub bya'i ming / /yi ge lo dang spel te bri/ /ri rab zur 7brgyad gnas na 7bris pa'itso/ /kham phor kha sbyar nyid du bya/ /ri rab steng du dbang chen gyi16/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su lo gyis — )ni/ /mtshan cing sna tshogs pordo rje yis/ /steng nas mnan par rnam par bsgom 3/ /srad bu ser pos rnam par dkri 3/ /ho ru ka ni phyag gnyis pa'i/ /rnam par bdag lus yang dag bsgom ste/ /rnal 'byor pas ni lhor bltas te/ /kha dog dmar por rnam par bsgoms/ /bsgrub bya ri rab dbus gnas shing / /ri rab kyis ni mnan par bsgomatsha 9/ /de steng tsho 1sna tshogs rdo rje yis( nye/ /yongs su mnan par 0rnam par bsgoma'i )/ /rang gi 78wa 803

gnas su de byas na/ /dgra yi kha ni gnon pa dang / /dpung rnams kun kyang gnon par byed/ /dgra yi snying yang gnon 6)pa'o/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ②rgyu ni phaṭa / lo lhas byin s+t+waṃ bha (geya/ oṃ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa hūṃ ⑤rgyu phaṭa/ lo lhas byin ste bha ①ya / oṃ gro: pa ya gros pa ya/ r+ghaṃ 6)rtsu phaṭa/ lo lhas byin ste bha ⑧ya/ oṃ ā na ya ho bi byā rā dza rdu (1)rgyu phaṭa/ lo lhas byin s+t+waṃ bha ⑩ya/ sngar bshad rim bzhin 'khor lo ni/ /de nyid kyis ni nges par bri/ /me tog ser pos mchod bya ste / /ngag gnon pa yi mchog yin no/ /rtag tu dur khrod ras la ni/ /'khor lo gnyis ni mngon bris te/ /yi ge bo ni bsgrub bya yi/ /ming dang spel bas kha bcings pa/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /ga 'u kha sbyar byas pa yilhaste / /lug gi snying gar 8bsgrub bya ni/ /rab tu zhugs par (nyernam par bsamathu / /sngags ni rgyun mi 'chad par bzla8/ /nges par lkugs pa nyid du 'gyur / /de nas gzhan yang nges par ni/ /gsad yipa'i cho ga mchog bshad bya / /lan tshwa ske (7tshe tsha ba'i mar/ /nim pa'i lo ma de bzhin dug /dur khrod sol ba dha du ra/ /rang gi sdigs mdzub hunyekhrag kyang rung / /rdzas 'di dag ni snag tshar bya/ /lho phyogs kha bltas sbyor bas nyu)ni/ /khu yi gshog du — )pa'i sgyu 0gu yis / /bsgrub bya ri 2de yi ming bzung du nyeste/ /yi ge rtsu dang rnam spel ba'i/ /'khor lo gnyis ni yang dag bri/ /khro zhing drag po'i nga ro dang / /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par( ste/ /bskal pa'i me 'dra zhal rnam soge'agyur/ /sngo zhing mi bzad dus gi sgras/ /mgur ni (nyegang bar rnam par bsgomashuste/ /gyo mo khrod kyi sar bsam ⑥pa'am/ /dur khrod sol ba yi ni dbus/ /'di la sogs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /bsgrub bya gnas par mkhas 78—804

pas bsam/ /rid cing dri ma dang bcas pa/ /gos hrul gyon par rnam bsam ste / /yan lag kun dang mgo bo dang / /snying ga 6)dang ni dpung par yang / /sngags kyis phug par bsam par bya/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la gnas pa'i lha/ /rang gi lus la rab tu gzhug(snye /khyim stong lta bur bltas nas (kyeni/ /phyag na sna tshogs mtshon ④ca can/ /khro bo'i tshogs ni spro byas la/ /mtshon chas gsod (5)par rnam bsam ste/ /dum bu drug tu gtubs 96)nas ni/ /tshil dang rkang dang zhag dang sha /za dang 'thung bar byed pa dang / /de bzhin du ni khrag kyang 'thung du/ /ral gri dbyug to ༷gegatun shing dang / /dgra sta 'khor lo tho ba yis//bsgrub bya la ni rdeg cing gtub59)/ /dum bu brgyar ni gsheg 7par byed/ /khwa dang 'ug pa bya rgod dang / /ce nyunyespyang srin po mkha' 'gro ma/ /de rnams khros pa'i yid kyis ni/ /za ba dang ni 'thung bar byed/ /yi ge hūṃ phaṭa dang spel ba'i / /sngags dang de yis bzla /stebyas te/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed pa'i / /dgra yi tshogs rnams gsad 1)par bya/ /e ma'o tshigang phyir bsad ⑩pa'i las/ /bsad tshepar 'gyur nyi 〉kyang ma bsad de/ /'khor ba'i rnam par rtog pa tsam/ /de bzhin nyid du yid kyis rtogs/ /de nas yi ge phaṭa spel ba'i / /'khor lo gnyis ni bri byas tenyu8/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni yang dag blang / /sngags kyis sbyar te bri bar bya/ /rta /kyedang ma nye mnyam zhon pa'i/ /bsgrub ( nyabya bltas te yang dag bris/ /thod pa kha sbyar nang gzhag zhunyaste/ /srad bu sngon pos dkri bar bya/ /khro ba'i sems kyis nyi byed dam/ /mtshan mo de yi khyad par la gnya//rab tu gtum pa'i 6)bzhi mdo 'am/ /dur khrod 'jigs pa'i dbus su ni/ /gsang phyonas brkos ( gete gzhug par bya/ /sngar bshad cho ga bzhin du mchod/ /78—805

rta dang ma he dag 'thabs pas/ /de yi mod la 'byed 0)par byed/ / gnyis ka ekhro zhing khro bas 'jigs/ /g.yul 'gyed ⑤pa yi bdag nyid che/ /phan tshun rtsod pa byed pas ni/ /rnam par sdang 'gyur gzhan du min/ /yi ge r+ghaṃ phaṭa rnam ③spel ba'i/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis 'dir bri/ /sngags dang bsgrub bya mnyam ldan pas / /dur khrod ras la (5)bris nas ni/ /thod pa kha sbyar nang bzhag ste/ /srad bu nag pos dkris nas ni/ /he ru kur ni bsgoms nas su/ /ro bsregs sa brkos (7sba bar bya/ /mdun du yi las byung ba'i rlung / /gzhu yi dbyibs can dbus gnas shing / /kha dog sngon po rnga mo zhon/ /lho phyogs su ni bskyod pa dang / /khro bo'i tshogs kyis khrid pas na/ /sa stengs ⑦ston pa bzhin du byed//yi ge r+ghaṃ phaṭa sbyar (8beb yi/ /sngags ni rgyun mi 'chad par khyabazlas/ /gang gi cho ga ci byas pa/ /de yi mod la skyod par 'gyur/ /sgrub po lhor bltas khros pa yis / /rang mkhrag dur khrod thal ba dang / /dug dang lan tshwa 'bru mar tshe0/ /myos byed 'dab 512ma'i khu ba ni/ /ske tshe mnyam par yang dag sbyar/ /dur khrod ras la de bzhin du/ /'khor lo gnyis po nyid hunyerim bzhin/ /cho ga rdzogs par bri bar bya/ / gsad pa yigashin rje'i lus la gnas/ /dbye ba rta dang ma he lasnyi/ / bskrang ba tshernga mo la gnas pa/ /zhi ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mi mo rnams kyi snying gar nyu dbang / /rgyas pa glang chen rgyab tu'o/ /lkugs pa 8lug gi lus la gnas/ /mnan pa hu/ri rab dbus te dgug /sha ra bha yi 0 seng ger gnas/ /'di ltar las ni brtag shunyepar bya/ /las 'di dag dang bral ba'i las / /bsgrubs kyang des ni mi 'grub ste/ /bla ma'i man ngag med pa'i las/ /stong pa bzhin du 'bras ru med 'gyur/ /'di ni las rab 'byam du'abyung ba zhes 78wa 806

bya ba'i rim par 4)phye ba ste/ bcu pa'o// //de nas sngags kyi bzlas pa yil/ /mtshan nyid gsang ba bshad par bya/ /ri bo tshang tshing ri sul dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang ni/ /bzhi mdo dang ni 'dun ②khang gnas/ /dur khrod dam ni yid dga' ba/ /sngon du dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /phyi nas lha yi bdag nyid kyis/ /sngar bshad cho gas yang dag par/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la sogs bya/ /ri 'am ri bo'i gnas su ni/ /snying po'i sngags ni bzla bar bya/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra te he ru (7ru ka hūm̐ (3)rtsu phaṭa swā hāyi/'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas nas ni/ /bcu cha yi ni sbyin sreg ⑨bya/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das dngos grub/ /myur du 'grub ste (8)gzhan du min/ /tshang tshing ljon shing gtams 67par ni/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /nye ba'i snying po'i sngags rtag tu/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bzla zhing bsgruba'i/ /oṃ hrīḥ1nyaha ha r+ghaṃ 8rgyu phaṭa/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 0bya/ /char dbab r+shapa dang gter dang ni/ /ngag gi dngos grub bsgrub 8par bya/ /ri sul dri med chur 35bcas par/ /dkyil 'khor dge ba 3 tshobris nas ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sngags bzlas te/ /zhal bzhi pa yi gsang sngags bzlas/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha 384 3te/ phaṭa/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gros pa ya gros pa ya hūṃ 0 rtsu phaṭa/ ā ḍa lhan ya ho bi byā ( nyerā dza hūṃ 9 lhas phaṭa/ rnal 'byor pa yis bzhi 'bum bzlasaX ste/ /bcu cha yi nyeni sbyin sreg 25bya/ /zhi dang rgyas dang bcud kyis len/ /de bzhin sems can don sgrub 2 7pa'o/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram song nas/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag bris nas ni/ /lha mo'i sngags ni 78wa 807

khyad par du/ /'bum phrag gsum ni bzlas nas su/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin cho ga ni/ /rdzogs pas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg (1)bya/ /oṃ badz+ra bai 90ro tsa nī ye rtsu zhi'ergyu phaṭa swā hā/ 'jig rten dngos grub thams cad dang / /de bzhin mkha' spyod dngos grub bo(4)/ /dur khrod du ni sngar bshad pa'i/ /cho ga'i rim ⑤pas dkyil 'khor bri/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas la bsgrub(6nye/ /bcu cha'i sbyin sreg (7)byas nas las/ /rnam par nges pas bsgrub par bya/ /dbye ba dang ni bskrad pa'i las/ /khyad par du ni bsad (kyepa'i las/ /rdo rje sems dpas gang gsungs bzhin/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur//bzhi dzo9rimador dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /mnan ⑩pa'i cho ga bsgrub par 0bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gsang sngags ni/ /khri bzlas pas ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ ḍā ki nī ye r+ghaṃ (1ges phaṭa/ bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bsgrub tson ni/ /'byung po ro langs 'grub par 'gyur/ /gtsug lag khang ngam 'dun yikhang du/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni bri bar bya/ /lā ma'i sngags ni nges par yang / /'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas nas ni/ /lha mo bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 8bya/ /oṃ lā me hūṃ tso phaṭa swā hā/ mig sman dang ni rkang mgyogs chadang / /de bzhin dbang du byed pa ni/ /'grub par 'dir ni the tshom med/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas su ni/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bri byas la/ /khaṇ+ḍa hunyero hā la 4)sogs sngagasadu )/ /cho ga sngon 0bzhin bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro te rtsu sa phaṭa swā hā/ 'bum phrag gnyis ni tsobazlas nas kyang / /bcu cha yi ④ni sbyin sreg tsobya/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sngags bzlas te/ /gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo rnams bsgrubatsu'u/ /gzugs can ma yi ngagasang sngags ni/ /nges par 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas nas/ /lha mo du )bcu cha'i 78wa 808

sbyin sreg ①bya/ /'grub par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /oṃ rū pi tsā ye rgyu (mi phaṭa swā hā/ me tog dang ni spos dang dri/ /lha bshos gtor ma de bzhin te/ /bza' dang btung bas khyad par du/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni mchod bya zhing / /glu dang gar gyi ③khyad par gyis/ /phyag rgya sngags ni bsgrags 54)par bya/ /yid 'ong dam tshig rnyed nas ni/ /phyogs su bzhag (lde)nas bsgrub bya ste/ /las ni gang gis khyad par gyis/ /de yi rigs sogs brtag par bya/ /lha yi rnam pa la gnas te/ /cho ga ji bzhin bzlas zhing (6/mchod/ /dus gang tshe na mi smra zhing / /der ni sngon du bsnyen pa bya/ /myos byed gtor mar (nyamanyam ldan pas/ /sngags kyi nus pa bsgrub bya ste/ /brgya dang stong dang 'bum gyi bar/ /der ni grangs nyid mtshon par bya/ /grangs med sngags ni bzlas pa yis/ /bla na med pa'i dge ba 'byung / /de dag nges par sbyor ba yisan)/ / bsgrubs na yi)dngos grub 'thob ⑩par 'gyur/ /'di ni sngags kyi bzlas pa'i nges pa bstan pa'i rim par /smuphye ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //yang dag cho ga gang gis 'dir/ /'grub 8par the tshom med pa yi lha /bzlas pa'i phreng ④ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po legs par nyon/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang / /de bzhin shel dang dung la sogs/ /zhi dang rgyas pa dag la sbyar/ /zhi la ril bu 8brgya pa ste/ / ril bu ⑩brgya rtsa brgyad pa ni/ /rgyas pa'i las la rab bsngags hu 7te/ /mkhas pas rgyal srid ched dam dpal/ /bde spro phun sum tshogs phyir bzlas/ /dbang dang dgug pa'i rab sbyor la/ /gur gum la sogs dri'i ril bu/ /byi 3nyaru tsan+dan dmar po'i 78wa 809

'bru / /rtag tu ril bu tsho)lnga bcu'o/ / ru dā k+ṣa dang (milung tang 'bras/ /de bzhin mi rus rnga mo dang / /bong bu ma ho'i rus pa ni/ /drag spyod lkugs ①dang gnon (depa dang / /dbye bas dgra ni tshar gcad ⑤dang / /gsad dang bskrad la sbyar bya ste/ /las kyi khyad par ji lta bar/ /bzlas pa'i phreng ba'ang bya ba yin/ / bong bu (lernga mo'i spu dang ni/ / khu yi sgror (7)ni bsre byas la/ /mnan ②dang bskrad pa'i las la ni/ /de yi srad bus brgyu bar bya/ /rta dang ma nye'i spu yis ni / /rnam par sdang la srad bu bya/ /dur khrod skra yi srad bu dang / /khyi yi spu ni bsre bya ste/ /de yi srad bu drag po yi/ /las la bsngags tso)phyir sbyar bar bya/ /dge ba'i las la gzhon nu mas/ /bkal ba'i srad bus brgyu 0bar bya/ /zhi ba la ni mdzub la gzhag11 /rgyas pa rtag tu gung mo yis/ /ming med kyis ni dbang zhes gsungs/ /tha ma yis ni mngon spyod yin/ /mthe bo lha yi tsorang bzhin gyis/ /las kun las 12ni sbyar bar bya/ / ril bu chadagra bcom mdo 'dzin ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi 1gerang bzhin te/ /bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i khyad par gyis/ /mnyam gzhag bsgom 19zhing bzlas par bya/ /rdzogs ldan dus su gcig bzlas pa/ /gsum ldan dus su nyis hu tsho'agyur bzlas/ /gnyis ldan dus na sum 'gyur bshad/ /rtsod dus bzhi 'gyur du ni bzla/ /sngags kyi grangs ni bzhi po yis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par gsang sngags bzlasahunye/ /bzlas pa'i phreng ba sogs bsdus (//pa/ /'di ni ngag gi ri — )bzlas pa ste/ /lha yi gzugs su dmigs pa yisazhurje/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sno bdag nyid can/ /sngags kyi de nyid brda yis ni / /'gro dang 'ong ba yang dag bsam/ /mtha' gsum las ni rnam grol ba/ /don dam de bzhin nyid kyi don/ /'di rnams sngags kyi bzlas pa yis cho 78wa 810

ga'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa yin/ /'di ni sngags kyi bzlas pa'i bgrang phreng ①nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba ste/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa can/ /dngos grub yon tan kun gyi gnas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan kun khyab pa'i/ /sa phyogs mkhas pas yang dag brtag /khrag 'thung ②phyag gnyis sbyor ldan pas/ /phung po lnga sogs nga rgyal bya/ /zhal bzhi pa yi sngags brjod pas/ /phyogs ni bcing zhing ra ba ste/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ①hūṃ ④rgyu phaṭa/ shar du'o/ /oṃ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi hūm̐ ⑤rgyu phaṭa/ byang bu'o(6)/ /oṃ gros pa ya gros pa ya rgyu 9)rtsu phaṭa/ nub tu'ol/ /oṃ ā nyan ya ho bi byā rā dza hūṃ ⑩ phaṭa / lho ru'o/ /phyogs su se gol brdabs hustepa yis/ /gdug pa'i snyi/bdud ni bskrad par bya/ /snying ga'i nyunyechu skyes hūm̐ yig las/ /'od zer phreng ba spro bar bya//de yi snang bas mdun du ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sogs bltas la/ /phyag btsal ④me tog bdug sogs pas/ /mchod de rjes la sdig pa bshagasa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /byang chub sems ni rnam par bskyed/ /gzhan la phan pa'i sems ni byams pa ste/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'joms byed snying rje yin/ /gzhan gyi bde bas tshim pa dga' ba ste/ /sems can kun snyoms btang snyoms rnam par bsam/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥsarba dhasmyu swa bhā ba shurnyo3rta ⑩zhes bya bas/ sems tsam nyid la rnam gnas shing / /byang chub tshogs ni bsgom ⑩par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3rta8/rten dang brten ⑩pa'i gzugs su ni/ / r+bha ram ba la nga )sogs pa bsam yo 78—811

las byung ba'i rlung hu)dkyil 'khor/ /gzhu 'dra kha dog sngon po ste/ /de yi steng du ro las ni/ /me yi dkyil 'khor gyi ni gzugs/ /kha dog dmar po zur gsum pa/ /rdo rje rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de yi steng du bo byung ba'i/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor skum po dkar/ /de yi steng du'ang lo byung ba'i/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor zur bzhi pa/ /kha dog ser po grwa bzhir ni/ /de bzhin rdo rje rtse gsum mtshan/ /de yi steng du sum̐ byung ba'i/ /zur bzhi pa ni ②ri rab ste/ /rin chen bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /rtse mo brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de yi steng du r+ghaṃ byung ba'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje nirnam par bsgomabya/ /de yi steng du pad+ma ni/ /lte ba ge sar ldan par bsgoms)/ /de dbus ā li kā duli yi/ /dag pa'i sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su yi ge r+ghaṃ/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin las / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus bzhugs pa'isti/ /dpal ho ru ka rnam par bsgomadu / /dpa' bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas brkyang pa yis gdan la bzhugs / /rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po chel/ /g.yas pa kun+da lta bu ste/ /g.yon pa dmar po cher 'jigs pa'o/ /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan payi/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /mnan zhing ⑩bde ba chen pos bzhugs8/ /rdo rje rnam snang mdzad mas 'khyud/ /thugs rje'i chags pas shas tsocher dgyes/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu ni/ /mnyam par ldan pas yang dag 'khyud/ /gnyis pa'i phyag ni mchog gnyis kyis/ /glang chen pags 8pa gos su 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi gsum pas cang te'u ni/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid sgra sgrogs/ /g.yon gyi phyag ni gsum pa yis/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten 8thod pa bsnams/ /thod pa'i phreng ⑩bas thod du mdzad/ /zla ba phyed pas rnam par brgyan⑩/ /dbu la sna tshogs rdo rjes ⑫78—812

mtshan / /rigs kyi bdag pos cod pan mdzad/ /zhal ni rnam 'gyur cher 'jigs pa/ /sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /stag gi pags 1)pa'i na bza' can / /mi mgo nyi shu'i laphyed kyis brgyan/ /lha ni phyag rgya lnga 'chang zhing / /gar gyi nyams ni dgu dang ldan/ /de la 'khyud pa'i bcom ldan ma/ /zhal gcig ①phyag gnyis ④rgyan gsum ma/ /gcer bu brtse ka yi ⑤mdog /dum bus brgyan pa'i sku rags yican/ /skra grol ba dang rnam par gtsigs/ /khrag la dgyes shing 'dzag pa'o/ /phyag g.yon 'khyud pas gdug 9)pa yini/ /bdud sogs khrag can thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yas pa sdigs mdzub (1)rdo rje can/ /bskal pa'i me 'dra'i sku chen ma/ /byin pa gnyis ni mnyam 'khyud cing / /rtag tu bde ba cher dgyes pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro de bzhin lā ma dang / /khaṇ+ḍa ro hā tsogazugs can ma/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde 'byung ba/ /pad+ma'i phyogs kyi gnas su dgod / /gnag yidang ljang dang dmar ba dang / /ser skya'i mdog can spyan gsum ma/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis ma ste/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa'i phyag ldan ma/ /g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug ste/ /gcer bu g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs/ /skra grol mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /mtshams kyi 'dab 8ma bzhi la ni/ /byang chub sems la nyustesogs ④pa'i snod/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa dang / /glu dang gar gyi dga' bdes 8mchod/ /sgo bzhir lha tshogs gnas pa ste/ /rtag tu lha rnams bsgom par bya/ /shar gyi sgor ni khā ⑩gdong ma/ /phyag gnyis sngon mor bsgom par bya/ /byang gi sgor ni 'ug gdong ma / /ljang gu hu 7spa ni grol ba'o/ /de bzhin khyi gdong ma ni dmar/ /nub kyi sgor ni yang dag gnas/ /phag gdong ma ni ser mo ste/ /lho sgor yi dgas huste78—813

gdan la gnas/ /me dang de bzhin bden bral dang / /rlung dang ①dbang ldan mtshams su ni/ /gshin rje brtan ②ma pho nya mo/ /gshin rje mche ba 'joms ma ste / /de bzhin zur gnas lha mo ni/ /yid 'phrog gzugs ni gnyis ma ste/ /yi dgas ②la gnas drag mo che/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam brgyan pa'o/ /g.yon na thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas na rdo rje gri gug ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni de rnams kun/ /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol ④ba'o/ /de nas go cha gnyis shes nas/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom⑤/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /dam tshig 'khor lor mnyam par gzhug /de nas go cha gnyis bshad par bya ste/ oṃ ha snying gar (6)ro/ / na maḥ(7nyi mgo bo la'o/ /swā hā hu ⑧sbyi gtsug tu'o/ /bo ṣaṭa (9)te phrag pa gnyis la'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ hoḥbomig gnyis la'o/ /phaṭa haṃ shwe/ yan lag thams cad la ste mtshon cha'o/ /dang po rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /gnyis pa rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs/ /gsum pa pad+ma gar dbang ste/ /dpal he ru ka bzhi par grags/ /lnga pa rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /drug pa de bzhin rta mchog ste/ /go cha drug po rnams kyis bsrungs/ste/ /oṃ rba ni rdo rje rnam snang mdzad ma'o⑩/ /oṃ haṃ yo ④ni gshin rje ma'o/ /oṃ ṭhā mi 8ni rmongs byed ma'o/ /oṃ hre hri ⑩ni skyod nyurtebyed ma'o/ /oṃ hūṃ rtsu ni skrag byed ma'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa ni gtum mo lus thams cad la mtshon cha'o/she/ /lte ba dang snying ga hu7dang de bzhin du kha dang mgo bo dang / spyi gtsug sum̐ )la de bzhin du ni mtshon cha yin no/ /oṃ yo ga shud+dhāḥdusarba dharmā rdu 3yo ga shud rto3rta(snye/ lag pa g.yas phyedang g.yon pa snying gar libazhag ste/pad+ma ( 9rgyas pa'i gar bya'o/ /snying po'i phyag rgya la sogs lha/ /bskor ba mkha' 'gro ku snadra ba'i sdom/ /rnal 'byor 'di buni gtso bo mchog /lha yi rnal 'byor 78—814

rnam par bsgomanya/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ /bde chen 'khor lo sbyar bar ②bya/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa rnams ni/ /lus kun dag par byed pa ste/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi yisani/ /lus ni sdud cing 'dzin pa yin/ /lus 'di dpa' bo'i rang bzhin te/ /'di de sangs rgyas kun mtshungs pa'o/ /gnyis med rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsam ④mi khyab pa'i phyigo 'phang bstan/ /rjes mthun yirnal 'byor sems kyis ni/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom par bya 'di ni dpal nye ru ku'i bskyed ⑦pa'i rim par phye ba ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mchod pa yang dag rab bshad bya/ /gnas sogs bgrod par mi nus na/ /phyi yi rnal 'byor ma mchod bya/ /rang gi khyim du rnal 'byor ma/ /mchod de sngon 'u du bsnyen sogs bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa med pa las/ /de yi khyadon med yongs su ngal/ /mar ngo yi ni tshes bcu 'am/ /yar ngo'i ⑩yang ni de bzhin te/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs ldan pas/ /dad pa'i sems kyis spyan drangs te/ /rang gi khyim du shar bltas par/ /yang dag gnas pas lha mo mchod/ /gur gum mig sman de bzhin du/ /li khri yis ni mgo la byug / rkang pa lag ⑩pa gdong de bzhin/ /byug pas byugs shing phonyemachod par bya/ /mgo la me tog phreng ba dpyangs/ /dri zhim pa yi tsobadug pas bdugatso /gcig dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga/ /khyad par du ni bdun dang dgu / /ji srid nyi shu rtsa 8bzhi'i tsobar/ /yon bdag nges par dang ba 0yis/ /bza' dang myos byed btung phonyeb dang / /nya dang sha la sogs ldan pas/ /phyag rgya byin gyis brlabs nas mchod/ /dpa' bos brda ni 'o)bstan par bya/ /rdo rje 78—815

rnam snang mdzad pa'i tshogs/ /lha yi bdag nyid rtag tu mchod/ /gtor ma'i bya ba sngon 'gro bas/ /mar me lnga dang bza' ba dbul/ /glu dang bstod par rab ldan pas/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod/ /'dir ni brtson ①pas rdo rje lha mo rnams/ /myos (5)byed sha yis rab tu mchod byas te/ /dpal ldan rdo rje theg par mos 'gyur na/de'i/ /dad pas ston mos de rnams mchod byas na/ /thugs ni mnyes 54pas mchog ni 465 risa'agyur te/ /gang phyir mchog ni de yi lag na gnas/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mchod nas su/ /zhi rgyas mtshan ma brtag ⑥bya ste/ /gzhon nu ma mchod skad cig la/ /dge dang mi dge'i las 'bras brtag /gang zhig lag gnyis nyed 57 pa na/ /yid ni mnyes par ma gyur nas/ /des na nad rnams 'phel ba dang / /sdug bsngal 'thob ⑧pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mchod byas de yi skad cig la/ /gad mo'i sgra ni phyung gyur na/ /nad med pa ni mi 'grub cing //'chi ba nyid du the tshom med/ /mchod pa'i mod la du (shedabyed cing / /mig gnyis nyed tshepar byed na ni/ /skad cig hu)la ni 'chi zhes brjod/ /sgrub /snyepos rtag tu mchod byas pas/ /so so so sor zung rer ni/ /phan tshun gdong ni phyogs gyur na / /thams cad du ni rtsod nyuge'agyur bar/ /gzhon nu mas ni rtag tu ston/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rgyab phyogs ltayo/ /so yis sen mo 'cha' byed na/ /sha yi bza' bas ma (getshim ste/ /slar yang las ni dgos par 'gyur/ /bza' dang btung ba thams cad kyi/ /ston mos mnyes par ma gyur na/ /mtshon 8la sogs pa blo 7bur ba'i/ /nad ni 'phral du skye bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar glu dang rol mo byed / /yang dang yang du dgod 8pa na/ /rgyal po chom rkun /na'ajigs pa dag /gzhon nu de ston mkhas pas brtag /myos byed 'thungs nas yang dang yang / /78—816

rnam pa du mas gar byed na/ /de rnams la ni nad chen 'byung ①/ /mchod pa'i dus su brtag par bya/ /ston mo'i bza' ba thams cad ni/ /dor nas phyogs su lta ②byed na/ /spyod pa nyams par byas pa'i skyon/ /lha rnams bdag la 'khrugs pa'o/ /phan tshun gtam la 'jug pa dang / /gal te phan tshun rgod byed na/ /gtso bo'i cho ga nyams par ni/ /gzhon nu de bstan shes par bya/ /zos ma thag tu skyug byed na/ /smyo ba'i nad ni 'byung bar ston/ /mdzes ma gal te 'gro ba'i tshe / /rgyab kyi phyogs su lta ༅byed na/ /slar yang las ni dgos pa dang / /yun ring zhig na dund byung stiston/ /sa la rkang pas nyed (7pa na/ /gnas ni 'pho ba'i don du 'gyur/ /mchod dus babs par gyur na ni/ /phan tshun g.yul ni 'gyed par ston/ /rnam 6)'gyur 'di dag bral 6)bas ni/ /mchod pa 'grub par mtshon par bya/ /de bas brtson pas mchod nas ni/ /sgrub pos rtag tu brtag par bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu kun rab ster⑩/ /'di ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mchod pa'i cho ga nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye lhonyeb ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas de phyir snod kyi ni/ /mtshan nyid mchog ni yang dag bshad/ /'jim pa'am de bzhin rus sbal snod/ /'khar skaba'am zangs sam lcags las byas / /gser ram yidangul las byas pa 'am/ /dung ngam de bzhin nya phyis te/ /bal po se'u yi 'bras bu mchog /de bzhin gzhan yang gsar 8byung ba/ /rwa ⑫las byung dang shing 0snod sogs/ /gzhan yang rdo snod khyad par ro/ /dum bu gcig dang dum bu gnyis/ /de bzhin gsum dang bzhi dang lnga/ /dum bu drug 78—817

dang dum bu bdun/ /dum bu brgyad par rab tu grags/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs sam/ /dmangs rigs bud med rigs mthar skyes/ /dkar dang dmar dang ljang skya dang / /ser dang de bzhin ser skya ste/ /thal ba'i mdog dang mdog ngan dang / /sna tshogs mdog tu rab tu grags/ /lhag pa dman dang tha ma ste/ /de bzhin dbyibs ni sna tshogs dbye/ /gshongs ①gnyis glang po'i rgyab lta bu/ /de bzhin rdo rje'am khā yi rkang / /so ni ljang dang ser ba 'am//lto ba'am srin bus zos de ②bzhin/ /'di kun rnam par bltas nas ni/ /de la (0yongs su brtag par bya/ /sa gzhi rigemanyam pa'i yul rnams sam/ /thang ngam bye ma'i 55)gshongs dag tu/ /sngags pas der ni bsgrubs (6)byas la/ /de yi lhung (7)ba brtag par bya/ /lhor bltas bram ze 'jigs (8)par 'gyur/ /bden bral lhung bas ba lang dang / /rigs med pa dang rigs ngan 'jigasaspu / /rlung bltas sngags ni 'jigs 7pa ste/ /byang du bltas na phyug por 'gyur/ /dbang ldan sngags kyi dngos grub ste/ /brtul zhugs rgyun ni nyams pa med(1rnye/ /mer bltas nye bar 'phrog pa ste/ /de bzhin 'og bltas chom rkun ma'o/ /steng bltas nyugeganas pas bud med 'joms/ /logs su lhung 32bas gtum mo ste/ /snod kyi mtshan nyid rnam shes bya/ /dum bu gcig pa gnas la dbang / /dum bu gnyis pa dkyil 'khor dbang ④/ /dum yigasum sgrub po'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /dum bu bzhi ⑩pas sngags dngos grub(rte/ /lnga pa yis ni zhi dang rgyas/ /dum drug slong hu)mo rnyed par shes/ /dum bu bdun pas dbang du byed/ /dngos grub sgrub pa 'bras med phyir/ /de bzhin dum bu brgyad pa spang / /bu ga gcig pa bram zer 'gyur/ /bu ga gnyis pa rgyal rigs 'gyur/ /bu ga gsum pa rje'u rigs 78—818

shes / /bu ga bzhi pa dmangs rigs rnams/ /bu ga mang po'am bu ga med/ /mkhas pa yis ni spang bar bya/ /bud med thod pa'ang mi gzung 1)ste/ /khyad par du ni mdog nyams dang / /so med pa 'am so nyams pa/ /dge ba 'dod pas bcang mi bya/ /so (gyiljang bas ni sdug bsngal mang rin)/ /khā yi rkang 'dres ④rtsod par 'gyur/ /gshong bu gnyis pas rgyad (5)par 'gyur/ /de bzhin glang po'i rgyab kyis (6)nang / /dbus kyi gnas su gshong bu bzhi/ /'dod 'jo'i bar ni blta 6)bar bya/ /mdun phyogs su ni gshong bu gnyis/ /yid bzhin nor bu zhes byar bshad/ /dung dang kun+da zla ba yi/ /mdog ma tshungs snum par shis rin par blta/ /sngags rnams kun gyi dngos grub steratsho13/ /sgrub pos dngos grub thob par byed/ /che zhing mdog ni ser po 'am/ /pad+ma lta bu 7pad+mas mtshan/ /rgyas la bsngags pho7par gsungs pa ste/ /nor ni phun sum tshogs pa 'grub/ /snod ni gang zhig kha dog dmar/ /gzhan yang thig le dmar pos nyunyamatshan/ /rtag tu dbang dang dgug pa yi/ /dngos grub ster snod mtshan nyid do/ /ba lang kha lta bu yi dbyibs/ /shin tu sra zhing mu tig bcas/ /gsad kyi dang bskrad dang dbye ba la/ /khyad par du ni rab tu bsngags/ /snod ni rab bsngags yang dag 'thob skye/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu kun rab ster/ /gnas dang zhing du bgrod nas ni/ /sgrub pos lha mo bsgrub par bya/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag yongs rdzogs pa/ /bcangs na thudangos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni snod kyi mtshan 8nges par bstan pa'i rim par (1nyebye ba ste/ bcwa nyu8lnga pa'o// //de ni rtso)de phyir bdud rtsi lnga'i/ /sgrub pa 5 yang dag rab tu bshad/ /yang 78wa 819

dag cho ga gang gis ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras 'byung ba'o/ /cho ga sbas ①pas bram ze yi/ /mngal nas ②skyes las yang dag blang / / des na ①rnam snang mdzad pa'i ming / /grags te dngos grub yang dag bzhed/ /kha dog ljang zhing rab bzang lus/ /mig gi 'bras bu gnag ④pa yi/ /rin chen rigs ma rnyed nas de'i/ /dri chus bsangs ⑤te bsgrub par byayi/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus ldan zhing / /yan lag mdzes gzhon pad+ma'i rigs/ /bza' dang btung bas yang dag mchod/ /mkhas pas mchod yon phul nas ni/ /de yi mod ⑦la snyoms 'jug byas/ /phan tshun gyi ni shu kra blang / /des na gar mkhan rigs ming can / /de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin grags/ /sngar bshad pa yi cho ga yis/ /dngos grub yongs su rdzogs bgrod pa/ /tshos semakhan zhes ni rab grags pa'i/ /dang po'i me tog rab tu bsngags/ /dam tshig can ma'i gdol pa mo/ /gal te rnyed na rtag bsten ponyebya/ /sha dang tshil dang de bzhin khrag /mkhas pa 0yis ni gzung /stobar bya/ /sgrub po dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /lcags kyu lnga 8ni ci ⑫rnyed pa'ams/ /'dir ni gsad pa tsogatsor bshad pas/ /ci ⑩ste yang dag rnyed na gzung / /ba lang sha dang rta sha dang / /glang po'i sha yang de bzhin te/ /mi yi sha dang khyi yi sha /mkhas pa yis ni gzung ⑩bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpas tsogang gsungs pa'i/ /sgron ma lnga zhes grags pa'o/ /rnyed nas tshes bcu'i dus su ni/ /dngos po 'di dag yang dag bsdu/ /dri zhim pa dang bsres nas ni/ /rab tu gsang ste sbyar bar bya/ /sgrub pa po yis gsang ba yis/ / ril bu'i ⑪rnam pa yang dag bya/ /de yi mod la yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bza' dang btung ba'i khyad par gyis/ /tshogs kyi dbus su byin brlabs nas/ /phyi du nas las ni 78—820

yang dag brtsam/ /sngags bzlas de bzhin bsam gtan dang / /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras 'byung zhing / /lus kyi bcud kyis 0)len dang ni/ /mchog tu grol ba'i dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu ril bu bsten ( byed pa/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras rab ster/ /las rnams kun la rab sbyar na/ /mkha' spyod go 'phang 'thob ①par 'gyur/ /'di ni bdud rtsi lnga sgrub (pa)pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste/ bcu drug pa'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba yi(pe/ /cho ga mchog ni yang dag bshad/ /'di ltar 'ga' zhig gsol 'debs pa'am/ /rang nyid bsod nams 'dod pa yis//dang por rang lha'i bdag nyid kyi/ /'khor lo la gnas sngon bsnyen bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i dbang byas nas/ /der ni gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /brtan zhing zab mo'i chos shes pa/ /rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son/ /sbyin sreg ⑥dkyil 'khor de nyid shes/ /rig pa'i gnas ni thams cad rig /gsang sngags tshul la dad cing mos/ /gzugs bzang blta (3)na sdug pa dang / /bla ma la gus brtser ldan na/ /sdom pa 'byung bar rab bshad bya/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas/ /gnas khang 'dun 'a rikhang sa phyogs gtsang / /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /der ni dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /sngon du las ni byas pa'i sar/ /brko ba la sogs mi bya ste/ /lag pas reg (7nas rtsu yig gebo/ /sngags bzlas pas ni sa sbyang bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi cha'iyi / /nyis 'gyur sa ni sbyang bar bya/ /rang gi sems ni yongs dag pa/ /de nyid kyis na tsos dag 'gyur/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /78—821

lha yi sku yi bdag nyid can/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril 'chang ba/ /mkha' 'gror bcas la gsol ba gdab/ /blo ldan rdo rje gsor byed cing / /dril bu 'khrol bar brtson pa yis/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba dang / /rab tu gdug pa'i bgegs tshogs bskrad/ /nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /srung ①ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor (nadabs/ /lus srul la sogs gang ci'ang rung / /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengasal/ /ji ste ngas bsgo su zhig 'da'/ /rdo rje'i bdag po'i sku yis ni/ /lus gsum las byung dgas bya ste/ /'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min/ /sa ni yongs su bzung byas nas/ /ra bas mtshams ni bcing bar bya0/ /lag g.yas dam bcas phyag rgya yis⑤/ /yi ge rba byung sa'i lha mo / /mdog ser gser gyi bum 'dzin la/ /bstod nas rab tu bskul bar bya/ /che ge zhes bya bdag dkyil 'khor/ /'dri la lha mo khyed dbang gyur/ /me tog bdug pa sogs pas mchod/ /mkhas pas mchod yon phul (7byas la/ /bcom ldan khro mchod 57 rdo rje can/ /de bzhin gshegs la gsol ba gdab/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po lhan cig skyes 'byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri 8chibar 'tshal lags na59ri/ /de bas bcom ldan gus bdag la/ /bka' drin gnang ri7bar mdzad du gsol/ /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang ske/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub la brten tīpa'i / /'byung po bstan 12la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan kun/ /dkyil 'khor bde mchog 'byung ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri bar bgyid lags pas / /bdag dang de bzhin slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse ba bskyed du gsol/ /78—822

srad bu ye shes lnga ldan zhing / /nyi shu rtsa lngar rnam dbye bas/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /srad bu phan tshun bsgril bar bya/ /sgrub pos yi ge r+ghaṃ brjod de1)//bdud rtsi lngas ni byug par bya/ /dkyus su 'khor lo'i nyis 'gyur la/ /sboms su sgo yi nyi shu cha/ /dzaḥgasum brjod nas lte bar ni/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung nas/ /blo ldan nam mkhar thig gdab ste/ /de bzhin sa la'ang gdab par bya/ /gsal (gyizhing mdzes par ldan pa dang / /tshad ldan gtsang ma'i srad bu yis/ /dpal ldan lhan skyes 'byung dkyil 'khor/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bya/ /khru phyed la sogs nas brtsams nas/ /ji srid khru ni brgya yi bar/ /dang por tshangs pa'i thig yin te/ /gnyis pa la ni zur thig gdab/ /nub dang lho yi gnas su ni/ /slob dpon nges par yang dag gnas/ /shar dang byang gi phyogs gnas su/ /slob ma gnas te mnyam gzhag ( ri)pas/ /dang por (47bzhi 'gyur bdag nyid du/ /re'u mig gcig ni thig gdab bya/ /de nas brgyad 'gyur bdag nyid du/ /re'u mig gcig gi (5)thig rab gdab/ /gzhan yang brgyad 'gyur nyid du ni/ /re'u mig gcig ni thig gdab bya/ /de nas gzhan yang nyis 'gyur nyid/ /re'u mig gcig ni thig rab gdab tsho/ /de nas bzhi 'gyur nyid du ni/ /re'u mig gcig ni thig gdab bya/ /gzhan yang nyis 'gyur nyid du ni/ /re'u mig gcig gi (7thig rab gdab/ /de nas mkhas pas bzhi 'gyur nyid/ /re'u mig gcig ni thig gdab bya/ /de nas gnyis 'gyur bdag nyid de / /re'u mig gnyis ni thig gdab bya/ /de nas phyed ni rim gnyis bri4)/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor thig yin no/ /thig skud mtshan ma drug cu ⑩bzhi / /dkyil 'khor thig gi mtshan nyid de/ /'khor lo'i phyi rol mthar thug 78—823

par / /cho ga gsungs bzhin thig gdab bya/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma 'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pa ste/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu (7nag po'ang de bzhin te/ /slob dpon dbang ldan phyogs su ni/ /song ste mnyam par bzhag (5)nas su/ /legs sbas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /ri mo lnga ni dgye bar (gebya/ /phan tshun bar du nas re tsam/ /shong ba'i tshad du bri ba ste/ /ri mo sboms na nad du 'gyur/ /phra bas nor ni nyams par 'gyur/ /yon pos 'dir (deni rtsod par 'gyur/ /chad pas 'chi ba (ge'abyung bar 'gyur/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar po che/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang du margad 6)yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi (pes yi cha nyid ni/ /in+d+ra nī la 'od 'bar ba'o/ /grwa (8)yi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis spras par⑨/ /mnyam par bzhag ste ⑩yang dag bri/ /rdo rje ra ba'i nang du ni/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa ste/ /gtum drag de bzhin tshang tshing dang / /rdo rje 'bar ba keng rus can/ /dbang ldan du ni mi bzad bzhad/ /byin za ru ni bkra shis mchog /mun pa drag po bden bral du/ /rlung phyogs ki li ki li'i hunyesgra/ /shar gyi shir+ṣa a shwata 8shing / /kung gel khyad par tsū lha ta'i shing / /pa ṭā 8de bzhin ka ra43nye/ / la tā paṅka mthi thub/ /dbang po de bzhin sbyin byed dang / /klu yi dbang dang gshin rje'i bdag /dbang ldan de nas byin za dang / /srin po'i hunyedabang po rlung gi bdag /bā su ki dang 'jog po nyid/ /kusko nasheṭa dang pad+ma nyid/ /pad chen hu lu hu lu dang / /rigs ldan dang ni dung skyong ngo / /sgrogs pa dang ni cher sgrogs dang / /drag dang g.yo dang brtan de bzhin/ /gang ba dang ni de bzhin 78—824

'bebasal/ /gtum pa ①'di dag sprin dbang phyug /gzhan yang sna tshogs du ma yi la/ /khu dang 'ug pa bya rgod dang / / ce spyang ce 55)sbyang mo dang ni/ /'ol pa dang ni 'ol pa mo/ /seng ge'i gdong dang stag gi gdong / /drag cing 'jigs pa'i gdong can ma/ /sbrul ni ba lang mgo can dang / /gdong gnyis la sogs phyogs su rgyu/ /keng rus dang ni mdung gis phug /'phyang dang phyed tshig pa dang mgo/ /thod pa byin pa mgo rdum dang / /gtsigs pa'i mgo dang rus pa dang ske/ /rigs ④'dzin grub pa sna tshogs dang / /dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams dang / /gnod sbyin ro langs srin po sogs/ /ki li ki li'i ⑤sgra chen bdag /dngos grub rdzu 'phrul yang dag par / /thob pa'i slob dpon gyi ni tshogs/ /dur khrod dbus su blta bar bya/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i rim par (7bye ba ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas ༅slob dpon mtshan nyid ni/ /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /zhi zhing dul ba'i cha lugs can/ /sems can kun rab mi 'jigs ster(81/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi rab sbyor shes/ /bstan bcos (rtenarig cing snying rjer ldan/ /sems can kun la bu bzhin lta7/ /thams cad du ni snyan par smra/ /sbyin la nyunyasogs la rtag tu dga'/ /bsam gtan rnal 'byor mngon par brtson/ /kun la mi 'tshe 8bden par smra/ /snying rje dang ni phan sems ldan/ /mnyam sems dang ni phyag rgyar 0ldan/ /sems can rnams kyi mgon gyur zhing r+sha/ /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par shes/ /mgon med pa ni rnams kyi gnyename/ /dbang 78—825

po yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus/ /gzugs 0)dang ldan zhing blta ②na sdug /dbang bskur don gyi de nyid shes/ /tshig gsal yon tan rgya mtsho che(mi/ /rtag par rgyun du gnas brten pa/ /de ni slob dpon rig par bya/ /slob ma rigs bzang chos la spro/ /slob 3dadapon gyis ni yang dag bsdu/ /snying rje med cing khro dang gdug /khengs dang brkam (5)chags rnam g.yengs (yecan/ /drag dang rmongs dang snyom (7 las can/ /gzhan gyi srog la snying brtse med/ /gzhan gyi nor la sred pa ni/ /bla mas rtag tshon)tu spang bar bya/ /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan / /bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo sgyu 0med/ /mi dge bcu ni yongs su spangs/ /sems can rnams la byams par ltas/ /'bar ba'i me dang dug bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi nor la mi reg cing / /rtag par rgyun du bla ma mchod/ /dam chos lta 'ostobar spro ba dang / /rtag tu sbyin pa la sogs dga'/ /'jig rten pha rol mngon par 'dod/ /de dag slob mar rab bsngags te/ /dkyil 'khor dge ba bstan (1gepar bya/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /gus pa'i yid kyis gsol gdab bya/ /rnal 'byor ma 1lhamachog kha sasbyor ba'itshe/ /dpa' chen khyod bdag ston pa pos / /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan hu tshopa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang mo dang / /de bzhin phag mo he ru ka /gsang ba'i gnas sogs yang dag dgang / /lus la rnam gnas bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho 78wa 826

ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni/ /mnyam med ye shes yang dag 'thob①/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /bla ma mchod dang de bzhin byams/ /sangs rgyas la gus 'gro la brtse/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba yongs spang zhing ②/ /sbom po'i ltung ba'ang ④rnam par spangs/ /sems can rnams ni bsten par bya/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /ma rgal (4ba rnams brgal gebar gyis/ /ma grol ba rnams grol bar gyis/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis dkrugs pa'i/ /sems can dbugs ni dbyung bar gyis/ /bslab pa de dag yang dag ldan/ /slob ma rnams ni lhag gnas bya/ /cho ga ji bzhin khrus dang ni/ /bsang (65byas so shing sbyin par bya/ /srad bu dmar pos khyad par du/ /dpung par bcings te rtag tu bsrung 9)/ /yi ge dhī 9sheyi sngags bzlas pa'i/ /ku sha de la rab tu sbyin/ /rmi lam dge dang mi dge brtag /sku gsung thugs kyi sdom pa'ang sbyin/ /yon dang lhan cig 0mnyam ldan pa'i/ /me tog sil ma rab gzung khunas/ /der ni gdong g.yogs bcings nas su/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab tu gzhug /skye ba sngon bsags 1nyesdig pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor mthong bas byang bar 'gyur/ /kye khyod su zhes dri bya zhing / /bdag ni skal bzang zhes kyang smra/ /dam tshig chu dang mna' bsgag chadang / /me tog dkyil 'khor dor ba ste/ /gang dang gang du me tog babs/ /de dang de yi rigs su 'gyur/ /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang ske/ /dril bu dang ni ming dbang bskur/ /de bzhin gshegs lnga'i bdag nyid dbang / /brtul zhugs dang ni lung bstan nyid/ /rjes gnang dang ni dbugs dbyung dang / /phyir mi ldog pa'ang sbyin bya ste/ /gdugs dang gdan 78—827

dang rig pa sogs/ /rdo rje dril sogs yang dag ldan/ /slob dpon dbang bskur yang dag rdzogs/ /bum pa las ni byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa gsang ba mchog yin te/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes yin/ /bzhi pa de ltar yang de bzhin / /dbang bskur ①'di dag yang dag ldan/ /de ni dam tshig can shes ②bya / /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mchog tu rab zhugs mthong bas na / /deng khyod sdig pa thams cad las/ /rnam grol bzang por ①gyur pas gnas / /sangs rgyas kun ④gyis mnyam gsungs pa'i/ /rjes gnang mchog tu dbugs dbyung ba/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom (gepa ni/ /'di dag rtag tu bsrung (6)bar gyis/ /slob ma dad pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag btsal (7rinas/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bgyi zhes smra bar bya/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa'i/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang na bza' sogs/ /khyad par du ni rang gi lus/ /bla ma la ni yon du dbul/ /dbang bskur gtso bo thob pas ni58ra/ /bya ba byas pa'i blo chen gyis/ /gzhan yang rab dgas 'di skad du/ /smra zhing mjug hu)ni rdzogs par bya/ /deng du 0bdag tshe 'bras bu yod / /bdag gi gson par hunye'abras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras por bdag gyur to/ /sbyin sreg 8gis ni rdzogs bya zhing phonye/ /dge 'dun la ni ston mo drang / /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ /nad pa'am mgon med rnams la'ang sbyin/ /phyi nas man ngag ji bzhin du/ /dam tshig spyod pa la brtson pas/ /snod du byas pa'i rgyun gyis ni/ /'khor lo la sogs bsgom ④pa'i rim/ /yang dag man ngag phun tshogs pas/ /dngos grub 'gyur gyis /nyagazhan du min/ /'di ni dbang bskur ba'i rim par phye ba ste bcwa ⑩78wa 828

brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'chi bar nges pa yi0)/ /mtshan nyid mchog tu bshad par bya/ /rang gi lus sam phyi rol gyi/ /ltas ni mkhas pas brtag ④par bya/ /rkang mthil chadag tu phug snyam dang / /gang tshe lte bar phug snyam gyur(ge/ /de tshe nyin zhag gsum pha rol/ /lnga yi gong du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bshang dang gci ba'i dus dag tu/ /dus mtshungs sbrid pa byung gyur na/ /lo gcig na dus de nyid kyi / /dus tshod la ni 'chi zhing brlag /mtshan gnyis (snyemanyam par sbyor ba yi/ /bar dang tha mar sbrid pa ni/ /dus mtshungs byung na de yi tshe/ /zla ba na ni nges par 'chi/ /snying ga lkog (6)ma'i dbus dag tu/ /dus mtshungs gal te zug gzer 9)gyur/ /ci 6)ste chos la mi brten ri11na/ /zla ba phyed dang gnyis na 'chi/ /gal te mig g.yon 'bras bu yi/ /gzugs brnyan me long la bom mthong nyanya ci meste zlog /(rtepar mi byed na/ /zhag bdun na ni nges par 'chi/ /rna rtsa chadang ni smin ma'i dbus/ /spyi bo'i rtse mor zug pa ste/ /bzhi po mtshungs par zug gyur na / /de tshe 'phral du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /glo tshebur du ni tshor gyur cing / /rid dang khro dang 'jigs pas 'khrugs/ /gal te chos ni ma tshabasten gang / /de ni lo gcig dag na 'chi/ /yar ngo yi ni tshes gcig la/ /gal te khu ba nag por mthong ske/ /de tshe zla ba drug na 'chi/ /dmar pos nad kyis 'debs par ston/ /mig las rtag tu 'dzag pa dang / /gzugs mthong ba yang rnam 'phrul 7dang / /me long ngam ni chur nyusnyegang zhig /rang gi grib ma ma mthong dang / /mtshan mo'i tshe na dbang po'i gzhu/ /nyin par skar ma'i dkyil 'khor mthong / /sprin med 78wa 829

par ni lho phyogs su/ /brten ①pa'i glog 'gyu mthong ba dang / /nyin par grib ma'i lam dang ni/ /de bzhin skar mda' lhung ba mthong / /ngang pa bya rog rma bya ni/ /gcig tu 'dres pa mthong ba dang / /zla ba gnyis dang nyi ma gnyis/ /de bzhin rang gi mgo bo 'bar/ /shing rtse ri yi rtse la ni/ /dri za'i grong khyer mthong ba dang / /yi dgas (bsha za 'jigs rung ba/ /gzhan dag kyang ni mthong ba dang / /glo di bur du ni rab 'dar dang / /yang dang yang du brgyal ba dag6) /de yis gcig cig mthong gyur na'ang / /zla ba gcig gis 'chi bar 'gyural/ /zla ba ra (5)ri med pa dang / /nyi ma 'od dang bral ba dang / /mtshan mo nyi ma nyin par ni/ /zla ba de bzhin rang mig 'bar/ /skar ma ri rab dag gi tshad/ /rgya mtsho chu bo lta bu dang / /khu ba dang ni bshang gci 6)rnams/ /dus mtshungs par ni 'bab 'gyur na/ /gal te chos la ma brten 9)na/ /zla ba phyed na (87'chi bar 'gyur/ /der yang nyin mo grib ma ni/ /skye bo'i stigazugs can blta bya ste/ /de yi mgo bo ma mthong na/ /lo gcig gi ni nang du 'chi/ /lag pa g.yon pa ma mthong na/ /bu dang chung ma nges brlag 'gyur/ /lag pa g.yas pa ma mthong na'ang / /pha dang bu sogs tshegs 7chen 'chi/ /gcin ni rgyun lngar 'gyur ba dang / /g.yon nas 'khor zhing dri nga dang / /skyur ba la sogs gcin byung na/ /zla drug nang du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gi ni mi lam mthar / /bye ma'am thal ba'i phung po 'am/ /lha khang ngam ni mchod sdong 'dzeg41 /de ni sngon bzhin 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gal te bong bu'am spre'u zhon nas / /grog mkhar phyag dar phung po la/ /mngon 'dzeg 8lho phyogs 'gro bar ni / /gang gis rmi lam mthar mthong na/ /bud med gang zhig gos gnag cing //78wa 830

mdog gnag mi ni 'dod spyod pa/ /de ni dus mtshan yin zhes bya/ /gshin rje'i lto bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bya rgod ce ①sbyang khyi dang khwa/ /dred dang yi dgas ②sha za yis/ /za bar mi lam mthong na ni/ /lo gcig ①na ni nges par 'chil/ /gos ni dmar pos g.yogs ④pa dang / /phreng ba dmar pos brgyan pa dang ske/ /til mar gyis bskus rmi lam mthong / /zla ba drug na (shegason mi 'gyur//man ngag ji bzhin ldan pa yis⑥/ /'chi ba blu 9)bar 'gyur ba ste/ /de nyid kyis ⑧ni 'chi las rgyal/ /chos kyis 'chi las rgyal ba ste/ / rdzogs pa'i ⑨byang chub rim sgrub pas/ /de bas chos ni mchog tu bsam/ /gzhan yang bsgom ⑩pa'i khyad par ni/ /mdzes pas yang dag bshad par bya/ /dbugs ni skad cig 'chad pa dang / /sna tshogs ltas ni (lhayang dag mthong ⑫/ /'thor dang dgang ba'i 8sbyor ba yis/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor sbyang bar bya/ /'chi ba'i dus la yang dag bab/ /'pho ba'i rnal 'byor mchog bya ste/ /bu ga dgur ni bon pa'i rtsa/ / pu ri gas ④ni dgang bar mabya/ / re tsa lokas ni chadabugs mnan bya / / kum pa hunyekas ni bsdam byas te/ /bu ga'i sgo ni sbyang bar bya /rab tu zhi bas zhi bar 'gyur/ /rnam shes dbrog lho pa'i sbyor ba dang / /gzhan yang pha rol bgrod pa la/ / ā li kā hūṃ )li mnyam ldan par/ /mkhas pa rka 1yis ni sbyar bar bya/ /snying khar 3yi ge hūṃ sbyar te/ /yi ge phyed dang gnyis po ni/ /'og dang steng du gzhag tsho )par bya/ /de yi 'og gi char rlung gi/ /sa bon 'og tu bltas pa'o/ /rlung gi sa bon gnyis byas te/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas kha sbyar nga stebya / /nyi shu rtsa gcig rim pa yis/ /yi ge phyed dang gnyis sngags brjod/ /rnam shes bzhon sogepa rlung yin te/ /gang dang gang du bgrod pa yin9/ /rlung gi 78—831

sgor ni ①bsam byas na/ /grol ba'i dngos grub ster byed pa'o/ /mchog dang tha ma'i dbye ba ni/ /bshad kyis (migasang ba'i bdag po nyon/ /lte bas 'dod khams bde 'gro ste/ /thig le las ni gzugs can lus/ /steng nas gzugs med khams su ste(mi/ /de ④ni bde bar 'gro byed pa'o/ /sna las gnod sbyin rnams su 'gyur/ /rna ba las ni mi 'am ci/ /lha mo gal te mig las ni/ /mi yi rgyal por 'gyur ba yin/ /kha yi sgo las yi dgas ⑤rnams/ /gci las de bzhin dud 'gro'o/ /bshang lam nas ni dmyal bar 'gro/ /grol ba las ni gzhan du 'gro/ /dus la bab na 'pho bya yi4)/ /dus min lha ⑦rnams gsod par 'gyur/ /lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni/ /mi ni dmyal bar 'tshed ⑧par 'gyur/ /des na mkhas pas 'chi ba yi/ /mtshan ma yang dag shes par bya/ /'di ni 'chi ba'i ltas lta (sheri ba dang 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor rim par phye ba ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas de phyir dus bzhi yi/ /tshad ni yang dag rab bshad bya/ /gang zhig rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /bskal pa myur du shes 'gyur ba'o/ /nyi khri dang ni brgyad stong dang / /sa ya phrag gcig bdun 'bum ste/ /de dag la ni rdzogs ldan gyi / /bskal pa zhes ni grags par bshad/ /rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis mtshams su/ /de bzhin stong phrag brgyad yin no/ /sa ya phrag gcig 'bum 'phrag gnyisam/ /dgu khri dang ni drug stong ste/ /gsum ldan bskal pa zhes grags pa/ /der ni mkhas pas shes par bya/ /gsum ldan gnyis ldan bar mtshams su/ /stong phrag drug ni shes par bya/ /drug khri dang ni bzhi stong 78—832

dang ske/ /'bum phrag brgyad ni gnyis ldan te/ /bstan bcos 4)kun las bsdus nas ni/ /gnyis ldan bskal par yang dag grags/ /gnyis ldan rtsod pa'i bar mtshams su/ /de bzhin stong phrag bzhi yin te/ /sum khri dang ni nyis stong dang ske/ /bzhi 'bum rtsod dus shes par bya/ /rtsod dus rdzogs ldan gnyis mtshams su/ /stong phrag dag ni bzhi dang ldan/ /de rnams dus zhes (snyegags pa ste / /'grub par 'dir ni the tshom med/ /gling bzhi pa yi dngos po ni/ /mgon po yis ni bshad du gsol/ /shar gyi lus 'phags sgra mi snyan/ /de bzhin nub kyi ba lang spyod/ /gling ni gsum po de dag rnams/ /'bras bu'i sa par yang dag gnas/ / 'dzam bu'i lagling du legs skyes pa/ /dngos grub sa par shes par bya/ /gling gsum por ni skye ba yi/ /'bras bu 'byung ba'i bsod nams gnas/ /'dzam bu'i gling pas grol ba dang / /dngos grub nyid ni sgrub pa ste/ /de dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis/ /gsungs pa'i gling du shes par bya/ /'di ni dus bzhi po nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas sbyor ba ④pa rol son/ /mchog ni yang dag rab bshad bya/ /sgrub po ⑤dngos grub rgyu nyid ⑥kyis/ /gang gi stidangos grub mthar bgrod pa'o/ /thun mong ⑧rnal 'byor rgyud rnams su/ /gsang ba rnam par ma bshad pa/ /dngos grub rnams las mchog dngos grub/ /brtul zhugs rnams las mchog brtul zhugs/ /bla ma dam pa bsnyen bkur nas/ /bla med rgyud ni mang thos te//de nyid ji bzhin bla ma yil/ /zhal las 0thos nas rtag tu bsgom0/ /nor dang chung ma de bzhin srog /sbyin pa nyid du gtang thabar bya/ /mdud pa 'di gsum 78—833

las grol na6)/ /rtag tu spyod pa spyad par 'gyur/ /spro ba chen pos rig pa bzlas/ /de bzhin bden par (7smra la dga'/ /dam bcas pa la rab gnas te / /ji ltar dad pas sngon du brtsamasarin)/ /'dod dang khro ba 'jigs pa dang / /sred dang gti mug nga rgyal spang / /slob ma brtag dang bshad (gede bzhin/ /gzhung (5)rnams bsdu ba rtag tu spang / /gtsang dang mi gtsang dag byed gyedang / /btung dang btung min brtag mi bya/ /smad dang bstod la khro ba dang / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spang / /rtag tu mi chags dga' med par/ /thams cad la ni mnyam par gnas/ /sbyin sreg ④med cing mchod pa med/ /phreng ba med cing bzlas pa med/ /nyi ma gza' (3)dang skar ma dang / /tshes grangs kyang ni brtag mi bya/ /bdag gzhan bdag nyid gzugs kyis 9)ni/ /the tshom med par gnas par bya/ /'dod pa med par mi spyad detshe/ /kun la 'dod pa cung zad spyad / /stag gi pags 7pa gos su byas/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /shes rab thabs bdag rnal 'byor pas/ /he ru ka dpal rnam par bsgomanyugye/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa yis1lha/ /yid ni bde bar gnas par bya/ /grong du mtshan mo gcig gnas shing / /grong khyer du ni lngar gnas bya/ /yid dang rjes mthun 8sbyor ba 32yis/ /sa yi steng du gnas par bya/ /yang na rlung zhes bya ba yi8rka/ /spyod pa bde zhing dga' bar spyad/ /rtag tu grogs po med par rgyu/ /gcig pur nyu tshoyid ni rtse gcig pas/ /smyon pa'i brtul zhugs la brten shegenas/ /lo ma rlung gis bskyod bzhin 'khyam/ /dur khrod dam ni mtshan gcig gam/ /shing gcig gam ni nags tshal lam/ /ri yi rtse 'am chu bo'i 'gram/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram yang rung / /skyed 519mos tshal lam ri phug gam/ /khang 78—834

bzangs sam ①ni khang stong ngam/ /bzhi mdo dang ni sgo mdun nam/ /de bzhin rgyal po'i pho brang sgor/ /gdol pa'i (miganas sam phyugs 55)lhas sam/ /bzo yi khang par sbas pas gnas/ /tshong srang dor ba'i me tog phreng / /me tog rnying pa gang ci'ang rung / /dur khrod mtshan gcig (deme tog phreng / /de dag gis ni lus rab mchod/ /rang gi mgrin par me tog phreng / /khyad par du ni tshangs skud dang / /ska ⑤rags dag kyang bcing bar bya/ /rkang pa gnyis la rkang gdub bya/ /smra ba bzlas pa'i bdag nyid grags/ /lag pa bskyod pa phyag rgya ste//rnam par mi rtog rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor pa ni ci bder gnas/ /dogs ( yipa thams cad rnam spangs te(7)/ /sgrub pos seng ge bzhin du spyad/ /yang na g.yo med brtul zhugs la/ /brten nas rnal 'byor spyod pa spyad/ /skyed 78)mos tshal lam khyim stong gnas/ /grong dman ngan pa'i khyim du ni/ /ji srid nus pa thob de srid/ /mi smra'i sbyor bas gnas par bya/ /ji ltar gnyid log 'gro dang 'dug /sad dam yang na ma sad pa'am/ /ci rnyed pa tsam za ba dang / /mi bkres pa ni bzang por gnas/ /gal te slong 99)mos gnas pas na/ /lag 7pa'i snod du za zhing gnas/ /rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin gyis/ /'dir ni 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /gsum po de dag nang nas ni/ /gang 'dod brtul zhugs la brten nas/ /cung zad nus pa rab thob nas31/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i spyod pa spyad/ /lus ni sbyin par byin nas su/ /phyi nas spyod pa yang dag brtsam / /spyod pas rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nges par dri ma med 'gyur ba/rte/ /'di la 'khrul bar mi bya ste/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /'di ni spyod pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //78—835

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nges pa dang / /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud kyi tshad/ /bshad kyis tshigasang ba'i bdag po nyon/ /rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi ni tshad/ /bye ba phrag ni drug nges te/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grags(ba/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grangs②/ /theg chen las gzhan mdo sde rnams/ /dung phyur phrag brgyad gsungs pa yin/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /sa ya dang ni dung phyur lnga/ /'di dag thams cad thub dbang po/ /sku gsum bdag nyid can gyis gsungs/ /bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa'o/ /'dul ba'i gnas la sogs pa kun/ /nyan thos bdag nyid la bstan pa'o/ /sna tshogs mdo sde'i rnam bshad chese/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bstan pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /gsang ba sangs rgyas spyod yul te/ /shes rab thabs bdag rnal 'byor gyis/ /bde ba chen po bsgom ⑤pa yis/ye / /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa'i/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob pa'i phyir / /sems can bsod nams dman rnams la/ /lha yi bdag ④nyid can gyis gsungs/ /de nas gzhan yang rab gnas kyis98ste/ /cho ga pha rol son bshad bya/ /sngar bshad mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ /slob dpon du ni yongs su brtag /lugs ma'am mngon par 'du ponabyas pa'i/ /sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams ni/ /rab gnas don du sa sbyang zhing / /bla re ⑩rgyal mtshan ba dan rnams / / brgyan cing turjes ni yongs su gzung / /sku gzugs sam 8ni glegs bam mamanyuge/ /bris sku yongs su rdzogs pa rnams/ /mdun rol du ni gzhag 8par bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo nam mkhar gnas/ /nyer spyod lnga yis yang 78—836

dag mchod/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ 0nyes ma ya ((ho/ lan gsum du ni brjod par bya/ /ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan yang dag bzhugs nas ni/ /lha mo sgyu ge'aphrul lhums 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /che ge zhes bya'i don du ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'phel phyir/ /me tog la ④sogs 'di bzhes te/ /mgon po 'dir zhinani rtag bzhugs mdzod/ /tshig 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /lhag par gnas par byas nas ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bstod byas nas/ /yungs kur (6)gyis ni bskor nas su/ /lan gsum du ni sbyang bar bya/ /dri zhim ldan pa'i mar gyis byug /'dag chal (7)gyis ni khrus kyang bya / /slar yang bum pa so so yis(9)/ /sku gzugs rnams ni khrus kyang byas/ /phyi nas nam mkhar gnas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das/ /lugs ma sogs la rab gzhug bya/ /yul chos la sogs ji bzhin du/ /las bcu yi ⑩ni bya ba bya/ /spyan ni dbye ba byas nas su/ /rdo rje spyan ni byin gyis brlab/ /de bzhin me tog spos mar me/ /byug pa zhal zas de bzhin te/ /de ltar las ni kun byas phyir/ /sbyin sreg nyi las kyis rdzogs par bya / /lha kun zhal ni me 12yin pas/ /mkhas pas rab tu gnas par mi bya/ /rab gnas yang dag rdzogs dus su/ /bstod dang bkra shis brjod bya zhing / /mṛ yidang ga sogs sil snyan sgra/ /ji ltar rnyed pas rab tu mchod/ /ston mo dang ni yon 'bul bas/ /skye bo tshim zhing rgyas par bya/ / rgyas pas miskye bo skal ⑩ba bzang / /bkra shis zhi bar bcas 'gyur te/ /zhi ba'i sbyor ba la smod tsopal/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'tshe nyi bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar rab tu mi gnas lha/ /rab tu gnas par bya bar nusatshe/ /slob ma dang bas gsol 'debs pas/ /78—837

bsod nams phyir ni bya ba ste/ /rnam rtog med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rab gnas lha ni bzhugs pa yin/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha la sogs/ /gang tshe rtag tu gnas gyur pa/ /mchod dang mchod bya mnyam 6)ldan par/ /de tshe lha yang yang dag bzhugs/ /'di ni lha rnams rab tu gnas pa'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas me yi las ( sogs pa'i/ /mtshan nyid yang dag ①bshad par bya/ /sa ni sbyang ba byas rjes la/ /me thab dag ni bya ba ste/ /sor brgyad pa nas brtsams nas ri4)ni/ /ji srid khru ⑤ni stong gi bar/ /sor brgyad pas ni dgra rnams gsod/ /sor bcus de bzhin rgyas pa ste/ /bcu gnyis sor gyis dbang dang dgug /bcu bzhis yide bzhin zhi ba'o/ /thab khung sor ni bcu drug pas//rigs ni mngon par 'phel bar byed/ /sor ni bcwa ⑦brgyad bdag nyid kyis/ /yul dang ba lang rigs 'phel 'gyur/ /thab khung sor ni nyi shu pasame/ /yams kyi nad ni zhi bar byed/ /'di dag thab zhu)kyi nges pa ste/ /bsreg bya'i rdzas kyi tshad rnams ni/ /las dang rjes su mthun 7bya bar/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /rgya 11yi tshad kyi cha gsum gyi/ /cha gnyis zabs su bsko hu bya ste/ /me thab dag ni thams cad kyi/ /brko nyugeba'i thun mong mtshan nyid do/ /thab khung gi ni brgyad cha yis/ /kha cher ri7nyid ni mtho bar bya/ /kha khyer dpangs kyi phyed tshad nyid/ /de nyid du ni dma' bar sbyar/ /ji ltar phyi rol dma' ba'i tshad/ /de bzhin kha khyer nang nyid do/ /de yi phyi yi khar na yang / /dpangs kyi tshad ni ji bzhin bya/ /thab khung nang gi khyad par du/ /rdo rje yis ni mtshan par bya/ /78wa 838

dkar dang ser dang dmar ba dang / /de bzhin gnag dang ljang ba ste/ /ji ltar las kyi rjes 'gro bas/ /thab kyi kha dog mtshan nyid yin/ /'on kyang las kun byed pa'i thab/ /zhi ba'i thab kyi khyad par mtshungs/ /kha khyer pad+ma'i rnam par te①/ /dma' ba rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ /de yi phyi rol kha khyer ni/ /gru bzhi kha khyer dpangs tshad bya/ /zhi la skum po'i rnam pa ste/ /shar bltas (7kha dog dkar por 'gyur/ /rgyas pa la ni gru bzhi ste/ /byang du bltas (5)pas ser pos ④bya/ /bskrad dang mngon par spyod pa la/ /zla ba phyed pa nub bltas (5)bya/ /dbye dang gsad ⑥pa'i las la ni/ /zur gsum lhor (7 ni bltas te bya/ /dbang dang dgug dang dbye ba gsum/ /kha dog dmar po zur gsum pa'o/ /mnan dang rmongs 6)pa'i las la ni/ /bden bral du ni bltas te bya/ /bskrad 79la dud pa'i mdog lta bu/ /de bzhin rlung phyogs bltas te bya/ / rims kyis khugadungs sogs mnan nyunyepa'i las/ /rtag tu me phyogs bltas te bya/ /lha dang gdan dang mdog rnams ni/ /las kyi gzugs kyis 'gyur ba yin/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi sbyor ba yis/ /phyag gnyis pa yi rnam par bsgom12/ ci /skad cig rnam pas gsang sngags brjod/ /skad cig rnam pas lha'i bdag nyid/ /rgyas la dga' ba'i sems kyis bya/ /zhi la zhi 32ba'i sems kyis bya/ /dbang la rjes chags sems kyis so/ /khro ba'i sems kyis gsang ba ste/ /rnam 'gyur drag po'i sems kyis ni/ /bskrad pa dang 0ni mngon spyod 'gyur/ /mchod yon zhabs la bsil 8sogs gzhagatso /de nas me ni spyan drang 7bya/ /rang snying chu 18skyes rgyu yig las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgomanya9tsho/ /yig ‘ stagasum las byung gzhu'i 0rnam pa/ /der dbus ro gyi sa bon las/ /kha dog dmar po mdzes 78wa 839

pa'i zhal/ /dbyug 0)gu ril ba ④spyi blugs (cigayon/ /g.yas kyis ④bgrang phreng mi 'jigs sbyin/ /gsus 'phyang ral pa'i cod pan can/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan ri5)pa ni/ /sngags pa mkhas pas blta bar bya/ /oṃ dzaḥyi/ gi yi ges ni / /thab khung logs su blta bya ste/ /bsang megator 'thor 'thung ⑧mchod yon sogs/ /byin nas thab kyi dbus su gzhag tsho /dam tshig sems dpa' bsams nas ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug 7par bya/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /de bzhin dri dang zhal zas mchod/ /lag gnyis pus 7mo'i nang gzhag /2ste/ /dgang gzar /sridang ni blugs gzar bzung 8/ /oṃ asna 8ye swā hā zhes pas/ dgang blugs bdun nam gsum byin natso/ /de nas me ni tshim gyur pas1 7/ /mi 'jigs pa ni chen po ston/ /me tog so rtsi na bza' sogs/ /bstod pas kyang ni mnyes bya ste/ /de nas 'thor 'thung byin nas ni/ /me ni yang dag gnas par bsam/ /oṃ bo dhi bṛ k+ṣu (snyeya swā hā/ a shwata tha yi'o(ste/ /oṃ badz+ra la tā ya sbyo )swā hā/ blag sha yi'o( nye/ /oṃ badz+ra ya du )tshwa ya swā hā/ u dum bā sonyera'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ku be rā ya swā hā/ shing 'o ma du nyecan rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha dgen badzā ya du 9swā hā/ til rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/'bras ma grugs sa pa rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ sarba sam pa de swā hā/ zho zhunyedang zas kyi'o / /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe ri rteg hā/ drar du)ba'i 'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ya ⑥swā hā/ ku sha rnams kyi'o/ /de nas snying ga'i 7pad+ma'i gdan la rang gi lha'i sa bon dang mtshan ma yongs su gyur pa las rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom du par bya ste/ de nas dam tshig gi 'khor lo la ye shes kyi 'khor lo gzhug bupar bya'o/ /me yi snying ga'i su dbus su ni/ /skad cig rnam pas rnam 78wa 840

par bsam/ /bsang gtor 'thor 'thung sogs mchod dang / /mchod yon zhabs bsil bstod pas mchod/ /rang lha'i sa bon bzlas pa yis1) the tshom med par sbyin sreg ②bya/ /lha rnams so sor phul nas ni/ /phyi nas ci 'dod sbyin sreg ③bya/ /gsum dang bdun dang lhag par ni/ /ji srid brgya (destong bar de bzhin/ /ji ltar las kyi rjes mthun (5)par/ /mkhas pa yis ni sbyin sreg (yebya/ /de bzhin zhu ⑦ba'i rdzas kun ni/ /de ltar me yi zhal du dbul/ /yam (nyeshing dang ku sha la sogs pa ni 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la'o/ /zhal zas dang 'thor 'thung la sogs pa ni phyag tu'o⑨/ /me tog ni dbu la'o/ /bdug pa ni 'od la'o / /byug pa ni thugs kur ro/ /bsang tshegator ni sku la'o/ /zhabs bsil ni zhabs la'o/ /mar me mchod yon zhal zas rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du mdun du dbul/ /sngar bshad cho ga ji lta bsanasto/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten sbyin sreg 7yang dag rdzogs/ /gal te 'jig rten 'das sbyin sregatso /nyin mo 'jig rten sbyin sreg 8ste/ /de bzhin mtshan mo 'jig rten 'das/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rnams 'dus/ /bza' dang btung ba'i khyad par dang / /ca co'i sgra yi spro ba che/ /glu dang gar gyi dga' bde btso/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /der ni tsa ru'i sbyin sreg 7bya/ /mngon 'dod bya ba gsol btab na/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom med/ /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun ⑩pa'i dngos grub stsol8 / /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol / /gang yang tshangs hu)pa la sogs pa'i/ /lha 'am 'byung po gang zhig la/ /dang por sbyin sreg (2 sbyin par bya/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a 2nyamu ka su 78—841

shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ mngon 'dod bya ba gsol btab na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la ①the tshom med/ /de nas sngags pa mnyam gzhag (gecing / /mkhas pas mdog dang sgra dang ni/ /dri dang 'bar ba'i dbyibs brtags te/ /de ltar me yi dge mi dge'i(8)ske/ /ltas ni nye bar mtshon par bya/ /me ni rtse mo gcig tu 'bar/ /phun sum tshogs pa 4)kun byed pa'o/ /rtse mo gnyis rab mi g.yo bar/ /mtshungs par 'bar na bar mar dun)shes/ /rtse mo bzhi ni mnyam du 'bar/ /rgyas shing dngos grub brtan 6)par gnas/ /kun+da zla ba lta bu'i mdog /snum zhing be+e ḍūr+ya yi ge'od/ /dri med me ni du ba med/ /nad med rigs ni 'phel bar byed/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /kha ba yi ni mdog lta bu/ /nor bu put+pa rā mega'i mdog /sdig pa thams cad 'jig (9༄byed yin/ /me tog bca boka lta bu/ / dza ba'i (2me tog gi ni mdog /btso zhugem gser gyi mdog lta bu1nye/ /dbang phyug rgyal srid rab tu ster/ /tsam pa pad+ma ut+pal dri/ /u shi ra dang mā la tis/ / shrī ta bogarnya'i dri mtshungs pa/ /ga pur a ka ri ru yi dris/ /dge zhing gnas kyi bdag po mchog /pi wang nyu rgyud mangs nyanardza rnga dang / /dung dang zangs dung ltar sgra snyan/ /shin tu zab pa'i sgra snyan pa'i/ /me mthong bde ba 'byung bar byed / /dpal be'u gdugs dang dung lta bu/ /gang zhig rtse gsum bum pa'i dbyibasal/ /rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdo rje bzang / /g.yung drung rta dang glang po'i dbyibs / /sgra med g.yas su 'khyil pa dang / /me lce gcig 'bar don cher ster / /'di dag dge ba phun sum tshogs/ /tshe dang nad med rab ster ba'iyi/ /g.yo zhing mdun gyi phyogs su 'bar/ /rtse gsum du ba'i tshogs mang dang / /'khor zhing me stag dang bcas pa/ /rnam par 'phro bas nad 'phel byed/ /me du dī78wa 842

gang yang yang charab tu 'dar/ /yang yang rtsub par rgod pa dang / /yang yang g.yon du 'khor ba dang / /yang yang sa la me lce reg /thig le nag po sol ba'i mdog /myur du rigs ni zad 'gyur zhing / /gang zhig rgyal po'i drung gnas pa'i/ /sde ②dang bdag po 'joms par ston/ /mdog med du ba'i mdog ltar gnag /mdog ljang sna tshogs mdog rtsub pa/ / pa la sha (snyedang 'bru mar mdog /'dis ni don rnams nyams par byed/ / ro'i dri nya yi ladri ltar ngan/ /chu skyes srog chags dri dang ldan/ /ji ste me ni 'di ltar mthong / /gtso bo rnam par ltung zhes ston/ /tseg tseg bcas (5)pa'i sgra 'byung zhing / /hur hur gyi ⑥ni sgra gang ldan/ /sim sim gyi ni sgra bdag nyid/ /rdo rje'i sgras stini don nyams byed/ /mdung dang ral gri mda' dang sbrulal/ /rnga mo ba lang mgo 'dra gang / /'jigs pa'i rnam pa 'di ltar mthong / /de'i mdun bzod par ⑨mdzod cig ces/ /'di ltar lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /yon bdag khyim du zhi bde dang / /bde pho )legs cho ga'i rim pa 0bya/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyin sreg gitso/ /yan lag kun 'byung 'bras rab bshad/ /sa dang sa bzhi ⑫zhing byas pa'i/ /thab kyi yan lag yon bdag rgyas/ /mar 0gyis 'byor pa thams cad byed/ /yam shing gzi brjid rnam 'phel ba'o/ /bud shing lhag par dpa' bar byed/ /ku shas 8thams cad srung bar byed/ /yungs kur tshedakar pos ⑩zhi bar byed/ /'bras kyis rgyas par byed par bshad/ /til gyis sdig pa 'joms rig bya/ /so bas nor dang 'bru rnams 'gugs/ / mā gas pho)stobs ni chen por byed/ /nas kyis rlung gi poshugs rab ster/ / drur bas ri du)tshe ni 'phel bar byed/ /gro yis nad ni 'joms par byed/ /'o ma rko 7sbrang rtsis shes 78—843

rab 'phel/ /lag pan gyis ni bde kun ster/ /mes ni 'dod don dngos grub ste0tsho/ /rab 'dod lhas ②ni grol bar 465①/ /lhag ma las kyi rjes mthun par④la/ /zhi sogs las byas shes par bya/ /dgang gzar ⑤shes rab blugs gzar ⑥thabs/ /de gnyis sbyar ba gnyis med bsgomasti/ /de las nges 'byung mar gyi rgyun/ /ye shes chen po'i bdud rtsir 'dod/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i bdag nyid kyi/ /me ni de yis yang dag mchod/ /'di ltar sbyin sreg ⑧gang byed la/ /skal bzang dngos grub rab tu ster/ /'di ni sbyin sreg langes par bstan ⑩pa'i rim par phye ba ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas las ni phonyerab 'byam 8'byung / /dngos grub sna tshogs go 'phang sngagasarkyunyel/ /sna tshogs las kyi 'bras 'byung ba/ /yang dag par ni rab tu bshad / /oṃ na maḥ thra shā na bā si de8/ ma hā kā la 8a nu stoyo0/ tabya 0shā/oṃ tsa la pra tsa la/ lā la lā la 8ya/ de ba liṅga yiswā hā/ bsnyen pa khri byas te/mtshan phyed na hu )ling ga bzung stsol ji srid 'ongs kyi bar de srid du bzlas par bya ste gong bu dgug pa'o/ /oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍi 'ji ma ke byashi/ dhū ma bibyu smyu twe ④/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de ba da/ a.ā na 0ya swā hā/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthil du sen rtsis 0ri rab bris la/ de'i nang gi zur gyi cha dul yi ge trīḥ0bzhi dbus su sngags kyi tshig bris te/ gnon cing bzlas na dbang du byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha gu na da ha ⑥pa tsa dubi t+t+waṃ sa ya yo sau mā dur ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ grog ④mkhar gyi sa ba'i rnam pa lnga dang bsres sapa las mtho gang tsam gyi bā su ki tsobyas te/ ka ra bī byara'i lhug mas chu tsogator zhing / gu gul 78wa 844

gyis bar ma chad ①par bdugs (2)te/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma byin na nyi ma bdun na chu'i rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /ci ①ste mi 'bebs na 4)nyi ma bdun pa la dum bu tso)dum bur byas te bum par bcug ste (5)chu bo la bskur na ⑦char 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /char dbab pa'i go cha'o(nye/ /oṃ ga ga a ri ga ga swā hā / sngags 'dis gdong bkrus te/ rdo ba la lan bdun bzlas pa byas na su yang 0rung ba'i sgo'i bu gar bcug na kha bcing ba 7byed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ mū kā stiṣ+ṭhan+ti mū kā gats+tshani mu kāḥkā dhani māṃ ga lo/ mū kā māṃ mū tra pu ri ṣe ṇa/ de ba dat+ta dhi/su mu khaṃ bas mi swā hānyan/ khyu mchog gi lci sgo ba sa la ma lhung ba blangs te/gang su yang 8rung ba'i bu gar gzhug copa byas na tsotha snyad brjod pa'i kha bcing ⑩bar 'gyur te/ bklags 32pas 'grub pa'o/ /oṃ na mo ni khā lha /ltar bā ya/ tsi ri tsi ri ki rā ta rū pe ṇa/ mu ṣi kā nī tuṇ+ḍa bas mi/ maska ṭo/ shri gā la/sa: ṛ khyo bā rā hā dī 〉du )/ si ri si ri/ khi li khi pyo skyeli swā hā/ sngags 'dis lag pa ya gcig gam/ rdo ba la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas nas khyim mam ⑤/ zhing ngam ldum ra'i sa zur bzhir rdo ba bcug na nye bar 'tshe ba med par 'gyur ro/ /yang na dug dang / lan tshwa sosnyedang / ske (nyetshe dang / yungs kur tsodang / la phug gi sa bon dang / dha zhu du ra'i sa bon dang / nag po chen po'i sa bon gyi rdzas 'di dag ma he dang phag pa dang ce 2nyespyang rnams kyi khrag dang bsres te/ yang dag par sbyar nas bcu bzhi'i nyi ma la me tog dang /bdug pa la gtor ma byas te/ de'i rjes la lag pa g.yas pas yang dag par bzung ⑥ste/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub swe )byas nas khro bo'i gistengag gis 4)bzlas te/phyogs bzhir sbas na mtshams bcad pa dang ra ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ trī 78—845

sdi rtsu hu)phaṭa bisna biskyo ②swā hā/ sngags 'di ba lang gi rtsi ②ba la mngon par bsngags ④te chu'i gnas su bcug na zho rnams rnam par chud zos par 'gyur te/'o ma gtor bas ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ re ban+ta swā mi nergya/ tre+e lo kyā yisnyi pa ta ye/ ku ru ku ru/ gats+tsha gats+tsha/ bha k+ṣa ya bha k+ṣa ya/ ne tra ro gā si ri si ri/nā sha ②ya nā sha ya hūm̐ laphaṭa phaṭa dz+rī dz+rī ⑨su hā/ mig nad la bya ba pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a ru ṇi ༅rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ chu la yongs su bzlas te/ mig bkrus na ⑩mig nad 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /sman ba la'i rtsa 0ba dum bu bdun du byas te/lag pa la bcings na rims 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /a pā marga'i 0rtsa ba bcings na rims nyin bzhi pa 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /shing sap+ta 8paṇ+ḍa ⑫blangs te/ sgo rtsa'am lam du sbas na chang ⑩rnam par nyams par 'gyur te/bton ༷ na ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na ma :: ku sha 8ku lu ku lu swā hā/phug ron gyi brun dang / lham bu chu gsher dang / stong yizil dang / gu gul dang ske/ shing tsha dang / chu zhu srin sen mo dang / ru rta dang / gser shing gi 'bras bu ste/ 'di rnams de bzhin du bu ram dang sbyar la spos su byas te/zong gi snod thams cad la bdugs zhunyen tshong ( nyepa rnams rnyed pa bzang bar 'gyur rol/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa (3ti suska mu khi tsā muṇ+ḍi tsi ri mi ri pā tā (seke/ a mu ke ba sha mā na ( nyeya swā hā/ ru rta 4nyeshu dag 0dbang po'i nasadu/ /yungs kur ⑩ta ka du )ra'i me togazhu /sug smel de bzhin klu'i me tog /sardza ra sa cha mnyam byas/ /de dag gis ni rdzas la bdugs/ /tshong sani myur du zhu'ong bar 'gyur/ /yi ge ya gnyis kha sbyar byas/ /dbus su ming ni sbyar byas te/ /rlung gis khyer ba'i shing lo gzung son/ /de yi lo ma la bri bya/ /khu yi sgro yi smyu mgu dang / /snag mtsha 78—846
